skyes rabs/ spyoX/ (187)3386 sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po/ 3dang po/ gzhon nu sgu bltams pa'i le'u/ 3gnyis pa/ btsun mo'i 'khor na gnas pa'i le'u/ 15gsum pa/ thugs skyo ba skyes pa'i le'u/ 23bzhi pa/ bud med kyis gegs byas pa'i le'u/ 32lnga pa/ phyi rol du mngon par byung ba'i le'u/ 41drug pa/ bsngags ldan phyir la bzlog pa'i le'u/ 53bdun pa/ dka' thub kyi nags su zhugs pa'i le'u/ 60brgyad pa/ btsun mo'i 'khor smre sngags bton pa'i le'u/ 67dgu pa/ gzhon nu rjes su tshol ba'i le'u/ 79bcu pa/ bzo sbyangs sngon du song ba'i le'u/ 90bcu gcig pa/ 'dod pa la rnam par smod pa'i le'u/ 951

bcu gnyis pa/ ring 'phur dang lhag spyod kyi drung du gshegs pa'i le'u/ 105bcu gsum pa/ bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i le'u/ 116bcu bzhi pa/ mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i le'u/ 126bco lnga pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i le(1/ 137bcu drug pa/ slob ma mang po dang ldan pa'i le'u/ 145bcu bdun pa/ nyan thos chen po rab tu gshegs par mdzad pa'i le'u/ 154bco brgyad pa/ mgon med zas sbyin la rjes su ston pa'i le'u/ 159bcu dgu pa/ yab dang sras mjal ba'i le'u/ 170nyi shu pa/ rgyal byed kyi tshal rab tu bzhes pa'i le'u/ 178nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ las kyi sbyo/na —— mkhye(1/ 186nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ a mra skyong ma'i nags gzigs pa'i le'u/ 193nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ sku che'i 'du byed byin gyis brlabs pa'i le'u/ 198nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ lits+tsha bī rnams la thugs brtse ba'i le'u/ 205nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ mya ngan las 'da' bar gshegs pa'i le'u/ 211nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba chen po'i le'u/ 219nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ mya ngan la sa 'da' ba bsngags pa'i le'u/ 233nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ sku gdung rnam par bgo ba'i le'u/ 244'phags pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad/sa dbang bzang po dang blo gros rgyal pos bsgyur/bsnyur mchan/(255) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(276)3387 byang chub sems dpa'i skyes pa'i rabs kyi chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi/ 277snyan dngags mkhan chen po slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kha che shākya shrī bzang po 2

dang / lo tsā ba dge slong byams pa'i dpal byis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(286) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(287)3388 rgyal po la gtam bya ba rin po che'i phreng ba/ 288dang po/ mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 288ba/3)bsgyu nga / ches95 skyab cesab byu1 pa/:re /ba(1/ 297gsum pa/ byang chub kyi tshogs bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 306bahā/ pa/ rgya'ab dzes:re zhesa'ab brtagan pa:re mkhye(1/ 316lnga pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i le'u/ 325slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dz+nyā na gar+bha dang /lo tsā ba dge slong klu'i rgyal mtshan rmis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/slad kyi rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka na ka warma dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis rgya dpe gsum la gtugs nas legs par bcos/bsdur mchan/(335) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(339)3389 rin po che'i phreng ba'i rgya cher bshad pa/ 340slob dpon mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra pra bhā dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(436) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(444)

3390 rmi lam yid bzhin nor bu'i gtam/ 445slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad/kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shrī ra tha dang / lo tsā ba dge slong grags 'byor shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(4go) bci ra 'bras re'u mig(4go)3391 /byecad /ba/sde rngan/ste(ma/ 'ju50slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(452) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(452)3392 —stepan pa 'bas par2)sa pa:re ba/taskyab/ ༷453slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad/kha che paṇ+ḍi ta shrī ra tha dang / lo tsā ba dge slong grags 'byor shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(455) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(455)339na yon tan bdun yongs su brjod pa'i gtam/ 456slob dpon dbyig gnyen byi mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta gaṅgā ta ra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin r+ṣa bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(459) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(459)3394 gres(ba /byezugabag /) sgyun/stezug/ 460slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dza rarnya na dang /zhu d+ku gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang

pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(462) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(462)3395 tshul khrims kyi gtam gyi 'grel pa/ 463slob dpon gsal grags kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(gyen) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(gre4)3396 cesathab/tham /) sgyun/stecam/ 4༅5slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta gaṅgā ta ra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin r+ṣa bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(rga0) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(na0)3397 :sgo shesam pa brgyad kyi gtacan/ ༷ 481slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī a dzi ta bha dra dang / zhu ra gyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(na9) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(go0)3398 legs par bshad pa rin po che za ma tog lta bu'i gtam/ go1dang po/ bsod nams la spro ba bskyed pa'i gtam/ go1gnyis pa/ chos nyan pa la spro ba bskyed pa'i gtam/ go2gsum pa/ mi'i skye bo dkon pa'i gtam/ 493/ba/de tshon/ /spyocad 2pa/re 2na/stozug/ 'tsho'aju5

lnga pa/ bsod nams kyi gtam/ 496drug pa/ sgu gzugs kyi gtam/ 498bdun pa/ khrus kyi gtam/ 499brgyad pa/ gur kum la sogs pa'i gtam/ ༷ 500dgu pa/ gdugs phul ba'i gtam/ 500bcu pa/ ring bsrel gyi gtam/ 501bcu gcig pa/ maṇ+ḍal gyi gtam/ 501bcu gnyis pa/ zas kyi gtam/༷ 502bcu gsum pa/ btung ba'i gtam/ 503bcu bzhi pa/ gos kyi gtam/ 504bco lnga pa/ me tog la sogs pa'i gtam/ 505bcu drug pa/ phyag gi gtam/ 505bcu bdun pa/ snang ba'i gtam/ 506bco brgyad pa/ mar rnge'i gtam/ 507bcu dgu pa/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i gtam/ 508nyi shu pa/ mal cha dang stan gyi gtam/ ༷ 509nyi shu gcig pa/ zhing gi gtam/ 509nyi shu gnyis pa/ sna tshogs bsdus pa'i gtam/ 511nyi shu gsum pa/ tshul khrims kyi gtam/ 516nyi shu bzhi pa/ bzod pa'i gtam/ 518nyi shu lnga pa/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam/ 518nyi shu drug pa/ bsam gtan gyi gtam/ 519nyi shu bdun pa/ shes rab kyi gtam/ 520nyi shu brgyad pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i gtam/ 521

slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ru dra dang /dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(522) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(524)3399 nyu)na ci 61ga bstuno spang baḍire gtacas/ 525slob dpon ma ti tsi tras mdzad/rgya garakhya mkhan po birtse bha dra dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(531) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(532)3400 dresaspyad 25/re /dubag /) rngan/stezum/ 533slob dpon ma ti tsi tras mdzad/rgya gar mkhan po a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(536) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(536)3401 tshod(pecad 25/re thab//stezum/ ༷ 537slob dpon chen po sa 'tsho byin gyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(544) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(545)

byang yig dzasti (188)3402 chos smra ba dang dam pa'i chos nyan pa la gus par bya ba'i gtam/ ga goslob dngo/na sa 'tsho byin gyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po gnas brtan a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang / lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(555) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(556)3403 ched du brjod pa'i gtam/ 557drang srong ra po zla bas mdzad/lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(559) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(559)3404 mi rtag pa'i don gyi gtam/ 560snyan dngags mkhan r+ṣa po dga' ba'i dbang pos mdzad/kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta bi na ya dang / lo tsā ba grags 'byor shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(561) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(561)3405 legs pa'i lam bstan pa'i gtam/ 5628

phun sum tshogs pa dang po/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba/ 562phun sum tshogs pa gnyis pa/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyis mdzes pa zhes bya ba/ 592phun sum tshogs pa gsum pa/ nying nge 'dzin gyi yan lag rnam par dag pa /sgo/ma /rgya /ba/ /tshon rdo slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po di paṃ ka ra shrī dzha na dang / lo tsā ba chen po dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(623) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(628)1go /re /)3406 spyan ngab 2bste: (bas 95zug ba/gzug pa/ ༷ ༷ 629slob dpon bram ze btsun nga chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyi zhal snga nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po kurtse ka ra barma dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dbe+e slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(638) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(639)3407 zum/ spyangacad /ba/ga(pa /ba 6'a 0slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(644) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(645)9

3408 mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam bstan pa/ 646slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(6go) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(6go)3409 dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ 650sems can dmyal ba'i rabs 650/byecad par11/sde zang/bathag 653(pe tsho12natham /) zab/batheg 65zhengami'i rab/ma ༷ (3ru 5(be+e capa (pecad /) bab /bathag 658lha'i ra/ba25 (358slob dpon btsun pa chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā ka ra dang / zhu ra byi lo tsā ba gtsang de ben tra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(660) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(661)3410 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i nyes dmigs bshad pa/ 662slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(663) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(664)10

3411 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis dge slong rab gsal gzhon nu la springs pa'i 'phrin yig ༷ 666rgya gar kyi mkhan po sarba tshwa de ba dang / lo tsā ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(668) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(668)34༄12 thab/debag pa///re rjesapa (perngan 669slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzha de ba dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(684) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(686)3413 :sgongab skyab 'ab rjesaparab nga/:re rjesapar 6bab/ 687slob dpon chen po tsan dra go mis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dz+nyā de ba dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(704) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(706)3414 rgyal po chen po ka nis ka la springs pa'i spring yig ༷ 707slob dpon ma ti tsi tras mdzad/11

rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de rin chen mchog gis bsgyur/a tsār+ya dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(716) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(717)3415 sems rin po che rnam par sbyang ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba'i /byesgyur /yecan 718'dod chags kyi gnyen po bshad pa/ 718zhe sdang gi gnyen po bshad pa/ 725rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba yid la byed pa bshad pa/ 727sems rin po che rnam par sbyang ba mdor bsdus te bstan pa/ 729slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' chen po dgra las rgyal ba gsang bas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsār+ya du lo pa dang / lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(735) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(736)3416 /spo cam (5 rjesapang thab/ 737dang po/ 'dod pa spang ba'i le'u/ 737gnyis pa/ sred pa spang ba'i le'u/ ༷ 740gsum pa/ bag med pa spang ba'i le'u/ 742bzhi pa/ nyon mongs pa spong ba'i le'u/ 74512

dge slong dgon pa pas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsār+ya bi na ya tsān dra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(747) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(7na)spri3zhen1ba/ /zu par 1nga /ba ༷ ba/'tshopaṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa chen po sad dza na chen pos mdzad/kha che'i mkhan po ma hā dza na dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(756) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(757)3418 dri ma med pa rin po che'i spring yig ces bya ba/ 758gnas brtan mkhas pa chen po dī paṃ shrī dz+nyā nas mdzad/bla ma de nyid dang / lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(763) bsnyur 'bras re'u mig(763)3419 rgya'ab dzes bzu ba ba springs pa:re spring yig 764rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shrī dzā ga ta mi tra ā nan+das mdzad/rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug de nyid dang /bod kyi lo chung gnubs tshul khrims shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(770) bsnyur 'bras re'u mig(771)13

3420 bshes pa'i spring yig gi rgya cher bshad pa tshig gsal ba/ 772slob dpon blo gros chen pos mdzad/rgya gar kyi mkhan po sarba dz+nyā de ba dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bsde dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(868) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(879)3421 slob ma la spring ba'i phrin yig gi dka' 'grel/ 880slob dpon bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta chen po su ta ga shrī mi tra dang / lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(903) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(905)3422 byesangab zug 'ab rjesapar nga :re parabresgo'ab nga// 906slob dpon mkhas pa chen po shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi nā ya tsan dra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(934) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(936)3423 lho za mo tshangs dbyangs la sdug bsngal gye bye brag bstan pa /ba/nurngon/ma (so/ / 937)slob dpon ka ma la bhā las mdzad/bsdur mchan/(942) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(942)14

3424 rje 'bangs dang bod btsun rnams la spring yig bzhugs so// 943/shā(ba 11 (ba thab:sdopa thag ngas 9zhen3blon po rnams 'ab brdzangs pa/ 94na14zug byebyen rnacabathab 15 babasdongs pa/ 950spyi'i ban de rnams la brdzangs pa/ 950slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(953) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(955)3425 dad skyed sgon ma bzhugs so/ / 956slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad/bsdur mchan/(967) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(968)3426 cad(pe:re 13pa /ba/ 969rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang /lo tsā ba ban de tshul khrims yon tan gyis bsgyur cing / dge slong rin chen bzang pos bcos nas zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(977) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(978)3427 mya ngan med pa'i sgo nas klu btul ba'i le'u'o/ / 979rgya gar gyi mkhan po gnas brtan a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang / dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(989) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(990)15

3428 spyad1go paraducad (1cad 15pa /ba/ 991dpal 'byor rab bstan gyi phyag dpe rgya dpe las zha lu lo tsā bas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(999) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1000)3429 gnas brtan (3na drang ba/ ༷ ༷ ༷ 1001slob dpon bha ba skan+da pa zhes bya bas mdzad/ā tsār+ya dzi na mi tra dang / ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1022) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1025)3430 bstan pa'i gtad rabs bzhugs so/ / 1026'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1029) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1029)na431 dgra bcom dge 'dun 'phel gyis lung bstan pa bzhugs so/ / 1030dgra bcom pa dge 'dun 'phel gyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(10gye) bsdura'abras re'u mig(10go)3432 li yul lung bstan pa bzhugs so/ / 1050bsdur mchan/(1rka99) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1106)16

༄༅/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po/) ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bud+dhā tsa ri ta nyam hā kā zhe bya nā ma/ bod skad du/ sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan yon tan tshogs kyis gang / /bdag nyid chen po sems can gyi/ /don mdzad yang dag sangs rgyas dang / /chos dang dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal/ /bu ram shing par mthu mnyam bu ram shing pa'i rgyud/ /thub dka' shākya rnams la spyod pa rnam dag pa/ /'phrog byed zla ba lta bur skye dgu rnams la sdug /rgyal po zas gtsang zhes bya'i ming can byung bar gyur/ /dbang po dang mtshungs de yi bdag po ldan ma yin/ /nus mthu rjes mtshungs gzi brjid lha mo bde sogs dang / /pad+mo can 'dra phun sum tshogs pa sa bzhin brtan/ /sgyu ma chen mo zhes bya dpe med sgyu 'dra byung / /mi skyong rgyal po 'di ni de dang thabs cig tu/ /dga' ba 96—3

nyer ldan rnam thos sras kyi dpal bzhin rol/ /de nas yang dag ting 'dzin ldan pa'i rig ma bzhin/ /sdig bral ma de mngal ni rnam par gzung rmyebar gyur//mngal dang nye bar ldan pa nyid kyi sngon rol du/ /de ni gnyid song glang po'i dbang bo dkar po zhig /rang nyid la ni rab tu zhugs sogs mthong gyur la/ /de yi mtshan ma nyam thag pa nas nyathob ma yin/ /lha dang rab tu mtshungs pa de yi lha mo de/ /mngal byis 1rigs kyi dpal ni rab tu 'dren byed cing / /sgyu ma ngal ba dang ni mya ngan sgyu med par/ /gtsang la nyon mongs med pa'i dgon par blo gros mdzad/ /de ni lum bi zhes bya'i nags mthar gyur pa'i sa/ /sna tshogs spyon shing sna tshogs shing rta mngon dga' bar/ /bsam gtan la bzod dbe+en pa'i nags kyi mtha' bzhed ma/ /'gro ba'i ched dang gnas phyir mi skyong la zhus so/ /de yi chos dang ldan la 'phags pa'i zhe 'dod dag /rnam par shes nas ya mtshan dga' ba yis gang ste/ /zhi ba'i grong nas sa yi bdag po gshegs gyur te/ /de yi dga' ba'i rgyu yin rnam par rgyu phyir min/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i nags der rgyal po'i bdag ldan ma/ /rab tu bltam 5pa'i dus ni yang dag mngon gzigs shing / /bla re nye bar phul ba'i gzims mal rab thob ste/ /mi mo stong phrag dag gis mngon par dga' bar byed/ /de nas skar ma rgyal rab ldan par gyur pa'i tshe/ /brtul zhugs legs par 'dus byas lha mo de yi ni/ /rtsib selogs dag nas 'jig rten phan phyir sras bltams te/ /tshor ba dang ni bral zhing nad dang bral ba nyid/ /ji ltar brla skyes brla nas rgya chen lag pa nas/ /dbang po dang mtshungs nga la nu ni spyi bo nas / /mtshan ldan nyid kyang lag pa'i cha shas gsang ba nas/ /rnam pa de 96—4

ltar de yi skye ba byung bar gyur1/ /mngal nas mngon par nges par byung ba gzugs mdzes te/ /nam mkha' dag las 'phros zhu'adra skye gnas las ma skyes/ /bskal pa gcig min rnams su bsgoms pa'i bdag nyid ni/ /gang zhig yang dag rab tu shes na skyes gyur blun po min/ /nyi ma gzhon nu sa lam khumangon par babs pa bzhin/ /gsal ba dang ni brtan pas gang zhig mdzes pa ste/ /de ltar shin tu gsal yang nges par rtog pa na/ /ri bong gis mtshan ji ltar mig dag 'phrogs ④ par gyur/ /de ni rang gi lus kyi 'od rab 'bar ba yis/ /sgon ma'i 'od kyang gsal bar byed pa snyeltar bcom ste/ /rin thang chen po 'dzam bu chu gser mdzes pa'i mdog /phyogs rnams thams cad rnam par snang zhing gsal bar mdzad/ /'khrugs pa ma yin yon po'i skyon dag rab bsal zhing / /shin tu brtan pa dang ldan rnam par yangs pa'i 'gros/ /de ltar mi g.yo rab tu brtan pa'i gom pa bdun/ /drang srong skar ma bdun dang rab mnyam gshegs par gyur/ /byang chub phyir dang 'gro la phan pa'i phyir skyes shing //'di ni bdag gi srid pa'i skye ba tha ma zhes/ /seng ge'i 'gros 'dra phyogs bzhi dag tu rnam gzigs nas/ /snod ldan rnams kyi don byed dag kyang smras par gyur—/ /nam mkha' dag las rab babs zla ba'i 'od zer dkar/ /grang dang dro ba'i chu rgyun rnam pa gnyis kyi shugs/ /lus la yang dag reg pas bde ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong de yi spyi bor babs par gyur/ /dpal ldan bla re bres par gser gyis khye'abar zhing mtshan/ /be+e ḍūr+ya yi rkang pa'i gzims mal la gzims pa/ /de la gus phyir gser gyi pad+ma'i phyag mnga' ba'i—/ /gnod sbyin bdag rnams kun nas yongs su bskor nas gnas/ /mi 96—5

mngon gyur pa'i lha rnams kyis kyang nam mkha' la/ /gang gi mthu las mgo bo yis ni rab btud cing / /kun nas gdung ba skyob pa'i gdugs dkar rnams bzung ste/ /byang chub ched du mchog gi bsngags pa dag kyang smras/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par mchod byas pa'i/ /lto 'phye che rnams khyad 'phags chos la sred pa'i phyir/ /gang la rlung g.yab kyis g.yab gus pa'i mig gzir cing / /man dā hūṃr ba'i me tog rnams kyis yang dag 'thor/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bltams pa'i yon tan gyis tshim pa'i/ /gtsang mar lhag par gnas pa'i rnam dag sems can rnams/ /sdug bsngal nyid du bying ba'i 'gro la phan pa'i phyir/ /lha rnams 'dod chags bral ba na yang dga' bar gyur/ /gang gis rab tu bltams tshe ri rgyal phur bu nyid/ /rlung gis bsnun pa'i gru ltar sa gzhi g.yos gyur zhing / /tsan+dan dang bcas ut+pal pad+ma'i snying po yi/ /char pa dag ni nam mkha'i sprin dang bral las bye babs/ /yid 'ong reg na bde ba'i rlung dag byung gyur te/ /lha yi na bza' dag rgo mngon par 'be+ebs byed cing / /nyi ma de nyid lhag par mngon par gsal ba ste/ /zhi ba'i 'od zer 'dus ma byas pa'i me 'bar ro/ /shar dang byang gi mtshams kyi khang pa'i phyogs gcig na/ /bsil ba'i chu yi khron pa rang byung gyur pa ste/ /pho brang btsun mo'i 'khor rnams ya mtshan gyur rnams kyis/ /gang la bya ba rnams ni stegs bzhin rab tu byas/ /chos dang ldan pa'i lha dang 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /de ni lta snyeba'i don du nags tshal rab gang ste/ /rmad byung ngo mtshar gyur pa nyid kyi shing las kyang / /me tog rnams ni dus ma yin par nges par brul/ /'tshe bar byed pa'i sems can rnams kyang de yi tshe/ /phan tshun dag tu phyin te 96—6

gnod pa mi byed la/ /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten dag na nad gang ji snyed pa/ /de dag rnams kyang 'bad pa med par de tshe bcom/ /mkha' 'gro'i bya ni mtho min sgra sgogs ri dwags kyang / /chu klung dag k+ṇini chu yang zhi bar bab gyur la/ /phyogs rnams rab snang dge ba'i nam mkha' rab mdzes shing / /lha yi rnga rnams mkha' la rab tu grags par gyur/ /rgud byepar gyur la mgon ni nye bar thob nas bzhin/ /'jig rten dag kyang mchog tu rab zhi thob gyur la/ /'jig rten rnams kyi thar pa'i bla ma rab bltams tshe/ /'dod pa'i lha nyid kho na dga' ba med par gyur/ /shin tu ngo mtshar sras kyi skye ba mthong gyur nas/ /mi bdag brtan pa yin yang rnam par 'gyur nas song / /rab dga' skyes pa nyid dang yid mi bde skyes te/ /brtse ba las ni mchi ma rnam pa gnyis byung ngo / /mi ma yin pa'i sras po nyid kyi nus pa dang / /ma yi rang bzhin kyang ni stobs chung nyid kyi phyir/ /grang dang dro ba'i chu dag 'dres pa'i chu klung bzhin/ /lha mo 'jigs pa dang ni dga' bas gang bar 'gyurarngu/ /lhag ma spangs te 'jigs pa nyid ni shes byas nas/ /yid 'ong 'dod pa'i ched du rtogs pa ma yin pa'i/ /bud med rgan mo rnams kyis chobade legs gyur byas shing / /gtsang mar byas te lha rnams dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yi mtshan nyid dag kyang shes shing thos gyur nas/ /spyod dang thos dang tshig la grags thob bram ze rnams//rnam rgyas zhal ni ya mtshan dga' ba yis 'ugang ste/ /dga' dang 'jigs par gyur pa'i mi yi lha la smras/ /mi dag sa la bu ma gtogs pa'i khyad 'phags pa/ /gzhan gang cung zad 'dod min zhi ba de yi phyir/ /khyod kyi sgon ma 'di ni rigs kyi sgon ma ste/ /khyod nyid dga' bar mdzod cig dga' ston da ltar ⑪96—7

bgyi / /de phyir brtan par rnam dpyod med par dgar ①mdzod dang / /rigs ni nges pa nyid du mchog tu 'phel bar 'gyur/ /'di ②ni khyod kyi bu zhes skyes par gyur pa ste/ /'jig rten sdug bsngal dag gis mngon par bcom pa'i mgon / /mchog gyur 'di la mchog gyur gser gyi 'od mnga' zhing / /sgon ma'i 'od zer dag gis mtshan rnams gang gyur pas/ /de nyid rtogs par gyur pa'i thub par 'gyur ba'am/ /yang na mi bdag 1sa stengs 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur/ /sa yi bdag po nyid la gal te dga' 'gyur na/ /stobs dang chos dag gis ni de'i tshe sa stengs suche/ /rgyal po kun gyi thog tu 'di ni gnas 'gyur te/ skar ma'i 'od rnams la ni nyi ma'i 'od bzhin no/ /de ni gal te thar bzhed nags su gshegs gyur na/ /mkhyen dang de nyid kyis ni de tshe sa stengs susnye/ /lugs kun zil gyis mnan nas 'di ni gnas 'gyur te/ /mtho ba kun la ri rab ri yi rgyal po bzhin/ /ji ltar lcags rnams la ni gser dag mchog yin la/ /ri rnams la ni ri rab chu bo rnams la mtsho/ /gza' rnams la ni zla ba gdung ⑥byed rnams la nyi/ /de ltar khyod kyi sras ni rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog /gang gi spyan dag mi 'dzums mig ⑦gzir rnam par spangs pa ste/ /brtan zhing shin tu ring la dkar min spru ma dang / /gzi brjid ldan pa yin yang 'on kyang zhi ba nyid/ /'di ni kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan mnga' ci la min/ /de nas snyeganyis skyes rnams la mi bdag ⑨gis smras pa/ /bdag nyid chen bo mi skyong snga mas ma mthong ba/ /mthong zhes khyad 'di gang yin 'di la rgyu mtshan ci/ /de nas bram ze rnams kyis lnga de nyid la smras pa/ blo dang thos pa las dang grags pa rnams la ni/ /mi skyong sngon dang phyi ma nyid ni 96—8

tshad ma yin⑨/ /dngos po'i lugs la 'dir ni bya ba rgyu yin la/ /'dir yang bdag gi rjodaper brjod dag ni mkhyen par mdzod/ /gang zhig rgyal bo'i bstan bcos shes ldan ngan spong dag /rig byed drang srong de gnyis kyis ni ma byas pa//de dag gi 1sras zhi ba pa wa 2sangs dang ni/ /phur bu yis ni dus kyis 1de nyid bskyed par gyur/ /nyams gyur snga ma rnams kyis ma mthong rig byed gang / /dbyangs can ma yi bu yis kyang ni slar smras pa/ /nus med gnas 'jog gis ni ma byas gyur pa gang / /rgyas pa yis ni de ltar rnam pa mang por brjod/ /'pho byed drang srong chen pos ma bsdebs gyur pa gang / /tshig gi rkang pa grog mkhar gyis ni dang por bskyed/ /gso ba gang yang rgyun shes kyis ni ma mthong ba /phyi nas de ni drang srong rgyun shes bu yis byas/ /gang yang gnyis skyes nyid ni kun shas 'um rnyed pa/ /de ni gting dpogs bu yis rgyal po la thob bo/ /bu ram shing pas dang por ma bsdams gyur pa gang / /rgya mtsho la ni dug bcas kyis kyang mtshams bzung ngo / /slob dpon nyid du bram ze'i rnal 'byor cho ga la//gzhan rnams kyis ma thob pa skyed byed gshegs par gyur/ /khyab 'jug gi ⑦ni grags pa'i las rnams gang yin pa/ /de rnams la ni dpa' bo la sogs stobs med gyur/ /de phyir lang tsho dang ni rigs dag tshad ma yin/ /la la la lar mchog nyid nyer thob 'jig rten na/ /rgyal dang drang srong rnams kyis dzusnga mas ma byas pa/ /de dang de dag rnams ni bu rnams dag gis byas/ /de ltar gnyis skyes de rnams kyis ni yid ches te/ /mi skyong dbugs 'byin dang yang mngon par dga' gyur la/ /mi 'dod the tshom dag ni yid las rnam bstsal ⑪te//rab tu dga' ba nyid la lhag par 'dzegs par gyur/ /dga' ba yis ni gnyis 96—9

skyes dam pa de rnams la/ /bkur ste sngon du 'gro ba'i nor rnams rab phul te/ /ji skad smras bzhin 'di ni sa yi bdag por gyur/ /rgas pa thos 1nas nags rnams su ni 'gro bar shog /de nas mtshan ma rnams dang dka' thub stobs las ni/ /skye ba mthar mdzad bltams pa de rgo rtogs gyur nas/ /dam pa'i chos la gus pa'i shākya'i dbang phyug gite / /gnas su dkar min drang srong chen por snyegashegs par gyur/ /tshangs pa'i dpal nyid kyis kyang ngudaka' thub dpal gyis ni/ /'bar ba'i tshang rig rnams kyi tshang rig de la ni/ /rgyal po'i bla mas gus pa dang ni bkur ste'i phyir/ /mi dbang pho brang du ni rab tu spyan drangs so/ /de ni sa bdag btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nye logs su/ /gzhon nu bltams pa la ni dga' ba'i shugs kyis 'ongs/ /dka' thub mchog las dang ni rgas pa la brten byenas/ /brtan pa nags kyi 'du shes kyis ltar rnam par zhugs/ /de nas thub pa gdan la gnas pa de la mi skyong gis/ /zhabs bsil mchod yon sngon 'gro yang dag rab mchod nas/ /sngon tshe gnas mchog la ni mtha' can lhas bzhin des/ /ji ltar nye bar spyod la snyan gsan phab pa'o//bdag gi thurigs ni rjes su hūṃbazung phyir nor ldan des/ /gang zhig bdag la gzigs phyir bcom ldan nyer gshegs la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzod cig zhi ba ci bgyi bgyi/ /kho bo slob ma lags so thugs rjes dumadzad par rigs/ /de ltar mi skyong gis ni dngos po thams cad kyis/ /nye bar gsol btab gyur pa'i thub pa ji lta bzhin/ /rab rgyas yangs pa'i spyan ni ya mtshan dang bcas pas / /zab pa dang ni brtan tsu7pa'i tshig rnams smras pa'o/ /chos 'dod gtong ba dang ldan 'gron la snyug cing phangs⑩/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed la 96—10

'thad pa 'di yin la/ /sems pa ①rjes 'gro ye shes lang tsho rjes mthun pa/ /khyod kyi blo gros gnyen gang de ltar bdag la yin/ /de dang de ni gang gis mi skyong drang srong des/ /phra mo'i chos kyi /snyenor rnams rab tu thob byas nas/ /rtag par cho ga bzhin du mchod sbyin byas gyur pa/ /dka' thub rnams kyis phyug cing nor rnams dag gis dbul/ /bdag gi nye bar 'ongs la dgos pa gang yin pa/ /bdag gi de ni gson mdzod dga' bar nyer song spyod/ /byang chub rtogs pa'i ched du khyod kyi bye sras bltams zhes/ /lha yi ngag dag bdag gi nyi ma'i lam du thos/ /ngag de thos nas dang ni yid la bsgoms nas dang / /mtshan ma rnams kyis shes nas de nas nye bar 'ongs/ /brgya byin gyi ni rgyal mtshan yang dag bsgreng ba bzhin/ /shākya'i rigs kyi rgyal mtshan blta bar 'dod pa yis/ /zhes pa'i tshig 'di de ltar thos par gyur nas ni/ /mi dbang rab tu dga' bas kun nas g.yos gyur te/ /yum gyi pang du son las gzhon nu blangs nas ni/ /dka' thub nor can la ni yang dag bstan par gyurapya/ /de nas drang srong che des zhabs la 'khor los mtshan/ /phyag dang zhabs kyi sor mo dra bas 'brel ba dang / /glang po bzhin du mdoms trenub smin ma mdzod spur bcas / /ya mtshan dang bcas rgyal po'i tre7sras ni mthong bar gyur/ /lha mo'i pang na zhugs pa me yi bu bzhin du/ /ma ma'i pang du 37bzhugs pa mngon par mthong nas ni/ /byung gyur spru ma'i mtha' ru mchi ma rnams byung ste/ /dbugs med gyur nas gyen du lta la zhal phyogs gyur/ /mig dag mchi mas yongs gang dkar min mthong nas ni/ /bu la brtse ba'i phyir ni mi skyong 'dar gyur te/ /mchi ma dang ni gre ba kha zhing ldab ldib bcas/ /thal mo sbyar zhing yan lag 96—11

btud de dris par gyur/ /gang gi lus ni lha las bar na cung zad cig /rang rngugi skye ba ngo mtshar mang po'i sgon ma ste/ /gang gi don ni mchog tu 'gyur bar smra ba ste/ /rab tu mthong nas brtan pa gang phyir mchi ma 'ong bcom ldan gzhon nu brtan pa'i tshe can yin snyam mam/ /bdag gi mya ngan ched du skyes pa min nam ci/ /bdag la chu yi snyim pa ci zhig ltar rnyed de/ /'di ni dus kyis 'thung phyir nye bar 'ongs ma yinakhru/ /bdag gi snyan grags gter ni mi zad yin snyam mam/ /nges par bdag gi ⑦ rigs kyi lag nor yin snyam ci/ /bde bar pha rol du ni rab tu 'gro snyam mam/ /gnyid par gyur kyang bu ni phye ba'i mig gcig yod/ /bdag gi rigs kyi myu gu skyes pa pyam rgyas par/ /yongs su skams pa'i skal ba can zhig min snyam mam/ /khyab bdag myur bar gsungs shig bdag la zhi ba med/ /gnyen 'dun rnams kyis ⑤bu la brtse ba khyed kyis rig /de ltar mi 'dod blo yis 'khrul ba byung gyur pa/ /rig nas mi dbang rgyal la thub pa des smras pa/ /bdag gis smras pa gang de the tshom med pa de/ /mi skyong khyed kyi blo gros gzhan gang ma gyur cig /'di yi gzhan gyur mtshon min bdag gi rnam 'gyur te/ /'on kyang rang la slu bar rab mtshon rnam par 'khrugs/ /skye ba zad pa'i rnyed par bla min rtogs 'upa po/ /'di skyes bdag gi 'gro ba la ni dus yin no/ /rgyal srid rnam par spangs nas yul rnams la mi gnas/ /'bad pa drag po rnams kyis de nyid thob byas nas/ /'di ni 'gro la gti mug mun pa rnam 'joms phyir/ /ye shes rang bzhin nyi ma rab tu 'bar bar 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho nad rnams bkram pa'i dbu mub can/ /rga ba'i dba' rlabs 'chi ba'i shugs ni drag po las/ /'gro ba nyam thag byeng 96—12

bar gyur rnams 'di yis ni/ /ye shes gru bo chen po yis ni sgol bar byed/ /shes rab chu yi shugs la brten ṭ+wāpa'i tshul khrims ngogs/ /ting nge 'dzin ni bsil ba'i brtul zhugs ngang pa 'phyo/ /'di yi mchog gi chos kyi chu bos rab bskor ḍa la/ /sred pas nyam thag gson pa'i 'jig rten 'thung bar byed/ /sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag dang yul gyis bsgribs rnams dang / /'khor ba'i 'brog dgon 'jigs par gnas pa rnams la ni/ /lam rab chud zos rnams la lam 'gro rnams bzhin du/ /'dis ni rnam par dag pa'i lam dag 'chad par 'gyur/ /yul gyi bud shing can gyi 'dod chags me yis ni/ /'jig rten skye bo rnam par bsregs 1par gyur pa la/ /sos ka'i tha mar sprin chen gyes ni char bzhin du/ /'di yi rnguchos kyi char gyis rab tu sem byed 'gyur/ /sred pa'i sgo gtan ma rig mun pa'i sgo glegs can/ /sgo la skye dgu rnams kyi 'thon pa'i rgyu las ni/ /'di yis mchog rab kun nas rnyed par dka' ba yi/ /dam pa'i chos kyi sgras ni rnam par 'byed par 'gyur/ /rang gi las kyi zhags pa rnams kyis rizhiyongs dkris shing / /sdug bsngal dag gis mngon par zil non rten med pa'i/ /'jig rten rnams kyi rdzogs pa'i byang chub brnyes gyenas kyang / /chos kyi rgyal po 'dis ni 'ching ba mthar mdzad 'gyur/ /rmongs 3sam 'dod pa'i bde ba yis sam rgyags las rung / /'di yi mthar thug bye chos gang thos par mi byed pa/ /mi yi 'jig rten 'dir de mya ngan bya ba'i gnas/ /de phyir khyed nyid 'di la mya ngan ma byed cig /yon tan rgya mtsho 'di las 'khrul gyur bdag gi ni/ /bsam gtan rnams ni thob kyang don byas med nyid de/ /de yi dam chos ma thos pa la kho bo ni/ /mtho ris dag na gnas kyang phun tshogs 96—13

med pa snyam/ /de ltar don thos bshes dang bcas shing btsun mor bcas /yid mi bde ba dor nas mi dbang dgar gyur la/ /rnam pa de ltar bdag gi bu ni 'di'o zhes/ /des ni bdag nyid la ni snying bo ldan par bsams 2 /'phags pa'i chos rnams kyis kyang 'gro bar 'gyur ro zhes/ /bsam pa'i rnam par gzung krubya snying la byas gyur te/ /nges par 'di ni mi sdug chos kyi phyogs min la/ /rigs rgyud nyams pa las ni 'on kyang 'jigs pa mthong / de nas bu la rnam par 'khrugs pa'i rgyal po la/ /bu yi nges pa'i de nyid rig par byas nas su/ /gus bcas gyen du gzugs mthong dkar min thub pa ni / /rlung gi lam gyis ji ltar 'ongs par gshegs par gyur/ /blo gros byas pa'i sring mo'i bu yang mthong nas ni/ /thub pa'i gsung mnyan pa dang de yi lugs la ni//rnam mang rjes su brtse ba yis ni legs pa des/ /sdug pa'i thubu bzhin du ni sbyor ba byed du bcug /sras po skyes pas tshim pa'i mi yi bdag po yang /yul la song ba'i 'ching ba rnams ni rnam spangs te/ /sras kyi yid 'ong sras po bltams pa'i las dag ni/ /rigs dang 'dra bar ji lta ba bzhin byed du bcug /zhag bcu yongs su 'das par gyur pa nyid kyi tshe/ /mchog gi dga' ba rab ldan stoms par gyur pa'i yidakru/ /sras las mchog tu 'gyur phyir lha yi mchod pa ni//bzlas brjod dang ni sbyin sreg bkra shis la sogs byas/ /gzhan yang brgya dang stong phrag yongs su gang ba'i grangs/ /brtan dang stobs ldan bu rnams gser gyi rwar bcas shing / /rgas pa nye bar 'ongs min sba snyem ldan pa'i ba/ /rang gi sras 'phel phyir na gnyis skyes rnams la byin/ /de nas snyoms pa'i bdag nyid kyis ni rnam mang yul/ /rang sems tshim par byed pa'i bya ba rnams byas 96—14

nas / /yon tan ldan zhing dge ba'i yud tsam nges pa na/ /grong khyer rab tu 'jug la dga' bas blo gros mdzad/ /de nas mche gnyis mche ba las byung rin thang che/ /dkar po'i me tog gis spras nor bu'i sgron/ /khri la dge ba'i phyir ni lha mo sras ldan ma/ /lha rnams la ni rab tu btud nas bsnyen lku par gyur / /de nas gnas brtan skye mo rjes 'brang sras mgon ma/ /bdag po ldan ma grong la mdun du rab zhugs nas/ /mchod ldan lha na 3snalha rnams kyis ni brgya byin bzhin/ /mi bdag nyid kyang grong ba'i tshogs kyis gshegs par gyur/ /de nas gdong drug skyes pas yid ches 1dbang phyug bzhin/ /shākya'i rgyal pos grong khyer rnam par khyab mdzad de/ /zhal ni dga' bas rab gang 'di dang 'di zhes pa'i/ /srid 'phel rgyas pa dang ni grags dang snyan pa mdzad—/ /de nas mi yi bdag po'i sras bltams cher skyes pas/ /ser skya zhes pa'i grong khyer ljongs dang bcas pa de/ /gnod sbyin grong na phun tshogs 'dod pa skyes pa na/ /lha yi bu mo rnams kyis bkram bzhin dga' bar gyur/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ gzhon nu sku bltams pa'i le'u ste dang bo'o// //skye dang rga ba mthong song bdag skyes bdag pham de'i/ /skyes pa nas brtsams mi nyid nyi mas pyargyal po de/ /chu yi shugs rnams kyis ni chu bo sen byu bzhin / /nor dang glang po rta dang bshes rnams 'phel bar gyur/ /nor rnams dang ni rin po che dang bzang po'i gser/ /de dang de ni byas dang ma byas pa nyid kyang / /yid la re ba yi rang bzhin du byekhur gyur pa/ /de la 96—15

gcig tu phan pa'i cha shas gter rnyed gyur/ /gang zhig pad+ma dang mtshungs gnyis 'thung rnams kyis kyang / /dkyil 'khor 'di la nye bar 'ong bar mi nus pa'i / /gangs she7dang ldan pa'i glang chen chang gis dregs de rnams/ /'bad pa las kyang gzhan du de la nye bar gnas/ /sna tshogs mtshan mas mtshan zhing gsar ba'i gser sga dang / /de bzhin gzhan rnams dag gis brgyan byas rngog ma 'phyang / /stobs dang byams pa dang ni nor gyis thob pa yi/ /'di yi mgyogs 'gro rnams kyis ④grong khyer bye mar byas/ /de bzhin 'di yi yul 'khor du ni tshim dang rgyas/ /legs la rdul ldan yon tan ldan pa 'o mar ldan/ /rab mchog be'u rnams dang bcas pa'i ba rnams ni/ /'o ma mang po 'jo ba mang po byung bar gyur/ /'di yi dgra bo dbus gnas nyid du song gyur pa/ /dbus gnas gyur pa mdza' bshes nyid du rab tu song / /khyad par du ni bshes gnyen brtan por song ba ste/ /'di yi phyogs dag gnyis te dgra yang yod ma yin / /de bzhin du ni 'di yi 'jam rlung 'brug gi sgra/ /glog gi phreng 1ba 'khyel ba yis ni brgyan pa'i sprin/ /rdo char dang ni thog lhung nyes pa rnams kyis gzhan / /yul du dus la lha yis char pa phab par gyur/ /zhing gi las kyis shengal dub byed pa nyung ngus kyang / /'bru ni 'bras bu ldan pa dus spyor bzhin skyes te/ /de rnams nyid kyang 'di yi sman du byung gyur la/ /bcud dang snying po yis kyang mngon par lhags pa nyid/ /g.yul du rab tu zhugs la kun du 'joms pa bzhin/ /lus la the tshom za bar byed pa'i dus na yang / /rang bzhin gnas shing bde ba nyid du nad med par/ /dus kyi dbang gis mi mo rnams ni rab tu btsas/ /brtul zhugs ldan ⑤rnams ma gtogs nor rdzas 96—16

dman na yang / /mi rnams pha rol rnams las don du gnyer mi byed/ /mngon par don du gnyer la 'phags pa nor 'phra yang / /de tshe 'ga' zhig dag ni rgyab kyis phyogs ma gyur/ /de tshe rgyal po de yi rgyal srid la ni dga'/ /gnyen la zhe sa med min mi ster ba yang med/ /brtul zhugs med pa nyid min brdzun tshimed 'tshe med pa/ /sgra mi bsgrags kyi sras po lta bu byung bar gyur/ /der yang skyed mos tshal dang lha gnas dka' thub gnas/ /khron pa rdzing dang dge bcu 'du ba'i gnas rnams kyi/ /bya ba rnams ni mtho ris bzhin du nyer thob nas/ /chos 'dod rnams kyis ( byemangon sum du ni rab tu mdzad/ /mu ge dang ni 'jigs dang nad rnams las grol zhing / /dgar gyur skye bo mtho ris gzhan du mngon par dga'/ /bdag mos bdag po la'am mo yis bdag por rung / /phan tshun log par mngon par spyod pa dag kyang med/ /dga' ba'i ched du 'dod la 'ga' zhig gis ma bsnyen/ /'dod pa'i don du nor ni 'ga' zhig gis ma bsrungs/ /nor gyi don du chos la 'ga' zhig gis ma spyad/ /chos kyi don ñtshadu 'tshe ba 'ga' zhig gis ma byas/ /rkun po sogs dang dgra yang nyams par rang gnas med / /pha rol mya ngan med pa ji lta ba nyid bzhin/ /rang gi 'khor lo pha rol 'khor lo las grol te/ /rgyal po de la bde dang lo legs byung bar gyur/ /de yi tshe na rgyal po de yi rgyal srid la/ /de skyes pa na nyi ma'i sras po'i yid shes bzhin/ /dga' bar spyad par gyur la sdig pa rab nyams rgyashing / /chos rnams 'bar zhing nyon mongs rnams ni zhi bar gyur/ /gang phyir rnam pa de ltar don kun grub pa dang / /rgyal po'i rigs kyi phun sum tshogs pa byung gyur te/ /de phyir mi skyong gis ni sras po de yi mtshan/ /don 96—17

kun grub pa zhes bya 'di ni rab tu mdzad/ /lha mo sgyu ma yang ni lha yi drang srong mtshungs / /bu yi nus mthu rnam par spangs pa mthong nas ni/ /bltams la rab tu dga' mas bzod par ma nus te/ /de nas gnas pa'i ched du ltar khyeni gshegs par gyur/ /de nas lha yi mngal dang mtshungs pa'i gzhon nu la/ /byams pa'i rang bzhin gyes kyang khyad par med pa yi/ /ma yi nu mo mdangs mnyam pa yi rang bzhin la/ /yang dag skyed btsud bdag las skyes pa lta bur gyur / /de nas nyi ma gzhon nu 'char rir gnas 'dra dang / /rlung gis rab tu bus par gyur pa'i me bzhin dang / /skar ma'i bdag po mun min phyogs la gnas pa ltar/ /gzhon nu de ni rim gyis yang dag 'phel bar gyur rngu/ /de nas rin thang chen po'i tsan+dan rnams dang ni/ /rin chen phreng ba sman gyi snying bor bcas rnams dang / /ri dwags rab tu sbyar ba'i gser gyi shing rta rnamasasgo//'di yi ched du gshegs kyi khyim rnams dag nas blangs/ /lang tsho nyid dang rjes su mthun pa'i rgyan rnams dang / /gser gyi rang bzhin ri dwags glang chen rta rnams dang / /gser dang dngul gyis bris pa'i mi chung gzugs rnams dang / /shing rta ba glang byung dus yang dag sbyar rnams blangs/ /de ni lang tsho rjes mthun yul la nye spyod pa/ /de rnams kyis ni yul la nyer spyad la/ /dpa' dang brtan pa yis dang blo dang dpal gyis kyang / /byis pa yin yang byis min rab mtshungs byung bar gyur/ /lang tsho gzhon nu shin tu 'das nas yang dag par/ /'du byed las ni rab tu thob nas dus su ni/ /lo mang dag gis rtogs bya nyin zhag nyung ngu yis/ /rang dang rjes su mthun pa'i rigs ④pa rnams ni blangs/ /drang srong chen po dkar min las ni sngon rol du/ /de yi nyes ⑤ legs don gyi 96—18

skal ba thob ①nas ni/ /nags su gshegs par 'gyur zhes shākya'i rgyal po yis/ /'dod pa rnams la chags pa skyed du bcug par gyur/ /brtan pa'i tshul khrims spyod pa can gyi byerigs de lasnye/ /ngo tsha dang ni dul ba nyer ldan legs ldan ma/ /grags 'dzin ma zhes grags pa rnam par yangs pa ma/ /btsun mor mngon par brjod pa'i dpal mo 'di la blangs/ /kun 'gyed gzhon nu dang ni rab tu mtshungs pa yis/ /mchog gi lus kyis 4snang zhing gsal ba de nyid ni/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i mna' ma de dang thabs cig tu/ /bde sogs ma dang mig stong ldan bzhin mngon par dga'/ /yid kyang dpyod thu7par byed la cung zhig rab log pa/ /gang gis mthong mi 'gyur zhes rjes su bsams byas nas/ /sa la rab tu spyod min lding khang lto nyid du/ /gnas dag mi skyong gis ni de la rnam par bstan/ /de nas gzhal med nam mkhar sa la spyod pa bzhin/ /ston kha'i dus kyi chu gter sprin ni dkar po yi/ /dus spyor kun du bde ba'i gzhi yi lding khang la/ /bud med rnams kyi sel snyan rgya chen rnams kyis 'urnam par gshegs/ /gser gyis gdams pa'i rnga shing can gyi rdza rnga'i skad/ /mi mo'i lag lhipa'i rtse mos mngon par brdungs pa yi/ /lha mchog ma yi gar dang mnyam pa'i gar rnams kyis—/ /ti se'i gangs ltar de yi pho brang mdzes par gyur/ /ngag dang gzo dang rol dang khrurnam 'gyur rnams kyis kyang / /rgyags dang rtse dang dgod 7pa dngar mo rnams kyis dang / /smin ma bskyod pa yis 6dang phyed mig lta rnams kyis—/ /de la der ni mi mo rnams ni dga' bar gyur/ /de nas de ni 'dod pa bsten ⑫ par mkhas pa yi⑫/ /dga' bas dregs pa'i bud med rnams kyis bzung gyur la/ /gzhal med khang ni rgyab nas bsod nams las can bzhin/ /96—19

gzhal med khang ni kyergyab nas sa la ma gshegs so/ /mi skyong gis kyang de nyid bskyed pa'i ched las ni/ /de yi 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i don gyis bskul gyur te//sdig pa las ni dga' bral zhi la mngon dga' zhing / /legs la skal bar bgos shing dul la bsnyen par gyur/ /brtan min bzhin du 'dod pa'i bde la ma zhen la / /ma rungs skyed (byem la ni yang dag chags ma gyur/ /brtan pas dbang po'i bye —rta ni stobs las rnam thul zhing / /gnyen dang grong khyer pa rnams yon tan rnams kyis rgyal/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal phyir ni rig pa ma brjod la/ /ye shes dge ba gang yang de la lhag par brjod/ /des ni rang gi skye dgu rnams la ji lta bar/ /de ltar skye dgu rnams la dge ba'i bsngags pa mdzad/ /skar ma rgyal snang shes ldan sras po lhag pa'i lha/ /ji lta bar ni de yi tshe ring phyir mchod desathu/ /chung min me la bsreg bya rnams ni bsregs gyur la/ /gnyis skyes rnams la gser dang ba lang rnams kyang byin/ /'gram kru stegs chab rnams kyis dang yon tan chab rnams kyis/ /gtsang sbra'i ched du lus dang yid la khrus byas te/ /rig byed du ni nye bar bstan pa'i chang rnams dang / /zhi ba bdag skyes snying la zhi ba'i bde la 'thung d+ngha/ /gang zhig don dang mi ldan zhi ba ma smras la / /gang zhig dga' ba dang bral de nyid ma brjod de/ /zhi ba de nyid med spyo dang rtsub pa'i de nyid phyir/ /ngo tsha ba yis bdag nyid kho na brjod ma nus/ /don ldan 'dod pa rnams dang mi 'dod pa rnams la/ /chags pa'i skyon la brten nas rab tu 'thob min te/ /dge ba'i tha snyad gtsang ma la ni bsnyen gyur la / /mchod sbyin la yang ma mos de ltar ji lta bzhin/ /sred pa dang ldan mngon par 'ongs pa ṣ+pe7de ma thag /sbyin bya chu 'dra rnams kyis rmyeskom pa bcad ⑩96—20

gyur la/ /g.yul las ma gtogs ye shes kyi ni sta ri yis/ /dgra bo rnams kyi nga rgyal chen po bcom par gyur⑫/ /gcig ni rnam par dul la des ni mdun bsrungs shing / /bdun po nyid ni don kyel lnga po dag ni bsrungs/ /sde tshan gsum po thob la sde tshan gsum rtogs shing / /sde tshan gnyis po shes la sde tshan kyeganyis po spangs/ /nyes pa byas kyang rab tu bskyangs chonas gzhom bya la/ /'tshe bar mi byed khro bas kyang ni gzigs ma yin/ /de rnams dag la 'bras bu zhi bas bcings gyur la/ /de rnams dag ni 'dor ba tshul ma yin phyir mthong / /drang srong rnams kyis mchog gi phya7brtul zhugs spyad gyur la/ /yun rings spyoyang dag bzung ba'i sha khon ⑦zhugs rnams dor/ /yon tan dri ldan snyan dngags rnams ni thob gyur la/ /dri ma can du byed pa'i rdul rnams rnam par dor—/ /rab tu mi gnas gtor ma'i dbe+e ni ma blangs la/ /pha rol dngos po rnams la mngon par rlom ma byas/ /dgra rnams la ni chos ma yin pa ma smras la/ /khro ba rnams ni snying gis gzung bye ba ma yin no/ /zhi ba'i bdag nyid sems ni rnam par rab dang la/ /rnal 'byor rab tu ldan pa'i dbang po rnams ci ltar/ /der ni de ltar sa bdag rab tu sgyur ba can/ /'bangs dang grong khyer ba rnams de lta nyid du byas/ /de nas mdzes pa'i kye'o ma 'dzin pa dang ldan ma/ /grags 'dzin ma ni rang gi grags pa 'dzin ma la/ /zas gtsang sras po'i sras po sgra gcan sgra yi zhal/ /sgra gcan 'dzin zhes bya ba dus su skyes par gyur/ /de nas 'dod pa'i bu mnga' mchog gi ṅkayid ches te/ /rigs rgyud 'phel ba rab mtshon sa skyong rgyal po ni/ /ji lta nyid du sras po rab tu skyes la dga'/ /de lta nyid du sras po'i sras po skyes la dga'/ /bdag gi bu yi bur gyur pa la brtse 96—21

ba ni1/ /bdag bzhin gang las yin zhes dga' ba skyes gyur te/ /dus su des ni cho ga de dang de dmigs shing / /bu la dga' ba mtho ris bzhin du 'dzegs par gyur/ /rgyal po'i khyu mchog grags dang snyan pas mtshan rnams kyis//dang po'i skal ba rnams kyi lam la gnas nas ni/ /dkar po ma dor dka' thub rnams la dka' thub dang / /'tshe ba dor ba'i mchod sbyin rnams kyis ༷ snamachod par gyur/ /rgyal po'i dpal gyis dang ni dka' thub dpal gyis kyang / /bsod nams las can de ni de nas 'bar gyur la/ /rigs dang blo dang mdzad spyod kyis kyang gsal ba ste/ /gzi brjid stong gi 'od zer bzhin du rab tu 'phro//rang byung las byung mchod byed sngags ni mchod byas nas/ /sras gnas ṅkuched du brtan pa'i dpal gyis bzlas byas shing / /dka' thub byed pa'i las rnams byas gyur skye dgu rnams/ /skyed 'dod skye dgu'i bdag bzhin dang po'i dus su'o/ /mtshon cha spangs shing bstan bcos rnam par shes gyur la/ /nye bar zhi la bsnyen zhing nges la rnam par bzod/ /dbang ldan bzhin du yul rnams gang la ma bsnyen la/ /yab mes bzhin du yul rnams kun la gzigs par gyur/ /des kyang bu yi ched du rgyal srid bzung gyur la/ /bu ni rigs kyi don du rigs ni grags pa'i phyir/ /grags pa mtho ris ched du mtho ris bdag nyid phyir/ /chos kyi don du bdag nyid gnas la 'dod par 'gyur/ /de ltar des ni dam pa rnams kyis nges thob pa'i/ /thos pa las grub chos ni rnam pa sna tshogs byas/ /gang las bdag gi ngubus ni bu yi ngo mthong nas/ /nags tshal nyid du 'gro mi 'gyur zhes mgon babe+engs snyeso/ /bdag la yang dag blangs khyapa'i dpal ni srung pe'adod pa'i/ /sa skyong rnams kyis sa la bu ni bsrung ba ste/ /chos ni 96—22

'dod pa'i ma yi dbang po de yis kyang / /yul rnams 'dor ba med par bu ni chos las bsrungs/ /byang chub sems dpa' yul la bde ba'i ro shes lkuthams cad kyang / /sras skyed khupa na dpe med sems pa 1nags su gshegs gyur te/ /de phyir nye bar bsags pa'i las ni rtsa nas skyed krupa'i phyir/ /de ni zhi ba ma thob de srid dga' ba bsnyen par gyur/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ btsun mo'i 'khor na gnas pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas re zhig dus na 'u'ajam po'i rtswa rnams dang / /khu byug pho ni gyen du skad 'don rkang 'thung rnams/ /glu rnams dang ni nges ldan skyed mos tshal rnams ni/ /pad+ma'i 'byung gnas kyis brgyan des ni thos par gyur/ /de nas bud med skye bo rnams ni dga' ba yi/ /grong khyer skyed mos tshal gyi yid 'ong dngos thos te/ /khyim gyi nang du mngon par bkag pa'i glu bzhin du/ /phyi rol rab tu 'gro ba'i ched du blo mdzad do/ /de nas sras su mngon brjod yid 'ong de yi ni/ /dgongs pa mi skyong gis ni nges par thos gyur nas/ /brtse ba'i phun sum tshogs pas lang tshor 'ongs pa ru/ /ltad mo dag la rnam par gshegs par bka' stsal to/ /gzhon nu shin tu gzhon nu'i sems dang ldan pa ni—/ /yang dag skyo ba'i sems su ma gyur zhes sems zhing 'u/ /nyam thag tha dad skye bo kun nas 'dus pa ni/ /rgyal po'i lam du phyir la rnam par zlog pepa ste—/ /nying lag dman pa rnams dang dbang po ma tshang rnams/ /'khogs ⑤pa nad pa la sogs bkren rnams phyogs rnams su/ /de nas mchog tu zhi bas yang 96—23

dag rab ston nas/ /rgyal po'i lam rnams dag ni mchog tu mdzes par byas /de nas dpal ldan rgyal po'i lam ni byas pa na/ /dpal ldan rnam par dul ba rjes 'brangs 4gzhon nu ni/ /gzhal yas khang pa'i logs nas dus su mngon babs nas/ /mngon par rjes gnang byas pa mi skyong la mngon gshegs/ /de nas mi dbang bu la mchi ma byung gyur te/ /mgo la nye bar bsnams kyete yun rings gurnam gzigs nas/ /song cig kruces ni tshig gi bka' dag sprul byegyur la / /brtse ba dag las de ni yid kyis ma btang ngo / /de nas de ni 'dzam bu chu gser sga 'dzin pa'i/ /legs par babe+ebs pa'i mgyogs 'gro bzhi yis sbyar ba yi/ /dbang po ma nyams sakhas shing gtsang la 'od zer 'chang / /gser gyi rang bzhin shing rta la ni yang dag 'dzegs/ /de nas 'bras spos me tog 'bar ba rab bkram zhing mu/ /phreng ba rnam dpyangs rab tu g.yo ba'i ba dan can / /zla ba skar ma dang bcas bar snang la bzhin du/ /'dra mub rjes 'brang lam ni rab tu thob par gyur/ /ya mtshan gyur las rab tu rgyas pa'i mig rnams ni/ /ut+pal sngon po'i phyed 'dra rnams kyis bkram pa ni/ /rgyal po'i lam la dal bu — 7dal bus gshegs gyur te/ /grong khyer skye bo rnams kyis kun nas mngon par dga'/ /kha cig de la zhi ba'i yon tan gyes bstod la/ /de bzhin gzhan rnams gsal ba nyid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing / /kha cig dag ni 'di la mngon du phyogs nas kyang / /dpal dang tshe yi rnam ⑫par rgyas la shis pa brjod / /zhar ba sgur po nad pa mi'u thung rnams kyi satshu/ /tshogs pa rnams ni rigs chen rnams la nges dral nas/ /mi mo rnams ni nges par zhugs gnas phra rnams las/ /lha yi rjes 'gro rgyal mtshan bzhin du rab tu btud/ /de 96—24

nas gzhon nu nges par gshegs zhes gtam dag ni/ / bsgo bya skyes 2las bud med rnams kyis thob gyur nabye/ /bkur 'os skye snyebos mngon par rjes gnang byas pa rnams/ /blta bar 'dod pas lding khang shong du song bar gyur/ /yon tan ska rags brul zhing gegs byas de rnams ni/ /gnyid log rab tu sad pas lta byed 'khrugs pa rnams/ /gnas lugs gtam gyis rnam par brgyan rnams rnam gzhag ste/ /ya mtshan gyur pas dogs med par ni yongs su song / /gzhal yas khang gi skas pyakyi 'og gi sgra rab dang / /dril chung sgra rnams dang ni gdu bu'i sgra rnams kyis/ /rnam par skrag gyur khyim gyi bya yi ⑤tshogs rnams ni/ /phan tshun shugs rnams las kyang yang dag kun nas gtor/ /gang zhig 'dir ni yan lag rab mchog ma rnams ni/ /myur ba rab tu skyes gyur tsam tsam skyes rnams kyis / /lo kakhyem 'dzin rnams rgyas shing skyed smad shing rta ni/ /yangs pa rnams kyis lci ba nyid phyir 'gro ba bzung / /mtha' gcig legs par rab tu sbyar ba'i rgyan rnams ni/ /rnam par sbas pa rnam par gsal bas ngo tsha bas /skyen por 'gro bar nus pa yin yang gzhan ma yin gye/ /'gro ba nges par bzung ste myur min song bar gyur/ /phan tshun rab tu bcer bas ril por gyur pa rnams / /yang dag drud las bskyod gyur rna lung 'khyil ba can/ /de dag rnams kyi de tshe sgra bcas rgyan rnams ni/ /rlung bgrod khyaskar khung rnams su rab tu zhi bar gyur/ /rlung bgrod bye/skar khung rnams las rnam par 'thon ⑩pa rnams//phan tshun thang chen gyur pa'i rna lung 'khyil ba rnams/ /bud gred rnams kyi 'dam skyes 'dra ba'i 'dam skyes zhal/ /lding khang rnams su bkod pa rnams ni rnam par mdzes/ /de nas khang bzangs hūṃlang tsho ma rnams kyis khyab cing / /96—25

ya mtshan la ni rab phye skar khung rnams kyis ni/ /lha mo dang bcas gzhal med rnams kyi 1nam mkha' bzhin/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i grong khyer kun nas mdzes par gyur/ /skar khung rnams kyis ⑤rnam par yangs ① pa ma yin las/ /phan tshun 'gram par bkod pa'i rna lung can rnams kyis④/ /'dam skyes pad+ma rnams kyi tshogs rnams bcings pa bzhin/ /rab stsos mchog ma rnams kyi zhal ni mdzes par gyur/ /gzhon nu de la lam du rnam par blta ⑤ba yi/ /bud med de rnams sa la 'gro 'dod ltar mdzes shing / /gyen du gdong phyogs de la rab tu lta 'ub yi/ /mi rnams gnam la 'gro bar 'dod bzhin mdzes par gyur/ /lus dad dpal kyis mchog tu 'bar bar gyur pa yi/ /rgyal po'i sras de mthong nas bud med de rnams rgo/ /nges par dgongs pa ⑦gzhan min bsam pa dag pa yis/ /'di yi chung ma skal ba bzang zhes dal bus smra/ /gzugs kyi dngos su me tog tog can dang mtshungs shing / /rnam par ring zhing rgyas pa'i dpung pa can 'di ni/ /dpal nyid dor nas chos la nye bar gshegs zhes te/ /de la de dag rnams kyis snyezhe sa kho na byas/ /rnam par dul la gtsang zhing brtan pa'i cha lugs can/ /grong pa rnams kyis sh+yide ltar rgyal po'i lam khyab pa//de ni sngon du gzhon nus mthong nas dga' bas te/ /bdag gi srid pa gzhan ma cung zhig brtags 6pa 'dra/ /grong khyer de yang mtho ris bzhin du rab dga' ba—/ /mngon par gzigs nas gtsang mar gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis/ /sa ⑫ gzhi skyong ba'i sras po yang dag bskul don du/ /'khogs pa'i mi rgan rab tu 'gro bar sprul gyur to/ /de nas gzhon nu yis ni rga bas zil non zhing / /mi rnams las ni tha dad dbyebs can de gzigs nas/ /g.yo ba med cing de nyid 96—26

du ni zhugs pa'i spyan/ /chags par gyur cing kha lo 'dzin pa la smras so/ /mngon par nyer 'ongs 1mi de su yin 'dren pa kye/ /skra rnams dkar zhing dbyug pa la ni lag pas brten/ /smin mas kun nas mig g.yogs 'khogs shing yan lag drud/ /rnam 'gyur 'di ni tha mal gang 'dod yin nam ci/ /de skad ces smra shing rta rab tu 'dren pa po/ /lha mchog de rnams ③nyid kyi blo ni rmongs byas shing / /don ni bsrung bya yin yang skyon med mthong gyur te/ /de yis sa skyong bdag nyid skyes la nges par gsol/ /gzugs kyi gnod byed stobs kyi rnam par za ba po/ / rgan pa rnams kyi snye'ajoms byed mya ngan rnams kyi sa/ /dran pa rnams kyi nyams byed dbang po rnams kyi dgra/ /'di ni rgas pa zhes bya gang gis 'di bcom mo/ /'dis kyang byis pa nyid dang ④'o ma 'thung khyegyur cing / /dus kyi sa la yongs su gnyid log gyur pa ste/ /rim gyis lus rab ldan pa'i lang tshor gyur nas kyang / /rim gyes de nyid kho nas rga bar nye bar song / /de skad ces smras rgyal po'i bdag nyid skyes pa ste/ /cung zhig 'dar la skyekha lo sgyur la 'di skad smras④/ /skyon 'di kho bo la yang 'byung ba min nam ci/ /de bzhin 'di la kha lo sgyur ba yis gsol to/ /'di ni na tshod rab mchog tshe dang ldan pa'i yang / /gdon mi za bar dus kyi dbang gis 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin rgas pa gzugs kyi rnam par nyams pa bor/ /'jig rten pa yi phyashes pa nyid dang mthong ba nyid/ /de nas sngon gyi bsam pa dag pa'i blo mnga' ba/ /rnam rgyas bskal par bsags pa'i bsod nams las can de//rdo rje chen po'i sgra la nye bar 9snab lang bzhin/ /rgas pa thos nas gzhon nu kun nas yi mug gyur/ /dbugs ni ring du brgyus menas rang gi mgo bsgul zhing / /96—27

'khogs pa de la spyan ni rnam par zhugs nas su/ /rga ba dang bcas skye ba de rnams gzigs gyur nas/ /sems ni khong du chud pa de yis 1tshig 'di smras/ /dran pa dang ni gzugs dang pha rol gnon pa yang / /de ltar rgas pas rnam dpyod med par 'joms pas te/ /'di lta bur ni mngon sum nyid du song ñtshan yang / /'jig rten pa dag skyo med nyer 'gro kho na'o/ /de ltar song la rngu'adren pa rta rnams phyir zlog ④la/ /khyod ni khyim nyid du ni skyes khyapar rab tu song / /rgas pa'i 'jigs pa'i sems su gnas pa kho bo la/ /skyed mos tshal gyi sa la bde ba ga la yod/ /de nas rgyal po'i sras po de yi bka' lung gis/ /kha lo sgyur bas shing rta phyir la bzlog par gyur/ /de nas gzhon nus pho brang de nyid kho nar ni/ /bsam pa'i dbang gis stong pa bzhin du rab tu thob/ /gang gi zhwatshe na de yang bde ba ma yin telte/ /rgas pa rgas pa zhes ni rab tu yongs su rtog /de nas mi dbang gis ni rjes gnang de ni slar/ /rim gyis de nyid kho nas phyi rol gshegs par gyur/ /de nas gzhan yang lus la nad dang yongs ldan pa/ /lha mchog de rnams nyid kyis bskyed cing sprul pa'i mi zas gtsang rgyal po'i sras po can kye7der song nyid kyis/ /gzigs nas kha lo sgyur ba de nyid la smras pa/ /gsus pa sbom zhing dbugs dag skyod pa'i lus po can/ /lag pa cha shas zha zhing rid la skya bseng kyelus/ /a ma zhes ni snying rje'i ngag dag smra ba po/ /gzhan la brten nas gnas pa'i mi de su zhig yin/ /de nas kha lo sgyur bas smras pa zhi ba kye/ /'di yi khams ni rab 'khrugs rab stobs rab tu 'phel/ /nad ces bya ba mngon brjod shin tu don med chen po ste/ /nus kyang gang gis de ni rab dbang med par byas/ /rjes su brtse bcas mi 6de 96—28

la ni ①gzigs bzhin du/ /rgyal po'i sras des slar yang 'di skad ces smras pa//skyes gyur skyon de so sor 'di nyid kho na'i 'am/ /nad kyi 'jigs la skye dgu rnams kyi spyi la yin/ /de nas shing rta rab tu 'dren pa des smras pa/ /gzhon nu nyes pa de ni thun mong gyur pa ste/ /de ltar nad rnams dag ni yongs su gtser 1ba ni/ /nad mthar phyir na 'jig rten dga' bar nye bar gshegs/ /de ltar dzudon thos sems ni khong du chud pa de/ /chu rlabs nang song ri bong can bzhin rab 'dar zhing / /brtse ba thugs rje mnga' bas gsung ngag tshig 'di ni/ /cung zhig dngar ba'i dbyangs kyis cerab tu smras pa'o/ /skye dgu rnams la rnam par zhen pa'i nad 'di ni/ /'jig rten pa dag rang bzhin gnas shing blo gtad byed/ /mi shes rnam par rgya chen e ma mi rnams kyis/ /gang zhig nad las rnam par grol rnams bzhad gad byed/ /'dren pa ⑤phyi rol rab tu 'gro las phyir log la/ /mi dbang pho brang nyid du shing rta rab tu song / /bdag gi nad kyi 'jigs pa thos nas dga' ba las/ /sems ni 'khums pa bzhin du rab tu bcom par gyur/ /de ltar lan gnyis phyir log de ni rab gzigs nas/ /sa yi bdag po yis kyang yongs su gros byas so/ /de yi phyir log nges pa'i mtshan ma thos gyur nas/ /bdag cag rnams ni 'di yis yang dag 'dor snyam ste/ /lam rnams gtsang mar lhag par byed pa po rnams la/ /khros shing 'khrugs kyang chad pa drag pos 'ugacod pa med/ /slar yang sras po de la khyad par 'phags pa dang / /ldan pa'i yul la rab tu dpyod ⑦pa rnams mdzad cing / /dbang po g.yo ba nyid kyi phyir yang chags ṇashesnyam ste/ /bdag cag rnam ⑨ par mi 'dor zhes ni mgon blangs kye so/ /gang gi tshe na sgra sgogs ⑪96—29

dbang po'i don rnams kyis/ /sras po 'di la pho brang 'khor na dga' ba med/ /de nas ro gzhan ro la gyur cig zhes ①sems shing / /phyi rol ltad mo la ni rnam par bka' sprul to/ /brtse ba las ni sras po'i dgongs pa rtogs nas su/ /de la chags pa'i skyon rnams 'ga' zhig ma bsams zhunas/ /sgyu rtsal rnams la mngon par shes zhes res ma'i gtso/ /mdzangs rngo ma rnams la des ni yang dab bka' sprul to/ /de nas khyad par du yang mi yi dbang po'i lam/ /legs par brgyan byas nyid dang yongs su brtags pa la/ /'dren pa dang ni shing rta brjes lgonas rgyal po yis/ /gzhon nu phyi rol du ni rab tu gshegs su gzhug /de nas de ltar rgyal po'i bu ni gshegs pa na/ /lha mchog de rnams nyid kyis rnam par sprul pa yi/ /srog song shi ba'i ro de lam du bteg khyepa ni/ /'dren pa dang ni gzhon nus mthong ste gzhan gyis min/ /de nas 'dren pa hūṃrgyal po'i sras po des smras pa/ /zhan zhing stug ⑦pa'i mi rnams dag ni rjes 'brang zhing / /rgyan gyis brgyan pa yin yang kun nas ngu ba ste/ /mi bzhi rnams kyis bteg ldupa pha gi su zhig yin/ /de nas gtsang ba'i bdag nyid gtsang mar gnas pa yi/ /lha rnams dag gis sems ni zil non 'dren pa po/ /des ni brjod par bya ba min kyang don 'di ni/ /don ldan dbang phyug la ni rab tu rnam par gsol/ /blo dang dbang po srog gi yon tan dang bral zhing / /gnyid log ming bral rtswa dang shing du gyur pa ste/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa rnams kyis bskyed nas bsrungs nas kyang / /sdug pa sdug pa rnams kyis spangs pa de ni su yin nam/ /de ltar tshig ni rab tu 'dren pa las thos nas/ /cung zhig kun nas bskyod cing kyede nyid la smras pa/ /chos 'di nyid ni skye ba 'di nyid kyang gi'am/ /mthar gyur 96—30

'di 'dra skye dgu kun gyi ①yin nam ci/ /de nas rab tu 'dren pas 'di nyid la gsol pa/ /mthar gyur las 'di skye dgu rnams ni kun gyi ste/ /dman dang 'bring dang bdag nyid chen po thams cad kyi/ /'jig rten dag ni rnam par rngunges par rnam par nyams par 'gyur sna/ /de nas mi dbang sras po de ni bstan rgyan yang / /'chi ba thos nas de ma thag tu yi mug cing / /dpung pas shing rta'i shing gi rtse la rab 'khyud nas/ /gdangs snyan dang ldan dbyangs kyis rab tu smras pa'o/ /'di ni nges par skye dgu rnams kyi mthar thug ste/ /'jig rten pa dag 'jigs pa spangs shing bag gred la/ /mi rnams dag gi 5sems rnams sra ba snyam pa ste/ /lam la gnas rnams de ltar rang bzhin nyid du gnas / /de phyir 'dren pa shing rta'i kha ni phyir bzlog dang / /bdag cag sa la rnam par rgyu ba'i yul dus minathu/ /nyam thag dus su rnam par nyams pa shes nas ni/ /sems dang bcas pa gang 'dra 'di na bag med yin/ /mi bdag bdag skyes kyis ni de skad smras na yang / /de yis shing rta de ni phyir la ma bzlog ste / /khyab par ldan pa yin yang mi dbang brten pa la/ /pad+ma'i tshogs bcas nags nyid du ni gshegs par gyur/ /de nas me tog rgyas ldan gzhon nu'i rkang 'thung zhing / /yongs su bskor zhing rab dga' myos 2pa'i khu byug can / /gzhal med khang ldan pad+ma dang bcas mdzes pa'i rdzing / /dga' ba'i tshal 'dra dge ba'i nags de 3snagazigs par gyur/ /lha mchog mas bskor grong khyer brgyan tsu7byed bdag po'i gzhir/ /brtul zhugs gsal ( 7ldan thub pa bgegs kyis 'jigs pa bzhin/ /yan lag mchog ma'i tshogs khyab mi skyong bdag skyes sras/ /de nas stobs las nags der skyespyan drangs so/ /sangs 96—31

rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ thugs skyo ba skyes pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas skyed mos tshal de nas/ /ya mtshan gyes ni mig g.yos 1rnams/ /bud med rnams ni khyo thob bzhin/ /mi skyong sras la mdun du 'ongs/ /'ongs nas de la de rnams kyis/ /ya mtshan rab rgyas spyan ma drangasarngo 7/ /pad+ma'i mdzod 'dra'i 2phyag rnams kyis/ /phrin las yang dag spyod pa byas/ /g.yo med dga' ba rnam gsal ba'i/ /spyan mig rnams kyis 'thung ba bzhin/ /yid dkrugs nga'adod pas sems g.yengs rnams/ /de la yongs su bskor nas gnas—/ /lhan skyes rgyan rnams kyis bzhin du/ /mtshan ni mdzes rnams kyis brgyan pa/ /'dod lha lus dang ldan no zhes/ /de la mi mo de rnams snyam/ /zhi ba nyid phyir brtan snyenyid phyir/ /gsang ba'i 'od zer bla ba ni/ /sa la dngos su babs shepa bzhin/ /de la kha cig rnams kyis shes/ /de yi lus kyis g.yengs de rnams/ /nges bzung lus ni rnam 'gyur zhing / /phan tshun mig rnams kyis bsnun nas/ /dal bus dbugs ni rnam par brgyus/ /de ltar mi mo de rnams kyis/ /de ni mig tsam gyis mthong nyid/ /smra ba med cing dga' med par/ /'di yi mthu yis menon par gyur/ /de ltar de rnams rtsom bral zhing / /snying rjes rnam par 'khrugs mthong nas/ /bram ze mdun na 'don gyi sras—/ /blo ldan 'char kas tshig smras so/ /kun gyi sgyu rtsal kun shes shing / /dgongs pa len la mkhas ma durnams/ /gzugs dang mdzangs thudang ldan pa ste//rang gi yon tan gtsor phyin no/ /lus ngan gyi yang skyed tshal dang / /byang gi 96—32

sgra mi snyan na yang / /yon tan 'di rnams kyis mdzes te/ /nor 'dzin 'di na sngon nyid do/ /chags bral rnams dang drang srong yang / /khyed cag rnams kyis g.yo nus shing / /lha mo rnams kyis shes pa yis/ /lha rnams la yang len par ro/ /dgongs pa shes dang rtsed 'jo dang / /mdzangs )dang gzugs ni yun tshogs pas/ /bud med rnams kyis rtechags nus na/ /skyes pa rnams kyis 1smos ci dgos/ /rnam pa de ltar rab sbyar ba/ /de yi rang gi spyod yul las—/ /rnam pa de ltar spyod pa 'di/ /khyod kyi drang po'i tshig ma gyur/ /khyod kyi 'di ni ngo tsha bas/ /mig 'khums bag ma gsar pa yi/ /spyod pa dang mtshungs yang na ni/ /ba glang skyong gi chung ma'i 'os/ /gang yang 'di ni dpa' ba ste/ /dpal gyi mthu las chen po yin/ /bud med kyi yang gzi che ste//de phyir 'di yang nges par bya/ /sngon yang ka shi'i mdzes ma ni/ /smad 'tshong ma yi 4drang srong che/ /lha yis thub par dka' ba yang / /drang srong rgyas pas 3 rkang pas brdungs/ /mān thal go tam dge slong ni/ /smad 'tshong gtso mo byin ma yin6/ /dga' 'dod de yi don ched du/ /sngon gye tshe na ro rnams bton/ /go ta ma mun rings 7ming / /drang srong chen po tshe rings byopo/ /kha dog dbyibs mchog ma yin pa'i/ /bud med kyis ni tshim par byas/ /drang srong rwa skyes thub pa mchog /bud med yul la mi mkhas pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs thabs rnams kyis/ /zhi mas de ltar blangs shing pham/ /sna tshogs bshes gnyen drang srong che/ /brtul zhugs chen po brtan shepa yang / /lha mo mar srung ( 7mas phrogs te/ /lo bcu rnams la nyi mar shes/ /drang srong de rnams de rnams sogs—/ /bud med kyis sgyur 11blangs gyur na/ /rol zhing lang tsho snga ma yis/ /96—33

mi bdag sras po smos ci dgos/ /de ltar gyur na yid ches shing / /'di ni mi skyong rigs kyi dpal/ /'di las phyir phyogs ma yin pa/ /ji ltar de ltar nan tan mdzod/ /lang tsho ldan ma 'ga' zhig rnams/ /mtshungs pa'i skye bo 'phrog pa ste/ /mchog dang mchog min dag gi sems/ /len pa gang de bud med rnams/ /de ltar 'char ka'i tshig thos nas/ /bud med de rnams phug pa bzhin / /gzhon nu len par rab mtshon te/ /bdag nyid yang dag kun nas 'dzegs/ /'jigs las 'jigs bzhin yan lag ma/ /de rnams smin dang lta dang sgeg /dgod 1dang rol dang 'gro ba yis/ /kun nas bskyod pa'i spyod pa byas/ /rgyal po'i bka' lung sbyar phyir dang / /gzhon nu nyid kyang 'jam phyir dang / /rgyags pa yis ni myos pa'i phyir/ /yid mi ches pa —myur bar dor/ /glang mo'i tshogs dang thabs cig tu/ /glang po gangs can nags na ltar/ /de nas mi mo'i skye bo yis/ /gzhon nu bskor zhing nags na spyad / /rnam par mdzes pa'i skyed tshal na/ /lha mos bskor ba'i nyi ma bzhin//yid 'ong nags der gzhon nu de/ /bud med rnams ni —mdun 'gro bar4/ /rnam par sgeg bcas gzhon nu ma/ /rgyags pas ma spangs thude rnams dga'/ /sra 6zhing zlum rgyas lhan cig pa'i/ /nu ma rnams kyis de la reg /dpung pa las brul 'jam ring mnyen/ /lag pa'i ljon shing stobs med ma/ /kha cig bden min 'khrul pa ru/ /byas nas de la stobs las 'khyud/ /kha cig zangs mchu ma mchu can/ /kha cig 4chang gi dri ngag gis/ /gcig pu dbe+en par sdod cig ces/ /'di yi rna bar shab shib byed/ /kha cig bka' lung stsol ba bzhin//byug pa gsher mas rab smras te/ /'dir ni gus/ par gyis shig ces/ /dgod khye96—34

dang 'khyud dang 'dod pas so/ /kha cig gser gyi ska rags kyi/ /cal col rnams kyis ṭ+wātsam tsom dang / /phra mo'i dar gyi 5gos gyon zhing / /'di la ro smad ston cing bskor/ /yang dang yang du myos ma'i rgyus/zi/ /gzhan ma dar sngon nyil ba ste/ /ska rags phan tshun sdud pa ni/ /mtshan mo glog phreng bzhin du mdzes/ / tsū ta'i me tog yal ga chorgyas/ /bzung nas gzhan ni 'phyang 9 gyur la/ /gser gyi bum par mtshungs pa yi/ /'o ma 'dzin pa ston par byed/ /kha cig pad+ma'i nags tshal nas/ /'ongs nas pad 7bcas pad+ma'i srun/ /pad+ma'i zhal gyi logs gnas shing / /pad+ma'i dpal bzhin bsdad par gyur/ /rang gnas de la bskul ba bzhin/ /bslus par gyur zhes 8mig rnams kyis/ /kha cig mngon par 'dren bcas lag /don ldan dngar ba'i glu len no/ /dge ba'i gdong gis gzhan mas ni/ /smin pa'i gzhu ni rnam bkang ste/ /bskor gnas brtan 9dang rol pa yis/ /'di yi spyod la rjes zlos 7byas/ /rgyas zlum nu ldan kha cig ni/ /dgod 1 pas rna lung g.yos gyur cing / /khyod ni thob par gyur cig ces/ /mthon po rnams kyis bzhad cing smras/ /gzhan ni de bzhin 'gro 'dod pa/ /me tog phreng ba'i tshal gyis bcings/ /kha cig cod bcas dngar mo yisatso5/ /ngag gi zhags pa rnams kyis bzung / /so sor 'bral ba don gnyer 'ga'/ /tsū 1ta'i snye ma bzung nas ni/ /me tog 'di ni gang gi zhes/ /rgyags pas ⑪rnam par 'khrugs shing dris/ /kha cig 'gros dang cha lugs ni/ /skyes pa bzhin du byas nas ni/ /sa 'dir rgyal bar gyur cig kye/ /bud med kyis 'pham de la smras/ /de nas g.yo ba'i mig can 'gas//ut+pal sngon po snom byed cing / /cung zhig rgyags skad tshig rnams kyis/ /mi 96—35

skyong bdag skyes la smras so/ /gzigs shing jo bo tsū ta'i shing / /me tog sbrang rtsi'i dris khyab la/ /khu byug 'dir ni skad 'don pa/ /gser gyi bu rmye/na bkag pa 'dra/ /mya ngan med pa'i shing 'di gzigs/ /'dod pa can gyi mya ngan 'phel / /bung ba 'dir ni sgra bsgrags snapa/ /me yis tshig pa yin pa 'dra/ /tsū ta'i shing gis yang dag 'khyud/ /gzigs shing ti la ka yi shing / /bud med lus ser chags pa yis/ /skyes pa gos dkar gon pa 'dra/ /rab rgyas ku ra ba ka gzigs/ /ma zos pa yi smug rtsi'i 'od/ /bud med rnams kyi sen 'od kyis/ /sma 4phab gyur te dud pa 'dra/ /gzhon nu mya ngan med 'di gzigs/ /'dab ma rnams kyis 5spras pa gang / /kho mo'i lag pa mdzes pa yis ngo mtshar gyur te gnas pa 'dra/ /rdzing bu gzigs shing 'gram skyes pa'i/ /lcang ma rnams kyis rab tu bskor/ /dkar po'i dar gyi gos gon pa'i/ /rab pyos ma rnams nyal ba 'dra/ /bud med rnams la bdag nyid che/ /gzigs shig ngang pa chu 'di la/ /rgyab na bsgo bya'i bran bzhin du/ /ngang mo rjes 'jug rjes su 'gro/ /rab tu myos pa'i khu byug ni/ /skad grag sgra ni gson mdzod cig /khu byug gzhan ni mngon sum du/ /kus 'debs brag ca'i sgra brnyan 5'dra / /mkha' la rgyu ba rnams kyi yang / /rgyags pa dpyid kyis khyer te 'ongs/ /bsam bya min sems skye bo ni/ /shes rab can du zlom dz+wapa med/ /de ltar dar la bab pa rnams/ /yid dkrugs 'dod pas sems dregs shing / /sna tshogs tshul ni de dang des/ /gzhon nu la ni nye bar brtsams/ /de ltar kun nas g.yengs na yang / /brten —pas dbang po dkris pa de/ /'chi bar bya zhes skyo byas shing / /dga' dang 'jigs pa med par 'gyur/ /de rnams kyi 96—36

ni gnas skabs de/ /gzigs nas skyes mchog dam pa des/ /mnyam la 7skyo dang brtan pa yisnye / /thugs kyis bsams par gyur pa'o/ /ci zhig bud med 'di rnams ni/ /lang tsho g.yo bar rtogs pa min/ /gang phyir gzugs kyi myos pa ni/ /gang zhig dga' bas nyams par 'gyur/ /gang gi nang du bying ba ru/ /nges par de rnams kyis mi mthong / /'gro ba nad kyi chos can la/ /'jigs pa spangs te de ltar dga'/ /thams cad 'phrog byed 'chi ba yi nges par mngon par shes min zhing / /de ltar rang gnas skyo med par/ /rtsed mo dang ni bzhad gad byed/ /rga dang na dang 'chi ba yang / /shes ldan yin na sems ldan su/ /rang gnas langs dang 'dug pa 'am/ /nyal byed rgod pa smos ci dgos / /nad dang 'chi ba nyid dang ni/ /mchog tu 'khogs gang de mthong nas / /rang gnas gyur zhing skyo med pa/ /ji ltar sems med de ltar de/ /me tog rnams dang 'bras bu yis/ /rnam par spangs par gyur pa'i shing / /'gyel lam yang na bcad pa ste/ /shing gzhan mdzes par byed ma yin/ /de ltar bsam gtan mchog mthong nas/ /yul rnams la ni 'dod pa thal/ /'char ka tshul lugs bstan bcos shes/ /mdza' bo nyid kyis de la smras/ /kho bo mi skyong gis byin te/ /khyod la grogs su nus pa lo/ /gang phyir khyed snyel smra 'dod pa/ /rab dga' ldan pa de phyir ro/ /phan pa min las rab 'gegs shing / /phan pa la yang rjes rab 'jug /sbug pa na yang yongs mi gtong / /yongs rdzogs shes kyi mtshan nyid do/ /bdag de byams par dam bcas nas/ /skyes bu'i don la phyir phyogs pa/ /gal te khyod la btang ristoms byed/ /grogs po nyid kyang ma yin no/ /de phyir mdza' bor gyur nas smras/ /gzhon 96—37

nu'i lus dang ldan pa ni/ /khyod kyis rmye'adi 'dra bud med kyis37/ /yul la mkhas pa'i gzugs brnyan min/ /de yi ngo tsha'i rgod don dang / /bdag nyid dga' ba'i don nyid du/ /bden min gyis kyang mi mo yi/ /rjes su 'jug pa rigs pa yin/ /yang dag 'dud dang rjes 'jug gi/ /bud med rnams kyis sems 'ching ste/ /brtse ba'i yon tan skye gnas phyir/ /yid la 'dod pa bud med yin/ /de phyir rnam par spangs pa'i spyan/ /snying la gzhan du phyir bltas kyang / /'di yi yul sngudang rjes mthun par/ /mkhas pa 3rnam par dpyad par 'os/ /mkhas pa sman yin bud med la/ /mkhas pa rab mchog rgyan yin no/ /mkhas pa dang bral gzugs dag rgo/ /me tog med pa'i nags dang 'dra/ /yang na mkhas pa'i rang bzhin gyi kye/ /bsam pa rang bzhin khas len mdzod/ /yul rnams nyes )par dka' thob nas/ /phyi shol byed pa 'os ma yin/ /sngon tshe lha yi dbang pos kyang / /'dod pa mchog 8ces shes byas nas / /go tam thub pa'i dga' /ldan ma/ /bshol med ma la 'dod pa byas/ /zla ba'i chung ma snar ma ni/ /drang srong ri byis don du gnyer/ /de nas de dang 'dra ba yi/ /brkam bya ma ni rnyed ces thos/ /u bha ju yi chung ma ni/ /rlung gi bu mo mthun 11ma la/ /dka' thub chen po'i phur bu yis/ / ba ra dwa ⑩dza bskyed par gyur/ /drang srong phur bu'i chung ma ni/ /sbyin sreg ma la sbyin sreg mchog /zla ba yis ni lag pa yi/ /lha yi las byed bskyed par gyur/ /sngon tshe bu mo nag mo ni/ /chur skyes ma nyu1las skyes ma la/ /rtsib logs skyes ni chags skyes shing / /ya nu ni yi sbyigling du phyin/ /gnod sbyin phreng /8ma rigs ngan ma/ /snod lam la ni dga' 'dod pas/ /gong ma sreg ni za ba'i bu/ /96—38

thub pa gnas mchog ⑨gis bskyed do/ /'gro mgyogs rgyal po drang srong nyid/ /na tshod rnam par song ba yi/ /lha mo sna tshogs mchod mar bcas/ /sna tshogs shing rta'i nags su dga'/ /bud med 'grogs min zhi ba ni/ / skya bseng 3 gis ni shes nas kyang / /dga' ma'i gzugs yon gyis bkug ste/ /'dod las skyes pa'i bde ba bsten/ /skyed mdzad rgyal po dmar ser yang / /bram ze'i bu mo phrogs nas ni/ /na babs thob pa nyid yin kyang / /yid dkrugs 'dod pa ma bsten min/ /de la sogs pa bdag nyid ches/ /yul rnams smad pa yin na yang / /dga' ba'i ched du longs spyad de/ /yon tan ldan la sngon nyid do/ /khyod kyang rigs pa las 'thob cing / /stobs ldan gzugs ldan dar la bab/ /gang du skye 'gro 'di 'chags na/ /yul rnams la ni phyi shol byed—/ /de ltar 'jam zhing lung dang bcas/ /de yis tshig ni gsan gyur nas / /'brug gi sgra skad dbyangs kyis ni/ /gzhon nu yis ni lan smras so/ /ngag tshig 'di ni 'thad pa ste/ /khyod la mdza' bo nyid du gsal/ /gang du bdag la ngan par sems/ /'dir ni khyod la rjes zhi bgyi/ /yul rnams la ni phyi shol byed bye/ /'jig rten de'i bdag nyid du shes/ /'gro ba mi rtag par shes nas/ /'dir ni bdag yid dga' ba min/ /rga dang na dang 'chi ba ste/ /gal te 'di gsum ma yin na/ /yid du 'ong ba'i yul rnams la/ /kho bo yang ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /gal te bud med rnams kyi lus/ /de nyid rtag par 'gyur na ni/ /skyon ldan 'dod pa rnams la yang / /kho bo'i sems ni 'dod la phyogs/ /gang tshe 'di dag rnams kyi gzugs/ /rgas pas 'thung ba 'byung 'gyur zhing / /bdag nyid kyi yang 'dod med na/ /rmongs las der ni dga' 96—39

bar 'gyur/ /rga dang na dang 'chi ba'i tshes/ /rga na 'chi ba'i bdag nyid kyis//skyo ba med par rol pa ni/ /ri dwags dang ni bya dang mtshungs/ /bdag nyid chen po 'di rnams kyang / /'dod pa'i bdag nyid ces smras gang / /hūṃ'adir ni skyo bar bya ba ste/ /gang tshe de rnams kyi yang tshad/ /gang du phyi bye las zad pa ste / /bdag nyid chen por mi sems te/ /yul rnams la — chags pa 'am/ /sbyor min bdag nyid ldan nyid kyis/ /mkhas pa yis kyang dpe brjod cing / /bden min gyis kyang bud med kyi/ /skye la zhugs zhes smras pa gang / /bden min bdag gis shes ma yin/ /gang du drang min rjes 'jug pa/ /de la bdag gis sred pa med/ /dngos po kun gyi tshogs pa de/ /gal te smon na med par 4shog /mi brtan pa yi dad pa dang / /skyon du mthong ba'i nus pa yis / /chags pa skyes par gyur pa'i sems/ /slu thubar bya ba ci zhig yin/ /bud med skyes pa'i chags skyes shing / /bud med skyes pa phan tshun du/ /gal te de ltar slu 6na ni/ /lta bar nus pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar gyur na sdug bsngal gyes/ /nyam thag rga 'chi'i skal ba can/ /bdag ni 'phags min 'dod pa la/ /slu bar 'os pa ma yin no/ /e ma shin tu brtan la stobs ldan khyod kyi sems/ /'dod pa g.yo ba rnams su snying po mthong gyur la/ /shin tu rno zhing 'jigs pa'i yul la zon mdzad cing / /rga dang rgud pa nad kyi 'jigs pa rnam sems shing / /'gro ba rnams ni me yis tshig pa bzhin thos nadz+wa/ /zhi ba 'thob min brtan min dga' ba ga la zhig /the tshom med par 'chi zhes rab tu shes pa yi/ /mi rnams gang gi snying la chags pa rab skyed pa/ /de yi sems ni lcags las gyur par shes pa ste/ /'jigs pa che la chags pa gang zhig 96—40

du ba med/ /de nas gzhon nu yis ni 'dod pa rnams kyis bstenabye / /'joms byed gtam ni rnam par nges pa'i bdag nyid mdzad/ /skye bo rnams kyi mig gi 'gro bya gsal byed kyi/ /dkyil 'khor sa 'dzin ri bo la ni nub par gyur/ /de nas rgyan dang me snyetog phreng ba 'bras med 'dzin/ /sgyu rtsal yon tan kyis dang rab dgas 'bras med rnams/ /rang gi sems la yid dkrugs rngu 'dod pa rnams smad nas/ /yid la re nyams bud med rnams ni grong du thal/ /de nas grong khyer skyed mos tshal song skye bo'i dpal/ /legs par brtags nas spyod 4la so sor brtul te yang / /thams cad mi rtag par gyur rnam par sems bzhin du/ /slar yang mi skyong bdag skyes grong du rnam par zhugs/ /de nas de yi yid ni yul la rnam par phyir phyogs rgyal pos thos gyur nas/ /snying la song ba'i zug la glang chen bzhin du mtshan mo de la gnyid ma log /de nas sngags mang rnam pa sna tshogs lam rnams dag gis 5thang chad blon por bcas/ /des ni 'dod pa las gzhan sras kyi blo yi nges pa gzigs ma gyur/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ bud med kyis gegs byas pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de ltar yul rnams dam pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis ni/ /sred du bcug kyang shākya'i rgyal po'i sras bo de/ /dug bsgos mda' yis snying la phug pa'i seng ge bzhin/ /bde ba rnyed pa ma yin brtan par gshegs ma gyur/ /de nas res 'ga' zhig na blon po'i bu mkhas shing / /grogs gyur sna tshogs gtam gyes rjes su 'brangs byas pa/ /nags kyi sa la 'gro 'dod lta bar 'dod pa yis/ /96—41

mi yi lha yis rjes gnang rmyephyi rol rab tu gshegs/ /gsar ba'i gser gye srab dang dril bu chung ngu dang / /rab tu g.yo ba'i rnga yab mdzes pa'i gser sga dang //stan bcas dam pa'i rta la mngon par zhon nas ni/ /tog la ljon dang chu skyes tog can bzhin du gshegs/ /de ni mchog tu rnam par rgyang ring nags mtha'i sa / /nags tshal 'dod dang sa yi yon tan las gshegs te/ /chu gnyer bzhin du rnam par bkram pa'i gshol 5lam can/ /nor 'dzin sa la zhing dag rmo ba gzigs par gyur/ /gshol gyi snaphya las rnam bkram rtswa myug ku sha dang / /shi gyur 'bu srin srog chags phra mos khyab pa ste/ /rnam pa ④de 'dra'i sa de yang dag mngon gzigs nas/ /rang gi skye bo bsad pa la bzhin shāmya ngan gyur/ /zhing dag rmo ba'i skyes bu rnams ni rnam gzigs pa/ /rlung gis gtor ba'i rdul gyis rnam 'gyur kha dog can/ /khur bas thang chad rnam par 'khrugs pa'i glang rnams la/ /'phags pa mchog gis 6mchog tu brtse ba'i snying rje mdzad/ /de nas mgyogs 'gro'i rgyab nas dal bus babs nas ni/ /sa la rnam par rgyu zhing mya ngan dang ldan pa/ /skye bo dag gi skye dang 'god pa rnam sems zhing / /nges par bkren pa 'di zhes smras shing nyam thag gyur/ /bsam pa yis 8/kyang rnam par dben pa mngon bzhed cing / /rjes su 'ongs pa'i mdza' bshes de rnams phyir bzlog nas/ /kun nas mngon par g.yo zhing mdzes pa'i lo 'dab can / /'dzam bu'i rtsa ba skye bo med par de gshegs so/ /rin chen bai ḍūr+ya dang mtshungs pa'i rtswa 'jam can/ /gtsang mar ldan pa'i sa gzhi der ni de zhugs te/ /'gro ba'i skye ba dang ni 'god pa rnams sems shing / /yid ni 9—brtan pa'i lam la dmigs pa'o/ /yul la 'dod sogs sems kyi nad las 96—42

rnam grol ba'i/ /sems gnas pa ni de ma thag tu thob gyur la/ /bsam gtan dang po zag pa med pa'i rab spyod snapa/ /rtog pa dpyod pa dang bcas zhi ba thob par gyur/ /rnam par dbe+en pa las skyes thob nas de nas ni/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba sems kyi ting nge 'dzin/ /yid kyis 'jig rten 'gro ba yang dag rab brtags nas/ /'di nyid de nas gzhan ni rab tu rtogs par gyur/ /kye ma skye bo bkren pa gang zhig rang dbang ni/ /yod min rga dang na dang rnam par nyams pa'i chos/ /nad pa dang ni shi dang rga bas nyam thag gam/ /gzhan la rgyags pas long zhing shes pa med pas smod/ /'dir ni gal te bdag gis rang dang mtshungs gyur pa/ /gzhan gyi rang bzhin dag la de ltar smod pa ni//mchog gi chos 'di rnam par rtog pa kho bo yi/ /mtshungs par gyur pa ma yin nus pa'ang gzhan gred do/ /'gro ba'i rga dang na dang rgud pa'i nyes pa rnams/ /de ltar ji lta ba bzhin rnam par gzigs de 2yi/ /stobs dang lang tsho dang ni srog la rab zhugs pa'i/ /bdag tu gyur pa'i rgyags pa skad cig gis med gyur//de ni dga' ba med cing rjes su gdung med la/ /the tshom som nyir ma gyur gnyid dang rmugs pa med/ /'dod pa'i yon tan rnams la yang dag ma chags shing / /gzhan la rnam par sdang bar ma gyur phyi shol med/ /de ltar bdag nyid chen po de yi rdul med cing / /rnam par dag pa'i blo gros 'di ni 'phel gyur la/ /skyes bu gzhan dag rnams kyis mthong bar ma gyur pa'i/ /dge slong cha lugs ldan pa'i skyes bu nye bar 'ongs/ /su zhig yin pa dz+res zhes mi yi lha sras kyis/ /de la mngon par dris gyur de la des smras pa/ /mi yi skyes mchog skye dang 'chi bas 'jigs pa yi/ /thar pa'i phyir ni rab tu zhugs pa'i dge spyong 96—43
