yin / /bdag ni 'gro ba zad pa'i chos ni thar 'dod cing / /dge zhing 'gyur ba med pa'i gnas de tshol ba ste/ / rang gi skye bo dang ni skye bor mnyam pa'i blo/ /1snayul rnams la ni chags ke pa'i nyes pa phyir log pa'o/ /skye bo med pa'i gnas khang dang ni ri 'am nags/ /shing gi rtsa ba 'ga' zhig tu ni gnas pa yi/ /don dam phyir rgo ji ltar nyer ldan slong mo pa/ /sred bral yongs su 'dzin pa med par rnam par rgyu/ /de ltar gzigs pa'i rgyal po'i bye sras po de nyid la/ /'di skad smras nas nam mkha' la ni gshegs par gyur/ /de ni de yi lus kyis sangs rgyas gzhan gzigs shing / /lha na gnas pa de yi dran pa'i ched du 'ongs/ /mkha' la mkha' 'gro bzhin du gshegs pa de la ni/ /mi mchog yang dag dga' bar gyur zhing ya mtshan gyur/ /de nas chos kyi 'du shes nye bar thob gyur nas/ /mngon par nges 'byung cho ga la ni blo gros mdzad/ /de nas dbang po dang mnyam dbang po'i rta thul pa/ /grong la rab tu 'jug 'dod rta la rab 'dzegs shing / /'khor gyi skye bo dag kyang mngon par 'dod pa ste / /de nyid phyir na mngon 'dod nags ni ma bsnyen geto/ /de ni rga dang 'chi ba zad par byed 'dod pa/ /nags su gnas phyir blo gros dran pa la bzung nas / gnyis 'thung dbang po nags kyi sa nas grong du ltar/ /'dod pa las min grong la slar yang rab tu zhugs/ /de ni yang dag mthong nas shākya'i bu mo zhig /rab zhugs lam la chothal mo sbyar ba dang bcas shing / /kye ma spyan dbang gang gi zhwabadag po 'di 'dra 'dir/ /mo de bde ma mya ngan 'das ma zhes smras so/ /de nas dbyangs 'di sprin chen dbyangs dang ldan pa yis7 /yongs su thos nas mchog tu zhi ba rnyed gyur la/ /mya ngan 'das zhes sgra skad 96—44

thos pa dang ldan des/ /yongs su mya ngan 'da' ba'i chos gar blo gros mdzad/ /de nas gser gyi ri bo'i rtse mo'i sku mnga' zhing / /glang chen phyag dang 'brug gi sgra dbyangs khyu mchog spyan/ /seng ge'i stobs dang ri bong can gyi zhal mnga' bas / /mi zad 7chos la chags skyes pho brang rab tu 'thob —/ /de nas mtho ris dag na lha yi 'dun sa ru/ /lha dbang 'bar ba la ni bkug sngu'agyed gzhon nu bzhin/ /blon po'i tshogs kyis nye bar bsnyen pa'i mi bdag la/ /ri dwags dbang po'i 'gros dang ldan pa mngon par gshegs/ /rab tu btud nas thal mo dang bcas smras gyur pa/ /mi dbang bdag la legs par rjes su gnang ba byen/ /nges par skye bo 'di ni rnam par 'bral ba ste/ /thar pa'i ched du yongs su rnam par gshegs par bgyi/ /de ltar de'i tshig thunges par thob khyenas rgyal po ni/ /lag ldan gyis ni mngon snun 7ljon pa ltar g.yos shing / /ka ma la dang rab mtshungs thal mo dag bzung nas/ /mchi ma dang ni gre ba kha zhing tshig 'di smras/ /brtse ba'i blo gros 'di ni rab tu thong mdzod cig /khyed kyi chos la bsnyen pa'i dus ni ma yin te/ /na tshod dang po dang 8ni blo gros g.yo ba na / /chos kyi spyod pa gsungs pa rnams ni skyon mang ngo / /yul rnams su ni dbang po ya mtshan glo bur zhing / /brtul zhugs g.yo ba rnams su nges par nus med la/ /khyad par du ni dbe+en par mngon par mi shes pa/ /dar la bab pa'i yid ni dgon pa nas g.yo'o/ /mtshon gyur khyod la phun sum tshogs pa gtad nas ni/ /kho bo yi yang chos dga' chos kyi dus yin te/ /rnam par gnon pa bstan 6pa rnam par gnon pa yis/ /bla ma spangs nas khyod kyi chos kyis chos ma yin/ /de phyir khyod kyis nan tan nges pa 'di dor la/ /khyod ni 96—45

re zhig khyim gnas chos la dga' bar gyis/ /dar la bab pas bde ba rnams ni longs spyad husnanas/ /skyes bu'i dka' thub nags su 'jug rngupa nyams dga'o/ /de ltar rgyal po'i tshig 'di rnam par gsan nas ni/ /ka la ping ka'i dbyangs kyis lan ni smras pa ste/ /rgyal po gal te bdag gi khas len bzhi rnams su/ /khyed snyekyis 'gyur na dka' thub nags ni mi bsnyen to/ /bdag gi srog ni 'chi ba nyid du mi 'gyur zhing / /bdag gi rang gnas gyur 'di nad kyis mi 'phrogs 4la / /bdag gi lang tsho rgas pa yis ltani mi g.yeng zhing / /phun sum tshogs pa 'di ni rgud pas ma gtor na'o/ /de ltar rnyed par dka' ba'i don smras gyur pa yi—/ /sras po la ni shākya'i rgyal pos tshig smras pa/ /shin tu rab tu zhugs pa'i blo 'di thong mdzod cig /shin tu yid la re ba 'phya zhing sha thang 'chad/ /de nas lhun po ltar phyis bla ma la smras pa/ /gal te rim pa de dag med de shol mi thebs/ /'bar ba'i me yis tshig pa'i khang pa nas/ /phyi rol 'byung bar 'dod pa 'dzin par nus ma yin/ /gang gi tshe na 'gro ba nges par 'bral ba ste/ /chos phyir ma yin 'di ni rnam par 'bral ba mchog /'o na bdag la 'chi bas dbang med 'bral byed cing / /rang gi don ma byas shing tshim pa ma yin nyid/ /de ltar mthar bzhed sras po de yis nges pa ni/ /sa yi 7bdag po yis ni nges par thos nas ni/ /'gro bar mi bya zhes ni mngon par brjod nas su/ /slar yang bsrung ba dag ni 'dod pa mchog rnams mdzad/ /dga' zhi zhi ba sngon 'gro bkur ste mang po las/ /blon po rnams kyis ji lta ba bzhin dpe bstan zhing / /bla mas mchi ma lhung ba rnams kyis shol btab ste/ /de nas de ni mya ngan bzhin du khyem la zhugs/ /rna lung 'khyil 9ba g.yo bas 'o byas gdong ldan ma/ /96—46

dbugs rlung stug pos rnam par bskyod pa'i nu ma can/ /bstan 7snapa min pa'i mig ldan bud med rnams kyis ni/ /ri dwags mo rnams kyis bzhin mngon par gyen du lta/ /gser byi ri bo dang 'dra dkar ser mdog de ni/ /yan lag mchog ma rnams kyi snying ni myos mdzad cing / /ngag dang reg bya dang ni lus dang yon tan gyis/ /thos byed lus dang lta byed bdag gi dngos rnams phrogasatso //nyin mo rnam par thal tshe de nas khang bzangs la/ /lus kyis nyi ma bzhin du mngon par gsal ba ni/ /rab rib rnam par 'joms 'dod bdag nyid snang ba yis/ /nyi ma shar ba lhun po la bzhin kun nas 'dzegs/ /gser byus 'bar zhing gsal ba'i sgon ma'i shing dang ni/ /a ga 1ru mchog nag po'i bdug pas zigang ba'i ltor/ /mngon par 'dzegs nas rdo rjes spras shing sna tshogs pa/ /rab mchog gser gyi bzhugs gdan la ni bsnyen pa'o/ /zla ba ltar dkar gangs dang ldan pa'i rtse mo na/ /nor dbang bdag nyid skyes la lha mo'i tshogs 'dus bzhin/ /de nas lus mchog ma rnams dbang po dang mtshungs mchog /de la mtshan mor sil snyan rnams kyis 5nye bar gnas/ /mchog rab lha yi sel snyan 'dra ba rnams kyis kyang / /de yang de yis bskyed par ma gyur dga' ba med/ /dam pa'i don gyi bde phyir legs pa de yi ni/ /mngon par nges par 'byung 'dod gang la dga' ma gyur/ /de nas der ni brtul zhugs mchog gyur 'og min gyi/ /lha rnams kyis ni 'di yi nges pa rtogs nas ni/ /lus kyi rnam 'gyur rnam par 'gyur byas dus gcig la/ / myos ma'i 47skye bo rnams ni gnyid du 'gro bar byas/ /de la kha cig dga' ba yin yang khros kyepa bzhin / /pang du son pa'i gser gyi snod ni sna tshogs pa'i/ /pi wang rnam 96—47

par spangs nas lag pa g.yo ba la/ /'gram pa rnam par bkod nas nyal bar gyur pa'o/ /'khyog min bung ba'i lhaphreng ba sgra sgogs 3pad+ma dang / /chu bo'i ngogs na chu sbur 1rab tu rgod pa bzhin/ /gzhan rnams nu mar rnam nyil dkar po'i dar gon zhing / /gling bu lag par sbyar ④zhing gnyid log rnam par mdzes / /de bzhin gzhan rnams pad+ma gsar pa'i snying po ltar/ /'jam zhing gdung bya gser gyis 'bar ba'i dpung rgyan ni/ /'dus pa'i lag pa dag gis dga' ba bzhin du ni/ /rdza rnga nyid ni yongs su 'khyud nas gnyid log gyur/ /de bzhin gzhan ni gsar ba'i gser gyes rnam brgyan zhing / /bgo ba'i gos ni ser po mchog dag gon pa ste/ /kar 3ni ka ra'i 5yal ga glang pos bsgyel ba bzhin / /dbang med par ni sdug ma gnyid kyis 'gyel bar gyur/ /de bzhin gzhan ni skar khung logs la sngas nas ni/ /nyal bar gyur pa'i lus kyi mchod sdong rnams 7'khyog pa/ /rta babs la ni sha la bhañdza reka bzhin du/ /mdzes pa'i do shal rnam par 'phyang ba rnam par mdzes/ /de bzhin gzhan gyi zhal gyi pad+ma rnam rgyas shing / /'gram pa'i logs la nor bu'i rna lung gis dmugs pa/ /'dab sgo ma brgya pa'i sdong bu'i phyed ni 'khyog pa la/ /gnas pa'i kar ṇi ḍa bas bskyod nyu1bzhin g.yos par gyur/ /gzhan ni ji ltar rnam par zhugs bzhin gnyid log cing / /nu ma'i khur gyes mngon par dud pa'i lus po rnams/ /lag pa'i zhags pa gser gyi gdu bu can rnams kyis/ /phan tshun nye bar 'khyud nas rnam par gnas te mdzes pa'o/ /rnam par g.yo zhing bskyod pa'i gser gyi skud pa can/ /rna ba'i shog dril kun nas 'khrugs pa'i gdong gis ni/ /yongs su smra ldan pi wang chen po 'khyud nas ni/ /bud med 96—48

kha cig grogs mo bzhin du gnyid log go/ /lang tsho ma gzhan lag pa'i dpung pa'i yul las ni/ /kun nas rnam 'phyang mdzes pa'i logs can pa ṇa wa/ /sgyeg 1bcas dga' ba'i mthar ni thang chad snyug pa bzhin/ /brla gnyis dag ni dbus su blangs nas nyal ba'o/ /rab tu yang dag 'khums gyur pad+ma dmar po'i mdzod/ /nyi ma nub par gyur tshe sprung bu rnams ji ltar/ /rnam rgyas mig dang mdzes pa'i smin ma yod na yang / /gzhan rnams mig rnams btsums shing mdzes par ma gyur to/ /de bzhin gzhan ni mgo skyes lhod pa las 'khrugs shing //rgyan dang dar rnams dpyi la rnam nyil de rnams ni/ /yan lag ma yi gzugs brnyan glang pos bcom pa bzhin/ /mgrin pa'i skud pa'i do shal rnam par bkram zhing nyal/ /brtan ldan lus ni yon tan rnams dang ldan na yang / /gzhan rnams kyang ni dbang med ngo tshas rnam spangs shing / /rnam par 'gyur zhing bskyod pa'i yan lag gya gyu dang / /dbugs ni rnam par rgyu zhing lus po gsal bar gnyid/ /gzhan gyi 2rgyan dang me tog phreng ba rnam brul zhing / /mdud pa'i gos rnams rnam par nyil gyur 'du shes med/ /btsums pa ma yin dkar po g.yo ba dang bral mig /srog song ro ltar nyal ba rnam par mdzes ma gyur—/ /kha sbyar rnam par gdangs te lus po rab brkyang zhing / /kha yi chu ni rab 'dzags —gsang ba rnam rab gsal/ /gzhan ma dag ni chang gis 'khrul par gyur pa nyid/ /lus rgyas rnam par 'gyur bar gnyid log mdzes ma gyur/ /de ltar sems pa dang ni rigs kyi rjes 'gro'i gzugs/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rab stsos skye bo de nyal ba/ /rlung gis kun nas bskyod gyur gser gyi pad+ma yi/ /rdzing bu dang ni mtshungs pa'i gzugs ni mdzes par gyur/ /de ltar rnam par 96—49

'gyur la brtan min spyod pa can/ /de ltar nyal ba'i lang tsho ldan ma de mthong nas / /lus kyi 3snayon tan ldan zhing smra ba'i rnguyid 'ong yang / /mi skyong sras po des ni rnam nga/ra smad par gyur/ /mi gtsang rnam par 'gyur ba gson pa'i 'jig rten te/ /bud med rnams kyi rang gi ngo bo 'di 'dra ba/ /bgo ba rnams dang rgyan rnams kyis kyang slu ba ste/ /bud med rnams kyi 4yul la skyes pa chags par 'gro/ /gal te skyes pas bud med rnams kyi rang bzhin ni/ /rmi lam rnam par 'gyur ba bzhin du rnam dpyad na/ /nges par 'dir ni bag med 'phel ba ma yin la/ /'on kyang yon tan rtog pa bcom ste chags par 'gro//de ltar de yi go skabs rnam par rig nas ni/ /mtshan mor phyi ru 'gro 'dod yang dag skyes par gyur/ /'di yi 5sems ni kun nas rtog nas de nas ni/ /lha rnams dag gis khang pa'i sgo ni phye bar gyur/ /de nas lang tsho ldan ma nyal ba de rnams ni/ /smad cing de ni lding khang logs nas babs pa ste/ /mngon par babs nas de nas som nyi rnam bral bar/ /khang pa'i rim pa dang por phyi ru rnam par gshegs/ /de ni mgyogs 'gro bsrungs 6la go bar byas nas ni/ /skyen par 'dun pa la ni 'di skad ces smras so/ /bsngags ldan rta ni khyer shog myur ba dang ldan pas/ /bdud rtsi thob phyir 'di las di ring bdag skom 7mo/ /bdag gi snying la de ring tshim pa skyes gyur zhing / /nges pa yang ste ji ltar blo gros la zhugs pa / /skye bo med pa la yang mgon dang ldan pa ste/ /nges par 'dod pa'i don ni mngon du phyogs par 'du/ /ngo tsha nyid dang yang dag 'dud pa spangs nas ni/ /lang tsho ma rnams bdag gi 1 gdong du ji bzhin nyal/ /sgo ni rang bzhin ji ltar rnam par dbye 1 ba la/ /nges par bdag ni 'di nas di 1196—50

ring 'gro ba'i dus/ /mi dbang brtan rmyepa'i don ni rnam par rig na yang / /jo bo bka' lung des ni de nas rab bzung nas/ /yid la pha rol po yis yang dag bskul ba bzhin/ /mgyogs 'gro khyer te 'ong ba la ni blo gros byas/ /de nas gdong gi gser gyi srab kyis gang ba ste/ /rgyab na yang ba'i stan g.yogs dag gis nye bar g.yogs/ /stobs dang sems pa mgyogs dang rjes 'gro nyer ldan pa/ /de yis rta mchog de la der ni nye bar 'ongs/ /snga ma'i rtsa ba rtsib logs — gsum ga rab rgyas shing / /rgyab dang rna ba lus skyes spu ni thung zhing dul/ /rgyab kyi rtsib ma dag ni dud cing rnam rgyal la/ /mchu dang dpral ba brang dang dbye ni rab rgyas pa'o/ /zhi zhing ka ma la dang mtshungs pa'i phyag gis kyang / /sku stong rnam par spangs des de la nyer 'khyud nas/ /rgyal mtshan sde la dmag dpon rab tu 'jug pa bzhin/ /mngar mo'i yi ge'i tshig gis zhal ta mdzad pa'o / /g.yul du khyod la mngon par zhon nas sa skyong gis/ /dgra bo rnams ni lan grangs mang por nges par gtor/ /bdag kyang 'chi med go 'phang ji lta ba bzhin du/ /mgyogs 'gro'i gtso bo nye bar thob pa de ltar mdzod/ /yul thob bde ba la dang nor bsgrub pa la rung / /g.yul 'gyed pa na 'khor ni nges par rnyed bla ste/ /brgyud par lhung ba la dang chos la brten par rung / /skyes bu yi yang 'khor ni rnyed par dka' ba'o/ /'di nyid du yang gang zhig 'khor du gyur pa ni/ /sdig pa'i las la dang ni chos dang ldan la rung / /ji ltar bdag gi nang gi bdag nyid kyis rtogs pa/ /mi de rnams kyang de yi cha shas skal ba yi5/ /de phyir chos dang ldan pa 'di ni yongs shes nas/ /bdag ni 'di las nges 'byung 'gro la phan pa'i phyir/ /mgyogs 'gro mchog skye shugs 96—51

dang rnam par gnon pa yis/ /bdag phan la dang 'gro phan la ni 'bad par gyis / /de ltar mdza' bshes bzhin du rjes su bslabs nas ni/ /mgyogs 'gro mchog la mi mchog 'gro 'dod de/ /dkar la dkar min 'gros kyi 'od zer lung 3ldan pa/ /nyi ma ston ka'i sprin la bzhin du yang dag 'dzegs/ /de nas 'khor gyi skye bos go bar byed pa'i skad/ /mtshan mor gtum pa dam pa'i rta des yongs bkag cing / /'gram pa'i sgra med 'tsher ba'i skad ni rab zhi bar/ /'jigs pa'i sgra ni dor ba'i gom pa'i 'gros kyis gshegs/ /gser gyi gdu bu'i rgyan ni lag pa'i mkhrig —ma la/ /ka ma la 'dras ka ma la rnams rnam byas nas / /lus 'dud gnod sbyin rnams ni de nas 'di yis ni/ /tshim gyur lag pa'i rtse mos rmig pa rnams bzung ngo / /lci mo'i sgo gtan sgo glegs yang dag bcad 4pa gang / /bde bar gnyis 'thung 5gis kyang phyed pa ma yin pa/ /mi skyong sras po gshegs tshe skad med grong khyer dang / /sgo khang de rnams rang nyid rnam par bye bar gyur/ /mngon par gdong phyogs yab dang sras po byis pa dang / /skye bo rjes su chags dang phun tshogs mchog dag ni/ /blo gros byas shing ltos pa med par dor nas ni/ /yab kyi grong nas de ni de nas rnam par gshegs / /de nas de ni rnam rgyal 'dam skyes yangs pa'i spyan/ /grong khyer kun nas gzigs nas seng ge'i sgra bsgrags tsupa/ /skye dang 'chi ba dag gi 37pha rol ma mthong bar/ /grong khyer ser skya zhes byar sherab tu mi 'jug go/ /de ltar de yi gsung ni nges par thos nas ni/ /nor gyi bdag po'i 'khor rnams dag ni dga' bar gyur/ /rab tu dga' ba'i yid can lha yi tshogs rnams ni/ /nan tan pha rol song ba de la bsngags pa byas/ /me yi lus can mtho ris 96—52

gnas pa gzhan rnams ni/ /'di yis rmyenges pa shin tu dka' ba rnams 7rig nas / /sprin stug gseb nas zla ba'i 'od zer 'thon pa bzhin/ /mtshan mo'i mun pa'i lam ni rab tu gsal 1bar byas/ /nyi ma'i mgyogs 'gro lta bu'i mgyogs 'gro de/ /yid kyis sprul pa bzhin du rnam par rgyu bzhin du/ /shing rta 'dren pas gzi nyams skar ldan bar snang la/ /de ni shin tu mang po'i dpag tshad rnams su gshegs/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ phyi rol du mngon par byung jeba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas 'gro mig nyi ma ni/ /mngon par shes pa'i yud tsam na/ /ngan spong bu yi dka' thub gnas/ /mi mchog des ni gzigs par gyur/ /blo phab gnyid log ri dwags dang / /rang gnas gnas par bya gang zhig /gzigs nas ngal sos trebazhin du dang / /don ni byas pa bzhin du gyur/ /de ni rgyags pa med don dang / /dka' thub mchod 4pa'i don nyid dang / /rang gi rjes su srung 3ba la/ /rta yi rgyab nas babs par gyur/ /mngon par babs nas kyang reg cing / /dga' zhing mig gis 'khru ba bzhin/ /nges par 'khor zhes rta dang ni/ /'dun kyepa la ni smras pa'o/ /'di ni mkha' lding dper mgyogs la/ /mgyogs 'gro la ni rjes su 'ongs/ /'dis ni bdag gi rmyestobs dang ni/ /zhi ba bdag la gus pa bstananyu 7/ /thams cad nas don gzhan yin kyang / /khyod kyi /4snying la bzung ba ste/ /gang gi jo bo dag la dga'—/ /'di ni de 'dra dag la nyid/ /gus pa med la nus pa yod/ /nus pa med la gus pa ldan/ /gus pa ldan dang nus pa ste/ /khyod 'dra sa 96—53

stengs rnyed par dka'/ /de phyir skal ba chen po'i las/ /khyod kyi 'dis ni bdag dga'o/ /gang zhig khyod kyis bsams 1pa 'di/ /'bras bu las kyang gzhan du phyogs/ /skye bo 'bras bu la gnas pa'i/ /mthun phyogs skye bo gang gis min/ /zlog la rang gi skye bo yang / /phal cher 'asnapha rol skye bor gyur/ /rigs kyi don du bu bzung zhing / /gsos pa'i don du pha bskyed la/ /sred pa'i bsam pas chags skye ste/ /byed pa med par rang nyid med/ /mang po brjod cing mdor bsnyus nas/ /bdag gi dga' chen legs byas te/ /rta blangs nas ni phyir log dang / /bdag ni 'dod pa'i gnas rab thob/ de skad smras nas phyag chen te/ /rjes su bsngags par 1byed 'dod pas/ /rgyan rnams kun nas btogs nas ni/ /gdung sems ldan pa 'di la byin/ /dbu rgyan dag nas nor bu gsal/ /sgon ma'i las la blangs nas ni/ /nyi ma 'bigs byed la bzhin des/ /tshig 'di smras bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ /'dun pa nor bu 'di long la/ /lan mang btud nas mi skyong ni/ /kun nas gdung ba zlog 4pa'i phyir/ /blo phebs par ni gsol bar bya/ /skye dang 'chi ba nyams don du/ /dka' thub nags tshal rab thob ste/ /mtho ris skom pas nges min zhing / /brtse ba gred min khros pa min/ /de phyir de ltar mngon byung ba / /bdag la mya ngan 'os ma yin/ /yun rings 'dus par gyur nas kyang / /dus kyis 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /gang phyir nges par 'bral ba ste/ /de phyir thar phyir bdag gi blo/ /be+er yang rang gi skye bo las/ /rnam par 'bral ba gang las min/ /mya ngan spong phyir nges 'byung ba/ /bdag la mya ngan 'os ma yin / /mya ngan rgyud ni 'dod la chags/ /chags pa can la mya ngan bya/ /96—54

'di yang snga ma rnams la grags/ /kho bo cag la nges par gnas/ /de ltar ster byar gyur pa lasalha/ /mya ngan 'os min lam gyis 'gro/ /skyes bu rnams la phyin log tu/ /nor gyis ster bye byar gyur pa ste/ /sa la chos kyi bdag po yang / /rnyed dka' yang ni ma yin no/ /gang yang 'di ni dus min par/ /nags su song ba yin zhe na/ /srog kyang g.yo bar gyur pa na/ /chos la dus yod ma yin no/ /de phyir da lta nyid du bdag /dge ba bsag ces nges pa ste//'chi ba'i dgra ni gnas pa na/ /gson pa la ni blo gtad cing / /zhi ba khyod kyis de la sogs/ /sa 'dzin bdag la zhu bya ste/ /ji ltar bdag ni mi dran pa/ /de ltar nyid du 'bad pa gyis/ /gzhan yang bdag la yon tan med/ /khyod kyis mi bdag la smra bya/ /yon tan med las brtse ba 'dor/ /brtse ba dor las mya ngan med/ /de ltar tshig 'di thos gyur nas/ /'dun pa gdung bas rnam 'khrugs shing / /mchi mas 'dud pa'i tshig nyid kyis/ /thal mo sbyar te lan gsol ba/ /jo bo khyed kyis —dgongs pa ni/ /gnyen la ngal ba ster ba 'dis—/ /chu bo'i 'gram na gnyis 'thung bzhin/ /bdag gi sems 'di sgyur 4ba'o / /khyod kyis sanges pa 'di lta bus/ /su yis mchi ma 'byung ba med/ /lcags las gyur pa'i snying la'ang ste/ /brtse bas 'khrug la smos ci dgos/ /gzhal med khang gi mal 9'os pa'i/ /shin tu gzhon nu 'di gang na/ /ku sha'i myu gu rno ba can/ /dka' thub nags kyi sa gang na/ /khyod kyi 'bad pa thos nas kyang / /rta gang bdag gis blangs pa 'di/ /mgon po de ni stobs kyis ni—/ /lha yis byed du bcug pa 'dra/ /khyed kyi nan tan nges pa 'di/ /rang dbang shes na gang gi phyir/ /nye bar len te mgyogs 'gro'i rta/ /ser 96—55

skya'i gzhi yi mya ngan gnas/ /med pa po yis dam chos bzhin/ /rgyal po brtse ba bgres pa dang / /sras po sdug go 'dor ba ni/ /phyag chen de ni 'os ma yin//dam pa'i bya ba byed bcom yinashesna/ /yang dag bskyed pas yongs su ni/ /thang chad gnyis pa'i ma de dang / /lha mo brjod par 'os ma yin/ /ma ning gis ni dpal thob bzhin/ /sras po byis pa yon tan ldan/ /rigs btsun bdag po'i brtul zhugs ma/ /lha mo 'dor bar 'os ma yin/ /bsngags 'os sras po grags pa 'dzin/ /snyan grags chos ni 'dzin pa'i mchog /zhen bye pa ldan pas grogs mchog bzhin/ /byis pa 'dor bar 'os ma yin/ /ci ste gnyen dang rgyal srid dag /'dor ba nyid du blo gros mdzad/ /bdag gi 1'gros ni khyod zhabs la4/ /khyab bdag bdag 'dor 'os ma yin/ /ma choghu'i bu ni bshes bzang bzhin/ /khyod ni dgon par dor nas su/ /me yis tshig pa'i sems kyis ni/ /grong du 'gro bar nus pa med/ /khyod 'dir grong du 'gro ba canazhwa/ /rgyal pos bdag la ci zhig gsung / /khyed 7kyi btsun mo'i 'khor du 'am/ /'os pa mthong na ci zhig smra/ /gang yang yon tan med pa yang / /mi bdag la smos gsung ba yang / /spyon med thub pa'i bzhin khyod kyi/ /ma gyur pa de ci zhig smra/ /ngo tsha dang bcas sems kyis ni/ /lce ni thogs par gyur pa yibye/ /bdag ni gal te yang smra ba/ /de la dad par 'os pa khusu/ /gang zhig zla ba'i 'od rdo bar/ /smra bar dad par 'dzin pa 'am/ /khyed kyis skyon shes des skyon ni/ /smra ba dad par 'dzin pa 'am/ /rtag tu rjes su brtse bcas dang / /rtag par snying rje shes pa yi/ brtse ba spong ba tshul min te/ /phyir log bdag la bka' drin mdzod/ /de ltar mya ngan gyis non pa'i/ /'dun pa'i tshig 'di 96byed56

gsan gyur nas/ /rang gnas mchog tu brtan pa yis/ /smra ba'i mchog gis bka' sprul to/ /'dun pa bdag dang bral ba la/ /kun nas gdung ba 'di thong ciganyu /lus can 'gro ba tha dad la/ /dgongs zu pa sna tshogs nges pa yin/ /gang yang brtse las rang gi skye/ /bdag gis rang ni mi 'dor te/ /'chi bas phan tshun dbang med par/ /bdag cag rnams ni 'dor bar 'gyur/ /sred pa chen po'i sdug bsngal gyi/ /mngal gang gis ni bdag bzung ste/ /'bras 1 med 'bad pa med de yis/ /bdag su bdag gi de su yin/ /ji ltar sgong skyes gnas shing la/ /yang dag 'dus nas rnam par bral/ /de ltar 'byung po 'dus pa ni/ /nges par 'bral ba'i mtha' yin no/ /ji ltar sprin rnams 'dus nas ni/ /be+er yang rnam par 'byed pa'o/ /de ltar 'du dang 'bral ba ni / /bdag dang srog chags rnams kyi lugs/ /gang gi ④phyir na 'jig rten 'di / /slus pyenas rnam par 'bral ba de6/ /de phyir rmi lam 'dus gyur la/ /bdag gi ba nyid bzod ma yin/ /shing rnams 'dab ma dmar po dang / /lhan cig skyes te rnam par 'bral/ /gzhan dang gzhan gyi 'bral ba 3ni/ /'gyur ba ma yin smos ci dgos/ /de phyir de ltar gyur na ni/ /zhi ba gdung ba ma byed song / /gal te yang ni brtse ba 'be+ebasabye/ /song nas kyang ni slar yang shog /kho bo cag la ltos byas pa'i/ /ser skya'i gzhi na rmyeskye bo la/ /der song brtse ba thong cig dang / /'di yi nges la nyon cig smos/ /rga dang 'chi ba zad byas nas/ /yang na myur du 'ong ba'i gtam/ /rtsom pa nyams shing don ma byas/ /yang na nyams par 'gyur ba smros/ /de ltar 'di yi tshig thos nas/ /bsngags ldan mgyogs 'gro'i mchog gis ni/ /lce yis zhabs la 96—57

rab ldags rmyete/ /mchi ma dron mo phyung bar gyur/ /dra ba dang ni bkra shis rtags / /'khor lo dbus ldan phyag gis ni/ /gzhon nus de la reg gyur cing / /na tshod bzhin du rnam par smras/ /bsngags ldan mchi ma ma 'don cing snye/ /dam pa'i rta nyid 'di bstan to/ /sron mdzod khyod kyi ngal ba 'dis/ /myur du 'bras bu bcas par 'gyur/ /de nas ral gri rnon po nor bu'i yu ba can/ /gser gyi phra ni sna tshogs dang ldan 'dun pa yi/ /lag na yang dag gnas pa brtan pa des bsnams nas/ /khyang bu dag nas sbrul bzhin zhugs nas rab tu drungs / /ut+pa la yi 'dab ma sngon po de drangs nas/ /sna tshogs dbu rgyan dbu skrar bcas pa rab bcad cing / /rdzing bu dag na ngang pa bzhin du rnam bkram pa/ /'od zer dang ldan bar snang dag la de gtor ro/ /mchod pa mngon par 'dod phyir rnam mang bkur ste'i phyir/ /lha ni gnas pas rab tu bkram pa de bzung ste/ /ji lta ba bzhin de ni lha ni lha tshogs rnams/ /lha yi khyad par 'phags pa rnams kyis mchod pa byas/ /rgyan ni bud med 1ldan pa rnam par spangs nas kyang / /dbu las dpal ni rnam par rgyang ring byas nas ni//nags su gser gyi ngang pa'i mtshan ma gos gzigs nas/ /brtan pa des ni gos dag mngon par 'dod par gyur/ /de nas lha ni gnas par ri dwags sngon po'i 6lus/ /dgongs pa rnam dag 'di yi dgongs pa rnams rig )7nas/ /kha bsgyur ngur smrig gos can nye snalogs mngon par 'ongs/ /de la shākya'i rgyal po skyes kyis mngon par smras/ /khyod kyi dge yi ngur smrig drang srong rgyal mtshan dang //'tshe sheb byed pa'i gzhu —'di rigs pa ma yin te/ /de phyir zhi ba gal te 'dir ni chags med na/ /bdag la rab tu byin la 'di dang 'di snoms mdzod/ /96—58

rngon pas smras pa 'dod sbyin 'dod pa snying po las/ /'di yis blo ni phab nas ri dwags rnams gsod do/ /brgya byin mtshungs pa gang de 'dis ni don 'gyur na / /e ma rab tu bzhes la dkar po de gsol mdzod/ /de nas de ni mchog tu rab tu dga' ba yis/ /nags su byung ba'i na bza' blangs shing gos dor la/ /rngon 2snapa nyid kyang lha yi lus nyid rnam bzung ste/ /dkar po de nyid blangs nas lha ni gshegs par gyur/ /de nas gzhon nu dang ni rta mchog skyong ba des/ /de ltar gshegs pa de la ya mtshan skyes gyur te/ /nags nas byung ba'i na bza' nyid dang de la ni/ /slar yang ri mor bya ba mang po skyen par mdzad / / 7gdong ni mchi ma dang bcas 'dun pa rnams bzlog nas/ /bdag nyid chen po brtan dang grags pa 'chang ba ste/ /mtshams kyi sprin gyis g.yogs pa'i skar ma'i rgyal po bzhin/ /ngur smrig gyon zhing gdung sems byegang yin de nas gshegs/ /de nas de ltar jo bo rgyal srid mi bzhed par/ /dka' thub nags su gshegs pa mdog nyams snang ba na/ /mgyogs 'gro 'chang de phyag rgyas gyen du bskyod byas nas/ /shin tu rnam par ngu zhing sa la 'gyel gyur to/ /rnam par bltas nas slar yang sgra bcas par ngu zhing / /bsngags ldan rta la lag pa dag gis nyer 'khyud nas/ /de nas kho chad yang dang yang du zlog bzhin du/ /lus kyis sngusong bar gyur kyang sems kyis ma yin no/ /la lar rab tu sems zhing thul lar rnam par du/ /la lar sa la rab tu 'brad cing la lar 'gyel/ /de nas 'gro bzhin gus pa'i dbang gis snesdug bsngal zhing / /dbang med lam na bya ba mang po byas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ bsngags ljuldan phyir la bzlog khye 96—59

pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas 'dun pa gyengu zhing gdong ni mchi ma can/ /bzlog nas nags su 'dun pa'i dka' thub chags med pa/ /don kun grub pa'i lus kyis mngon par zil mnan nas/ /dka' thub gnas de byegrub pa bzhin du rab tu thob/ /de nas ri dwags rgyal po'i 'gros can rgyal po'i sras po de/ /ri dwags gnas der ri dwags bzhin du rab zhugs pa/ /phun tshogs rnams dang bral yang lus kyi phun tshogs kyis/ /dka' thub gnas ldan kun gyi mig dag phrogs par gyur/ /khur ldan rnams bzhin mgo bo rnams ni phyed — dud pas/ /lag na gnya' shing bcas par 'gro gyur ya mtshan la / /de bzhin 'khor los sgyur ba chung ma dang bcas pa/ /dbang po dang mtshungs de mthong song bar ma gyur to/5/ /sbyin sreg bud shing phyir ni bram ze rnams phyin nas/ /me tog lo 'dab rgyas pa'i lag pa gtsang ma rnams/ /dka' thub gtso bo rnams — blo rnams byas na yang / /gshegs pa mthong ste klog grar song bar ma gyur to/ /chu gter sngon po bzhin du mthong nas rma bya rnams/ /dga' zhing gyen du dud cing skad dag 'don gyur la//rgya skyegs 7ri dwags spyod ldan rnams dang ri dwags rnams/ /'bru rnams bor nas mngon par gdong phyogs gnas par gyur/ /'od zer ldan pa shar ba lta bur 'bar ba yis/ /bu ram shing pa'i rigs kyi sgon ma de mthong nas/ /sbyin sreg 'jo rnams bzhos pa yin na yang / /rab tu dga' ba skyes te rab tu 'jo gyur to/ /'di ni nor sbyin rnams kyi brgyad pa yin nam ci/ /tha skar dag gi nang nas gcig ni 'phos sam zhes/ /de mthong ba la ya mtshan skyes par 96—60

gyur pa yi/ /thub pa rnams kyi tshig der mthon por sgogs par gyur/ /lha yi khyu mchog gnyis pa'i lus po lta bu dang / /'jig rten rgyu dang mi rgyu'i snying po lta bu dang / /gang 'dod pa yis nyi ma mngon par babs 'dra ba/ /des ni nags tshal mtha' dag rab tu snang bar mdzod/ /de nas gdung gnas pa de rnams kyi ji lta 1bzhin/ /nye bar snyan gsan phab cing mngon par mchod gyur la—/ /de ni chu bcas chu 'dzin lta bu'i dbyangs kyis ni/ /chos 'dzin rnams la slang yang rab tu mchod par gyur/ /de nas rnam par thar bzhed 2brtan pa de yis ni/ /dka' thub sna tshogs rnams la nges par rnam gzigs shing / /mtho ris mngon 'dod bsod nams byas pa'i skye bo yis/ /khyab pa'i dka' thub gnas der rjes su dpyad ༄ —par gyur/ /dka' thub nor can rnams kyi dka' thub nags tshal der/ /dka' thub rnam par 'gyur ba rnams ni nges gnas 4nas/ /rjes su gshegs pa'i dka' thub ldan pa kha cig la/ /zhi bas de nyid rnam par shes bzhed 'di gsungs so/ /gang phyir chos kyi cho ga 'di ni mi shes pa/ /bdag gis phyodaka' thub gnas mthong de ring snga ma'o/ /de phyir khyod kyis bdag la smra bar 'os min te/ /nges pa gang zhig gang la rab tu 'jug pa'o/ /de nas dka' thub rnam par rgyu ba'i gnyis skyes des/ /shākya'i khyu mchog khyu mchog rnam par gnon pa po/ /de la rim gyis dka' thub khyad par rnams dang ni/ /dka' thub 'bras bu dang bcas gtam dag byas pa'o/ /grong byung bza' ba ma yin chu la rab skyes pa'i/ /'dab ma rnams dang chu dang 'bras bu rtsa ba nyid/ /thub pa rnams kyi spyod pa 'di ni lung ji ltar/ /dka' thub rnams kyi rnam rtog tha dad de de'o/ /kha cig ri dwags bzhin du rtswa rnams 96—61

la spyod la~X/ /gzhan rnams bor ba yis ni mkha' la rgyu ba'i bya ltar 'tsho/ /kha cig lag 'gro rnams dang lhan cig 'tsho ba ste/ /grog mkhar gyur pa rnams ni nags na rlung gis so/ /rdo yis rab 'bad bsgrub pa'i spyod pa gzhan rnams te//kha cig rang gi so yis nye bar blangs shing za/ /de bzhin gzhan ni gzhan gyi 3 don du bcos chobyas nas/ /gal te lhag ma yod na bya ba byed pa'o/ /chu yis gsher ba'i ral pa'i tshogs can kha cig ni/ /gsang sngags sngon 'gro lan gnyis me la sbyin sreg cing / /kha cig nya dang mnyam par chu la rnams zhugs nas/ /rus sbal bzhin du lus rnams rab tu bsgum pa'o/ /de ltar dus su bsags pa'i dka' thub nags tshogs kyi/ /mchog gis lhar 'gro gzhan gyes mi yi 'jig rten te/ /sdug bsngal lam gyis bde ba nye bar thob phyir dang / /chos kyi rtsa ba bde ba nyid du gsungs phyir ro/ /de skad ces sogs rkang gnyis dbang po'i sras po yis/ /dka' thub nor dang ldan pa de yi tshig gsan nas/ /de nyid gzigs pa min yang ngoms sngupar ma gyur la/ /bdag tu song ba 'di ni dal bus gsungs par gyur/ /sdug bsngal bdag nyid dka' thub rnam pa du ma ste / /dka' thub bdag 5gi 'bras bu mtho ris gtso bo'o/ /'jig rten thams cad yongs su 'gyur ba dang ldan la/ /nyung ngu la ngal 'di ni gdung gnas rnams kyi'o/ /phangs pa rnams dang gnyen dang yul rnams bor nas ni/ /gang zhig mtho ris phyir ni rnam par spyod byed la/ /de rnams rnam par bral te nges par 'gro 'dod la/ /slar yang shin tu 'ching ba chen po nyid yin no/ /lus kyi ngal dub gdung ba'i bya ba rnams kyis ni/ /'dod pa'i rgyu las rab tu 'jug par 'dod pa'o/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i skyon rnams yongs su mi rtog 6 96—62

par / /sdug bsngal gyis de sdug bsngal kho na rjes su tshol/ /'chi bas skye dgu rnams kyis 77rtag par 'jigs pa ste/ /'bad pa yis ni slar yang rab tu 'jug par 'dod/ /rab tu zhugs par gyur na nges par 'chi ba ste/ /'di nyid du ni gang las 'jigs pa rnams lhung ngo / /'di yi don du gcig rnams ngal bar rab 'jug cing / /gzhan rnams mtho ris don du ngal ba 'thob pa ste//bde ba'i don du sred pa'i bkren pa don ma byas/ /gson pa'i 'jig rten nges par don med nyid du lhung / /gang zhig dman pa dor nas khyad 'phags 'gro ba can / /'bad pa 'di ni nges par smad pa ma yin la/ /shes ldan rnams dang mnyam pa'i yongs su gdung ba yis/ /bya ba ma yin de 'dir slar yang byed pa'o//lus kyi gtser bas gal te 'dir ni chos yin na/ /lus kyi bde ba chos ma yin par 'gyur ba ste/ /pha rol du ni bde ba chos kyis kyang 'thob la/ /de 2snaphyir 'di yis chos kyi — chos min 'bras bu'o/ /gang gi 4phyir na bsams ༄pa'i dbang gis lus yin la/ /rab tu 'jug pa dang ni zlog 6pa dag kyang ngo / /de phyir sems kyi medul ba nyid ni rig 8pa ste/ /sems las gzhan pa'i lus ni shing dang mnyam pa'o/ /bza' ba gtsang bas gal te bsod nams 'dod na ni/ /de phyir ri dwags rnams kyang bsod nams yod pa ste/ /phyi rol skyes bu gang dag rnams kyang 'bras bu las/ /bskal pa'i nyes pas don rnams gzhan du kha bltas so/ /bsod nams phyir ni sdug bsngal mngon par mtshams sbyor na/ /'o na sdug bsngal 9mngon par mtshams sbyor tshad ma min/ /de ltar gang dag las ni rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ /stegs zhes 9rab tu zhugs te chu la reg par byed / /de /1yang de yi snying la tshim pa tsam yin te/ /chu yis sdig pa dag 96—63

par byed pa ma yin phyir/ /yon tan ldan pas 1rig pa'i chu ni gang dang gang / /de dang de ni sa la gal te stegs 'dod na/ /chu yang the tshom med par chu nyid kho na ste/ /de phyir yon tan ldan rnams kho na stegs su go/ /de ltar rigs pa mang po ldan pa de dang de/ /smras te rnam par mdzes pa'i nyi ma nub par gyur/ /de nas sbyin sreg du bas kha dog 'gyur ba'i shing / /dka' thub rab tu zhi ba'i khrus sar rnam par zhugs/ /mngon par bton pa'i rab tu 'bar ba'i me yis thal ba bye ni/ /dbang bskur byas pa'i drang srong skye bos khyab pa ste/ /bzlas bya'i dbyangs kyis kun nas skad sgogs lha yi tshogs/ /chos kyi lam gyi las kyi mtha' snyebazhin rab tu zhugs pa'o/ /de ni mtshan mo thang 'ga' mtshan mor byed 'od kyisame/ /dka' thub rnams la yongs su rtog cing zhugs gyur la/ /dka' thub thams cad yongs su brtags shing mkhyen gyur na/ /dka' thub zhing gi thang de las ni gshegs par gyur/ /de'i gzugs bdag nyid chen por song ba'i yid rnams kyis/ /dka' thub gnas ldan rnams ni de nas de rjes gshegs//'phags min sdig pa rnams kyis zil non yul las ni/ /drang srong chen po rnams ni chos bzhin pha rol gshegs/ /de nas ral pa shing shun zur phud kyis rol ba'i/ /dka' thub nor dang ldan pa de rnams des gzigs shing / /de dag rnams kyis hūṃdaka' thub rnams la rjes brten te/ /dpal dang ldan la dge ba'i shing gi rtsa bar gnas/ /de nas dka' thub gnas ldan rnams ni nyer 'ongs nas/ /mi mchog de la yongs su bskor nas gnas gyur la/ /de dag rnams kyi rgyan pos mchod ma sngon btang ste/ /dus kyi zhi bas tshig 'di rab tu 'di smras so/ /khyod kyis byon tshe gdung gnas gang ba bzhin gyur la/ /rab 96byed64

tu gshegs tshe stong pa bzhin du rab tu thob/ /de phyir brtse ba 'di ni 'bor bar 'os min te/ /'tsho bar 'dod pa'i phangs pa'i tshe yis lus bzhin no/ /lha yi drang srong tshangs pa'i drang srong rgyal po yis/ /drang srong gis bsnyen bsod nams nye bar gang ldan ri/ /dka' thub nor ldan rnams kyi dka' thub de rnams ni/ /gang gi nye logs dag nas mang por 'gyur ba'o/ /de bzhin kun nas bsod nams dag gi stegs gyur la/ /nam mkha'i 'og gi jem skas dag tu gyur pa ste/ /lha yi drang srong rnams dang drang srong chen po ni/ /chos kyi bdag nyid bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis bsnyen/ /'di nas slar yang khyad 'phags chos kyi ched 1las be+e/ /byang gi phyogs nyid kho nar bsnyen par nus pa ste/ /blo dang ldan pas gom pa gcig tu gyur pa yang / /lho yi phyogs su 'gro bar nus pa ma yin no/ /dka' thub nags 'dir ji ste bya ba ngan pa 'am/ /bsre ma'i chos sam ltung ba 2min nam mi gtsang bar/ /khyed kyis mthong ste gang gis khyed 'di bzhugs 'dod min/ /de ni gsung la re zhig sred par bzhugs mdzod cig/dka' thub gter dang rab tu mtshungs par gyur pa la/ /'di rnams kyis ni dka' thub grogs su 'dod pa ste/ /dbang po dang mnyam spyod dang lhan cig gnas pa ni/ /phur bu yi yang mngon par mtho ba 'dren pa yin/ /dka' thub ldan pa'i gtso bos de skad ces smras te/ /srid pa 4rab tu nyams phyir dam bca' byas pa yis/ /mkhas pa'i gtso bo des ni dka' thub ldan dbus su/ /nang du song ba'i rang bzhin smras par gyur pa'o/ /'gron la sdug cing rang gi skye bo dang mtshungs pa'i/ /drang po'i bdag nyid chos 'dzin thub pa rnams kyis 5ni//bdag la rnam pa de ltar bsam pa skyes pa yis/ /bdag gi 6dga' ba mchog 96—65

dang bkur ste skyes par gyur/ /mdor bsdus gyur na brtse zhing bsnyen shesnapa 'di rnams dag /snying la song ba'i ngag rnams ngag gis khrus byas bzhin/ /kun nas 'dzin med chos can bdag gi dga' ba ni/ /de ring slar yang cung zhig g.yos par gyur pa nyid/ /de ltar rab tu zhugs pa'i khyed cag skyabs 'os rnams / /shin tu phyogs su lhung ba yang dag bstan pa rnams/ /bor nas 'gro zhes kho bo yi yang sdug bsngal te/ /ji ltar gnyen 'dun rnams ni spangs pa de ltar ro/ /khyed cag rnams kyi chos 'di mtho ris ched du ste/ /bdag gi mngon par mtho bar yang srid ma yin phyir/ /nags der gang gi bdag ni sdod 'dod ma yin te/ /chos las ldog pa rab tu 'jug pa tha dad phyir/ /de phyir nags 'di dag na gang gis yongs 'gro ba/ /bdag gi ma dga' ma yin pha rol spyod log min/ /sngon kyi dus na rjes mthun chos la gnas pa yi/ /drang srong chen po thams cad rnams dang mtshungs par gyur/ /de nas don dang ldan la bde zhing yid du 'ong / /legs mthun mdangs dang ldan la snying po dang ldan pa / /gzhon nu'i tshig ni dka' thub ldan pa de rnams kyis/ /thos nas khyad 'phags dang ldan bkur snyi mang pos gshegs/ /de nas gnyis skyes thal ba la nyal kha cig ni/ /lus ring gtsug tor dang ldan shing shun gos gyon zhing / /mig ni cung zad dmar ser sna ni phra la rings4/ /lag gabyug spyi blugs ldan pas tshig 'di smras pa'o/ /khyod kyis snyenges pa nyid du rgya chen blo ldan zhing / /gzhon nu khyed kyi 6skye ba la ni nyes pa gzigs/ /mtho ris dang ni nyes ṣ+pe7pa yang dag rnam spyod phyir/ /thar pa gang gi blo gros yod pa de yin no/ /mchod sbyin dka' thub nges pa de dang de rnams kyisaX / /chags pa dang ldan mtho ris la ni 96—66

'gro bar 'dod/ /dgra bo bzhin du chags dang lhan cig g.yul sprad snanas/ /sems pa rang ldan thar pa ru ni 'gro bar 'dod/ /de phyir gal te khyod kyi blo gros 'di nges na/ /skyen par spyod nyid 'bigs byed phug par gshegs mdzod cig /gang zhig mthar thug nges par legs pa thob pa'i mig /thub pa 'di ni de ru mtshan mo min par gnas/ /de phyir khyod kyis de nyid lam ni thob 'gyur la / /sred par gyur na yang dag rab tu thob thupar 'gyur/ /bdag gi mthong ba ji ltar blo gros de de ltar/ /de nyid kyi yang blo gros bor nas 'gro bar 'gyur//gsal zhing mtho ba'i shangs dang rnam rgyas yangs pa'i spyan/ /zangs mdog ya mchu ma mchu rno dkar mche ba can/ /ljags ni dmar zhing phra ba'i zhal dang ldan pa 'di/ /shes bya'i rgya mtsho mtha' dag la ni 'gro ba nyid/ /khyod kyi zab pa dang ni gting dpag dka' gang dang / /gang zhig sgon ma nyid dang mtshan rnams gang yin pas/ /sngon gyi bskal par drang srong gis kyang 5ma mthong ba'i/ /slob dpon nyid de sa la mngon par dga' nas gshegs/ /dka' thub ldan pa de rnams kyis kyang de la yang / /cho ga bzhin rjes byas nas dka' thub nags der gshegs/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ /dka' thub kyi nags su zhugs pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas mgyogs 'gro spyod de yid mi bde gyur te/ /de ltar jo bo nags su nga med par gshegs la/ /lam du mya ngan med pa 'bad pa /byas gyur te/ /de lta kyen yang de yi mchi ma khogs ma gyur/ /gang la jo bo'i bka' la mtshan mo gcig gis ni/ /mgyogs 'gro de dang gshegs par gyur pa'i lam/ /lam 96—67

de nyid la 'gro zhag dag ni brgyad rnams kyis/ /jo bo nyid dang bral ba de yis sems shing 1'ongs/ /'thon pa med pas rgyags pa med par gyur pa yis /bsngags ṭaldan mgyogs 'gro nyid kyang mdangs med rgyu ba ste/ /de ltar rgyan de rnams kyis brgyan par byas na yang / /de yis dor bas dpal ni song ba bzhin du gyur/ /phyir log nas kyang dka' thub nags su mngon phyogs te/ /snying rje bar ni yang dang yang du drag tu 'tsher/ /lam na ltogs /1pa ldan pa yin yang 'bru dang 4chu/ /ji ltar sngon bzhin mngon par ma dga' ma bslangs so/ /de nas 'gro la phan pa'i bdag nyid bdag nyid rī/chen po des/ /ser skya zhes bya'i grong khyer rnam par dman pa la/ /nyin mor byed pas bor ba'i nam mkha' 'bras med bzhin/ /rim gyis de gnyis stong pa bzhin du nye bar song / /pad+ma dkar po dang bcas chu yis mdzes gyur zhing / /me tog 'dzin pa'i shing rnams kyis ni brgyan pa ceyang / /grong khyer pa rnams rab tu dga' ba song gyur te / /de yi nye ba'i nags de nags ltar mdzes ma gyur/ /de ltar lta byed mchi mas bcom pa'i mi rnams ni/ /rab tu 'bar min zhan pa'i yid kyis phyogs su skor/ /'ong du mi ster ba bzhin gnyis po de grong du/ /dal bus log pa'i khrus bzhin mngon par song bar gyur/ /shākya'i rigs kyi drang srong dang bral 'ongs pa yis7/ /lus zags 'gros dang ldan pa de gnyis mthong nas kyang / /sngon tshe shing rta bcu pa'i shing rta 'ongs pa bzhin/ /grong khyer skye bo rnams ni lam du mchi ma phyung / /de nas mya ngan nye bar ldan pa'i skye bo dag /mchi ma phyung ba rnams kyis 'dun pa la smras pa/ /grong khyer yul 'khor dga' mdzad rgyal po'i sras po de/ /khyed kyis gang du bor zhes rgyab nas rjes su 'gro/ /96byed68

de nas gus ldan skye bo de la des smras pa/ /mi dbang sras po bdag gis yongs su bor ba min/ /ngu bzhin skye bo med pa'i nags su kho bo dang / /khyem bdag 1 cha lugs dag kyang de yis rnam par spangs/ /de yi tshig ni skye bo de rnams kyis thos nas/ /nges par shin tu dka' ba nyid ces nges par song gyur la/ /'gyel zhing mig skyes chu ni rnam par 'thor 5ba ste/ /yid la smod grucing bdag nyid kyis ni 'bras bu long / /de nas smras pa gnyis skyes rgyal po'i shugs mnga' ste / /gang du gshegs pa'i nags der di ring zhugs par bgye/ /lus can dbang po ma tshang rnams kyi ji lta bar/ /de dag bral bas bdag cag 'tshe bar 'dod pa med/ /de dang bral ba'i grong khyer 'di ni nags yin la/ /de dang yang dag ldan pa'i nags de grong khyer yin/ /lha ni lha min gsod tshe brgya byin kyis ji ltar/ /de dag cebral bas bdag gi grong khyer mdzes ma gyur/ /de nas slar yang gzhon nu phyir la log ces te/ /yan lag ma rnams skar khung phreng 5 rnams rab thob ste/ /mgyogs 'gro'i rgyab ni rnam par dbe+en pa mthong gyur nas/ /slar yang skar khung rnams ni rnam par bkag nas ngu / /brtul zhugs dang ni mya ngan ngag gis yid dub cing / /brtul zhugs la rab zhugs pas sras po nyer thob phyir/ /bzlas byas shing gi lha yi khang par mi bdag gis/ /bsam pa ji ltar bya ba 5de dang de rnams byas/ /de nas mig dag mchi mas rab tu gang ba des / /mgyogs 'gro blangs nas mgyogs 'gro rjes su 'gro ba ste/ /g.yul 'gyed pa na dgra bos jo bo khyer ba ltar/ /mya ngan dag gis mngon bcom mi skyong khang par zhugs/ /mi dbang rgyal po'i khab tu rnam par zhugs pa na/ /rnam par blta zhing mig dag mchi ma 'bab pa yis/ /skye bo la ni sdug bsngal 96—69

rab tu rtogs 'jug bzhin/ /bsngags ①ldan mgyogs 'gro gsal 1ba'i dbyangs kyis ngus par gyur/ /de nas khang pa'i dbus na spyod pa'i bya rnams dang / /nye bar brtags snyepa'i mgyogs 'gro dam par byed rnams kyis/ /mi dbang sras po log par gshegs la the tshom ste/ /mgyogs 'gro de yi 5dbyangs la so sor ram 'degs byas/ /ji ltar bsngags 5ldan mgyogs 'gro 'tsher bar byed pa ste/ /nges par gzhon nu khab tu rnam par zhugs snyam ste/ /dga' ba phul du byung bas bslus pa'i skye bo rnams/ /skye bo'i bdag po'i btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nye logs song / /shin tu dga' ba las ni mya ngan gyis brgyal rnams/ /gzhon nu blta ba la ni g.yo ba'i spyan ma rnams/ /ston ka'i chu gter sprin las glog ni g.yo ba bzhin/ /bud med rnams ni sred pas khyim nas phyir la 'thonabyu //lan bu rnam par 'phyang zhing dar gos dri ma can/ /mig rtsi dang bral mchi mas mig bcom gdong rnams kyis/ /mtshan mo zad tshe skya rengs kyis jemakhar skar ma bzhin/ /byi dor dang bral bud med rid snyernams mdzes ma gyur/ /rkang pa rkang gdub dang bral zangs mdog ma chags rnams/ /gdong pa rna lung dang bral mgrin pa drang po rnams/ /rang bzhin gyis rgyas brla ni 'og phab dang bral rnams / /nu ma do shal dang bral stod g.yogs tshad rnams so/ /rten dang bral ba'i 'dun pa dang ni mgyogs 'gro nyid/ /mig ni mchi ma dang ldan de rnams kyis mthong nas/ /nags mthar khyu mchog dang bral ba glang rnams bzhin du / /sems khral gdong ldan yan lag mchog ma rnams ni ngus/ /de nas rgyal po'i ḍa—btsun mo mchi ma dang bcas tshipar/ /be+e'u nyams pa'i ma te mo ltar mnyes gshin 11/ma/ /gser gyi chu shing lo 'dab rnam par g.yo ba bzhin/ /go 96—70

ta ma mas ni lag pa bzung nas 'gyel/ /dpung pa lag pa mnyam zhing 1gzi brjid bcom pa yisakye/ /bud med gzhan rnams yid mi bde bas sems med bzhin—/ /mchi ma ma bton 'o dod 'bod min dbugs med par/ /g.yo bral ri mo bris pa bzhin du gnas par gyur/ /brtan min bdag po'i mya ngan gyis brgyal bud med gzhan/ /rnam par lta byed nas 'bab rgyun gyi gdong rnams kyis/ /sa 'dzin ri bo nas 'bab rgyun gyi rdo ba ltar/ /tsan+dan rab bskus —7nu ma rnams la rnam par 'thor/ /de rnams kyis ni mig chus btab pa'i gdon rnams kyis/ /rgyal po'i khab de de tshe mdzes par gyur pa ni/ /chu gsar dus na chu gter char kyis btab pa yi/ /chu 'dzin pad+ma rnams kyis sprung bu ji ltar ro/ /rgyas shing bar med legs par zlum pa'i sor mo can/ /rgyan bral rtsa mi mngon pa'i ④yan lag mchog ma rnams/ /rlung gis g.yos pa'i ljon shing rang gi 'dab mas ltar/ /pad+ma lta bu'i lag pa rnams kyis brang rnams brdungs / /nags rlung gis sgul 5pad+ma lta bur g.yos pa yis ngang pa rnams kyi gye'akhrigs pa rnams kyis tsochu klung ltar/ /brang brdungs rab bskyod 'byel mtho'i nu ma rnams kyis ni/ /de lta na yang mi mo de rnams mdzes par gyur/ /ji ltar brang rnams la ni lag pas zug byas pa/ /de ltar lag pa rnams la brang ni zug byed cing / /le lo can ma brtse med stobs rnged ma yis der/ /lag pa'i rtse dang brang rnams phan tshun zug byas so/ /de nas khros pas rab tu dmar ba'i spyan ldan ma/ /sems khral gyis sbrel mgrin pa kha zhing ldab ldib dang / /shugs ring 3phyung bas 'o ma 'dzin g.yo brtan pa yi/ /mya ngan mchi ma 'dzin pa'i grags 'dzin mas smras pa/ /mtshan mo gnyid log dbang med bdag ni 96—71

rnam rngu/spangs nas/ /'dun pa 'dod pa'i shing rta de ni gang du thal/ /gsum po mnyam du song la khyod dang bsngags /rnguldan ni/ /nye bar 'ongs pas kho mo'i yid ni g.yos par gyur/ /kho mo 'phags min brtse min bshes ma yin pa'i las//phul byung de 'dir byas nas da ni ci la ngu / /mchi ma ma 'don khyod kyi sems ni sim par 'gyur/ /khyod kyi mchi ma dang ni las de gtam ma yin/ /dga' dang dbang du song dang phan dang legs pa dang / /ci lta ba bzhin don byed khyod nyid dang 'grogs shing / /slar mi ldog pa'i ched du jo bo sras po thal/ /khyod kyis ༄nga la 'bras bcas sems ni dga' bar gyis/ /mi yi dbang po'i dgra bo dag ni mchog yin la/ /spyor min la mkhas shes rab med pa'i bshes mchog min/ /nges par mdza' bshes rnam par mi mkhas khyod kyis ni/ /'di yi rigs kyi nye bar nub pa chen po byas/ /rab chags dri mas 'dres shing dmar ba'i mig can ma/ /kun nas rgyan dang bral ba 'di rnams mya ngan byed/ /gangs ldan ri bo dang mnyam bdag bo gsan 5na yang / /bud med rnams ni yugs sa 6mo bzhin mdzes pa nyams/ /'di dag rnams kyang bya 'dab lag pa rnam bskyod cing / /rtag par phug ron rnams kyi ring ba'i skad rnams ni7 / /de dang bral bas 'bras med pho brang 'khor dang bcas/ /gzhal med khang pa'i gtsang rnams shin tu ngu ba 'dra/ /skye bo 'di ni kun nas don med 'dod pa ste/ /bsngags ldan mgyogs 'gro de yang nges pa nyid du'o/ /mtshan mo skye bo gnyid che rkun pos rin chen bzhin/ /bdag gi 'di ltar 'di nas nor rdzas thams cad stor / /mgyogs 'gro 'dis ni mda' yi rma srol byung rnams kyang / /sron par nus zhes grags na lcags rnams smos ci dgos/ /bdag gi snying dang 96—72

'dra ba'i dpal ni blangs gyur nas/ /'dis ni lcags lhung 'jigs las song khyeb yin nam ci/ /ci dbang pho brang yongs su gang ba bzhin du ni/ /'phags pa min las da lta drag tu 'tsher bar byed/ /gang gi tshe na bdag gi dga' ba phyi rol gshegs/ /de yi 2tshe na mgyogs 'gro lkugs pa 1thang chad gyur/ /gal te skye bo dag la go bar 'tsher byed dam/ /yang na rmig pas sa la rmig pa'i sgra byed dam/ /yang na 'gram pa'i sgra ni mchog tu bskyod na ni/ /bdag la sdug bsngal 'di 'dra 'byung ba ma yin no/ /de ltar 'dir ni lha mo'i smre sngags la brten zhing / /mchi mas 'dud 4pa yi ge'i tshig dag thos gyur nas/ /'og tu gdong phyogs mchi ma dang bcas thal sbyar te/ /'dun pas lan 'di dal bus hūṃ smras par gyur pa'o/ /lha mo bsngags ldan la ni smod par 'os min zhing / /kho bo la yang khro bar mdzad pa 'os ma yin/ /kho bo cag gi skyon min lha mo mkhyen par mdzod/ /mi yi lha de lha bzhin bkra shis kun gyis gshegs/ /bdag gis rgyal po'i brtan 5pa shes pa yin na yang / /lha nyid gang dag gis ni stobs las byas pa bzhin/ /bdag gis mgyogs 'gro 'di ni nye bar 'ongs pa de7/ /lam na ngal ba med par de ltar rjes su song / /mgyogs 'gro mchog 'di nyid kyang gshegs tshe sa la ni/ /bar snang dag la ṣ+pebazung bzhin rmig pas ma reg cing / /de bzhin lha yi ched du gdong ni sngogs byas bzhin/ /'gram pa'i sgra ni byas min 'tsher ba dag kyang med/ /gang las sa skyong bdag nyid skyes pa gshegs pa na/ /de tshe sgo ni rang nyid bye bar gyur pa ste/ /mtshan mo'i mun pa nyi mas bzhin du bsal gyur te/ /de yi phyir yang lha yi cho ga de zung shig ri/ /gang phyir mi dbang bka' las skye bo stong phrag dag /khang pa 96—73

dang ni grong khyer nyid du bag yod kyang / /de tshe de ni gnyid kyis ①phrogs shing ma sad de/ /de yi phyir yang lha yi cho ga de zung shig /gang phyir nags na gnas la mthun pa'i gos dag ni/ /lha na gnas pas dus su 'di la byin gyur la//rgyan dag mkha' la rab tu gtor ba de khyer te/ /de yi phyir yang lha yi cho ga de zung shig 'u /de phyir de ltar lha mo nged gnyis la skyon du/ /ji ltar song ba de la rtog par 'os ma yin/ /mgyogs 'gro 'di dang bdag gi 'dod pa mi mdzad par/ /de ni lha rnams dag gis rjes 'gro byas shing gshegs/ /de ltar bdag nyid chen po de yis kwa rab gshegs pa/ /lha yi mtshar mang bud med de rnams kyis thos nas/ /rab tu gshegs las yid la 'bar ba yang 'thob ste/ /mya ngan rab tu nyams bzhin ngo mtshar ldan par thal/ /de nas yid mi bde bas yongs lding mig can ma/ /phrug gu rab tu nyams pa'i 'ol ba sdug bsngal bzhin//rmongs gyur nyid kyang mchi ma dang ldan gdong gis smras/ /rlabs chen dang ldan 'jam zhing dkar zumin dge ba ste/ /so so so sor rtsa ba nas 'khrungs gyen du 'khyil / /de yi dbu skyes sa la 'thor ba de rnams ni/ /mi dbang dbu rgyan la ni yongs su dkri bar 'os/ /phyag ni rab 'phyang ri dwags rgyal po'i stobs mnga' zhing / /khyu mchog chen po'i spyan ldan gser 'bar 'od mnga' ba/ /'brug dang rnga yi sgra ldan sku stod rnam par yangs/ /de ltar gyur kyang dka' thub gnas su gnas par 'os/ /sor mo legs skyes 'jam zhing dra bas 'byel ba dang / /long bu mi mngon pad+ma'i rtsa ba ltar 'jam la/ /dbus na 'khor lo dang bcas zhabs ni de dag gis/ /drang srong rnams kyi nags mtha'i sa la 'gro 'am ci/ /khang bzangs logs na khri dang gdan la 'os pa ste/ /rin chen na 96—74

bza' phyi min tsan+dan gyis spras shing / /de yi lus ni mdangs dang ldan pa nags dag tu/ /grang dang dro dang chu 'od 1rnams su bskor zuram ci/ /rigs dang gzugs dang stobs dang sems pa dag dang ni/ /thos dang phun sum tshogs dang na tshod kyis khengs shing / /slong bar ma yin ster ba nyid du mngon 'ongs pa /de ni pha rol dag la slong rngumo rgyu 'am ci/ /gser khri dang zhing gzims mal dag la gzims nas ni/ /mtshan mo sil snyan sgra rnams dag gis rab slong ba/ /gos kyi phyogs gcig par na sa yi logs la ni/ /bdag gi brtul 4zhugs ldan de de ring ji ltar gzims/ /snying rje'i smre sngags rab tu zlos pa 'di thos nas/ /bud med de rnams phan tshun lag pas yongs 'khyud de/ /ljon shing g.yos las me tog las ni sbrang rtsi bzhin/ /rnam par lta byed dag nas chu dag 'thor ba'o /de nas ngang pa med pa'i ngang mo bzhin du ni/ /grags 'dzin ma ni nor 'dzin sa la 'gyel gyur la/ /rnam par 'khrugs shing yang dang yang du ldab ldib kyi/ /skad kyis de dang de dag rnam par smras pa'o/ /chos dang lhan cig spyod pa thu mgon med kho mo ni/ /de yis dor nas gal te chos ni byed 'dod cing / /chos dang lhan cig spyod ma dang bral dka' thub gang / /yongs su longs spyod 'dod 'di'i chos ni ga la zhig /sngon gyi sa skyong rnams des nges par ma mthong ste6 / /legs mthong chen po la sogs rnges po chen po rnams/ /bdag po ldan ma dang bcas nags su gshegs gyur la/ /kho mo dang bral chos byed 'dod pa de ltar ltos/ /mchod sbyin du 'am rig byed cho gas 'dus byas shing / /pho mo gnyis la dbang bskur de yi 'bras bu ni/ /gzhan du mnyam por longs spyod 'dod pa ma mthong ste/ /de nas bdag la 'di yi chos la ser sna skyes/ /96—75

bdag nyid la ni sdud tshodang phan tshun phrag dog cing / /yang yang rtsod par chos 'ga' des ni nges par shes/ /khro ba kho mo spangs nas dbang chen 'jig rten du//'jigs med lha mo las ni dga' ba len par 'dod/ /de la lus kyi yon tan bzung ba'i btsun mo de/ /ci 'dra zhig gam 'di ni bdag gis bsam mno ste/ /bdag gi gus pa nyid dang bud med bor nas ni/ /nags su gang phyir des ni thu dka' thub rnams la gdung / /nges par bdag gi 'dod 'di 1mtho ris bde phyir min/ /sems ldan skye bo 4de ni rnyed par dka' ba min/ /sdug pa des kyang bdag la 'di 'am gzhan du rung / /gang gis ma spangs 3zhes ni bdag gi yid la re/ /gal te bdag ni jo bo'i gzigs byed yangs pa'i zhal/ /gtsang zhing bzhad pa gyen du blta ba'i skal med na/ /skal ba dman par 'os min sgra gcan 'dzin de yang / /pha yi 6pang na yongs su gnas par nam zhig 'gyur/ /e ma yid mnga' 'di yi lus rgo shin tu gzhon/ /yid ni mi rnams kyis bsngags shin tu sra ba ste/ /ngag gi skad grag rab zos 7dgra yang dga' ba yi/ /bu ni byes pa 'di 'dra kye ma spong bar byed/ /bdag gi 'dod pa'i sems kyang shin tu sra ba ste/ /rdo las gyur ram yang na lcags las byas pa 'am/ /bder 'os jo bo dpal dor nags su song ba la/ /mgon med ldan pa gang zhig dum bur ma song ngo / /de lhar lha mo bdag po'i mya ngan gyis brgyal te/ sems shing rnam zlos lan cig ma yin 'di — dus la/ /rang bzhin brtan yang dam pa mo de mya ngan gyes/ /brtan pa dran pa ma yin ngo tsha ma byas so/ /de nas de ltar mya ngan gyis smra rnam 9'khrugs pa'i/ /grags 'dzin ma ni sa la 'gyel ba mthong nas ni/ /char kyis btang bas 1 snapad+ma chen po bzhin du ni/ /mchi bcas 96—76

gdong gis 1bud med rnams ni cho nges lngo7'debs/ /bzlas brjod rdzogs shing sbyin sreg 1bkra shis byas gyur te/ /mi skyong nyid kyang lta gang cedag nas phyir gshegs pa/ /rdo rje'i sgra yis glang po ji bzhin skye ba yi/ /nyam thag sgra des kun nas bcom zhing g.yos par gyur/ /'dun pa dang ni bsngags ldan gnyis po mthong nas kyang / /sras kyi nges par brten pa yang dag gsan nas ni/ /bde sogs bdag bo'i ltad mo zin pa'i rgyal mtshan bzhin/ /mya ngan gyis bcom sa yi bdag po 'gyel bar gyur/ /de nas sras po'i mya ngan gyis rmongs yud tsam zhig /skye bo mtshungs mnyam mngon pa'i skye bos bzung gyur la/ /chab kyis ridegang ba'i spyan gyis mgyogs bgro la gzigs nas/ /sa yi logs nas sa skyong gis ni sme sngags bton/ /g.yul 'gyed pa na dga' chen mang po byas nas ni/ /bsngags ldan khyod kyis 6bdag gi dga' ba ma yin byas/ /bdag gi dga' ba yon tan dga' de gang gis ni/ /dga' ba yin yang dga' ba med bzhin nags su bor/ /de phyir de nyid gang du gshegs pa der bdag khyer / /yang na de ni slar yang skyen par khyer la shog /tshabs cher na ba'i sman dang bral bas de bzhin du/ /de dang bral bas bdag gi 'tsho ba med pa'o/ /rgyal bu gser 'bab 'chi bas phrogs par gyur pa na/ /dka' thub gang las yang dag rgyal ba shi ma gyur/ /bdag kyang chos 'dzin sras po gshegs par gyur pa na/ /bdag nyid thar 'dod bdag nyid med pa lta bur gyur/ /rgyal rigs bcu byas khyab bdag skye dgu'i bdag bo ni/ /mchog dang mchog min shes pa nyi ma'i sras po yi/ / bu ni phangs 7shing sdug bsngal dam pa dang bral la/ /yid mi bde byas yid kyi rmongs pa gang las min/ /rgyal po a dza' sras po blo dang 96—77

ldan pa ni/ /mi bdag dbang po'i grogs la bdag gi 'dod pa ste/ /sras po nags su song la gang zhig lhar lkusong la/ /mchi ma don yod ma yin bkren pas 'chos so kye/ /khyod kyis bdag gi chu yi snyim pa de gang du/ /phrogs pa'i dka' thub gnas der bzang po bdag la sgos/ /de la bdag gi skom pa 'dis ni yongs 'dod de/ /bdag gi srog ni yi dwags 'gro bar 'dod/ /de ltar sras dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal skyes gyur te/ /sa dang 'dra ba'i lhan skyes brtan pa rnam spangs nas/ /rā ma'i mya ngan dag gis shing rta bcu pa bzhin/ /mi skyong 'du shes bral bzhin mang po rnam par labs/ /de nas de la thos dang dul dang yon tan ldan/ /rab bgres mdun na 'don dang blon po blo gros kyis//mnyam par gzhag 'di ji lta ba bzhin smas gyur te/ /yongs su gdung ba'i gdong min mya ngan med pa'ang min/ /mi mchog brtan pa mya ngan thong 4la brtan par gshegs/ /mya ngan bzhin du mchi ma 'don par 'os ma yin/ /me tog phreng ba rnying bzhin phun tshogs bor nas ni/ /sa na mi skyong mang po nags su shin tu song / /gzhan yang de yi dgongs pa nges pa 'di sngon tshe/ /drang srong dkar ming 5de yi tshig ni dran par mdzod/ /mtho ris su yang 6'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid la/ /skad cig kyang de gnas par bde bas nus ma yin//gal te yang de mi mchog 'bad pas byas pa ste/ /myur bar bka' lung stsol mdzod ji snyed 'dir 'gro bgye/ /sna tshogs rnams kyi khyed kyi 7sras po de yi ni/ /sna tshogs mang bo'i 'thab mo de rnyed 8 der byed shog /de nas de gnyis la ni mi bdag gis bslabs la/ /de phyir nges par 'di nas khyed gnyis mngon par song / /bu la lhag par chags pa'i nags kyi bya yi bzhin/ /bdag gi sems 96—78

ni dga' bar rab tu song ma yin/ /dam pa zhes ni mi dbang bstan 1las blon po dang / /mdun na 'don pa de gnyis nags der song bar gyur/ /byas zhes gna' 3ma'i skye bo dang bcas btsun mor bcas/ /mi skyong gis kyang bya ba lhag ma rab tu mdzad/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las / btsun mo'i 'khor smre sngags bton pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas de'i tshe mdun na 'don dang blon po de/ /mi spyong mchi ma'i lcag gis mngon par bsnun pa dag /phug pa'i dam pa'i rta bzhin 'bad pa thams cad las/ /bsam pa bzang pos skyen par nags der song bar gyur/ /'dra ba'i rjes 'brangs 4ngal ba skyes pa de gnyis ni/ /dka' thub nags der dus su nye bar phyin nas ni/ /rgyal po'i rdzu 'phrul dor de dul ba'i spyod pa yis/ /drang srong shes ldan bu yi khang par nye bar song / /de dag gis ni tshul bzhin bram ze de mchod nas/ /de ni de dag la yang rjes mthun mchod pa ste/ /gdan byas pa dag bdag tu lta ba bcad 5nas ni/ /shes ldan sras po gdan gnas pa la gtam smras so/ /mdangs gtsang gtsang zhing rnam par grags pa'i yangs 6pa mnga'/ /bu ram shing pa'i rigs su rab 'khrungs rgyal po yis/ /khru ka rab tu 'dzin dang gsang sngags yongs 'dzin la/ /nag bor skye bo 'di ni khyod kyis rig 4par mdzod/ /dbang po dang mtshungs de yi rgyal ba dang mtshungs sras/ /rga dang 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dag ni sgol 'dod de/ /'di na mngon par nye bar 'ongs grag de yi phyir/ /bdag cag nye bar 'ongs par bcom ldan mkhyen par mdzod/ /de dag la des smras pa phyag ring gyur pa de/ /96—79

—— — rab tu thob gyur gzhon nu shes pa min pa min/ /chos 'di 'khor bar byed ces mngon par mkhyen nas ni/ /mngon par gdong phyogs ma yin thar bzhed skyen par gshegs/ /de nas de las de nyid de dag nyer thob nas/ /bram ze de la snyan dngags phab nas de ma thag /dub kyang ma dub pa bzhin rgyal po la gus pas / /de nyid gang nas gshegs pa de nas rab tu song lku/ /song ste de nas de dag gi ni rngon pa dang / /rnam par bral ba'i sku lus rab tu 'bar ba de/ /nyi ma stug bye po'i longs spyod dag la zhugs pa ltar/ /lam ni shing gi rtsa bar nye bar bzhugs shepa mthong / /de nas de la mdun na 'don dang sngags 'dzin bcas / /theg pa rnam par spangs nas nye bar gshegs pa ste/ /be+er gnas thub pa'i bu ni g.yon gyi lhar bcas pas/ /nags gnas lhag spyod lta bar 'dod pa ji ltar ro/ /lha na 5pa ba sangs dang phur bus dbang chen bzhin/ /de dag gis thuni de nyid bskyed cing mchod pa'o/ /lha na 7pa sangs phur bu dag la dbang chen bzhin/ /mchod 'os des ni de gnyis dag la slar mchod do/ /sbyor bar song ba'i zla ba 8nye sar nab 9 so bzhin/ /de nas kun nas mngon par rjes gnang byas pa ni/ /de dag shākya'i rigs kyi rgyal mtshan de yi ni/ /nye logs dag tu song ba rnam par mdzes par gyur/ /shing gi rtsa bar gnas pa mngon par 'bar ba yi/ /rgyal po'i sras po de la mdun na 'don gyis smras/ /lha na lku yongs 'dus dag la brgya byin sras po ni/ /rgyal ba nye bar gnas la phur bu 2ji ltar ro/ /khyod kyi mya ngan zug rngu snying la btags pa na/ /sa yi logs la rmongs shing brgyal bar gyur pa ste/ /gzhon nu mig gi chu yi char ltar rgyal po yis/ /gang zhig khyod la smras pa 'di ni mkhyen par mdzod/ /khyod 96—80

kyis chos la rab dmigs nges par shes pa ste/ /khyod kyi 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i don ni shes pa'o/ /khyod kyi dus ma yin par nags su bsnyen las bdag /me dang rab mtshungs mya ngan me yis tshig pa'o/ /de phyir tshur spyon chos dga' dag gi rmyedaga' ston du/ /chos kyi don du blo gros de nyid thong mdzod dang / /chu bo'i shugs kyis 'gram ngogs mngon par bcom pa bzhin/ /bdag la mya ngan shugs 'dir snyerab tu 'phel ba'o/ /rlung dang nyi ma me dang thog chen rnams kyi ni / /'jug pa gang zhig sprin dang chu me ri rnams su/ /rnam par 'byer dang skems dang srog ngadang 'byed rnams kyis/ /bdag cag rnams la mya ngan gyis 'jug pa de byed/ /de phyir re zhig nor 'dzin bdag nyid longs spyod la/ /dus su bstan bcos mthong ste nags su gshegs gyur te/ /'byung po thams cad la ni brtse ba chos yin phyir/ /mi 'dod gnyen 'dun kho bo la ni ltos par mdzod / /chos de nags nyid kho nar 'grub pa ma yin te/ /sdom brtson rnams kyis 5nges par grong khyer na yang 'grub/ /'dir ni blo dang 'bad pa dag ni mtshan ma ste/ /nags dang stag 6ni 'jigs pa dag gi mtshan ma'o/ /dbu rgyan 'dzin zhing dpung par rna cha do shal dang / /dpung rgyan rnam par rengs 4pa'i phyag mnga' mi dbab rnams/ /phun tshogs yan lag dbus na yongs su gnas rnams kyis/ /khyim na gnas kyang thar pa'i lam ni rab tu thob//bstan byepa'i nu bo stobs dang rdo rje'i lag pa dang / /rnam mdzes bu dang chu stod de nas mthar gnas lha/ /lus 'phags rgyal po skyes byed dang ni de bzhin du/ /grong dang ljon shing can dang sde rgyal rgyal po rnams/ /nyes 9legs chos kyi cho ga la ni rnam dul ba'i/ /mi bdag khyim na gnas pa de rnams mkhyen mdzod la/ /96—81

nor gyi bdag po dang ni mi skyong dpal dag ste/ /gnyis po dag kyang de phyir dus gcig mkhyen par mdzod/ /mngon par dbang bskur byas pa'i chu yis brlan pa nyid/ /gdung ba skyob pa'i gdugs bzung khyed la drag tu ni/ /nye bar 'khyud nas kun nas gyen du lta 4ba ste/ /dga' ba des ni nags su rab tu 'jug par 'dod/ /de ltar mchi mas 'dud pa'i yi ge'i tshig gis ni/ /khyed nyid la ni sa yi bdag pos smras pa ste/ /thos nas de la brtse zhing de la dga' don du/ /khyed kyi brtse bas rjes su 'gro bar 'os pa'o/ /khrod las byung ba'i mya ngan chu ni gting med pa'i/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor shākya'i rgyal po nub gyur te/ /de phyir mgon po rgya mtshor bying la gru bzhin du/ /dman zhing rten dang bral ba de ni sgol mdzod cig /chu bo gang gā'i lto nas byung ba 'jigs byed dang / /lhag spyod dang ni ngan spong 2sras po lhag spyod kyis/ /pha yi dga' ba'i don du las byas thos nas ni/ /khyed kyang yab kyi bzhed pa mdzad par 'os pa lags/ /gnyen bshes be'u nyams par gyur pa'i —ba bzhin du/ /rgyun mi 'chad 4par nyam thag snying rjer ngu ba mo/ /drang srong ri byi bsnyen zhing phyogs su ma song ba/ /yang dag skyed par byed pa'i lha mo mkhyen par mdzod/ /ngang pa rnam par bral ba'i ngang mo lta bu dang sha /nags na glang po dang bral glang mo lta bu ni/ /mgon dang bcas kyang mgon med dman zhing nyam thag pa'o/ /btsun mo gzigs pa yis ni skyob par 'os pa yin/ /sras gcig byis pa sdug bsngal 'os pa ma yin pa/ /kun nas gdung ba mthar gyur pa ni 'dren pa ste/ /gang ba'i zla ba sgra gcan nye bar bsgyur las bzhin/ /sgra gcan 'dzin de gnyen gyi 5mya ngan las thar mdzod/ /pho brang btsun mo'i 'khor dang grong khyer mtha' 96—82

dag ni/ /khyed dang bral ba'i bud shing can gyi mya ngan me/ /phyir 'byung dbugs ni du ba mun pa'i rtse mo yis/ /tshig pa dag ni spyod la lta ba'i chu 'dod do / /mdun na 'don pa de yi tshig dag gsan gyur nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' yongs su gang ba'i sems dpa' des/ /yon tan ldan zhing yon tan shes pas yud tsam zhig /bsam gtan mdzad nas rigs pa'i lan 'di smras pa'o / /pha rnams kyi ni bu la dgongs pa shes pa ste/ /gang zhig bdag la sa skyong gi ni khyad par du/ /shes pa yin yang na dang rga dang rgud pa las/ /'jigs te nags su phyin nas rang gi skye bo dor/ /mthar ni gal te dga' ba dang bral ma yin na/ /rang gi skye bo dga' ba lta 'dod cis ma yin/ /gang tshe yun ring gyur kyang rnam par 'bral ba ste/ /de phyir bla ma brtse ba yin yang 'dor bar bgyi/ /gang yang bdag gi ched du mi yi bdag po yishe/ /mya ngan khyod kyis smras des bdag la dga' ba med/ /gang phyir rmi lam yang dag 'dus par gyur rnams su/ /rnam par 'bral 2bar 'gyur la kun nas gdung bar byed//'gro ba'i spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs mthong nas ni/ /de bzhin du yang khyod kyi 5blo gros nges par song / /bu min gnyen min kun nas gdung ba'i rgyu yin bzhin//'ching ba de ni shes pa med pa'i mtshan ma nyid/ /lam du 'gro rnams 'dir ni 'dus pa ji lta ba'i/ /skye dgu rnams ni dus su nges par 'bral ba ste/ /gnyen 'dun dam 'cha' skye bos rnam par dman pa yi/ /shes rab ldan pa'i skye bos mya ngan bsnyen nam ci/ /gzhan du rang gi skye bo dor nas 'dir 'ongs la/ /'dir yang rab tu bslus nas slar yang 'gro ba ste/ /der song nas kyang pha rol gzhan du 'gro 'gyur la/ /de ltar 'dor ldan skyo la rjes su brten nam ④ci/ /96—83

gang tshe mngal nas bzung hūṃsnaste gnas skabs thams cad du/ /gsod pa'i phyir ni 'chi ba rab tu gnas pa ste/ /bu la dga' ba der ni khyed kyis smras pa yi/ /bdag gi nags su brten pa gang phyir dus ma yin/ /yul la mngon par lhung tshe dus ma yin pa de/ /de bzhin nor gyi cho gar zhugs pa dus yin no/ /dus rnams kun du dus kyi 'gro ba khyab pa ste/ /dge legs nges par thob pa 5dus yod ma yin no/ /gang yang rgyal pos bdag la rgyal srid 'dir bzhad la / /de yang yab kyi rgya chen mtshungs shing 'dra ba ste/ /sred pa las ni nad pa'i mi 'phrod zas bzhin du/ /bdag gis 4rab tu 'dzin par nus pa ma yin no/ /gti mug rmongs pa'i gzhi ma mi skyong rgyal po nyid/ /rab tu 'thob par mi ni mkhas pas gang phyir nus/ /gang du skyo ba dang bcas rgyags dang ngal dub dang //pha rol log par spyod pas chos la gnod pa'o/ /'dzam bu chu gser bzhin du gsal ba'i lding khang ni/ /dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang po lta bu dang / /gza' yis 'khrugs pa'i pad+ma dang bcas chu lta bu/ /rgyal srid dang ni gser dag snyug bsngal dag gi rten/ /de ltar rgyal srid chos min bde ba ma yin pa/ /ji ltar mi gtsang skyes te mi dbang snga ma rnams/ /snyug bsngal yongs su spang bya na tshod rab mchog tshe/ /rgyal srid nges par dor nas nags su song bar gyur/ /rin chen bzhin du tshim pa mchog ni nyer mkhyud snyenas/ /'brog dgon dag na rtswa dag 6zos pa mchog yin la/ /sbrul nag bzhin du mthong ba ma yin nyes pa ni/ /rnyed bla'i dpal dang lhan cig nyal ba mchog ma yin/ /rgyal srid rnam par spangs pa rgyal po rnams kyi chos/ /mngon par 'dod pas nags su rab 'jug bsngags pa ste/ /nags tshal yongs su dor nas khyim du rab 'jug 96—84

pa—/ /dam bca' nye bar bcom pa'i 'thad pa ma yin no/ /rigs su skyes shing sems pa dang bcas mi gang gis/ /chos ni mngon par 'dod pas nags su rab zhugs la/ /ngur smrig rab tu dor nas ngo tsha rnam spangs nasahūṃ/ /grong khyer 'joms pa yi yang grong la bsnyen ma yin/ /sred dang rnam par rmongs dang yang na 'jigs pa yis/ /gang zhig sgyugs byepa'i bza' ba slar yang len byed la / /sred pa zude ni rmongs dang yang na 'jigs pa yis/ /'dod pa rnams ni dor nas slar yang len par byed/ /gang zhig rab 'bar khang pa dag nas ci zhig ltar/ /byung nas slar yang de nyid kho nar rab 'jug la/ /nyes pa mthong de khyim na gnas pa dor nas ni/ /rmongs pas slar yang len par mngon par 'dod pa'o/ /gang yang mi skyong khyem na gnas pas thar pa ni/ /'thob pa dang ldan zhes thos de ni med pa ste/ /zhi ba gtso bo'i thar pa'i chos ni gang la yang / /chad pa gtso bo'i rgyal po'i chos ni gang du'o/ /zhi ba 4dga' ba gal te rgyal srid dman pa ste/ /rgyal srid la blo gal te zhi ba rnam par nyams/ /grang dang dro dang me dang chu yi gcig nyid bzhin/ /zhi ba dang ni rno nyid 'thad pa ma yin no/ /me dang chu yi 'du ba yod pa ma yin la/ /khram dang drang po'i 'du ba yod pa ma yin zhing / /'phags dang sdig pa'i 'du ba yod pa ma yin te//zhi dang chad pa'i 'du ba yod pa ma yin no/ /de phyir sa 'dzin bdag po de rnams nges pas sam/ /rgyal po'i srid rnams spangs te zhi ba thob pa can/ /rgyal srid dag la bsnyen nam pyedabang po sbas nyid las/ /mthar ma thug par thar par mngon pa'i nga rgyal byas/ /de dag rnams kyi rgyal srid la zhi ji lta bzhin/ /bdag ni nags tshal rab thob nges pas ma yin zhing / /khyem dang gnyen gye 'du 96—85

shes zhags pa bcad nas ni/ /thar gyur sbar yang rab tu 'jug par 'dod ma yin / /de ltar bdag nyid rnam shes yon tan rjes mthun pa/ /re 'dod spangs shing gtan tshigs ldan pa sgogs pa ste/ /mi dbang bdag nyid skyes kyi smra ldan thos gyur nas/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa yis kyang lan ni smras pa'o 1/ /gang zhig chos kyi cho gar nges pa khyod kyi 'di/ /rig pa min pa ma yin 'di ni dus rig min rngu/ /na tshod la gnas yab ma mya ngan phyir byin nas/ /chos 'dod khyod kyi chos ma yin par gyur pa'o/ /nges par khyed kyi blo yang shin tu phra min pa/ /yang na chos dang don dang 'dod par mkhas ma min / /gang zhig ma mthong 'bras bu'i don du spyod nyid kyis/ /mngon sum don ni yongs su brnyas zipar mdzad nas gshegs/ /yang srid yod ces kha cig dag ni smra ba ste//med ces kha cig dag 5ni nges par dam 'cha'o/ /de ltar gang tshe don 'di the tshom gyur pa ste/ /de phyir longs spyod par nus dpal ni nye bar gnas/ /gal te slar yang rab tu 'jug pa gang yang yod/ /der ni ji ltar 'bad pa dag la dga' bar bkyi/ /ci ste gzhan du rab tu 'jug pa gang yang med/ /'gro ba 'di yi 'bad rtsol med las thar pa 'grub/ /kha cig 'jig rten pha rol yod ces smra ba ste/ /thar pa'i sbyor ba la ni bsngags pa byed ma yin/ /ji ltar me yi dro dang chu yi gsher ba nyid/ /de ltar rab tu 'jug par rang bzhin nyid du smra/ /dge dang mi dge nyid dang srid dang srid min la/ /kha cig rang bzhin las zhes bsngags pa byed pa ste/ /gang phyir 'di dag thams cad rang bzhin las yin te/ /de yi phyir yang rab tu 'bad pa don med 'gyur/ /gang zhig dbang po rnams kyis nges par rab spyod pa/ /yul rnams la ni dga' 96—86

ba dang ni mi dga' nyid/ /gang zhig dga' dang nad rnams dag gis spyor byed de—/ /de la gang gis 'bad dam de ni rang bzhin no/ /chu rnams kyis ni me rnams zhi bar nye 'gro zhing / /'od zer rnams kyis 1chu ni skams rte7par byed pa ste—/ /lus la yang dag gnas pa'i 'byung ba tha dad rnams/ /gcig nyid gyur nas 'gro ba dag ni 'dren par byed/ /gang zhig lag pa rkang pa lto rgyab mgo rnams kyis bye/ /mngal du song ba'i ngo bo nges par sgrub byed la/ /gang tshe 7bdag nyid de yi de yis sbyor ba ste/ /rang bzhin las byung de shes rnams kyis de smra'o/ /bya dang ri dwags rnams kyi sna tshogs ngo bo dang / /tsher ma'i rnon po nyid du rab tu byed pa su/ /rab tu 'jug pa 'di kun rang bzhin las yin la/ /'dod pa byed pa yod min 'bad pa gang las so/ /de bzhin gzhan rnams dbang phyug las skyes smra ba ste/ /der ni skyes bu'i rab tu 'jug pa la don ci/ /'gro ba'i rab tu 'jug la gang nyid rgyu yin zhing / /sdog pa la ni nges par de nyid rgyu yin no/ /kha cig bdag gi mtshan ma nyid du smra ba ste/ /rab tu skye ba nyid dang srid pa zad pa yang / /'bad pa med las rab tu skye bar smra ba ste/ /'bad pa yis ni thar pa 'thob par smra ba'o/ /lha yi mchod sbyin drang srong rnams kyi rig byed dang / /pha yi bu lon med pa bu rnams kyis te mi/ /gang gi zhegrol ba yod pa de yi thar pa zhes/ /bu lon gsum po de dang lhan cig skyes pa'o/ /de ltar cho ga'i bya ba'i rim pa 'di yis ni/ /'bad rtsol bcas pa'i thar pa de shes rnam smra la/ /'bad rtsol ldan pa yin yang rnam par gnon pa yis/ /thar pa 'dod pa rnams ni ngal ba thob par byed/ /de phyir zhi ba gal te thar la gus yod na/ /cho gar brjod pa ji ltar rigs pas bsnyen mdzod dang / /96—87

'di yi nye bar 'thad pa de ltar gyur pa ste/ /mi yi bdag po'i kun nas gdung ba nyams par 'gyur/ /dka' thub nags tshal dag nas khang par 'jug pa la/ /khyod kyi skyon gyi blo gros gang zhig rab zhugs te/ /yab gcig der yang /chid kyi bsam par ma gyur dang / /snga ma rnams kyang nags nas rang gi khang par gshegs / /dka' thub nags na gnas pa bu rnams kyis bskor te/ /rgyal po a ma snari ṣa grong du zhugs gyur la/ /de bzhin 'phags min rnams kyis sa ni rnam bcom pa/ /dka' thub nags nas 'ongs nas rangs byed kyis gsungs 2snaso / /de bzhin rdo snab dang bcas bdag po'i ljon shing ming / /nags gnas bu dang bcas pa grong du bzhugs pa ste/ /tshangs pa'i drang srong gyur dang thub pa gnas 'jog las/ /sbyin sreg dang bcas mtha' can lha yis dpal bzung 4ngo / /rnam pa de ltar chos dang grags par rab bzhugs pa/ /nags rnams bor nas khang khyim rnams su song ba ste/ /de phyir dka' thub nags nas chos kyi ched du nyid/ /khyem na rab tu 'gro ba skyon yod ma yin no/ /de nas mi skyong rgyal po'i dga' dang phan pa nyid/ /byas pa'i blon po de yi tshig dag gsan nas ni/ /dman min ma 'khrugs sachags min brtan dang gnas pa la/ /myur min tshig ni rgyal po sras kyis 5smras pa'o/ /'dir ni yod dang med ces the tshom gang de ni/ /gzhan gyi tshig gis bdag la 'di na nges pa med/ /dka' thub dang ni zhi bas de nyid rtogs gyur nas/ /gang 'dir nges par bdag nyid kyis ni gzung 7bar bgyi/ /phan tshun gnod cing mi gsal the tshom skye ba yi/ /lta ba dag ni len par bdag gis nus ma yin/ /mun par long bas long ba'i lam mkhan byed pa bzhin/ /mkhas pa'i skye bo su zhig gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 5'gro//96—88

de nyid ma mthong gyur kyang 'on kyang kho bo yi/ /dge dang mi dger the tshom na dge blo gros gyur/ /'bras bu med phyir la yang dge ba'i bdag nyid mchog /smod pa'i bdag nyid de nyid la yang bde ba med/ /rnam gzhag med pa'i lung 'di yang ni rmyemathong gyur nas/ /tshad ldan rnams kyis khyegang smras de ni legs rtogs mdzod/ /nyes la rab dman tshad ldan nyid ni rtogs mdzod dang / /nyes pa rab tu dman pas bden min smra ba yin/ /khyim la 'jug par dmigs gang bdag la khyod kyis ni/ /smras shing rangs zubyed la sogs rnams ni dpe 9bstan te/ /de rnams zhitshad min chos nges rnams su nus med cing / /tshad ma'i ched du brtul zhugs rnams ni yongs su zad/ /de lta na yang nyi ma sa la lhung gyur la/ /gangs dang ldan pa'i ri bos brtan nyid 'dor na yang / /de nyid ma mthong yul la kha bltas dbang po ni/ /khyim rnams dag la so so skye bo mi bsnyen to/ /bdag ni 'bar bar gyur pa'i me la 'jug pa ste/ /don ma byas par khyem kyi gzhi la rab mi 'jug /de ltar thugs rgyal ldan des dam bca' mdzad gyur cing / /ji ltar 'dod bzhin bzhengs nas ngar 'dzin med par gshegs / /de nas mchi ma dang bcas blon dang gnyis skyes gnyis/ /de yi bstan 5pa nyid dang nges pa thos gyur nas/ / gti mug bzhin gye ldan rjes su song nas sdug bsngal ba/ /dal bus song nas grong khyer nyid du song bar gyur/ /de nas de la brtse dang mi skyong la gus las/ /de dag ltos byas /ldurab tu song zhing gnas gyur la/ /gsal zhing snang bas nyi ma blta bar dka' ba ltar/ /de ni lam du lta byebar ma nus 'dor / snabar min/ /mchog tu gshegs te gshegs pa shes phyir de dag gis/ /so pa'i skyes bu gtsang ma sbas pa rnams byas 96—89

nas / /dga' zhing sras po 'dod pa'i rgyal po la song nas/ /ji ltar blta'am zhes ni ji ltar yang song ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ gzhon nu rjes su tshol ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //sku stod rgyas shing rgya chen rgyal bo'i sras po ste/ /bsreg bya dang bsngags ①bdag po de dag rnams spangs te/ /dba' rlabs g.yo ba'i chu bo gang gā rgal nas ni/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs par gyur/ /ri rnams dag gis legs par sbas dang brgyan pa dang / /dge dang dka' thub gter bas gzung dang gtsang ba ste/ /zhi ba byerang byung tshangs pa mtho ris logs su bzhin/ / ri lngas mtshan pa'i 2grong khyer rab tu thob par gyur/ /zab mor gyur pa'i mdangs dar de yi lugs gsal ba/ /skyes bu rnams ni shin tu gnon pa mthong gyur nas/ /khyu mchog rgyal mtshan de yi brtul zhugs brtan pa bzhin/ /der ni de tshe skye bo rnams ni ya mtshan gyur/ /de rab mthong nas gzhan gang ma song de gnas shing / /der ni gang zhig lam na gnas de rjes 'gro zhing / /gang zhig skyen por song ste pyabartan por song gyur la/ /kha cig bsdad pa gang yin de ni langs pa'o/ /skye bo kha cig de la mchod pa'i lag pa yis—/ /bste stang byas nas kha cig mgo bos phyag 'tshal zhing / /kha cig gnyen po'i ⑤tshig gis mngon par stod byed cing / /kha cig de la rab tu mchod nas song bar gyur/ /de rab mthong nas sna tshogs cha lugs rnams ngo tsha/ /rab bkram tshig ni lam du smra ba med par song / /dngos su gzhan du chos rnams dag gi nye logs su/ /kha cig tshul ma yin pa'i blo gros ma gyur to/ /lha 96—90

dang mtshungs pa'i mi dbang sras po de mthong nas/ /bya ba gzhan ma rnams kyang rgyal po'i lam du ni/ /mchod mang bkur ste sngon 'gro bud med rnams kyi 'am/ /skyes pa rnams kyis 1mig dang ngoms ②par ma gyur to/ /dpral ba'am smin ma dag dang zhal lam srun dag dang / /sku 'am phyag dag dang ni 'gros sam zhabs dag ni/ /gang gis de yi gang nyid der ni mthong gyur pa/ /de nyid kyis ni de yi mig dag bcings par gyur/ /smin ma mdzod spu dang bcas spyan dag yangs pa dang / /sku lus mdzes shing dge ba'i dra ba dang ldan phyag /sa skyong nyid du 'os ldupa'i dge slong cha lugs de/ /mthong nas rgyal po'i khab kyi phun tshogs g.yos par gyur/ /de nas khang pa'i phyi nas rnam rgyas ceskye bo'i tshogs/ /ma ga dh+wa yi khyim gyi ngo rngubo bzo sbyangs kyis/ /mthong bar gyur te de yi rgyu mtshan dris pa ste/ /de nas 'di la skyes bu rnams kyis de smras so/ /ye shes mchog gam yang na pya sa yi dpal dag ni/ /'thob par 'gyur zhes bram ze rnams kyis gang smras pa/ /rab tu gshegs par skye bos nges par mthong ba yi/ /shākya'i bdag po'i sras po de ni 'di yin no/ /de nas don thos yid kyis 3chags shing zhen gyur pa'i/ /rgyal po yis rdoni skyes bu de nyid la smras pa/ /de ni gang du song zhes rnam par shes par mdzod/ /de nas de ltar bkyi zhes skyes bu rjes su song / /g.yo mi spyan ni gnya' shing gang tsam gzigs pa ste/ /gsung ni kun nas snyoms shing zab mo'i 'gros mnga' ba/ /g.yo ba'i sems dang lus rnams dag ni nges bsdams nasaspu / /dge slong mchog nyid de yang bsod snyoms 6la gshegs so/ /ji ltar nye bar 'thad pa'i bsod snyoms bsnams nas ni/ /rnam par dbe+en zhing char rab 'bab par rab gshegs la/ /der ni tshul bzhin rigs pas 96—91

mngon par gsol gyur nas/ /de ni sa 'dzin ri bo skya bseng la 'dzegs so/ /ro dha'i nags kyis nye bar sbas pa'i ri bo der/ /rma bya'i skad kyis rab gang lo ma'i spyil bo na/ /'char ri'i steng na nyi ma gzhon nu ji lta hubar/ /ngur smrig gos kyis byenyi ma'i nyi ma de mdzes so/ /der ni de nyid rgyal po'i 'khor de mthong gyur nas/ /bzo sbyangs rgyal po la ni gtam dag byas pa ste/ /thos nas rgyal po des kyang mchod pa mang po las/ /der ni sbas pa'i rjes su 'brang bas rab tu song / /skya bseng ri bo mchog la skya bseng na dang ni/ /bsgon 'grus mnyam zhing ri bo dang mnyam sku lus can/ /mi yi seng ge'i 'gros can cod pan 'dzin pa ste/ /ral pa g.yo ba'i seng ge bzhin du 'dzegs par gyur/ /de nas de yi steng na rtse mor gyur pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbang po nye 5 bar zhi ba ni/ /ri bong gis mtshan sprin gyi sbubs nas byung ba bzhin/ /skyil mo krung gis bzhugs nas rnam par mdzes pa mthong / /gzugs dang phun sum tshogs dang nye bar zhi ba yi④/ /chos kyi sprul pa bzhin du nye bar bzhugs de la/ /ya mtshan dang bcas rab tu bsnyen ldan mi dbang po/ /rang byung la ni brgya byin gyes bzhin nye bar gnas/ /rigs pa 5yis ni rigs pa rig pa rnams kyi mchog /khams mnyam gyur pa de 6la song nas dris pa ste/ /de nyid kyis kyang mtshungs shing zhi bas mi skyong la/ /yid ni rang bzhin gnas dang nad med smras par gyur/ /de nas gtsang la glang po'i rna ba ltar sngo ba'i/ /rdo ba'i logs la rgyal po yang dag nges gnas shing / /nye sar nye bar bsdad nas rjes su mthun pa yis/ /de yi dgongs pa rnam par shes 'dod 'di smras so/ /rim pas 'ongs pa nyid dang yongs su brtags pa ste/ /khyod kyi rigs kyis bdag gi 96—92

dga' ba mchog yin la/ /gang phyir bdag la rang gi lku na tshod smra 'dod pa/ /skyes te de phyir brtse ba'i tshig 'di mkhyen par mdzod/ /khyod kyi rigs ni rnam rgyas sngon du nyi ma ste/ /lus kyang na tshod gsar pa gsal la mdzes pa 'di/ /gang phyir 'di ni khyod kyi pyablo gros rim med pas/ /slong mo nyid la mngon dga' rgyal srid la ma yin/ /khyod kyi lus 'di tsan+dan dmar po 'os pa ste/ /ngur sprig gis dkris de ni 'os pa ma yin no/ /lag pa 'di ni skye dgu skyong bar 'os pa ste/ /gzhan gyes byin pa'i bza' ba za bar 'os ma yin/ /de phyir zhi ba gal te yab kyi rgyal srid la/ /khyod kyi yab kyi brtse las stobs kyis mi 'dod cing / /khyod kyi blo gros rim par bzod par ma gyur na/ /skyen par kho bo'i yul gyi phyed la longs spyod mdzod/ /de lta na ni rang gi skye la gnod min zhing / /dus kyi rim pa yis kyang dpal gang bsngags pa ste/ /de phyir khyod kyis bdag la brtse ba mdzod cig dang / /dam pa rnams dang bcas pas dam pa'i dpal 'phel lo/ /ci ste da ni rigs kyis 4khengs pa nyid las ni/ /bdag cag rnams la khyod la blo gtad yon tan med/ /sde rgyas rnams ni mda' yis rnam par dkrugs byas nas/ /bdag dang bcas pas pha rol rnams ni pham par mdzod—/ /de phyir 'dir ni gnyis dbus gcig blo tshol mdzod la/ /chos don 'dod pa rnams la cho ga bzhin bsnyen mdzod/ /'di na sde tshan gsum po chags las rnam bzlog nas/ /'di dang gzhan du phyin nas lhung ba kun nas 'thob / /gang zhig don dang chos la gnod nas 'dod pa dang / /chos dang 'dod pa yongs su brnyas nas don dang ni/ /'dod dang don dag nye bar zhi bas chos de ni/ /don byas gal te mtha' dag 'dod na don yin no/ /de 96—93
