phyir sde tshan hūṃgasum la nges par bsnyen pyapa yis/ /khyod kyis rngu gzugs 'di 'bras bu bcas pa nyid du mdzod/ /chos dang don dang 'dod pa dman min thob pa la/ /mi rnams dag gis rmyedaman min skyes bu'i byedon du smra/ /de phyir gzhu ni rnam par 'gengs 'os rgyas pa'i phyag /'di dag 'bras bu med par byed par 'os min te/ /nga las byunu bzhin 'dis rgo 'jig rten gsum rnams kyang / /pham par 'os pa yin na sa 'dir smos ci dgos/ /brtse bas nges par de ni bdag gis smra ba ste/ /ya mtshan gyis min dbang phyug nyid kyi chags pas min/ /khyod kyis 3dge slong nyid kyi cha lugs 'di mthong nas/ /rjes su brtse ba skyes nas mchi ma rang — 7byung ngo / /de phyir rang rigs rab mtshungs khyod kyi gzugs ji srid/ /rga bas zil gyis mnan nas slar yang ma 'ongs par/ /slong mo'i gnas 'dod 'dod pa rnams la longs spyod la/ /dus su chos la dga' ba chos ni gyis 6mdzod cig /'khogs nyu snapas nges par chos ni 'thob par nus pa ste/ /'dod pa nye bar spyod la rgas pa'i 'gro ba med/ /de phyir dar la bab pa'i 'dod pa rnams smra ste/ /bar ma'i nor yin rgan po rnams kyi chos yin no/ /gson pa'i 'jig rten dag na chos dang don dag ni/ /rnam par 'gal /4bar gyur pa yin phyir lang tsho rnams/ /yang dag srung nyubyeb yin yang thub par dka' ba ste/ /gang phyir 'dod pas lam de las ni 'phrog par byed / /na tshod 'khogs pa rnams ni rnam spyod 6ldan pa ste/ /shin tu brtan pa'i gnas skabs mchog tu song ba rnams/ /ngo tsha ba nyid phyir dang song ba ma yin phyir/ /'bad pa nyung ngus zhi ba'i bdag nyid gyur pa'o/ /de nyid phyir na g.yo zhing yul ni gtso bo dang / /rab stsos lhozibazod pa ma yin ring por 96—94

mthong min la/ /'brog dgon dag la des par thar nas dbugs phyung bzhin/ /g.yo sgyu mang po'i lang tsho shin tu 'das nas so/ /de phyir mi brtan g.yo la bag med ldan pa yi/ /na tshod gsar pa 'di ni re zhig rnam par 'ong / /'dod pa'i lha yi sngon du na tshod dbe+en 1yin la/ /dbang po rnams las bsrung bar nus pa ma yin no/ /ci ste khyod kyi chos nyid mdzad par 'dod pa ni/ /mchod sbyin gyis lha mchog mdzod 'di ni rigs kyi chos/ /mchod sbyin rnams kyis mtho ris logs ni byin brlabs byenas/ /lha dbang nyid kyang mtho ris logs su gshegs par 'gyur3/ /gser gyi dpung rgyan rnam par bcings pa'i phyag rnams dang / /nor bu'i sgon mas 'bar ba'i dpung rgyan sna tshogs can/ /mi skyong drang srong rnams dang drang srong chen po rnams/ /ngal bas gar gshegs 'gros der mchod sbyin rnams kyis gshegs/ /de ltar ma ga dh+wa yi bdag pos tshig smras pa/ /gang zhig dbang po'i bzhin du smra ba yang dag mdzes/ /sna tshogs du ma'i sa phyogs ti se'i gangs ri ltar/ /rgyal po'i sras des de thos gyur nas rnam ma g.yos/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las / bzo sbyangs sngon du song ba'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas bshes kyi sgo nas phan pa min chopa'i don/ /de ltar ma ga dh+wa yi bdag pos smas pa yis/ /rang gnas rnam par 'gyur min rigs gtsang gtsang pa pothu/ /zas gtsang rgyal po'i sras kyis ⑪tshig 'di smras pa'o/ /seng ges mtshan pa'i yangs pa'i rigs su rab skyes pa/ /khyed kyi cho ga de ni ngo mtshar che ma yin/ /gang phyir bshes gnyen phyogs su gshegs 'dod khyod kyi ni//96—95

yongs su dag pa'i spyod pas spyod pa de yin no/ /rang rigs rjes su spyod pas dam pa min la byams/ /dbang po ma tshang ba la dpal bzhin gnas min la/ /snga mas byas pa'i dga' ba rim rnams kyis/ /de ni dam pa rnams kyis rnam par 'phel bar byed/ /don ni dka' ba rnams su mi rnams gang zhig gis/ /mdza' bo rnams kyis 1mnyam pa'i don gyur 'jig rten na/ /bshes treganyen de rnams blo yis 3yongs su shes bgyi ste/ /rang gnas dag ni 'phel bar gang gi phyir ma yin/ /de ltar gang gis rdzas dag thob nas 'jig rten na/ /bshes rnams dang ni chos la nges par sbyor byed pa/ /de rnams kyis ni nor gyi snying po thob pa ste/ /mthar ni nyams las gdung ba skyed par byed ma yin/ /rgyal po mdza' bo nyid dang 'phags pa nyid kyis kyang / /khyod kyi nges pa gang zhig bdag la dmigs pa 'di/ /mdza' bo nyid kyis je'adir ni rjes su bsnyad bgyi ste/ /rgol ba gzhan min 'dir ni bdag gis smra bar bgyi/ /bdag gis rga dang 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa rnam rig nas/ /thar pa 'dod pas chos 'di rab tu thob pa ste//gnyen 'dun dga' ba mchi ma'i gdong ldan rnams spangs nas/ /mi dge'i rgyur gyur 'dod pa rnams ni sngon nyid do/ /bdag ni 5yul rnams dag la 6ji ltar 'jigs pa nyid/ /de ltar sbrul gyi dug rnams la ni mi 'jigs shing / /nam mkha' dag las 'phos pa'i thog rnams las min la/ /rlung dang bcas pa'i me rnams dag las ma yin no/ /mi rtag 'dod pa rnams kyis dge ba'i nor rku zhing / /stong pa rmi lam sgyu ma dang mtshungs 'jig rten na/ /yid la smos pa yis kyang rmongs par byed pa ste/ /mi yi sems ni bdag nyid gnas pa smos ci 'tshal/ /kye ma 'dod pas zil gyis non na mtho ris su/ /bde ba thob min 'chi ba'i 96—96

'jig rten na smos ci/ /rlung grogs ldan pa'i me yis byebud shing gis ji ltar/ /sred dang bcas pa'i 'dod pa rnams kyis tshim pa med/ /'gro na 'dod pa rnams dang mnyam pa'i don med med/ /rmongs 3las de rnams kho nar skye bo rab tu chags/ /de nyid shes nas de ltar don me+ed 'jigs pa ste/ /shes ldan su zhig rang gis don med mngon par 'dod/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can sa ni kun nas thob nas hūṃkyang / /rgya mtsho chen bo'i pha rol rgal bar 'dod pa ste/ /rgya mtsho'i chu bo rnams dang chu bran rnams kyis ltar/ /'jig rten pa yi 'dod pa rnams kyis ngoms pa med/ /lha yis gser gyi char pa dag kyang phab gyur la/ /gling rnams bzhi po mtha' dag la yang longs spyad de/ /brgya byin gyi yang thu gdan phyed dag kyang rab thob nas/ /nga las 5nu ni yul rnams dag la ngoms pa med/ /lha na lha rnams kyi yang rgyal srid longs spyad nas/ /mchod sbyin brgya pa lha min 'jigs las rab nyams tshe/ /rgyags las drang srong chen po rnams la'ang khur bcom nas/ /'dod pa rnams la ngoms med sgra med thong bar 'gyur6/ /e la'i rgyal pos mtho ris rnams ni rnam dkrugs te/ /brla mdzes lha mo de nyid dbang du blangs 7nas kyang / /sred phyir drang srong rnams las chogaser dag phrogs pa ste/ /yul rnams la ni ngoms med nyams par song bar gyur/ /lha min las ni dbang chen dbang chen las dgra med/ /dgra med las slar dbang chen gang du nyer song ste/ /mtho ris dang ni sa 'am yul ni de rnams su/ /bskal pa'i tshogs 'khrugs rnams la su zhig blo gtad byed/ /shing shun gos can rtsa ba 'bras bu chu za zhing / /lag 'gro'i sbrul ltar ring ba'i ral pa'i khur rnams kyang / /gang gis don gzhan ma yin thub pa yang nyams te//96—97

'dod pa zhes bya'i dgra bo rnams ni sa yis tshol/ /rno ba'i mtshon cha dang ni rdo 'dzin mtshon cha yang / /gang gi don du 'jigs sde rmyelas ni 'chi thob la /de dag rnams kyi dge min sems kyang spyod rnams kyis/rngu/ /'joms phyir de phyir brtul zhugs rnams kyis smos ci dgos/ /yul rnams su ni mya ngan nyung ngur shes gyur nas/ /kun nas sbyor zhing mchog tu ngoms pa med pa nyid/ /dam pa rnams kyis smod cing nges par sdig pa ste/ /'dod pa'i mig snyecan dug ni su yis len par byed/ /zhing gi 4las la sogs pa rnams kyis nyam thag cing //'dod pa rnams la mi tshar rnams kyi rang gnas dang / /'dod pa'i bdag nyid rnams kyi rang gnas thob nas ni/ /'dod pa rnams ni spong bar sems ldan rnams kyis nus/ /grub 'gyur 'dod pa rnams su rgyags pa nyer 'thob phyir/ /'dod pa can la 5'dod 'byor rgud pa shes bya ste/ /rgyags las bya ba min byed bya ba ma yin la/ /gang gis zad cing ngan 'gror nye bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gang la 'bad pas thob cing yongs su bskyangs pa rnams/ /rnam par bslus nas slar yang so sor 'gro ba ste/ /bdag nyid ldan pas g.yar po dang mtshungs de rnams su/ /'dod pa rnams la 'di na mkhas pa su zhig dga'/ /btsal nas dang ni blangs nas skom pa skyes pa yina'u/ /gang rnams mi 'dod sdug bsngal bar ni yongs 'gro la/ /'jig rten dag na rtswa sgon dang mtshungs de rnams su/ /'dod pa rnams la sems ldan su mi shaṃdaga' ba yin/ /dga' 3 ldan min pa'i snying la gang gis rnam rmugs te/ /rnam par nyams par 'gro 'gyur bde bar 'gro min zhing / /kun nas khros pa'i sbrul dang rab mtshungs de rnams su/ /'dod pa rnams la sems ldan su yi dga' ba yin/ /ltogs pas 96—98

nyam thag khyi bzhin rus pa zos nas kyang / /gang rnams la ni ngoms par 'gyur ba ma yin nyid/ /'khogs pa'i nus rmyepa'i keng rus dang mnyam de rnams su/ /'dod pa rnams la sems ldan su yi dga' ba yin/ /gang gi rgyal po rkun po chu dang me rnams las/ /thun mong gyur pa nyid phyir sbug bsngal sred zhebyed de/ /rab tu gtor ba'i sha dang mtshungs pa de rnams su/ /'dod pa rnams la sems ldan su yi dga' ba yin/ /dgra bo dang ni gnyen 'dun 'byel pa rnams las kyang / gang la gnas pa rnams ni skyen par rgud pa ste/ /skye mched dang mtshungs nye bar 'tshe ba de rnams su/ /'dod pa rnams la sems ldan su yi dga' ba yin/ /ri dang nags dang chu dang rgya mtsho rnams su yang / /gang la rnam par 'phyo ba rnams ni lhung 'gyur te/ /ljon shing rtse mo'i 'bras bu dang mtshungs de rnams su/ /'dod pa rnams la sems ldan su yi dga' ba yin/ /rnam pa sna tshogs 'bad pa drag bo 'thob pa rnams/ /gang gis skad cig gis 'dir nyams par 'gyur ba ste/ /rmi lam nye bar longs spyod dang mtshungs de rnams su/ /'dod pa rnams la sems ldan su yi dga' ba yin/ /gang rnams bsgrubs nas dang ni rnam par spel nas dang / /yongs su bskyangs nas dang 4ni bde bar 'gro min la/ /lci ba'i me ma mur dang rab mtshungs de rnams su/ /'dod pa rnams la sems ldan su yi dga' ba yin/ / gtum po long byed bcom brlag pa dang daṇa ḍa ka /snyegang gi don du sgra ngan rnams ni nyams gyur la—/ /ro bsregs shing dang rab tu mtshungs pa de rnams su/ /'dod pa rnams la bdag ldan su yi dga' ba yin/ /lha min mdzes sbyin dang ni nye ba'i mdzes sbyin bdag du sna /gang gi don du phan tshun dgrar song nyams gyur la/ /96—99

mdza' bshes gyur cing rnam par 'bral ba de rnams su/ /'dod pa rnams la sems ldan su yi dga' ba yin/ /gang dag rnams kyi don du chu dang me la dang / /sha za rnams la bdag nyid 'dir ni 'dor ba ste/ /dge ba ma yin dgra bor gyur pa de rnams su/ /'dod pa rnams la sems ldan su yi dga' ba yin / /bshes med 'dod pa'i don du bkren por byed pa ste/ /gsod dang 'ching ba la sogs sbug bsngal rab thob la/ /'dod pa'i don du sems ni bkren pa'i dka' thub can/ /gson pa'i 'jig rten 'ching ba dang ni ngal bar 'gro/ /ri dwags rnams ni gsod phyir glu yis 'phrog byed la/ /gzugs kyi don du phye ma leb rnams mer mchong zhing / /sha dag don gnyer nya yis lcags ni za ba ste/ /de phyir yul rnams don med nyid du 'bras bu smin/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod yin zhes gang gi blo yin la/ /kha cig longs spyod rnams ni yongs su spyod pa ste/ /gos sogs rdzas kyi yon tan yin phyir 'jig rten na/ /sbug bsngal zhi bar byed ces rab tu gzung bar bya/ /skom pa rab tu zhi phyir chu dag 'dod pa ste/ /bkres pa rnam par nyams phyir bza' ba de bzhin du/ /rlung dang gdung ba sgrib pa'i ched du khang pa ste/ /mdoms 1dang grang ba sgrib pa'i phyir ni bgo ba'o/ /de bzhin nyid ni rnam par 'joms phyir gnas yin la//de bzhin lam la ngal ba nyams phyir theg pa ste/ /de bzhin gnas ni rnam par spyong phyir stan yin la/ /gtsang dang nad med stobs la brten phyir khrus yin no//sbug bsngal rab tu zhi ba'i ched du gyur pa ste/ /de bzhin skye dgu rnams kyi yul nas longs spyod min/ /rab tu zhi ba'i cho gar rab zhugs shes rab can/ /longs spyod rnams ni bza' zhes su yis khas len byed/ /gang zhig 'gro ba'i 96—100

gdung bas rnam par gdungs pa ni3sna/ /longs spyod yin zhes grang ba'i bya bar nan tan byed/ /sdug bsngal zhi ba'i bdag nyid la ni rab 'jug cing / /des ni 'dod pa rnams la longs spyod 'du shes byed/ /gang phyir 'dod pa rnams la mtha' gcig gyur min te/ /de phyir bdag gis 2de la longs spyod 'du shes med/ /dngos po gang nyid kyis ni bde ba ster byed pa/ /de nyid kyis ni slar yang sdug bsngal 'dren par byed/ /bgo ba lci mo dang ni phyi ba ma yin nyid/ /grang dang dro ba'i tshe na bde dang bde min la/ /zla 'od rnams dang tsan+dan nyid kyang dro ba na/ /bde ba'i phyir dang sdug bsngal phyir yin grang ba na'o / /gang phyir rnyed dang ma rnyed la sogs 'jig rten na/ /kun gyi gnyis su 'dzin pa rnams ni rab zhugs te/ /de phyir mtha' gcig bde ba yod pa ma yin zhing / /sa na skyes bu kha cig mtha' gcig zusdug bsngal min/ /bde dang sdug bsngal nyid ni rnam par 'dres mthong nas/ /rgyal srid dang ni bran nyid mnyam pa bdag gi lugs/ /rgyal bo nyid ni rtag par rgod pa ma yin zhing / /bran ༄ni kun nas gdung ba nyid kyang ma yin no/ /gang phyir mi skyong nyid du bka' lung lhag par gyur/ /de phyir rgyal po'i sdug bsngal dag ni chen po nyid/ /kun nas brten pa'i shing dang rab mtshungs rgyal po ni/ /srid pa'i rgyu las yongs su ngal bar 'gro ba nyid/ /rgyal srid 'dor ldan bshes min mang por mi skyong gis/ /gal te blo gtad 'cha' bar gyur na rgud pa ste/ /ci ste yang na blo gtad nye bar byed min na/ /'dir ni 'jigs ldan rgyal bo'i bde ba zhes bya ci//gang tshe sa ni mtha' dag rgyal bar gyur nas kyang / /gnas pa'i ched du grong khyer gcig pu nyid mthong zhing / /de nyid la yang pho brang gcig pu bsnyen bya ste/ /96—101

rgyal por gyur pa pha rol don du ngal lam ci/ /rgyal po sdod pa'i gnas kyang gnya' shing gcig nyid do/ /rmyede bzhin bkres pa 'gegs phyir bza' ba tsam yin la/ /de bzhin nyal lam gcig dang stan ni gcig nyid de/ /lhag dang lhag min mi skyong gis ni rgyags phyir ro/ /gal te tshim pa'i don du 'bras bu de 'dod na/ /rgyal srid rnams dang bral yang bdag ni tshim pa yod/ /tshim pa yod par gyur na skyes bu'i 'jig rten na/ /khyad par med pa ma yin thams cad khyad par ro/ /de phyir dge dang zhi ba'i lam ni rab thob pa/ /kho bo 'dod pa rnams la slu bya ma yin la/ /mdza' bshes nyid du dran par byas nas yang dang yang / /dam bca' nges par skyongs bye zhes bdag la smras pa'o/ /bdag ni nags su zhugs pa mi bzod pas min la/ /dgra bo'i mda' rnams kyis ni mgo bo 'dar ba min/ /'bras bu lhag pa rnams las re ba byas min te/ /de phyir khyed kyi tshig de bzung ba ma yin no/ /gang zhig yang yang shin tu sos 'debs khros pa'i sbrul/ /spangs nas slar yang len pa la ni nan tan byed/ /yang na sreg pa'i rang bzhin 'bar ba'i rtswa snguyi me/ /spangs nas 'dod pa rnams ni slar yang de yis brten/ /gang zhig ma long long ba'i phyir ni 'dod pa ste/ /grol ba 'ching ba'i phyir dang phyug po nor med phyir/ /rang bzhin gnas pa'i sems ni bston pa'i sems phyir la/ /yul gyi bdag nyid phyir ni 'dod par de yis byed/ /gang zhig 'dir ni mchog tu zhi ba'i bde ba dang / /gzhan du sdug bsngal rnams ni kun nas sgrib pa ste/ /byed ldan rga dang 'chi ba'i 'jigs las sgol 'dod pa/ /slong 5mo nye bar rgyu zhes rjes su brtse bya min/ /gang zhig 'dir ni zhi ba'i bde ba 'thob min la/ /gzhan du sdug bsngal rnams kyis 96—102

rab tu 'dzin byed cing / /phun tshogs chen po'i bdag nyid la yang rnam gnas pa'i—/ /sred pas ⑫zil gyis gnon 1la rjes su brtse bar byas/ /sems pa rnguyi dang spyod pa yi dang rigs nyid kyi/ khyod kyis brjod pa la ni rjes su mthun pa ste/ /sems pa ④yi dang spyod pa yi dang rigs nyid kyiḍashā/ /kho bo yi yang dam bca' 'dren par mtshungs pa'o/ /bdag kyang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i 6‘mda' yis rnam phug pa/ /zhi ba thob par ④'dod pas rnam par nges 'byung ste//nad med mtho ris na yang rgyal srid 'thob pa ru/ /'dod pa med na kye ma mi rnams su smos snyeci/ /mi skyong gang yang sde gsum mtha' dag brten pa ni 9 / /rab mchog mi yi don zhes khyed kyis bdag la smras/ /de ltar don med ces ni bdag gi bstan byapa 'dir/ /mdzad ldan sde tshan shā1gsum ni tshim byed kyang ma yin—/ /gang du dga' bar 'gro min 'jigs min nad ma yin/ /skyong mumin nye bar 'da' min sems kyi nad rnams minashā1/ /gang na yang dang yang du bya ba yod min pa/ /de nyid skyes bu'i don ni mchog tu shes pa'o/ /ji srid na tshod so ma rnam par 'gyur bar 'gro/ /de srid dga' ba yongs su skyongs mdzod zhes smras pa/ /'di ni nges pa ma yin g.yo bar mthong ba ste/ /rga ba brtan pa min dang lang tsho brtan ldan mthong / /rang gi las mkhan mthar byed gang gi 'gro ba ni / /na tshod kun la dbang med rnam par 'gugs pa ste/ /rnam gzhag ma yin rnam par nyams tshe gang ltar ni/ /zhi 'dod mkhas pa dag gis dga' ba rtogs par byed/ /gang tshe dga' ba'i gzhu dang nad rnams bkram pa'i mda'/ /mthar byed dge ba ma yin rngon pa bzhin gnas pas/ /skye dgu'i ri dwags bskal pa'i nags brten 1〉rnams gtor te/ /na tshod rab mchog la dmigs 96—103

yid la re ba yi/ /de phyir gzhon nam rgan dang yang na byis pa ni/ /rab tu 'jug par 'dod dam rnam par ldog pa nyid/ /chos ldan bdag nyid byas pa ji lta bar gyur pa/ /de ltar myur ba ldan pas 'dir ni bya bar 'os/ /yang na 'dod pa'i 'bras bu rigs su 'os pa rnams/ /chos phyir mchod sbyin bya ba gyis zhes gang smras pa/ /gang zhig gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bya bas 'dod pa ste/ /mchod sbyin rnams la phyag 'tshal bde ba 'dod pa med/ /'bras bu 'dod pas dbang med pha rol gsod pa la/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid dam pa rnams kyi rigs tshul min/ /gang yang mchod sbyin dag gi kyi'abras bu rtag gyur pa/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid gang gis snade ltar byas nas ci/ /sems ni zhi ba yis sam tshul khrims brtul zhugs 1kyis/ /gal te chos tshul gzhan gyi cho ga ma yin la/ /de lta na yang mchod sbyin bsnyen par 'os min 4te/ /gang du gzhan la 'tshes nas 'bras bur brjod pa'o/ /'di nyid du yang re zhig skyes bu gnas pa yi/ /bde ba gang zhig pha rol 'tshe bas rab zhugs pa/ /de yang brtse bcas blo dang ldan pa'i 'dod min 5te/ /gang zhig sred pa'i mtha' mar mi mthong kye ma ci/ /rgyal po 'khor bar bdag gi yid ni dga' med cing / /'bras bur rab tu 'jug phyir bdag ni bslu bya min/ /chu 'dzin char gyes brgyab pa'i ljon shing bzhin du ni/ /kun du song ba'i rab tu 'jug pa rnams ni g.yo/ /rnam par thar pa smra ldan rtsibs phur thub pa ni/ /blta bar 'dod pas bdag ni 'dir yongs de yi phyir/ /mi skyong khong zhwal dge bar gyur cig de /dz+wani 'gro/ /bdag gi de nyid ltos med dag ni bzod par mdzod/ /lha na dbang po bzhin srungs kye/rtag par nyi bzhin srungasakai/ /yon tan gyis srungs sa srungs ⑩'dir ni dge 96—104

legs srungasatū/ /tshe srungs 'phags pa yis srungs dam pa'i bu rnams dang / /dpal srungs rgyal po'i bdag nyid kyis ni chos srungs shig /kha ba'i dgra yi rdeg 2snalas skyes pa las skyes nas/ /ji ltar gnyis skyes gang zhig lus ni rnam thar 'gro/ /kha ba'i dgra yi dgra yis khyim gye dgra 'joms nang / /nang du de ltar gang zhig yid ni rnam par thar gshegs mdzod/ /thal mo dang — byebacas re thob mi skyong pyagis smras pa/ /khyed kyis ji ltar 'dod pa bgegs med thob par shog /bya ba byas pa kun nas thob pa dus su 'dir/ /kho bo yi yang rjes su 'dzin pa khyed kyis mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar gyur zhes brtan pa'i dam bca' mdzad nas sa skyong la/ /de nas de ni thams cad sgol gyi dka' thub gnas su gshegs / /yongs su gshegs pa de mthong nas kyang ya mtshan gyur pa yi/ /mi skyong nyid kyang ri yi tshogs kyi grong khyer nyid du song / /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ 'dod pa la rnam par smod pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas lus kyis 5gang ba bzhin/ /bu ram shing ba'i zla ba yis/ /zhi bar gnas pa'i thub pa yis/ /rtsibs 'phur 6gyis ni gnas su bsnyen/ /sgyu rtsal shes kyi rigs de yis/ /rgyang nas gzigs nas mthon po yis/ /legs par 'ongs zhes smras pa ste/ /drung du nye bar gshegs pa'o/ /de gnyis phan tshun rigs par ni/ /khams ni snyoms par dris nas su/ /shing gtsang brtul zhugs gdan dag la/ /sa phyogs gtsang bar bzhugs pa'o/ /bkur mang rnam par yangs pa yis⑦/ /lta byed dag gis 'thung ba bzhin/ /mi skyong sras 96—105

po bzhugs de la/ /thub pa mchog des smras pa'o/ /zhi ba bdag gi ①shes pa ltar / /khyim nas nges par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gnyis 'thung rgyags pas zhags pa ltar/ /brtse ba'i zhags pa bcad nas 'ongs/ /khyod kyi yid ni shes rab dang / /kun nas brtan pa ldan pa nyid/ /dug gi ljon pa'i 'bras bu bzhin / /gang khyod dpal dor nas 'ongs so/ /longs spyad lhag ma'i phreng ba bzhin/ /bu rnams dag la dpal byin nas/ /sa skyong 'khogs pa'i na tshod rnams / /gang zhig nags 'ongs ngo mtshar min/ /bdag gi lugs snyeni ngo mtshar te/ /so ma'i na tshod la khyod kyis/ /yul gyi ༄ —spyod yul la gnas pa/ /dpal nyid longs ma spyad nas 'ongs/ /de phyir chos 'di shes pa la/ /khyod ni dam pa'i snod yin la/ /ye shes gru bo byin brlabs thunas/ /skyen par sdug bsngal rgya mtsho sgol/ /gang yang slob mar shes pa na/ /dus kyis bstan bcos la 'jug ste/ /zab pa las dang nan tan las/ /bdag gi ༄5yongs rtog khyod ma yin/ /de ltar rtsibs 6'phur nyid kyi tshig /mi yi drang srong des gsan nas / /mchog tu dga' bar gyur pa yis/ /lan gnyis rab tu smras pa'o/ /don ma byas kyang 'di yi ni/ /don byas bzhin du da lta nyid/ /chags dang bral ba gang 'di ni/ /dam pa khyed kyi mngon du gyur/ /blta bar 'dod pas 'od bzhin dang / /sgol bar 'dod pas gru bzhin dang / /'gro bar 'dod pas lam mkhan bzhin/ /khyed mthong ba la bdag gis shes/ /rga dang 'chi ba'i 'jigs rnams las/ /gal te gsung byar dgongs nas ni/ /de phyir gsung bar 'os pa'o/ /de ltar rtsibs 'phur gyis gzhon nu'i/ /bdag nyid che las bskul ba nyid/ /rang nyid kyi ni bstan bcos kyi/ /nges par mdor 96—106

bsdus gsungs pa'o/ /ji ltar 'khor ba yin pa la/ /ji ltar nges par ldog pa nyid/ /nyan pa rnams kyi mchog grub mtha'/ /kho bo'i 'di ni gson mdzod cig /rang bzhin dang ni rnam 'gyur dang / /skye dang 'chi dang rga ba ste/ /re zhig sems pa rmyezhes brjod pa/ /brtan pa'i sems pa pyade shes mdzod/ /de la rang bzhin shes bya ba/ /rang bzhin shes pa shes par mdzod/ /'byung ba lnga yi bdag nyid dang / /blo dang mi gsal ba nyid do/ /rnam 'gyur zhes bya mkhyen par mdzod/ /yul rnams dang ni dbang po rnams/ /lag pa rkang pa dag dang ni/ /'phongs dang mdoms gudang de bzhin yid/ /'di yi zhing ni shes pa la/ /zhing shes pa zhes bya ba ste/ /zhing shes pa zhes bdag nyid du/ /bdag tu bsam byed rnams kyis thusmras/ /slob ma dang bcas ser skya yis/ /'di ༄ ni rab tu rtogs zhes dran/ /bu dang bcas pa'i rtogs pa yang ༷ skye dgu'i bdag por 'di brjod do/ /skye ba nyid dang rga ba dang / /na ba dang ni 'chi ba dang 3/ /de ni gsal zhes rtogs bya ste/ /bzlog las mi gsal ba yang ngo / /mi shes pa dang las dang srid/ /'khor ba'i rgyu rnams shes bya ste/ /gsum po 'dir gnas 'gro ba ni/ /snying stobs de ni 'da' ba med/ /log pa las dang ngar 'dzin las/ /the tshom las dang mngon 'phyo las/ /khyad par med las thabs min las/ /chags pa las dang mngon lhung las/ /de la log pa zhes bya ba/ /phyin ci log tu 'jug pa ste/ /bsam par bya ba gzhan sems shing / /bya ba gzhan ni byed pa'o/ /smra ba nga dang rig pa dang cho/ /'gro ba nga dang gnas pa nga / /de ltar 'di ni ngar 'dzin pa/ /ngar 'dzin med kyi 'jug pa'o/ /gang zhig the tshom med dngos rnams/ /gcig tu gyur pas 96—107

mthong ba ste/ /je tshom med pas 'jim gong ltar/ /de 'dir je tshom du brjod do/ /gang zhig nga nyid de nyid 'di/ /yin dang blo dang las yin la/ /gang zhig drangs te de nyid nga shesna/ /zhes gang de ni mngon par 'phyo/ /rab rgyas rab rgyas ma yin pa'i/ /khyad par med pa'i khyad shes kyi/ /rang bzhin rnams kyis gagang shes pa/ /de ni khyad par med ces dran/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang gzhi mi 'grib/ /bsang /gtor dang ni mngon 'thor ④sogs/ /thabs min zhes ni shes ldan gyes/ /rab tu rtogs bya thabs shes kyi/ /chags pa sgomi skye yul rnams la/ /yid 6ngag blo dang las rnams kyis/ /blo ngan gang gis chags byed pa/ /de ni mngon par chags zhes dran/ /bdag gi 'di dang 'di bdag ces/ /gang zhig sdug bsngal mngon snyam ste/ /gang zhig 'khor bar lhung shes 7bya/ /de ltar mkhas skye ma rig pa/ /gnas skabs lnga ni rab thob ste / /mun pa rmongs pa rmongs 9pa che/ /mun las gyur pa gnyis nyid do/ /de la mun pa le lor dang / /rmongs pa skye 'chir rtogs par mdzod/ /rmongs pa chen po 'dod pa zhes/ /kun nas rmongs med mkhyen par mdzod/ /gang phyir 'di na 'byung rnams kyisarka/ /chen por yang ni rab rmongs byed/ /de phyir phyag chen 'di dag ni/ /rmongs pa chen po zhes dran no/ /mun las gyur pa khro nyid du/ /lhag par byed pa'o khro med kyis shārta/ /mi shes mun las gyur pa ni / /skyo bar rab bshad skyo med kye/ /ma rig pa 'dis byis pa 'di 7/ /gnas skabs lnga dang ldan pa ste/ /'khor bar sdug bsngal gyur pa yi/ /skye ba rnams su 'bab nyu5par byed/ /lta bo nyan po shes pa po/ /bya ba dang ni rgyu nyid dag /da zhes de ltar 'ongs nas ni/ /'khor bar yongs su 'khor bar byed//96—108

blo ldan rgyu 'di rnams kyis 'di/ /skye ba'i rgyun la rab tu 'jug /rgyu rnged pa las 'bras bu med/ /de ltar rnam par shes par 'os/ /de la rgyun rab hūṃ rab rgyas mig /gsal ba dang ni mi gsal nyid/ /thar pa 'dod pa bzhin rnams te/ /yang dag 'gro ba rigs par mdzod/ /bzhi po de dag ji lta bzhin//'gyur med go 'phang 'thob par byed/ /de phyir 'jig rten na tshangs pa/ /mchog tu tshangs par smra ba 3rnams/ /tshangs pa'i spyod pa spyod byed 'dir/ /tshangs pa rnams kyis gnas par byed/ /mi skyong sras kyis thub pa de'i/ /tshig 'di de ltar gsan nas ni/ /mthar thug go 'phang nyid dang ni/ /thabs mngon pa dag dran pa'o/ /ji ltar ji srid gang du ni/ /tshangs pa'i spyod pa 'di spyad cing / /chos 'di yis ni mthar thug pa/ /khyod kyis rnam par bshad par 'os/ /de ltar thub pas bstan bcos ltarasnye/ /rnam gsal don ni mdor bsdus pas/ /cho ga'i rtog pa gzhan nyid kyis/ /chos de de la smras pa'o / /'dis ni dang por khyim spangs nas/ /slong jemo'i rtags ni bsten sa pa ste/ /phrin las rnam par rgyas pa yi/ /tshul khrims blangs nas 'jug par byed / /byed ldan rtsod med bstan bcos rig /mchog tu tshim pa la gnas nas / /gang dang de yis gang dang der/ /rnam dbe+en gnas ni bsten 5pa'o/ /de nas chags las 'jigs mthong nas/ /chags pa med las mchog zhi yang / /dbang po'i grong ni nges bzung ste/ /yid la zhi ni 'bad pa byed/ /de nas 'dod pa rnams las dang / /gnod sems sogs las rnam dben nyid/ /bsam gtan dang po rnam dpyod ldan/ /rnam par dbe+en pa las skyes thob/ /bsam gtan bde ba de thob nas/ /de dang de nyid rnam dpyod cing / /sngar 96—109

med bde ba thob pa yis/ /byis pa'i skye bo 'phrog par byed/ /'dod dang sdang ba rnam smad pa'i/ /zhi ba'i cho ga de 'dra 'dis/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten thob pa ste/ /yongs su tshim pas gnas pa'o/ /rnam dpyod yid ni skyong tso byed rnams/ /mkhas par rnam par shes nas kyang / /de las rnam par grol ba ni/ /bsam gtan dga' ba'i bde ldan thob/ /gang zhig khyad par ma mthong zhing / /dga' ba de yis phrogs pa de/ /'od gsal ba yi lha rnams su//'od gsal ba yi gnas 'thob bo/ /gang yang dga' ba'i bde de las/ /yid ni rnam par dben byed pa/ /dga' ba'i bde ba dang bral ba/ /bsam gtan gsum pa thob par byed/ /de 'dra'i bde ba 'dir thob nas/ /gang zhig chags min btang snyoms shing / /bde dang sdug bsngal rnam spangs pa'i/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa thob par byed/ /bde dang sdug bsngal zhi phyir dang / /sems kyi bya ba med pa'i phyir/ /thar zhes mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ /der yang kha cig 'bad pa byed/ /bsam gtan de yi 'bras bu ni/ /'bras bu che bas lhas mnyam par/ /longs spyod shes rab che rnams kyis/ /chen po'i dus su smra ba'o/ /ting 'dzin de las rnam langs shing / /lus skyes skyon rnams mthong nas ni/ /lus las rnam par ldog pa'i phyir/ /shes ldan bsam gtan la 'jog go/ /de nas bsam gtan de bor nas/ /khyad par la ni nges byas pa'i / /shes rab ldan de 'dod las bzhin/ /gzugs rnams las kyang chags pa med/ /lus 'di la ni kha gang du/ /de la yongs su rtog pa ste/ /de nas rdzas sdug rnams la yang / /nam mkhar lhag par mos par byed/ /nam mkhar song ba'i bdag nyid du/ /bsdus nas gzhan du blo ldan gyis/ /de 96—110

nyid mtha' med par mthong zhing / /khyad par 'phags pa lhag par 'thob/ /nang na rmyemakhas pa gzhan dag ni/ /bdag nyid bdag nyid kyis bzlog nas/ /ci yang med ces mthong ba ni/ /ci yang med pa zhes dran no/ /de nas gur nas bya bzhin dang / /gong 1bu dag nas srin bal bzhin/ /zhing shes lus las 'thon pa las/ /thar pa zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /de nyid shes pa'i mkhas pa yis/ /gang zhig thar pa zhes brjod pa/ /'di de tshangs pa dam pa ste / /rtags med rtag cing 'gyur ba med / /de ltar thabs dang thar pa dag/bdag gis khyod la bstan thu pa ste/ /gal te shes shing gal te sred/ /ji lta ba bzhin rtogs par mdzod/ /rgyal 'dod bu dang skyed byed dang / /gzhan mi 'bral ba rgan po dang / /thar pa 'dod pa gzhan rnams kyang / /lam 'di thob nas grol bar 'gyur/ /de yi dam pa'i tshig 'di dang / /rnam par dpyod pa yang bzung nas/ /sngon du rgyu yi stobs thob pas/ /lan ni smras par gyur pa'o/ /gong nas gong du zhi ba yi/ /ye shes phra mo 'di thos shing / /zhing shes yongs su ma btang phyir/ /de ni mthar thug min par go/ /rnam gyur snyedang ni rang bzhin las/ /zhing shes grol bar 5kho bo yis/ /rab tu skye ba'i chos su dang / /sa bon chos su snyam pa'o/ /gang yang rnam dag bdag nyid ni/ /nges par thar zhes rtog pa ste/ /slar yang rkyen dag yod pa las/ /de ni grol bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar dus spyor sa dang chu/ /me las sa bon skye ma yin/ /de bzhin rkyen ni de rnams kyis/ /skye ba de yang bdag gi lugs//gang zhig mi shes las sred rnams/ /spangs las thar pa rtogs byed pa/ /de ni mchog tu yongs spong ba/ /bdag yod gyur na yod ma yin/ /spangs nas 96—111

spangs nas gsum bo 'di/ /khyad par du yang nyer 'thob cing / /gang du bdag ni gnas gyur pa/ /der ni gsum po 'di phra'o/ /skyon rnams phra ba nyid las dang / /sems kyi bya ba med las dang / /tshe ni ring ba nyid las kyang / /thar par kyang ni yongs su rtogahūṃ /ngar 'dzin par ni yongs spong bar / /gang de yongs su rtog byed la/ /bdag spyod gyur nas ngar 'dzin pa/ /yongs su spong ba yod ma yin/ /drang srong rnams kyis ma spangs pa/ /'di ni yon tan med ma yin/ /de phyir yon tan med gyur na/ /'di yi thar par mi brjod do/ /yon tan can gyis bye yon tan gyi/ /ldog pa yod pa ma yin te/ /gzugs dang 'gro 1ba dang bral ba'i/ /me ni nye bar 'thob ma yin/ /lus las sngon du celus can dang bye/ /yon tan las sngar yon tan can/ /ma yin de phyir dang por grol/ /lus bzhin sbar yang 'ching bar byed/ /zhing shes lus dang ma khubral ba/ /shes pa yin nam shes min nyid/ /gal te shes 'di shes bya yod/ /shes bya yod na mi grol lo/ /ci ste khyod la shes mi 'grub/ /bdag tu rtog ④pas ci zhig bya/ /bdag dang bral yang shes pa ni/ /rab grub shing dang rtsig pa bzhin/ /gang phyir gong nas gong du ni/ /de ltar rtsibs 'phur gyi ni chos/ /mkhyen nas de ni ma tshim zhing / /mtha' dag min zhes shes nas su/ /de nas so sor gshegs pa'o/ /de nas khyad par chos 'dod pa//lhag spyod kyi ni gnas su gshegs/ /de yi bdag tu 'dzin las kyang / /des ni lta bar sred ma gyur/ /'du shes 'du shes med pa'i skyon/ /thub pa lhag spyod kyis shes nas/ /'du shes 'du shes med bdag min/ /cung zad med las gzhan 'gro thob/ /gang phyir dmigs pa phra mo ni/ /'du shes 'du shes 96—112

med las gzhan/ /'du shes med min 'du shes min/ /de phyir der ni re 'dod min 1/ /gang phyir der ni blo 37gnas shing / /gzhan du rab tu rgyu ba med / /phra zhing rdo ldan de phyir der/ /'du shes med min 'du shes med/ /de phyir de yang rab thob nas/ /slar yang 'gro ba 'khor ba ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' mchog 'dod pas/ /de phyir lhag spyod dor ba'o/ /de nas de yi gnas thob nas/ /dge legs don gnyer nges byas nas/ /gang yang rgyal ba'i drang srong gisarngu// /grong khyer zhes bya'i gnas bsnyen no/ /de nas nai rañdza na'i 'gram/ /gtsang mar gtsang zhing pha rol gnon/ /dben pa'i gnas ni mngon 'dod pa'i/ /thub pa yis ni gnas mdzad do/ /de nas de ni sngar brten zhing / /dbang po lnga yi dbang las khengs/ /mun pas bsnyen pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /dge slong lnga rnams des gzigs so/ /bsod nams kyis bsgrubs nor nad med/ /dbang don rnams kyis dbang phyug bzhin/ /dge slong de rnams kyis kyang 'dir/ /de mthong gyur nas nye bar gnas/ /de'i dbang gis gnas slob ma rnams/ /dbang po g.yos pas yid bzhin du/ /rab tu de rnams kyis mchod cing / /rnam par dul las rjes su 'jug /'chi dang skye ba mthar byed la/ /de nas thabs ni 'di yis zhes/ /bza' 5ba med par shes pa yis hūṃ/ /dka' thub gdung ba rnams brtsams so/ /basmyung 3 gnas cho ga du ma rnams/ /mi yis spyod dka' rnams mdzad cing / /las ni thob bzhed lo drug tu/ /bdag gi 87sku lus rig shesnapar mdzad/ /pha mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba yi/ /pha rol thob par 'dod pa des/ /bza' ba'i dus su til dang 'bru/ /rab sha rnams ni re re gsol/ /dka' thub gdung ba 96byed113

des de yi/ /sku las bri bar byas pa gang / /sbar yang de yi gzi brjid kyis/ /sku lus nye bar 'phel byas gyur/ /ston ka'i dkar phyogs dang po yi/ /zla bas ku mu ta snarnams bzhin/ /ring kyang dpal grags ring rngumin zhing / /gzhan gyis thumig rnams tshim par mdzad/ /rus lpags lhag ma lhag med par/ /tshil dang sha dang khrag rnams kyis/ /zad kyang zab mo ma zad par/ /rgya mtsho bzhin du de mdzes so/ /de nas sangs rgyas nyid 'dod pas/ /ngal dub gdung bas don med bsal/ /nyon mongs lus can thub pa ni/ /srid las 'jigs pa blo mdzad do/ /chos 'di chags bral phyir min zhing / /rtogs phyir ma yin thar phyin min/ /de tshe 'dzam bu'i rtsa bar gang / /bdag gis thos te nges pa yin/ /'di ni stobs chung gis thob par/ /nus pa min thuphyir gus 'ongs shing / /sku yi stobs ni 'phel don du/ /slar yang 'di ni rjes su bsams5 / /bkres dang skom pas yongs gtser 6zhing / /ngal las rang gnas med pa'i sems/ /yid kyis thob bya'i 'bras bu ni/ /sdog pa med pa gang zhig 7'thob/ /rtag par dbang bo tshim pa las/ /yang dag gnas pa 'thob pa ste/ /dbang po yang dag tshim nyid kyis / /yid ni rang bzhin gnas pa 'thob9/ /dang zhing rab dang yid kyis ni/ /ting 'dzin nye bar skye ba ste/ /ting 'dzin gyis sbyar sems kyi ni/ /bsam gtan spyor ba rab tu 'jug /bsam gtan rab tu zhugs pa las/ /rnyed dka' zhi zhing dga' med mchog /'chi med go 'phang de chos rnams/ /gang gis thob pa rab thob po / /de phyir bza' ba rtsa ba ste/ /'di ni thabs zhes nges pa yin/ /bza' ba byed la brtan pa ni/ /dpag med blo yis blo mdzad nas/ /khrus 96—114

byas ṣ+pe rañdza 'gram nas/ /lag byin 'gram gyi ljon shing ni/ / gus pa yis sna dud yal ga'i rtses/ /sku lus rid pa dal bus drangs/ /de nas lha rnams kyis bskul ba'i/ / ba lang spyong bdag bu 3mo ni/ /snying la dga' skyes 'gyur ba yi/ /dga' stobs ma ni der 'ongs so/ /dung dkar gyis 'bar lag pa can/ /la ba sngon po gon pa mo/ /dbu 1ba dang bcas chu sngon phreng / /chu mchog ya mu na bzhin no/ /spyan mig ut+pal rab rgyas shing / /dad pas 'phel ba'i dga' ma des/ /de la mgo yis rab btud nas/ /'o ma drangs par gyur pa'o/ /des de gsol nas de la ni/ /skye ba'i 'bras bu thob byas nas / /yang dag dbang po drug tshim ste/ /byang chub 'thob par nus par gyur / /phul byung rgyas pa'i sku mnga' zhing / /rang gi grags bcas thub pa ni/ /nus gyur rgya mtsho gnyis dag gis / /mdzes dang bstan mopa gcig pus 6 bzung / /bdag ni nges par grol ba la/ /blo ldan khams lnga rnams kyis ltar/ /kun nas 'jug ces rnam shes nas/ /dge slong lnga rnams kyis de dor/ /de nas 'bad rtsol gnyis pa ni/ /byang chub ched du nges mdzad de/ /rtswa 'jam bkram pa'i sa gzhi la/ /a shwad tha 8yi rtsa bar gshegs/ /de tshe glang po'i 'gros mnga' ba'i/ /dpe med zhabs kyi sgra yis sad par byas pa ni/ /thub pa chen po'i byang chub nges par rtogs pa yi9 / /grub mchog nag po zhes byas bstod ⑩pa smras par gyur/ /ji ltar thub pa khyod kyis 11zhabs kyis brdzis pa ni/ /yang nas yang du sa ni sgra skad sgogs pa 'dra/ /ji ltar khyod kyi 'od ni nyi mar nyurtasnang ba ste/ /khyod kyis nges par 'dod pa'i go 'phang mkhyen pa nyid/ /ji ltar mkha' la khug rta'i phreng ba rnams 1rtabaskor zhing / /pad+ma'i spyan mnga' khyed 96byed115

la skor ba byed pa nyid/ /ji ltar mkha' la rlung rnams zhi bar 'gro ba ste/ /khyod kyis nges par de ring sangs rgyas 'gyur ba nyid/ /de nas glu ①mchog gis ni yang dag bstod pa ni/ /spyo ga las ni gtsang ma'i rtswa rnams nyer blangs pyanas/ /byang chub shing chen rtsa ba dge la rab brtan cing / /byang chub ched du dam bca' mdzad cing bzhugs pa'o/ /de nas gnyid log lto 'phye'i gdengs kas ④ bsdus pa la/ /des ni rdo rje'i byal krung g.yo med mchog bcings te/ /ji srid bya ba byas pa nyid ni ma thob par/ /de srid sa las chogadan de 'byed par mi bgyi'o/ /de nas nges pa'i bdag nyid bcom ldan gdan mdzad tshe/ /lha na gnas rnams mnyam med dga' ba thob gyur la/ /ri dwags tshogs rnams gnas par ma gyur bya rnams dang / /rlung gis bsnun pa'i nags kyi ljon shing sgra med gyur / /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ ring 'phur dang lhag spyod kyi drung du gshegs pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //der ni rnam par thar 7phyir dam bca' mdzad pa na/ /rgyal po'i rigs las rab 'khrungs drang srong chen po ni/ /der ni nye bar zhugs tshe 'jig rten rab dga' zhing / /der ni bdud kyang dam pa'i chos kyi dgrar gyur to/ /gang la 'dod pa'i lhar ni 'jig rten na smra ba/ /sna tshogs mtshon cha me tog mda' can de bzhin /du/ /'dod pa rab tu spyod pa'i bdag po de nyid la/ /thar pa'i dgra bo bdud du dpe rjod 9byed pa'o/ /de yi bu ni rol pa dga' ba rgyags pa dang / /bu mo dga' ma dges ma sred ma gsum rnams kyis ⑩/ /de la sems kyi rnam par 'gyur ba dris pa ste/ /des ni de rnams la tshig mngon 96—116

par smras/ /thub pa 'dis ni nges pa'i go cha rnam bzung hūṃzhing / /sems pa'i mtshon cha blo yi mda' ni bsdogs byas nas/ /bdag cag yul rnams la ni rgyal 'dod bsdad 3pa ste/ /gang phyir 'dis ni bdag gi yid ni rnam par 'gyur / /gal te 'dis bdag zil gyis mnan nas 'gro ba ste/ /'jigs 5pa la yang thar pa'i lam dag 'chad byed cing / /lus 'phags jo bo spyod las lhung ba'i bzhin du ni/ /de phyir 'di yis bdag gi snguyul ni de ring stongs/ /de phyir ji srid 'dis ni spyan mig ma thob cing / /ji srid bdag gi spyod yul dag na gnas pa nyid/ /chu bo shin tu 'phel ba'i shugs kyis zam pa bzhin/ /de srid 'di yi brtul zhugs 'joms su 'gro ba'o/ /de nas me tog las byas gzhu ni bzung nas dang / /kun du rmongs par byed pa'i mda' lnga rnams bzung nas / /skye dgu rnams kyi yid kyi ༄thurang gnas mi byed pa/ /de ni bur bcas a shwad tha yi rtsa bar song / /de nas srid pa 'khor ba'i pha rol rgal 'dod pa'i//thub pa rab tu zhi bar gdan la bzhugs pa la/ /lag pa g.yas pa mtshon cha'i rtse mor bdungs nas ni/ /mda' yis rol zhing bdud kyis 'di ni smras pa'o/ /kye ho rgyal rigs 'chi bas 'jigs pa longs mdzod cig /thar pa'i chos ni spongs la 'jig rten mdzod/ /mda' dang mchod sbyin rnams kyis 'jig rten pham byas nas/ /'jig rten dag nas dbang po'i go 'phang 'thob par mdzod/ /gang zhig mi dbang snga ma rnams kyis 'drims pa ste/ /nges par 'byung la 'di ni grags pa'i lam yin zhing / /rgyal po'i drang srong rnams kyang 3rigs su skyes pa yis / /slong mo rab thob la ni 'di ni bsngags ma yin/ /ji srid nges pa'i bdag nyid de ring mi ldang bahūṃ/ /dam bca' rnam par ma dor brtan par gyur 96—117

cig dang / /gang zhig nya dgra sru rwa ka la rnam ① spangs pa'i/ /de nyid bdag gis 'umada' 'di 'bar bar byas pa'o/ /'dis ni cung zhig reg pa tsam gyis e la de/ /zla ba'i tsha bo yin yang sems med gyur pa ste/ /zhi ba'i lus zhes bya ba de yang der 'gyur nas/ /zad pa'i dus su kye ma mi gzhan smos ci dgos/ /de phyir skyen par longs la 'du shes thob gyis dang / /yang yang shin tu ro myang mda' ni mnan pa ste/ /dga' ma'i byar 'os dga' zhing dges pa rnams la ni//gang zhig ngang pa rnams la bzhin du mi 'phen no/ /gang tshe de skad brjod kyang chags pa dang bral ba'i/ /shākya thub pas gdan ni bshig pa ma yin nyid/ /de nas 'di la bdud kyis kyemada' ni 'phangs pa ste/ /bu mo rnams dang bu rnams bdun pyanas byas nas so/ /der ni de yis 7mda' ni rab tu 'phangs na yang / /chags par byas pa med cing brtan las g.yos pa med/ /de ltar de mthong gyur nas bdud ni yi mug cing / /bsam mno yongs su ldan pa dal bus 6smras par 'gyur pe/ /ri dbang bu mo la dmigs gang gis phug pa yi/ /bde 'byung lha yang yongs su g.yos par gyur pa ste/ /'dis ni mda' de nyid la sems par mi byed pa/ /sems med yin nam mda' 'di de ma yin nam ci/ /de phyir me tog mda' 'di 'os pa ma yin zhing / /dga' ba ma yin dga' bar (re spyor ba 'os ma yin/ /'di ni zhi ba ma yin 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /'jigs dang bsdigs dang rdeg pa rnams ni 'os pa'o/ /de nas bdud kyis rang gi sde ni dran pa ste/ /shākya thub pa'i bgegs ni mnyam por byed 'dod pa/ /ral gri be+e con shing rtse ljon shing rtse gsum mdung lag rnams/ /sna tshogs bsam pa dang ldan rjes su 'brangs rnams 'ongasaphyosna/ /phag dang nya dang bong bu rnga 96—118

mo'i gdong can rnams/ /stag dang dom dang seng ge gnyis 'thung gdong can rnams—/ /mig gcig kha ni du ma mgo bo gsum ldan rnams/ /gsus pa 'phyang ba rnams dang gsus pa che ba rnams/ /brla rnams pus mo'i bar du bum pa'i pus mo rnams/ /mche ba'i mtshon cha rnams dang sen mo'i mtshon cha rnams/ /keng rus gdong can rnams dang gzugs ni mang po rnams/ /gdong phyed gzhom 3 pa rnams dang gdong ni chen po rnams/ /thal skya rnams dang thig le dmar po sna tshogs rnams/ /kha ṭī ga rnams dang ni spre'u ltar ngud sgra rnams/ /'phongs 'phyang rnams dang glang bo'i rna ba'i rna ba rnams/ /pags pa'i gos can rnams dang gos dang bral ba rnams/ /gdong phyed dkar po rnams dang lus phyed ljang gu rnams/ /zangs mdog dung mdog rnams dang ljang gu dkar po rnams/ /sprul gyi sham thabs rnams dang de bzhin lag pa rnams/ /rab tu sgra sgogs dril bu 'khrugs pa'i ske 3rags rnams/ /ta la'i tshad mnyam rnams dang mdung rnams bzung ba rnams/ /byis pa'i tshad mnyam rnams dang mche ba gcigs pa rnams—/ /lug gi gdong can rnams dang bya yi mig can rnams/ /byi la'i gdong can rnams dang mi yi lus can rnams/ /skra bkram rnams dang ral pa can dang byi bo rnams/ /gos dmar rnams dang rnam par 'khrugs pas dkris —pa rnams/ /rab dga'i gdong can rnams dang gnyer ma'i gdong can rnams/ /gzi brjid 'phrog pa rnams dang yid ni 'phrog pa rnams/ /kha cig dag ni 'pho zhing drag tu phan tshun du/ /mchan khung 'khyud cing de bzhin gzhan rnams mchongs—/ /mkha' la 'gro ba rnams ni kha cig rtse ba ste/ /kha cig shing gi rtse mo rnams la zhon pa'o/ /kha cig rtse gsum bskor chozhing gar ni byed pa ste/ /96—119

kha cig dbyug pa gdengs shing thog sgra sgogs pa'o/ /kha cig dga' bas khyu mchog bzhin du skad 'don zhing / /kha cig lus 'phos rnams las rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ /'dzin par 'dod pa rnams dang 'joms par 'dod pa rnams / /jo bo'i bka' ni rab tu skyong bar byed pa ste/ /rnam pa de ltar 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun nas ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' de la yongs su bskor nas gnas/ /mtshan mo snga ma la ni shākya'i khyu mchog dang / /bdud kyi 'thab mo dus de rab tu mthong nas ni/ /nam mkha' gsal ba ma yin sa ni g.yos gyur la/ /phyogs rnams sgra dang bcas pa rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ /drag po'i shugs can rlung ni kun du g.yos gyur la/ /skar ma rnams ni mi snang zla ba gsal ma gyur/ /slar yang mtshan mor mun pa rnam par rgyas gyur la/ /rgya mtsho rnams ni thams cad kun du g.yos par gyur/ /sa gzhi 'dzin cing chos dag 'dzin pa'i klu rnams ni/ /thub pa chen po'i bgegs la bzod pa ma yin zhing / /bdud las khros pas rnam par log pa'i mig can rnams/ /rngam pa bton zhing lus ni rnam par 'gyur ba'o/ /gtsang mar lhag par gnas pa'i lha yi drang srong ni/ /dam chos bsgrub pa'i don du mngon par zhugs pa rnams/ /bdud las yid kyis 1snarjes su brtse ba byas pa ste/ /chags dang bral ba las kyang khros par ma gyur to/ /'tshe ba'i bdag nyid bdud kyi dpung ni de yis ni/ /byang chub rtsa ba de ni khyab pa mthong nas ni/ /chos kyi bdag nyid 'jig rten thar pa 'dod rnams kyis/ /nam mkha' dag la hā hā'i khyesgra dag byas par gyur//chos kyi cho ga de ni nye bar nyams byed pa/ /bdud dpung gnas pa drang srong chen pos gzigs nas ni/ /ba lang rnams kyi dbus su seng ge gnas pa bzhin//96—120

g.yo 'gul med cing rnam par 'gyur bar yang ma gyur/ /de nas de yi 'jigs pa'i ched du bdud kyis ni/ /'byung po'i sde ni drag ⑨po rnams la bka' stsal zhing rngo sna / /de nas 'di yi sde des rang rang mthu rnams kyis/ /de yi bstan chapa dbye phyir blo gros byas pa'o/ /kha cig lce rnams g.yo zhing du mar rnam 'phyang rnguzhing / /mche ba'i rtse mo rnams rdo mig rnams ljang ser zlum/ /kha rnams gdangs shing phur bu'i rna ba rnams bstan khyezhing / /kun nas skrag par byed pa snyam du gnas zhes grag /des ni gzugs dang bsam pa dag gis mi bzad ⑥pa//rnam pa de dag ⑦nyid du gnas pa de rnams las/ /rtsed mo byed pa'i byis pa rgyags pa rnams las ni/ /drang srong chen po zug med skye bar ma gyur to/ /de nas kha cig khros pas lta byed rnam 'gyur zhing / /'di la dbyug pa rdeg 3par 'bad pa bya ba ste/ /sngon tshe grong khyer 'joms pa'i rdo rje dang bcas ltar/ /de nas 'di yi dbyug pa dang bcas lag pa rengs/ /kha cig rdo dang shing rnams gyen du 'phyar ba ni/ /thub pa la ni rnam par 'phen par ma nus te/ /'bigs 9byed ri brags rnams ni rdo rjes bcom pa bzhin/ /shing rnams dang bcas rdo rnams bcas pa de bzhin lhung / /kha cig mkha' la gyen du 'phur bas rdo rnams dang / /dgra sta rnams dang shing rnams rnam par 'phangs skyepa rnams/ /— kha dog gcig min mtshams sprin rkang pa rnams bzhin du/ /mngon par lhung ba ma yin nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ /gzhan ni de yi steng du 'bar ⑫ba'i khyu mchog gis/ /glang bu teri bo tsam pa'i rwa can 'phangs pa ste/ /de ni 'phangs pa tsam du che nam mkhar gnas pa nyid/ /de yi mthu las rnam pa brgyar ni gas par gyur/ /'jig rten 'jig tshe lhun po rab tu 'bar ba yis/ /gser gyi 96—121

bya skyibs rnams kyi phye ma rnam bzhin du/ /kha cig nyi ma shar ba bzhin du 'bar ba yi①/ /me mdag char pa chen po mkha' las phab par gyur/ /byang chub shing gi rtsa bar rab tu rnam 'phangs pa'i/ /me stag 'phro ba dang bcas me mdag char pa de/ /drang srong dam pa mchog gis 3 byams pa'i gnas pa las/ /at+pal dmar po'i 'dab ma'i char par gyur pa'o/ /lus dang sems la rnam par gnod par bya ba'i phyir/ /rnam pa de ltar phab pa de dang de rnams kyis/ /rang gi nges pa'i gnyen 'dun nye bar 'khyud nas bzhin/ /shākya thub pa gdan las g.yos par ma gyur to/ /de nas gzhan rnams 'khogs pa'i ljon shing rnams nas ltar/ /kha rnams cholas ni sbrul rnams rnam par skyugs pa ste/ /sngags kyis bcings bzhin de rnams de yi drung du ni/ /song ba ma yin dbugs min g.yos par ma gyur rosnye/ /gzhan rnams glog dang bcas shing thog dang bcas pa yis/ /chu 'dzin chen bo gtum pa'i dbyangs ldan rnams gyur nas/ /ljong shing de la rdo ba'i char pa phab pa ste/ /de ni me tog char pa mdzes par gyur pa'oshe/ /dbang phyug ma yin sron par dkar peba'i mi yi ni/ /snying la yongs su g.yos pa'i khro ba bzhin du ni/ /de nas gzhan gyis bye7gzhu la mda' dag bkang ba (ni/ /de nyid du ni 'bar zhing lhung bar ma gyur to/ /yul la rab tu 'jug la 'khor ba la 'jigs pa/ /yongs su rtog ṅkupa po yi dbang po lnga rnams bzhin/ /gzhan rnams dag gis mda' lnga rab tu 'phangs pa rnams/ /nam mkhar gnas bzhin 1rtethub pa la ni ma lhung ngo / /gzhan ni brdeg par 'dod pas khros shing rab bskor zhing / /dbyug pa bzung nas drang srong chen po'i mngon du phyogs/ /don med byed pa'i nyes pa rnams la 'jig rten ⑫bzhin//96—122

des ni 'dod pa ma thob dbang med 'gyel bar gyur/ /bud med sprin pa nag mo lag na thod pa can/ /drang srong chen po'i thugs ni rmongs par byed ces grag /g.yo ba'i bdag nyid can gyi 77blo ni lung la bzhin/ /der ni nges pa med par bskor rnguzhing gnas ma yin/ /kha cig mig ni rab tu 'bar bar byas nas ni/ /mig gi me yis 'u sbrul gyi dug bzhin bsreg je'adod pas/ /'dod pa'i bdag nyid can gyis nyer gnas dpal bzhin du/ /der ni drang srong bzhugs pa mthong bar ma gyur to/ /ye shes ting 'dzin dag gis 'gro bya nyes legs chos/ /lus kyi ngal ba rnams kyis 'thob par 'dod pa bzhin/ /de bzhin gzhan ni rdo ba lci mo bteg pa ni/ /rab tu 'bad pa rnam ༄5bcom don med ngal bar gyur/ /de bzhin gzhan rnams dred dang seng ge'i rnam pa yis ༷/ /chen po'i sgra rnams mthon po dz+warab tu sgogs pa ste/ /rdo rjes bsnun pa'i nam mkha' 'gas pa zhes snyam nas/ /sems can rnams ni gang gis kun nas 'khums par gyur/ /ri dwags glang po rnams ni nyam thag skad 'don zhing / /rnam par 'bros shing thim byesna pa nyid du gyur pa ste/ /de yi mtshan mor phyogs rnams las ni nyin mo bzhin/ /nyam thag bya rnams skad 'don yongs su babs par gyur/ /rnam pa khyede ltar de rnams kyi sgra de rnams kyis/ /'byung po thams cad rnams su g.yos pa yin na yang / /khab rnams dag gi sgra rnams dag gis mkha' lding ltar/ /thub pa 'jigs pa ma yin 'khums par ma gyur to/ /'jigs pa 'dron pa yongs su bskor ba'i tshogs rnams las/ /ji lta ji ltar thub pa'i 'jigs pa ma yin pa/ /de lta de ltar chos 'dzin rnams kyi dgra bo yi/ /bdud rnams mya ngan las dang khros nas byer ba'o/ /de nas 'byung po cung zhig gzugs ni mtho ba ma yin zhing / /96—123

khyad par 'phags par gyur pa nam mkhar gnas nyid kyis/ /drang srong la gnod dgra ma yin la khros mthong nas/ /bdud lha chen po'i dbyangs kyis smras par gyur pa'o/ /don med ngal bar byed par 'os pa ma yin bdud/ /'tshe ba'i bdag nyid spongs ①la bde bar song mdzod dang / /ri bo chen po lhun po bye rnams kyi sa bzhin du/ /khyod kyis bskyod cing bsgul bar nus pa ma yin no/ /sa yi brtan pa nyid dang chu yi ③gsher ba nyid/ /me yi 5dro ba nyid ni rab tu 'dor ba yang / /bskal pa du mar bsgrub pa'i bsod nams las mnga' ba/ /'dis ni nan tan nges par 'dor ba ma yin no/ / 'dis ni thunges pa gang dang pha rol gnon pa dang / /gzi brjid gang dang brtse ba skye dgu rnams la brten / /'od zer stong gis mun rnams ma bcom gnas bzhin du/ /'di ni de nyid ma thob nas ni ldang ma yin/ /shing la bsrubs nas me ni rnyed par 'gyur ba ste/ /sa la brkos na chu yang 'thob par 'gyur ba nyid/ /rigs pa dang ni ldan pa'i thams cad byas pa ste/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa'i bsgrub bya ma yin ci yang med/ /de phyir chags sogs nad rnams dag la gnas pa yi/ /'jig rten nyam thag pa la thugs rje mnga' ba ni/ /ye shes dman gyi don du yongs su ngal ba po/ /sman pa chen po 'di la bgegs 'os ma yin no/ /lam ngan mang po rnams kyis 'jig rten stor ba la/ /gang zhig zhi bas dam pa'i lam ni rjes tshol ba/ /chud zos pa la legs par ston byed ded dpon bzhin/ /ston mdzad de ni bskyod par rigs pa ma yin no/ /mun pa chen po sems can chud zos rnams la ni/ /ye shes sgron ma rab tu gsal bar mdzad pa 'di/ /mun pa la ni rab tu 'bar ba'i sgon ma yin 3 / /'phags pa'i mya ngan 'da' 96—124

bar byed par 'os ma yin/ /'khor ba'i rnam 'gyur chu bo chen por 'gro ba ni/ /pha rol ma thob par ni bying bar gzigs nas ni/ /gang gis de ni sgol bar byed la rab zhugs te/ /de la sdig pa 'phags pa su yis tso7sems par byed/ /bzod pa'i chu rgyus bstan ldupa'i rtsa ba brtan pa ste/ /spyod pa'i me tog blo dang dran pa'i yal ga can/ /ye shes ljon shing chos kyi 'bras bu ster ba po/ /'phel bzhin pa ni zlog par 'os pa ma yin no/ /gang gi snyesnying la rmongs pa'i zhags pa sra rnams kyis/ /bcings pa'i skye dgu rnams kyi grol phyir blo mnga' zhing / /'gro ba bcings pa thar pa'i ched du 'o brgyal ④ba/ /de la brdegs grupa khyod kyis khye'athad pa ma yin no/ /byang chub ched du las gang dag na dz+wamadzad pa rnams/ /de rnams kyis byeni nges par de ring dus yin la/ /ji ltar thub pa snga ma rnams ni de bzhin du/ /gnas der de bzhin 'di ni nye bar bzhugs pa'o—/ /dbyig 'dzin sa gzhi yi ni lte ba 'di yin zhing / /snying po dam pa mtha' dag dang ni ldan pa nyid/ /gang zhig 'di yis tsho—ting nge 'dzin gyi shugs bzod pa'i/ /sa yi phyogs de 'di las gzhan pa yod ma yin/ /de phyir khro bar ma byed zhi bar nyer song la/ /bdud ni khyod kyi drags /kyepas nga rgyal ma gyur cig tso1 /dpal ni mi brtan blo gtad par ni nus min zhing / /go 'phang g.yo lnga rgyags par mngon par nyer 'gro zhing / /de nas de yi tshig de yang dag thos nas dang skya/ /thub pa chen po'i g.yo ba med pa nyid mthong nas/ /gang gis mda' yis 0'gro ba'i snying la rdeg byed pa'i/ /bdud ni 'bad pa bcom zhing yid mi bde bar song / /dga' ba med cing 'bras med ngal ba byas pa rnams/ /pha bong rmyernams ni khyu mchog ljon shing rnams gtor te/ /dgrar gyur dgra bo'i 96—125

dpung ni gtso bo bsad pa ltar/ /de nas 'di yi dpung ni phyogs phyogs bros pa'o / /me tog tog can 'khor dang bcas pa bros shing nges par 'pham pa ni shā//drang srong chen po mun pa 'pham zhing rdul dang bral ba rgyal ba na/ /rgod pa dang bcas lang tsho ma bzhin zla ba dang bcas mkha' gsal zhing / /chu yi snying po can gyi dri zhim me tog char pa bab par gyur pa'o/ /de ltar sdig pa can ni nges par pham pa ni rngu / /de tshe phyogs ni rab snang mtshan mor byed pa mdzes/ /mkha' las snome tog char rnams sa la bab pa ste/ /lang tsho ma bzhin ngal ba med par mtshan mo gsal/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas brtan dang zhi ba yis④/ /bdud kyi stobs ni pham mdzad nas/ /don dam rnam par mkhyen bzhed pa/ /bsam gtan mkhas de byebasam gtan mdzad / /bsam gtan cho ga thams cad la/ /dbang phyug dam pa rab brnyes ⑥nas/ /sngon gyi skye ba rim pa ni/ /dang po'i thun la dran pa'o/ /che ge mo bdag ming 'di ni/ /de nas 'phos te 'dir 'ongs pa'o/ /zhes ni skye ba stong phrag rnams/ /rjes su myong ba bzhin du dran/ /'thad pa de dang de rnams su/ /skye bar 'chi ba dran nas ni/ /de nas sems can la thugs rjesakye//thugs rje'i bdag nyid can gyis mdzad/ /rang gi skye bo bor nas ni/ /slar yang gzhan du bya ba rnams/ /nges par 'jig rten mgon med 'di/ /'khor lo bzhin du yongs su 'khor/ /de ltar nges pa'i bdag nyid ni/ /de yi dran par gyur pa ste/ /chu shing snying po snying po med/ /'khor ba de ltar nges par ro/ /96—126

thun ni gnyis pa byung ba na/ /gnyis med pha rol gnon pa de/ /mig dang ldan pa kun gyi mchog /lha yi spyan ni thob par gyur/ /de nas des ni lha yi spyan—/ /yongs su dag pa de yis ni/ /me long dri ma med pa ltar/ /'jig rten mtha' dag la gzigs so/ /mchog dang mchog min las rnams kyis/ /sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang / /skye ba gzigs pa de yis tsho7ni/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'phel bar gyurathu/ /'di rnams sdig pa'i las can rnams/ /srog chags rnams ni ngan 'gror 'gro/ /'di gzhan dge ba'i las can rnams/ /mtho ris su ni rab gnas so/ /shin tu mi bzad dmyal ba ru/ /rab tu 'jigs par gyur pa rnams/ /'di rnams sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis 7/ /kye ma bkren pas gtser jepar byed/ //kha cig me yi kha dog gi /lcags khu khol ma 'thung bar byed/ /lcags kyi ka ba tshan mo la/ /gzhan rnams cho nges 'debs shing 'dzeg phyo /be+egs zangs rnams su khas bub rnams/ /kha cig thug pa bzhin du 'tshed/ /me mdag ⑥phung po 'bar rnams su/ /kha cig snying rje bar sreg go/ /kha cig lcags kyi mche rno can/ /mi bzad khyi rnams kyis za zhing / /kha byug ma rungs be+egs mchu can/ /lcags 'dra'i bya rog rnams kyis ྅za / /kha cig gdung bas yongs ngal rnams/ /bsel ba'i grib ma mngon ladod pas/ /ral gri'i lo ma'i nags sngon por/ /'di rnams bcings pa bzhin du zhugs/ /kha cig sta re rnams kyis ni/ /lag pa bteg rnams shing ltar 'gems/ /las rnams kyis bzung srog rnams ni/ /sdug bsngal na yang rnam dumi smin/ /sdug bsngal zlog 6 pa'i don ched du/ /bde ba yin zhes las gang byas/ /de yi 'bras de dbang med kyis/ /snyug bsngal kho na nyer longs 96—127

spyod—/ /bde don mi dge ba byas nas/ /gang de shin tu sdug bsngal rnams/ /de dag rnams kyi ro myang des/ /bde ba phra mo yang byed dam/ /sdig pa'i bdag nyid rgod rnams kyis/ /sdig pa'i las ni byas pa gang / /de ni mngon lhadu gyur pa'i tshe/ /cho nge rnams kyis rjes su myong / /gal te de ltar sdig las can / /las kyi 'bras bu mthong ba ste/ /dmigs su mngon par bsnun pa bzhin / /skyen par khrag ni skyugs sbyipa nyid/ /lus kyi sdug bsngal rnams las dang / /dmyal ba'i rnams las sems ldan gyi/ /'phags min rnams dang lhan cig 'grogs/ /ngal ba mchog ni bdag gi lugs/ /gzhan 'di sems kyis zurnam g.yo las/ /byung ba'i las rnams sna tshogs kyis/ /byol song skye gnas sna tshogs su/ /nye bar skyes rnams gdung ba can/ /sha lpags spu dang so yi phyir/ /chags pa las sam rgyags pa las/ /gnyen 'dun rnams kyis mthong na yang / /gang du snying rje bar gsod ④do/ /nus med ldan yang dbang med rnams/ /bkres skom ngal bas gtser lteb rnams/ /lcags kyis bsnun pa'i dbyig pya can rnams/ /rta dang ba lang gyur rnams 'khol/ /stobs can rnams kyang stobs chung gi /glang por gyur pa rnams 'khol te/ /lcags kyus nyon mongs mgo bo rnams/ /rkang pa'i rting pa rnams kyis btags/ /phan tshun rnam par rtsod las dang / /gzhan gyi dbang du gyur nyid kyis/ /sdug bsngal gzhan rnams la yod mukyang / /gang la sdug bsngal khyad par ldan/ /phan tshun du ni rab phrad nas/ /ma gnas skam gnas rnams kyis re7dang / /chur gnas chur gnas rnams kyis dang / /mkhar gnas mkhar gnas rnams kyis 'joms/ /ser snas non pa'i sems ldan rnams/ /yi dwags 'jig 96—128

rten snang med du/ /skyes pa 'di rnams de bzhin du/ /bkres pa 'bras bu la longs spyod/ /khab mig lta bu'i kha rnams dang / /ri bo lta bu'i lto ba rnams/ /bkres skom gyis bskyed snyug bsngal gyis/ /sdug bsngal skal can rnams gtser khyeto—/ /ser sna'i 'bras bu 'di 'dra ba/ /skyes bu (nagal te shes na ni/ /lus kyi cha shas rnams kyang ni/ /zhi ba bzhin du kun nas gtong / /rang gi las rnams kyis bzung zhing / /sred pas shin tu non pa rnams/ /bor ba'i mi gtsang ba rnams kyang / /longs spyod par ni 'dis mi rnyed/ /'di gzhan dmyal ba dang mtshungs pa'i/ /mngal phyin mi gtsang khu ba ru/ /nye bar skyes rnams mi rnams su/ /'gro ba rnams ni sdug bsngal 'thob/ /de sngon skye ba tsam na yang / /lag pa rnon pos bzung ba rnams/ /ral gri rnams kyis gshegs pa ltar/ /gang du snying rje bar ni ngu / /byams dang bsrung dang skyong rnams kyicha / /gnyen 'dun rnams kyis 'bad nas sos/ /sdug bsngal las slar sdug bsngal drag /rang rang las kyis nyon mongs so/ /bya ba 'di dang bya ba 'di/ /zhes ni gang du lhag par la/ /sred dang yongs ldan byis rnams kyis//rgyun chad med par rjes su pyong / /'di gzhan bsod nams las rnams kyis/ /mtho ris su ni skyes pa rnams/ /'dod chags me yis drag tu ni/ /me ltar rab tu sreg par byed/ /yul rnams kyis ni ngoms med rnams/ /gang las 'di rnams gzi bcom ste/ /phreng ba yongs rnyings zhags cepa rnams/ /gyen du mig phyogs rnams phyo lhung ngo / /gang du lha mo rnams kyis ni/ /snyug pa dbang med lhung ba la/ /snying la brtse ba ltos rnams tre7kyis/ /lag pa rnams kyis gos rnams 'dzin/ /gang zhig sa la lhung pyab bzhin/ / lus 'dud byedo 96—129

shal g.yo rnams kyis/ /sdug rnams gzhal med khang rnams nas/ /snying rje dang bcas ltung ba 1rtelta/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rgyan phreng can/ /gzhan 'dis sdug bsngal lhung rnams la/ /gdung rnams brtse dang g.yo ba yi/ /lta byed rnams kyi ( byerjes su 'gro/ /'dod pa can rnams lhung ba la/ /lag pa rnams kyis brang brdung zhing / /'khrugs chen gyi ltar nyam thag pa/ /lha mo'i tshogs rnams kyis bstan snyeto/ /kyi hud shing rta sna tshogs rdzing / /kyi hud sdug pa gang na zhes/ /nyam thag pa rnams rnam zlos shing / /lha la gnas rnams sa la lhung / /las mang rnams kyis thob pa yis ④/ /mtho ris mi brtan g.yo ba la/ /'bral bas byas pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ /gang du 'di 'dra thob par 'gyur/ /kye ma nged byelas khyad par du/ /'jig rten mdzad pa'i chos nyid de/ /'dod chags bral ba thob nas kyang / /gzhan rnams lha nas nges par lhung / /'di ni rtag par gnas pa ste/ /zhes ni nges pa'i sems ldan rnams/ /'jig rten 'di yi rang bzhin ni/ /'di lta ⑥bur ni mthong ma yin/ /dmyal ba rnams su sdug bsngal drag /dud 'gro rnams su phan tshun za/ /bkres skom sdug bsngal yi dwags su/ /mi la tshol ba'i sdug bsngal lo/ /lha na sdug pa dang bral bas/ /skyed )pa'i sdug bsngal phul byung ste/ /bskor snyeb gson pa'i 'jig rten gyis/ /gang na zhi ba nges par byed spu/ /'khor ba'i chu bo rten med du/ /'di ni 'chi bas bskor ba ste/ /tsam tsom du ni bskor ba yi/ /'gro bas gnas ni thob ma yin—/ /de ltar des ni 'gro ba lnga/ /lha yi spyan gyis gzigs pa ste/ /chu shing gshags r+ṣapa bzhin du ni/ /srid par snying po rnyed ma yin/ /de nas de yi mtshan mo'i thun/ /gsum pa nye bar gnas pa na/ /'jig rten 'di yi 96—130

rang bzhin ni/ /bsam gtan rig pa mchog gis bsgoms/ /kye ma 'jig rten ngal thob gang / /yang dang yang du skye ba dang / /'khogs pa dang ni 'chi ba dang / /'pho ba dang ni skye ba nyid/ /yang na sdug bsngal che 'di las/ /chags las ①long min kyis bsgribs pa/ /skyes long shin tu dog sa rngunas/ /phyi rol 'gro ba shes ma yin/ /de ltar bsams pa de yis ni/ /thugs kyis trernam dpyod gyur pa ste/ /gang du gyur na nges sam zhes/ /rga bas 'chi ba mngon par song / /skye gnas nas de nyid bsgoms pa/ /de yis mngon par rtogs par gyur/ /rga dang 'chi ba dag gis ni/ /skye ba yod na rdzogs pa'o/ /mgo bo yod na mgo bo yi/ /nad 'di 'byung ba mthong ba ste/ /shing gi skye ba yod gyur na/ /'gyel ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba'o/ /de nas de yi slar gyur pa/ /skye ba 'di slar gang la zhes/ /de nas las srid las skye bar/ /skye ba yang dag mkhyen pa'o/ /des ni lha yi srun gyis ni/ /las las 'jug par mkhyen pa ste/ /dbang phyug las min rang bzhin min/ /bdag las ma yin rgyu med min/ /ji ltar rig pa las gling bu/ /dang po'i tshigs ni bcad pa na/ /cho ga bzhin du kun myur 'gro/ /de ltar ye shes go rims so/ /de nas srid pa'i skye ba ni/ /mkhyen phyir thub pas blo gros mdzad/ /de nas srid pa'i skye ba des/ /nye bar len las byung bar mkhyen/ /tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin dang / /'dod blo bdag tu lta rnams kyis/ /bud shing rnams kyis me bzhin du/ /'di yis thulas ni nye bar len/ /gang gi 'u rgyu las len pa zhes/ /de nas de yi gyur pa ste/ /de nas nye bar len pa'i rkyen/ /sred par des ni mkhyen pa'o/ /chung ngu'i me yis nags kyi me/ /rlung gis bud de ⑪bskyed pa bzhin/ /'dod 96—131

sogs nyon mongs rgya chen rnams/ /sred pa yis ni skyed par byed/ /de nas de yis bsams pa nirmye/ /sred pa gang las byung zhes so/ /tshor ba'i rkyen gyis sred pa zhes/ /de nas rnam par nges pa mdzad/ /tshor bas mngon bcom skye dgu rnams/ /gnyen por byed la sred pa ste/ /skom pa med na chu la ni/ /kha cig mngon par dga' ba yin/ /de nas slar yang tshor ba yi/ /skye ba'i gnas ni gang zhes bsams/ /tshor ba tshor ba mthar byed kyis/ /reg pa'i rgyu can nyid du mkhyen/ /yul dang dbang po blo rnams kyis/ /'dus pa reg par brjod bya ste/ /gtsub —shing las ni me bzhin du/ /gang las tshor ba skye ba'o/ /de nas reg pa rgyu yin zhes/ /de yis bsams rngupar gyur pa'o/ /de nas skye mched drug gi 4ni/ /rgyu can nyid du des mkhyen to/ /long bas gzugs ni mi rig cing / /mig ni blo yis mi sbyor phyir/ /mig yod gyur na des spyor te/ /de phyir dbang po yod na reg /de nas skye mched drug gis phyeni/ /skye ba mkhyen phyir blo gros mdzad/ /de nas de'i rgyu ming dang gzugs/ /rgyu la mkhas pas mkhyen pa'o/ /ji ltar myu gu yod pa las/ /lo ma sdong bu 'byung bar dran/ /de ltar ming dang gzugs yod na/ /skye mched drug ni 'byung ba'o/ /ming dang gzugs ni 6rgyu gang zhes/ /de yi de nas gyur de nas/ /de yi skye ba rnam shes su / /ye shes pha rol son pas mkhyen/ / 3rnam par shes pa 'das pa na/ /ming dang gzugs ni rab snyeganas te/ /sa bon bskrun pa rdzogs pa na/ /myu gu rnam par 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas rnam par shes pa ni/ /gang las yin zhes bsams 9par gyur/ /ming dang gzugs la brten nas de/ /de nas de yi skye ba mkhyen/ /de nas rgyu yi go rims ni/ /mkhyen nas de yi blor gyur te/ /96—132

sems ni lugs 'byung bskor ba ste/ /gzhan du lugs las zlog 47par min/ /rnam par shes pa'i rkyen las ni/ /thuming dang gzugs la brten nas ni/ /slar yang rnam par shes pa skye/ /ji ltar gru yis mi 'dren zhing / /de bzhin rnam par shes pa dang / /ming gzugs phan tshun gyi rgyu'o/ /ji ltar lcags ni 'bar ba yis/ /rtswa 1 rnams 'bar bar byed na yang / /'bar ba de yis de gdung ste/ /de bzhin phan tshun rgyu nyid do/ /de ltar rnam par shes pa las/ /ming gzugs 'byung ba mkhyen gyur pa/ /de nas dbang po 'byung 'gyur zhing / /dbang po las byung cho reg pa'o/ /reg pa las skyes tshor ba mkhyen/ /tshor ba las skyes sred pa'o/ /sred pa las skyes len pa'o/ /len pa las ni de bzhin srid / /srid pa las ni skye ba dag /skye bas sarga shi 'byung bar mkhyen/ /'gro ba dag ni rkyen rnams las/ /skyes zhes yang dag mkhyen pa'o/ /de nas 'di yi blo gros nges par song ba ni/ /skye ba zad las 'chi dang rga ba 'gags pa ste / /srid pa nyams pa las kyang 3skye ba nyams pa nyid/ /len pa 'gags pa las ni srid pa rnam ldog cing dz+wa/ /de nas srid 'gags pa las de ni 'gag pa ste / /tshor ba yod pa min na sred pa yod ma yin/ /reg las chud zos gyur na tshor ba yod min zhing / /skye mched 'jug pa med las reg pa zad pa'o/ /de bzhin ming dang gzugs ni yang dag 'gags pa las/ /skye mched drug po thams cad rnam par nyams par byed —/ /rnam par shes pa 'gags las de dag 'gags pa ste/ /'du byed 'gags pa las kyang de ni 'gag pa'o/ /ma rig pa ni mtha' dag med las de bzhin du/ /'du byed 'gag par drang srong chen pos mkhyen pa ste/ /'di las mkhyen bya 'di ni yang dag mkhyen mdzad nas//96—133

sangs rgyas zhes ni 'jig rten na rab gnas par gyur/ /yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa rab tu shar ba yi/ /rtse mor myur 'gro dam pa'i lta ba'i lam gyis ni/ /srid rtse'i bar las mchog gyur bdag med rnam hūṃgazigs nas/ /bud shing tshig pa'i me bzhin zhi bar gshegs par gyur/ /de nas bdag nyid mdzad pa de yi gyur pa ni/ /mchog gi drang srong mchog dang mchog min mkhyen pa'i tshogs/ /gna' —ma rnams kyis byedon dam rgyu las gshegs pa yi/ /snying po'i lam 'di bdag gis lhag par thob par gyur/ /thun ni bzhi pa'i skya rengs shar ba'i yud tsam na/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'byung po rnams ni zhi ba na/ /drang srong mchog gis 'gyur ba med pa'i go 'phang dang / /kun gyi mgon gyis thams cad mkhyen pa nyid brnyes so/ /de nyid 'di ni sangs rgyas nyid kyis mkhyen pa na/ /bud med chang gis myos bzhin sa ni g.yos gyur la/ /grub pa rnams kyis mngon gang phyogs ni rab snang ste/ / mkha' la rnga bo che rnams rab tu grag par gyur/ /dge ba'i rlung rnams rab tu zhi bar g.yos gyur zhing me/ /sprin med 'o ma rnams ni lha yis char phab ste/ /ljon shing rnams la 5dus min me tog 'bras bu rnams/ /mchod pa rab tu spyor ba'i ched bzhin brul bar gyur/ /man dā ra ba'i me tog rnams dang pad+ma dang / /gser dang bai ḍūr+ya yi rang bzhin pad+ma ni/ /mkha' las bab pa rnams kyis shākya thub pa'i sa/ /de tshe mtho ris bzhin du kun nas bkram par gyur/ /yud tsam de ni kha cig khro ba sked gyur la/ /nad med gyur zhing mi dga' bar yang ma song ste/ /sdig pa bsnyen pa ma yin rgyags par ma byas shing / /grub pa brnyes pa bzhin du 'jig rten zhi bar gyur/ /thar pa 'dod pa'i lha yi tshogs rnams dga' ba ste/ /sems can 'og tu song ba rnams 96—134

kyang dga' bar gyur/ /yon tan phyogs kyis 'phel bas chos ni rgyas pa ste/ /rdul dang mun pa dag las 'gro ba gyen du byung / /de yi las kyis ya mtshan dga' bas gang ba yi/ /bu ram shing pa'i rigs kyi mi skyong drang srong rnams/ /rgyal po'i drang srong rnams dang drang srong che rnams kyis/ /yang dag mchod rnams mkha' la gzhal med rnams su gnas/ /mthong min 'byung po'i tshogs kyis hūṃdrang srong chen po yi/ /ston 3pa rnams ni mthon por 'thon 71zhing sgogs pa ste/ /gson pa'i 'jig rten 'phel ba bzhin du dga' gyur zhing / /rtsang ba mchog la bzhin du bdud ni yi myug cing 4/ /de nas nad mi mnga' ba zhag bdun bdag nyid kyisasde/ /sems la gzigs shing spyan mi 'dzums par bzhugs pa ste/ /kho bos 'dir ni rnam par thar pa brnyes so zhes/ /thub pas yid la re ba yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ /de nas rkyen nyid thob pa 'di ni thub pa nyid/ /bdag med cho gar rnam par gzhag pas gsan nas ni/ /zhi phyir 'jig rten dag la mchog tu brtse bas so/ /sangs rgyas spyan kyis rnam par gzigs par gyur pa'o/ /lta ba ngan pas chud zos 'bad la 'khrugs pa yi//'gro ba rdul ni rgya chen dang ldan gzigs nas dang / /rnam thar chos ni mchog tu phra ba nyid gzigs nas/ /g.yo ba med pa nyid phyir thugs ni mdzad par gyur//de nas sngon gyi dam bca' yang dag mkhyen gyur nas/ /zhi ba'i gdams pa la ni so sor nges par gshegs/ /de nas chen po'i rdul dang chung ngu'i rdul nyid dang //ldan pa'i skye bor yid ni rnam par dpyad pa'o/ /de nas zhi ba'i don du gdams pa'i ched du nges par ni/ /gzung ba'i bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs ni shes gyur nas/ /mngon par snang zhing 'gro la phan par 'dod pa can/ /mtho ris 96—135

gnas pa'i gtso bo nyid gyeni nye bar 'ongs/ /sdig pa spangs shing don mdzad gdan la bzhugs pa po'/ /mchog gi chos ni gzigs pa de la mchog gnyis so//mchog tu zhi bas rab tu bstod nas de gnyis kyis/ /'jig rten phan pa'i don du tshig 'di gsol ba'o/ /e ma 'gro ba 'di gang nor 'os 'di lta bu/ /skye dgu rnams la rjes su bste mdzad spyod kyi thugs/ /'jig rten na yod skye bo rnam par —bsre ma'i rgyu/ /chen po'i rdul dang nyung ngu'i rdul nyid ldan pa'o/ /thub pa srid pa'i mtsho las rang nyid rab rgal d+nghanas/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal bying ba rab tu drongs mdzod cig /legs pa'i dbang phyug gis ni phun sum tshogs pa thob nas bzhin/ /gzhan rnams la yang rang gi yon tan gyis sbyor mdzod/ /don mkhyen 'di na'i don dang pha rol du 'am gang / /skye bo kha sbug 'di na sa bdag gi phan pa byed/ /gang zhig 'jig rten dge ba'i ched du rab zhugs de/bye //mi yi 'jig rten dang ni mtho ris su rnyed dka'/ /de ltar drang srong che la tshig 'di gsol nas ni/ /lha na gnas pa de gnyis 7ji ltar 'ongs par gshegs/ /thub pa yis kyang de yi 8tshig de rab mnod nas/ /'gro ba rnam par thar phyir nges par rgyas par mdzad/ /de nas bsod snyoms dus su phyogs bzhir drang srong la/ /lha na gnas pas lhung bzed rnams ni phul ba ste/ /go ta mas bzhi po de rnams rab bzhes nas/ /de yi chos kyi ched du gcig nyid mdzad pa'o/ /de nas de tshe don bcas rab song tshong dpon gnyis/ /mdza' bshes nyid kyis lha yis rab tu bskul ba dag /rgya chen thugs mnga' drang srong che la thog ma ru/ /dga' ba dang ldan phyag byas nas ni bsod snyoms phul/ /rtsibs 'phur dang ni rangs byed bu ste de gnyis ni/ /chos 'dzin nus pa'i blo gros thub pas gzigs 96—136

pa ste/ /de gnyis lha na gshegs par thugs kyis mngon gzigs nas/ /dge slong lnga po rnams la thugs kyis gshegs pa'o/ /de nas zhi ba'i gdams pa las ni go ta mas/ /nyi ma shar bas mun bzhin myun pa rnam 'joms phyir/ / bā rā ṇa sbos /snabargyan pa'i sna tshogs nags tshal can/ /'jigs byed shing rtas bsnyen pa'i grong khyer dge bar gshegs/ /de nas khyu mchog 'dra ba'i spyan mnga' glang chen myos pa'i 'gros ldan pa/ /'gro ba mngon par rnam par 'dus phyir kā shi sa la gshegs bzhed pa/ /glang chen bzhin du rang gi sku lus ma lus phyir la rab log nas/ /thub pas spyan mig mi 'dzums /byepar ni byang chub shing gi rtsa bar gzigs / /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //zhi zhing mdangs ldan mdzad pa kun nas brnyes pa de/ /gcig pur rab gshegs mang po dang ni thabs cig bzhin/ /lam na dge slong chos ldan kha cig gis mthong nas/ /ya mtshan dang bcas thal mor bcas pas 'di skad gsol/ /dbang po'i rta ni g.yo bar dbang po'i rta thul zhing / /sems can chags rnams ji ltar chags ma gyur/ /shin tu ro ldan gsar pa'i shes rab ro yis ni/ /ri bong gis mtshon 1dang mtshungs tshim par gyur pa rnams/ /brtan pa khyod kyi zhal ni ji ltar 4rab rgyas shing / /'dir ni dbang po rnams kyi phyedabang phyug mdzad pa ste/ /khyu mchog chen po'i spyan mnga' nges par don mdzad cing / /khyod kyi bla ma su lags gang las grub pa gsungs/ /de rnams la dudes smras pa bdag la ston pa med/ /bdag la mchod bya med cing smad bya su yang ⑦ med/ /96—137

mya ngan 'das pa thob cing gzhan rnams dang mi mnyam/ /bdag ni chos la rang byung du ni shes par mdzod/ /gang phyir gzhan rnams kyis ma rtogs pa'i rtogs bya ni/ /bdag gis mtha' dag rtogs pa de phyir sangs rgyas te/ /gang phyir bdag gi khyon mongs rnams ni dgra bzhin 'phamalku/ /de phyir zhi ba dag ni kun nas shes par mdzod/ /sdug bsngal rnams kyis nyam thag grogs la phan don du/ /zhi ba kho bo 'di yang bā rā ṇa sīr 3sna'agro/ /der ni 'chi med chos kyi ༄ 7rnga dag rdung ba ste/ /snyan grags bde ba'i phyir min nga rgyal phyir ma yin/ /rgal bas 'gro ba rnams ni rgal bar 'gyur bgyi zhing / /grol bas sems can rnams ni yongs su thar bar bgyi/ /de ltar gson pa'i 'jig rten nyam thag par mthong nas / /sngon du bdag gi dam bca' 'di ni gyur pa'o/ /'di na kha cig nor ni thob nas bdag nyid ni/ /gcig tu nyid kyang 5'dzin par byed pa ngo mtshar cing / /skye bo chen po ma btsums 5mig la gang gis kyang / /khyad 'phags thob nas rnam par 'dzin pa de don yin/ /gang zhig skam la gnas pas mi ni chus khyer ba/ /'dren par 'dod min de ni legs pa'i gzugs ma yin/ /gang zhig gter ni thob nas skye bo dbul po la/ /nor gyi dz+wasbyor ba med pa de ni spyang po min/ /rang bzhin gnas pas nad kyis mngon par bcom pa la/ /lag tu song ba'i sman gyis gso bar rigs pa ste/ /de ltar lam ngan song ba'i ched chodu lam dag ni/ /nges par byang peba'i lam gyis bshad par 'thad pa yin/ /ji ltar sgon ma rab tu gsal bar byed pa ste/ /de yi ⑩rgyu can dmar por 'gro ba ma yin nyid/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas nyid kyis ye shes rab gsal bar/ /mdzad de de phyir chags par 'gro ba ma yin no/ /ji ltar shing rnams la ni me ⑩ 96—138

dag nges pa dang / /mkha' la rlung dang sa la chu ni nges pa ste/ /de bzhin gang yang rnams su thub pa rnams kyis ni/ /byang chub nges shing kā shi rnams dang chos smra des/ /de nas nye bar 'ongs nas lku.a la la zhes pa/ /rnam par brjod nyanas ji ltar 'dod bzhin rab spangs nas/ /yang dang yang du ya mtshan mig ni g.yo ba yis/ /re 'dod skyes shing sangs rgyas la ni lta bzhin song / /de nas thub pas rim byis kā si'i grong khyer ni/ /nor gnas snying po dang ni rab mtshungs gzigs pa ste/ /grogs mo bzhin du 'khyud nas yang dag 'dus pa ni / /skal ldan shing rta dang ni bā rā ṇa sī ④nyid/ /mthu dang gzi brjid dag gis mngon par mdzes pa des/ /khu byug rnams kyis sgra sgrogs shing gi tshogs ldan zhing / /drang srong chen pos bsnyen pa'i ri dwags nags nyid du/ /rnam par mdzes pas nyi ma bzhin du rab 'thob 5po/ /kauṇ+ḍi n+ya'i rigs dang de nas ming chen dang / /rlangs pa dang ni rta thul de bzhin bzang rgyal te/ /dge slong lnga yis de ni rgyang ring nas gzigs nas/ /phan tshun du ni tshig 'di smras par gyur pa'o/ /bde ba'i bdag nyid dge slong go ta ma 'di/ /dka' thub de las phyir log mngon par 'ongs pa ste/ /mngon du 'gro bya ma yin nges par phyag 'os min/ /dam bca' bcom pa mchod par 'os pa ma yin no/ /de ni brgya la gal te sdod par 'dod gyur na/ /de nyid la ni gtam 'di 3 rab tu gsol mdzod dang / /'gron po nye bar 'ongs pa gang dang su la ni/ /'phags pa rnams kyis mi byed par ni 'os ma yin/ /de ltar bya ba byas nas dge slong de rnams ni/ /nye bar gnas pa'i nye bar sangs rgyas gshegs pa ste/ /ji lta ji ltar de rnams la ni nye bar gshegs/ /de lta de ltar de rnams dam 96—139

bca' nyams par gyur/ /de nas kha cig 'di yi na bza' blangs ⑨pa ste/ /de bzhin gzhan ni phyag 'tshal nas ni lhung bzed bzung / /kha cig 'di la 'os pa'i gdan ni phul ba ste/ /de bzhin gzhan gnyis zhabs bsil nye bar phul ba'o / /de ltar rab byed mchod pa mang po ldan pa rnams/ /'di la thams cad kyis ni bla mar spyod pa byas/ /rigs su mngon brjod de rnams kyis kyang ma spangs shing / /de rnams la rjes brtse bcas bcom ldan gyis smras pa/ /mchod 'os dgra bcom la ni gus pa ma yin pas/ /sngar gyi 3spyod pas dge slong rnams kye ma smra shig /bstod dang smad pa nges par bdag gis mnyam pa ste/ /khyed rnams bsod nams min las rnam par bzlog ④par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten phan pa'i ched du sangs rgyas shing / /'byung po kun la phan pas rab tu zhugs pa la/ /bla ma nye bar 'joms las ming gis gang smras demu/ /ma rungs pa yi pha ma bzhin du chos 'chad do/ /de ltar drang srong chen po'i khuthugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /smra ba rnams kyi mchog gis de skad gsungs pa ste/ /rmongs las snying po med pas chud zos de rnams kyis/ /gdong ni cung zad bzhad pa dang ldan rgol ba —smras pa'o/ /gau ta ma re zhig dka' thub mchog dang ni / /dam pa de yis de nyid rtogs pa ma yin te/ /don ni dga' bas bsgrub bya bde bas gnas pa'o/ /khyed kyis mthong zhes bya ba 'dir ni gtan tshigs gang / /gang tshe de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i de nyid la/ /de nas dge slong de rnams dad par gyur min te/ /byang chub pa yi lam ni de las gzhan du shes/ /de nas lam mkhyen pa yis kyelam ni bka' stsal pa/ /byis pa'i skye bo bdag nyid ngal bar ldan pa dang / /dbang po'i spyod yul rnams la 96—140

de bzhin chags pa ste/ /'chi ba med pa'i lung gis lkulam ma yin pa'i phyogs/ /skyon dang ldan pa gnyis po de la ltos mdzod cig5 /gdung bar mngon par brjod pa'i lus kyi ngal rnams kyis/ /yongs su 'khrugs shing rnam par gnod pa'i sems la ni/ /'jig rten tha snyad kyang ni brgya la shes min na1/ /dbang po las 'das de nyid lam ni kye ma ci/ /ji ltar sgon mas mtshan mo'i mun pa nyams pa ru/ /'dir ni mngon par nyer 'asngo chu rnams gtor bas min/ /de bzhin ye shes me yis mi shes mun pa ni / / nyams par sngon 'gro lus kyi ngal ba rnams kyis min/ /ji ltar me ni 'dod pas shing la 'bigs pa dang / /rnam par 'gems pas me ni thob pa ma yin la/ /de nyid mngon pa'i thabs las bsrubs pas thob pa ste/ /de bzhin spyor las 'chi ba med thob ngal bas shemin//de ltar don med 'dod pa rnams la chags pa ni/ /rdul dang mun pa dag gis zil non sems ldan rnams/ /bstan bcos don la nus kyang grub pa thob min na / /chags bral 'gog pa'i cho ga la ni sngon nyid do/ /ji ltar nad kyis mngon par bcom pa'i srog chags kyis/ /mi phan bza' ba za ba'i gso ba 'dir yod min/ /de bzhin mi shes nad kyis mngon par bcom pa yi gye /'dod pa rnams la chags pa'i zhi ba gang las so/ /ji ltar skam pa'i thurten la gnas pa'i rlung gis ni/ /bus pa'i me yi zhi ba yod pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin 'dod pa'i rten la gnas pa'i chags pa yis/ /rjes su song ba'i sems kyi zhi ba yod ma yin/ /mtha' 'di gnyis po byedag kyang rnam par dor byas nas/ /bdag gis lam gzhan dbu mas lhag par rtogs tsu7pa ste/ /shin tu sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i 'dren pa po⑩/ /bde ba dang ni dge ba nyid dang bral ba'o/ /96—141

yang dag lta ba'i nyi mas rab tu gsal byas shing / /rnam dag yang dag rtogs pa'i shing rtas drangs pa ste/ /yang dag brjod pa'i yang dag dag ni gtsug lag khang / /dge ba'i bya ba'i skyed tshal brgya phrag mngon par dga'/ /smad pa med pa'i 'tsho ba lo legs chen po ste/ /yang dag rtsol bas stobs rab rjes su 'gro ba can/ /kun du yang dag dran pa'i sbas pas sbas pa ste/ /ting 'dzin gzims hūṃsna mal dang ni gdan dang khyab 7 pa yis/ /de ltar mchog gi yan lag brgyad 'dir 'di lam ste/ /'chi dang rga dang na ba rnams las 'dren pa po shā/ /gang la drangs nas bya ba thams cad byas pa ste/ /'di dang che ge mor ni be+en chad 'gro ba med/ /'di ni snyug bsngal mtha' dag 'di ni mtshan ma ste/ /'di ni 'gog pa 'di yi lam ni 'di yin te/ /de ltar ma thos chos kyi cho ga sngar med pa'i/ /rnam par mthar phyin jebadag gi spyan mig skye ba'o5/ /skye dang rga dang na dang de nas rgud pa dang / /sdug pa dang bral mi sdug pa la sbyor ba dang //'dod pa'i don ni rab tu 'thob 7pa med pa ste/ /rnam pa sna tshogs snyug bsngal 'di ni yongs su 'thob/ /'dod pa'i bdag can gyi 'am bdag rgyal can gyi 'am / /lus can gyi 'am yang na lus can ma yin pa'i/ /gang zhig yon tan med pa gang la rab zhugs kyang / /mdor bsdus nas de sdug bsngal du ni shes par mdzod/ /de ltar 'bar ba zhi ba'i me ni chung na yang / /lhan cig skyes pa dro ba'i ngo bo spong min nyid/ /de bzhin bdag tu 'du shes zhi sogs kyis phra yang / /sdug bsngal bdag nyid can zhes bdag gi choshin tu nges/ /ji ltar sa chu sa bon dus rnams myu gu'i bzhin/ /'dod chags la sogs rnam pa sna tshogs skyon rnams dang / /skyon las rab tu skyes pa'i las rnams nyid dag ni/ /96—142

sdug bsngal dag gi rgyur ni nges par shes par mdzod/ /mtho ris su 'am 'og tu srid pa'i rgyun las ni/ /'dod chags la sogs skyon gyi tshogs rnams rgyu yin zhing / /dman dang 'bring dang mchog ste sna tshogs nyid kyi ni/ /de dang der ni las rnams dag ni rtsa ba'o/ /nyes pa zad las 'khor ba'i rgyun sna/ni yod min te / /las zad pa las sdug bsngal de ni yod ma yin/ /gang phyir don gang yod pa las ni kun 'byung ste/ /de phyir med pa las te slar yang 'byung ba med/ /gang du skye ba med cing rga med 'chi ba med/ /me med sa med chu med mkha' med rlung med la/ /thog ma bar dang mtha' med 'phags pa dbrog bya min/ /dge zhing 'gyur rnged 'gog pa de ni shes par mdzod/ /yan lag brgyad ldan gang zhig mngon brjod de lam ste/ /lhag par rtogs phyir 'di yi thabs de'i gzhan ma yin/ /lam 'di yin na ma mthong ba las 'jig rten rnams/ /de nyid dang ni nye du rnams ni yongs su 'khor/ /sdug bsngal yongs su shes par bya zhing rgyu 'di ni/ /spang bya 'gog pa yang ni dbang du bya ba'o/ /de bzhin lam 'di yang ni bsgom par bya ba ste/ /de ltar 'di ni bdag gi blo gros rab zhugs so/ /sdug bsngal 'di ni yongs shes rgyu ni spangs pa ste/ /de bzhin du ni 'gog pa mngon du byas pa'o/ /de bzhin du ni 'di yi lam 'di bsgoms pa ste/ /de ltar 'dir ni bdag gi spyan mig rab zhugs so/ /ji srid du ni yang dag 'phags pa'i bden pa ni/ /bzhi pa'i rkang pa 'di rnams mthong ba ma yin pa/ /de srid bdag 'dir grol ba med pa thuzhes brjod cing / /bdag nyid la ni don byas nyid du yang ma mthong / /gang tshe 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni rtogs pa ste / /rtogs byas ④ kyang ni dor chobyar 'os pa byas pa'o/ /de tshe bdag 'dir 96—143

rnam par grol zhes brjod pa ste/ /bdag nyid la ni don byas nyid du yang mthong ngo / /de ltar drang srong chen po thugs rje mnga' ba yis ṭ+wā/ /'dir ni chos dag de skad mngon par gsungs pa na/ /kauṇ+ḍi n+ya'i rigs dang lha ni brgya phrag rnamasaske/ /gtsang zhing rdul dang bral ba'i mig ni thob par gyur bye/ /bya ba thams cad nges par byas shing zhi ba de la ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pas khyu mchog bzhin du mthon po'i dbyangs kyis gsungs/ /khyod kyis shes 1shes bdag nyid chen po ④ des ni tshig gsol pa/ /legs so khyod kyi blo gros mchog ni bdag gis shes pa'o/ /legs so bdag gis shes shes de nas des ni 'jig rten ni/ /kauṇ+ḍi n+yas de yi go 'phang rigs ni bzung ba ste/ /bla ma dam pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i cheslob ma rnams kyis ni/ /gtso bo nyid du chos la yang dag lhag par gshegs pa'o/ /sgra de sa la rgyu ba'i gnod sbyin rnams kyis thos nas ni/ /rnam par rgyas pa'i dbyangs 'di 9rab tu gsol bar gyur pa ste/ /'byung po rnams kyi 'chi med zhi ba'i ched du nges par ni/ /dam pa gzigs pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de legs so/ /tshul khrims rtsibs dang zhi dang dul ba'i mu khyud blo rnams yangs/ /dran pas blo gros brtan pa brtson 'grus lta ba ngo tsha'i gzer / /zab pa'i phyir dang brdzun gesnamed phyir dang legs par bstan nyid phyir—/ /'jig rten gsum na brtan byezhing bstan bcos gzhan rnams kyis mi ldog /sa 'dzin gnod sbyin rnams las sgra ni nye bar thob byas nas/ /mkha' la lha yi tshogs rnams kyis ni dbyangs byas shing / /de ltar thos nas mtho ris rim dang rim rnams kyis mthon por/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bar du sgra yis nye bar 'dzegs pa'o/ /mtho ris dag na gnas pa'i bdag nyid ldan pa kha cig 96—144
