gis—/ /drang srong che las 'jig rten gsum ni g.yo 7zhes thos nas ni/ /sna tshogs yul rnams la ni chags par gshegs pa ma yin zhing / /yang dag skyo las srid pa gsum na zhi ba nyid du gshegs/ /de ltar 'jig rten rnams kyi mchog tu zhi ba'i ched du ni/ /mtho ris dang ni sa na chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tsam na— / /sprin bral mkha' las me tog dang bcas chu yi char bab cing / /srid gsum gnas pa rnams kyis rnga bo che rnams mngon par brdungs/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o// //de nas thams cad mkhyen pa yis/ /rta thul la sogs dge slong rnams/ /rab snyems sems ldan de rnams kun/ /thar pa'i chos la bkod pa'o/ /nyi ma dang ldan skar ma lngas/ /nam mkhar zla ba ldan pa bzhin/ /lnga sde pham 4 pa'i lnga sde yis/ /kun nas bskor ba de mdzes so/ /de nas de tshe kha cig ni/ /mo rnams glos 5phab nyal mthong nas/ /grags pa zhes bya chen po'i bu/ /yang dag skyo bar nye bar song / /'di kun nye bar mdzes pa ste/ /zhes ni tshig dang brjod bzhin du/ /dpal ldan mchog gi rgyan ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas ga la ba der song / /sems dang nyon mongs mkhyen pas de3/ /gzigs nas de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /mya ngan 'das la nyer 'tshe 8med/ /tshur shog dge ba thob par gyis/ /de ltar rnam rgyas grags pa'i gsung / /'di ni thos nas tsha shesnab yis/ /nyam thag chu la 'dzul nas dang / /mchog tu tshim pa nye bar 'ong ⑩ / /sngon gyi rgyu yi stobs brten nas/ /de nas lus de nyid bzung ste/ /96—145

lus kyis dang ni sems kyis ni/ /dgra bcom nyid ni nye bar thob/ /ston ka'i chu yis bkrus pa yi rmye/ /gos la tshon ni bkod pa bzhin/ /dkar po'i blo yis 1dam pa'i chos/ /thos nas rab tu rtogs pa nyid/ /cha lugs de yis hūṃngo tsha bzhin/ /gnas pa de ni gzigs gyur na/ /don mdzad dam pa'i don mkhyen pa/ /smra ba rnams kyi mchog gis smras/ /rtags ni chos kyi rgyu min zhing //'byung po rnams la snyoms pa ste/ /zhi zhing dul la dbang po dul/ /brgyan pa yin yang chos la spyod/ /gang zhig lus ni 'thon pa ceste/ /sems kyis 'thon pa ma yin pa/ /nags na gnas kyang chags pa can/ /khyim na gnas shes de shes bya/ /gang zhig sems ni 'thon 5pa ste/ /lus kyis 'thon pa ma yin pa//khyem na gnas kyang nga med pa/ /nags na gnas shes de shes bya/ /khyim na gnas par gyur pa'i lam3/ /rab tu byung bar gyur pa'i yang / /gang gis bsgrub pa yod na ni/ /de yi thar pa mngon par brjod/ /ji ltar rgyal 'dod dgra sde la/ /rgyal phyir go cha 'dzin pa ste/ /de bzhin nyon mongs dgra de la/ /rgyal phyir rtags 9ni 'dren pa'o/ /de nas dge slong tshur shog ces/ /de bzhin gshegs pas de la gsungs/ /des ni dge slong rtags bzung ste/ /skad cig de nyid kyis grol to/ /de nas de yi rjes chags pas/ /de yi 'khor ni lnga bcu dang / /gsum rnams nyid dang gcig nyid dang / /chos de rab tu thob par gyurati/ /'dag chal gyis bsgos gos rnams ni/ /chu yis /1yang dag reg pa bzhin/ /sngon tshe bsgoms pa'i las can rnams/ /de rnams myur du dag par gyur/ /de nas de tshe dgra bcom slob ma yi8/ /dang po don byas nyu5drug cu thams cad la/ /dgra bcom rnams kyis mngon mchod dgra bcom pas/ /96—146

ji ltar 'os par yang dag bka' stsal to/ /dge slong rnams kyis kye7sdug bsngal rgal / /rang gi bya ba legs chen byas/ /pha rol sdug bsngal rnams la yang / /rjes su 'dzin par sne/byed pa'i rigs/ /de phyir re re thams cad kyis/ /sa 'dir yongs su gshegs mdzod la/ /nyam thag 'jig rten ched du chos/ /rjes su brtse bas snyebastan par bya/ /grub phyir rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i spun/ /'od srungs drang srong rnams 'dul phyir/ /rgyal po'i drang srong gis bsnyen pa'i/ /ga yar kho bo 'di yang 'gro/ /de nas de nyid mthong de rnams/ /de yi bka' las phyogs su song / /rtsod bral bde bar gshegs pa ni/ /drang srong che yang ga yar gshegs/ /de nas dus su der gshegs nas/ /chos kyi dgon par sngu nye bar gshegs/ /dka' thub dngos su gnas pa bzhin/ /der ni 'od srungs gzigs pa'o/ /ri rnams dang ni nags rnams su/ /gnas rnams yod pa na yang de/ /rnam par 'dul bzhed stobs bcu pas/ /rab tu brten nas bslangs sapa'o/ /de nas grub pa nyams tshad phyir/ /me khang lto 'phye ches bsnyen par/ /ma rungs gnas des 'di la byin/ /der gzims mtshan mor rang gnas shing / /ltos bral thub pa chen po la/ /mthong ba'i dug can khros pa yi/ /sgrul des mthong nas dbugs phyung ngo / /de yi khro bas 'bar ba yi /me yi khang par gyur pa des/ /drang srong chen po'i sku lus la/ /'jigs pa bzhin du mes ma reg /dus mtha'i me nyer zhi ba na/ /tshangs pa bzhugs pa mdzes pa ltar/ /me yi khang par bsregs na yang / /go ta ma rnam 6'gyur med/ /gang tshe sangs rgyas der bzhugs tshe/ /gnod med g.yo ba med pa ste/ /de tshe klu de ya mtshan zhing / /drang srong mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ri dwags nags 96—147

der skye bo yis tsho/ /thub pa der bzhugs shes gyur nas/ / srugs pa 'o brgyal ༄ 'di 'dra ba'i/ /dge slong tshig ces rjes su brtse/ /de nas mtshan mo 'das pa na/ /rnam par 'dren pas 'od srungs la/ /sbrul ni zhi bas lhung bzed kyis/ /blangs nas de la bstan pa'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas che bdag nyid / /thos nas de ni ya mtshan gyur/ /de lta na yang bdag nyid kyis/ /che zhing gong na med pa snyam/ /de nas dus su rab sbyar ba'i/ /sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul gzugs rnams kyis/ /de yi sems de mkhyen nyid las/ /zhi ldan thub pas thugs dgongs mdzad/ /ji ltar bdag las rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /sangs rgyas khyad par 'phags pa snyam/ /de yi chos ni rab sgrub 4phyir/ /de tshe nges ni nges par byas/ /kun nas slar log gnas pa yis/ /lteng rgyas 'od srungs mthong nas ni/ /slob ma ༄rnams kyi tshogs rnams kyang / /lnga brgyas de yi chos la bsnyen/ /der ni spun zla slob mar bcas/ /mthar phyin shun lpags spangs pa na/ /ga ya chu klung zhes byas kyang / /der song lam la bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas thub pas slob mar bcas/ /'od srungs gsum po de rnams la/ /sa 'dzin ga ya'i rtse mor ni/ /nges par mthar phyin gtam mdzad do/ /rnam par rtog 6pa'i skye gnas dang / /gti mug rnam bkram du ba can/ /chags sdang me yis dz+wa'agro ba ni/ /thams cad dbang med par bsreg go/ /de ltar 3snanyon mongs mes tshig cing / /rab tu ma zhi mgon med can/ /rga na 'chi ba'i me rnams kyis/ /slar yang rgyun mi chad par sreg /rnam pa sna tshogs mes tshig pa'i / /'gro ba skyabs med 'di mthong nas/ /yid bcas dbang po dang bcas pa'i/ /gzugs la blo ldan skyo ba ste/ /skyo ba las ni chags bral rorngu / /96—148

chags bral las ni rnam grol zhing / /rnam grol de nas thams cad na/ /rnam par grol zhes shes pa'o/ /skye ba'i rgyun ni yongs 'dzad cing / /tshangs pa'i spyod pa 'dir gnas la/ /byed pa thams cad byas pa ste/ /sred pa gzhan ni yod ma yin/ /bcom ldan gyi gsung 'di thos nas/ /dge slong stong phrag dag gi sems/ /len pa med nas zag pa las/ /de ma thag tu rnam par grol/ /sbyin pa tshul khrims dul rnams kyis/ /chos ni yongs 4su yongs bskor bzhin/ /de nas shes rab rgya che ba'i/ /'od srungs gsum gyis sangs rgyas mdzes/ /chos don 'dod pa dang bral ba'i/ /sems can ngan pa'i nasrog bzhin du/ /bgres mchog de rnams kyis bor ba'i/ /dka' thub nags de mdzes ma gyur/ /de nas de rnams kyis yongs bskor/ /thub pa rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs/ /ma ga dh+wa yi mi dbang phyir/ /sngon gyi dam bca' dran pa'o/ /de nas 'od ma'i tshal yul ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu thob/ /blon bo rnams ni rjes 'gro bas/ /thos nas rgyas po sngon 1du song / /de nas rang gi skal mtshungs pa'i / /rkang pa bzhon 4pas skye bo ni/ /ya mtshan gyes ni rnam yangs mig /ri yi lam nas phyi rol byung / /ma ga jo yi mi dbang gis/ /thub mchog rgyang ma nas mthong nas/ /skyen pa dang bcas mchod pa'i phyir/ /shing rta las ni sa la babs/ /des ni rnga yab rlung yab dang / /rjes su 'brang ba rnam hūṃspangs nas/ /tshangs pa la ni dbang pos bzhin/ /thub pa 6rgyal po sngon du song / /cod pan rab g.yo mgo bo dz+wayis/ /drang srong mchog la phyag 'tshal nas / /sa yi logs la rtswa — 'jam la/ /mngon par rjes gnang bsdad pa'o/ /der mi rnams kyis bsams par /gyur/ /e ma shākya thub pa'i stobs/ /'od 96—149

srungs bcom ldan drang srong ni/ /'di yi slob ma nyid du song phya/ /de nas de'i sems sangs rgyas kyis/ /mkhyen nas 'od srungs la smras pa/ /'od srungs yon tan gang mthong nas/ /khyed kyis byeme ni spangs pa'o/ /chu sbyin chen po'i dbyangs kyis ni/ /bla mas de ltar de bskul te/ /mthon pos skye bo kun khyab par/ /thal mo sbyar zhing rnam par gsol/ /gang phyir mchod dang sbyin sreg giri/ /'bras bu yongs su 'khor ba ste/ /sems nad sna tshogs dang ldan te/ /de phyir me rnams bdag gis spangs/ /gang phyir yul la skom pa yis / /bzlas dang sbyin sreg la sogs 'jug /yul rnams dag gis skom pa med / /de phyir me rnams bdag gis spangs/ /gang phyir bzlas nas bsregs ye nas kyang / /skye ba la ni thar min zhing / /skye ba yi ni sdug bsngal che/ /de phyir me rnams bdag gis spangs/ /gang phyir mchod sbyin dka' thub kyis/ /dge legs yin zhes yid gyur pa5/ /de ni brdzun pa nyid yin te/ /de phyir me rnams bdag gis spangs/ /gang phyir skye 'chi las grol ba/ /'gyur med go 'phang dge bar ni/ /brjod pa bdag gis shes pa ste/ /de phyir me rnams bdag gis spangs/ /de ltar de'i tshig dad skyed cing / /don dang ldan pas 3 gsan gyur nas/ /'dul ba'i slob dpon go ta mas/ /dul ba'i 'od srungs la gsungs so/ /skal chen khyod ni legs par 'ongs/ /'di ni legs byas byas min min/ /gang khyod tha dad chos rnams su/ /dge legs gang de nye bar thob/ /de phyir re zhig 'khor rnams ni/ /rnam rgyas yang dag 'phel ba bzhin / /sna tshogs sdug bsngal bye 7ston bzhin du/ /yid ni yang dag skyo bar gyis / /de nas mchog ces smras nas ni/ /bdag la bdag ni yongs bsdus 96—150

nas—/ /mkha' 'gro'i bya ltar 'od srungs ni/ /rlung gi lam la 'phur ba'o/ /de mkhar sdong dum bzhin gnas shing / /sa la bzhin du rnam par rgyu/ /khri la bzhin du bzhugs pa dang / /rdzu 'phrul mkhas pa gzims pa'o/ /be+er yang me bzhin 'bar ba dang / /slar yang sprin bzhin char 'bab ste/ /slar yang cig car shin tu ni/ /'bar ba dang ni 'bab pa'o/ /glog gi snang ba'i 'od ldan pa'i—/ /rab 'bab chu gter sprin bzhin du/ /'bar ba dang ni 'bab pa yis—/ /rgya cher rnam par gnon te mdzes/ /der ni mig rnams chags byas nas / /ya mtshan gyen phyogs skye bo rnams/ /mchod mang po las phyag 'tshal zhing / /seng ge'i sgra ni sgogs pa'o/ /de nas rdzu 'phrul bsdus nas des/ /bya ba byas pa'i slob ma ni/ /bdag gi ston pa bcom ldan zhes/ /thub la mgo bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /drang srong mchog la de bzhin du/ /phyag 'tshal 'od srungs rab mthong nas/ /bde bar gshegs la kun mkhyen zhes/ /ma ga dh+wa pa rnam nges so/ /de nas zhing byas mkhyen nas ni/ /dge phyir dge legs la gnas pas/ /chos thos par ni 'dod pa yi/ /bzo sbyangs la ni bka' sprul pa//gzi chen ldan pa yid bcas shing / /dbang po thul ba dbang por bcas /sa yi bdag po gzugs nyid ni/ /skye ba dang ni rnam par nyams/ /yon tan 'phel phyir 'di yi ni/ /skye dang 'gag pa shes bya ste/ /shes nas de gnyis yang dag par/ /lus ni yang dag rig par mdzod/ /skye dang 'gag pa'i chos can du/ /dbang po dang bcas lus shes nas/ /bdag ldan bdag ces cung zhig ni/ /nye bar len min nyer 'gro min/ /lus dang dbang po blo rnams las//gzhan ni dmigs pa ma yin te/ /sdug bsngal 'di snani skye ba ste/ /sdug bsngal 96—151

nyid ni 'gag pa'o/ /gang tshe 'di kun mngon par 'gro/ /bdag med bdag gi ba yang med/ /de tshe mchog tu mi g.yo ba'i/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob pa'o /ngar 'dzin la sogs nyon mongs kyis/ /bdag tu 'dzin las 'ching ba ste/ /'jig rten bdag med par mthong na/ /chags pa rnams las rnam par grol/ /mi bden par mthong 'ching ba ste/ /bden par mthong ba rnam par grol/ /bdag yod ces ni 'jig rten 'dir/ /rab tu 'jug 'di bden min hūṃ'adzin/ /gal te bdag yod gyur na de/ /rtag gam yang na mi rtag nyid/ /phyogs ni gnyis po 'di dag la/ /nyes pa chen bo rab tu chags/ /gal te re zhig mi rtag gyur/ /las kyi 'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /yang srid yod pa ma yin zhing / /thar pa 'bad pa med par 'gyur/ /ci ste rtag cing khyab bdag tre 'gyur / /skye ba med dang skye ba min/ /nam mkha' khyab cing rtag pa ni/ /'god pa med cing skye ba med/ /gal te bdag 'di khyab bdag 'gyur/ /gang du mi gnas pa ma yin/ /'di dang song nas dang thar par/ /thams cad du rgo cig car 'gyur/ /khyab bdag nyid phyir bya med 'di'i/ /las kyi bya ba med par 'gyur/ /las rnams ma byas pa las ni/ /'bras bur sbyor bar gang gis 'gyur/ /gal te 'di yi byed par 'gyur/ /bdag gi sdug bsngal byed ma yin / /rang dbang gyur na sdug bsngal ni/ /bdag gis bdag gi byed pa su//bdag ni rtag pa nyid las ni/ /rnam par 'gyur ba skye min zhing / /bde dang sdug bsngal thob pa las/ /de yis rnam par 'gyur ba mthong / /ye shes thob pas dang nyon mongs/ /spangs las thar pa yod pa ste/ /bya ba chomed khyab bdag 'di yin5/ /de phyir thar pa yod ma yin/ /yod min gyur las de nyid 96—152

kyis / /bdag ste 'di ni brjod min la/ /rgyur gyur pas kyang ma yin zhing / /'di ni cung zad byed ma yin/ /bya ba las kyang gsal min zhing / /gang rnams kyis 'di byas min la/ /rnam pa de ltar gyur min smra/ /de phyir bdag gi yod ma yin/ /byed pa po med 'dir ni rig pa po yang med/ /bdag po med pa'i lus po 'di ni 'dren par byed/ /ji ltar 'khor ba'i chu bo rab tu bskor ba ste/ /smra ba de ni nyon mdzod nyan pa rnams kyi mchog /dbang po drug dang dbang po'i spyod yul drug rnams la/ /brten nas rnam par shes pa rnam drug 'char ba ste/ /gsum po so sor rig pa'i cho ga rab bskor zhing / /gang las dran dang blo dang las kyi 'jug par yin/ /nor bu bud shing nyi ma yang dag phrad pa las/ /ji ltar me ni sbyar ba'i dbang gis skye ba ste/ /de bzhin blo dang dbang don dbang po la brten nas/ /skyes bu la brten bya ba rnams ni thams cad 'gyur/ /ji ltar sa bon las ni myu gu skye ba ste/ /myu gu des na 1sa bon de ni shes min zhing / /gzhan las gzhan du ma yin de las de ma yin/ /de bzhin lus dang dbang po blo yi rim pa'o/ /de ltar thub pa mchog gi gsung ni mchog tu dge/ /dam pa'i don du bsngags pa yang dag thos nas ni/ /dri ma med pa'i rdul med gzhal du med pa'o/ /ma ga dh+wa 2yi bdag po chos mig skyes par gyur/ /'khor der ma ga dh+wa yi grong na gnas pa yi/ /mi ni du ma rnams dang lha na gnas pa rnams/ /thub pa'i gsung thob pa las rnam dag bsam ldan rnams/ /'gyur med 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ slob ma mang po dang ldan pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //96—153

de nas rgyal po des ni thub la rnam gnas phyir/ /dpal ldan nags tshal 'od ma'i tshal ni rab phul nas/ /de nyid khong du chud phyir kun nas dmigs kye pa ni/ /mngon par rjes gnang byas pa grong khyer la zhugs so/ /de nas gtsug lag khang der 'gro la phan pa'i phyir/ /ye shes las gyur dge ba'i sgon ma bsnams pa ste/ /tshangs dang lha dang de bzhin 'phags pa rnams kyi ni/ /gnas pa de dang de yis sangs rgyas rnam par gnas/ /de nas rta thul dbang po'i rta ni kun bsdams shing / /bsod snyems 'dod pas rgyal bo'i khab ni rab thob ste/ /gzugs kyis 2dang ni zhi ba yis dang rnam 'gyur gyis/ /skye bo chen po rnams kyi mig rnams phrogs par gyur/ /ser skya'i rigs kyi dge slong slob ma du ma can/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu zhes rab tu grags pa yis/ /dbang po zhi bar 'ongs pa de ni mthong ba ste/ /lam na rjes su gnas nas tshig ni mngon par smras/ /khyod kyi gsar pa'i rtags mtshan dang ni zhi ba nyid/ /mthong nas kho bo'i blo gros ya mtshan mchog gyur te/ /de phyir re zhig gal te de nyid rig pa dang / /khyod kyi ston pa'i mtshan ci smra ba gang yin sgos/ /de ltar mchod mang sngon 'gro bram ze de yis ni/ /de skad brjod cing rta thul gyis kyang smras pa ste/ /bu ram shing pa'i rigs su rab 'khrungs thams cad mkhyen/ /bdag gi ston pa bla na med pa shes par mdzod/ /byis pa gsar bu chos las skyes par gyur pa yis/ /khyod la ston pa brjod par nus pa ma yin tesnye/ /smras pa mkhyen pa'i mchog gyur thub pa chen po'i gsung nga/ /nyung ngu cung zad tsam zhig nges par rtogs par mdzod//gang zhig chos rnams mtshan ma las ni byung ba ste/ /de dag rnams kyi mtshan ma 96—154

bcom ldan gyis gsungs shing / /gang zhig de dag rnams kyis nges par 'gog pa dang / /yang dag 'gog pa de yi thabs gang gsungs pa'o/ /de ltar rta thul gyi hūṃni tshig 'di thos nas ni/ /gnyis skyes nyer rgyal zhes bya'i ming can de yi ni/ /skyen par chos la mig ni rdul dang bral ba ni/ /dge zhing rnam par dag par nges par gyur pa'o/ /rgyu med pa dang bya ba med dang dbang phyug ste/ /zhing shes pa ni nges par de yis sngon rig cing / /rgyu las 'di rnams rab tu 'jug par thos nas ni/ /bdag med gyur pa mthong nas dam pa'i bden pa gzigs / /sgom po'i nyon mongs tshogs kyis 2rnam par nyams pa ni/ /grangs can lus las cha shas dang bcas mthong ba ste/ /sbom po dang ni phra mo de yis nyams pa ni/ /sangs rgyas pa yi bstan las 'gyur zhes snyam par gyur/ /bdag tu 'du shes skyes pa nye bar mkhyud nas ni/ /ngar 'dzin spong ba ma yin de nas nga yi nyid/ /sgon ma dang ni nyin mor byed pa yod pa na/ /'od kyi rnam par nyams par gtan tshigs shes bya ci/ /ji ltar pad+ma'i chu ba che bar gyur pa yi/ /snal ma phra mo nyid ni bzhin dang 'byel pa ste/ /thar pa'i cho ga mthar thug min par de snyam zhing / /sangs rgyas pa yis rdo ba phye dang mnyam par rtogs/ /de nas bram zes rta thul de la mngon mchod nas/ /tshim zhing rang nyid kyi thuni khang par rnam 5song zhing / /bsod snyoms rim bzhin rta thul gyis kyang rab thob nas/ /rang bzhin gnas shing mkhas pa 'od ma'i tshal du song 5/ /de bzhin rab tu dang bas mchog dang ldan pa yi/ /nye rgyal kyang ni mngon du zhugs pa mthong nas ni/ /thos pa dang ni bsam pas bya ba mnyam kyepa yi / /mod gal rib/sa su rab tu skyes pas smras pa'o/ /dge slong de nyid gang 96—155

gis gzhan bzhin gyur pa ste/ /brtan pa kyeyin yang yang rmyedag dga' bzhin zu nye bar song / /khyed kyis 'chi med ci zhig de ring thob pa ste/ /bzhin ni rab tu dang 'di gtan tshigs med ma yinashe/ /de nas 'di ltar bgyi zhes 'di la nges bden smras/ /de nas des ni bdag la smos pa shes des smras/ /de nas tshig de nyid ni de yis smras pa ste/ /thos nas nyid kyi yang dag mig ni skyes par gyur / /las dang bsam pa rnam dag blo ldan de gnyis ni/ /lag nas sgon ma bzhin du de nyid mthong ba ste/ /shes pas ston la rnam par g.yo min bsam ldan dag /de ni lta rnguba'i don du da lta nyid du gshegs/ /slob ma'i sder 'ubacas de gnyis 7rgyang ma nas gzigs nas/ /bcom ldan drang srong chen pos dge slong rnams la gsungs/ /shes rab can dang rdzu 'phrul ldan pa rnams kyi gtso/ /kho bo'i mchog gi slob ma 'di gnyis 'dir 'ongs so / /de nas zab dang brtan pa'i gsung ni zhi ba yis༄ —/ /thub pas de gnyis la rgo gtam dag mdzad pa ste/ /dge slong 'dir ni mngon par nyer 'ongs rab zhi'i phyir/ /chos 'di ji lta ba bzhin yang dag thob par gyis/ /dbyu gu gsum lag gtsug phud dang ldan gnyis skyes te/ /gnyis la de bzhin gshegs pas 'di skad ces gsungs te/ /sangs rgyas mthu yis ngur smrig gos dang ldan pa yi/ /dge slong nyid du skad cig gis ni gyur pa'o/ /slob ma'i sder bcas cha lugs de yis de gnyis kyis/ /mgo bo dag gis thams cad mkhyen la mchod pa ste/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyis chos de gnyis la gsungs shing / /dus kyis tsude gnyis kyis ni nges legs thob par gyur/ /de nas 'od srungs rigs kyi sgon ma gnyis skyes kyis6/ /kha dog dang ni gzugs dang nor dang nyer ldan lasakye/ /rdzu 'phrul dang ni bdag ldan 96—156

bzang mo rnams 7spangs nas/ /thar pa'i ched du ngur smrig bzung zhing gshegs pa'o / /mdog bzangs gser gyi mchod sdong dang mtshungs 'bar ba ni/ /bu mangs ming bcas mchod rten du ni nges mthong nas/ /dngos po thams cad spangs shing ya mtshan dang bcas pas/ /thams cad mkhyen la thal mo rab sbyar mngon par song / /thub pa la ni rgyang nas mgo bos phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyag 'tshal nas ni ji lta ba bzhin mthon por gsol/ /bdag ni slob ma bcom ldan bdag gi ston pa lags/ /mun pa rnams su bstan 2pa bdag gi sgon mar gyur//gnyis skyes skom pa skyes shing nye bar 'ongs par ni/ /mkhyen nas bsam pa rnam dag thar 'dod de la ni/ /sems la gsung gi chab kyis rab tu tshim mdzad pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas legs par 'ongs zhes bka' stsal te/ /gsung 'di yis ni ngal ba rnam par sos bzhin te/ /nges par legs par rtogs pa'i ched du gnas pa ste/ /de nas dag pa'i bdag nyid 'di la thugs rje can/ /thub pas chos ni mdor bsdus pa yis gsungs pa'o/ /gang phyir thub pas chos ni phra mor gsungs tsam na/ /de yis don ni mtha' dag yang dag thob gyur te/ /de phyir yang dag rig dang na tshod che gnyis 1las/ /dgra bcom 'od srungs chen po nyid du mtshan gyur to/ /gang gis thulus las gzhan dang yang na lus su ni / /bdag dang bdag gi ba zhes bdag tu rtogs pa ste/ /de yis bdag tu lta ba de ni nges spangs shing / /nyi tshe ba min sdug bsngal 'di ni mthong bar gyur//tshul khrims brtul zhugs dag gis dag par byed ces gang / /rgyu med pa dang rgyu las de yis rtogs pa ste/ /sdug bsngal nyid /thudang lam ni yang dag thob nas te/ /tshul khrims dang ni brtul zhugs mchog tu ma bzung ngo / /phyin ci log tu gyur 96—157

par song ba gang gis rmyeni/ /mngon du bskor zhing mchog ni rab tu thob ma yin/ /bden pa bzhi po'i go 'phang rnams ni mthong gyur nas/ /the tshom som nyir gyur te yang dag mchod par gyur/ /'dod pa gang rnams su ni yang dag rgyar snyenyid dang / /brgyal bar gyur dang brgyal bar 'gyur nyid 'jig rten pa/ /mi gtsang bden pa ma yin de rnams des shes nas/ /'dod chags shes bya'i yul de spangs par gyur pa'o/ /de bzhin du ni byams par gyur pa'i sems kyis des//bshes dang bshes min rnams su khyad par med pa ste/ /'byung po kun la rjes su brtse ba byas pa yis/ /nad du song ba'i gnod sems spangs par ṅkugyur pa'o/ /gzugs la brten pa rnams dang grong khyer brten pa rnams/ /sna tshogs nyid dang ldan pa'i 'du shes rnams spangs nas/ /des ni gzugs kyi khams su chags pa rnam 5 bcom ste/ /gzugs la 'jug pa'i nyes pa rnams ni rtogs nas so/ /rmongs las snyoms 'jug rnams su thar pa'i 'du shes dang / /gzugs med lha rnams mdzad pa can du rtogs nas ni/ /zhi zhing mtshan ma med pa'i sems ni gzung 5nas su/ /gzugs med sred pa las ni chags dang bral bar song / /chu bo sen dhu'i 'ushugs chen rab tu 'jug pa bzhin/ /sems kyis ④g.yo zhing skyod dupar byed pa shes nas ni/ /brtan pa'i brten ⑨las rgod pa rnam par spangs pa ste/ /zhi zhing rdzing bu gang ba bzhin du gnas par gyur/ /snying po med pa'i phyir dang 'god pa'i chos nyid phyir/ /bdag med nyid phyir dngos rnams yang dag rab mthong nas/ /khyad 'phags nyid dang mnyam dang mchog nyid mthong ba ste/ /nga rgyal rnam par spangs nas yod ma yin zhes rtogs//ye shes me yis mi shes mun pa rnams bcom nas/ /zad pa can dang zad pa 96—158

med par sna tshogs mthong / /rnal 'byor gyis ni rig pa nyid ni yongs bsgoms nas—/ /ma rig pa ni mtha' dag ji lta ba bzhin spangs/ /mthong dang bsgom pa dag gis lkukun du sbyor ba ni/ /bcu po 'di dag mtha' dag 7narnams kyis rnam par grol gyur cing / /thal mo sbyar byas sangs rgyas nyid la lta bzhin du/ /bya ba kun byas rang bzhin gnas te gnas par gyur/ /skar ma gsum gyis zuganas skabs gsum skyong rjes skyes lha dang ni/ /ldan pa'i lnga gsum tshes kyi dus su skar ma'i rgyal po bzhin/ /gsum ni chud zos gyur cing gsum ni lhag par thob pa yi/ /gsum rig slob ma gsum gyis bde bar gshegs pa rnam par mdzes /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ nyan thos chen po rab tu gshegs par mdzad pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas 'ga' zhig tshe na nor ldan khyem bdag ni/ /skal ba med pa rnams la nor ni rab sbyin pa/ /bzang sbyin zhes ni rab tu grags pa'i ming ldan pa/ /byang phyogs yul ko sa la rnams nas der song gyur/ /de yis der ni thub pa bzhugs pa thos pa ste/ /thos nas blta bar 'dod pas mtshan mo rab tu song / /rnam dag sems pa ④des ni rab sleb gerab mkhyen nas/ /rab tu phyag byas pa la bde bar gshegs pas 'u bstan/ /gang phyir chos la bsgoms pas nyid ni rnam spangs nas/ /blo ldan mtshan mor bdag la lta 'dod rab sleb ste/ /da rmye lta nyid du 'ongs pa de yi de ma thag /nges par legs pa'i mgron 'di dā rab tu long mdzod ⑨ cig /gang zhig khyod kyis lhag kye bsam gang zhig bstan pa dang //bdag gis grags pa nyid las gang zhig dang ba dang / /gang zhig sngon gyi rgyu 96—159

las blo gros rab zhugs te/ /des ni yon tan chen bo rnams kyi snod yin no/ /de phyir 'jig rten dag na grags dang gzhan du ni/ /'bras bu sbyin pa mchog las byung bar rig nas ni/ /bkur ste byas nas dus su snyems pa'i bdag nyid kyis / /chos las thob pa'i nor ni sbyin par bya ba'o/ /tshul khrims yang dag blangs nas spyad par bya ba ste/ /tshul khrims nyid ni bsrung ba lhadang ni rgyan yin zhing / /'og tu song ba rnams kyi rnam par ldog byed do/ /nam mkha'i steng gi nges par rdzogs pa po nyid yin/ /'dod pa rnams su gcig min zhes shepas rjes bcings pa'i/ /yongs su tshol ba la sogs skyon rnams thos nas ni/ /nges par 'byung ba'i cho gar yon tan rnam 3shes nas/ /rnam dbe+en las skyes shi ba'i bden pa bsnyen par mdzod/ /'chi bas nye bar gzir zhing rga bas zil non pa'i/ /'jig rten rab tu bskor ba 4yang dag yongs shes nas/ /zhi ba skye ba med phyir 'bad pa mdzod cig dang / /skye ba bden pa med na rga med 'chi ba med/ /ji ltar mi rnams la ni mi rtag bdag nyid kyis/ /rab chags sdug bsngal mngon sum du ni rig mdzod la/ /de bzhin lha rnams la yang srug bsngal rig mdzod dang / /'jug pa rtag pa nyid ni su yang yod ma yin/ /gang du mi rtag pa nyid der ni sdug bsngal zhing / /gang du rang nyid med pa byeder yang sdug bsngal te/ /gang du bdag ces pa dang bdag gi ba zhes pa/ /de tshe mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med gang la yin/ /de phyir sdug bsngal las ni sdug bsngal 'di dang khye ni/ /mtshan ma las ni 'di yi mtshan ma ltos mdzod la/ /rnam par nye bar zhi las sdug bsngal zhi ba dang / /lam las khyod kyi 3lam ni dge ba shes par gyis/ /'gro ba g.yo ba sdug bsngal 'di ni shes nas su/ /me 96—160

dang rab mtshungs dus kyi me yis 'jig rten 'di①/ /mtha' dag rab tu tshig par yongs su rtogs zhubazhin du/ /srid dang srid min rnams su smon pa med par gyis/ /stong pa nyid dang bdag med bdag gi ba sped pa/ /sgyu ma dang mtshangs kyi'ajig rten 'di ni shes byas nas/ /'du byed tsam zhig rab tu yongs su rtogs bzhin du/ /lus 'di la ni khams kyi je'adu shes nyid du gyis/ /sems ni srid pa g.yos las yang dag g.yos nas dang / /'khor ba'i 'gro ba rnam pa sna tshogs mthong nas ni/ /rtog pa med cing zhi la bden zhing chags med par—/ /sems ni snyoms shing ༷5mtshan ma med pa bsnyen 6par gyis/ /de nas drang srong chen po'i chos de thos pa las/ /chos kyi cho ga'i sngon gyi 'bras bu thob gyur zhing / /gang zhig thob nas 'di yi sdug bsngal las lhag ma/ /rgya mtsho chen po las ni thigs pa gcig bzhin gyur/ /chags bral rnams kyi dgon par yang dag gnas kyang ngam/ /lus med rnams kyis dz+wasrid rtser yang dag gnas na yang / /nags sam lha na de nyid mthong min ma yin la/ /khyem na gnas pa yin yang lta bas dge legs gyur/ /rnam pa sna tshogs lta ba'i dra ba rnams kyis dang / /'khor ba'i sbug bsngal rnams kyis ༄chode rnams rnam mi 'grolashe/ /de phyir rab tu nyams shing de nyid ma mthong bar/ /chags pa rnam par bsal nas khyad par 'phags par gshegs/ /lta ba legs skyes des ni lta ba ngan de rnams//ston ka'i sprin gyis rdo yi char bzhin spangs pa ste/ /dbang phyug la sogs mi mthun rgyu las ma yin zhing / /des ni 'jig rten rgyu med par min zhes rtogs so/ /de ṅkuphyir mi mnyam rgyur ni 'thad pa ma yin zhing / /rgyu rnged par ni 'gal ba chen po yod pa nyid/ /'dir shā1yang rigs pa ⑫shes pas so sor mthong ba ste ⑪/ /96—161

je tshom med pas de nyid mthong ba kye ma ci/ /gal te dbang phyug gis ni ①'gro ba skyed gyur na/ /'gro ba rim gyis rab tu 'jug pa ma yin la/ /skye dgu rnams kyi 'khor ba'i 'khor lo ma yin zhing / /gang du gang zhig bskyed pya nas de dang de nyid 'gyur/ /lus can rnams kyis sgomi 'dod thob ④pa ma yin zhing / /de yi bdag nyid rnams kyis 57'dod pa'i spyod pa med/ /gang zhig lus can rnams kyi dge dang mi dger gyur/ /de ni dbang phyug nyid phyir dbang phyug la yin no/ /de yi dbang phyug nyid la the tshom 'gyur min zhing / /der ni mi rnams dag gis byams pa pha bzhin 'gyur/ /de la nyam thag pas ni smod 'upa smra min zhing / /lha rnams de dang de la 'jig rten mchod ma yin/ /gal te 'di mi bskyed mel dgongs par gyur na ni/ /bya ldan nyid phyir deng 'dir dbang phyug ma yin zhing / /gal te 'di yis 'jug la 'dod par gyur na ni/ /de nyid dbang phyug yod pa nyid la byed par 'gyuraḍa/ /ci ste 'di yi skye la nus pa cung zhig med/ /byis pa bzhin du 'di yis spyod rnams rgyu med do/ /gal te dbang phyug gi ni bdag la mnga' nyid med/ /'jig rten bskyed la 'di yi stobs de ci zhig yod/ /ji ltar 'dod la gal te bde sdug la /1bsnyen na/ /'byung po rnams ni 'jig rten na des byas pa nyid/ /gang phyir 'dod la chags pa khong khro la 'jug ste/ /de phyir de yi dbang nyid yod pa ma yin no/ /de'i rten nyid la sems med rnams kyis gnas bya ste/ /skyes bu'i ⑫'bad rtsol tshad mar gyur pa nyid yin no/ /las 'bras med par 'gyur zhing lung ⑫ni byas min la / /las kyi spyor ba rnams ni de yi rten skyeyin na/ /gal te dbang phyug rang gi las kyis 'gyur na ni/ /thun mong gyur pa'i las la dbang phyug gyur ma yin/ /96—162

ci ste de yi khyab bdag rgyu med gyur na ni/ /'gro ba kun gyi dbang phyug nyid ni rab tu grub/ /ci ste de yi dbang phyug nyid gzhan las yin zhing / /de nyid kyi yang byed 1rtepo'i dbang phyug gzhan yin la/ /de yis gzhan zhes de ltar 'dir ni rnam gzhag med/ /de phyir 'gro ba skyed pa yod pa ma yin nyid/ /dbang phyug skyed por gyur na rigs pas tha dad du/ /rnam par 'gal ba rnam pa du ma mthong ba ste/ /de yi phyir yang rang bzhin la ni nyes pa de/ /slar yang rab tu chags par 'gyur ba nyid yin no/ /rgyu shes rnams kyi trerten ni cung zad rnam log pa'o/ /rgyu ni bya ba'i cho gar smra ba ma yin zhing / /bya ba'i cho gar sa bon la sogs de dang de/ /ltos pa yin te de phyir rang bzhin rgyu ma yin/ /'bras mi rdzogs par byed pa po ni gcig pa nyid/ /'ga' zhig gi yang rgyu ni cung zad yod ma yin/ /gcig gi bdag nyid can gyi rang bzhin rab bstan te/ /de phyir rab tu 'jug la rang bzhin rgyu ma yin/ /gang gi rang bzhin gyis ni khyab pa nyid 'dod pa/ /de yi bya ba med pa nyid kyang rab chags shing / /bya ba ma gtogs 'bras bu'i cho ga mthong min te/ /de yi phyir yang bskyed la rang bzhin rgyu ma yin/ /de yi khyab pa po nyid la ni rgyu nyid phyir/ /thams cad las ni thams cad rgyun mi 'chad gyepar 'gyur/ /'bras bu'i rab tu 'jug la nges pa mthong ba ste/ /de phyir skyed pa la ni rang bzhin rgyu ma yin/ /ji ltar 'di yi yon tan med nyid grub pa ste/ /de ltar 'bras bu la ni yon tan med nyid 'gyur—/ /rnam 'gyur rgyayon tan can rnams 'jig rten na mthong ste/ /de phyir rab tu 'jug la rang bzhin rgyu ma yin/ /rtag pa'i rgyu las khyad par 'gyur ba ma yin phyir⑥/ /rnam 'gyur la ni tha dad yon tan nyid ma yin/ /rnam 96—163

'gyur la ni tha dad yon tan zhugs pa ste/ /de phyir rang bzhin las ni skyed pa rigs ma yin/ /rang bzhin gyis ṭ+wāni bskyed pa'i bdag nyid can nyid la/ /'bras bu rnams su nyams pa'i rgyu ni grub ma yin/ /gang phyir rnam 'gyur gyi lkuni nyams pa mthong ba ste/ /de phyir rtogs par bya ba rgyu ni gzhan nyid do/ /nus par gyur pa'i sbyor la shin tu mthar thug pa'i/ /thar pa 'dod pa'i sdom brtson rnams kyi ma yin zhing / /skye dgu rnams kyi rang bzhin rab tu 'jug pa'i phyir/ /gang las thar pa'i ched dang pha rol gnon par gyur/ /skyed pa'i bdag nyid rang bzhin gyis ni nges nyid phyir/ /de yi bdag nyid rnam 1'gyur la ni nges nyid yin/ /'jig rten dag na rnam 'gyur la ni brtan nyid med/ /de phyir rang bzhin gyis ni skyed par rigs ma yin/ /sems kyi spyod pa mi gsal 9rang bzhin zhes bya zhing / /rnam 'gyur gsal ba 'di ni de nas grags pa ste/ /de phyir rab tu 'jug la rang bzhin rgyu min zhing / /gsal ba'i rgyu la 'dir ni 'bras bu grub pa nyid/ /sems med rang bzhin las ni sems dang bcas pa yi//rta glang bong bu la sogs 'bras bu rigs pa snyem yin zhing / /sems dang rnam par bral ba'i rgyu rnams dag las ni/ /sems dang ldan pa cung zad zhig ni 'jug ma yin/ /gal te 'gro ba skyed phyir dus ni nges pa ste/ /de phyir yongs su rtog khubyed rnams kyis )thar pa med/ /gang phyir skye dgu rnams kyi mtha' ni byas min te/ /de phyir 'jig rten rgyun chad med par skye bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig yon tan rnams kyi gcig dang du mas byas/ /rjes rnams su ni rang nyid nges pa mthong ba ste/ /gal te rgyu gcig nyid du gnas par gyur pa na/ /de yang tha dad khyad par gyur pa ma yin noṅku7 / /gang zhig smin pa las skyes rdzas kyi 96—164

cho gar sar/ /yon tan shes pas yon tan tha dad nyid du mthong / /gang phyir rgyu ni khyad par min pa 'dod pa ste/ /stong pa'i dzas rnams su yang nges par gyur pa nyid/ /gang gi mi gsal ba las rdzas ni 'char ba ste/ /de yi rjes su dpag pa nges par grub ma yin/ /'bras bu gsal ba yi ni yang dag rab 'jug pa/ /mi gsal ba las gang gis mngon du mthong ma yin/ /gsal ba gnyis pa dag las rab tu 'jug pa bzhin/ /mi gsal ba las gang gi she'abras bu dang por gyur/ /de yi 'dod pa las 'dir mi 'dod chen po'o/ /rang bzhin nyid kyis nyes pa gnyis ni rab tu chags/ /ji ltar gser gyi phreng ba khyad par 'phags pa ste/ /de ltar rang bzhin gyi ni rnam 'gyur khyad par 'phags/ /'bras bu khyad par yin zhing rgyu yi ma yin te/ /de phyir skyed rte la rang bzhin rigs kyepa ma yin no/ /gal te bya bar skyes bu de ni rgyu yin na/ /gang gis nges par gang 'dod des de 'thob par 'gyur/ /'dod kyang kha cig don ni 'thob pa ma yin la/ /mi 'dod na yang dbang med 'dir ni 'thob 4par 'gyur / /gang zhig /thub glang rta bong rnga mo'i skye gnas 'gro/ /mnga' bdag nyid du gyur na de ni bsnyen min zhing / /de ru 'gro ba'i sdig pa'i las ni byed pa dang / /sdug bsngal mi 'dod su yis sdug bsngal byed par 'gyur/ /gal te 'jig rten dag na skyes bu byed par gyur/ /sdug bsngal byed pa ma yin bde ba kho na byed/ /'dod pa byed par 'dod kyang mi 'dod byed pa ste/ /dbang phyug chen por 'gyur hūṃn mi 'dod su yis spyod/ /gang tshe mi ni chos min pa las rnam 'jigs shing / /'bad pas chos ni rab tu son par byed pa nyid/ /sna tshogs nyon mongs rnams kyis ⑦dbang rnged 'phrog pa ste/ /de phyir 'di na mi 96—165

ni pha rol rgyud du gyur/ /grang dang dro dang char dang thog dang glog sogs kyi/ /bya ba rnams ni mi la bzlog nas mthong ba ste/ /gang phyir rang dbang ma yin mi ni gzhan ldan te/ /de phyir bya ba rnams su skyes bu dbang phyug min/ /gang tshe sa bon las dang sa chu'i rten las ni/ /dus sbyor rab tu 'jug la lo thog phun tshogs shing / /mar me dag las rab gsal shing las me yin te/ /rgyu med las yin zhes pa rgyu med ma yin no/ /rgyu med pa las gal te 'gro ba'i rab 'jug na/ /mi yi byed pa yis ni med par 'gyur ba ste/ /thams cad kyis ni thams cad nges par 'thob byed cing / /rtag na 'di ni thams cad du ni song bar grub/ /bde dang sdug bsngal gal te rgyu med las yin na/ /gang char kun gyi bde dang sdug bsngal skal min zhing / /rgyu med las kyang bde dang sdug bsngal rtogs min te/ /de phyir rgyu med las shes 'di ni rgyu ma yin/ /de skad ces pa la sogs mi mnyam rgyu rnams des/ /'jig rten rab tu 'jug la rgyu rnams shes ma yin/ /rgyu med par ni 'jig rten mthong ba ma yin zhing / /nyes pa 'di rnams rgyu med las ni yang dag rtogs/ /brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba'i 'byung po rnams su yang / /de dang de la brten nas de dang de 'byung ste/ /'jig rten dag na rgyu med ci yang yod min zhing / /kun gyi rgyu ni 'jig rten pa yis shes ma yin/ /de nas sbyin pa bzang por byin pa'i bzang byin des/ /rgya che'i chos kyis 1dam pa'i chos ni rnam shes nas/ /g.yo ba med pa'i blo gros nges par rab dang bas/ /drang srong chen po la ni tshig 'di gsal 3snaba'o/ /mnyan yod rta ljang rta rid kyis bsnyen grong khyer ni/ /bdag gi gnas kyi sa 1ni bsod nams grags pa can/ /der ni bdag gis khyed kyi gnas ni byed 'dod 96—166

derka/ /sdig med gnas mchog dam pa de ni bsnyen par mdzod/ /gang lta na yang thub pa khyed kyi gnas su stoms pa ni/ /gzhal yas khang gi logs sam rnam dbe+en nags su ste⑫ / /bdag la rjes su brtse phyir gnas kyi ched du ni/ /dgra bcom rab tu gzhes par mdzad par 'os pa lags/ /de nas gtong bar lhag par mos pa 'di yis ni/ /rnam par grol ba'i sems ni rnam par mkhyen nas ni//chags pa med pa'i blo mnga' blo gros mkhyen pa yis/ /mchog tu zhi bas blo gros yang dag bka' stsal to/ /sems dpa' brtan kye gang zhig rdzas glog g.yo rnams su/ /khyod kyi sems dpa' gtong la lhag par mos pa ste/ /rang bzhin gyis ni sbyin la dga' zhing chos la dgyes/ /de nyid mthong ba khyed la de ni ngo mtshar min/ /gang zhig khyim ni tshig las phyi rol 'thon byed pa/ /de yi don de 'tshig par byed pa ma yin te/ /de bzhin dus kyi me yis 'gro ba tshig pa na/ /gang gis gang zhig sbyin pa de yis de nyer 'thobabye/ /de phyir rnam spangs sems dpa' rnams kyis sbyin par dang / /yul rnams yang dag longs spyod par ni shes pa nyid/ /bkren pa 'jig rten dag na ñtsha zad pa'i skyon mthong bas/ nye bar longs spyod ma yin 'jigs las sbyin ma yin/ /dus su smod la don ni rnam par gtong ba dang / /dpal dang nga rgyal las ni de bzhin g.yul 'gyed par/ /sems dpa' lhag pa nyid kyis shes te gzhan gyis min/ /sems dpa' yis ni sbyin pa nyid dang g.yul 'gyed do/ /sbyin byed dga' ba nyid du 'gro la 'gro ba ste/ /snyan pa dang ni dam par grags pa rab tu 'thob/ /sbyin pa po yod gang zhes dam pa rnams sbyin nas/ /yang dag bkur ba dang ni mngon du 'gro bar byed/ /de bzhin 'jig rten dag na blo gtad nyid 'gyur zhing / /mi bzad chopa rnams 96—167

las kyang nyes pa 'job ma yin/ /bsod nams rnams ni bdag gis byas zhes tshim pa ste/ /'chi ba'i dus su skrag par mngon par 'gro ma yin/ /sbyin pa'i 'bras bu 'dir ni me tog tsam zhig ste/ /sbyin pa po yi 'bras bu gzhan nyid rab tu 'thob/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo la ni 'khor ba'i skye bo yi/ /gtong ba dang mnyam gnyen ni yod pa ma yin no/ /mi yi 'jig rten na dang lha na skyes pa rnams / /gtong ba las dang mnyam pa rnams las lhag par 'gyurarmye/ /rta dang glang po'i skye gnas su yang gnas pa rnams/ /'bras bu de ni gtso bo thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /sbyin pas longs spyod rnams kyis yongs su 'dzin pa ste/ /tshul khrims kyis bsrungs mtho ris su ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /ye shes sngon du 'gro ba can gyi zhi ba yis kyang ni/ /rten dang bral ba gang na grangs su 'gro ba 'gro ma yin / /'chi med bdud rtsi de yis 'thob pa'i ched du yang / /sdom par gyur pa rab tu sbyin pa yin pa nyid/ /sbyin pa dran nas rab tu dga' bar gyur pa ste//yid ni rab tu dga' las nges par ting 'dzin yin/ /mnyam par gzhag na yang dag mtho ba 'di ru ni/ /skye dang 'god pa shes par rim gyis 'gyur ba ste/ /gzhan la sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sbyin pa po yis ni/ /snying la gnas pa'i nyon mongs rnams ni bsrabs 2par 'gyur/ /gang zhig sbyin pa byin byed de yi don rnams su / /chags par grags pa de ni dang por chod krupa nyid/ /gang la rab tu byams pa'i sems kyis sbyin pa ste/ /de phyir zhe sdang dang ni nga rgyal spangs par gyur / /rab tu len pa po ni bde ldan rnams mthong nas/ /gang zhig 'ga' thuste des na ser sna yod ma yin/ /sbyin pa pos ni sbyin pa'i 'bras bu mngon rtogs nas/ /med pa nyid dang mi shes mun pa 'joms pa po/ /de phyir zhi ba 96—168

'phags min gyis bsnyen ser sna dang / /sred pa gang las sbyin pa byed pas bcom pa ste/ / de nas ⑨thar pa'i yan lag gyur pa sbyin pa ni/ /yin zhing nyes pa rab tu thob duphyir thar pa'o/ /ji ltar gzhan rnams grib ma'i don du shing 'dod cing / /kha cig 'bras bu'i don du gzhan rnams me tog phyir/ /de ltar sbyin pa yongs su sbyin par 1byed pa ste/ /kha cig zhi ba'i don du gzhan rnams nor gyi phyir/ /de phyir khyad par du ni khyem na gnas rnams kyis/ /sbyin pa ji ltar nus pa mchog ni gter yin zhing / /sbyin pa snying po med pa'i nor gyi ④snying po ste/ /dam pa rnams kyi rjes su song ba lam 'di yin/ /bza' ba rab tu sbyin par stobs ni rab ster zhing / /bgo ba sbyin byed la yang lus ni ster ba'o/ /gang gis dam pa rnams la gnas ni sbyin byed pa/ /des kyang 'jig rten dag na thams cad byin pa yin/ /theg pa sbyin byed la yang bde ba byin pa ste/ /mar me sbyin byed la ni spyan mig sbyin pa nyid/ /de nas dbrog bya ma yin 'chi med rab sbyin zhing / /gang gis mthar thug gyur pa'i chos kyis ston pa nyid/ /kha cig 'dod pa'i ched du sbyin pa gtong ba ste/ /gzhan ni don gyi pyedon du gcig ni grags pa'i phyir/ /kha cig mtho ris don du gzhan ni 'ubartse ba'i phyir/ /khyod kyi sbyin pa 'di ni chags pa med pa yin/ /de phyir legs so khyod ni sred pa de ltar gyur/ /gang zhig yang dag bsgrubs mdzod 'dod pa tshim par shog /rdul bcas mun pa dang ldan gang spyod 'ongs nas ni/ /ye shes rnam dag blo ni rab tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de nyid de ⑦bzhin gshegs pas lam gyi lduyang dag par/ /dga' ba byas pa dang yang gzhug pa byas pa ni/ /gtsug lag khang de snying la rnam par byas nas ni/ /nye rgyal dang ni lhan cig 96—169

dus su song bar gyur/ /song nas de na kau shām ①rgyal po'i khab dang ni/ /gtsug lag khang gi sa la so sor yang dag rgyus/ /dpal ldan mnyam zhing mdzes la yid 'ong shing ldan pa/ /der ni de yis rgyal byed kyi ni tshal mthong ngo / /de nas de yi don du rgyal byed la zhus rngute/ /de yis chags pa las ni de la ma byin no/ /khrod kyis chagal te don kyis kun nas bkram na yang / /sa ni bdag gis sbyin pa ma yin zhes smras so/ /de nas der ni bzang sbyin gyis de la smras pa/ /tshal de la ni rin byas shes ni mngon 'dod do/ /de nas des ni nor gyis sa jeni yongs g.yogs nas/ /chos kyi tha snyad mthong zhing nyos par gyur pa'o/ /de yi 'ugatong ba de bye ni mthong nas rgyal byed kyis/ /sangs rgyas la ni mchog tu rab tu dang ba byas/ /nags tshal de yi lhag ma dag ni kun nas ni / /de bzhin gshegs pa la ni phul bar gyur pa'o/ /de nas mgon med zas sbyin gyis ni drang srong chen po yis/ /nye rgyal gyis ni nges par gzigs par bya ba'i don ldan par/ /myur ba'i blo gros dang ldan ma chags grol ba'i sems kyis )ni/ /mdzes shing dge ba mchog gis snyegatsug lag khang ni byed du bcug /nor gyi dbang phyug nyid kyi gnas ni 'phos pa lta bu dang / /byang phyogs ko sha la yi khang pa'i bde ba lta bu dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi gzhi ni mtshungs pa lta bu dang / /rang gi nor dang stobs kyi dang ni lta ba yi ḍa—yang ngo /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ mgon med zas sbyin la rjes su ston pa'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o// //de nas thub pa sna tshogs tha dad blo can gyi/ /ston pas thams cad ye 96—170

shes kyis ni zil mnan ①nas/ /bcu phyed phrag ri nas dang grong khyer nas rim gyis / /rgyal po bum pas bsnyen pa'i grong khyer du gshegs so/ /de nas slob ma stong phrag tsam ni dul ba na/ /gshegs so des ni yab kyi yul ni rab tu thob//de nas de la rjes su 'dzin pa mdzad bzhed pa/ /rang gi grong gi gnas la mtha' ru bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas mdun (byen 'don dang blon po blo gros can/ /dga' ba'i gtam la dam pa rgyu ba de rnams kyis/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i rab brnyes khu'aphags pa ste/ /sa skyong rgyal po de la zhus shing gsol ba'o/ /de nas de ni 'ongs pa thos nas sa skyong ni/ /dga' ba yongs ldan sems kyis blta chobar 'dod pa yis/ /grong khyer ba ni kun gyis chorjes su 'gro byas pa/ /myur bas brtan pa spangs shing bsu ba la gshegs so/ /drang srong dbus su tshangs pa bzhugs pa ⑦bzhin du ni/ /slob mas bskor ba de ni rgyang ring nas gzigs nas / /drang srong chen po'i chos la rjes su 'gro bas ni/ /shing rta spangs nas rkang pa rnams kyis nye bar gshegs/ /myur bar de yi nye logs su ni yongs phyin nas—/ /thub pa mthong ba nyid de des ni ma smras so/ /de la rngo bu zhes smra bar nus pa ma yin zhing / /de bzhin dge slong zhes ni nus pa ma yin no/ /de nas de yi dge slong cha lugs de mthong zhing / /bdag tu song ba'i sna tshogs dpal la brtags nas ni/ /dbugs ring brgyus shesnanas mchi ma rnam par bton pa de rmye/ /drag tu myun par gyur cing rnam par zlos pa nyid/ /lam 'gro skom par gyur pa mngon par song ba yis nyunye/ /rgyang ring dag nas rjing bu skam po mthong nas ltar/ /rang gnas rnam pa dang bral nye bar nyer bzhugs pa/ /mthong nas bdag gi nyam thag stobs ldan mchog tu gyur/ /'jig rten mtha' 96—171

ru gnas pa'i sems gyur thim pa na/ /sdug pa'i rnam 'gyur ri mor song ba ji lta bar/ /gzugs de nyid ni mthong ba na ni bdag la ni/ /dga' ba yod pa ma yin 'di la dga' ba thal/ /gang gis 7 mtha' dag ri yis zlums pyapas sa gzhi ni/ /dang po'i dus su nga las byenu ni gnas pa bzhin/ /gang zhig dbang po la yang slong bar 'os min pa/ /bdag gi de ni pha rol rnams la slong mos 'tsho / /gangs 'di snying po lhun po las ni khyad 'phags shing / /gsal bas nyi ma la dang mdzes pas zla ba la/ /'gros kyis glang po che la dbyangs kyis ④/khyu mchog la/ /des ni slong mo za zhing sa ni rdzogs la min/ /de nas bu yi 'du shes kyis ni 'phyo ba nyid/ /rgyal po'i bsam pa 'di ni rnam par mkhyen nas dang / /'jig rten lhag ma la snyeyang rjes su brtse ba ste/ /de yi don du sangs rgyas mkha' la 'phur bar gyur/ /nyi ma'i shing rta phyag gis reg par mdzad nas ni/ /rlung gis bsnyen 6pa'i lam la zhabs dag gis gshegs shing / /sku la gcig tu gyur zhing du mar gyur pa 3dang / /mang po nyid du gyur nas gcig tu gyur pa'o/ /sa la chu bzhin du yang zhugs shing thogs med la/ /chu yi logs la sa la bzhin du spyod pa dang / /ra ba dang ni ri la thad kar mdzad pa dang / /thogs pa med cing mkha' la bzhin du rab tu zhugasakye// /lus kyi phyed kyis chu yi char pa 'bebs pa dang / /phyed kyis 17me bzhin du ni 'bar bar gyur pa ste/ /ri bos 'bar ba'i sman dang rab tu 'bar ba bzhin/ /mkha' la gang zhig 'bar dang 'bar bas mdzes par gyur/ /dbang phyug mngon par 'dod pa'i skye bo de yi ni/ /sems kyi rab tu dga' ba de ltar skyed 0nas ni/ /nyi ma gnyis pa bzhin du mkha' la bzhugs nas su/ /mi skyong la ni chos dag bgro bar mdzad 96—172

pa'o / /mi skyong khyed kyis ①bdag la gang zhig ltos pa dang / /mya ngan rjes su zhugs pa snying rje'i bdag nyid shes/ /bu la dga' ba de ni chod mdzod zhi bar gshegs—/ /bdag las bu yi 'bras bu kyegasar pa snoms snyemadzod cig /gang zhig sngon chad bu yis pha la ma byin zhing / /sngon ni pha yis bu las rab tu ma thob pa/ /rgyal srid las khyad 'phags shing mtho ris las khyad 'phags/ /rgyal po mchog gi bdud rtsi de ni bzhes mdzod cig /sa skyong las kyis byebadag nyid las kyi skye gnas dang / /las kyi rten dang las kyi rnam smin skal ba dang / /las kyi dbang gis gnas par 'gro ba shes nas ni/ /phan pa'i ched du las gang gyur pa de bsnyen mdzod/ /'jig rten de nyid rtogs nas dang ni btsal nas su//dam pa'i las ni mi yi bshes min sgo gzhan ma yin/ /thams cad bor nas las dang lhan cig khyod kyi ni/ /rten dang bral zhing gcig pur 'gro bar bya ba'o/ /lha 'am dmyal ba dud 'gro mi yi 'jig rten du/ /las kyi rten las son pa'i 'jig rten 'gro ba ste/ /srid pa'i rgyu ni rnam pa gsum dang skye gnas gsum/ /sna tshogs las ni 'jig rten pa yis rab tu byed/ /de phyir sde tshan gnyis ni yang dag 'jug par yang spe// /lus dang ngag gi las 'di rnam par dag pa dang //yid kyis pyarab tu zhi la 'bad par bya ba ste/ /de ni bdag gi don yin gzhan don ma yin no/ /'gro ba chu yi dba' rlabs g.yo bar shes nas ni/ /brtags nas khyod kyis kyesrid pa rnams su dga' mi bya/ /las ni yongs su zad phyir dam pa'i las gang despu / /mchog tu bde ba'i don du gang gyur bsnyen par bya—/ /rgyu skar 'khor lo mkha' la bzhin du rtag par ni/ /'jig rten yongs su 'khor bar shes par byas nas ni/ /rtse mo 'das nas lha nas lha yang khrung ba 96—173

ste / /kye ma mir gyur smos ci blo gtad byed pa su/ /bde ba rnams las mchog tu thar pa'i bde ba dang / /dga' ba rnams las bdag tu dga' ba gtsor rmye shes nas/ /lag 'gro rnams kyis kyebrang la bzhin du bdag ldan ni/ /su zhig 'jigs pa du ma'i dpal gyis skyabade la dga'/ /de phyir brten pyapa khyem la mes bzhin bye 'jig rten ni/ /'jigs pa chen po dang ni yongs ldan mthong nas ni/ /gang zhig skye 'chi ngal ba mya ngan dang bral ba/ /zhi zhing brtan hūṃpa'i go 'phang de ni slongs mdzod cig /don gyis ma yin g.yul gyis ma yin mtshon gyis min/ /gang la rta dang glang pos don ni yod ma yin/ /skyon ni dgra bo rnams kyi sde de choms ⑦ mdzod dang / /de las rgyal na rnam par rgyal ba gzhal du med/ /sdug bsngal dang ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu zhi ba dang / /zhi ba yi yang mngon pa'i thabs ni shes par mdzod/ /bzhi po 'di yi kun nas khong du chud pa las/ /'jigs pa chen po dang ni ngan 'gro rnams 'gog go/ /de nas bde bar gshegs pas rdzu 'phrul gyi kyesngon du/ /zhing du byas pa'i sems la dga' ba skyes pa ste/ /thos nas mi skyong de yis chos ni rab thob cing / /dga' bzhin thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /blo ldan dang bcas 'bras bu dang bcas khyed dgyes shing / /sdug bsngal chen po las ni rnam grol khyed dgyes so/ /mya ngan ched du don med sa sbyin bdag dga' la/ /bu yi rngu 'bras bu dang ldan bdag ni dga' bar gyur/ /phun tshogs spangs nas gshegs pa khyed ni gnas su gyur/ /ngal ba chen pos dub las ⑫khyed ni gnas su gyur/ /dga' ba'i gnyen 'dun dga' ba khyod kyis bor ba rnams/ /bdag cag rnams ni snying rje bar du gnas su gyur/ /lha yi drang srong rnams sam rgyal po'i drang 96—174

srong rnams/ /de rnams sngon dus na yang gang la ma gshegs pa/ /nyam thag 'jig rten dag gi dge ba'i ched du lam/ /nges par legs pa 'di dang khyed kyis lhag par thob/ /khyod ni 'khor los sgyur bar gal te gyur na ni/ /bdag gi dga' ba de ltar 'gyur ba ma yin zhing / /rnam pa de ltar rdzu 'phrul 'di dang khyod kyi rmye chos/ /mthong nas ji ltar bdag gi bstan tre7pa dga' bar 'gyur / /'dir ni yang srid nyid du spyor ba'i chos la ni/ /'khor los sgyur bas skye dgu rnams ni skyong ba ste/ /'khor ba'i sbug bsngal chen po rnams ni 'joms pa la/ /'jig rten ched du chos kyang thub pa khyod kyis gsungs/ /gang gi rdzu 'phrul 'di dang rnam rgyas choblo gros dang / /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag nges par log pa ni/ dpal dang bral yang 'jig rten na khyod dbang phyug ste/ /dpal ni 'phel yang dbang med sred bcas ma yin no/ /brtse ba'i chos kyis bstan 7 pa'i 'os gyur pa/ /shākya'i rgyal pos mang po de dag smras thunas ni/ /rgyal po nyid dang yab nyid du ni gnas na yang / /sras la de nyid khong du chud phyir phyag byas so/ /thub pa'i mthu ni lhag par thob pa mthong nas dang / /de nyid rab tu 'bigs pa'i bstan bcos mthong nas dang / /bla ma rgyal pos sbyar ba'i mchod pa mthong nas ni/ /du ma rnams kyis rab tu 'byung phyir re 'dod byas/ /de nas gzhon nu mang po 'bras bu la gnas rnams//chos kyi cho ga de nyid rab tu thob gyur te/ /sngags dang 'dod pa chen po rnams la ltos thumed nas/ /byams pa'i gnyen 'dun ngu ba rnams ni spangs nas so/ /kun dga' mdzes dga' kra mi la dang ma 'gags pa/ /dga' bo nye dga' dag dang de nas 'khyel pa 'dzin/ /slob ma'i sgog tu ston pa yis ni lha sbyin mete/ /96—175

thub pas rjes su bslabs pa de rnams byung bar gyur/ /de nas mdun na 'don gye bu ni bdag nyid che/ /'char kas lam de nyid la rab tu song ba ste/ /de yis nges pa rab tu mthong nas de bzhin du/ /nye ba rmye'akhor dang rgyun shes bu yi ⑤blo byas so/ /rgyal po yis kyang sras kyi mthu ni mthong nas dang / /mchog gi bdud rtsi 1rgyun ni rab tu thob byas nas/ /chags pa med par rgyal srid srun zla la byin zhing / /rgyal po'i drang srong spyod pas khyem rnams la bsnyen to/ /de skad ces pa la sogs legs pa'i gnyen rnams dang / /'khor dang gnyen rnams rjes su brtul nas sangs rgyas ni/ /mchi ma dang bcas grong khyer pa yis mngon dga' ba/ /rang gnas grong khyer la ni dus su rab zhugs hūṃpa/ /don kun grub pa zhes pa rgyal po'i sras po ni/ /don mdzad grub pa grong khyer du ni rab zhugs pa/ /zhes ni don thos khang pa rnams su mi mo rnams/ /sgo rnams dang ni skar khung rnams la mnyam par brten/ /mtshams kyi sprin gyis phyed bkag phye'od zer ldan pa bzhin/ /ngur smreg bsnams shing mdzes pa de ni rab mthong nas/ /bud med de rnams mig nas mchi ma phyung ba ste/ /pad+ma dang mtshungs thal mo rnams kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyis hūṃdang ni gzugs kyis gsal 3bar gyur pa ni/ /'og tu zhal gzigs gshegs pa de ni mthong gyur nas—/ /brtse ba dang ni gus pa rnam ldupar ston pa ste/ /mchi mas rnyogs pa'i mig can rab pyos ma rnams 'u/zlos/ /legs skyes dbu ni bzhar bar rnam par mdzad nas dang / /na bza' rnying pa yongs su gsol nas dang / /sku la 1 ༄ gser gyi kha dog rab tu g.yogs nas dang / /des ni spyan mig rab tu bkod nas gshegs/ /gang zhig gdung ba skyob pa'i gdugs dkar bsnyen phyir dang / /96—176

sras po rnam par dul ba blta ba'i phyir 'ongs shing kye/ /kun nas gnas phyir 'os shing rgyal ba'i phyir 'os pa/ /des ni lhung bzed yang dag yongs su bzung ༄ snanas gshegs/ /'gram par ta ma la yi lo ma rnam 3 bkod pa'i/ /mdzes ma'i gdong dang gdung ba skyob pa'i gdugs dkar ni/ /gang gis bsnyen par 'os shing mgyogs 'gro 'os pa ste/ /des ni lhung bzed yongs su bzung nas rkang pas gshegs/ /sa skyong bdag skyes rnams kyi dgra rnams zad par 4dang / /dga' ba rnams kyi chags dang 'gro ba'i rjes chags par/ /blta bar 'os shing sna tshogs dbu rgyan bsnams pa gang / /des ni sa yi gnya' shing gang tsam gzigs shing gshegs/ /'di yi blta snyeb ci zhig mtshan nyid de ni ci/ /don gnyer ci zhig rol pas dgra bor gyur pa ci/ /gang 'di brtul zhugs dang ni lhan cig rol ba ste/ /bu byis rnams dang mo btsun mdzangs ma rnams dang ni gye//rgyal po'i mna' ma nges par mya ngan 'dzin ma'o/ /grags 'dzin ma de shin tu dka' thub byed pa ste/ /gang gis 7jo bo'i rab tu spyod pa 'di thos shing / /thos nas kyang ni gnas shing nyams par 'gro ba med/ /'di yi gzugs ni nges par rjes su mthun pa dang / /kha dog ngan pa'i gzugs 'di snang ba mthong nas ni thu—/ /sras 'dod mi dbang rgyal po ji lta bur gyur zhing / /'tshe ba'i dgra bo la yang ji lta bur byed dam/ /mchi mas gang ba'i sras po sgra gcan 'dzin mthong nas/ /gal te de lta nyid du 'di ni chags ma yin/ /byams pa'i gnyen rnams las kyang gzhan du kha bltas pa/ /'di 'dra nges pa'i brtul zhugs la ni dge legs co/ga /gzi mdangs dang ni lus kyi dbyebs dang 'gros sam ste/ /bde ba'i rab tu 'jug la nges par tshad ma yin/ /yon tan de spu 96—177

rnams dag gis 'di ni mdzes pa ste/ /zhi bas ldan zhing yul rnams kyis ni rnam par bral/ /sna tshogs ston ni rang 1mtshungs bsam pa yang dag yongs bzung nas / /de skad ces sogs rab stsos ma rnams mang po rnam par labs /sangs rgyas ma chags thugs kyang rang gi grong khyer la gshegs nas/ /bsod stoms brnyes shing n+ya gro dha yi mtshan ma'i bye nags su gshegs/ /nyung ngu nyung ngu'i bsod snyoms sbyin pa rnams kyis nor rdzas phra zhing dge ba ma byas skye bo sgol bar mdzad bzhed pa/ /spyod pa 'di yis yang dag tshim pa ma yin dge sbyong skye bo bsam pa ma thul ba la brten par mdzad bzhed la/ /'jig rten dag na skyid de ba zhes rgol ba nub par mdzad bzhed de bzhin yongs su bris nyid ston par mdzad bzhed pa/ / brtag par snyam la bsod snyoms phyir ni yab kyi grong khyer la ni sred med thugs mnga' de bzhin gshegs pa zhugs par gyur/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ yab dang sras mjal ba'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //nga rgyal nyid kyis skye bo dam pa ma smod snyecig /bshes gnyen 'du shes dka' thub rnams ni ma thu'ajoms shig /nyon mongs dbang gis dam pa'i brtul zhugs ma byed cig /dam pa min mupa'i lta ba cung zad ma bsnyen 3cig /mtshar la ma 'gro mi dge'i lam la ma gnas shig /rgyags par ma 'gro dga' min mi 9bzod ma nyan cig /snyan grags mi bzad brdzun la blo gros ma 'dzin cig /bstan bcos mthong las ⑩lhag par gtor /1ma ma 'phrog cig /blo ni mnyam par zhog cing chos ni gyis mdzod cig /dam pa rnams dang sbrel mdzod 96—178

ri mo khod mdzod cig /ji ltar phul byung 'di ni thob nas slar yang ni/ /rgya cher mngon par 'gro ba de ltar gyis mdzod cig /brtson 'grus brtsams nas dang ni bstan pa yongs bzung nas/ /rigs (7pa rnams ni bskyed nas skyon rnams zil mnan nas/ /'chi ba yang dag dran nas 'phags pa'i bya ba gyis/ /che ba'i bdag nyid thob nas zhi lam thob par gyis/ /gang gi 37'bras bu 'di ni zhi ba skyong ba ni/ /las de nyid ni slar yang byed par snye'os pa ste/ /yid gzhungs ldan pa 'di dang byed pa byas pa nyid/ /'bras bu gang zhig mthong bas sa bon bskrun byapar byed/ /'di na mchog gyur gang zhig sdig pa byed pa ste/ /snang ba de ni mun par gnas pa bdag gi lugs/ /chos ni gtso bo skyes bu gtso bo ma yin pa/ /mun pa snang ba la ni gnas pa bdag gi lugs/ /khyad 'phags gang zhig chos kyi cho gar 'jug pa ste/ dkar po dkar por mchog tu 'gro ba bdag gi lugs/ /dman pa gang zhig sdig pa'i las ni byed pa ste/ /de yang mun pa mun pa'i mtha' ru 'gro ba lugs/ /de phyir phung po bzhi po de rnams shes byas nas/ /rgyal po 'bad pa gyis shig de ltar ji ltar 'dir/ /bde 5nas bde bar gal te 'gro bar 'dod na ni/ /phyogs ni gsum pa bsnyen zhing snga ma ma yin no/ /gzhan gyis 4gzhan la dge ba byed pa ma yin zhing / /ci ste byed na de la rjes su 'gro ma yin/ /byis pa'i nyams pa yod min rang la 'thob thupa ste/ /ma byas pa yi 'ong ba 'grub pa yod ma yin/ /ma byas pa yang brgya la byed pa ma yin zhing / /ma byas pa ni gzhan du dge legs 'gyur ma yin//der ni 'gro ba la yang nor ni yod min te/ /de phyir dge ba'i las kyi cho gar 'bad pa bgyisaldu/ /gang zhig sdig pa lhag par spyod pa legs min zhing / /96—179

gson pa'i 'jig rten na de'i bdag la dga' ma yin/ /bdag gi ched du bdag gis 1sdig pa byas nas ni/ /gzhan du 'bras bu bdag nyid kho nas longs spyod do/ /rgyal po chen po ri bo chen po bzhi rnams ni/ /'ongs pa rnams su 'gro ba kun nas srub pa ste/ /chos kyi bya ba rnam pa sna tshogs bsten dulas ni/ /ji ltar 'thad pas gzhan na bya ba ci zhig yod zu/ /rga dang rgud pa nad dang de nas 'chi ba ste/ /bzhi po 'di rnams de bzhin du ni 'ongs pa ste/ /ri 4bo rnams kyis 5kun nas bskor ba bzhin du ni/ /'jig rten mtha' dag dbang med 'khol bar byed pa'o/ /de nas 'ongs pa rnams su dbang med sbug bsngal te/ /rten ni yod min mngon du 'thab min srung hūṃb med/ /der ni byed pa'i ched dz+wadu nor med chad pa med/ /chos las ma gtogs sman gzhan yod min na na/ /de ltar mi rtag gyur na 6gson pa'i 'jig rten na/ /glog ni g.yo ba'i yul la rab tu zhugs pa na/ /'chi ba'i lag pa'i rtse la yongs su gnas pa ste/ /chos ma yin pas 'bras bu longs spyod par 'os min/ /dbang chen dang mtshungs mi dbang de dang de rnams ni/ /g.yul du lha yi mngon par 'thab la phyin nas kyang / /rab tu rgyas pa rnams dang nges par zum pa rnams/ /dus kyi dus su bde dang sdug bsngal skal ba'o/ /'byung po 'dzin pa'i sa yang zad par 'gro ba ste/ /'jig pa'i mes ni lhun po de bzhin sreg par byed/ /rgya mtsho chen po yongs su bskams par 'gro ba ste/ /dbu ⑩ba dang mtshungs mi yi 'jig rten kye ma ci/ /shugs byas nas kyang rlung ni zhi bar 'gro ba ste/ /'jig rten gdungs nas kyang ni nyi ma nub par 'gro/ /bsregs nas kyang ni me nyid 'da' bar nyer 'gro ste/ /gang de de ltar gnas par 'gyur ba yin snyam 96—180

mam—/ /lus po 'di ni yun rings ①dus su bsrungs kyang ngam/ /sna tshogs longs spyod rnams kyis nye bar bskyangs kyang ni/ /de yis 'dir ni nyin zhag 'ga' zhig bzhugs nas su/ /skye bo chen po'i rjes su brtse ba mdzad nas ni/ / bde bar rngu 'pham byed kyis ni phyag gis mngon bsrungs pa'i/ /grong khyer la ni chen po'i tshogs kyis 1/rab tu dpags/ /me tog rab rgyas mya ngan med pas gsal byas shing / /yan lag dmar por gyur cing khu byug skad sgogs pa/ /ti se'i gangs ltar mtho ba'i lding khang phreng ba can/ /dpal ldan rgyal byed tshal ni de nas rab tu thob/ /des byeni gtsang ma'i chus gang phreng ba dkar po can/ /gser kyi bum pa dang bcas bum pa blangs nas ni/ /de nas dus su rgyal byed tshal ni bzang sbyin gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la ni rab tu phul bar gyur/ /de nas shākya thub pa lta 'dod rgyal po ni/ /sde rab 'pham byed rgyal byed tshal du song ba ste/ /song nas de nas bkur ste byas te thub pa la/ /rab tu btud cing gdan byas tshig 'di gsol ba'o/ /thub pa grong khyer 'dir ni khyed kyi gnas bzhed pa/ /nges par rang choni ko sa la rnams kyi dge ba'o/ /de nyid gzigs pa 'di 'dra brten pa med pa ni/ /nye bar 'tshe byas yul ni skal ba med pa'am/ /khyed mthong ba 'am yang na mngon par phyag 'tshal ba/ /yang dag thob po bdag cag rnams kyi rjes bzung phyir/ /dam pa rnams kyi 'dus pa thob nas 'jig rten na/ /tshim pa med kyang ji ltar tshim pa nyid yin no/ /gang gis khyarten can rlung ni rab tu g.yos pa ste/ /de yi bdag nyid las ni nye ba las 'gro ste/ /mkha' 'gro'i bya rnams lhun po'i 'dus pa nyer thob nas/ /rang bzhin rnam par spangs nas gser du 'gyur ba'o/ /de phyir 'di dang che ge 96—181

mor ni mgon gyur zhing / /skye bo legs pa'i rten las gzhan min bdag gi nags / / ga dha'i rmyesras po thub pa chen po rab thob nas/ /phur bu gsum pa'i khyim ltar lta na mdzes par gyur/ /'jig rten dag na rnyed (shepa rab rnyed sna tshogs pa/ /tshad dang ldan pa dag ni mdzad pa can yin la/ /khyod kyi nye ba las sheni don gang yin pa rnams/ /de dag rnams kyi grangs med nyams pa yod ma yin/ /legs pa khyod kyi nges pa'i lta ba'i lta ba las/ /'di las gzhan du rnyed pa shes pa ma yin zhing / /khyab bdag bdag ni gnod pa rnyed bla pyasdug bsngal ba/ /chags pa dang ldan rgyal po'i chos la spyod par 'gyurarī / /de ltar dbang po dang mtshungs rgyal po de ⑥yis ni/ /rnam pa de ltar mngon du gyur te gsan nas ni/ /don dang 'dod pa dag gi chags pa mkhyen nas su/ /de yi bsam pa yang dag bskul ba thub pas gsungs/ /mi dbang khyod kyi 5tshig 'di ngo mtshar che ma yin/ /khyod kyi spyod pa 'di ni legs pa rnams la min/ /'og nas 'phos pa 'gro bar 'dod pa rnams kyis ni/ /phan pa 'dod pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams la sdang 5/ /gang phyir sa skyong khyed kyi dgongs pa de nyid ni/ /des na khyod la 'dir ni cung zad smra 'dod de/ /de ni she shes par gyis shig bdag gi lta ba ni/ /'bras bcas ji ltar gyur pa khyed kyi de ltar gyis/ /mi skyong rgyal po'i dus kyis bcings nas bkug pa na/ /mdza' bshes ma yin gnyen min phun tshogs rjes 'gro min/ /thams cad kyis ni dman zhing dbang med 'gro ba ni/ /grib ma bzhin du las gcig rjes su 'gro ba nyid/ /de phyir mtho ris dang ni grags pa dam pa ni/ /mngon par 'dod bzhin chos kyi rgyal srid rjes su skyongs/ /rmongs pa las ni chos la 'khrul pa'i rgyal po yi/ /rgyal 96—182

srid de nyid mtho ris na yang ma yin no/ /'dir ni rgyal srid yang dag yongs su bskyangs nas ni/ /chos las ring min rta tu7rid mtho ris rab 'thob nas/ /'dir ni rmongs las mi yi bdag po ni kum+bha/ /chos las 'phos shing ka ldushi rnams su sa la zhugs/ /'phags pa yi dang sdig pa yi ni las kyi ni/ /khyod la dper bstan zhi ba bdag gis de smras te/ /rang gi 1skye dgu rnams ni rtag tu legs bsrungs shing ④/ /dpyad nas de phyir brtan pa dge la 'bad pa gyis/ /ji ltar srog chags rnams ni gtse bar ma byed cig /rtag par dbang po rnams ni rol par ma byed cig /'phags min gyis bsnyen khro ba 'dzin par ma byed cig /phyogs min bya bar sems ni g.yo bar ma byed cig /nga rgyal dang ni rgyags pa khur nas dus su ni/ /rab tu 'thor khruzhing shin tu gyur pa gnyid log gyur / /rnam pa de ltar 'jig rten 'gro ba shes nas su/ /de la ma nyal dge ba la ni gnyid ma log /'khor ba'i phyogs ni g.yo bar 'dzegs nas su/ /nges par ltung na sa gzhi bag med 'gyur ba'o/ /gang zhig bde ba 6'byel min de ni bsnyen bya min/ /gang gis 'bras bu legs min gang de bya ba min/ /gang zhig dge la sbyor min de ni bshes ma yin/ /sdug bsngal rnam par 'joms min gang de ye shes min/ /gal te ye shes min hūṃn yang srid ma yin zhing / /srid par gyur na lus med nyid la yin pa ste/ /lus su gyur na yul las thar pa ma yin zhing / /nyi tshe ma yin 'dod pa'i srid pa don med do/ /gang phyir lha na gnas rnams dus kyi dbang gis ni/ /gzugs med rnams kyang mdzad pa can phyir mi rtag ste/ /de bzhin 'jug pa min la blo gros zhugs bya zhing / /gal te 'jug pa med na sdug bsngal yod ma rkyeyin/ /gang phyir lus ni 'gro dang 96—183

gnas pa la sogs pa'i/ /sna tshogs rten gyi sdug bsngal dag gi rtsa ba ste/ /de phyir lus med du rmyeni ye shes nus pa gang / /de yod lus kyi bu lon yod pa ma yin no/ /gang las 'gro bas 'dod pa'i ched du bskyed pa yis/ /sdug bsngal chen po du ma rnams la nyer 'gro ste/ /'di las 'dod pa'i srid las khu rnam par dben nus shing / /sdug bsngal rnams las ⑦chags med nyam thag yod ma yin/ /de phyir gzugs dang bral ba'i lha rnams na yang ngam/ /'dod pa rnams dang ldan pa'i gzugs ldan rnams na yang / /skor ba nyid phyir 'jug pa zhi ba ma yin na/ /'dod pa dāspyod pa drug po rnams su sngon nyid do/ /rnam pa de ltar mi rtag sdug bsngal de med cing / /rtag par 'bar ba'i 'jig rten gsum po nyid mthong nas/ /bya tshang shing la sgong skyes rnams kyis phyegadung ba ltar/ /gang du 'jug la smon lam rigs pa ma yin no/ /mchog de rig par bya zhing gzhan ni rig bya min/ /mchog de blo gros yin zhing gzhan ni blo gros min/ /mchog de bya ba yin zhing gzhan ni grub pa min/ /chos 'di khyem dang ldan pa'i skye bo rnams kyis te/ /yod pa min zhes de ltar nges par rig bya min/ /nags sam khyim na gnas pa dag gi zhi ba ni/ /gang gis sgrub pa yod pa de yis 6 yod pa'o/ /tshad pas mngon par gdungs pa chu la rnam zhugs te/ /spyi thulas thams cad tshim pa nye bar 'gro ba nyid/ /sgon ma dang ldan mun pa ru ni mthong ba ste/ /rnal 'byor tshad ma'o na tshod ma yin rigs ma yin/ /kha cig nags na gnas kyang na tshod la mi spyor/ /brtul zhugs zad cing ngan 'gro la ni bsnyen pa nyid/ /kha cig khyem na gnas kyang rnam dag las can ni/ /bag dang ldan pa nges legs la 87ni bsnyen pa'o/ /mun pa'i rgya mtsho la ni lta ngan dba' rlabs 96—184

can / /sred pa'i chu la srog chags rnam par 'phyo rnams ①su/ /shes rab gru bo dran dang brtson 'grus skya ba ni/ /gang gis yod pa de ni de la sgol ba yod/ /de ltar yul la mchog tu song ba'i rgyal po de yis ni/ /thams cad mkhyen las chos kyi de nyid 'di ni nyer thob nas/ /rgyal srid ngan pa mi rtag g.yo zhes nyer skyes blo can ni/ /myos pa dang bral gnyis 'thung bzhin du mnyan yod nyid du zhugs / /sa dbang btud pa de ni shes nas mu stegs can gzhan rnams/ /der ni stobs bcu pa la rdzu 'phrul gyis ni 'gran btsugs khu gyur/ /sa skyong las ni rnam par gsol nas — snade nas bdag 'pham krupa'i/ /drang srong gis ni rdzu 'phrul ched du sdug pas gnas pa byas/ /de nas gsal zhing 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas dkyil 'khor can/ /skar ma rnams ni 'bar bar gyur pa'i nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /yang dag dga' zhing rnam pa sna tshogs blo can ston pa rnams/ /der ni thub pas rdzu 'phrul rnam pa mang pos pham par mdzad/ /de nas mnyan yod kyi rnguni de las skyes pa'i grags pa dang / /bkur ste nges pa mchog gi dpal gyis yongs su spangs par gyur/ /de nyid kyis ni srid pa gsum las gyen du 'dzegs pa ste/ /de'i stsophyir chos dag gsung bar bzhed cing yul la phan phyir ro/ /de nas thub pa mtho ris gnas pa'i yul ni ye shes kyis/ /rnam par btul dz+wanas mtho ris gshegs pa lo ni rnam da7yul des/ /mkha' la lha yi rgyal po'i bsod snyoms cho ga bzhin bzhes nas/ /lha yi 'jig rten dag nas sām ka par kyeni yang dag babs/ /de la gzhal med gnam sa'i logs la babs pa yi/ /zhi ba thob cing ltos pa dang bcas lha rnams rjes su 'ongs/ /sar gnas nam mkha'i logs la gyen du gdong phyogs rgyal po ni/ /de dang de 96—185

rnams mgo bo rnams kyis btud cing rab tu bzung / /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ rgyal byed kyi tshal rab tu bzhes pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //thar 'dod lha na gnas rnams dang / /skyed ma mtho ris su btul nas/ /thub pas gdul bya rnams 'dul zhing / /de nas de ni 'jig rten rgyus1/ /ri lnga'i dbus kyi grong khyer du/ /'od ldan 'tsho byed dbang po dang / /gro bzhin skyes dang yan lag sbyin/ /rnam par 'dren pas de nas btul/ /rgyal bo'i bu ni 'jigs med dang / /dpal sbas dang ni nye ba zu'akhor/ /n+ya gro dha sogs mthar ldan rnams/ /snga ma'i lta ba las zlog 1go/ /chos kyi thos pa nyid las ni/ /mi skyong dpal ni yangs ngapa can/ /spos 'dzin kyi rnguni dbang phyug 'dir/ /pad+ma zhes bya rnam par btul/ /de nas gnod sbyin gangs kyeldan dang / /rtse mo brgya dz+wapa de nas ni/ /rnam rgyas pha rol gnon pa yis/ /rnam rgyas ri bor btul ba'o/ /yon tan gzigs pas mi skyong ni bye/ /lta byed btsun mo'i 'khor bcas la/ /'tsho byed a mra'i nags tshal du/ /mtshan mo dad pas mesbyar bar mdzad/ /de nas pha rol 'gro ba can/ /bram ze zhi bar 'gro rnams des / /rdo ba'i ri bor phra mo yi/ /tshigs bcad don rnams klog tu bcug /de nas dam pa dran mdzad pas/ /dngos su nor sbyin mthong ba mo/ /dga' ba'i skyed ma legs ldan ma/ /'od ma'i tsher ma can du btul/ /de nas brtan ldan grong khyer du/ /brtsegs rmye sbyin gnyis skyes dam pa ni/ /mchod sbyin rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /mchod 'dod thar pa'i chos la btsud/ /de nas 96—186

lus 'phags ri bo ru/ /btsud phyed rtse mo nyid dang ni/ /lha min skyes ma dang lha rnams/ /nges par 'dzin du btsud par gyur/ /de nas aṅga'i grong khyer du/ /gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po dang / /mchog dang dbyug rmye pa dkar dmar dang //gtum po lto 'phyo che rnams btul/ /a pa ṇa yi grong khyer du/ /bram ze ke bya she la dag /dka' thub thob pa thar par sbyar/ /'tsho phyed sor mo'i phreng ba can / /bran bzangs dang mtshungs gnyis skyes ni/ /bcom ldan rdzu 'phrul phun tshogs kyis/ /phra mo rnams su btul ba ldumadzad/ /gang ba bzang po dang mtshungs rdzas/ /lug ces bya ba bzang pos 'tsho/ /nor sbyin bzang dang bzang po'i bu/ /bzang por yang dag rtogs par mdzad/ /de nas tshangs pa'i tshe ldan ming / /rnam rgyas 1tshangs pa'i krutshe ldan pa/ /gang 2gi smra ba 'usmra mchog gis/ /lus 'phags po yi grong du pham/ /yangs pa can gyi rdzing bu ru/ /srin bu sha za dang seng ge/ /la sogs lits+tsha bī gyernams dang / /mchog dang bden byed nyid btul to/ /de nas las bzang pos gnod sbyin/ /bzang po bzang po'i sems ldan pa/ /rgyan byed dang mtshungs grong khyer du/ /chos kyi lam la btsud pa'o/ /de nas blo dang ldan pa yis/ /shin tu mi bzad 'brog tu ni/ /gnod sbyin 'brog gnas zhes bya dang / /gzhon nu legs 'ongs la ston byeto/ /de nas gnod sbyin sdig med la/ /gnod sbyin bdag pos phyag byas pas/ /bde dga'i grong du thar pa ni/ /thar pa gzigs pas gdams pa mdzad / /thub pa grags phyo7pa yangs rnams dang / /gnod sbyin drag po'i las can dang / /kha spu ldan pa gnyis la ni/ /ga yar drang srong gis bstan to/ /de nas drang srong dkar min gyi/ /tsha bo kā kṛbye t+yā ya na ni/ / bā rā ṇa sī'i ⑪96—187

grong du sngonanyu/ /gnyis skyes stobs bcu ldan pas btul/ /mtsho 'obs bde bar pha rol 'gro'i①/ /grong la rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs nas/ /dus su tshangs pa rna bstod —7la/ /de nas des ni rjes su bstan/ /rjes su bstan de rab dang bas/ /drang srong mchog gi gtsug lag khang / /rtag par dri ldan kha la reg /tsan+dan rang bzhin byed du bcug /de nas gang du thub pa'i zhabs/ /rdo las 'khor lo'i mtshan mthong bas5/ /ser skya dka' thub ldan pa ni/ /'od zer ldan pa snyedes btul lo/ /de nas gnod sbyin glang po la/ /glang po ldan par bstan pa stekhye/ /de bzhin drag po bong bu ni/ /bcom brlag tu ni btul ba'o/ /yul 'khor skyong dang dzas mnyam pa/ /yul 'khor skyong zhes dran pa ni/ /grong rdal rags pa'i mdzod ldan du/ /ston pas de nas rnam par btul/ /tshangs pa dang 'dra skye bo mchog /dgra can du ni btul ba ste/ /mkhas pa rgya chen skyes bu can/ /nyon mongs dul bar de bzhin no/ /'jigs bcas kyi dang mtshams bzangs kyi/ /bu'i bu mos 'jug bu dag dang / /mu stegs gzhan rnams kyi skyemun pa/ /mnyan yod nyid du thub pas bcom/ /'dir ni bram ze mchod sbyin can/ /dge sogs rnams dang rigs gtsang dang / /ko sa 3la yi dbang phyug ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis ⑨dad pas sbyar/ /de nas bram ze mkhas pa ni/ /bram ze su ka sā ri dang ⑫/ /she ta bi ka'i 'brog zhi bar/ /bstan pa mchog gis bstan pa'o/ /de nas 'thab ⑪pa'i grong khyer du/ /grong khyer gtso dang dus byed dang / /'jigs pa'i las can chu srin klu/ /rab tu ma zhi zhi bar mdzad/ /de nas bhar ga 8rnams su des/ /gnod sbyin 'jigs byed btul mdzad cing / /rigs med kyi ni bla ma gnyis/ /rgan po de bzhin 96—188

rjes su bzung / /nor ldan kyi mchog dbyangs ldan dang / /bud med sgur mchog sogs rnams dang / /skyes chen de rnams de rnams ni/ /kau shām bīr ni rjes su bzung / /de nas spos 'dzin yul nyid dang / /klu chen sog 7ma med pa ni/ /dul ba'i bdag nyid dul ba la/ /nang gi pha rol son par rngugashegs—/ /'bar zhing 'jigs pa'i las can ni/ /mthar byed bzhin du sreg 'dod pa/ /rnam par btul nas mkhas pa des/ /dus su de nas gdams ngag bstan/ /de la sogs pa'i 'byung po rnams/ /sa pa ༄ snarnams dang mkha' 'gro rnams/ /btul jenas tshigs su rgya mtsho bzhin/ /sangs rgyas grags pa 'phel bar gyurahūṃ/ /che ba'i bdag nyid de mthong nas/ / lha sbyin zlom sems 6byas pa ste/ /bsam gtan rnams las 'khrul thob cing / / 'dra ba memin pa mang po byas/ /nye bar bcom pa'i sems ldan des/ /thub pa dge 'dun dbe+en /8byas shing / /'phye shelas 'dod pa ma byas te/ /de la gnod pa'i phyir brtsams so/ /de nas bya rgod phung po'i rir/ /rdo ba'i 'khrul 'khor byas pa ste/ /thub pa'i steng du gang 'phangs pa/ /ltung ba ma yin gnyis su gyur—/ /'jig rten dus su chu 'dzin sngon po sgra sgogs pa/ /zla ba 'gog pa la ni mkha' la rlung bzhin du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la ni mngon du gdong phyogs par/ /glang po'i dbang po ⑪rgyal po'i lam la gtad pa'o/ /lus kyis snun nyuhūṃpas yan lag mchog ni nyer blangs shing / /mche bas phug pas rgyu ma'i dra ba rab bkram pa'i/ /lus po rnams kyis rgyal po'i khab kyi lam rnams ni/ /rgyu bar dka' bar 6 byed la mngon par rab tu zhugs/ /sha ni 'dod pas 11 mi yi brla la rmugs pa ste/ /mche ba'i rtse mos reg cing g.yo ba'i rgyu ma'i phreng / /96—189

khrag gis gsher ba'i mgo bo sna ljags drag po yis/ /'phen pa'i don du rdo rnams bzhin du gyen du 'phen/ /gsum du rab dga'i chang gis 'thor rmyema'i dri ldan zhing / /rul ba'i khrag dang zhag gi dri yis bsgos rnams kyis/ /de tshe bskor zhing mtha' med khro ba dang ldan pa/ /grong khyer skye bo de la skyo bas 'jigs par byed/ /gnyis 'thung stsos pa dus kyi dbyug pa 'jigs 'dra ba/ /khengs las gdong ni bcos shing sgra skad 'thon pa ste/ /khros pas rnam par log pa'i mig can de mthong nas/ / hā hā byed rīpa rgyal po'i khab nas byung bar gyur/ /kha cig yid mi bde bas phyogs su bros pa ste/ /gzhan ni mtho snyeb min pa'i yul rnams la thim zhing / /de bzhin 'jigs pa las gzhan 'jigs pa ma bzung 7nas/ /gzhan rnams gzhan rnams dag gi khyim rnams la zhugs so/ /kha byug rnam par bye'adug pa'i seng ge'i sgra rnams ni/ /rang gi srog la the tshom yang dag ma bsams shing / /sangs rgyas la ni mngon par 'tshe ba ma byed ces/ /rab tu bzung nas gnyis 'thung de la rgyab nas 'bod/ /de bzhin gzhan rnams glang po spyong la 'bod pa ste/ /gzhan rnams 'di la thal mo dag gis phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas de la gzhan rnams 6bsdigs par byed pa ste/ /kha cig nor gyis 3sred cing 'dod par byed pa'o/ /rlung 'gro kyeskar khung dag nas rnam par lta bzhin du/ /lang tsho ma rnams lag pa g.yo zhing ngu ba ste/ /'jigs ma gzhan rnams gser gyi gdu bu dag dang ldan pa yis/ /zangs mdog lag pa rnams kyis mig rnams 'gebs byepa'o/ /yongs su ro myang glang pos 'joms par 'dod pa na/ /gyen du lag bteg skye bo ngu bar gyur na yang / /gshegs pa 'byed pa med cing gnod pa mi mnga' bar/ /bde bar gshegs pa rang 96—190

gnas rnam 'gyur med par gshegs/ /byams pas 'byung po rnams la rjes su brtse ba ni/ /gus pas lha rnams kyis ni rjes su 'gro ba ste/ /de la dbang po'i glang rmyebo ches kyang reg pa ru/ /nus pa ma yin gang phyir thub pa brtan par gshegs / /gang phyir rngusangs rgyas la ni rjes 'gro dge slong ste/ /des ni rgyang nas glang chen mthong nas bros pa ste/ /sna tshogs bdag nyid 'jig rten rang bzhin gyis byebazhin du/ /kun dga' bo gcig sangs rgyas la ni rjes su song / /de nas glang chen khros pa de ni nyer 'ongs nas/ /thub pa'i mthu las 'du shes nye bar thob pa ste/ /mig sman ri bo rdo rjes phye mar bcom pa bzhin/ /lus po rab tu zegs shing spyi bos 'gyel bar gyur / /de la shin tu mdzes shing 'dam skyes 'jam po yis/ /legs skyes sor mo'i dra ba'i phyag gis mgo bo la/ /zla ba chu 'dzin la ni 'od zer gyis bzhin du/ /gnyis 'thung dbang bo la ni thub pas reg par gyur/ /chu yi shin tu khur las dus kyi sprin bzhin du/ /zhabs kyi rtsa bar gnyis 'thung de ni bsdad pa ste/ /thub pas rna ba'i ta ltal g.yo med la gzigs shing / /de la sems can ma 6'os zhi bas bstan pa'o/ /sdig med dang bcas rnam par 'joms pa sdug bsngal te/ /sdig med nyid la glang chen gnod pa ma byed cig /srid pa srid par sdig med bcom pa'i srog chags kyis/ /bde 'gro brgyad la glang chen 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /'dod chags dang ni zhe sdang de bzhin gti mug ste/ /glang chen gsum po bzod par dka' ba'i chang yin la/ /chang gsum rnams dang thub pa rnams ni bral ba ste/ /rims nad med cing mya ngan 'das pa mngon par brnyes/ /de phyir mun par 'dod pa 'di ni spongs )'dod pa/ /chang ni spangs snyel rang gzhan 'du shes 96—191

thob par gyis/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i 'dam ni rgyas par chags pa ste/ /slar yang de ltar gnyis 'thung hūṃdabang po ma thong cig ༄ — /de nas glang po des ni gsung 'di thos nas su/ /chang ni spangs shing yang dag rig par song ba ste/ /bdud rtsi 'thungs nas nad rnams dag las grol ba bzhin/ /nang du song ba'i bde ba dam pa thob par gyur/ /slob ma bzhin du thub la rab btud de ma thag /chang ni yongs spangs glang po'i dbang po de mthong nas/ /kha cig chos hūṃrnams bskor zhing g.yug par gyur pa ste④/ /gzhan rnams lag pa rnams ni rdebs shing skad cho'adon to/ /gzhan rnams kyis ni mgo bos gyethub la phyag 'tshal zhing / /de nas de la gzhan rnams bskor ba byas pa ste/ /gzhan rnams 'phags pa nyid las glang chen la bstod cing / /ya mtshan dang bcas gzhan rnams rig par gyur pa'o/ /lding khang la gnas bud med gzhan rnams de la ni//gtsang zhing rin thang chen po'i gos rnams kyis mchod cing / /gzhan rnams gsar ba'i phreng ba yon tan yid 'ong dang / /rgyan ni de dang de dag rnams kyis mngon par 'thor/ /dus dang mtshungs pa'i glang bo dul bar gnas pa na/ /skye bo dad pa med pa dbus nas song ba ste/ /dbus gnas dz+wakhyad par las ni dang bar rab song zhing / /dad pa rnams kyang gang de bstan napar nye bar song //dad pa la gnas ma skyes dgra ni thub pa yis ḍa/ /glang chen dbang po de ni brtul skyeb mthong nas ni/ /ya mtshan gyur zhing de nas dga' ba skyes pa ste/ /sangs rgyas la ni mchog tu dad pa byas pa'o/ /nyon mongs rtsod ldan dus ni nges par log pa na/ /rdzogs ldan dus ni 'ongs nas be+er yang chos don bzhin/ /de ltar rdzu 'phrul dang ldan snyan grags mchog rnams kyis/ /rab tu gnas pa'i 96—192

dka' 1ldan thub pa mchog 'phel to/ /mi dge ba dang yongs su ldan pa'i lha sbyin no 37/ /nyon mongs sdeg pa'i las ni mang po byas nas ni/ /mi skyong ste na rgu ba gnyis skyes drang srong gi /dmod pa las bzhin sa yi 'og tu bying bar gyur / /sangs rgyas kyi /spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ las kyi rgyun gyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas 'jig rten rjes bzung nas/ /dus kyi 5smra ba rnams kyi mchog /chos kyis hūṃs ni khyab mdzad nas/ /mya ngan 'da' ba dang mtshungs dgongs/ /de nas dus su rgyal khab na )/ /pa ṭā li yi grong du gshegs/ /mchod rten pa ṭā choli mtshon pa/ /der ni 'phags pa de bzhugs so/ /dus ni de tshe grong khyer gyi/ /lits+tsha bī /snani zhi ba'i phyir/ /ma ga dh+wa yi rgyal po yi/ /blon po char dbyibs kyis byas so/ /lha rnams kyis der rang gi nor/ /nye bar len pa rab gzigs nas/ /grong de 'gro na phul byung du/ /de bzhin gshegs pas 11rnam par gsungs/ /de tshe char pa'i rnam pa yis1 / /bkur byas byed pa rnams kyi mchog /rgya mtsho'i chung ma gtso bo 1ṣ+pel/ /mngon phyogs slob ma dang bcas gshegs/ /gaṅgā'i 'gram du de gshegs nas/ /ji ltar rnyed gru de dang des / /skye bo rnams ni sgol ba gzigs/ /de rnams gzigs nas thugs mdzad do/ /'bad pas chu bo sgol ba la/ /bdag gi de ltar 'dra ba rnguyin/ /de phyir rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /bdag gi gru med rab tu 'gro/ /de ltar der ni slob mar bcas/ /lha mi 6rnams la mi snang zhing / /rlung gis la'agros kyang phan mdzad nas/ /skad cig gis ni pha rol gyur7/ /sdug bsngal mtsho yi 3pha 96—193

rol sngon/ /ye shes gru bos de mkhyen nas/ /be+er yang gru 'di ma dmigs nas//thub pas gaṅgā bsgral ba'o/ /bcom ldan nyi ma mdzes pa ni/ /gang gi sgo las nges 'byung ba/ /de ni de tshe go tam sgor/ /de la mchod don nyid du byas/ /'gram gang dag las rnam 'dren pa/ /gaṅgā'i pha rol du gshegs pa/ /de ni stegs su 'gro la grags/ /de yi rigs kyis gyomangon par brjod/ /de nas sgrol 'dod mi rnams dang / /rgal ba rnams dang sgol ba rnams/ /ya mtshan rnam rgyas gdong rnams kyi/ /mig rnams de la btung 5bar gyur/ /de nas gaṅgā'i 'gram nas ni/ /sangs rgyas ku ḍa'i ④grong du gshegs/ /der ni chos ldan 5gtam mdzad nas/ /nā dā'i kar ni mngon par gshegs/ /dus ni de tshe de na ni/ /skye bo chen po rgud thupa ste/ /gang gis dz+wagang du gang 'gro ba/ /de rnams la der thub pas gsungs/ /der ni mtshan mo gcig phul nas mo7/ /yangs pa can gyi grong du gshegs/ /de nas a mra skyong ba'i ḍas/ /dpal ldan tshal du dpal stug gshegs/ /a mra skyong ma res nyu1ma'i gtso/ /rnam par 'dren pa der thos nas/ /rnam dul jeg pa la gnas nas/ /mchog tu dga' bas rab tu song / /phra ba'i gos dkar 'dzin pa mo/ /phreng ba med cing dbyug 7bral ma/ /lha yi bya ba'i dus su ni/ /legs ma / 1rigs kyi mna' ma 'dra / /rang gi gzugs kyis khengs pa yi/ /dam pa lits+tsha dī 6 rnams kyi/ /sems rnams dang ni nor rnams dang / /yon tan mtha' dag rnams kyis thu phrogs / /dpal dang mdzes pa brtan ⑩pa yis/ /nags kyi lha mo'i gzugs 'dra ba/ /de ni theg pa la babs nas/ /skyen par nags der rab tu zhugs/ /rigs kyi mo btsun gdung ba mo/ /mig rab ⑪g.yo ba de gzigs nas/ /bde 96—194
