bar gshegs pas rnga dbyangs kyis/ /dge slong rnams la bka' sprul pa/ /stobs chung rnams kyi hūṃyid kyi rim— —/ /a mra skyong ma 'di mngon —'ongs/ /dran ldan bdud rtsi'i sems ldan rnams/ /ye shes kyis geni khyed rnams gnas/ /nye sar sbrul ni mchog yin zhing / /ral gyi gdengs pa'i dgra bo mchog /dran dang ye shes rnams pyebral ba'i/ /nye sar bud med rnams ma yin/ /bsdad pa 'am ni nyal ba 'am/ /'gro 'am /khuyang na gnas pa 'am/ /bud med ri mor bris pas kyang / /mi rnams kyi dz+wani yid 'phrog go/ /'di rnams zhen pas nyam thag gam/ /gyen du lag bteg ngu na yang / /skra bkram rnams kyis bsreg pa ru / /nus na mo btsun rnams sngon nyid/ /pha rol po 9 'byel rnam mang po'i/ /dbrog bya yon tan kyis bslus rnams/ /de yi rang bzhin ma mthong ste/ /bud med rnams la byis rnams rmongs/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med dang / /mi dge ba zhes mthong nas ni/ /lta zhing sgom tso 7pa po rnams kyi11/ /sems ni zil gyis non ma yin/ /gnas de rnams su legs goms blo/ /spyod yul rnams su ba lang bzhin/ /lha yi yul rnams kyis 'joms par/ /nus min /nami rnams kyis ci spos1)/ /de phyir shes rab mda' 'dzin zhing / /brtson 'grus gzhu ni lag pa na/ /dran pa'i go cha yongs bgos shing / /yul gyi 'du shes can du mnos / /lcags kyi thur ma tsha mo yis/ /mig la reg pa mchog yin zhing / /g.yo ba'i mig can bud med la//ma rungs dran pas lta phyir min/ /gal te dus ni de yi tshe/ /chags pa'i sems kyis hūṃ9dus byed na/ /dud 'gro 'am ni 'og nyid du/ /dbang med bcings nas khrid 15par byed/ /de phyir 'jigs pa 'di shes nas/ /mtshan 96byed195

mar spros —1pa mi bya zhing / /lus po la ni gzugs tsam du/ /gang gis mthong ba de mthong ngo / /dbang pos 'jig rten na yul rnams/ /'chi min khyedabang po rnams des min/ /gang zhig de rnams la chags gyur/ /de ni de rnams las 'ching ngo / /ba lang gnyis kyi sbyor ba'i phyir/ /sbyor ba la gcig ji ltar gyur / /yul dang dbang bo de dag ni/ /chags pa phan tshun de ltar min/ /mig gis gzugs ni 'dzin pa ste/ /sems kyis rnam par rtog par byed/ /rnam par rtog las der skye zhing / /chags dang chags bral nyid kyang ngo / /rnam par ma brtags dbang po'i don/ /gal te don med ched gyur na/ /dbang po'i spyod yul la spyod pa/ /thams cad don med kyis spyor to/ /de phyir ma dor dran pas dang / /bag yod mchog tu 'gro bas dang / /rang don rjes su mthong bas dang / /gdung med sems kyis bsgom par bya/ /de ltar don mthar ma gyur pa'i/ /dge slong rnams la 4snade rjes bstan/ /ltos byas a mra skyong ma ni/ /thal mo sbyar byas nye bar 'ongs/ /des snyeni thugs zhi drang srong ma/ /shing drung gnas pa mthong nas ni/ /nags kyi yongs su longs spyod kyis / /mchog tu rjes su 'dzin pa snyam/ /de nas bkur ste 6mang po las/ /g.yo yang lta byed rab bkod nas/ /me tog tsam pa ka rgyas ltar/ /mgo bos thub pa la phyag 'tshal/ /kun mkhyen gyis kyang rjes gnang rngom/ /de nas sa la bsdad pa ste/ /de yis blo la bzod gsung gis/ /thub pas de la bka' stsal to / /bsam pa 'di ni yon tan ldan/ /rnam dag sems dpa' kyenyid bstan to / /bud med byis pa phul gnas pa/ /chos la 'dod pa rnyed par dka'/ /gal te chos kyi bdag nyid gyur/ /zhen pas bcom pa'i sems ldan pa'i/ /na 96—/96

rab mi mo rnams kyis ① dang / /blo ldan mi rnams kyis mtshar cing thu rang bzhin gyis ni blo chung zhing / /g.yo ba'i sems ldan lang tsho ma/ /yul gcig ro yis 'jig rten na/ /chos shes shes pa ya mtshan no/ /khyod kyi chos la yid gyur pa/ /de ni khyod kyis 1bdag nyid don/ /mi rtag gson pa'i 'jig rten na / /chos las gzhan na nor yod min/ /nad kyis thund med 'joms pa ste/ /rga bas lang tsho gcod pa nyid/ /'chi bas srog ni len pa ste/ /chos kyis rgud pa yod ma yin/ /gang phyir dga' ba rnams dang bral/ /mi dga' ba rnams dang sbyor zhing / /mngon par 'dod pa thob pa na/ /de phyir chos ni mchog tu 'gro / /gzhan dbang sdug bsngal chen bo ste/ /rang dbang mchog tu bde ba nyid / /ma nu'i rigs su skyes na yang / /bud med thams cad gzhan dbang ngo / /gang phyir gzhan dbang nyid phyir dang / /de bzhin phru gu 'dzin pa'i phyir / /bud med rnams kyi sdug bsngal lhag /de phyir yang dag nges par 'os//de ltar thub pa chen po'i gsung / /rang bzhin gyis dang mkhas las dang / /brtan las byis kyang byis min bzhin/ /thos shing mngon par dga' ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi smra ba yis/ /'dod pa'i bdag nyid can gyis 5sems la brabs pa ni/ /bud med nyid ni smad cing yul las log pa ste/ /gang ༄ byegi skye bo'i rten la btsog 3par byas pa'o/ /de nas me tog khur las tsu ta'i mchod sdong bzhin/ /yang dag kun nas dud pa'i lus kyi mchod sdong can/ /thub pa chen po la ni gus pas mig zhugs shing / /yang yang chos ni rnam par dag pa'i lta bas gnas/ /rang bzhin kyis ni ngo tsha dang ldan bud med de/ /chos ni mngon par 'dod pas yang yang bsgul ba ni/ /'dam skyes mdzod dang 96—197

'dra bas thal mo sbyar nas ni/ /dal bus smra ba'i skad kyi gdangs kyis ①gsol ba'o / /bcom ldan don mdzad bdag la kyegasung don du/ /nang par bsod snyoms dus su dge slong sder bcas pa/ /sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i mdzad po 'jig rten na/ /'bras bur gyur pa'i ༄ 7bdag la 'bras bur mdzad du gsol/ /de nas de yi gus pa de ltar gzigs nas dang / /sems can rnams ni bza' ba'i dbang nyid mkhyen nas ni/ /gsung ma phye nas bde bar gshegs pas de ltar zhes / /de la nges par rnam 'gyur brnga yis mdzad pa'o/ /skad cig mdzad pa dang ldan spyan yangs mchog gi chos mnga' zhing / /chos kyi sgod la des ni dga' zhing mgu la rungs 7pa ste/ /gus pas rnyed pa mchog ni rnam par nges shing bstod par gyur/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/a mra skyong ma'i nags gzigs pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas thub pa'i thugs rig nas/ /phyag 'tshal nas kyang grong du song / /de ni lits+tsha bīs 5thos nas/ /lta 'dod sangs rgyas la song ngo / /dkar po'i rta dang shing rta gdugs/ /phreng ba rgyan dang bgo ba rnams/ /kha cig kha cig de rnams dang / /dmar ser rnams dang de bzhin gzhan/ /kha cig bai ḍūr+ya ljang dang / /gzhan rnams rma bya'i mjug ma ste/ /de ltar cha lugs rgya chen po//bdag gis khyadaga' byed rnams dang song / /ri bo rnam 5rgyas ro stod can/ /gser gyi gnya' shing lag pa rnams/ /dpal ldan bong ring dngos su ni/ /de rnams mtho ris bzhin du mdzes/ /mtshams sprin rkang la sna tshogs rnams/ /glog ni rab tu snang ba bzhin/ /shing rta rnams las babs 'dod pas/ /de 96—198

rnams gnas pa rnam par mdzes/ /dbu rgyan rnam g.yo rnam btud pa'i/ /brtan rnams thub la phyag 'tshal nas/ /nga rgyal ldan rnams rgyags med bzhin/ /chos la dga' bas de rnams gnas/ /nyi ma sprin dang bral ba yi2/ /logs su khyer 'jigs gzhu bzhin du/ /thub pa'i drung der de rnams kyi/ /chags bral dkyil 'khor mdzes pa'o/ /sa la seng ge gnas pa rnams/ /gser gyes spras pa'i seng ge'i gdan/ /seng ge la sogs de rnams la/ /mi yi seng ges de nas gsungs/ /gzugs dang dpal dang stobs la sogs/ /bkur mang rnams dang ldan pa ni/ /khyed kyi chos la gus 'di hūṃgang / /de las lhag par mdzes pa nyid/ /tshul khrims la sogs yon tan gyis/ /ji ltar 'jig rten mdzes de ltar/ /lus ni sna tshogs gos sam rgyan/ /phreng ba rnams kyis — —ma yin no/ /gang du khyed cag bdag po rnams/ /chos shes 'dul ba 'dod pa rnams / /spong byed pa rnams rjes bzung zhing / /skal ba bcas rnams bdag gi jelugs/ /'phags skyes 5rnyed par dka' dus su/ /chos la gnas rnams srung byed gyur/ /phyis 'byung ma yin yul rnams kyi/ /skal bas dman pa rnams kyis 'umin/ /dpal ldan skal ba chen po rnams/ /chos shes srung bar byed rnams kyis skyo/ /bsrung ba nyid kyis yul 'di ni/ /chos kyis kyang ni rjes su 'dzin/ /rlung byernams rgal 'dod pa la rnams/ /khyu mchog rgal lku ba rnams kyi bzhin/ /rgyal po rnams kyis gang bzung ba'i/ /yul la de nas skye dgu 'gro/ /khyed cag rnams la tshul khrims de/ /rtag par 'gyur bar 'os pa ste/ /bdag gi don ni 'dod rnams kyi/ /'dir dang song nas dbrog bya min / /yid ni tshim zhing bkur mang dang / /rnyed dang grags dang yid ches 96—199

nyid / /dga' ba nyid dang song nas bde/ /tshul khrims kyi ni 'bras bu che/ /'byung po rgyu dang mi rgyu yi/ /rten ni ji ltar sa yin pa/ /de ltar yon tan thams cad kyi/ /rten ni tshul khrims dam pa'o/ /'phur 7sna'adod gshog pa med pa dang / /rgal 'dod gru med ji lta bar/ /mi ni tshul khrims rnam spangs par//dge legs 'dod pa de ltar shes/ /me tog 'bras bus khyab pa'i shing / /tsher ma can gyur ji lta bar/ /thos dang gzugs don phun tshogs pa/ /tshul khrims 'chal pa de ltar ro/ /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan ldan zhing / /khang bzangs 2rnams su gnas na yang / /tshul khrims dang ldan skye bo gang / /de yi drang srong dang mnyam 'gros/ /ngur smrig shing shun zur phud dang / /gtsug phud spyi bo ral pa rnams/ /tshul khrims nyams pa kun rnams kyi/ /bcos ma 1nyid du shes par bya/ /stegs las dus gsum khrus byas nas/ /me la lan gnyis bsregs nas dang / /gdung ba drag por gdungs nas kyang / /tshul khrims med na bdag ma yin/ /sha za rnams la lus byen nas/ /ri yi logs nas bor nas sam/ /me 'am chur ni bdag mchongs na/ /tshul khrims med na bdag ma yin/ /'bras bu rtsa ba chu 4za zhing / /ri dwags bzhin du rtswa za 'am/ /rlung gi bza' ba 'dod pa yang / /tshul khrims med na bdag chomi 'gyur/ /mi gang tshul khrims kyis dman pa/ /de ni bya dang ri dwags mtshungs/ /rdol ba'i sgod ni chu yis bzhin/ /de ni chos kyi snod ma yin/ /'jigs pa dang ni gtam ngan dang / /yid mi ches dang mi dga' ⑩nyid/ /mngon sum 'dir ni thob pa ste/ /song nas don med za bar 'gyur/ /de phyir tshul khrims gzhom mi bya/ /'brog dgon dag na lam mkhan bzhin/ /rang dbang dag ni rnyed 96—200

dka' ba'i/ /tshul khrims mtho ris dag na gru/ /skyon rnams kyis bcom sems kyis ni/ /thams cad bcom nas 'jug pa ste/ /tshul khrims rab tu gnas byas nas/ /nyon mongs 'joms la 'bad zirmyepa gyis/ /de phyir dang por nga snyam pa/ /brgyan par 'dod pas spang bar bya/ /bsreg ༄snyebya za ba'i du ba bzhin/ /yon tan rnams kyis nga snyam nyid/ /skar ma nyi ma zla ba rnams/ /sprin gyi dra ba chen pos bzhin/ /nga rgyal gyis bcom yon tan rnams/ /yod par gyur kyang mdzes ma yin/ /dregs pa ngo tsha 'joms pa ste/ /mya ngan gyis gtan dga' bas lus/ /yon tan rnams kyi rtsa ba nas/ /'joms phyir nga'o snyam pa skye/ /'gran pa dang ldan nga rgyal las/ /lha min lha rnams kyis bcom zhing / /mi skyong ta cela'i byin pa dang / /dong gsum pa rnams zad par gyur/ /gang zhig mi rtag dngos rnams su/ /mchog ni nga yin snyam pa dang / /mi dman pa ni nga zhes snyam/ /de ni mkhas pa min par rtogs/ /gzugs ni brtan pa ma yin zhing / /'jig pa'i chos can g.yo ba yis/ /nga zhes gang zhig nga rgyal te/ /yongs su rtog pa min gzhan ci/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags stobs ldan pa/ /rab gab lhan skyes dgra bo ste/ /bshes min nang 3na spyod pa bzhin / /gang zhig 6bshes kyi sgo nas 'joms/ /'dod chags me dang me nyid ni/ /sreg pa'i bdag nyid kyis mnyam ste/ /'dod chags me ni 'bar ba na / /mtshan mo de nyid ring bar 'gyur/ /'dod chags me'i stobs ji 'dra ba / /rnge yi stobs 3ni de 'drar smin/ /me ni chu rnams kyis shes te/ /'dod chags me ni mtshos kyang min/ /dus su nags su mes tshig rnams/ /nags kyi shing rnams skye ba ste/ /'dod chags mes tshig blo med (ṭ+wārnams/ /96—201

chos la skye ba ma yin no/ /chags las bde ba tshol ba ste/ /bde phyir mi dge ba byed cing / /mi dge ba las dmyal bar 'gro/ /chags pa dang mnyam dgra bo med/ /chags las sred pa skye ba ste/ /sred las 'dod pa rnams la chags/ /'dod pa rnams las sdug bsngal 'thob/ /chags pa dang mnyam yul med do/ /chags pa zhes bya'i nad chen po/ /de ni byis pas rtogs ma yin/ /mi rtag nyid las mi gtsang las/ /sdug bsngal nyid las bdag med las/ /gal te mthong na 2mi chags te/ /log pa'i blo yis chags pa'o/ /de phyir dngos po la chags pa/ /gang du nye bar skye ba na/ /der ni ji ltar 'gyur brtag ste/ /gyur pa mthong ba zhes brjod do/ /yon tan yongs su rtogs bye pa na/ /ji ltar chags par nye byebar 'gro/ /yon tan med na yongs rtogs ④na/ /de bzhin khro ba 'gugs par byed/ /de phyir khro ba spong 'dod pasaye/ /zhe sdang yongs su brtag mi bya/ /dkar min 'gros las ngu ba bzhin/ /khro ba las ni zhe sdang 'dzag /khro ba gzugs ldan rnams kyi dga'6/ /mig ldan rnams kyi mun pa yang / /chos don 'dod pa rnams kyi gshed/ /mos 5pa'i mi mthun pa nyid do//khro ba blo yi mun pa mchog /mdza' bshes gyur pa'i dgra bo mchog /bkur ste mang po'i gcod pa po/ /zil gyis non ldesnapa'i byed pa po/ /de bzhin khro ba mi bya zhing / /byas nas kyang ni dor bar bya/ /dmug pa'i rang bzhin lto 'phye ༷rmye bzhin / /khro ba'i rjes su 'jug mi bya/ /skor ba'i shing rta bzhin gang gis/ /khro ba brtan pas thag pas bzung / /de bdag kha lo sgyur snyam ste/ /cig shos skye bo thag pa 'dzin/ /gang zhig khro ba 'dod pa ste/ /skye ba 'gog pa ⑫'dod ma yin/ /phyis de khro ba med pa na/ /me la reg pa bzhin du bsreg /khro ba 96—202

skyes pas sngon rol du/ /bdag nyid kyis ①ni sems bsreg buste/ /rnam par 'phel zhing phyin pa chani/ /gzhan ni sreg gam ④mi sreg gam/ /nad sogs nye bar 'tshe rnams kyiphya/ /gang tshe 'jig rten brtse ba rnams⑥/ /lus can bshes ma yin rnams la/ /gnod sems byas nas yon tan ci/ /de phyir 'jig rten sdug bsngal ba/ /shes nas khro ba zlog dz+wapa'i phyir/ /'byung po kun la byams pa dang / /snying rje nyid ni bsgom par bya/ /de ltar nyon mongs lhag pa gang / /de yi de tshe gzigs pa ste/ /de la brtse bas sangs rgyas kyis/ /de rnams la gsungs smad pa'o/ /sems can nyam thag rnams la ni/ /ji ltar rang bzhin gyis mkhas pa'i/ /sman pas sman ni gsungs pa ste/ /nad rnams nye bar zhi phyir ro/ /de bzhin chags dang rga sogs kyi/ /nad kyis 'byung po nyam thag la/ /thub pas bsam pa mkhyen nas ni/ /de nyid shes pa'i sman byin to/ /de ltar thub pa'i gsung hūṃl ni/ /lits+tsha bī 9rnams mngon dga' ste/ /rab 'phyang gtsug gi nor bu can/ /mgo bo rnams kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas thal mo rnam sbyar nas/ /cung zhig dud pa'i lus rnams kyis/ /phur bu la ni lha rnams bzhin/ /sangs rgyas la ni byon par zhus/ /dang po a mra skyong ma'i rigs/ /thub pas de rnams la gsungs nyu— shing / /dam pa rnams kyis shā1 thog mar ni/ /snyan mnan 'dor bya min par gsungs/ /de rnams bud med de yis ni/ /bdag la bslus par shes pa ste/ /de bzhin gshegs la mchod mang po/ /nyis thu'agyur nyid du byas pa'o/ /legs brjod drang srong sngags rnams kyis/ /sbrul rnams kyi ni dug bzhin du/ /kun mkhyen gyis bstan blade rnams ni/ /rab tu zhi ba'i yid rnams song / /de yi mtshan mo 'das nas ni//96—203

a mra skyong mas bkur byas te/ /'od ma ldan pa'i grong du ni/ /dbyar rnams rnam par 'das pa na/ /yangs pa can nyid du gshegs shing / /spre'u rdzing gi 'gram du ni/ /thub pa chen po bzhugs pa'o/ /shing gi rtsa bar de bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du ni 'bar ba la/ /nags tshal de ni snang byas shing / /nye bar 'ongs nas bdud kyis smras/ /ṣ+pe rañdza na'i 'gram du sngon/ /thub pa khyod la bdag gis smras/ /bya ba byas pa mya ngan zlos/ /zhes 'dir khyod kyis lan smras so/ /nyam thag pa rnams 'jigs med cing / / nyan thos lkurnams ni don byas par/ /bdag gi 2snaji srid ma gyur pa / /de srid mya ngan mi 'da' zhes / /de 'di mang po rnams grol zhing / /de bzhin grol bar 'dod rnams dang / /grol bar gyur pa thurnams nyid de/ /de phyir mya ngan 'da' bar 'os/ /de nas tshig 'di gsan gyur nas/ /zla ba gsum na mya ngan 'da'/ /mi brtan pa ni dor cig ces/ /dgra bcom rnams kyi mchog gis gsungs5 / /de nas dam bca' 'di shes nas/ /yid la re ba gang ba ste/ /rab tu dga' zhing mgu ba ni/ /de nyid du ni mi snang gyur/ /de nas drang srong chen po'i thugs kyi ting nge 'dzin/ /rnam pa de ltar rnal 'byor stobs las mdzad pa nyid//sgu tshe ji ltar gyur pa sngon du btang ba ste/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu las mtshungs pa med pa 'tsho bar gyur6/ /des ni sku tshe btang ba'i yud tsam de la ni/ /bud med myos ma dz+wabazhin du sa ni g.yos gyur la/ /ma yis tshos pa'i lhun po'i rdo ba rim bzhin du/ /phyogs rnams dag las sgon ma chen po rnams lhu dang / /de bzhin kun nas dbang po'i rdo rje mi bzad ḍarnams/ /glog dang bcas shing me yi /— snasnying po can g.yos shing / /bskal pa 'jig che 'jig rten bsreg par 96—204

'dod pa bzhin/ /phyogs rnams thams cad rnams su me dag 'bar bar gyur/ /shing rnams kyis ⑨ni phung po 'khogs pa rnams bor zhing / /ri rnams kyis ni rtse mo rnams ni dor ba ste/ /rlung gis mngon par gang ba'i rdo ba'i phug bzhin du/ /mkha' la rnga rnams kyi ni ma rungs sgra rnams bsgrags/ /de nas de ltar kun du bskyod tshe yud tsam la/ /mi yi 'jig rten na dang lha dang nam mkha' la/ /nying 'dzin chen po de las rnam par bzhengs mdzad nas/ /thub pa chen pos gsung ni 'di nyid gsungs pa'o/ /shing rta srog shing rnam par nyams pa dang 'dra ba'i/ /tshe btang lus po nang gi stobs las 'dren bgyi zhing / /sgo nga'i skye gnas pa rnams sgo nga phye nas bzhin/ /srid pa'i 'ching las tshe dang lhan cig 'grol bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyis brlabs pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas bskyod pa de mthong nas/ /kun dga' bo ni spu langs shing / /ci zhig gyur zhes shugs 'ongs te/ /'dar bar gyur cing dga' ma gyur/ /kun mkhyen gtan tshigs mkhas pa la/ /des der gtan tshigs dris pa ste/ /de nas de la thub pas ni/ /khyu mchog myos pa'i dbyangs kyis gsungs/ /rgyu mtshan gang gis g.yos pa 'di/ /bdag gi snyetshe 'di btang 4ba la/ /zla ba gsum ni yongs bgrangs par/ /byin gyis brlabs nas de ༄ni 'tsho/ /de ltar thos nas kun dga' bo/ /tsan+dan ljon pa'i thang chu ni/ /glang po che yis brabs pa bzhin/ /mchi ma phyung zhing g.yos par gyur/ /des gnyen nyid phyir bla ma'i phyir/ /chags bral min phyir sdug bsngal zhing / /snying rje bar 'uni 96—205

rnam zlos termye/ /yongs su dga' ba med par ngus/ /mgon gyi nges pa thos gyur nas/ /bdag gi lus ni lhung ba bzhin/ /bdag gi phyogs rnams spobs pa med/ /bdag gis ṭ+wā chos rnams thos pa rmongs/ /gangs kyis gtser rngo rnams la 5me bzhin/ /rga ba rnyings pa'i chos ltarnams su/ /kyi hud mis bsngags skyen par ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan 'da'/ /nyon mongs 'brog dgon chen po ru/ /chud zos lus dang ldan rnams la/ /lam mkhyen shin tu skyen pa ru/ /lam mkhan nges par nyams par 'gyur/ /thag ring she lam la rab zhugs pa'i/ /srid pa yongs ldan bdag rnams kyi/ /lam na rdzing bu bsel ba'i chu/ /shin tu myur bar bskam par gyuratso/ /blo ni rdzi 87ma zhi ba sminatso / /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gzigs/ /ye shes rnam mespangs 'jig rten gyi/ /mig ni nges par zum par 'gyur/ /nges par lo thog skyed 1bye rnams su/ /chu ni don gnyer ngal rnams la/ /char bab 7gyur nas skyen pa ru/ /chu sbyin sprin ni nub par 'gyur/ /mi shes mun pas phrogs rnams su/ /sems can lam gol ba rnams lanyurte/ /rab tu gsal ba'i sgon ma ni/ /shin tu skyen par zhi bar 'gyur/ /de nas de ltar mya ngan gyis/ /sems gzir kun dga' bo gzigs nas/ / zhi byed mgon pos de nyid ni/ /de nyid rig pa'i mchog gis 6gsungs/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin shes nas ni/ /mya ngan ma byed kun dga' bo/ /'dus byas ngo bo mi rtag cing / /'gro ba 'di kun 'dzad zupa nyid/ /lus can rtsod skrepa'i skyed tshal du/ /sdug pa kun dang bral ⑫ba ste/ /brtse ba kun nas thang cig 8ces/ /sngon du bdag gis smras pa nyid/ /'dus /sna byas g.yo ba skyes pa gang / /rten nas 'byung ba dbang med de/ /bdag gis rtag 96—206

par gyur cig ces/ /'di ni rnyed par mi nus so/ /sa stengs kye'abyung po rtag gyur na/ /'jug pa g.yo ba ma yin zhing / /thar pas bya ba su yis 'gyur/ /de phyir mthar thug 'dod pa'o/ /ci ste khyod dam skye bo gzhan/ /bdag la khyod kyi sred pa ci/ /gang phyir ngal ba skyes pa 'di/ /khyod kyis bdag dang bral bas byas/ /lam ni mtha' dag khyed cag la/ /bdag gis bstan 3snacing bshad pa ste/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang 1slob dpon gyithu/ /dpe mkhyud med ces gzung phyemadzod cig /bdag gi gyeganas sam nyer zhi na/ /don ni de tsam nyid yin te/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams chos kyi sku/ /lus kyis khyed cag la don ci/ /de phyir dang ngam bdag 'das tshe/ /skyo ba yis dang bag yod dang //bdag gi sgon mas gsal byas te/ /chos kyi sgon ma rtag par ro/ /der zhugs brtson 'grus brtan pa dang / /rtsod med bdag gi don la mkhas/ /blo ni gzhan dbang ma yin pa/ /bdag gi sgon ma zhes shes bya/ /rig pa dang ldan mkhas pa ni/ /gang gi 7sgon mas mun pa bzhin/ /shes rab sgon mas ru 'joms pa stekye/ /chos kyi sgon mar shes par bya/ /dge legs nye bar thob bya'i phyir/ /de dag rnams kyi spyod yul zhi/ /lus dang tshor ba nyid dang ni/ /sems dang bdag med pa nyid do/ /rus lpags khrag dang rgyus pa dang / /sha dang spu sogs rnams kyis dkris/ /mi gtsang lus su mthong bas ni/ /lus la chags pa ma yin no/ /de lta de ltar rkyen rnams kyis/ /'jug pa'i tshor ba rnams su ni/ /sdug bsngal zhes de ltar mthong ba'i/ /bde ba'i shes rab rab tu 'joms/ /skye ba dang ni gnas pa dang / /chos kyi 'god pa nyid dag ni/ /zhi ba'i sems kyis mthong ba yinakye/ /rtag par 'dzin pa sdog pa'o/ /rkyen 96—207

rnams las ni skyes pa rnams/ /phung po rnams ni mthong ba yi ngar 'dzin gyis ni skyed pa po/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa 'jug ma yin/ /sbug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i phyir/ /bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam 'di ni/ /lam ni bzhi po de rnams su / /de ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag ① /de ltar ram rnguni bdag 'das tshe/ /gang rnams 'di la gnas 'gyur ba/ /de rnams 'god med go 'phang mchog /nges par legs pa thob sgopar 'gyur/ /de ltar kun dga' bo la gtam5/ /de rnams rnam par 'dren pas mdzad/ / lits+tsha bī snyernams kyis thos nas/ /de la gus phyir skyen par song / /thub la brtse dang gus pa'i phyir/ /gdung bas phrog pa'i sems can rnams/ /spyod mthas 6bkod pa'i don rnams kun/ /myur las rdzu 'phrul don rnams so/ /ston pa la ni smra 'dod pa3/ /de rnams btud nas nye bar gnas/ /smra bar 'dod rnams ston pa yis/ /mkhyen nas thub pas tshig /snagasungs so/ /gang 'di bdag la song ba'i sems/ /khyed cag rnams kyis 6de kun shes/ /de nyid gzhan bzhin mya ngan gyis/ /de ring khyed kyis spobs par gyur/ /dpal gyi bde skyo1rnams la gnas kyang / /khyed cag rnams kyis thams cad nas/ /mngon par zhugs pa 'di yis ni/ /gsal ba nyid dang chos mkhan nyid/ /gal te ye shes bdag las kyang / /cung zhig thos shing shes pa na/ /bdag gi zhing ba rab dmigs te/ /gdung ba ma byed brtan par song / /mi rtag 'dus byas dngos po rnams/ /g.yo zhing yongs su gyur pa shārtacan/ /snying po dang bral blo gtad min/ /cung zhig brtan par gnas pa med/ /gnas 'jog rgyun shes la sogs dang / /gang gzhan thig le gzhan nyurternams dang / /dus kyi dbang du song ba ste/ /srid pa 96—208

'di ni ma rungs nyid/ /sa 'dzin nga las lkunu dang ni/ /brgya byin dang mtshungs dbyig pyanor dang / / skal ba che dang skal med min/ /'byung por mnyes gshin 'byung ba'o/ /'gro mgyogs de nas 'gro byar 'gro/ /skal ldan shing rta shing rta bzang / /sgra ngan gyis smad sgra ngan rdzogs/ /rangs byed ri mo rdul ma skyes/ /mi skyong drang srong bdag nyid che/ /de rnams dang gzhan mang po rnams/ /dbang chen dang mtshungs nyams pa ste/ /mi nyams pa ni yod ma yin / /nyi ma gnas las 'phos pa ste/ /nor lha rnams ni sa la song / /dbang po brgya rnams 'das pa ste/ /rtag zipa ci yang yod ma yin/ /gang gzhan yang dag sangs rgyas rnams/ /'gro ba'i snang ba mdzad nas su/ /mar me snum zad bzhin du ni/ /de rnams mya ngan 'das par gyur/ /gang gzhan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /'byung 'gyur de bzhin gshegs rnams kyang / /bud shing tshig pa'i me bzhin du/ /de rnams mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ /thar 'dod dka' thub nags su bzhin/ /de phyir bdag kyang 'gro bar bgyi/ /bdag gi don med lus ming ni/ /'gran sapa la ni rgyu mtshan med/ /gang du gdul bya 'ga' zhig yod/ /gang phyir 'di nas 'gro bar blo/ /nyams dga' yangs pa can la ni/ /khyed cag blo gzhan ma gyur cig /de phyir 'jig rten skyabs med cing / /dbang med g.yo bar shes nas su/ /chags bral la ni 'gro bar dang / /skyo ba thob par 'os pa'o/ /de ltar gtam bcad dā nas dus su/ /ltos med de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /ston gyi zla ba snang byed bzhin/ /lus ngan phyogs su rab tu gshegs/ /de la mchi mas yongs gang mig /lits+tsha hūṃbī rnams rjes song zhing / /rgyan bcas lag pa rgyas rnams kyis/ /thal mo 96—209

sbyar nas rnam par smras/ /kyi hud 'o brgyal 7gser mtshungs shing / /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan mnga' ba/ /ston pa'i sku lus dbye bye ༷'gyur zhing / /thugs rje mnga' ba mi rtag nyid/ /srid cing 'o ma med pa yi/ /sems ma thob pa'i be+e'u ni / /bkren rnams ye shes 'jo ba'i bas/ /kye ma shin tu skyen par 'bor/ /'gro na mig ldan mi rnams kyis/ /rmongs pa'i mun pa bcom mdzad nas/ /ye shes 'od zer skyen pa ru/ /thub pa nyi ma nub par 'gyur/ /mi shes rgyun gyis — —'jig rten na/ /de las de las khyer ba la/ /rnam 4yangs chos kyi zam pa ni/ /shin tu myur bar chag 7par 'gyur/ /brtse ldan sman pa chen po ni/ /ye shes mchog gi sman mnga' bas/ /sems nad kyis na 'jig rten ni/ /bor nas nges par gshegs par 'gyur/ /sems kyis gzer bu'i yo byad dang / /shes rab rgyan gyis brgyan pa ste/ /ltad mo la ni skom rnams kyis/ /dbang po'i tog 6ni 'gyel bar 'gyur/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal skal ba can/ /'khor ba'i 'ching bas bcings pa la/ /gal te thar pa'i sgo 'di ni/ /dus kyis sdom par 'gyur ba'o/ /de ltar rnam zlog lits+tsha bī/ /mig rnams mchi mas rnams / me'akhrugs pa/ /rjes su 'ongs pa de rnams ni/ /thub pas slar la zlog 8par mdzad / /de nas thub pas bcad shes nas/ /bstan pa rab tu bzung nas su / /phyir la ldog phyir nges pa ni/ /sbug bsngal sdug bsngal gyis byas so/ /rlung gis 9snabaspyod pa'i me tog rnams/ /kar ṅkuni ka ra'i ljon shing bzhin/ /gser gyi ri ltar dkar de rnams/ /thub pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te ⑫/ /de la sems rnams kyis chags shing / /rkang pa rnams kyang 'khyar ba ste/ /gnyen po'i rlung la chu gnyer bzhinalhorta/ /'gro ba med par de rnams log / zhe sa bu/96—210

yin zhing dga' ma yin/ /dga' ba yin zhing zhe sa min/ /thub pa la ni de dag gis/ /dga' dang zhe sa g.yo ba med/ /'brog mtha' nas 'thon khyu mchog che/ /khyu mchog chen po rnams kyis bzhin/ /gnas na gnas kyang de rnams kyis/ /yang yang stobs bcu ldan la lta/ /de bzhin gshegs par sems song hūṃb/ /lus dang ldan yang 'od me+ed rnams/ /rkang pas de nas mya ngan 'das/ /log pa'i 'khrus bye —bzhin rjes su 'ongs/ /rnam par ma 'khrugs mda' gzhu rnams kyi sgra rnams zil mnan nas/ /de rnams nga rgyal ldan yang stobs dang ldan yang 'gugs ldan yang / /'gro na dpal 'dod lits+tsha bī ni 'dod pa chen po rnams/ /mya ngan gyis 'khrugs gdong rnams rang gi khang pa rnams su 'ongs/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/lits+tsha ngabī rnams la thugs brtse ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //snang byed 'dzin par gyur pa na/ /mun bcas kyis 'khrugs nam mkha' bzhin / /thub pa 'da' phyir gshegs pa na/ /de phyir yangs pa can ma mdzes / /dpal ldan dregs pa mi ldan zhing / /thams cad du ni nyams dga' yang / /bdag po nyams las bud med bzhin/ /kun nas gdungs pas mdzes ma gyur/ /thos pas 3dman pa'i gzugs bzhin dang / /yon tan dang bral rig pa bzhin/ /ngag gis dman pa'i blo bzhin dang / /'du byed dang bral ngag bzhin no/ /spyod pas dman pa'i dpa' sabazhin dang / /dang po dang bral byams pa bzhin/ /rnam gnon phun sum tshogs pa bzhin/ /chos kyis kyedaman pa'i bya ba bzhin/ /ston kar ༷nyachar ni log pa na/ / sha li 96—211

bskams pas tshosnanor 'dzin bzhin/ /de tshe mya ngan las ma mdzes/ /gang du der kyeni ma btsos shing / /zos pa ma yin mya ngan des/ /kun du ngu zhing thams cad kyis/ /grags ldan thub pa grags pa byas/ /gzhan ni ma gtams zum byas shing / /sus kyang bsams pa ma yin la/ /mya ngan dang ni ngu ba ste/ /grong khyer pa kun bya ba gcig /de nas dga' 'dun gtso bo la/ /brtan kyang mya ngan gyis nyam thag /sde chen bdag po seng ge ni/ /bsams shing rnam par zlos pa'o/ /lam log mu stegs rnams 'pham thunas/ /'di 'dra'i lam la gshegs nas su/ /gang gis dam pa'i lam bstan sate/ /slar mi ldog phyir gshegs pa nyid/ /nyam thag nyams par gyur pa yi/ /snang med 'jig rten bor nas su/ /skye dgu mgon med mdzad nas ni/ /mgon po de ni zhi phyir gshegs / /rnal 'byor gtso bo bla ma mchog /mthar thug zhi la mngon phyogs nas / /tshe zad pa las gzi mdangs bzhin/ /bdag gi 6brtan pa nyams par 'gyur/ /mi skyong 3sgra ngan mtho ris las/ /rdzu 'phrul dang ldan lhung ba bzhin / /de dang bral ba rtse byar gyur/ /sa la mi shes bya ba ci/ /tsha bas dub pa chur bzhin dang / /grang bas nyam thag me la bzhin/ /je tshom gcod la skye bo rnams/ /da ni su la brten par 'gyur/ /me ni 'phel phyir sbud pa bzhin / /gang gis sbud pa dge legs phyir/ /'jig rten slob dpon thub pa der/ /nyams tshe chos ni nyams par 'gyur/ /tshul med tshul ngan gyis bcings pa'i/ /rga shi dbang bdag rnams kyi ni/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor chen po yi/ /bshig 8snabyed de 'dra su zhig yod/ /sen dhur shing ni skams pepa rnams / /dpyid mthar chu gter gyes bzhin du/ /chags skyes rgod pa'i mi 96—212

rnams ni/ /gsung gis tshim mdzad su zhig lags/ /gang du bla ma lhun po'i snying / /kun mkhyen nyid kyang rgud 'gyur na/ /blo gros ldan pa 'jig rten na/ /blo gtad la 'gro 'os pa su/ /ji ltar gsang bya bskyangs khye/byas nas/ /'chi ba'i ched du 'khrid par byed/ /de bzhin gson pa'i 'jig rten snyug /'ching ba'i ched du skye bar byed/ /ji ltar shing ni rno ba yi/ /sog le yis ni gshegs par byed/ /de bzhin 'gro 'di nyams pa yidzu/ /sog le yis ni gshegs par byed/ /nyon mongs mtha' dag bsregs shenas kyang / /ye shes kyi ni stobs ldan kyang / /'gro ba'i mchog gi slob dpon ni/ /rab tu nyams phyir gshegs par gyur④/ /lta ngan srog chags ngan pa chu/ /srid pa'i dba' rlabs rdul ni nya/ /ye shes gru po chen po yis/ /gang gi /snyesrid pa'i mtsho las rgal—/ /rga ba'i yal ga nad me tog /'chi ba'i rtsa ba srid 3myu gu/ /ye shes mtshon cha chen po yis/ /gang gis srid pa'i ljon shing bcad gye// /ma rig gtsub 3sna shing las skyes shing / /'dod chags me lce yul bud shing / /gang gis rngeye shes bsel ba'i chus/ /skyon gyi me ni zhi bar mdzad/ /gang gis nyu zhi ba'i lam la gshegs/ /gang gis mun pa chen po spangs/ /gang gis dge legs mchog mkhyen zhing skye / /mkhyen nas byams pa yis bstan to/ /nges kyang nyon mongs kun mthar phyir6/ /kun du zhi ba gzigs pa ste/ /kun mkhyen kun la phan pa mdzad/ /kun spangs ched du gshegs pa nyid/ /mnyen zhing rnam yangs dbyangs mnga' ba'i/ /phyag ring thub pa chen po de'i/ /gal te mtha' na su yi mtha'/ /'byung 'gyur ma yin 'byung 'gyur min/ / 'brog dgon ⑫dag na chu mthong nas/ /lam 'gro don bcas 'khrul ba bzhin/ /myur ba dang 96—213

ldan mkhas pas ni/ /de phyir chos la bsnyen par 'os/ /nyams phyir khyad par med pa yi/ /sdig pa mi rtag nyid shes nas/ /gang zhig chos la gnyid ma log /de ni nyal yang gnyid ma log /de nas mi yi seng ge yi/ /ye shes za phod ①seng ge des/ /skye ba'i nyes pa rnams smad cing / /srid pa zad pa'i bstod pa nyid / /srid pa'i rtsa ba 'dor 'dod cing / /brtul zhugs dam pa len 'dod la/ /g.yo ba'i sems ni thul 'dod de/ /dge ba'i lam la gnas par 'dod / /zhi ba'i lam la 'gro 'dod cing / /srid pa'i mtsho las rgal 'dod la / /rtag par sbyin pa gtong 'dod de/ /yang srid gcod par 'dod pa'o/ /sbyin pa byin zhing nga rgyal spangs/ /chos ni bsams shing zhi bar song / /thub pa mya ngan 'da' bzhed tshe/ /de yis sa ni stong par go/ /de nas sku lus thams cad kyis/ /gnyis 'thung rgyal po bzhin bzlog nas/ /grong khyer la ni gzigs bzhin du/ /thub pas 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /yangs pa can gyi bdag gi /'di/ /khyod la lta ba'i phyi ma yin/ /gyad gnas kyi tshe tshong dus su/ /mya ngan 'da' phyir 'gro bar gyes/ /de nas gus ldan chos 'dod pa/ /nye bar 'ongs pa rnams gzigs nas/ /de yi rab spyod las rnams la/ /thub pas mngon par rjes gnang mdzad/ /de nas rim gyis rnam 'dren pa/ /longs spyod grong la bsnyen pa ste/ / der bzhugs — —thams cad mkhyen pa yis/ /dge slong rnams la mngon par gsungs/ /da ltar ram ni bdag 'das nas/ /chos la mchog tu gzhol bar bya/ /de ni khyod kyi chodon mchog ste/ /gang gzhan de ni ngal bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig mdo sder ma zhugs 5shing / /'dul ba na yang mi snang la/ /rigs par so sor gnod pa ste/ /de ni cis kyang 96—214

gzung ①mi bya/ /de ni chos min 'dul ba min/ /de ni bdag gi tshig ma yin/ /mang po rnams kyi tshig yin kyang / /nag po'i gdams pa de dor byasnye/ /dag pa'i gdams pa gzung ri1bya zhing / /gang la yod min zlog krupa ste/ /de ni chos yin 'dul ba ste/ /de ni bdag gi thutshig yin no/ /de phyir bdag gis hūṃmador bsdus nas/ /tshad ma 'di rnams bshad pa ste/ /gang zhig byed de tshad ma yin/ /'di las gzhan du tshad ma min/ /bdag gi gyedagongs pa phra mo de/ /rnam par ma bzhag ma shes nas/ / rmongs las byechos ma yin pa la/ /chos kyi blo rnams 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mun pa dang bcas lta 9bas sam/ /khyad par rnams ni shes min las/ /gser dang rab tu mtshungs pa yi/ /ji ltar nyu snazangs kyis slu bar byed/ /shes rab khyab pa med pas sam/ /de nyid 11'dzin pa ma yin pas/ /dam pa'i chos kyi gzugs brnyan gyi/ /de ltar chos ma yin pas 4slu/ /brdar las gcad 4las bsregs pa las/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis ⑪gser bzhin du/ /'dul ba mdo las rigs pa las/ /de phyir yongs su rtog lke par rigs/ /bstan bcos rnam par mi shes pas/ /mkhas pa rnams ni ma yin zhing / /tshul min la tshul khro gros dang / /tshul la tshul lamin mthong ba nyid / /de phyir don dang tshig gis ni/ /yang dag thos pas gzung bya ste/ /bstan bcos log par gzung mub yis/ /mtshon cha bzhin du rnam par 'joms /sngar med ldan pas 'khyog mang po'i —nya/ /mtshan mo'i 'od byed khyim la bzhin/ /tshig ni log par brjod pa yi/ /don la sdug bsngal gyis 'jug go/ /don nyams pa las chos nyams shing / /chos nyams pa las nus pa ste/ /de phyir ma log don la ni/ /gang gi blo de blo ldan no/ /dge mang de skad gsungs nas ni/ /96—215

dus su sdig pa'i grong la gshegs/ /der ni 'di la mkhyen ① rnams kyis/ /bsnyen bkur dam pa byas rngu pa'o/ /de nas der ni gus ldan pa/ /skul byed legs pa'i khyim nyid du/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis zas mdzad de/ /de yi phyir yin rgyas phyir min/ /de nas nyan thos tshogs bcas te/ /de bzhin gshegs pas zas mdzad nas/ /skul byed la ni chos gsungs te/ /ku sha ldan pa'i grong du gshegs/ /de bzhin nor ldan zhes pa'i 2klung / /sgul byed bcas pa de rgal 4nas/ /grong khyer der 5ni zhi ba yi/ /pad ma'i nags bcas nags su bsnyen/ /gser dang 'dra ba'i 'od mnga' des/ /gser ldan la ni khrus mdzad nas/ /kun dga' bo ni dga' med la/ /'jig rten dga' bas byubaka' stsal to/ /kun dga' gshin rje'i ra ba yi/ /dbus su bdag gi khri shoms shig7 /de ring nam gye cha smad la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan 'da' / /zhes gsungs kun dga' bos thos nas/ /mchi mas zhag ngan 5mig ldan pas/ /thub pa'i gzims mal bshams pa ste/ /bshams nas bstod cing kyi hud do/ /de nas gzims mal bstabs rngupa la/ /rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog byon te/ /yang yang sad pa med phyir dang / /sdug bsngal thams cad zad phyir ro/ /de ni rtsib logs g.yas kyi ni/ /phyag la dbu ni rnam gzhag nas/ /zhabs la zhabs ni bkod nas su/ /slob mas mdun bdar gzims pa'o/ /de nas yud tsam de na der/ /bya rnams skad ni mi sgogs te/ /zags shing stoms pa'i lus rnams kyis/ /bsam gtan la ni gzhol bzhin gnas/ /de tshe 'dab ma g.yo rnams las/ /rlung rnams kyis kyang ma g.yos pa'i/ /ljon shing rnams kyi : —mchi ma bzhin/ /mdog ngan me 96—216

tog rnams gtor to/ /nub ri'i rtse la nyin mor byed/ /gnas la lam 'gro rnam pa bzhin/ /khri la thub pa lta bzhin du/ /don dam mthong rnams skyen par gyur/ /de nas mthar thug blugazims mal la/ /thams cad mkhyen pa gzims pa yis/ /mchi mas rnam 'khrug ṣ+ṭakun dga' la/ /rjes su brtse bas bka' sprul to/ /bdag ni mya ngan 'da' ba'i dus/ /gyad rnams la khros kun dga' bo/ /mya ngan 'da' ba ma mthong na/ /phyis nas kyebadag la gdung krubar 'gyur/ /de nas gsung ni rab bzung nas/ /mchi mas brgyal ba'i kun dga' bos/ /thub pa'i gzims mal mthar thug pa/ /gyad rnams la ni smras pa'o—/ /de nas de'i tshe kun dga' bo yi tshig thos nas/ /mig nas chu yi char ldan de rnams ngu bzhin du/ /seng ge'i 'jigs las sa 'dzin dag nas khyu mchog ltar/ /brtan ming rnam rngu/par gnon rnams grong khyer nas 'thon ⑥to/ /zhen pa med pas gos rnams g.yengs shing rnam bkram ste/ /'gros kyis kun nas bskyod pas cod pan g.yo ba rnams/ /lha na gnas rnams bsod nams yongs su zad las bzhin/ /de na dz+wanyam thag 'ongs pa rnams ni nags der song / /de ltar 'ongs pa rnams kyis thub pa mthong ba ste/ /mthong nas mchi ma'i gdod ldan rnams kyis phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyag 'tshal nas ni yongs gdung ④sems rnams gnas pa ste/ /gnas pa de rnams la ni thub pas bka' stsal to/ /dga' ba'i dus su mya ngan byed par sherigs min zhing / /yid mi bde bas don med bstan ⑪ pa bsnyen par gyis/ /bskal pa du ma rnams su bdag gi ⑪'dod pa gang / /shin tu rnyed dka'i don de bdag la nye bar gnas/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang mkha' med pa'i/ /dge zhing 'gyur med dbang 96—217

po'i dbang don las 'das pa/ /zhi zhing dbrog bya ma yin mchog de gang thob ①nas / /skye ba med cing 'pho ba med la mya ngan med/ /ga ya rnams bye su byang chub tshe na bdag gis sngon/ /dge min srid pa'i rgyu rnams sbrul bzhin dor ba ste//sngon tshe bsags pa'i lus kyis 1rnam par gnas pa 'di/ /lus 'di nyid ni de ring nye bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal gyi ni gter chen phung bo song ba na/ /'jigs pa chen po yang srid nye bar zhi ba na/ /gang tshe sdug bsngal chen po las ni byung ba ste/ /gang gis ngu ba bdag la mya ngan 'os ci yod/ /rab tu zhi ba'i dus yin na yang 'brug gi dbyangs/ /shākya thub pa'i gsung ni de rnams kyis thos nas / /de nas kha rnams bye zhing smra 'dod gyur pa ste/ /de dag rnams kyi tshig de gnas brtan gyis gsol to/ /gang gis jengu ba khyod kyi mya ngan 'os ci yod/ /me ni khang pa 'bar las rnam par 'thon thupa ltar/ /de ltar thub pa de bye ni lha gtso rnams kyis kyang / /nges par bsnyen bya yin na mi rnams kyis sgos ci/ /khyab bdag skye bo gang 'di de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das 'di mthon min des na mya ngan byed/ /'brog dgon dag na song ba'i lam mkhan bzang po ni / /rnam par nyams tshe kun nas 'khrul bar cis ma tsa'agyur/ /bla ma drang srong chen po thams cad gzigs pa ni/ /dngos su mthong nas gal te khyad par ma thob na/ /gser gyi 'byung gnas dag nas dbul po song rnams bzhin/ /de tshe 'di na bzhad gad nyid du 'gro ba nyid/ /de ltar don ldan mang po de de smra ba rnams/ /bu rnams la bzhin gus ldan thal mo sbyar ba rnams/ /dge zhing zhi la dam pa'i don ni bsngags pa yis/ /gyad rnams dag la mchog bdag rnams kyi mchog gis gsungs/ /de ltar nges pa de ni kho bo mthong ba las/ /96—218

rnal 'byor cho gar 'bad rtsol med par grol min te/ /bdag gi chuchos 'di gang zhig rjes su rtog byed pa/ /sdug bsngal dra ba las de ma mthong na yang grol/ /ji ltar sman ni bsnyen par mi byed skyes bu yis/ /sman pa mthong ba las kyang nad ni 'joms min te/ /de bzhin bdag gis bye ye shes 'di ni ma bsgoms na/ /bdag ni mthong ba las kyang sdug bsngal 'joms ma yin/ /'di ni bdag ldan gang zhig bdag gi chos mthong ba/ /rgyang ring dag na gnas kyang des ni bdag mthong ste/ /gang zhig dge legs la ni gzhol rīzhing mi 'jug pa/ /bdag gi nye bar gnas kyang de ni rgyang ring nyid/ /de phyir brtson 'grus ma spangs bsdams pa'i sems rnams kyis/ /dge ba'i las rnams la ni bag dang ldan par gyis/ /sdug bsngal du ma nye bar 'dus shing g.yo ba ste/ /srog ni tho rangs mar me dang ni mtshungs pa nyid/ /de ltar thub pa'i skyes mchog gis bstan 5de rnams ni/ /mig nas chu ni rnam byung nyam thag yid rnams kyis/ /chu bo'i gzhung ni so sor sgol bar byed pa bzhin/ /ku sha zhes bya'i grong la dal bus dbang med zhugs/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/ mya ngan las 'da' bar gshegs pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas bzang pos yang dag nyer ldan legs bzang 6ni/ /dbyu gu gsum 'dzin 'byung po'i tshogs su mi mchod pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa lta 'dod dge slong thar 'dod pas/ /kun dga' byed pa'i kun dga' bo la smras pa'o/ /thub pa pemya ngan 'da' ba'i dus ni bdag gis thos/ /gang gi ched du bdag gis lta 'dod skyes pa ste/ /'jig rten dag na mchog gi chos kyi rtogs pa po 4/ /96—219

zla ba gnam stong la bzhin mthong bar zla ba ༄tshimin/ /sdug bsngal mtha' dag rnams kyi tha mar gshegs bzhed pa/ /khyod kyi 'dren pa de ni lta bar 'dod pa ste/ /sprin gyis 37mngon par bkag pa'i mkha' la nyi ma bzhin/ /bdag gis ma mthong bar de nub par 'gro ma yin/ /de nas yongs su 'gro ba po ni 'ongs pa ste/ /smra bar 'dod cing chos 'dod pa ni des shes nas/ /ngal kyeb dang ni ldan pa'i sems ldan kun dga' bos/ /dus ma yin zhes mchi ma'i gdong gis smras pa'o/ /de ni zla ba'i 'od mnga' bsam pa mkhyen pa po5/ /'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan yangs thurnam par mkhyen nas su/ /gang phyir kho bo 'jig rten phan phyir skyes pa ste/ /kun dga' bo kye 6gnyis skyes ma 'gogs zhes gsungs so/ /de las legs bzang mchog tu dga' zhing yid ches shing / /dpal stug 3dge legs mdzod la mngon du song ba ste/ /de nas dus kyi rjes su mthun pas zhi ba yibye/ /gsung ni mngon par gsungs nas slar yang de gsol to/ /kho bo lta bu'i yongs su rtog pa po rnams las/ /thar pa'i lam gzhan lhag par khyed kyis byelhag par thob ces grag /de phyir bdag la gsung nyu mdzod bdag la 'dzin 'dod yod/ /bdag gis 11lta 'dod rtse bar 'dod pa'i 15phyir ma yin/ /de nas gnyis skyes mngon par 'ongs pa de la ni/ /yan lag brgyad kyi lam ni sangs rgyas kyis gsungs shing / /rab tu chud zos lam ni yang dag dran pa bzhin / /thos nas gang ni hu1gang gis yang dag rtogs/ /des ni sngon du mthong bar gyur pa'i lam gzhan la/ /des ni mthar thug dam pa nye bar ma thob ste / /sngon du ma mthong lam ni lhag par thob nas su/ /snying la mun pa dang bcas lam de dor bar gyur/ /rdul dang lhan cig mun pa rab tu 'phel ba ste/ /96—220

de dag rnams kyi mi dge'i las ni sogs zhes grags rmye/ /snying stobs dang bcas rdul ni rab tu 'phel ba ste/ /de dag rnams kyi dge ba'i las ni rgyas zhes gragasadzu/ /thos dang blo dang 'bad pas snying stobs 'phel ba na/ /rdul dang mun pa nag ③ni rnam pa med pa'i phyir/ /las nyams pa las las ni zad par 'gro ba ste/ /de dag rnams kyi las de 'thad pa yin zhes grags(d+ngha/ /yid ni rmongs par byed pa rdul dang mun pa dag /rang bzhin par ni 'jig rten dag na smra ba ste/ /de phyir de gnyis zad pa yod min brtan chonyid phyir/ /rang bzhin par ni brtan pa nyid du rab tu grub/ /snying stobs sbyor las de dag bde skyebar gyur na yang / /dus kyi dbang gis slar yang 'byung bar 'gyur ba ste/ /bsil ba'i chu ni tshan nyamo bzhin du rim gyis ni/ /dus kyi rim las rang bzhin du ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rtag pa'i bdag nyid snying stobs de ltar 'phel ba ru/ /thos pa blo dang 'bad pa rnams kyis mi nus te/ /de ma 'phel na de dag nyams pa yod min zhing / /de dag ma nyams pa las zhi ba yod ma yin/ /sngon du des ni rang bzhin las ni skyes snyam ste/ /des kyang der ni thar pa mthong ba ma yin zhing / /me yi 'bar ba'i 'od kyi nyams pa ji lta bar/ /rang bzhin la thuni gnas na mthar thug gang las yin/ /sangs rgyas pa yi lam kyis de nyid mthong ba ste/ /srid pa la ni brten nas 'jig rten des rtogs shing / /de yi ⑨rnam par nyams pas kyezhi ba rigs skyapa ste/ /rgyu 7ni rab tu nyams phyir 'bras bu nyams pa'o/ /gsal ba 'di yin rnam par 'gyur ba med pa'i bdag /lus las gzhan ni de yis sngon du rtogs pa ste/ /thub pa'i gsung ni yongs su thob nas 'jig rten ni/ /bdag rnged pa dang bdag tu bya ba med par shes/ /96—221

chos ni du ma so sor brten nas skyes pa ste/ /rang nyid dbang med yongs su shes nas ni/ /des ni rab tu 'jug pa sdug bsngal nyid du dang / /nges par ldog ste sdug bsngal nyid du kye ma mthong / /ji ltar 'jig rten dag ni skye ba rtogs nas su/ /des ni chad pa'i lta ba rnam par spangs pa ste/ /'jig rten dag gi nub par 'gro ba shes nas su/ /rtag pa'i lta ba brtan po skyen par spangs pa'o/ /drang srong chen po'i gsung ni 1thos nas bzung ba ste/ /de ltar 'di na des ni sngon gyi lta ba dang 2sna/ /de yis sngon du yongs su las rgo byas pas te//gang gis skyen par dam pa'i chos la rjes su song / /yid ni rab tu dang bas mchog dang ldan pa des/ /zhi zhing 'gyur med go 'phang de ni rab thob nas/ /thub pa gzims —pa la ni bsngags pa byas pa ste/ /lta bzhin 'di las blo 'di rnams ni byas pa'o/ /mchod 'os dam pa mya ngan 'da' bar 'os pa yi ‘ / /mgon po mthong nas bdag ni gnas par 'os ma yin/ /ston pa thugs rje ldan pa mya ngan 'da' ba yi/ /sngon du re zhig bdag ni mthar thug la 'gro'o/ /de nas des ni thub pa la ni phyag 'tshal nas/ /sbrul bzhin g.yo ba med pa'i gdan ni bcings nas su/ /sprin rlung gis ni phra mo'i rngophra mor byed pa bzhin/ /de ma thag tu zhi ba mya ngan 'da' bar gshegs/ /de nas de phyir gdung gi 'du byed cho ga ni/ /cho ga mkhyen pa'i thub pas rnam par gyebaka' sprul pa/ /mthar gyur de ni skye ba mthar mdzad drang srong che/ /rgya chen slob ma mnga' ba'i slob mar gyur pa'o/ /de nas nam gyi thun ni 'das pa na/ /zla bas skar ma rnams kyi 'od ni phrogs pa na/ /nags rnams nyal ba bzhin du sgra med gyur pa na/ /dge slong rnams la thugs rje chen po mnga' bas bstan/ /slob dpon bzhin du 96—222

sgon ma bzhin du don bzhin du/ /bdag 'das tshe na so sor thar pa bstan ṭ+wābya ste / /khyed kyi ston pa de yin de'i dbang gis 'gyur bya/ /kho bo gnas pa na yang de tsam nyid smra'o/ /lus dang ngag gi las ni rnam par dag 'dod pas/ /de bzhin 'jig rten tha snyad thams cad 'dor ba dang / /sa dang srog chags sa bon rdzas la sogs rnams kyisaldu/ /rab tu 'dzin pa las ni me bzhin ldog pa'o//sa la skye ba gcod dang 'byed pa dag las dang / /sa yi logs la rko dang rmo ba dag las dang / /gso ba dang ni skar rtsis mtshan nyid rnams las ni/ /nges par ldog pa bza' ba'i cho ga dus yin no/ /pho nya'i rigs pa sman dang sngags ni bsnyen rnams la/ /sbyor min nyid dang 'chab pa nyid ni med pa nyid/ /chos las ma bkag pa yi sgrub pa rnams la ni/ /tshod shes nyid dang tshim dang sogs pa ma yin no/ /rnam pa de ltar tshul khrims yang dag bsdus pa 'di/ /thar pa'i rtsa ba zhes pa 5so sor thar pa ste/ /'di las ting nge 'dzin rnams rab tu skye ba ste/ /ye shes thams cad rnams dang mthar thug rnam 'da'o 5 / /de phyir ma ral ma nyams dbrog bya ma yin pa'i/ /gang gis 7tshul khrims gtsang ma yod pa de yi chos/ /de med gal te 'di yi thams cad med pa ste/ /tshul khrims yon tan dam pa rnams kyi rten yin no/ /tshul khrims ma nyams rnam par dag pa gnas pa na/ /dbang po spyod yul rnams la 'jug pa ma yin zhing / /dbyug dupas ba lang 9snatshogs rnams lo thog la spyobazhin du/ /brtan las dbang po drug rnams bsgrib 11par bya ba'o/ /dbang shāsnepo'i rta rnams yul rnams la grol gang zhig gzhan/ /len zhing de rnams las ni de tsam nyid ma yin/ /g.yo ba'i rta rnams kyis phrogs lam ngan la bzhin du/ /des ni de yi ched du don 96—223

med thob par 'gyur/ /dgra bo chen po rnams kyi dbang du song ba rnams/ /'di na kha cig sdug bsngal 'thob par 'gyur ba ste/ /rmongs pas yul rnams dag gi dbang du song nas ni/ /song nas deng 'dir dbang med rnams ni sdug bsngal 'os/ /de phyir dgra bo ma rungs dbang po rnams kyi bzhin/ /dbang po rnams kyi 'gro ba 'gro bya ma yin zhing / /dbang po rnams kyi dga' bo rmye 'jig rten na byas nas/ /dbang po rnams kyi gshed ma 'jig rten na mthong ngo / /rang gi g.yo ba'i sems las 'jigs pa ji lta bar/ /stag rnams las dang sbrul dang 'bar ba'i me las dang / /dgra bo las ni de ltar 'jigs par mi bya ste/ /gang gis 37sbrang rtsi dang ni yang dag rtog pa med/ /lcags kyu med pa'i gnyis 'thung myos pa lta bu dang / /yal ga'i ri dwags shing la rab tu ma zhi ltar/ /sems ni ji ltar 'dod bzhin phyogs su skor ba ste/ /g.yo zhing bskyod pa de la go skabs sbyin mi bya/ /de ni rang dbang yin na zhi ba yod min zhing / /de yi gnas pa jeyin na byed pa byas pa nyid/ /de phyir sems 'di ji ltar rnam par mi g.yo ba/ /de ltar rab tu 'bad pa yis ni gyis mdzod cig /bza' ba tsam ni sman bzhin nges par bsten bya ste/ /'dir ni khong khro bya ba ma yin chags pa min/ /ji srid bkres pa nyid ni ldog pa'i ched du dang / /lus kyi 'khrul 'khor byus 'dzin pa yi ched du'o/ /ji ltar nags su bung ba rnams kyis me tog ro/ /'thung ste me tog rnams ni nyams par byed ma yin/ /de bzhin dus kyi dbang las bsod snyems rgyu ba ste/ /pha rol dad pa rnams ni nyams par byed ma yin/ /drang pos rtag par khur bar byed ces khur bya dang / /skye bo sbyin pa po yang yod pa ma yin te/ /'di na sbyor ba min las khur ba ltung ba ste/ /96—224

ji ltar khur bu de ltar sbyin pa po yin no/ /rnal 'byor rim las nyin mo mtha' dag phul nas dang / /mtshan mo'i dang po'i thun dang cig shos dag kyang ste/ /dran pa dang bcas snga ma'i cig shos la nyol la/ /gnyid kyi tshe ni don med byed pa ma yin no/ /dus kyi me yis 'di na 'gro ba sreg pa nasna7/ /mtshan mo mtha' dag la ni gnyid par 'os pa su/ /nyon mongs dgra bo dang mtshungs 'joms pa po rnams ni/ /snying la gnas pa yin na su yi gnyid log 'gyur/ /de phyir khyem na nag po'i sbrul rnams nyal ba ltar/ /yid la nyes skyon sbrul rnams rab tu nyal ba rnams/ /rigs pa dang ni rkang pa sman gyis ston nas su/ /gnyid log par 'os 'di las gzhan du ngo tsha'/ /ngo tsha rgyan nyid dang ni mchog gi gos yin zhing / /ngo tsha lam las 'khyog snyepa rnams kyi lcags kyus te/ /ngo tsha ldan pas de ltar gyur na 'jug bya zhing / /ngo tshas rnam par spangs pa'i yon tan rnams kyis chospangs/ /ji srid pa la skyes bu ngo tsha dang bcas pa/ /de srid de yi mi yi ngo tsha phyenyid yin te/ /don dang don min rnams la rnam dpyod med pa ni/ /ngo tshas rnam par dman pa phyugs thudang mnyam pa'o/ /gang yang yan lag nying lag rnams ni ral gris gcod/ /der yang yid kyis 7nyes pa bya ba ma yin zhing / /zhi ba ma yin dag ni 4brjod par mi bya ste/ /bdag gi de yis hūṃkhyed cag rnams kyi sbyibar chod yin/ /bzod pa dang mnyam dka' thub yod pa ma yin zhing / /gang gi bzod pa de yis 11stobs dang brtan pa ste/ /gang rnams pha rol rnams las rtsub mo mi bzod pa/ /de rnams chos byed rnams kyi lugs min grol ba min/ /chos kyi 'byed pa po dang grags pa'i 'joms pa po /gzugs kyi dgra bo dang ni snying gi me yin te/ /khro ba de yis /rtego skabs rab 96—225

'byam snyemi sbyin zhing / /yon tan rnams kyi dgra bo de 'dra gzhan ma yin/ /yongs su bsil ba'i chu las glog gi me bzhin du/ /ji ltar rab byung las ni khro ba 'gal ba ste/ /de ltar khyem pa rnams kyi skyes pa mi 'gal te/ /chags ldan de rnams de la dam bca' ma yin no/ /mdzes pa'i skra ni rgyang ring mgo la reg nas dang / /rnam par 'gyur ba'i gos dang lhung bzed mthong nas dang / /gzhan las mthar gyur spyod pa rnam par bsams nas su/ /snying la skyes pa'i nga rgyal rab tu spang bar bya/ /khyem la brten pa khengs pa ldan pa byernams kyi yang / /nga rgyal rnam par 'phel ba bye 'joms pa'i phyir yin na/ /slong mo za bas bdag nyid yongs su rtog 4pa po/ /thar pa la dmigs skra bzhar rnams kyi sngon nyid do/ /ngan g.yo dang ni chos kyi mtshams sbyor yod min te/ /gang phyir 'di las 'khyog po nyid ni bsnyen mi bya/ /ngan zhegayo nyid dang sgyu ni slu sgotshoba'i don du ste⑦/ /chos kyi bdag nyid rnams kyi bslu bya yod ma yin/ /gang zhig rgya chen rnams las sbug bsngal 'ongs pa — ste/ /nyung ngu 'dod la 'ong ba ma yin de dang bral/ /de yi phyir yang nyung ngu 'dod nyid bsnyen bya ste/ /gang zhig yon tan rnams kyis spu rdzogs byed kye ma ci/ /de ni bkren pa'i lta ba rnams la mi 'jigs shing / /dbang po rnams las gang zhig cung zad 'jigs min la/ /gang zhig thos nas med ces mya ngan med pa ste/ /gang gis ⑩nyung ngu 'dod de de skyeyi thar pa min/ /gal te grol bar nyusnye'adod na tshim pa bsten mdzod dang / /tshim pa na ni 'dir kyebade de 'di chos yin zhing / /tshim pa rnams ni sar yang bde bar gnyid log ste/ /tshim med rnams ni mtho ris na yang rnam par sreg kyi /phyug kyang tshim pa med pa rtag tu dbul po ste/ /dbul yang tshim pa dang ldan rtag tu phyug po nyid/ /96—226

tshim pa med pa sdug pa'i yul rnams dang 'bye zhing / /tshim pas 1'gro ba ngal ba ldan la mya ngan byed/ /zhi ba'i bde ba dam pa thob par 'dod rnams kyis/ /de ltar tshogs la dga' ba rnams su 'gyur mi bya/ /zhi ba'i bdag nyid gcig tu rgyu phyir 'jig rten na/ /brgya byin la sogs lha rnams kyis kyang re 'dod byed/ /chags po sdug bsngal gyi ni gnas pa'i shing yin te/ /rang gi skye bo la 'am skye la chags pa spangs/ /chags pa rnam pyergyas sdug bsngal la ni 'jig rten na/ /gnyis 'thung 'khogs pa 'dam la bzhin du chags kyipar 'gyur/ /rtag par rab zhugs chu yi rgyun ni mnyen na yang / /rdo yi d+nghalogs la dus su rnam par 'bigs pa ste/ /brtson 'grus kyis ni rnyed par dka' ba ci yang med/ /de phyir khyar rnams mi 'bor bar ni bzod bgyis dang / /gang zhig yang yang ngal bso phye nas ni srub byed pa/ /de yi 67shing la me ni rnyed par sla min zhing / /brtson 'grus brtsams pas rnyed par sla bar 'gyur ba ste/ /de phyir sbyor ba yod na bya ba 'grub ⑦pa nyid/ /dran pa yod na skyon rnams 'jug pa ma yin te/ /dran pa dang mnyam mdza' bo med cing bsrung ba med/ /dran pa nyams las nges par thams cad nyams pa ste/ /de phyir lus la song ba'i dran pa spang mi bya/ /ji ltar dpa' bo rnams ni go cha bzung nas su/ /dgra bo'i sde la 'jigs pa med rnams 'jug bya ste/ /de bzhin lus la dran pa'i go cha bgos nas su/ /brtan pa rnams ni yul gyi g.yul rnams la spyod do/ /mnyam par gzhag pa'i snyeblo dang sems ni yongs bsdams kyeshing / /'jig rten dag gi skye dang 'god ⑩ pa shes pa ste/ /de phyir ting nge 'dzin la yongs su 'jug bya ste/ /ting 'dzin rab tu thob pa'i sems nad yod ma yin/ /rnam par 'thor ba'i chu ni rnam par 96—227

'dzin don du/ /ji ltar 'bad pas dong dang 'obs ni byed pa ste/ /ye shes chu ni gnas pa'i don du ting nge 'dzin/ /de ltar dong dang 'obs dang mtshungs par rab tu bstan/ /shes rab ldan pa yongs su 'dzin pa btang ba yi/ /chos 'di nang la mchog tu gzhol ba dag gis te/ /de ltar gnas pa'i grol ba yod cing 'di yi ni/ /phyin ci log ni khyem pa ma yin dge slong min/ /shes rab dga' dang 'chi ba'i mtsho chen dag la gru/ /rmongs pa'i mun pa rnams la ji ltar sgon ma ste/ /nad rnams thams cad 'joms pa dag gi 7sman yin zhing / /nyon mongs ljon shing 'joms byed mtshon cha rnon po yin/ /de phyir thos pa bsam pa bsgom pa rnams kyi ni/ /shes rab rnam par 'phel la rab tu 'jug par bya/ /gang gi 2shes rab rang bzhin lta byed mig yod pa/ /de ni mig dang bral yang mig dang ldan pa nyid/ /sems la rgyu ba'i spros pa de dang de rnams kyis/ /khyem na gnas pa spangs nas kyang ni grol min nyid/ /mchog tu zhi ba thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis 'di/ /shes nas spros pa med pa rnams su 'gyur bar bya/ /de phyir bag yod bla ma bzhin du bsnyen mdzod la/ /bag med dgra bo bzhin du rnam par spongs mdzod dang / /bag yod pa las brgya byin gye na 4dpal thob cing / /bag med pa las lha min khengs rnams rnam par nyams / /phan pa dang ldan rjes su brtse ba mnga' ba yi/ /ston pa thugs rje mnga' bas mdzad bya gang yin pa/ /de ni bdag gis byas shing dang ni rab bsdams pa/ /khyed cag rnams kyi sems ni zhi bas byas pa'o/ /ci ste ri rnams dang ni khang pa stong pa dang 5/ /dgon pa de rnams 6gang dang der ni yod pa na/ /rab tu sbyor la rtag tu 'bad pa bya ba ste/ /phyi nas yongs su 96—228

gdung ba ldan par ma gyur cig /sman pa rang bzhin yang dag legs par shes nas ni/ /nad pa rnams la dam pa'i sman ni brjod bya ste/ /de yi dus kyis sbyar bar nges par bsten pa la/ /nad pa gang de bdag po yin te sman pa min/ /dpal ldan drang zhing mnyam la 'jigs pa med pa yi/ /lam ni lam mkhan gyis ni rnam par bstan pa na/ /thos nas gang zhig mi 'gro de yi nyams pa ste/ /bstan pas 'dren pa po ni bu lon yod ma yin/ /snyug bsngal la sogs bden pa bzhi bo kho bo yis/ /bstan pa rnams la 'di ni gang gi sna'adod pa yod/ /de ni myur zhing spobs par bdag la smros shig dang / /je tshom shin tu rnam par dpyad bya bcad par bgye/ /de ltar mthon por gsungs pa'i 2drang srong chen po la/ /the tshom med pa de rnams ci yang ma gsol to/ /sems kyis snade dag rnams kyi sems kyi gting dpags 4nas/ /byed ldan ma 'gags pas kyang tshig 'di smras pa'o/ /rlung ni g.yo ba ma yin nyi ma bsel ba dang / /ri bong mtshan ma can ni dro ba nyid na yang / /'jig rten dag na rkang pa bzhi po de rnams 5ni//bden pa min par byed par nus pa ma yin no/ /gang zhig sdug bsngal brjod pa de ni bde ba min/ /'di yi rgyu gang rab tu skye bo de gzhan min/ /rgyu ni 'gags pa las ni nges par thar pa ste/ /gang zhig 'di yi lam ni thabs ma yin pa min/ /de phyir bdag nyid chen po bden pa bzhi rnams la/ /dge slong skye bo des 'di gtam ci yod ma yin/ /ston pa mya ngan 'da' ba rnyed thupar 'gyur zhes te/ /gang zhig don ni rdzogs pa ma yin sdug bsngal te/ /gang zhig tshogs pa 'di ni brtul zhugs gzhon nyid las/ /sngon du don ni mthong bar gyur pa ma yin pa/ /de yang spyod kyi gsung 'dis da ni de ma thag /96—229

glog gi 'od kyis 1snalam bzhin yang dag mthong bar gyur/ /gang gi don gyi lhag ma yod pa ma yin zhing / /gang yang srid pa'i mtsho yi pha rol phyin pa ste/ /mgon po shin tu skyen par snyenges par gshegs thos te/ /de dag gi yang snying la bsams r+shapar gyur pa nyid/ /de ltar 'phags pa ma 'gags pa yi tshig de yis//don ni rnam par shes kyang shes nas slar yang ni/ /gus ldan rnams kyi blo gros brtan po mdzad bzhed pa/ /byams pas slar yang sangs rgyas kyis ni bka' stsal to/ /gang phyir skal bar 4gnas kyang de ni nyams pa ste/ /phan tshun du ni 'du ba nges par yod 5ma yin/ /bdag nyid kyi dang gzhan gye don ni byas nas ni / /kho bo 6gnas pa la ni dgos pa yod ma yin/ /gang rnams mkhar dang sa na bdag gi gdul bya rnams/ /de rnams thar par byas shing rgyun la bcug pa ste / /'di las gzhan du slob ma rim dang rim rnams kyis/ /nga yi chos 'di skye dgu rnams la gnas par 'gyur/ /de phyir 'gro ba'i rang bzhin rnam par shes byas nas/ /bsam mno ma byed nges par rnam par 'bral ba ste/ /rnam pa de ltar 'gro ba 7shes nas su/ /ji ltar 'di ltar ma yin de 8ltar gyis mdzod cig /ye shes sgon mas mun pa rnam par bsal byas nas/ /srid pa rnams la snying po med par mthong nas su/ /ji ltar nad ni nye bar zhi ba de ltar ni / /tshe ni rnam par 'gags na tshim pa nyid yin no/ /dor bar bya zhing rtsod ldan lus zhes bya ba ni/ /srid pa'i mtsho yi rgyun ni rnam par 'gags pa na/ /don med byed pa'i dgra bo'i rnam par nyams las bzhin/ /tshe ni nye bar zhi bas tshim pa ma yin su/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu thams cad rnam par 'god pa ste/ /de phyir khyed cag rnams ni legs par bag yod gyis/ /mya ngan 'da' ba'i dus ni 96—230

yongs su gyur pa ste/ /khyed cag ma smra 'di ni bdag gi phyi ma'i tshig /de nas bsam gtan rig pa rnams kyi mchog gis ni/ /yud tsam de la bsam 1gtan dang po thob mdzad nas/ /de las rnam par bzhengs nas gnyis par gshegs pa ste/ /rim gyis ma tshang med par thams cad la gshegs so/ /de nas rjes su rim pas rab tu byed pa dgu/ /snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshogs ni mtha' dag bsam gtan mdzad/ /de nas drang srong chen pos slar yang rim gyis ni/ /bsam gtan dang po de nyid la ni bab 2/pa'o/ /de las rnam par bzhengs nas kyang ni rim gyis ni/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa la ni slar yang 'dzegs pa ste/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i cho ga las de rnams bzhengs shing / /mngon sum nyid du nye bar zhi ba la gshegs so/ /de nas thub pa mya ngan 'da' bar gshegs pa na / /char gyis snun 4pa'i ba lang bzhin du sa g.yos shing / /phyogs kyi glang po rnams kyis sbyangs pa 5bzhin du ni/ /nam mkha' las kyang sgon ma rnams ni lhung bar gyur/ /lha yi nags tshal sna tshogs shing rta sreg 'dod pa'i/ /nags kyi me ni bar snang dag la byung ba bzhin6/ /bud shing med cing rlung med du ba med pa'i me/ /phyogs ni sreg par byed pa byung bar gyur pa nyid/ /lha min 'joms par 'dod pa g.yul du 'jug pa na/ /khro ba brgya bas khro ba rnam par gtong ba bzhin/ /de bzhin me stag brgya pa'i me ni sgyug pa yi/ /dbang po'i rdo rje mi bzad pa rnams lhung bar gyur/ /'jig pa'i rlung rnams dag gis btags pa rnams kyi 7bzhin/ /'dzin pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi rtse mo rnams lhung zhing / /'khri shing shing rnams dag ni zug rngu byed pa yi/ /phyag dar khyar ba'i rlung ni drag tu g.yos par gyur/ /'dam gyi 9chus bsgos sdong du tshigazhon 96—231

nu rnams kyis ni/ /lus ni yongs su dkris pa'i ngang pa'i rgyal po bzhin/ /cung zhig 'od zer kha dog ngan pa de rnams kyis/ /'od ni bcom ste zla ba mngon par gsal bar gyur/ /sprin dang bral yang mkha' la zla ba gnas na yang //mun pa mi bzad rnams kyis phyogs rnams rgyas pa ste/ /yud tsam de la mya ngan gyis ni zil non bzhin1/ /chu bo rnams ni de ma thag tu chu dron 'bab/ /de nas nye na/sar skyes pa'i sha la'i shing dag gis/ /rang gis snyeme tog mdzes pa 'jug pa dus min la/ /rnam par btud nas drang srong chen po'i sku lus ni/ /gser gyi stegs bu'i gzugs brnyan la ni yang dag gtor/ /mkha' la mgo bo lnga rnams mi g.yo'i 5klu rnams ni/ /mya ngan kyis slar so sor dmar ba'i mig can rnams/ /rab tu gnyid log gdengs ka stod 6pa'i lus rnams kyis/ /thub pa la ni gus pas lta bzhin gnas par gyur/ /nang du song ba'i kun nas gdung ba rnams/ /de rnams shin tu dron po'i 7dbugs ni brgyus pa ste/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin mi rtag pa ni rtogs nas su/ /mya ngan 'ongs pa min rnams mya ngan smad par gyur/ /nges par legs pa'i chos kyis 9cho gar rab zhugs pa//rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi 'dus pa dam pa de/ /chos la mngon par chags pas 1 mya ngan ma byas shing / /lha yi rten la mchi ma phyung bar ma gyur to/ /gtsang mar lhag par gnas pa'i byed ldan lha rnams kyang / /drang srong chen po'i yang dag shin tu gus ldan rnams/ /rang gnas gyur zhing rnam par 'gyur ba ma song ste/ /'jig rten dag ni rang bzhin rnam par smad pa'o/ /dri za'i rgyal po rnams dang de nas klu yi rgyal po rnams/ /gnod sbyin rnams dang dam chos la dga' lha rnams ni/ /mya ngan byed cing mya ngan mchog la gzhol rnams kyis/ /96—232

rigs chen po yi nyam thag bzhin du kha 1la gyur/ /yid la re ba thob pa'i bdud kyi sde rnams ni/ /rab tu dga' bas skad ni 'thon zhing dgod pa ste/ /'phyo zhing glu dbyangs gar byas dga' bar gyur pa rnams/ /rnga bo che dang rdza rnga pa ṭa ha rnams brdungs/ /de nas rdo rje rtse mo bcom pa'i ri bo bzhin/ /chang dang bral ba'i gnyis 'thung dga' ba med pa bzhin/ /nog gis rnam par dman pa'i dbyibs can khyu mchog bzhin/ /thub pa'i khyu mchog nub pa na ni 'jig rten gyur/ /nyin mor byed pas rab tu dman pa'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /ba mos bsregs pa'i pad+ma dang ldan rdzing bu bzhin/ /nor dang bral zhing bya ba med pa'i rigs bzhin du/ /srid pa nyams mdzad rab tu nyams las 'gro bar gyur/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba chen po'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas ngang pa stong dang ldan pa'i lha yi ni/ /gzhal med khang nas gdong ni cung zhig rab btud nas/ /yud tsam thams cad mkhyen pa 2la ni bltas nas su/ /lha na gnas pa chen po gzhan zhig gis smras pa'o / /kye ma 'gro na dngos po thams cad mi rtag cing / /skye ba'i chos can dang ni 'dzad pa'i chos can la/ /skye ba rnams ni sbug bsngal skyed par byed pa ste/ /de dag rnams ni lhag med zhi bas zhi ba nyid/ /skye ba'i bud shing tshad ma min pa bsregs mdzad nas / /ye shes me lce grags pas rnam khyab du ba can/ /chu yis yeme bzhin du ni dus kyi chu yis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i me de mya ngan 'da' bar bya/ /de nas mchog gi drang srong dang mtshungs drang srong gzhan/ /mtho ris gnas 96—233

kyang 'bras bu rnams la ma chags pas/ /rab tu zhi ba'i dgra bcom drang srong mthong nas su/ /ri dbang brtan 1pas tshig ni rnam par smras pa'o/ /'jig rten dag na 'ga' zhig nyams par mi 'gro med/ /de ltar 'gro ba gred cing song ba med pa ste/ /mchog dang mchog min mkhyen pa mchog gi ldadon rig pa/ /ston pa mtshungs med gang du rab tu zhi bar gyur/ /shes rab rnam par dag cing mchog gi spyan mnga' ba/ /yongs su 'dren pa po nyid 'di yis dman pa ni/ /rmongs pa nges par mig long gson pa'i 'jig rten ni / /'du shes nyams shing lam ngan la ni gnas par 'gyurasngu/ /de nas 'gro ba'i 'gal ba ma yin ma 'gags pa/ /rjes su chags pa nyams shing skye ba 'gags byas pas/ /'jig rten snang bas dman pa mthong nas su/ /thub pa zhi ba na ni zhi ba'i yid kyis smras / /shes rab ldan pa 'du byed cho ga la gnas pa/ /dus 'dir nges par blo gtad bya ba ma yin zhing / /mi rtag nyid kyi rdo rje nges par btung ba yis5 / /gang du thub pa ri bo chen po bcom par 'gyur6/ /snying po med cing nga med rnam par nyams pa'i chos/ /'jig rten gson 7pa'i 'jig rten kye ma smod par shog /gang du thub dka' 8drang srong chen po seng ge yang / /nyes pa'i gnyis 'thung rnams ni nyams par mdzad nas nyams/ /'dod chags bral ba min pa'i 'gro ba 'jug pa la/ /da ni 'jigs pa chen po ma yin su yi lags/ /thun mong las ni gang du de bzhin gshegs pa yang / /gser gyi ka ba lta bu kun nas chag par gyur/ /sa bon drug dang myu gu gcig dang lo ma gcig /rtsa ba drug dang 'bras bu lnga dang yal ga gnyis/ /phung po gsum dang bdag nyid gcig la nyon mongs kyi9/ /sdong po 'di ni bcag nas thub pa gnyis 'thung 96—234

gzims / /'gro rgyal mda' bzhin dgra bo rnams ni bcom nas su/ /chu med pa na hūṃrma bya bzhin du chags bral zhing / /mgyogs 'gro rta bzhin du ni rnam rgyal lam song ba/ /me bzhin thub pa skye ba med cing zhi bar gyur/ /mtho ris dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin pa mig 'phel na/ /rab tu tshim byed rgyun bzhin gsung rnams btang 'unas su/ /'od kyis ༄ nyam thag ba lang bzhin sar rnam brgyus nas/ /grags pas phyogs ni mngon par bkang nas bla ma gzims/ /snyan grags ldan pa nyid dang 'od zer ldan pa ste/ /chu bo sen dhu bzhin du gser sgyug shugs ldan pa/ /rnam thos bu yi rdzu 'phrul mi skyong sder bcas pa/ /lam la bcug nas mi yi nyi ma nub par gyur/ /rmug chopa'i do shal gyi 6ni phyogs rnams dkris 7pa bzhin/ /rgya chen sprin rnams kyis dkris nyi ma'i 'od rnams bzhin/ /mchod sbyin rdzogs tshe mar gyes 8sman pa'i me bzhin du/ /thub pa zhi tshe de ring 'jig rten gsal ma gyur/ /mdud pa med pa bden pa'i lam ni bsnyen 9nas su/ /mdud pa med pa zhi ba'i chos 'di khobarnyes nas ni/ /rdzu 'phrul gyes ni sku lus 'dren par nus na yang / /snyug bsngal dag gi 1cegater ni lus yin zhes spangs so/ /mun pa mun pa nyi mas bzhin du zil mnan nas/ /rdul ni rdul ni char pa bzhin du mngon bcom nas/ /be+er yang slar yang sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor mi len te/ /thub pa thub pa skar rgyal bzhin du mngon par gshegs / /gang zhig skye ba'i sbug bsngal 'joms phyir /1skyes pa ste/ /gang la 'jig rten pas ni zhi ba'i ched du bsnyen/ /gang zhig 'od zer mchog gis skernam par gsal ba dang / /khyad par 'phags pa'i blo yis rnam par gsal bar gyur / /gang gis skye dgu rnams ni dge legs la bcug ste/ /yon tan rgya 96—235

chen rnams kyis tshos la rgyas pa nyid/ /'dod pa'i snyan grags gsal ba rnams kyis 'phel ba ste/ /khyim na gnas pa yin kyang grags pas 'phel ba nyid/ /gang gis mkhyen zhing smod pas 'o dod ma bos shing / /mi ni nyam thag rnams la brtse bas bos pa ste/ /bza' ba ngan pa 3rab tu 'joms shing ma gsol la/ /bza' ba legs pa rjes su 'gro zhing ma gsol to/ /mi gnas dbang po zhi ba gang zhig yul rnams la/ /stobs rab dbang po nyid las yang dag mi gnas shing / /gzhan rnams kyis ma thob pa'i lam bzangs thob pa ste/ /ro mkhyen pas ni nges par 'byung ba'i ro gsol to/ /gang gis sngar ma byin pa'i sbyin pa byin pa 1ste/ /'bras bu 'dod pas cung zad zhig ni mi ④byin la/ /mnyam nyid rjes mthun phun sum tshogs pa dor ba ste/ /dam pa rnams kyi yid rnams yon tan rnams kyis phrogs/ /brtan pa rnams kyi 5g.yo ba'i spyan ni bsrungs pa ste/ /brtan par gshegs shing sems ni bsrung du bcug gyur la/ /dge legs rnams ni bsrungs shing 'phel bar mdzad pa ste/ /chos skyes pa ni cung zhig 'dod par ma mdzad do/ /brtan pas mi dge ba las mi dge rnam 6spangs nas / /dge legs kyi lteni dgra bo skyon rnams spangs pa ste/ /gang zhig blo yis nyes pa rnams ni kun spangs la/ /de ni 'phags min mi rtag nyid kyis nub par gyur/ /gang la chos ni 'dod pa dāyang dag rjes song zhing / /dga' bas mchog tu nges pa rnam par bzung ba ste/ /me yis nor ni zos pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ /khyab bdag ye shes nor can de yang srog song ngo / /brgyad po rnams la mchog tu sde tshen 9 lnga thul zhing / /gsum gzigs spyod pa gsum ni zad byed spyan gsum pa/ /gcig ni bsrungs nas gabyug ni thob nas gcig 96—236

rtogs nas/ /lci ba bdun rnams spangs nas bla ma gzims par gyur/ /gang gi hūṃzhi ba'i ched du lam ni gsal mdzad de/ /legs pa'i skye bo zhi bas rab tu dang mdzad cing / /nyon mongs ljon shing rab tu chags pa bcad pa ste/ /srid pa rnams las gus pa ldan pa rnams bsgral to/ /gsung gi bdud rtsis 'jig rten shin tu tshim mdzad cing / /bzod pa yis ni khro ba yongs su bzung ba ste/ /slob ma'i sde ni dge legs la ni rol mdzad la/ /dge legs don du gnyer rnams phra mo rtogs su bcug /legs pa rnams la chos kyi sa bon skyed mdzad cing / /rgyu yi bdag nyid 'phags pa'i lam ni thob mdzad la/ /'jig rten 'das pas 'phags pa min pa ma brten zhing / /chos las ma gtogs gzhan la sbyar ba ma yin no/ /kā shi gnas su chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ste/ /blo dang ldan pa nyid kyis 'jig rten tshim mdzad cing / /gdul bya rnams ni chos kyi cho gar spyad mdzad la/ /bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i ched du dge bar rngumadzad / /gzhan rnams kyis 4ma mthong ba'i de nyid mthong mdzad cing / /yon tan rnams kyis chos byed rnams la sbyar ba ste/ /gzhan gyi lugs rnams tshar bcad nas ni skul 5gyur la/ /rtogs par dka' ba'i don ni rnam par shes par mdzad/ /thams cad mi rtag pa dang bdag med par gsungs shing / /srid pa rnams su bde ba cung zad ma bsrungs 6la/ /snyan pa'i ba dan gyen du rnam par bsgrengs pa 7ste/ /nga rgyal ka ba mthon po rnam par bsgyel ba 8mdzad/ /smad kyang rang gi thugs ni bskyod pa ma yin zhing / /thams cad la ni 'jug pa rnams la sred ma mdzad/ /rang nyid rgal zhing bying ba bsgral bar mdzad pa ste/ /zhi zhing pha rol 'khrul pa zhi bar mdzad gyur la/ /grol zhing pha rol bcings pa thu96—237

grol bar mdzad pa ste/ /rtogs shing pha rol rmongs pas rtogs par mdzad pa'o/ /thub pa thub pas tshul dang tshul min mkhyen 'di des/ /sems can rnams ni yang dag gtam gyes rjes bzung nas/ /tshul min la dga' tshul min 'byung po rnams la ni/ /bskal pa 'jig pa'i tshe na chos bzhin rab tu gzims/ /chu ldan sprin bzhin sa 'dzin ri bo nags tshal bzhin/ /'od ldan rgan po bzhin du 'od ldan gzhon nu bzhin/ /'jig rten dag gi lta byed bcom nas 'jig rten gyi1sna / /lta byed nye bar phrogs 2nas 'gros su 'di gshegs so/ /dbang phyug dam pa gang la ltung bas me reg cing / /gang gis 1mchog tu zhi ba'i lam ni brnyes 4pa ste/ /zhi ba brnyes pa de ni gus pas mthong nas su/ /de ring 'jig rten gnyen 'dun 5med cing rgud 6pa 'dra/ /'joms par 'dod cing stobs ni rab zhugs bdud kyang ni/ /sde dang bcas pas gang ni thub par ma nus pa/ /'joms par 'dod cing stobs zhugs bdud kyis de ring ni/ /de ni dus kyi 7spyor las 'joms par nus par gyur/ /'byung po rnams ni thams cad rnams ni 'dus pa rnams/ /sdug bsngal rnams kyis zil non lha dang bcas pa rnams/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa gang rnams zad pa ma yin zhing / /de ltar mchog tu mya ngan 'das pa thob ma yin/ /skye dgu 8rnams kyi snang mdzad gang gis 'jig rten ni/ /nye bar skye ba me long bzhin du gzigs pa ste/ /rgyang ring du 'am nye bar mtho ris su 'am mthar/ /lha yi rna bas sgra ni rnam par thos pa'o/ /bar snang dag la skar ma'i khang par 'dzegs pa ste/ /sa la rab tu zhugs kyang jeg pa ma yin zhing / /chu la rab tu gshegs kyang nub pa ma yin la / /sku yis rnam par 'gyur ba mang po rnams mdzad do/ /de rnams de 96—238

rnams gnas rnams lam 'gros lam na bzhin/ /gang gis skye ba du ma rnams kyang dran pa ste/ /yid kyis 1pha rol rnams kyi yid kyi spyod pa rnams/ /dbang po las 'das sna tshogs rnams kyang mkhyen pa'o/ /thams cad mnyam par rab zhugs thams cad mkhyen pa des/ /zag pa thams cad bcad cing bya ba thams cad mdzad/ /ye shes kyis ni nyon mongs thams cad rnam 2spangs nas/ /ye shes de nyid kun nas brnyes nas gzims par gyur/ /skyes bu rnams kyi rno ba'i sems rnams btul ba ste/ /rno ba ma yin blo rnams rim gyis drag par mdzad/ /rigs las chos kyi nyes pa spang bar mdzad pa ste/ /'chi med ched du chos ni su yis ston par 'gyur/ /rten dang bral ba'i na'ajig rten nyam thag pa la ni/ /zhi ba'i ched du chos kyi 'thor ma su yis ster/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid ldan la ༄rang gi don mdzad nas/ /gzhan gyi nyon mongs dra ba su yis 'byed rīpar 'gyur / /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor gzhol ba'i 'jig rten dag gi ni/ /zhi ba'i ched du ye shes dam pa su yis smra/ /shes pa med par gzhol ba'i 'jig rten dag gi ni/ /dge ba'i ched du ye shes dam pa su yis smra/ /ji ltar nyin mor byed pa 'od zer med pa dang / /ji ltar chu bo sen dhu 'bab pa med pa dang / /sa bdag rgyal srid dang ni rnam par bral ba 'am/ /de phyir 6'jig rten 'jig rten mkhyen pas rnam par dman/ /blo yis rig pa bzhin du bde bas dbyangs bzhin du/ /dpal gyis mi skyong bzhin du bzod pas chos bzhin du/ /de bzhin skyes bu mchog gis rnam par dman pa ni/ /'gro ba de ni yod pa dang ni med pa nyid/ /ji ltar kha lo sgyur bas shing rta dor 7ba dang / /skya ba 'dzin pas gru dang tshul gyis sde dang ni/ /tshong dpon gyis ni tshong pa sman pas nad 96—239

pa ste/ /de bzhin 'jig rten bde bar gshegs pas snyernam par smana'u/ /dbyar tha dang ni ston rar mkha' la sprin med na/ /rlung gis kyang ni mkha' la bsnyen pa med pa na/ /'tsho bar 'dod pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal ji lta ba/ /de ltar thar 'dod rnams kyi nga ni nyam thag 'di/ /de ltar dam pa'i don mdzad dgra bcom yin na yang / /byed pa shes pa nyid kyis bye —bla ma la zhugs pa/ /de ni chags bral yin kyang srid pa'i skyon rnams dang / /ston pa'i yon tan rnams 4ni mang po rnams smras so/ /de nas chags bral min 5rnams mchi ma 'thon pa ste/ /brtan 5pa btang nas dge slong tshogs ni mya ngan dang / /'jig rten 'god pa'i bdag nyid can zhes byar bzung nas/ /bya ba'i 'khor lo rnams ni brtan las ma g.yos so/ /de nas dus kyi dbang gis gyad rnams kyis thos nas/ /gus 7pa'i dbang gis skyen par 'thon zhing song ba ste/ /khra yi dāstobs kyis 1zil mnan khrung khrung rnams bzhin du/ /kyi hud 'o brgyal 1 zhes ni nyam thag 'thon pa'o/ /mun pa rab tu rgyas phyir thub pa rab gzims pa/ /nyi ma 'od med bzhin du de rnams kyis mthong nas/ /seng ges 11khyu mchog rmugs satsha ba lang rnams bzhin du/ /gus pas drag tu cho nges btab cing ngus pa'o/ /chos dga' chos kyi bla ma rab tu zhi ba na/ /gus pas 1/ji lta ba dang bsam pa ji lta bar / /'o dod 'bod cing mchi mas mig bcom de rnams kyi7/ /dpal ldan dam pa 'ga' zhig 'di ni smras pa'o/ /gang zhig gson 15pa'i 'jig rten gnyid tshe rab sad pa/ /'di de mthar thug gzims mal la ni gzims pa ste/ /chos ni rnam par 'dzin pa'i rgyal mtshan 'di de ni/ /mchod sbyin mtha' na dbang po'i rgyal mtshan bzhin du btulal/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyi ma nges 96—240

par blo gsal zhing / /brtson 'grus tshad gdung nyaye shes 'od zer stong ldan pa//nub par gyur tshe mi shes mun pa rnams rībacom nas/ /'jig rten dag na slar yang mun pa 'di mdzad do/ /'das dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar gzigs nas su / /da ni nges par 'jig rten mig ni sgrib pa ste/ /snyug bsngal rgya mtsho chen po rgod pa'i dba' rlabs las/ /'dren mdzad zam pa 'di ni nges par de ni rgud/ /de ltar 'di na kha cig snying rje bar zlos snyeshing / /gzhan rnams shing rta'i rta rnams dud pa bzhin du sems/ /gzhan rnams skad bton gzhan rnams sa la 'gyel ba ste/ /bya ba de rnams de rnams sems can dbang gis byas//de nas dus su gser gyis spras shing sna tshogs pa/ /mche ba rin thang chen bo longs ma spyad pa'i khyogs/ /gyad rnams ngu bzhin drang srong la ni glang chen kyi/ /lag pa dang mtshungs lag pa rnams ni btsugs 4pa'o/ /de nas dus dang mthun pa'i cho ga byas nas su/ /de la phreng ba yid 'ong rnam 5pa sna tshogs dang //6dri mchog dam pa rnams kyis de rnams kyis mchod cing / /de nas dga' dang gus pas mtha' dag bzung ba'o/ /de nas shing 7gzhon lus can gzhon nu ma rnams kyisan/ /gdu bu rab 'khrol zangs mdog lag pa rnams kyis ni/ /glog gi 'phan rnams dag gis sprin ni dkar po bzhin/ /'di la rin thang mchog gi bla re 9bzung ba'o/ /de bzhin mi rnams kha cig dag gis gdugs rnams ni/ /phreng ba dkar po ldan rnams kun nas bzung ba ste/ /kha cig dag gis gser gyi yo byad dang ldan pa'i/ /rnga yab dkar po rnams ni rnam par g.yabs pa'o/ /de nas khyu mchog rnams kyis bzhin du ngal ba yis/ /mig dmar gyad rnams dag gis khyogs ni bzung ba ste/ /sil snyan rnams ni rna ba'i 96—241

yid du 'ong ba rnams/ /dbyar dus chu gter bzhin du mkha' la rab tu grags//phyogs kyi glang po'i dbang po rnams kyi bskul ba yis—1/ /mdzes pa dang ni rtsub 'gyur 2shing rnams las bzhin du/ /me tog pad+ma la sogs de rnams de rnams ni / /lha yi me tog rnams ni lha nas lhung bar gyur༄ / /dbang po'i glang po las skyes glang po che rnams kyis/ /nor gnas snying po'i chu skyes pad+ma rnams dang ni / /man dā ra yi me tog 'dab 4/bcas chags pa rnams/ /chu thigs zer mas 'thor ba rnams kyis mngon par 'thor/ /de nas dga' ba'i tshal skyes lus mchog ldan pa yi/ /tsan+dan dmar po'i ro ni rnam par dul ba dang / /'bad pas ma bsgrubs bgo ba rnams ni dkar po rnams/ /dri za'i bu mo rnams kyis yang dag 'thor ba'o/ /rab tu g.yo ba'i ba dan rnams ni bzung ba ste/ /phreng ba rnam pa 5sna tshogs rnams kyis bkram pa ste/ /sil snyan rgya chen rnams kyis rjes su 'gro ba ste/ /zhi ba'i ched du zhi ba'i lam las 6khyogs te drangs/ /gus pa dang ldan gyad rnams kyis de 7yongs bzung nas/ /thub pa'i mthu las lan brgyar mngon par phyag 'tshal zhing / /de yi rnam par nyams las rekun nas ngu ba ste/ /grong khyer gyi 9ni dbus nas yongs su drangs pa'o/ /klu yi sgo nas zhugs te phyi rol byung nas ni/ /chu bo gser ldan zhes pa yang dag rgal nas su/ /cod pan zhes bya'i mchod rten gyi ni rtsa ba ru/ /grags pas bsags phyir bsags 1 pa de rnams kyis byas so/ /de nas shun pa 'dab ma dri bzangs a ka ru/ /tsan+dan e la klu rnams kyis bsags bsags pa ru/ /mya ngan las ni sbrul bzhin dbugs rgyu de rnams ni/ /brtan min mig can rnams kyis thub pa'i sgu bzhus 11so/ /de nas lan gsum bkod kyang me yi sgron ma yis/ /96—242

de tshe drang srong chen po'i bsags pa ma 'bar te/ /bag med ldan pa gzhu ni rnam par 'khrugs pa yis/ / mda' ni 7snarang bzhin sa yi bdag po'i dpal bzhin no/ /lam dag tu ni rnam par 'ong ba'i 'od srungs 2ni/ /rnam par dag pa'i sems kyis sems ni gyur pa ste 1/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung tshang ba 4lta 'dod de/ /gang gi mthu las me yi 5'bar ba ma yin no/ /de nas de tshe bla ma blta ba'i don du ni/ /der ni dge slong skyen par nye bar song ba na / /thub pa mchog la rab tu btud pa byas pa na/ /de ma thag tu gre ni rang nyid 'bar bar gyur/ /nyon mongs rnams kyis ma tshig thub pa'i sgu gdung la/ /pags pa sha dang spu dang cha shas rnams tshig nas/ /mar dang rlung 6dang bud shing yongs su rgyas na yang / /rnge yis rus pa tshig par nus pa ma yin no/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po 'das pa'i de rnams ni/ /chu mchog gis ni dang bar byas nas dus su ni/ /mngon par bstod cing gyad rnams dag gis 7grong khyer du / /gser gyi bum pa rnams kyis rab tu spyan drangs so/ /'di ni ri bo chen po'i rin chen khams bzhin no / /dge legs gang ba chen po rnams ni 'dzin pa ste/ /mtho ris dag na lha yi gtso bo'i khams bzhin du/ /khams ni me yis log par spyor ba ma yin nyid/ /byams pas yongs su rnam par bsgoms pa 'di rnams ni/ /'dod chags me yis tshig pas rnam par spangs pa ste/ /de yi gus pa'i dbang gis gzung tsu—ba'i gdung rus rnams/ /bsel ba yin kyang bdag cag rnams kyi yid rnams bsregs7/ /sred pa 'joms mdzad gang gi mthu las khyab 'jug gi /mkha' lding gis kyang khur bar nus pa ma yin pa/ /'jig rten dag na mtshungs med de yi rus pa rnams/ /mi rus 11gyur pa kho bo 96—243

cag gis khur bar gyesashā/ /e ma 'jig rten chos ni nges par stobs ldan te/ /chos la nus kyang nus pas gang gis ma bzlog cing 2/ /gang zhig snyan ṅkupas 'gro ba mtha' dag khyab pa ste/ /de yi sku yi cha shas 'di ni bum par gnas/ /gang zhig bdag gi snang bas nyi ma gzhan 4snang zhing / /de yi sa ni snang bas rnam par 5mdzad pa ste/ /gser gyi mdog dang ldan pa de yi sku lus ni/ /me rnams kyis ni rus pa lhag mar byas pa'o/ /gang gis nyon mongs ri bo rgyas tre pa rnams phye ste/ /sdug bsngal thob pa na yang bstan 7pa ma phye zhing / /sdug bsngal mtha' dag rnams ni bkag par gyur pa ste/ /drang srong de yi sku lus me yis bsregs pa'o/ /g.yul du dgra bo rnams kyis mchi ma phyung nas su/ /skyabs 'ongs rnams kyi mchi ma rnam par btul nas su/ /stug pa na yang mchi ma bstan 9pas ma bton pa/ /lam du mchi ma 'thon zhing de rnams rnam par zlos//de rnams nga rgyal ldan zhing lag pa stobs dang ldan na yang / /de ltar mya ngan byed cing nags bzhin grong khyer der zhugs shing / /lam rnams su ni ⑪gdung de rnams ni skye bos mchod pa ste/ /mchod pa'i don du gzhal yas khang par mdzes par byas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las/mya ngan las 'da' ba bsngags pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// //ji lta ba bzhin nyin zhag 'ga' zhig de rnams kyis/ /de rnams mchod pa dam pa rnams kyis mchod pa ste/ /chab 'og rgyal phran pho nya bdun rnams rim gyis ni/ /de yi ched du grong khyer der ni nye bar 'ongs/ /de nas de'i tshe gang rnams thos nas dus su ni/ /nga rgyal las dang de yi gus pa'i dbang las ni/ /96—244

gyad rnams 'thab hūṃmo la yang nges par song ba ste/ /sbyin pa la ni yid rnams byas pa ma yin no/ /de nas de dag rnams kyis rnam gzhag thu'adi rtogs nas/ /rlung bdun bzhin du mi dbang bdun po de rnams ni/ /gyen du zhugs pa'i gang gā'i shugs 'dra stobs tshogs ni/ /shin tu drag po rnams kyis —ku sha zhes byar 'ongs / /de nas grong pa'i skye bo nags mtha' nas skyen par/ /mi skyong de dag rnams kyi mgyogs 4'gro'i sgra yis ni/ /khros byepa las ni mgo bo rnams la bzung ba bzhin/ /'jigs pas rgyas pa'i gdong rnams grong khyer la zhugs so/ /de nas mi skyong de rnams grong khyer de bkag nas/ /glang po'i dbang po rnams bcings rtsed 9mo'i nags rnams su/ /gyad mchog rnams kyis 7mi mthun spyad du gyur pa rnams/ /rigs kyi rjes mthun cha lugs ldan rnams la gsos so/ /de nas mda' yab mdzes shing ring pa'i smin ma de/ /sgo yi mig ni rnam par btsums shing grong khyer de/ /mi dga' ba dang 'dus pa'i yan lag ma bzhin du//dpung pa'i khyogs ni bteg pa nyam thag par gyur to / /rgyal po bdun po rnams ni bya ba gcig pa ste/ /dpal gyis 'bar zhing shugs kyis 'phro ba rnams kyis ni/ /mnyam du dus gcig la ni gza' 9bdun rnams kyi ni/ /'jigs pa dang bcas nam mkha' bzhin du sa gyur to/ /sna rnams gnyis 'thung myos zhepa'i chang dri rnams kyis dang / /mig rnams dpung gis bsnun pa'i rdul rnams dag gis dang / /rna ba rnams ni rta glang rnga yi dbyangs rnams kyis/ /mi mo'i skye bo yi yang der ni bcom par gyur/ /de nas skyogs rnams nang du khu ba 'bab pa ni/ /mdun du bdar rnams bsdogs 7byas rta ba'i tshogs rnams dang //glang po rnams kyis yongs bskor sgo ni phyed bkag ste/ /'gegs shing g.yul la 96—245
