phyogs rnams kyis byas so/ /de nas shag ti ral gri mda' lag grong khyer pa/ / skrag pas da 3ni dpa' bas ngo tsha btang ba rnams/ /khra rnams bzhin du dgra bo rnams la lta bzhin du/ /nye ba'i 'thab ra rnams su kun nas gnas pa'o/ /brtan min ldan pa kha cig 'o dod 'bod pa ste/ /de bzhin gzhan rnams tshogs nas dung ni rab tu sgogs/ /drag tu dregs rnams kha cig rab tu 'phen pa ste/ /de bzhin gzhan rnams ral gri sngon po rnams 'debs so/ /de nas rgyal ba'i ched du gyad rnams 'thab 'dod cing / /gyad rnams bzhin du mtshan rnams sgogs pa mthong nas ni/ /g.yul 'gyed yan lag ma rnams dag gi tresems rnams dang / /sman rnams dang mnyam mchod yon rnams ni g.yos par gyur/ /g.yul der thog mar 'gro bar 'dod pa'i bu la ni/ /g.yul 'gyed yan lag ma rnams der ni yongs 'dar zhing / /go cha bcings nas zhi ba'i shes pa byed pa ste/ /sems khral gdong rnams mchi ma bton pa ma yin no/ /sems khral gdong las gzhan rnams ri dwags mo bzhin du/ /khyim thab 'gro bar 'dod pa'i gzhu la 'phyangs pa ste/ /gang gi gdong ni 'thab la dpa' ba de mthong nas/ /bcings pa'i 'phro spong song ba ma yin gnas ma yin/ /bum pa'i nang du yang dag bkag pa'i sbrul rnams bzhin/ /stobs kyis de ltar rab tu 'phro ba de rnams ni/ /de ltar rnam par gzhag 4pa'i gyad rnams mthong nas ni/ /mi dbang rnams kyis g.yul kyi ched du blo bsams so/ /shing rta glang po rta dang rkang thang dregs pa ni/ /g.yul la kun nas nye bar gzhol ba 5mthong nas ni/ /mkhas pa nyid kyis dang ni mdza' bo nyid kyis ni/ /gnyis skyes bye bos tshig ni 'di skad ces smras so/ /g.yul du dgra bo rnams kyi srog dang dregs pa ni/ /96—246

khyed cag rnams kyi 3mda' yis 'joms par nus pa ste/ /rdzod pa tha dad gnas rnams bde bar mi nus na/ /pha rol bya ba gcig pa rnams ni smos ci dgos—/ /ci ste kun nas bkag pas pha rol 'joms pa la/ /blo ni byas rnams de ni rnam par zlog mdzod dang / /nyes pa med pa'i grong pa'i skye bo 'gegs pa yi/ /gtse 2 bar byed pa de ni chos ni ci zhig yin/ /dong du zhugs pa'i nag po'i sbrul rnams bgrod pa ni/ /gcig la gnas pa rnams kyis dus su rmugs rngupa bzhin/ /bkag nas rgyal ba mtha' gcig yod pa ma yin zhing / /brgya la bkag pa rnams kyis rgyal ba 'thob par 'gyur/ /grong gi nang du bkag pa'i gtad rnams zhugs 4pa rnams/ /yid dang ldan pa nyid las mi rnams kyis thos nas/ /bsreg 5bya rnams kyis 'thor 6ba'i chung ngu'i me bzhin du/ /gzi brjid dman kyang legs pa chen por 'gro bar 'gyur/ /chos kyi bdag nyid can rnams grong du bkag na yang / /'joms 'dod thob pa rnams ni dka' thub kyis gtor te/ /dpung ni zad par gyur kyang kā dz+washa'i grong khyer du/ /lag pa sgra byed chos kyi stobs las rnam par rgyal/ /snyan grags ched dam yul ni 'thob pa'i ched du sa/ /mtha' ༷dag gang rnams kyis kyang mngon par thob pa ste/ /ba lang rnams kyis chu gnas nas chu 'thungs 9snanas bzhin/ /bor nas nor 'dzin bdag po de rnams sa la song / /de phyir chos dang don ni yang dag mthong nas su/ /khyed cag rnams kyis 1 zhi bas 'bad pa mdzod cig dang / /mda' yis 71'pham pa rnams ni be+er yang 'bar ba ste/ zhi bas 'pham pa rnams 1 kyi rnam 'gyur yod ma yin/ /'di kun khyed cag rnams kyi tshad ma ma yin te/ /khyed kyi stobs kyi 1)dgra yi stobs las 'gro 96—247

bar nus/ /shākya thub pa gang la mchod par blo yod na/ /de nyid kyi ni gsung la bzod pas bsnyen mdzod cig /de skad ces sogs 'dod pa rnam par nges pa ni/ /bram ze'i drang pos dang ni rab tu dga' ba yis/ /rgyal po yin yang rjes su bstan nas legs pa des/ /dge legs smras shing de nas de rnams kyis smras so/ /dus dang sbyar te mkhas shing phan la bshes kyis ni/ /tshig gang 'di de 3 khyed kyis rnam par smras pa ste/ /chos la dga' ba nyid dang stobs la brten 37pa las/ /rgyal po rnams kyis bsam pa nges par shes par mdzod/ /'dod pa'i phyir dang khro phyir stobs phyir 'chi ba'i phyir/ /phal che bar ni bya bar song zhing 'gro ba ste/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang bcas kho bo cag rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid la mchod pa la ni gzhu rnams bzung / /nga rgyal don du mchod yon blangs la rtsod pa ni/ /byes pa skyong dang drag po dag gis khyab 'jug byung / /nga rgyal spang phyir mchod pa'i don du nged rnams kyis/ /tshe rnams dag kyang 'dor bar mi bgyi gang las yin/ /bu mo la ni sa skyong dag gi rgyal po rnams/ /gtum po long byed rnams ni rtsod par song ba ste/ /'dod pa 'joms phyir mchod pa'i don du nged rnams kyis/ /tshe rnams dag kyang 'dor bar mi bgyid gang las yin/ /rgyal rigs zad phyir drang srong drag tu khros pa ni/ /ngan spong bu yis g.yul du mtshon rnams bzung ba ste/ /khro ba 'joms phyir mchod pa'i don du nged rnams kyis/ /tshe rnams dag kyang 'dor bar mi bgyid gang las yin/ /lha mo sī tar mngon brjod 'chi ba yongs bzung nas/ /srin po shin tu dregs pa yang ni nyams pa ste/ /yongs 'dzin spong phyir mchod pa don du nged rnams kyis/ /tshe rnams dag kyang 'dor bar mi bgyid snyegang las yin/ /96—248

e ḍi lam hu/ni pa ka zhes ni dgra 'phel nazhing / /rgyal rigs bye ba rnams ni de ltar nyams pa ste/ /rmongs mun gtor phyir mchod pa'i don du nged rnams kyis/ /tshe rnams dag kyang 'dor bar mi bgyid gang las yin/ /de skad ces sogs 'jig rten dag na 'thab mo ni/ /skyon las skyes pa mang po rnams ni byung gyur te/ /ston pa bla na med pa'i gus pas 'chi snyeb dang / /bcas pa yin kyang 'thab mo mi bgyid gang las yin/ /de lta na yang bdag cag rnams kyi nges pa 'di/ /khyed kyi pho nyar gyur cig skyen par gshegs mdzod la/ /ji ltar don ni snye'athab mo min pas 'grub pa cig /de ltar bdag nyid kun gyis 'bad pa gyis mdzod cig /khyed kyis thuchos ldan tshig rnams kyis ni nged cag rnams/ /'thab par 'dod cing mda' yi mche ba rnon po can/ /nang du rab tu 'phel ba'i dug ni 'thungs pa 3rnams/ /sngags rnams kyis ni sbrul rnams bzhin du bkag pa'o//de ltar bgyi zhes rgyal po rnams kyi tshig bzung nas/ /bram ze de ni grong khyer de la rab zhugs shing / /ji ltar rim gyis gyad rnams dag ni mthong ba ste/ /mthong nas dus su tshig ni 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhu rnams lag na gnas pa'i mi dbang 'di rnams ni/ /nyi ltar byi dor go cha 'bar rnams kyis/ /khyed cag rnams kyis 9grong 'dir nges par ro myang zhing / /seng ge bzhin du rnam par 'gying zhing gnas pa'o/ /de rnams kyi ni shubs su bkod pa'i ral gri dang / /gser gyi rgyab ldan gzhu rnams nges par rtogs pa ste/ /grub ⑫pa'i chos dran nas ni chos min gyes 'jigs shing / /zhu ba gsol bar byed de g.yul la 'jigs rnams min/ /de rnams mngon par 'ongs rnams sa yi phyir min zhing / /nor phyir ma yin rgyags phyir ma yin dgra phyir min/ /thub pa'i gus 96—249

pas nged cag rnams kyi zhe sa 'di/ /de phyir khyed cag rnams kyi bya bas bkur ste mdzad/ /thub pa de la khyed cag gi dang nged cag gi /bla ma nyid du mnyam ste 'di las ngal ba 'di/ /de phyir spun gyi tshogs ni 'dus nas 'ongs pa ste/ /bla ma'i gdung 1rnams mchod pa la ni bya ba gcig /ji ltar chos kyi cho ga la ni ser sna nyid/ /nor rnams la ni ser sna de ltar skyon ma yin/ /ser sna smra ba nges pa nyid du skyon yin zhing / /skyon ni chos kyi dgra bor gyur pa nyid yin no/ /gal te mi sbyin par ni khyed rnams kyis das 2na/ /sdong nas 'thon nas 'gron po rnams la bsnyen par mdzod/ /gang rnams kyis stobs mnga' rnams ma yin sgo glegs rnams/ /de rnams rigs su skyes pa'i rgyal rigs ma yin no/ /byams pa dang ni gzi brjid ston par byed bzhin du/ /mi dbang rnams kyis khyed cag rnams la de skad smras/ /bdag gi smra 'dod gang yang rang gis 3 rtogs nas su/ /dga' las bdag gi 4de ni khyed cag rnams kyis nyon/ /'ga' zhig rtsod pa dge ba ma yin chos min te/ /rnam par 'gras par ma 'gro zhi ba bsnyen par mdzod/ /thub pa des ni bzod pa rab tu bsngags pa ste/ /gang gis gus pas me ni kun nas 'phel bar 'gyur/ /nor dang 'dod pa dag gi gcig gi ched du ni/ /rnam par rtsod pa tshul ni nye bar 'gyur ba phyeste/ /chos kyi ched du slar yang 'phags par gyur pa ni/ /zhi ba dang ni dgra bo rnam par rtsod par smra/ /gang zhig nye bar zhi zhing byams pa'i thugs kyis hūṃni/ /sems can thams cad rnams la brtse ba gsungs pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po ⑦ mnga' ba de la mchod pa ni/ /'tshe ba byas nas bdag gi shelugs dang mtshungs ma yin/ /de phyir gdung ni rab tu sbyin las 'di rnams la/ /grags pa dang 96—250

ni chos kyis yang dag 1bgo ba mdzod/ /de ltar gyur 27na khyed kyis rtsod min de dag dang / /de dag gis kyang chos dang grags pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /chos ldan skyes bu rnams kyis chos las g.yos pa ni/ /chos la 'bad pa las kyang nged rnams kyis spyor na/ /gang bdag rnams kyis 4gzhan dag chos la spyor byed pa/ /de dag rnams kyis chos ni gnas pa'i ched du 'jug /drang srong dam pa mchog gis chos kyi rngusbyin pa ni/ /sbyin pa thams cad kyi 67ni khyad par 'phags par gsungs / /gang zhig la las nor la spyor bar byed pa ste/ /chos kyi sbyin pa po ni rnam par bsags pa yin/ /de nas snyan grags dang ni bde ba 'dren pa dang / /chos kyi tshig ni de las nye bar thob nas ni/ /ngo tsha dang bcas phan tshun lta ba de rnams kyis/ /bye bo'i rigs mnyam bram ze la ni smras pa'o/ /e ma mdza' bo'i dge la khyod kyis nges pa ste/ /yon tan rnams la bram ze'i rjes su mthun pas chags/ /lam gzhan kyis ni 'khrul ba'i rta ngan rnams bzhin du/ /gang gis legs par bsnyen pa'i lam la bkod par 'gyur7/ /ji ltar smras pa de ltar de ni ldan 'gyur zhing / /brtse zhing mnyen pa'i tshig 'di 'dzin par rigs pa ste/ /mdza' bo'i skye bo'i tshig la shin tu 'das nas su/ /phyi nas snyug bsngal nyid du lhung 9rnams mya ngan 'gyur/ /de nas 'gro ba'i khams rig gdung ni gyad rnams kyis/ /de rnams brgyad du gus pas yon tan las bgos so / /de nas rang nyid kyis ni cha shas bzung nas ni/ /bdun po so so so sor gzhan rnams la byin 7to/ /gyad rnams dag gis mngon mchod sa skyong de rnams kyang / /dga' zhing don byas rnams ni rang yul rnams su gshegs/ /de nas drang srong gis gdung de rnams cho ga bzhin/ /rang grong rnams su 96—251

mchod rten rab gnas rnams de byas/ /de nas rang gi yul du thub pa'i mchod rten ni/ /byed 'dod bye bos so sor hūṃ/bgos pa'i bum pa blangs/ /sol ba lhag ma rnams kyang pi sa la zhes pa'i/ /gus pas rjes su rab ldan rnams kyis byebaslangs par gyur/ /de nas gdung gi snying po can gyi sngon du brgyad/ /brag ri dkar po dang mtshungs mchod rten rnams gyur zhing / /de yi bum pas bsnyen pa bram ze'i dgu pa ste/ /sol ba'i snying po dang ldan bcu pa byung bar gyur/ /thub pa'i mchod rten sna tshogs ba dan g.yo ba rnams/ /ti se'i gangs ri'i rtse mo dang mtshungs de rnams la/ /rang gi skye bo dang bcas mi skyong de rnams dang / /skye dgu dang bcas bram ze rnams kyis sa na mchod/ /phreng ba mngon sbyar rnams dang dri bzangs mchog rnams dang / /phreng ba dge ba rnams dang sil snyan dbyangs rnams kyis/ /mchod pa dam pa mi skyong de rnams de rnams kyis/ /rgyal ba'i gdung ni 'dzin pa de rnams la byas so/ /de nas dus su dgra bcom rnams kyi lnga brgya rnams/ /ri bo lngas mtshan grong khyer du ni yongs 'dus nas/ /slar yang ji lta ba bzhin chos ni gnas pa'i phyir/ /thub pa'i gsung ni ri yi logs su yang dag bsdus/ /gnas skabs kun du drang srong che las thos pa ni/ /kun dga' bo nyid yin zhes nges par gyur pa yi/ /dge slong de rnams kyis ni 'dus pa mthun pa ru/ /gsung bar zhu zhes lus 'phags thub pa la zhus so/ /de nas de dag rnams kyi dbus su de bzhugs nas/ /smra ba rnams kyi mchog gis ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshig /gang du gang la gang gi tshe na gang zhig dang / /'di skad bdag gis 'di ni thos zhes gsungs par gyur/ /de phyir dgra bcom rnams kyis rjes su bcings pa des/ /thub pa chen po'i 4chos kyi bstan bcos 96—252

gnas pa ste/ /gang zhig 'bad pas yang dag rab tu thob pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das shing 'da' la mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyuralku/ /dgra bo khengs pa rnams kyi mya ngan ster ba po/ /skye dgu sdug bsngal rnams kyi mya ngan gcod pa pobye me tog 'bras ldan mya ngan med ltar blta na sdug /dus su de gus sa bdag mya ngan med pa byung / /'phags pa mo rgya'i dpal des skye dgur phan don du/ /'jig rten kun la mchod rten mtshan ma byed du bcug /gtum po mya ngan med nyid thob nas sa la ni/ /chos rgyal mya ngan med nyid las de thob par gyur/ /mngon du byas pa'i mchod rten bdun po de rnams las/ /drang srong de yi gdung rnams mo rgya snyedes blangs nas/ /dpal ldan mchod rten ston ka'i sprin kyi 'od rnams kyi/ /stong phrag brgyad cur babs 5pa dus su zhag gis byas/ /dga' byed grong gnas mchod rten brgyad pa dang po ni/ /de yi dus su gus ldan klu rnams kyis bsrungs te/ /de phyir gdung rnams thob pa ma yin rgyal po des/ /der byas pa la ma dad rgya chen gyur nga/'o/ /de'i 7phyir yid kyis dgra bo 'bras bu rnams la ni/ /kun nas gnas shing g.yo ba'i dpal ni bsrungs na yang / /mi skyong des ni ngur smrig gon pa las gzhan du/ /lta ba rnam par dag cing 'bras bu dang po thob/ /de las gzhan du gzhan gyis thub pa'i mchod pa ni/ /gang gis byas shing byed la byed par 'gyur ba ste/ /dam pa'i skye bos bsnyen pa'i 'bras bu bla na med/ /de yis thob cing 'thob la 'thob par 'gyur ba nyid/ /drang srong bzhugs pa la ni mchod pa sbyar nas sam/ /yongs su mya ngan 'das pa'i gdung la phyag byas nas/ /yid kyi dang ba mnyam na 'bras bu mnyam pa ste/ /sangs rgyas yon tan rnams ni mkhas rnams shes par mdzod/ /de phyir rtag tu 96—253

mchog gi chos ni mkhyen pa'o/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur 'pho ba med pa brnyes ldan pa//brtse ba dang bcas thub pa blo gros chen po ni/ /mchod 'os mchog la mchod la lkudam pa 'ongs pa'o/ /mchog tu thugs rje dang ldan mchog gi thugs mkhyen pa/ /gzhan la phan phyir mchog tu ngal bar byon pa de/ /mdzad pa mkhyen pa nyid kyis —dam pa mkhas rnams kyi/ /'di na gtang rag mchod pa gang phyir 'os ma yin/ /sa na 'chi dang rga ba dang mnyam 'jigs pa dang / /mtho ris dag na 'pho ba dang mnyam yod min te/ /'gro ba'i de gnyis mkhyen nas gang zhig gnas pa ste//de phyir mchod par bya ba dam pa su 'dra yod/ /skye ba yod na bde ba min pa zi'abyung ba ste/ /yang srid med las shin tu bde bas bde ba med/ /de ni brnyes shing gang gis 'gro la byin pa ste/ /de'i 5phyir mchod par bya ba dam pa su 'dra yod/ /de ltar thub pa'i skyes mchog de yi gus pa yis/ /mkhas nyid yon tan las min snyan dngags nus pas min/ /thub pa'i lung gi rjes su 'brangs nas 'di brtsams te/ /skye dgu rnams kyi phan dang bde ba'i phyir gyur cig /yul shā se 6 ta ka'i gser mig ma'i bu dge slong slob dpon snyan dngags mkhan chen po/ smra ba dang ldan pa phyogs su rnam par grags pa/btsun pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i/ sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las sku gdung rnam par bgo ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa yongs su rdzogs so// //sa stengs rgya mtsho'i mthar thug bstan pa'i bdag po dz+wamachog /yon tan mtshungs med phul byung du ma'i gter chen po/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi bla ma skye dgu rnams kyi dpal/ /bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' lung gis/ /'jig 96—254

rang dga'i mchog brnyes des ni srid pa gsum po'i 'jigs bcom chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/gre /grong khyer 'dir ni dman pa'i gla mis rang nyid zas bcad don gnyer rang sangs rgyas zhig la/ /lhad rnguzan changs pas yang dag bkur byas mchod pa de yis grong khyer der ni ko sa la'i/ /dbang phyug nyid thob dge ba yongs gyur rmad du byung ba'i rgyal por gyur te de la 'dir/ /'jig rten gsum du ngo mtshar sgra bsgrags ༄ 'dir ni thub pa'i chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/ ce/bsod snyoms don gnyer 'dod chags bral la bdag nyid sngon snyeskyid bsod snyoms sbyin pa las/ /rab tu rab 'jigs dmyal ba sprul te mngon par log brjod lha yi bu yis bkag pa las/ /de dag ma mnyan dmyal skyes pad+ma'i sdong bu mdzes la rim gyis gom pa dor nas ni/ /de 'dir bdud las rgyal gyur lha mi'i bla ma de yi 6chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/ 7 /sbyin la goms pas rab tu phul byung mtha' dag rtog pa'i tshong dpon gang gi nor/ /lha yi dbang po de yi khye nor sbas na yang zad par ma nus de ni sbyin pa'i chos dang ldan/ /'di ltar des ni phongs pa zil mnan nyams par byed bcom pa de yi/ /nyon mongs rab zad stobs —1bcu'i stobs mnga' ston pa'i chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/huṣ+pe /ri bong lus 'dzin brgya byin lus gzhan bsgyur ba gang de rnam sprul du med pa yi me /rab gsal gser gyi 'od 'tsher me stag tshogs 'phro mi bzad par ni mchongs nas byin par gyur/ /de ni dbang pos mngon par gsal nyenabar bstan pa'i don du sbyin pa 'di ni ngo mtshar tshul/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la mtshan de rjes thub pa mchog gi chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/ rmye /bram ze a ga ste 8zhes bya ba gang byung rgyas pa'i khyim skyes rtswa 7dang 'dra bar ni/ /bde bas yid byung rab zhi 96—278

nges par byung ba'i gling ni nye gyur te/ /'dab ma btsos pa tsam zhig gis tshim de yang dbang pos sbas byas mtha' dag rig mod kyi/ /gang 'dug nges tshim bstan pas phun tshogs mtha' dag rtsod rgyal chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/lku /sa yi bdag po'i bla ma byams pa'i stobs ni byung gyur gang gi yang dag byedon gyi ming / /bdag nyid lus ni bdag gis bcad cing phug ste sha dang khrag dag zos shing 'thung gyur gang / /gnod sbyin lnga ni thog mar mngon par byung bas de kho na nyid thob pas tshim mdzad rgyal ba nyid/ /gcig pu rjes brtse dri ma med pa'i rgya mtsho'i chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/snye /rang gi srog dang mnyam pa'i bu ni gsar pa'i lus dang yid 'ong btsun mo rjes su mthun pa dag /sdug bsngal zug rngur ldan pa'i mun sprul bram zes thurab 'gyed bzhin yang rab dgas legs par byin/ /yang dag sdogs pa'i byang chub tu ni smon lam mi g.yo gang gis thams cad sgol de yisathu/ /srid gsum dman 6pa'i 'dod las rnam par rgyal bar gyur pa'i chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/7 /mchod sbyin brtsams phyir rang gi 'jig rten dag la 'di skad smras te skyes bu dag /'di ltar skye bo sdig pas mchod sbyin byed rnams myur du rlag par dā'agyur ro zhes thos kyi 9 / /'dir ni skye bo'i tshogs rnams sdig pa las ldog dge ba bcu yi lam nyid la gzhag shā cing / /'phel bar byed pa gang yin thub de'i rjes su snyan pa'i chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/shā1 /lha min grong khyer tshal du lha rnams pham gyur lhan cig bros tshe brgya byin gzugs 'dzin gyis/ /mkha' ⑩lding phru gu shing rta'i lam gnas nyams par mthong ste lha rnams lha smra nyu5brtse ba yis/ /bdag nyid gcig pu'i shing rta phyir log grong khyer sa gzhir zhugs te gang gis lha min las/ /rgyal 96—279

gyur de yi rjes brtses 'gro ba gsum las rnam rgyal chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/⑫/bram ze gang zhig legs par spyod dang yul gzhan brtan zhing zab mo'i shes ②dang ldan dbul bor/ /rang gi rnam 2gsal byas nas sus kyang ma tshor bar ni brkur rung zhes/ /mkhan po'i cho gas gzhan nor brlag bstan 'gog par byed ldan de ni slob mas ma mnyan te/ /gzhan gyi nor brlag mi byed rnyog pa med pa'i chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/bye /bud med rin chen gang zhig ji bzhin don ming 5mtha' dag 'jig rten myos byed byung bar gyur/ /sa yi bdag po shin tu gzhon snyug de las skyes pa'i 'dod 6chags thob gyur na 'ang gang de la/ /de las byung ba'i me yis bdag gi srog bsregs kyang ni tshul khrims lhod cing nyams ma gyur/ /de lta'i tshul khyems phung pos gsal zhing rab tu snyan pa'i chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/dz+wa /gang zhig gru bo'i tshong pas 'gron bsgrubs 'dod pas gsol btab de dag bltas nas gru bor ni/ /dka' bas bdag nyid zhugs gyur rlung chen shugs rlabs kyis ni rgya mtshor bying bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /bden pa'i tshig brjod pas ni rlung gis gru byebo phyir log dga' kye mtha'i ngos su khyer song gyur/ /rab mtho bsten pa'i bden ⑩pa'i tshig des chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/rtse1 /lteng ka nyi ma'i zer gyis skams skyepar gnyen tshogs dang bcas nya dag la ni khwa la sogs/ /bya tshogs rgyags pas phyogs kun nas bskor za bar 'dod pa rnams la bden pa'i tshig dag gis/ /byin rlabs gang brjod myur bar lha yi bdag pos char gyi rgyun phab srog chags rnams la yid mthun pas/ /rjes su srung byed rab zhi'i rang bzhin blo gros can des 1)chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/1rta /gang zhig chu 'dzin gzhan hūṃ’gye zer las rgyal ba'i me yis 96—280

bsregs te de dag rlung gis bskyod rmyepa yi/ /me rnams kyis ni nam mkha' khyab par byas te sreg pa phru gu za bar 'dod 'dra la/ /des ni zhi byed bden pa'i tshig gis dubyin gyis brlabs brjod pa las zhi ba thob par gyur/ /brdzun rngugyi tshig las slar log bzod pa dang ldan de yi byechos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/'u /mi yi bdag po thams cad bshes gnyen chang 'thung ba las mngon par dga' ba nyid gyur dbang pos ni/ /skyes bu de dag mthong ste bram ze'i gzugs bsgyur chang gis gang ba'i bum pa gang zhig thogs/ /mi bdag skye tshogs bcas pa de dag mdun du chang gi nyes pa gang dag bstan pa yin༅/ /de las des ni thams cad rnam par btul te skyon spangs pa yi mthu ldan chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/pe/bdag nyid rigs dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig byung gyur 'dod pa rgyas pa'i khyim las yid phyung nas/ /zhi bde 'dod pas zhi ba'i nags mthar song ste rab tu byung gyur pha mtshungs des/ /nye bar 'dod pa'i yid las gnyen gcig 3de la rang khyem nyes pa mngon par bstan nas kyang / /'dod bya min blos rab mchog gnas kyi bde rnyed de yi chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/1— /pha ma dus 'das khyem gyi bde las skyo bar gang gyur bas mtha'i nags su gnas bcas te/ /des ni dran gzhag bi sa la yi 'dab ma rtag tu rung ba kham gyi zas kyis 'tsho byed de/ / brtan te ra/ snanyams sad bya shākhyephyir lha yi dbang po der song 1 gang gi skal ba'i 'dab ma ni/ /nyin lnga brkus na'ang bsam gtan brtan pa bdud rtsi'i ros 'tsho de yi chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/0 /rgyal po'i gnang thuchen gyur nas nor gyi bdag po na tshod thog nyu5ma nad med pa yi lus ldan zhing / /gnyen tshogs rnams la byams dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten dag gi ded nyu dpon mchog tu gyur pa 96—281

gang / /rab tu byung bar gyuྈ ces 'di ltar mi bden par yang yon tan bsgrags pas bsgul nas ni/ /legs par rab byung mtha' dag yon tan gtam gyi 'bras bcas de yi chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/① /khyem gnas dga' yang nye bar spangs gyur gang 'gar 9thubartse ba kho nas chung ma gcig yod las/ /bas mtha' gang du snyeganas bcas rab zhi dga' bas gnas las der ni rgyal po gang gis de/ /brtag phyir brtul zhugs legs zhes bstod skyinas khyim thab phrogs khyakyang rab tu khro ba nges bcom ste/ /de la slar yang ⑥chos bstan rnam ⑦rgyal de yi rjes su chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/rme /sna tshogs yid bzhin mtsho ni dri ma med par bzhin bzangs 9 mdun bdar ngang pa'i rgyal po ni/ /rgyal po thob gyur blon por bcas bzung nas ni tshangs pas byin gyes rgyal po thob gyur te/ /chos bstan kun nas khyon mongs sra ba'i bya rnyi las grol gang gyur kye'agro ba gsum po yi//nyon mongs rnyi rnams rab tu bcom pa'i mkhas pa de yi chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so / hūṃ /rgyal po gang gi gnas na gcig tu byams dang ldan pa'i kun du rgyu zhig yod gyur la/ /de yi bka' ri gnas ni bdag nyid de gnas las song gang zhig gcig tu zhi ba'i nags mthar gnas/ /der ni mngon shes ye shes thob byas slar yang mi bdag de yi log lta'i dra ba las/ /rab tu bsrungs nyu5te lta ba spangs gyur sman pa de yi 1trīchos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/6 /bas mtha' gang du spre'u'i bdag nyid gyur nas mi yi yon tan las rgyal legs pa'i yon tan can/ /der ni mi zhig sdong po mchog chag g.yang sa cher lhung khung bur cho nges 'don pa mthong bar gyur/ /mthong nas kyang ni 'di ltar snying la rjes brtse yongs ldan gang des mchongs nas phyung ste brtas/ /mi bde d+kurnams las srid gsum phan 96—282

par mdzad pa de yi chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/sna7 /mi bdag gang zhig dngos su ri dwags sha ra bha yi ri dwags gsad snyephyir rta la zhon nas ni/ /mgyogs brgyugs rjupa las khron par lhung nas de mngon song ste sdegayang sa las gang phyung gyur pa/ /mi shes 5pa dang bu yang mtshungs nyid lta bu kho nar byas te rjes su brtse ba yis/ /sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal kun zad mdzangs thupar gyur des 3chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/bye7 /mi gang chu bos khyer gyur sna tshogs mdzes pa'i ru ru'i ri dwags kyis ni 9 phyung nas su/ /'di skad mngags te 'jig rten su la'ang ma smra mekho bo gnas kyang hūṃm brjod zhes skyapa las/ /des ni sa 'dzin la ⑫ni lag pas mi rnams la bstan mkhrig /— ma gcig ni chad par gyur—/ /mi de'ang skyabs shing mi yi dbang skyepo la ni gdams byas de yi chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so//me /gnas gang zhig na ljon pa'i ri dang ldan pa'i 'bras bu lhung gyur chu bos khyer ba zhig /rgyal po de yi mthu rtsal rjes su 'tshol bas rang gi gnyen rnams gsad ⑫'dod ri bo'i rtser/ /rang gi rkang pa gnyis char :5rab tu sra bar bcings te sra bar byas nas mthar phyung nus/ /ngal bas der ni bdag nyid dor gyur de yi rjes su chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/nyu /brdzun pas bye rab tu brtags ༄ rkepa'i skyon gyis nyams par 'os pa'i blo gros can yid rang gi lus / /'dar zhing khro bas mi bdag 'jigs byed mig ni dmar zhing nyon mongs ral gri sa 3rab tu bcom/ /bden pa'i don can bzod par smra bas rang lus ltos dor gang zhig 'gar yang mi bzod pas/ /rab tu gnod par byed la gnod bzod yid la byed pa'i chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/ sna /mi yi bdag po yan lag byen ni mi dge chad lta rab tu bskyed la tshangs par gyur pa yis/ /96—283

mdun gyi nam mkhar gnas te rab tu gsal ba'i tshig gis sun phyung 'jig rten gzhan pa ni/ /thugs brtses bsrungs te mi shes pa yi mun pa 1mtha' dag rab tu bcom nas mi bden pa'i/ /lta ba'i dra ba gcod byed blo gros ldan pa de yi ②chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/ /shin tu mthug ④pa'i nags su gnas nas phyung tshe mi ni ltabadun brgya mthong nas nye ba yi/ /ri bo'i steng na glang chen mchog ni shi ba'i sha yod song la lam brgyags khubyes zhes smras/ /glang po'i rgyal po gang zhig brtse bar ldan bya'i ri bo'i rtse nas bdag nyid lus mchongs dor/ /srog chags rnams la byams ldan rdul rnams spangs pa de yi chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so / 7 /gang zhig shin tu dul bas tsha gdung mi yi sgyu bye ma dang ni sha tshil glo bas mngon gang bar/ /su da sa ni chos kyi dbyi byegus dpe med brtse ba brtson 'grus bden pa rab tu 'khrungs⑫/ /de thabs smon pas srog chags sman pa dang ni bde ba'i cho gas srid pa'i gnas/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang sdug bsngal slar zlog shāspepa yi don byas chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/ tre /na dang skye ba la sogs zug rngu ⑫'jigs pa mang po mthong ste 'bar ba'i me stag rab 'phro ba'i/ /khang pa nye bar zhi bya'i —phyir ni 'gro 'di 15mtha' dag skyo ba'i sems gyur cing / /rgyal po'i phun tshogs ji ltar rtswa 7bzhin gang spangs lcags khyem chen por bsrungs na yang / /nags mthar rab tu song gyur de yi rjes su legs pa'i spyod ldan chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/shā— /rtag tu mang po'i rnam pas /5rnam par gnod byed yal ga ri dwags 'dug 7pa 'khrugs pas ni/ /gang 'dod mchog gi lus can lang tsho ldan pa'i ma te la ni gnod sbyin gyis bskul nas/ /gang brjod mtha' dag shin tu bzod pa'i 7yon tan gter gyur thar pa'i lam gyi gtso/ /bzod pa'i 96—284

'byung gnas dang mtshungs pa yi mi g.yo de yi chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/tsho /gang zhig 'dab gshog rgyas pa yon tan brgya phrag rab mchog yang dag brgyan pa'i bdag nyid kyi/ /bya zhig byung gyur ri dwags dgra yi mgrin par rus pa'i dum bu ring por 5zug pa phyung byas te/ /ri dwags des slar bsad cing za phyir brnyas thob gyur mod de ni nus na'ang khro ma gyur/ /bzod pa'i zhing de'i 'chi med rang bzhin 'bras bu bcas gyur chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags so/ /ji srid ri rab nyi ma zla bas rab gsal rtse nas 'od chen 'phros pas snang bar byas ljongs dang / /ji srid chu bo 'dzin khri nya dang chu srin rlung rnams kyis dkrugs gnas ni lan tshwa'i 4rgya mtsho dang / /ji srid sa ni ri dang grong dang lkuljon shing nags tshal 6grong khyer ljongs dang ltang 7rgyun 'bab bcas gnas/ /de srid mdor na ston pa'i bka' yis srid pa'i khang pa mi bzad khrung gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag rab zhi shog /byang chub sems dpa'i skyes pa'i rabs kyi chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags pa snyan dngags mkhan chen po slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //dpal chos kyi rje sa'i steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kha che shākya shrī ga /bzang po dang / lo tsā ba dge slong byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur// //9 96—285
