3na91༄ga /sprun pa'i gtam/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ dā na pa ri ka thā/ bod skad du/ sbyin pa'i gtam/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbyin pa gter chen phyi bzhin 'brangs pa ④yin te chom rkun la sogs dbrog mi nus/ /sbyin pa sems kyi ser sna dang ni chags pa'i ①skyon gyi rdul rnams 'khru bar byed/ /sbyin pa 'khor ba'i lam dang ngal ba sel ba yin te bzhon pa bde blag can/ /sbyin pa bde dgur spyor ba du ma dag gi sgo bzang gtan byi mdza' bo ⑦mchog /'byor cing dag pa phun sum tshogs dang kun du bka' ⑤nyan yon tan rnams dang ni/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha yul grong khyer la gnas byad gzugs mjes pa'i yon tan rnamasaske/ /ci dang ci 'dod de dag thams cad sbyin pa dag gis nges par job du'agyur te/ /de ltar don ni yongs su brtags par gyur nas su dag sbyin pa sbyin mi byed/ /sbyin pa me dang chu dang chom rkun 'jigs pa'i 'khrug ⑦pa rnams kyis 96byed450

bskyod mi nus/ /sbyin pa sgrib pa zad byed srid pa'i 'gro ba ①phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i mdza' chen yin/ /sbyin pa 'gro ba'i rgyun gyi yul rnams kun du srog chags rnams kyi 'jug pa ①yin/ /sbyin pa tshe rabs bgrang ba ⑧dag tu phyi bzhin 'brangs te ba ④phyir be'u 'brang ba bzhin/ /nor rnams kun gyi snying po blang ba dbang phyug rnams kyi gzhi ni sbyin pa yin zhe'o/ /blo can legs par 'dod pa yis—/ /legs par bsgrims te sbyin pa sbyin/ /'khor bar yongs su 'khyam ⑤pa na/ /sbyin pa ma gtogs gnyen med do/ /sbyin pa 'jig rten rgyan yin te/ /sbyin pa ngan 'gro zlog pa yin/ /sbyin pa mtho ris skas yin te/ /sbyin pa zhi byed shis pa yin/ /'jig rten dag na rgyal po'i mchog /dpa' brtul dregs shing mthu che la/ /rgyal srid rgyas la dbang byed pa/ /bde du'abyung sbyin pa byin las byung / /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas rnams na/ /brgya byin lha yi dbang byed pa/ /de yang phyin ⑦pa'i 'bras bu mchog /dam pa yin zhes mkhas rnams smra/ /mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis mnga' ba/ /dri med gzi brjid mtshungs med pa/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rgal ba yang / /sbyin pa la ni brten te 'byung ⑧/ /lha yi 'jig rten skas kyang yin/ /thar pa'i mthar gyi sgo yang yin/ /ngan song rnams las bzlog pa yin/ /phun sum tshogs kun rgyu yang yin/ /de yi phyir na ⑨mi rnams kyis/ /legs par bsgrims te sbyin pa sbyinaske/ /chags dang phrag dog la sogs pa/ /med par bsod nams bsags par gyis/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med/ /chos dang 'dra ba'i skyob pa med—/ /dge 'dun 'dra ba'i zhing med de/ /de'i ⑩phyir gsum la dbul bar gyis—/ /phrad par gyur pa'i mtha' ni 'bral bar 'gyur/ /phun sum tshogs 96—451

pa'i mtha' ni ngan cing rgyad/ /tshe 'di stiglog ltar 'gyur zhing 'jig la g.yo/ /de yi phyir na bag yod brtan por gyis/ / 'jig rten ②'di kun bde ba mngon par 'dod/ /skyes bu bde la dulongs spyod med par min/ /longs spyod sbyin las byung bar mkhyen nas ni/ /thub pas dang por sbyin pa'i gtam dag mdzad//slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa sbyin pa'i gtam rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/45༷ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉pa sbyin pa'i gtam bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torabrang ba/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mdza'o/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dka'/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torathob/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rakhrugs/451 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorajugs/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bgrangs pa/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorakhyams/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toradi/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nyagin/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byung / ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/452 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉di/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wa'ajig rten/ ni〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/bsdur 'bras re'u migaskyes rabs/ (12)96wa 452

༄ga /srid pa las 'das pa'i gtam/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bhā ④ba saṃ krān ta pa ri ka thā/ bod skad du—/ srid pa las 'das pa'i gtam/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo①/ /dngos med dngos las mi skye ste/ /dngos med las kyang skye ma yin/ /dngos po rtag tu skye ba ste/ /dngos 'khrul nam mkha'i me tog bzhin//mkha' dang 'dra ba'i chos yod na/ /gzhan ni mkha' dang 'dra ba skye/ /brten nas thams cad mkha' dang 'dra/ /de nas srid pa med pa can/ /ngo bo nyid kyis ④las med cing / /rgyu med 'bras bu yod ma yin/ /'di dag thams cad med pa ste/ /'jig rten pa med 'jig ⑤pa med/ /ma skyes pa yi dngos po gang / /ji ltar gzhan zhig skyed par 'gyur/ /'jig rten dang por ma byung ste//'ga' zhig gis kyang sprul pa minarjo/ /zla ba seng ge'i grong khyer bzhin/ /'jig rten don med gyi na 'khyams⑦/ /'jig rten rnam par rtog las 'byung / /96—453

rnam rtog sems las yang dag 'byung ①/ /sems ni lus la brten pa ste/ /de phyir lus ni rnam dpyad do/ /gzugs ni stong pa tshor ba rang bzhin med/ /'du shes med de 'du byed yod ma yin/ /'byung ba spangs nas sems dang sems byung med/ /de phyir lus ni rtog bral ngo bo yin/ /sems med chos rnams de dag med/ /lus med khams rnams ②yod ma yin/ /gnyis su med pa'i las 'di ni/ /de nyid rig ①pa rnams kyis bstan/ /'di dag thams cad dmigs med par/ /gnyis su med par bstan pa yin/ /blo ni dmigs pa med byas nas/ /dmigs pa med par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan la sogs brten byas nas/ /yun mi ring ba'i dus kyis ni/ /byang chub dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /thabs dang shes rab la gnas te/ /sems can rnams la brtse bar bya/ /myur ba kho nar thams cad mkhyen/ /thob par 'gyur bar the tshom rnged/ /'di dag thams cad ming tsam ste/ /'du shes tsam la rab tu gnas/ /rjod par byed las tha dad pa'i/ /brjod par bya ba yod ma yin/ /chos rnams thams cad ming med de—/ /bdag med par yang yongs su gsal/ /yang dag min pa'i chos 'di dag /rnam par rtog pas kun nas bslang / /gang gis stong pa zhes brtags pa'i—/ /rtog pa de yang 'dis stong ngo / /mig gis gzugs rnams mthong bar ni/ /de nyid gsungs pas gang bshad pa/ /log par zhen pa'i 'jig rten la/ /kun rdzob bden par brjod pa yin/ /gang du tshogs par mthong ba ni—/ /'dren pas ston par byed pa yin/ /blo dang ldan pas don dam gyi/ /nye bar brtags pa'i sa de gsungs/ /mig gis gzugs ni mi mthong ste/ /96—454

na 93༄ga /yon tan bdun yongs su brjod pa'i gtam/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sap+ta gu ṇa pa ri ba da nā ④ka thā/ bod skad du/ yon tan bdun yongs su brjod pa'i gtam/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las ni du ma la brten pa'i/ /sna tshogs yon tan 'dod pa yis/ /'bad byas sa bon med par ni/ /myu gu skye ba yod ma yin—/ /nyes med yon tan bsdu ba ni/ /sna tshogs pa dag rnam bya ste/ /nyes pa dag ni gcig pu yis/ /yon tan mang po 'joms par byed/ /tshe ring de bzhin nad med dang / /gzugs dang skal ba ④bzang dang rigs/ /nor dang shes rab dag dang bdun/ /yon tan mdo sde dag las gsungs/ /de las bzlog pa nyes pa yin/ /de dag re res ji ltar na/ /yon tan thams cad 'byung 'gyur ba/ /de ltar da ni bshad par bya/ /nad rnged gzugs dang skal ba dubazang / /rigs nor shes rab phun sum tshogs/ /tshe ring ba ni med 96byed456

gyur na/ /gsad par ①phyin pa'i rgyan dang 'dra/ /tshe dang gzugs sogs yon tan ni/ /'di dag nad med mi ldan na/ /don med par ni nyams ②'gyur te/ /ma ning bud med mchog yod mtshungs/ /yon tan ldan pa mthong na yang / /gzugs ngan skyo ba skye 'gyur te/ /yon tan phun tshogs rgyas par ni / /rgyal po'i btsun mo mthong dang mtshungs/ /sngar bshad yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /skal ba ngan pas mdongs 'phrog ④pa/ /sdang ba'i gnas su gyur pa'i phyir/ /drang srong bran dang mtshungs par 'dod/ /yon tan dpal ldan dri ma med/ /rigs ngan la brten mya ngan gzhi/ /bram ze'i chung ma yon tan can/ /rigs ngan lag na gnas dang mtshungs/ /tshe dang nad med la sogs pa/ /sngar bshad yon tan 'di dag ni/ /dbul po la gnas bkur 'os min/ /dur khrod gnas kyi mi dang mtshungs/ /yon tan ji skad bshad phun tshogs/ /glen pa bdag nyid brlag don 'gyur/ /'od ma smyug ma'i rjochu shing gi/ 'bras bu phun tshogs lta bu yin/ /de rjoltar ji skad bshad yon tan//yan lag re re ma tshang nyams/ /yi ge gcig ni ma tshang ba'i/ /rig pa 'bras bu med 'gyur mtshungs/ /yon tan yongs rdzogs mdzes pa ni/ /yi ge tshang pa'i rig pa 'dra/ /sbyor ba grub las 'bras bu 'thob/ /ma tshang med pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de bas legs mjes rdzogs pa yi/ /yon tan la ni 'bad par gyis/ /'di dag rgyu ni gang yin pa/ /mdo bshad nga las rtogs par gyis/ /gsod par 0chud pa legs btang dang / /de bzhin srog gis phan btags shing / /srog chags 'tshe ba las ldog pas/ /tshe ring pa ni thob par 'gyur/ /nang pa'i bsnyen bkur byas sman pa/ /sman ni rab tu byin pa 96—457

dang / /srog chags bong ba dbyig sogs kyis/ /'tshe ba med las nad med yin / /khro bo ①med la brten pa dang / /brgya byen pas ni gzugs bzang nyid—/ /phrag dog med pa'i 'bras bu nyid/ /skal ba bzang por yongs su bshadaske/ /dam pa mchod cing bsnyen bkur byas/ /nga rgyal spangs pas rigs mthor 'gyur/ /sbyin byed rku ②ba las ldog pas/ /longs spyod phun sum tshogs thob 'gyur/ /dge dang sdig pa gang yin zhes/ /yang dag dri la btson ①pa dang / /chos kyi bstan bcos byin pa yis/ /blo gros rgya chen thob par 'gyuraske/ /yon tan bdun yongs su brjod pa'i gtam/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta gaṅgā ta rjor dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //96—458

bsdur mchan/456 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing /〈〈pe 〉〉pa yon tan bdun yongs su brjod pa'i gtam bzhugs so//zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brna/ 0)me〈〈snar 〉〉bskal pa/457 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉nyam pa/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉padangs phrogs/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ji/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar 〈〈co 〉〉pa/458 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brku/②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaradri la brtson/du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagang got+ta/bsdur 'bras re'u migathekhog rabs/ (14)96wa 459

༄ga /tshul lngams kyi gtam/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shī la pa ri ka thā/ bod skad du/ tshul khrims kyi gtam/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya mtsho dang ni glang rjes kyi/ /khyad par dag ni gang yin pa/ /sbyin pa dang ni tshul khrims kyi//khyad par dag ni de yin no/ /gang zhig dad ②pa'i sems kyis ni/ /lo brgyar ①sbyin pa byin pa bas/ /gang zhig nyin gcig tshul khrims ni/ /bsrung ba de las khyad par 'phags/ /sbyin pa shan pa rnams dang ni/ /rigs ngan dag kyang sbyin par byed/ /gang yang rung bas tshul khrims ni/ /yongs su bsrung bar mi nus so/ /sbyin pa durab tu 'byor gyur kyang / /de ni sbyin bdag chen po min/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yis/ /sbyin bdag chen po yin par bshad—/ /mgo bregs pa'am gtsug phud ldan par rgyu/ /tshul khrims ⑤chu yis ral pa khyab par 'chang / /cha lugs sna tshogs dag gis spyod gyur kyang / /96byed460

gal te tshul khrims med na rgyu ①spyod yin/ /gaṅgā bgrod pa ②chu bo na dar song ba'am / /dbyangs can chu 'am rdzing bur song ba'am/ /ṣ+pe le shar ni sten ④par byed pa yang / /gal te tshul khrims kyis rgud la don med/ /ji ltar tshul khrims bla med ldan pa'i dri/ /dam pa mtho ris 'di na mi zad ldan/ /de ltar phreng ba'i dri ni khyab min cing / /de bzhin byug pa'i dri yang 'byung mi 'gyur/ /'di na bdag dga' ④gzhan du 'gro ba bde/ /grags dang dga' zhing kun gyis bkur ba ste/ /chos ldan 'bras bu de de mang po mthong / /tshul khrims 'bras bu drang srong chen pos gsungs/ /tshul khrims nad la ⑤sman pa'i mchog yin zhing / /mun pa'i sgon ma nyam thag la buskyabs dang / /'jigs la srungs ⑦dang phongs la nye du dang / /'chi ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' med gzings gyur yin/ /gang zhig 'dul ba'i tshul khrims rnam 'jig tshe/ /skrag zhugs tshul khrims ldan pa yod ma yin/ /de bas 'jig rten gzhan mtha' rgal sems kyis/ /gang zhig 'gro 'dod des ni tshul khrims srungs⑧/ /tshul khrims dri med ma lus ji bzhin gzhag⑨ /shes rab zhi bas yid ni yongs smin 'gyur/ /de bas rga ⑩shi nad 'jigs rnam thar pa/ /gang zhig thob 'dod des ni tshul khrims srungs/ /tshul khrims kyi gtam slob dpon dbyeg gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dza rarnya na dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te ⑩gtan la phab pa'o// //96—461

bsdur mchan/46༷ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉pa tshul khrims kyi gtam bzhugs so//zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dag ②〈〈snar 〉〉brgya/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa rgyu//khrus kyi/461 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgyu/②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ne'am/①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brten/du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoraga'/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mchog du〈〈co 〉〉pa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bsrung / ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉bsrungs/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ton/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wazhus te/bsdur 'bras ze'u migathekhog rarngams/ (15)96wa 462

༄ga /tshul khrims kyi gtam gyi 'grel pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shī la ka thā dṛdhi/ bod skad du/ tshul khrims kyi gtam gye 'grel pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig bdud las rgyal zhing pha rol phyin drug rdzogs/ /brtse bas gzhan don mdzad pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan dag drang bas min la rang nyid drang ④phyir ni/ /dam pa'i rjes su 'brangs la tshul khrims 'di nyid bshad/ /de bzhin du spyi'i don ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i nang nas tshul khrims ni sa gzhi lta bu yin par dgongs nas/ de nyid sbyin pa las khyad par du ①'phags par bsgrub pa'i phyir/ dpe'i sgo nas bstan pa ni/ rgya mtsho dang ni glang rjes kyi/ /khyad par dag ni gang yin pa/ /sbyin pa dang ni tshul khrims kyi/ /khyad par dag ni de yin no/ /zhes bya ba 'dis rjosmos so/ /ni zhes bya ba ni nges par gzung ba'o—/ /de ⑤zhes bya ba ni 'das ma thag pa'o/ /yin no zhes bya ba ni 96—463

ngag rdzogs pa ste go bar zad do/ /de nyid tshul khrims kyi sgo nas rgyas par bstan pa'i phyir/ gang zhig ces bya ba la sogs pa ①smos so/ /de ji ltar mngon zhe na lung dang rigs pa ste/ de la lung ni zla ba sgon ma las/ bskal pa bye ba gaṅgā'i bye snyed du/ /sangs rgyas dag ni gaṅgā'i bye snyed la/ /gdugs dang ba dan mar me'i phreng ba dang / /zas dang skom gyis ②dad sems mchod byas pas/ /gang gis dam pa'i chos ni 'jig pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa dgag pa ni①/ /nyin zhig gcig tu bslab pa gcig bzung na/ /de bas bsod nams 'di ni khyad par 'phags/ /zhes 'byung ste/ rgyas par ni mdo nyid la dhibalta bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang tshul khrims kyi 'bras bu ni mtho ris yin la sbyin pa'i 'bras bu ni 'byor pa yin te/ /rgyu de log na cig shos dang ldan du zin kyang ngan song gi 'gro ba dag ni bsod nams bsags pa'i rten du rung ngo snyam du bsams pa yin no/ /gang zhig dad pa'i sems kyis ni/ /zhes bya ba la gang zag gi yid ches pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas so/ /lo brgyar sbyin pa byin pa bas/ /zhes bya ba ni mtshon pa ste/ dus yun ring por 'bad pa byas kyang zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gang zhig nyin gcig tshul khrims ni/ /zhes bya ba ni tshad 'jog pa ste/ dus mnyam par ni ma yin te/ tha na nyin gcig tsam zhes nges par bzung ba'o/ /bsrung ba de las khyad par 'phags/ /zhes bya ba ni bsrung ba'am 'bad pa'am ched du gnyer ba ste/ de gang la yod pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ /da ni de las lhag pa'am khyad par 'phags pa ste/ mi mtshungs pa zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /gzhan yang slob dpon gyes de nyid kyi rgyu mtshan bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /sbyin pa shan ⑤pa rnams dang ni/ /zhes bya ba la 96—464

sogs pa sgos te/ rnams zhes ①bya ba'i sgra ni du ma ste/ /shan ①pa dang nya pa dang tshong pa la sogs pa thams cad la bya'o/ /rigs ngan rnams kyang ster bar byed| /ces bya ba ni 'jig rten na tha chad du gyur pa gdol ba ①de dag tshul khrims kyis dben ④la sbyin pa gtong bar byed do/ /gang yang rung bas tshul khrims ni/ /zhes bya bas ⑤ni skyes bu dam pa sems pa lus ngag dul ba gnyen po stobs dang ldan pa dag gis kyang ste/ gzhan lta ci smos zhes bya ba'i don to/ /yongs su srung rjobar mi nus so/ /zhes bya ba la de'i phyir tshul khrims khyad par du 'phags zhes bya ba'i tha tshig gi ⑦lhag ma'o/ /ji lta zhe na skyes bu dam pas kyang tshul khrims rin po che dang 'dra bar dri mas dben pa rdul phra mo dag gis ma gces pa de lta bu ma byung bar du dka' ste/ bar chad mang ba'i ⑧phyir dang /snyigs ma'i sems can dag gis ga la nus snyam du bsams pa yin no/ /yongs su'i sgra ni lung du ste khyab pa'am chub par bsgrub pa'i mthu med de ⑨zhes bya ba'i don to/ /rgyu mtshan gnyis pa ⑩bstan pa'i phyir/ sbyin pa rab tu 'byor gyur kyang / /zhes bya ba la don 'di yin te/ da lta ⑪sbyin pa la gnas pa'am de'i 'bras bu la spyod pa ste ldan zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /yang na sbyin pas ⑩zhes gsum pa'i sgrar ⑫blta bar bya'o/ /de ni sbyin bdag chen po min/ /zhes bya ba smos pa yin te/ tshul khrims kyis lus dag ⑫pa'i phyir rta cang shes la sogs pa dag yin ⑫no/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yis/ /zhes bya ba ni de ltar tshul khrims la gnas pas de'i 'bras bu la spyod pa ste/ rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /sbyin bdag chen po yin par bshad/ /zhes ⑩bya ba ni bdag nyid chen po ste/ tshul khrims kyis 'phangs pa'i phyir lha'i dbang po 96—465

la sogs pa bzhin no/ /gal te 'o na sbyin pa dang ldan pa sbyin bdag ma yin na/'o na mdo las tshul khrims dang mi ldan pa yang sbyin pa'i sa ①can de la sbyin bdag ces pa ji lta bu zhe na/ de ni sbyin bdag tsam yin yang sbyin bdag chen po ni ma yin te/ pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan gyis ma zin pa'i phyir ro zhes bya ba'i don to//ji ltar sbyin pa de mchog yin yang tshul khrims la ltos ②shing dman par bstan nas/da ni tshul gzhan gyi sgo nas tshul khrims de nyid khyad par du 'phags pa bstan pa'i phyir / mgo bo bregs pa'am gtsug phud ldan par rgyu/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ mgo bo byegs pa ni skra byegs pa'am zhes bya'o①/ /gtsug phud can ni thor gtsug ste kun du rgyu'i rtags yin no/ /de nyid ldan par zhes bya ba'i sgrar sbyar te des rgyu zhing gnas par byed ces bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /tshul khrims chu yis ral pa khyab par 'chang / /zhes bya ba ni spyod pa'i tshul gzhag ④pa ste/ /tshul khrims kyi ched du zhes bya'o⑤/ /de nyid khyab pa'i ral pa'am ral pas khyab pa ste/ de 'chang ba gang yin pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ /cha lugs sna tshogs dag gis spyod gyur kyang / /zhes bya ba ni cha byad du ma dag gi sgo nas dpa' ba byas kyang zhes lhag ma dang ldan par ston pa yin no/ /de ltar 'bad na don dang ldan nam snyam du bsams na/ gal te tshul khrims med na g.yo sgyus spyod—/ /ces smos te/ gal te rtag pa'i mtha' bzung nas de yang tshul khrims med na stedhi/ thog ma nas ma thob pa'am/ thob kyang nyams shing zhig nas bdag nyid slu ba ste 'bad pa 'bras bu med ces bya ba'i don to/ /de ltar ci mngon zhe na/ dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo las/ dper na sdong po bzang po la/ /yun rings ⑦yal ga 'khrungs pa bzhin/ /mi de rtags tsam 96—466

yun rings na/ /kha na ma tho rtag 'phel dang / /sdig pa'i las rnams 'phel bar bshad/ /ces 'byung ba'i don ni ①'di dag yin te/ rgyas par ni mdo nyid du lta'o②/ /de tsam du zad dam zhe na/ tshul khrims nyid khyad par du 'phags pa sgrub pa de'i 'thad pa gnyis pa bstan pa'i phyir/ gaṅgā bgrod pa chu bo na dar song ba'am/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ 'di dag ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ des ni 'am zhes bsu ba mdzad/ /de bzhin du/ dbyangs can chu'am rdzing bur song ba'am/ /zhes bya ba ni dbyangs can gyi chu bo'am sprung bur 'jug pa la sogs pa dag /ṣ+pe ①le sha ni sten par byed pa yang / /zhes bya ba ni gang la ṣ+pe le sha yod pa der ro/ /yang zhes bya ba ni de dag kyang de bzhin du chur 'jug pa dang / /mer 'jug pa dang / nyi ma la lta ba dang / zla ba la lta ba dang / g.yang la mchong ba dang / gsal shing la sogs pa la zhon pa 'di dag don dang bcas pa yin nam snyam pa la gal te tshul khrims kyis rgud la don med ces gsungs te 'bad pa 'bras bu med ces bya bar snyegs ④so/ /des na bag chags ngan pa la bdag phyin ci log gi dbang gis lam gol par ⑤'jug cing bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' la yang yid mi ches shing lam drang po la 'gror mi btub pa'i snying rje'i gnas yin no/ /de bas na tshul khrims kyi nor 'di ni gru dang 'dra ba la 'phags pa'i nor gang rjogi nor las mchog yin la pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi nang na yang gtso bo yin te/ rin po che 'di gsum gyis sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsngags so snyam du bsams pa yin no/ /de ltar tshul khrims khyad par du 'phags pa bsgrubs ⑦zin nas/ da ni 'di'i yon tan ston pa de nyid dpe'i sgo nas bstan pa'i phyir/ ji ltar tshul khrims bla med ldan pa'i 96—467

dri—/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ ji ltar zhes pa ni dri ba bkod pa ste/de ltar zhes 'og ma dang 'byel lo/ /tshul khrims de bslab pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bla med ldan pa'i dri zhes bya ba ni gong na med pa de ldan pa'am de la gnas pa'i dri ni de'i dri ste rjed pa zhes ①bya ba'i don to/ /dam pa mtho ris 'di na mi zad ldanaske/ /zhes bya ba la dam pa ni mchog yin la mtho ris ni gnas bcu la sogs pa'oske/ /de nyid la bde 'gro zhes kyang bya ste/ de'i gnas sam rten 'di ni tshul khrims kyi dri mi zad pa ste/ drag cing mu med par smin zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go—/ /de ltar phreng ba'i dri ni khyab min zhing / /zhes bya ba ni sdom brtson gyi dri de ltar me tog phreng ba la sogs pa'i dris ni khyab mi nus te/ dman zhing mthu ②med pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na sman sna tshogs kyi sbyor ba'i byug pa dag gis nus sam zhe na/ de bzhin byug pa'i dri yang khyab mi 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba smos te/tshul khrims kyi 'khor lo skye ba du mar mtho ris kyi skas la rgyu ba bzhin du/ byug pa dang dpag bsam gyi shing la sogs pa'i dris ni ga la nus zhes bya ba'i don yin no/ /de ltar yon tan bstan nas de'i 'bras bu bstan pa'i phyir slob dpon gyis/ 'di na bdag dga' gzhan du 'gro ba bde/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ 'di na ①zhes bya ba ni sdom brtson gyi gzhi 'di na'o/ /bdag dga' buzhes bya ba ni mtshon pa ste/ gang zag la la dag go/ /gzhan du 'gro ba bde zhes bya ba ni gnas gzhan du ste/ 'jig rten pha rol la sogs par 'gro ba na sems bde bar 'gro ba ste de nyid rgyas par mdo dag las ⑤blta bar bya'o—/ /grags dang dga' nyid kun gyis bkur ba ste/ /zhes rjobya ba la grags pa de dze+eni 'jig rten du grags pa'o/ /dga' ba ni bdag nyid dga' ba 96—468

sterka/ tshul khrims kyi dbang gis ni snying por ①mthong zhes bya ba smos te/ chos ldan zhes bya ba ni khrims ldan can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /kun gyis bkur ba ste zhes bya ba ni gang zag de la sems can mang po dag gis bkur zhing rim gro byed pa'o—/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang dgongs par 'gyur te/ de skad du slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis/ de tshe de la dge ba'i phyir/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /dge ba'i thugs kyis rtag par yang / /bu sdug 'dra bar dgongs par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di nyid yin te/ de tsam du zad dam zhe na/ chos ldan 'bras bu de de mang por mthong / /zhes bya ba ②smos te/ chos ldan zhes bya ba ni khrims ldan no/ /'bras bu ni 'bras bu ste 'dod pa'i don yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de de mang por mthong zhes bya ba ni de dang de dag ste/ gzhan dpag tu med do zhes bya ba'i don to/ /ji ltar zhe na/ tshul khrims 'bras bu drang srong chen pos gsungs/ /zhes bya ba ston te ①de'i 'bras bu ni lhag par yang drang srong chen pos gsungs te/de ni che ba'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas de nyid rgyas par ni sdang ba dor zhing gus pa skyes pas bstan bubacos dang mdo sde la ⑤blta bar bya'o/ /da ni 'bras bu de nyid gnyen po'am dpe rnam pa drug gi sgo nas bstan pa'i phyir/tshul khrims nad la rjosman pa'i mchog yin zhing / /zhes bya ba smos te/ dper na shin tu yun rings nad kyis gdungs pa de dag la sman pa mkhas pa dag gis ⑦nad kyi rgyu las phye nas sman bzang po dag gis sbyor ba bzhin du/ ngan 'gro sdug bsngal nad dang 'dra ba du ma dag gis gzir ba de dag la tshul khrims ni sman pa'i mchog yin te/ nad de dag las thar par byed pa'o/ /mun pa'i sgon ma 96—469

nyam thag la skyabs dang / /zhes bya ba la gzhan yang mun pa'i tshogs shin tu chen po dag la mar me la sogs pa chung ngu dag gis de dag thams cad sel ba de bzhin du ma rig pa'i mun pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dag la ①tshul khrims kyis sdedangos sam brgyud ①pa'i sgo nas sgon ma'i mchog yin no/ /de bzhin du sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis nyam thag pa de dag la tshul khrims ni skyabs kyi mchog yin no zhes bya ba'i don tedu/ 'jigs la bsrung dang phongs la nye du dang / /zhes bya ba la mi dang mi ma yin pas 'jigs pa ⑤bsrung ba'i mchog yin zhing phongs shing rgud pa la dunye du la sogs pa lta bu ste/ tshul khrims zhes sbyar ⑦ro/ /'chi ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' med gzigs ⑧gyur yin/ /zhes bya ba ni dper na rgya mtsho las ⑨'gro ba na gzings la brten nas 'gro ba ⑩bzhin du tshul khrims ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po la gzings dang 'dra ba'o/ /de dag la sogs pa phan yon dpag tu med pa mdo las bshad de/ tshul khrims yang dag pa'i mdo las/ de phyir ⑪ston pas tshul khrims rab bsngags bshad/ /tshul khrims ldan pa sangs rgyas 'byung dang phrad/ /tshul khrims ldan pa rgyan rnams ⑫kun gyi mchog /tshul khrims ldan pa dri dang byug pa yin/ /zhes 'byung ste rgyas par ni mdo nyid la ⑫blta'o—/ /de ltar tshul khrims rnam par dag pas sems la 'gyod pa med/sems la 'gyod pa med pas sems dben zhing ting nge 'dzin las su rung ste/ de bas na spyorin po che dang 'dra ba 'di ni lam gyi mchog yin no snyam du bsams pa yin no/ /da ni 'bras bu'i sgo nas gang zag gi khyad par bstan pa'i phyir/gang zhig 'dul ba'i tshul khrims rnam ⑫'jig tshe/ /skrag zhugs tshul khrims ldan pa yod ma yin/ /zhes bya ba smos te gang zhig ces bya ba ni gang zag go/ /96—470

'dul ba'i tshul khrims zhes bya ba ni 'dul ba las gsungs pa'i tshul khrims so/ /rnam 'jig tshe zhes pa ①ni btang ba'i tshe ste med par 'gyur zhes bya ba'i don to/ /skrag zhugs zhes bya ba ni de'i dbang gis te ②'jigs pa'o/ /tshul khrims ldan pa zhes pa ma nyams pa ste/ gang la yod pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ /yod ma yin zhes bya ba ni①'jigs pa'am bag khums rjopa med pa yin te/ tshul khrims de'i dbang gis bdag nyid dga' bar ma bshad na 'jigs pa lta ga la srid ces bya ba'i don to/ /de ltar 'bras bu bshad zin nas de nyid rjobasrung bar gdams par 'dod nas/ /de bas 'jig rten gzhan mtha' rgal sems kyis/ /gang zhig rjobagrod 'dod des ni tshul khrims bsrung ⑦/ /zhes smos te de bas zhes bya ba ni de bas na'o/ /'jig rten gzhan mtha' zhes bya ba mtha' gzhan te/de dag kyang sdug bsngal gyi gzhi yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rgal sems kyis zhes bya ba ni de las 'da' bar 'dod pa ste/ go cha bgos nas zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gang zhig ces bya ba ni gang zag ste skyes bu'o/ /bgrod 'dod des zhes bya ba ni 'gro bar 'dod pa des so/ /ni zhes bya ba'i sgra ni nges par gzung ba ste gang zhe na tshul khrims te/ de gnas pa'i ched du srungs shig ces brtse ba'i tshul gyis bsgo ⑧bar mdzad do/ /da ni tshul khrims de nyid bye brag tu bstan pa dang /zhar la shes rab kyi 'bras bu'i sgo nas gdams pa ni/ tshul khrims dri med ma lus ji bzhin gzhag⑨ /shes rab zhi bas yid ni yongs smin 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ thams cad yin nam zhe na/ tshul khrims dri med ces bya ba ni rigs bdun la sogs pa sems pa ngo bo spong ba bdun 'khor dang bcas pa de nyid srung spyozhing dag pa'o/ /ma lus pa ni lus pa med pa ste/ ltung ba phra mo 96—471

tsam la 'dzem pa'i phyir ro/ /ji bzhin gzhag ①ces bya ba ni ji skad bshad pa ②bzhin du gzhag ①cing gdams pa'o/ /tshul khrims kho nar zad dam ce ④na/shes rab zhi zhes bya ba smos te/ shes rab zhi ba ni zhi gnas dang lhag mthong yin no/ /yid ces bya ba ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa ste/ chos mngon pa las rab tu grags pa'i phyir ro/ /yongs su smin 'gyur zhes bya ba ni las su rung ba ste khyad par can no/ /'di dag kyang mtshon pa ste de bzhin du gzhan du yang yin no/ /ji skad du slob dpon shān ⑤ta de bas/ bzod bya thos pa btsal bar bya/ /de nas gnas lugs duganas par bya/ /'di dag legs par bshad pa yin no/ /da ni de dag tshul khrims la rag lus pas mjug bsdu ba'i tshul gyis bstan pa ni/ de bas rga shi ⑦nad 'jigs rnam thar pa/ /gang zhig thob 'dod des ni tshul khrims srungs/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ de bas zhes bya ba ni de bas na'o/ /rga 'chi nad 'jigs zhes bya ba ni ma rig ⑧pa la sogs pa steske/ rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis srid pa len pa'i tshul lo/ /rnam thar zhes bya ba ni de las ldog ste spong bar byed ces pa'i tha tshig go/ /gang zhig ces bya ba ni snga ma bzhin no/ / thos 'dod ⑨zhes bya ba ni don du gnyer te⑩/bzod pa can gyi skyes bu thabs la mkhas pa des so/ /ji ste nges pa kho nar tshul khrims srungs te⑩/ de bas ni zhes bya ba'i sgra smos te/ don dag bstan pa yin no snyam du bsams pa yin no/ /bdag 'dra mkhas pa'i don la mkhas par bsam par mi nus kyang / /cung zad dman la phan phyir 'phags pa'i rjes 'brangs te/ /lo brgya brtse ba can gyi gtam la rnam bshad pas/ /nyes pa mang yod mkhas pa rnams la bzod par gsol/ /'di la bsod nams cung 96—472

zad bdag gis bskrun des ni/ /'gro ba ①rgyal ba thob nas de bzhin gzhan dag kyang / /myur du dbang phyug thob nas sa la gnas pa dang / /pha rol phyin drug thob nas 'gro ba'i don byed shog /tshul khrims kyi gtam gyi 'grel pa slob dpon gsal grags kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/463 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉la tshul khrims gtam gyi 'grel pa bzhugs/ zhes dang / 〈〈snar 〉skal tshul khrims gtam gyi 'grel pa bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra na/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7du/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉maradi/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nade/464 ①〈〈pe 96༄ga /tshogs kyi gtam/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ saṃ bhā ②ra pa ri ka thā/ bod skad du/tshogs kyi gtam/ gsung gi mnga' bdag 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo//bdag gis de ring bsod nams dang / /ye shes tshogs ni gang zhig gam/ /gzhan la phan pa gang bya ①zhes/ /byang chub sems dpa' dhiyang yang bsam/ /bsod nams rang bzhin ye shes che/ /tshogs ni gang gis rdzogs 'gyur dang ⑤/ / ji ltar gzhan phan byed 'gyur ba/ /dude ni legs par bshad par bya/ /gang gis lus dang srog dag ni/ /sems can kun la gtang ⑦bar bya/ /lus can kun la byams pa dang / /snying rje nyid kyis khyab par bya/ /sdig pa kun gye rnam smin ni/ /rang gi rgyud la mngon 'dod cing / /bsod nams kun la yi rang dang / /⑧sangs rgyas bdag nyid che la bsamasti/ /de ltar yang dang yang bya ba/ /'di ni cho ga gzhan yin no/ /byang chub sems ni sngon 'gro bas/ /96byed475

rtsom pa kun kyang bya ba yin/ /de lta bu yi thabs de yis/ /rtsom pa'i ngal ba med par ①yang / /bsod nams ye shes tshad med pa/ /yang dang yang du sogs par 'gyur/ /sems can rnams kyi longs spyod dang / /yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir dang ni/ /rang gi lus dang srog nyid ni/ /yid kyi rjes bzhin gtang bar bya/ /bkres skom ngal dang tsha grang dang / /rlung dang char gyi gnyen po bzhin/ / mchog mchod ②pa las bdag nyid ni/ /'di na bde myong ①gang yin dang / /nyams dga' khang bzangs gzhir gnas dang / /gtsang zhing zhi ba'i gnas gtogs dang / /bde ba thob pa gang yin dang / /bsam gtan bde ba thob pa yisarjo/ /bde ba'i gnas skabs job gang ⑤dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /dgra bcom shin tu sbyangs zhi nyid/ /de ni sems can thams cad la/ /bye brag med par nye bar bstabasadhi/ /phal cher mnyam par ma bzhag tshe/ /de ltar byams pa nyer bsten la/ /mnyam par gzhag ⑦tshe bdag gis rtogs/ /dga' dang shin tu sbyangs pa nyid/ /nyi ⑧ltar nyams su pyong ba dag /de bzhin gzhan la lhag mos byas⑨/ /skye dgu 'di ni sdug bsngal gyi/ /chu bor nub dang de rgyu can/ /ngan 'gro dang ni bde 'gro dag /brtse la 'bad pas brtag par bya/ /de las kyang ni dmyal ba dag /sdug bsngal mi bzad mang po dang / /dus ring rgyun mi 'chad pa yi/ /gcad gsheg ⑩me yis gdungs pa dang / /'tshed cing btags ⑪pa las byung ba'i/ /shin tu nyam thag rab tu 'phel/ /thal chu lta bur rab 'tshed pa'i/ /bsreg cing tsha rims 'dra ⑫nyam thag /dud 'gro phan tshun sdang dang srog /rang dbang med par gsad sogs kyis/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pas/ /96byed476

phal cher dmyal ba dag dang mtshungs/ /yi dwags me lce'i phreng ba yis/ /bskor zhing skad gsang mthon por ①sgogs/ /la la kha na me 'bar gzhan/ /mgrin pa khab mig lto ri tsam/ /rtag tu bkres skom ④la sogs pas①/ /bsreg cing lus ni skams pa dang / /kha cig sgyug rjopa za ba dang ⑤/ /gzhan dag de yang rab rnyed dka'/ /ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /mi rnams la yang yod par snang / /sdug bsngal gzir ba dmyal ba dumatshungs/ /dbul bas gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa⑦/ /'di yi dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal yang / /mthu ldan stobs kyis mthu med pa/ /rnam par gnon cing 'tshe ba dag /chu bo lta bu nyid yin no/ /kha cig dbul ba las gyur dang / /gzhan dag chog mi shes las byung / /yongs tshol sdug bsngal mi bzad dang / /thams cad 'khu zhing gsod pa yin/ /'dod spyod lha ni gang yin pa/ /de la'ang bde ba'i sems med de/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags rims btab pa'i/ /nang gi me yis bsregs 'gyur las④/ /gang zhig sems g.yeng gyur pa dag /de la bde ba ga la yod/ /g.yengs med sems la skad cig kyang / /dbang med ⑨pa ni ma yin pas/ /rnam g.yeng ⑩dkrugs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /nam yang zhi bar mi 'gyur te/ /rlung bcas 'bar bas khyab pa yis⑩/ /me ni shing dang bcas dang mtshungs/ /shin tu ngoms med tha mar ni/ /dbang med shin tu mya ngan byed/ /lha dang mi ni lha ⑫la dag /sdug pa'i chags pa dam du zhen/ /bsod nams sngon byas de dang des/ /'dod pa rmongs pas gdungs par 'gyur//de yang nyon mongs sna tshogs dang / /sdig pa'i las ni rgyun mi 'chad/ /rnam par rtsang ba'i mthar gnas pas/ /bag med gyur ⑫la brtse bya'i ④rigs/ /96—477

nad sos yun rings ma lon pa'i/ /nad pas mi 'phrod zos dang mtshungs/ /gang zhig gzugs can gzugs med pa/ /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal las 'das shing / /nying 'dzin bde ba'i bdag nyid can/ /bskal par g.yo ba med par gnas—/ /de yang shin tu nges grol min/ /de yang slar yang lhung bar 'gyur//ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal rba klong las/ /'das pa lta bur 'byung 'gyur ba/ /'bad kyang ji ltar ring mo ①gnas/ /mkha' la lding ba bya dang mtshungs/ /byis pa'i stobs kyis mda' 'phangs ltar/ /de ni lhung ba'i mtha' can yin/ /mar me ring du 'bar ba dag /skad cig re re 'jig pa ltar/ /'du byed yongs 'gyur zhes bya yi/ /sdug bsngal dag gis nye bar gtses/ /rga shi na ba'i chos can gyis④/ /nyon mongs nad na ①rgyu sogs kyis/ /gang phyir thams cad gdungs pas nadhi/ /de phyir shin tu brtse bya rigs/ /srog chags kun gyi sdig pa rnams/ /thams cad bdag la smin par ni/ /de ltar sdig pa len byed cing / /'gro ba'i phongs pas sdug bsngal byas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /'phags pa dag dang 'gro ba yi/ /dus ni thams cad dag gi yang / /bsod nams kun la yi rang bya/ /tshogs ni shin tu bya dka' dang / /sangs rgyas chos ni bla ⑤med pa/ /'gro ba'i don gyi bya ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis rjes su bsam/ /mang du thos la mngon brtson dang / /ji bzhin don ni sems pa dang / /'gro ba'i shes pa nye bsdus pa'ang / /rten 'byel yid la byed pa yis/ /'du byed tsam la skad cig ma/ /bya ba med la 'jug par bya/ /thams cad rten 'byel la bubasams la/ /rtag tu bdag med goms ⑦pa yi/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes tshogs/ /don dam par 96—478

ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni nyer 'phel bas/ /tshogs ni thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur/ /de ltar bsod nams ye shes kyis/ /rang bzhin chu bos 'gengs pa dag /'gro ba'i thar la gcig tu mkhas/ /byang chub lag ①pa'i mthil na gnas/ /sbyin dang snyan par smra ba dang / /don spyod don ni mthun pa nyid/ /de ltar bsdu ba'i dngos po rnams/ /'gro la phan par byed pa nyid/ /de ni gang la sbyin pa byen/ /gang zhig la ni snyan smra ba'amag/don spyod pa ni byas 'gyur ba/ /gang la don mthun byas 'gyur zhes/ /de ltar rtag tu brtson pa yis/ /'gro ba'i don ni ci nus bya/ /gzhan kun bdag gir bya ba dang / /rang la gnas pa gzhan gyir bya/ /tshogs kyi gtam slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po gang gā ta ①ra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //96—479

bsdur mchan/475 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la tshogs kyi gtam zhes bya ba bzhugs/ zhes 'khod/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 bha/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byas/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpas/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi ji ltar gzhan phan byed 'gyur ba// ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉btang / ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉rang / ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsams/476 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉chog shes/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉smyong / rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gang thob/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstab/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ji/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagashegs/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtags/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toradrar/477 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bskom/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyugs/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ste/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bas dmyal bar/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉srogs gyur pas/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byed/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagayengs/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngar/thon〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toragyur/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bya/478 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nya'i/ ①〈〈co 〉〉ni/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tonas/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉mi na/rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ 6)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgoms/479 ①〈〈snar 〉〉 nga / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoram/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gosta/bsdur 'bras re'u migaskyes rarngams/ (17)96wa 480

༄ga /mi gom pa brgyad kyi gtam/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ aṣ+ṭa ak+ṣa ṇa ②ka thā/ bod skad du/mi khom pa brgyad kyi gtam/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /'dir bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos gus par mnyan par bya ste/phyis ni rjes su rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang gi tshe 'dir mi khom pa brgyad las grol ba'i mi ni shin tu dkon no/ /mi khom pa brgyad po dag gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dwags dang / mtha' khob tu skyes pa dang / lha tshe ring po dang / dbang po ma tshang ba dang / log par lta ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'byung ba ste/ de ltar mi khom pa brgyad po 'di dag ldan na/ mi ma thob pas grol ①ba'i chos dang ldan par mi 'gyur ro/ /de dag ji lta zhe na brjod par bya ste/ dmyal ba dang /dud 'gro dang / yi dwags dang / sha za'i lam la phal cher gnas pas/96—481

'dir 'ga' zhig mi'am lhar 'gyur gyi phal cher ni mi 'gyur ro/ /①dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs bsags pa ni dkon pa nyid de/ de 'ga' zhig gi ②gnya' shing gi bu gar rus ①sbal gyi mgrin pa chud pa bzhin no/ /rin po che'i tshogs thams cad kyi gling du gyur pa/ bkra mi shis pa'i dri ma thams cad 'khrud pa/ dam pa'i chos kyi mthar thug rjopa/ bskal pa grangs med par nges par 'byung ba/sna tshogs pa la mkhas par byas pa⑤/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi go 'phang thob cing nges par legs pa ni thob pa mchog tu dka'o/ /bdag nyid kyis dge ba mdun du snying por byas te/ mi dge ba'i chos zhe sdang gis skyed dupas gnyen po dge ba'i chos gtsor bya'o/ /ri'i chu ltar g.yo ba dang / rlung ltar mi gnas pa dang / kā shi'i ⑦me tog ltar ⑧'thor zhing / g.yo ba dang / ston ka'i sprin dang /glog dang / tho rangs kyi mar me dang / pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i chu thigs dang /dri za'i grong khyer dang / dar la bab pa'i sems ltar g.yo bas mi rnams la yid brtan par mi bya'o/ /de bas na 'di ltar bsgrub par bya ste/ me'i nang du zhugs pa ltar bdag legs so ⑨'dod pas myur du nges par skyabs su 'gro bar bya'orka/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar gnas skabs thams cad du dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma rnyed pa ni dkon no/ /gang gi tshe yang sos dang / thig nag dang / bsdus 'joms dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang /tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen po 'di rnams su skyes shing 'khrugs pas sgyur ⑩zhing 'don pa dang / rdeg ⑪pa dang / sreg pa dang / 'tshed pa dang / 'don cing gtub pa dang / za ba dang / gsod pa dang / 'ching ba dang / ngu zhing nga ro 'don pas smre 96—482

zhing sdug bsngal sna tshogs shing sdug bsngal du mar byeng ste/ chu bo rab med du nub cing / lo ma ral gri'i nags tshal dang / tsher ma rnon po'i tshal dang /sru gris gtams pa'i lam dang / rim pa med par 'gro ba dang / lcags kyi thu lum 'bar ba za ①ba dang / khro chu 'thung ba dang / sa gzhi 'bar bar ②'dug pa dang / me'i phreng bas lus sreg pa ni bud shing rab tu 'bar ba bzhin no—/ /yongs su skyur zhing 'bros ①pa dang / brgyal ba dang / smre ba dang /rnam par 'joms pa dang / nyon mongs pas nga ro 'don cing mya ngan byed cing ngu ba dang / rnam pa rjosna tshogs pa'i gzugs du mas sdug bsngal brgya stong phrag mang po myong ngo / /de dag gang du ji ltar zhi ⑤bar 'gyur zhes kyang gsungs so//kyi hud zer ba dang / a chu zer ba dang / snying rje rje skad zer ba dang /ral gri rnon po thogs pa'i gshin rje gtum pos rdeg cing gtub pa dang /mnar med par skyes nas 'bar ba'i mes bsregs dupar de dag rab tu spangs ⑦nas chos kyi 'du shes ji ltar skye bar 'gyur/ de bas na gus pas ⑧chos mnyan par bya ste/ phyis rjes su rnyed par mi 'gyur ro zhes bya'o/ /yang gang dag 'di ltar phan tshun za ba dang / ded pa dang skrag par byed pa dang /'joms pa dang bcas shing za ba dang / ma la 'khrig pa spyod pa dang 'di lta ste/sre mo dang / ku ra dang / ri dwags dang / phag dang / ru ru dang /smi shi dha ⑨dang / gnag dang / spre'u dang / srin bu dang / phye ma leb dang / chu srin dang / ma he dang / glang po dang / glang dang / 'ug pa dang / bya rog dang / khrung khrung dang / bya rgod dang / khyi dang / wa dang / ce spyang dang / rnga mo dang / bong bu la sogs par skyes nas/96—483

phan 'dogs pa dang / blo gros dang rtogs pa dang / dran pa med cing blun por spyod pa dang / bgrod ①par bya ba dang / bgod ②par mi bya ba la ltos ④pa med cing / dgra dang dgra ma yin pa mi shes shing / smra ba dang bral zhing rigs pa mi byed pa/ dpal dang bral ba'i lus dang ldan pa de bas na/ de dag la yang chos kyi 'du shes ji ltar duskye bar 'gyur/ mgo dang mgrin pa dang kha dang rgyab la lcags kyu dang / rdo ba dang / dbyig pa dang / gnya' shing la sogs pas nye bar sdug bsngal zhing / skrag cing 'bros pa dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rdeg 'chos pa dang / 'gred pa dang / rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i ngo bo du mas sdug bsngal brgya phrag du ma nyams su myong ba/ de dag gang du ji ltar zhi bar 'gyur zhes gsungs so/ /dgun gyi dus su rlung drag po dang ba mo mi bzad pas 'joms shing / dbyar gyi dus su nyi ma'i 'od zer tsha bas gdungs par byed pa dang / phan tshun bsnyems shing 'chi ba'i ⑤'jigs pas 'jig rten rnams la rtag par skrag pa'i dud 'gro log par ltung ba'i srog chags la—/ 'di ji ltar chos kyi 'du shes skye/ de bas na gus par chos mnyan par bya ste/ phyis rjes su rnyed par mi 'gyur zhes bya'o/ /yang gang gi tshe bkres pa dang / skom pas gdungs shing lus bsregs pa'i rnam pa lta bu dang / mgrin pa dang / rkan dang / lce dang / mchu rnams duskams shing / snying dang /mig dang / lag pa dang / rkang pa dang / khrag dang / sha dang / rus pa dang / gzhungs ⑦pa dang / rgyu ma dang / nang khrol rnams phyung ba lta bur skams pa dang / mchil ma dang / skyug ⑧pa zas su za ba mes bsregs ⑨pa lta bu'i lus kyi rnam pa dang ldan pa/ snang ba med pa'i mun par gnas pa/96—484

mi gtsang ba zos pas gos shing spags dhipa lo brgya phrag du mar zas skom dang bral ba/ nyon mongs pa rab tu 'bar zhing gcig la ⑤gcig gnod pas skrag cing sdug bsngal ba/ shing dang bong ba dang dbyig pas rdeg pas skom bzhin du bsrungs ③pas/ rim par dbang med par skom pas sdug bsngal ba/ bsod nams dman pa/ gdong rang gi skras g.yogs pa/ dur khrod mi bzad par gnas pa/ lo brgya stong phrag du mar sdug bsngal brgya stong phrag du ma dhinyams su stsong ba/ de dag dus gang du ji ltar zhi bar 'gyur zhes kyang gsungs so/ /bkres pa dang skom pas skams shing / lus me 'bar ba drag po'i rnam pa dang ldan pa/ sgal bu rnams nang khrol gyis stongs pas ⑤ri'i khrod lta bu/ nang khrol nyams pas g.yo ba dang bral ba/ kha khab kyi mig ltar phra ba/ skra'i tshogs chen po rtsub cing gyen du badzes pa/ dge ba cung zad kyang med pas/ mi dge bas yi dwags kyi 'jig rten du skye ste/ de bas na gus par chos mnyan ⑦par bya ste—/ phyis rjes su rnyed par mi 'gyur ro zhes bya'o/ /yang gang gi tshe mtha' khob ④tu skyes par gyur pa de dag kyang rab tu dran pa dang / gcugs ⑧pa dang /blo gros dang / rtogs pa dang bral bas spyod cing lo brgyar yang ⑨ltos pa med do/ /de dag dus gang gi tshe zhi bar 'gyur zhes kyang gsungs so/ /yang gang gi tshe mtha' na gnas pa dang / gle na gnas pa dang / ri khrod dang / shul sa ⑩dang / par seg pa dang / dha ⑪ka pa dang / mu kha 'jab ⑫pa dang /kur pa pa dang / kha sha ba dang / ra ma tha ba dang / bug na ba dang / ci ra tha ba dang / tang ka na ba dang / la sha ba na ⑫dang / hor dang / ha das ga ba dang / nad ⑫ldan pa dang / ya ma na ba dang / a tra pa dang /96—485

dra ①ci la ba dang / rna can pa dang / tsin pa na dang / mi tshangs pa la sogs pa'i yul du skyes pas/ gang du bcom ldan 'das kyis ④nyan thos dus thams cad du mi rgyu bar 'di ltar de dag ni skyes bu'i gzugs tsam rten pa yin te/dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba ltar bya ba dang bya ba ma ①yin pa ni mi shes so/ /khye lta bur za ba dang / skrag pa dang / 'dod pa spyod pa mkhas pa'i 'du shes tsam mo/ /gzhan yang spong rjopa'i rtog pa tsam dang ldan pa dang / rkyen gyis ⑤khro ba dang / nga rgyal dang / phrag dog dang ldan par spyod pa de dag dus gang gi tshe zhi bar 'gyur zhes gsungs so/ /mtha' khob rjopa'i yul na gnas pa gang yin pa mtha' khob ⑦tu skyes pa dge ba dang mi dge ba'i sems mi shes pa'i mun pa dang ldan pa mtha' khob ⑧pa'i yul na gnas pa gang yin pa/ thos pa dang /dul ba dang / dka' thub pa dang / shes pa dang / sbyin pa dang rab tu spyod pa med pas/ dud 'gro rnams dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ /'di ltar 'di lta bu dang bral zhing mi'i gzugs tsam du zad de chos mnyan par ji ltar nus/legs pa'i blo gros dang bral zhing mi bzad pa'i mun pa dang ldan pa yin no/ /de bas na chos mnyan pa la gus par bya ste/ phyis rjes su rnyed par mi 'gyur ro zhes bya'o/ /yang gang gi tshe 'di ltar man+da ra ba'i rtse mor ⑨gnas shing lus rgyas shing dga' ba dang / mdzes shing gsal ba 'dod pa grub cing phun sum tshogs pa bsdus pa mchog tu gyur pa/ pad+ma dang ut+pa la sna tshogs pa'i mchog dang / shing sna tshogs pa'i mchog dang /⑩ shing sna tshogs pa'i dri ⑪ma bsel ba sna tshogs pa'i bya dang / ngur ba'i skad snyan pa sgogs pa dang / chu'i rgyun du ⑫drag tu 'bab ⑫pa/ skyed mos tshal nyams dga' bas brgyan pa/ 'dod pa'i 96—486

khams kyi mthar thug pa 'dod pa rtse gcig tu byed pa'i bya bas rtag tu g.yengs pas phyag 'tshal zhing rab tu 'khod pa ni rol zhing rtsed mo'i spyod ①pa sna tshogs pa byed cing / lta ba'i bde ba du ma nyams su myong ba de dag dus gang gi tshe zhi bar 'gyur zhes kyang gsungs so/ /mtho ris kyi bud med dang dga' bas mtshams sbyor zhing / g.yeng ba ②de dang de dag gis ①rtse zhing / man+d+ra ra'i lha mo dang rol cing glang po dang dpa' bo'i pad+ma'i rten pa la zhon nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i dbang po dang skyed mos tshal du dga' bas bag med pas chags pa'i phyir/sangs rgyas kyi gsung bdud rtsi la pyong bubar ji ltar byed de de bas duchos nyan pa la gus par bya ste/ phyis rjes su rnyed par mi 'gyur ro zhes bya'o/ /de yul dbus su skyes kyang lta ba dang mnyan pa dang / myang ba dang dbang po ma tshang bas/glang po lta bur brdas mtshon pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i bya ba rnams la rjoyang bya ba'i blo dang bral ba/ gang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zhi bar dus gang gi tshe yang 'gyur zhes kyang gsungs te⑦/ thub pa'i dbang po'i gsung ji ltar dbang po dang bral bas nyan sgepar nus/ thos pa'i sgo med pas byams pa dang /snying rje don du gnyer ba las log par gyur pa/ mi'i brjod ⑨pa dang bral bar gyur pa/ rang nyid kyis nyes par spyod pas bslus pa/ sems kyi glang po lcags kyu med pas dregs pa ma thul bas yan pa yin te/ de bas na chos gus par mnyan par bya ste phyis rjes su rnyed par mi 'gyur ro zhes bya'o/ /gal te yul dbus su skyes su zin kyang / yang dag pa'i lta ba'i mig log par lta bas g.yogs pa'i blos sangs rgyas yongs su spangs shing / rgyu dang 'bras bu thams cad la skur pa 'debs pa dge ba'i rtsa ba'i chos thams cad la ⑩mngon par 96—487

dga' ba dang bral ba/ nyes pa thams cad kyi stobs kyis ①nad la gso ba mi byed pa lta bu'i bsam pa phyin ci log gi ④bya ba byed pas ①dmyal ba nyid do/ /de dag dus gang gi tshe nye bar zhi bar 'gyur zhes kyang gsungs so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma yinadu/ /'gro ba thar par ⑤smin mdzad pasarjo/ /gang dag yid kyi phug gnas pa'i/ /rmongs pa'i mun chen mi sel ba/ /me khyen dang 'dra'i mu stegs rnams/ /log lta'i yid ldan de dag gis/ /sel bar nus pa ma yin te/ /nyi bdun gyis kyang sel mi 'gyur/ /de bas na gus par chos mnyan par bya ste/ /phyis rjes su rnyed par mi 'gyur ro zhes bya'o/ /bcom ldan thugs ni rnam rgyas pa/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma ma byung bar/ /nyi ma med par pad+ma bzhin/ /zla ba ma shar bar du ni/ /ku mu da ⑦yi nags bzhin du/ /gdul bya yi ni pad+ma rnams/ /rab tu rgyas par 'gyur ma yin/ /mun pa yis ni mig bsgribs pas/ /rgyal po yi ni lam bzhin dang / /gru skya med pa'i gru bzhin dang / /tshong dpon spangs pa'i zong thogs bzhin/ /byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams kyi/ /gru la kun nas ma zhon ⑧par/ /de ni rtse gcig sems kyis su/ /rnam par grol ba'i dga' mi myong / /khro bral bla ma thar la mos/ /'chi med grong khyer mchog lta ba/ /nyon mongs kun gyi gnyen po ni/ /skad cig gcig la dmigs pa yis/ /zhi ba'i bde ba'i lam la sbyor/ /'gro ba'i nam mkha'i che dkyil du/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma ma shar bar/ /bsgom spangs gdul bya'i pad+ma la/ /ye shes nyi mas rgyas ma yin/ /ngan 'gro'i dus ni thams cad du/ /chos smra ba yis gsal byas pas/ /gang zhig 'di la brten pa yi/ /'gro de dge ba'i bshes kyis stithul/ /mi rnams thob par gyur pa ni/ /ri rtse glog 'gyu 96—488

ltar ①g.yo zhing / /khyogs lta bur ni g.yo ba dang / /mi bzad mi khom brgyad kyi rtser/ /rab tu 'jigs pa'i gza' yis ni/ /med pa las ni thar ④gyur cing / /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor gnas pa yis/ /sangs rgyas gsung ni ①rang bzhin gyi/ /dam chos gru la ma zhon par/ /gang zhig pha rol 'gro 'dod pa/ /blo gros shin tu dman pa yin/ /mi yi ④skye ba 'bras bu med/ /mi khom pa brgyad kyi gtam slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī a dzi ta bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur// //baspur mchan/481 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉la mi khom pa brgyad kyi gtam bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉min/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉maragro/482 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra phal cher ni mi 'gyur ro/ / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(gis/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ru/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ra/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sa/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra skyed/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na sha'i/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ltar/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gsu/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaskyar/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaṣ+peg483 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaza'/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ngonang zhing 'gros/ du〈〈snar 〉〉par/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lta/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sreg ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ngas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gigus pas/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta/4/4 ①〈〈snar 〉thagrod/ ②〈〈snar 〉thagrod/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaltos/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rdza/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha yis/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkarnams/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazhung / sde〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgyugs/⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉stegs/485 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈rtesnar 〉migs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7gcig la/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pangs/ ༷〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉thamar/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesal gyis stong pas/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganyan/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉marakhob/sde〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacugs/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7yang / ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+ku/96byed489
