༄ga /legs par bshad pa rin po che za ma tog lta bu'i gtam/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ su bhā ṣi ta rat+na ka raṇ+ḍa ka ka thā/ bod skad du/ legs par bshad pa rin po che za ma tog lta bu'i gtam/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis glang chen mchog 'dra'i sems ni ②lcags kyus ma yin ye shes lcags kyus btab nas thul/ /'dod chags mun pa'i dmag tshogs me yis ma yin ye shes me yis ma lus bsregs/ /bdud kyi stobs rnams mtshon chas ma yin blo gros rab zhi bzod pa'i mtshon gyis zlogasne /gus la bsgom pa zhi mdzad sangs rgyas mkhyen pa rab rgyas thub dbang de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dka' ba brgya yis rnyed pa yidhi/ /mi rnams thob pa'i khom pa dkon/ /zlog pa med pa'i 'chi bdag ni/ /rtag tu mdun na gnas pas na/ /gang gis dul ⑤sbyin yang dag sdom/ /rgyags tshags mang po ma bsdogs pa/ /mi bzad 'khor ba'i mya ngan du/ /'gro ba de dag sdug bsngal 96—491

thobaske/ /mi rnams thob pa rnyed dka' ba/ /bar snang glog 'gyu lta bu yin/ /srid pa zad byed mkhas pa yis①/ /srid pa rnams su phan pa byas/ /yang dag mi nyid thob pa ni/ /glog dang rbab ④ltar mi brtan pas/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi①/ /bsod nams rjes su skyes bus bstanadu/ /da ltar mi rnams thob pa ltar/ /gang gi dumathu yis phyis kyang thob/ /bsod nams mchog ni gang yin pa/ /de ni bde ba'i rgyu yin te/ /gzugs dang gtong ba rigs mtho sogs—/ /yon tan sna tshogs ldan par 'gyur/ /bsod nams de nyid mdza' bo dhigacig /'khor ba kun du 'gro ba gnyen/ /de ltar 'dir ni bsod nams kyis/ /phyi phyir yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /gang tshe dpal gnas thob bsten pas/ /de bsngags ⑦'jig rten bdag po nyid/ /phan pa'i phyogs su 'dren byed pa/ /bsod nams de nyid spel bar rmis/ /bsod nams che kyis sdig dga' spongs/ /yul la g.yo ba yid kyi rta⑧/ /rtag tu phyin ci log zhi gyis—/ /dug stobs mi bzad 'chi sbrul gyis/ /sos ma bzung ba'i bar du ni//rtag tu khyed kyis thub dbang bzhin/ /gzhan phan ⑨la ni mngon dga' gyis/ /bsod nams la spro ba bskyed pa'i gtam ste dang po'o// //rgya mtsho gnya' shing bu ga ru/ /rus sbal mgrin pa chud pa bzhin/ /yud tsam 'dzom pa ngo mtshar che/ /mi brtan 'di la yang dag soms/ /rab tu zhi ba'i grong khyer lam/ /ngan song 'jigs pa 'joms ⑫byed pa/ /de ni thub pa'i dbang pos gsungs/ /skad cig tsam yang thos ⑪par dka'/ /mi khom brgyad kyi nyes spangs mi/ /gang zhig dkon la bskal pa brgyas/ /de ltar 96—492

bde thob mkhas pa yis/ /dam chos mnyan la 'dir 'bad bya/ /dmyal ba yi dwags 'gro ba dang / /dud 'gro dbang po ma tshang ba/ /'chi med bla ma mtha' khob ①skyes/ /log par lta ba sel ba dang / /thub dbang gsung rab bdud rtsi nirka/ /skyes bu mkhas pas 'thung nus pa/ /shes rab 'od mnga' thub dbang ni| /ma shar bar du yod ma yin/ /de phyir bya min spangs nas ni/ /bdag gi bya ba kun shes pas/ /'phags mchog dam chos mnyan par bya/ /chos 'di la ni gang 'bad pa/ /de la yon tan kun yod 'gyur/ /thub dbang gsung las rin chen 'byung / /mkhas pa 'di yis thog mar dga'/ /de ni gang gis thos pas kyang / /rtag tu stobs ldan brling pa yis/ /mun pa'i tshogs ni 'joms par byed/ /bsams shing bsgoms na mthar thug dze+egasal / /'jigs bcas skye ba 'khor ba'i rgyun/ /nyon mongs ma lus rim gyis spongs/ /thams cad phun tshogs rtag pa'i gter/ /mi bzad 'khor ba'i rgyun 'joms shing / /bla na med pa'i dga' bde thob/ /thos pas 'dir yid dri ma med/ /de ltar ①thub dbang gsung 'di soms/ /chos nyan pa la spro ba bskyed rjopa'i gtam ste gnyis pa'o// //gang zhig thob nas 'khor ba yi⑤/ /pha rol phyin pa'i sa bon bskrun/ /byang chub dpal gyi sa bon mchog /yid bzhin nor bu las lhag pa'i/ /yon tan rgyun gyi mi rnams ni/ /su zhig 'dir de 'bras med byed/ /gang zhig dge bas phyug pa'i mi/ /bskal pa grangs med kyis thob nas/ /'dir ni rmongs pas bsod nams gter/ /cung zad tsam yang mi sogs dhipa/ /de 96—493

dag 'jig rten pha rol du/ /mi bzad mya ngan khang par 'jug /rin chen gling phyin tshong pa ni/ /lag pa stong par rang khyim bzhin/ /dge bcu las kyi ①lam med par/ /phyi nas yang ni thob ma yin/ /mi ma thob par de bar ni/ /ci ltar de bde sdug bsngal nyid/ /de las pha rol slus yod min/ /de las mchog tu rmongs pa med/ /'di 'dra'i khom pa thob nas ni/ /bsod nams tshogs ni mi sogs ④pa/ /skad cig gcig las sdig spyad nas/ /mnar med par ni bskal par gnas/ /skye ba du mar sdig spyad pas/ /bde 'gro dka' lta ci zhig sgos/ /rgya mtsho cher g.yeng sneganya' shing gi/ /bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar/ /mi ni shin tu thob dka' bar/ /de skad bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ /mi'i skye bo dkon pa'i gtam ste gsum pa'o // //④zas skom mal stan ⑤gos mchog dang / /phreng ba gnas dang rgyan rnams dang / /grags pa yon tan khyad 'phags pa/ /de kun sbyin las 'byung rjobar gsungs—/ /ngag snyan mdzes dang longs spyod ldan/ /khyad par 'phags gzugs yangs pa dang / /tshig snyan gzi ldan yid 'ong dag /grags dang nad med tshe das/ ste/ /yid 'ong sdug pa de dang de/ /sbyin pa rnams kyi 'bras bu ste/ /rta dang dar dang glang po dang / /rnga yab gdugs dang me tog tshogs//khang bzangs ⑦mdzes dang rol mor bcas/ /sgra snyan rol mo dang ldan zhing / /me tog phreng ldan bud med dang / /zas dang rin chen phreng ba gnas/ /gur gum grong yul lha yi gnas/ /rdzogs sangs nyid dang sangs rgyas te/ /sbyin pa dpag bsam ljon shing gi/ /'di dag 'bras bu yin par gsungs/ /ut+pal 96—494

sngon po'i 'dab ma 'jam/ /dkyus ①ring dri ma med pa dang / /bud med gang zhig mig 'grub cing / /rked ①pa 'og pag g.yo bar ldan/ /dmar zhing mdzes pa'i gos ldan zhing / /nu 'bur rgyas par rnam par g.yo/ /smin ma mdzes dang ldan de ①dag /de dag ser sna'i sgo bye nas/ /sbyin pa btang las ④rgyas par 'gyur/ /mgul ba rnga mas brgyan pa'i rta/ /bzhon pa kha lo srabs kyi ⑤skyogs/ /mi dbang glang chen dregs zhon nas/ /gdugs bsgreng rjorgyan ldan 'khor bcas dang / /'gro ba thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /rtag tu mchod cing gsol 'debs pa/ /snga mar 'di 'dra sbyin pa yi⑦/ /'bras bu yin par thub pas gsungs/ /gser gyi gdu bu rdo rjes spras/ /dpung rgyan cod pan rin chen bkod/ /sa bdag mu tig phreng bas brgyan/ /rtag tu seng ge'i khri la gnas/ /'bangs sogs btsun mo'i 'khor bsten ⑧cing / /rtsed mo rtse bas rnam rol pa/ /seng ge lta bu'i rnam rol de/ /sbyin 'bras yin par thub pas gsungs/ /khang bzangs gser dang rin chen spras/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan bsgreng bas brgyan/ /pi wang rdza rnga rig byad ⑨sgrogs/ /rin chen rnams kyis ⑩'od 'bar ba/ /brgya byin bde sogs dga' spyod cing / /lha mo'i tshogs kyi 'khor ldan de/ /snga mar 'di 'dra byin pa yi/ /'bras bu yin par thub pas gsungs/ /sbyin pa ⑪skye bo'i yid du 'ong / /mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis rtag tu brten⑫/ /phyogs rnams dri med phreng bas khyab/ /snyan pas kṛ)gnas ni de dang der/ /'dir ni dri med nye bar gnas/ /lus dang bral nas lha rnams su/ /rnyog ④bral sna tshogs btung ba bsel/ /me tog sna tshogs mgo spyogs rgyas/ /dpag bsam gyi ni shing rnams skyes/ /tsan+dan la sogs 96—495

kyis gang ba'i/ /skyed mos tshal ni mchog rnams su/ /yun ring du ni sde ①spyod cing / /lha mo gzugs mchog ldan pa yis/ /bsnyen bkur mchog tu byed pa 'thob①—/ /sbyin pa zhes bya gter chen de/ /①rkun sogs mi 'khyer ④rjes su 'brang ⑤/ /sbyin pas sems kyi ser sna dang / /chags pa'i rdul gyi dri ma 'khru/ /'khor ba'i lam gyis rjodub pa sel/ /sbyin pa bzhon pa bde ba ⑦ste/ /sbyin pa bde ba du ma'i rten/ /yang dag grogs mchog bde ba'i sgo/ /rked pa gser gyi ska rags ldan/ /ngag 'jam zur mig bzhin skyob mdzes/ /mig gi dkyus ring rna ⑧drung gsan/ /me tog phreng bas skra bcings mdzes/ /gang zhig rang 'khor yan lag dang / /rkang gnyis 'gro ba mdzes pa yi⑨/ /zas gtsang gi ni phun sum tshogs/ /de dag sbyin pa'i 'bras ⑩yin zhes/ /bdag nyid chen pos bka' stsal te/ /sa ⑪sa ka ri'i dum bu dang / /ut+pal gyis bsgos dri zhim la—/ /bkra shis gser gyi snod du blugs/ /ban du ka dang zangs mdog 'dra⑫//btung ba chung ma mna' skyel zhing / /chung ma dang bcas yang yang 'thung / /dga' ba'i bsam pas smra ba de'i/ /rgyu ni sbyin mchog bkra shis yin/ /zhi ba'ang sbyin pa'i yon tan te/ /mdzes pa 'dod pa bdag cag gis/ /sbyin pa 'di la 'bad par gyis/ /srid gsum mi bzad 'jigs chen la/ /sbyin las gzhan pa'i gnyen mchog med/ /sbyin pa'i gtam ste bzhi pa'o// //'gro ba gang zhig mdzes yid 'ong / /gzugs dang rigs dang gnyen dang stobs/ /bde bar mthong ba gang yin pa/ /bsod nams bzo bos de byed ⑫par/ /'di skad mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad/ /gzhan phan byed pa'i 96—496

skyes bu yis/ /bsod nams dang mnyam yod ma yin/ /rim pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i/ /rgyal mtshan dkar po mngon mtho btsugs/ /rta glang rkang thang shing rta yi/ /dpung gi tshogs kyis nges 'khrug cing / /yu ba sna tshogs mdzes pa yi/ /rnga yab rnams kyis g.yob byed la/ /bsod nams lhag pa dbang sgyur zhing / /sa rnams la ni spyod byed de/ /dar dang kā ①shi du gu la/ /sna tshogs gos dang mu tig phreng / /gser dang nor bus yan lag brgyan/ /gang dag lha 'dra'i skyes bu dpal/ /bsod nams bzhon chapa la zhon nas④/ /de bas yin par shes par gyis/ /shin tu tshe ring rigs btsun zhing / /lus mjes nad kyi 'jigs pa med/ /nor mang g.yog 'khor phun sum tshogs/ /bsod nams rnam smin chen po yin/ /gang yang 'khor los sgyur ba mchog /bu ni dpa' bo stong dang ldan/ /rgya mtsho'i mtshams kyi sa la dbang / /de dag bsod nams rin po che'i/ /'bras bu yangs pa chen po yin/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i stan la 'dug /lha dang lha dbang rtag phyag 'tshal/ /brjid kyis 'khor rnams zil gyis gnon/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten snang byed pa/ /de dag nyid kyang rjobasod nams las/ /gang la lha klu lha min grub/ /dri za gnod sbyin mi'am ci/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ /rtag tu lha dbang mchod byed pa/ /de ni bsod nams rin po che'i/ /'bras bu yangs pa chen po yin/ /gzugs dang brtson 'grus bzo rnams ni/ /dbang med spangs ⑤nas mi rnams ni/ /las kyi rlung gis mngags nas ni/ /'jig rten pha rol 'gro ba na/ /bsod nams gcig pu mchog yin te/ /rjes su 'gro zhing bde ba 'char/ /bsod nams gzhan gyis du'aphrog mi nus/ /de phyir bsod nams 96byed497

gter gyi mchog /gang gi stobs kyis ①ri rab kyang / /phyogs dang phyogs su rnam 'thor ba'i/ /'jig ④pa'i bskal pa'i rlung rnams kyis/ /ded snekyang bsod nams 'jig mi nus/ /'jig pa'i bskal pa'i chu yis ni/ /lcags kyang dbang med 'jig byed pa/ /rgya mtsho bzhi yi chu rnams kyis/ /bsod nams bzhu ④bar nus ma yin/ /'od zer rab tsha gsal ba yi/ /nyi ma bdun shar me rnams kyis/ /sa rnams sreg par byed mod kyi/ /bsod nams gcig pu sreg ma yin/ /bsod nams kyi gtam ste lnga pa'o// //sangs rgyas sku gzugs bzhengs gsol pa/ /dang por mya ngan sel bar byedaske/ /rtsod pa kun spangs mthong na dga'/ /skal ldan gter tshogs dpal dang ldan/ /lus stobs ldan zhing snyan pa dang / /gzi brjid ldan zhing gzugs mdzes la/ /gsung rab kun la mkhas gyur cing / /dbang po'i rta ni thams cad thul/ /blo ldan stong ⑤dang ldan par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan sku gzugs mchod rten la/ /phra rab rdul ni ji snyed song / /de snyed sa 'og sa steng 'dir/ /de snyed rgyal por nges par 'gyur/ /gzugs dang gzugs med ting 'dzin 'grub/ /thams cad bde bar ma lus spyod/ /tha mar skye rga'i rgud spangs nas/ /de dag byang chub go 'phang thob/ /bde gshegs sku gzugs bzhengs gsol ba/ /mtshan bzang gis mtshan 'khor los sgyur/ /sum cu gnyis ldan lus mjes thob/ /nyes pa'i dgra 'joms rgyal bar 'gyur/ /dbang po rnams ni ma tshang med/ /dpal ldan ngan 'gro rnams las ring / /mi yi rigs su skye 'gyur zhing / /ngag ni btsan rjopa nyid du 'gyur/ /skye bar 96—498

thos dang dran ldan brtan/ /mngon par 'dod par 'byung 'gyur zhing / /gnas la mngon par dad pa dang / /'dod chags sogs kyis gnod pa med/ /'di rgyal rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis①/ /khyad 'phags legs pa'i gzhung la brten—/ /gang 'di rgyal ba'i sku gzugs bzhengs/ /sangs rgyas sku 'am mchod rten nam/ /bzhengs byed srog dang ldan pa de/ /bran dang dbul por mi skye zhing / /mngag gzhug par min rigs dman min/ /dbang po rnams ni tshang bar 'gyur/ /sku gzugs kyi gtam ste drug pa'o// //dri zhim sna tshogs kyis bsgos pas/ /bde bar gshegs la khrus gsol ba//me tog dri yis yan lag mdzes/ /rab tu dga' ba'i yid kyis su/ /rol mo'i sgra ni snyan pa yis/ /dal gyis 'bab dang stegs 'grun brjid/ /gser gyi rang bzhin pad+ma yi/ /ge sar rdul gyis khyab pa ru/ /khrus gsol gang zhig mchod byed pa/ /de dag rnyog pa thams cad kyi②/ /dri ma bkrus nas thar pa thob—/ /lha yi bu mo nu 'bur rgyas mthong zhing / / rked pa yangs ①pa la 'bab g.yo ba dang / /'dzam bu'i gser du'adra'i pad+ma'i ge sar gyi/ /rdul rnams gtor ba yis ni dri zhim la/ /dal gyis 'bab pa'i nang du lha yi tshogs/ /rgyun du chu rnams la ni rtse byed pa/ /gang zhig dga' ba sna tshogs dri zhim chus/ /rje btsun khrus gsol pa yi 'bras de yin/ /gla rtsi ga bur tsan+dan gur kum bsgos//dri zhim chu ni yid 'ong ba/ /kha dog dkar ser bye brag gis/ /yid 'ong thub pa khrus gsol 'dir/ /sems kyi dri ma spangs nas ni/ /de ni 'gro ba'i bla mar 'gyur/ /khrus kyi gtam ste bdun pa'o// //96—499

khrus byed lha yi bu mo mchog /rked ldan brla dang nu ma rgyas/ /'dab skyes mgo lcogs rgyas 'thor ①zhing / /lha dbang dal 'bab khrus byed cing / /mdzes shis 'dod pas g.yo ba ni/ /'gro mchog yang yang mnyes byas yin/ /de ni spos chu rol mo dang / /bdug pa dang ni me tog phreng / /sbyin pa btang ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /gang zhig 'khor los sgyur rgyal la/ /mkha' la gur kum sprin tshogs dang / /ga bur gyi ni chu rgyun dang / /ma la ya yi tsan+dan bzhin/ /rdza rnga pi wang rnga mchog gi④/ /bde bar gshegs mchog mchod byed pa/ /lha dang mi yi sgra rnams thos/ /khyad 'phags lha yi rna ba thob/ /gur kum la sogs pa'i gtam ste brgyad pa'o// //rta glang rkang thang shing rta dang / /rin chen sna bdun rnams dang ni/ /dpa' bo bu stong dang bcas par/ /mkha' la 'khor los sgyur 'gro zhing / /zla ba lta bu'i gdugs kyis ni/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer sgrib byed cing / /'bras bu mang la rgya che ba/ /gdugs phul ba las byung ba yin/ /bung ba yid 'ong sgra yis bskyod/ /me tog g.yo ba 'khor bar bkod/ /kha dog sna tshogs dri zhim pa'i—/ /rnge tog tshogs kyis ri mor bris/ /gdugs mjes sna tshogs dar gyis brgyan/ /mchod rten rnams la phul ba yis/ /'khor los sgyur ba sa skyong ba—/ /gling bzhi'i dbang phyug de yis 'thob/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer gser gdugs thogs/ /dpal ldan dul ba'i glang po mchog /rin chen du mas brgyan pa zhon/ /rdzu 'phrul brgya byin dang 'gran pa'i/ /gling bzhi yi ni 'khor 96—500

los sgyur/ /sa rnams ma lus skyong bar byed/ /de dag bde gshegs sku gdung la/ /me tog gdugs phul 'bras bu yin/ /gdugs phul ba'i gtam ste dgu pa'o// //bde bar gshegs pa'i 'khrungs gnas dang / /de yi yid tsam bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /rab tu gsal ba'i 'gram ①gyur pa/ /nus pa kun gyis gdung snod sku/ /shin tu khyad 'phags gtsug tor mtho/ /sku gzugs bzhengs nas legs sbyangs la/ /skye bo gang gis sku bzhengs pa'i/ /nang du ring bsrel bcug byas na②/ /kun nas brgya byen las 'phags pa'i/ /mi dbang gling bzhi rnams su ni/ /dpal dang ldan pas longs spyod nas/ /mtha' ru rnam dag go 'phang thob/ /rgyal ba'i sku gdung bcug las yin/ /zla ba dang 'dra blta na sdug /smin ma legs shing mig dkyus ring / /mir skyes gser dang nor bur ldan/ /bzod cing des pa dang ldan pa/ /rgya mtshos gtugs pa'i sa rnams ni/ /skyong byed 'khor los sgyur rgyal yang / /de dag sangs rgyas sku gzugs ni/ /ring bsrel dang bcas gus pas ①'thob/ /ring bsrel byi gtam ste bcu pa'o// //bde bar gshegs pa mchog rnams kyi/ /pho brang mchog ni brgyan ④byed pa//gser gyi mdog dang ldan 'gyur zhing / /nad rnams kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /lha dang mi las khyad 'phags shing / /nyi ma'i 'khor lo lta bur mdzes/ /nor dang gser ni mang ba dang / /rgyal po'i rigs kyi rgyal bar 'gyur/ /'jig 96—501

rten gsum gyis mchod pa yi/ /sangs rgyas la ni gang zhig 'dir/ /maṇ+ḍal me tog bcas byed pa/ /'gro ba'i bdag po tshe ring zhing / /sna tshogs nad kyi ①'jigs las grol/ /gang yin de yis skad cig job/ /bde gshegs maṇ+ḍal byed de dag /pha rol phyin drug thob 'gyur te/ /chu dang sa bsres btang sbyin pa—/ /grog mo sogs sel tshul khrims te/ /bsres nas nyes pa bzod pa yin//'bad pa byed pa brtson 'grus yin/ /skad cig de las rtse gcig tu/ /sems 'dzin byed pa bsam gtan yin/ /legs par gzob pa ①shes rab po/ /sna tshogs bsod nams kyis brgyan la/ /sa gzhi bris pa 'bul byed pa/ /lha yi bde ba thams cad dang / /longs spyod mchog dang ldan 'gyur zhing / /mir skyes gser las lhag pa yi/ /kha dog dang ldan mjos pa dang / /pad+ma'i mdog ltar yan lag tshang / /mig ni dkyus ring mdzes par 'gyur/ /maṇ+ḍal gyi gtam ste bcu gcig pa'o// //pad+ma'i 'dab 'dra'i lag pa mdzes/ /'od gsal kha dog dri bzang ldan/ /ro zhim reg na bde ba dang / /lha dang mi yi khang bzangs na/ /'od gsal gser gyi gzhong pa ru/ /lha yi bdud rtsis bkang za ba/ /de dag sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i/ /dge 'dun yul du lhags ①pa la/ /zhal zas drangs pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /rdo rje gdan la bzhugs nas ni/ /'dod pa'i dgra dang bcas pa yi/ /tshogs ni byams pas nges 'pham rjomadzad/ /gang zhig mthar thug dka' ba'i yul/ /mtha' med par ni spyod 'gyur ba'i/ /nyon mongs dka' ba'i dgra las rgyal/ /phung po'i bdud kyang rab bcom nas/ /'chi 96—502

bdag bdud la mnga' brnyes ①pa/ /zhal zas phul bar gyur pas yin/ /ro rnams bro ba'i mchog dang ni/ /yan lag tshang zhing yongs rdzogs ldan/ /bde zhing dpal ldan stobs dang ldan/ /tshe dang stobs dang kha dog dang / /gzugs bzang ba dang ldan pa ni/ /mkhas pas zas mchog btang las byung / /stobs dang brtson 'grus ldan pa yi/ /rnam grangs las ni nges par rgyal/ /yang dag dpal thob mi dbang gis②/ /ro ldan kha zas longs spyod pa/ /rtag tu zas mchog sbyin des yin/ /zas kyi gtam sneste bcu gnyis pa'o// //g.yo zhing ut+pal gyis bsgos pa/ /dri med pad+ma rā ga bzhin/ /yid 'ong gser kyi snod du blugs/ /dri zhim tsan+dan gyis bsgos mngar/ /yid du 'ong dang bdar zhing 'thung / /cung zad mig ni zangs mdog 'dra/ /glu len sgra dang nges ldan pa'i/ /mi mchog de rnams duskom rnams ni/ /sbyin pa byin pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /in+d+ra nī ⑤la bai ḍūr+ya/ /rin chen mchog rnams kyis spras dupa'i//gser gyi sdod ni gang yin par/ /lha gang lha yi bu mo ni/ /brang gi dkyil na nu ma ni/ /bum pa lta bu'i 'bur ldan pa'i/ /rab mdzes gcugs ④dang lhan cig tu/ /sbrang rtsi ltar mngar btung 'thung ba/ /yon tan ldan pa'i tshogs la ni—/ /btung ba yid 'ong byin pa yi/ /'bras bu yin par mkhas rnams gsungs⑧—/ /gang zhig kha dog dri zhim sogs/ /tshogs ldan skom pa'i sdug bsngal sel/ /bad kan rlung drag rab zhi byed/ /kha ra pi pi leng bsres tshod/ /tsan+dan lta bur tsha ba sel/ /zla ba'i 'od zer dang ldan pa'i/ /sdod du blugs nas de dag gis/ /gus par dge 'dun la phul bas/ /pha rol gyi ni skye 96—503

gnas su/ /lha yi btung ①ba thob par 'gyur/ /mngar zhim mngar mchog gus pa yis/ /btung ba tshogs mchog la phul bas/ /lha dang mi yi gnas rnams su/ /lha yi bu mo mchog rnams dang / /yun ring btung ba lhan cig 'thung / /gang zhig sa gnas mi rnams kyis/ /dang ba'i dad pa'i yid kyis ni//dge 'dun la ni btung ba mchog /dus la bab par drangs pa ④yis/ /'khor ba'i ri khrod gnas pa ni④/ /rtag tu btung ba'ang zhim bzang thob④ /btung ba'i gtam ste bcu gsum pa'o// //gang zhig sngo ser ljang dmar dkar/ /sna tshogs kha dog 'od bzang ba⑤/ /mdzes gsal gos kyi phreng ba ni/ /yon tan mchog dang ldan pa yi/ /'jig rten bla ma la phul bas/ /bsngags pa'i gos mchog thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig dge 'dun mchog sogs la/ /gang zhig dad dang gus pa yis/ /gos kyi phreng ba 'bul byed pa/ /de ni ngo tsha shes gos dang / /mchog tu gyur pa'i chos kyi gos/ /nyon mongs gnyen po'i chos gos 'thobarjo/ /kha dog sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i/ /sngon po ser po dkar po dang / /gzhan yang dmar po yid 'ong ba—/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos dag dang / /chos gos phreng ba 'bul byed pa/ /bde 'gro yi ni bde bar 'gro/ /gzugs dang ldan zhing yid 'ong la/ /lha yi gos ni zad med dang / /ngo tsha shes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /bdag blo ngang gis mkhas pa dang / /de — chos kyi dbang phyug 'gyur/ /gos kyi gtam ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //96—504

me tog bzang po dge 'dun la/ /rab tu 'thor zhing mchod byed pa/ /brgya byin las lhag longs spyod ldan/ /pad+ma'i dbang po lta bur mdzes/ /mchog tu grags pa dang ldan zhing / /rtag tu de ni skad cig gis/ /dgra las rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur/ /sa rnams la ni spyod byed pa'i/ /rin chen mchog gi mir gyur pas/ /spos mchog dang ni dri bzangs kyis/ /rgyal ba rnams la 'bul byed pa/ /lus kyi grags pa'i dri yis khyab/ /ut+pal sngo dang mnyam pa yi//mig ni dri med dkyus ring mdzes/ /bai ḍūr+ya dang mu tig dang / /rin po che yis yan lag brgyan/ /lus kun ku sha'i gos kyis g.yogs/ /skye ba kun du mi yi mchog /gzugs dang ldan par gyur pa ni/ /dge 'dun dri bzang phul ba ①yin/ /sna tshogs pa yi sman rnams ni/ /de dag dge 'dun la phul bas/ /mje la sogs pa'i nad rnams kyi/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad pa las grol/ /bzhin ni mjes shing gser rnams dang / /mnyam zhing kha dog yid du 'ong / /rgyal po yi ni 'tshe ba rnams/ /gang yin pa dang bral ba thob②/ /rnge tog la sogs pa'i gtam ste bco lnga pa'o// //sa bdag 'khor los sgyur sdegang la/ /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas ni/ /mkhur ba rna rgyan mdzes rtsang bas/ /gus ldan legs par spyi bo yis/ /lan mang du ni phyag byed pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas phyag byed pa'i/ /'bras bu yin zhes mkhas rnams smra/ /skyes pa tsam gyis gtsor 'gyur ba'i/ /rtag tu mthon po'i rigs skye zhing / /rta dang glang pos rgyu byed pa/ /de dag bla ma 'phags pa la—/ /legs par phyag ni byas pas yin/ /snyan pa yis ni khyab 'gyur zhing / /96—505

nges par legs par 'dzin pa dang / /gsal bar byed pa'i 'od kyis ni/ /sdug bsngal thams cad spong byed cing / /nad ni thams cad 'joms par byed/ /'jig rten du ni bde 'gror nges/ /mi dbang gis ni rgyun du 'gyur/ /'bras bu dpal dang ldan pa yang / /thub dbang phyag byas pa las yin/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal stobs grags ldan/ /yan lag sum cu gnyis mtshan ldan/ /rgyal 'gyur sa stengs ①gtso bo de/ /sangs rgyas la ni phyag byas pa'i/ /'bras bu yin par blo ldan gsung ②/ /de ltar yon tan tshogs shes pas④/ /lus 'di 'jig rjopar shes nas ni/ /mkhas pas sangs rgyas phyag bya zhing / /lus kyi las ni legs par spyad/ /phyag gcig 'tshal bar gyur pa yis/ /'khor ba spong ba'i rgyu thob ducing / /'khor ba'i 'jigs mthong gus pa yin/ /de ltar su zhig phyag mi byed/ /phyag gi gtam ste bcu drug pa'o// // kṛṇ+ḍa sa ra rjoltar mdzes gzugs/ /stobs ldan 'jam zhing shin tu snum//dgun dus bsro ⑦khang gos bzang bgos/ /yid 'ong mdzes ma la 'khyud nas/ /mi dbang gang zhig rtse byed cing / /ro mchog sna tshogs ldan pa ni/ /rin chen snod blugs 'thung ba ni/ /de dag sgon ma phul ba yisaske/ /shin tu 'bras bu mngon yin par/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rin chen gsungs⑨/ /'bar zhing me lce rgyas dang ldan/ /khang pa'i nang du me 'bar gsal/ /dgun dus grang ba sel byed pa/ /snang ba thub pa'i dbang po ni/ /mchog tu gyur la phul ba yis—/ /lha dang mi yi 'jig rten na/ /gsal zhing rab tu 'bar gyur dang / /dri za lha min mi'am ci/ /byad bzhin mjes dang lhan cig tu/ /ston zla dang 96byed506

'dra rab mjes pa/ /sdug pa pang bar 'khyud nas ni/ /lus ni yid du 'ong ba dang / /mtho ris su ni spyod byed pa/ /de dag gang tshe 'phags tshogs la/ /snang ba dang bas phul ba yin/ /rkun ma las rgyal bzhon par ldan/ /sa rnams ma lus rjes su skyong / /byad bzang gser gyis yan lag brgyan/ /de dag gis ni snang ba rnams/ /phul ba'i 'bras bu 'di dag yin/ /snang ba'i gtam ste bcu bdun pa'o// //ri rnams kyis ni bsgribs ①pa dang / /mchog tu ring na gnas pa dang / /shun tu phra ba'i dngos po dang / /mtshan mo smag gis bsgribs pa dag /gang tshe lag mthil gnas pa ltar/ /dge slong ma 'gags pa yis ④mthong de ni bde bar gshegs pa la/ /zhugs ④mar phul ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /spyan gyis dngos kun gzigs pa'i phyir/ /bde gshegs mar me phul ba yis /sangs rgyas nyid ni mnyes rjozhes grags/ /phul ba bcom ldan gang zhe na/ /thub dbang dri med spyan la phul/ /ring dang phra dang bsgribs pa dang / /dpag tshad kyis chod mthong la ltos/ /rgyal la zhugs mar phul ba yi/ /de 'bras yin par thub pas gsungs/ /sa bdag rgyal po gang yin pa/ /zla ba lta bu'i gzugs ldan pa/ /ut+pal lta bur mig dkyus ring / /gang zhig lha yi ⑤'jig rten na/ /gser mdog 'od kyis snang ba ltar/ /rang gi 'od kyis snang byed pa'i/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ni/ /nor bu brgya phrag 'od gzer 0gyis—/ /sa rnams rgyu zhing snang byed pa/ /de dag shākya seng ge la/ /gus par mar me phul ba yis⑦/ /rgya cher 'phel bar 'gyur ba ④yin/ /lha gang 96—507

'jig rten gsal byed cing / /ut+pal lha yi mig ldan la/ /smin ma legs shing gser mchog ltar①/ /mig stong dang ni ldan pa yi/ /brgya byen lha yi bdag po nyid/ /lha yi stan la 'dug pa dang / /gang zhig 'dod bral tshangs pa ni②/ /'od gsal lha mchog phyag byed cing / /lha yi shing rta g.yo byed pa/ /ston pa yi ni ring bsrel la/ /mar me'i phreng ba mis phul ba'i①/ /'bras bu rgya chen gyur pa yin/ /mar me'i gtam ste bco brgyad pa'o// //mi dbang dus ni thams cad du/ /nyams dga' ba yi khang bzangs mchog/rol mo'i gnas kyi ④nyams dga' bar/ /'tsho zhing rgyal ba'i sgra sgogs par/ /btsun mo'i 'khor dang rol byed pa/ /grang ba sel ba'i khang pa ni/ /phyogs bzhi nas ni byon pa yi/ /dge 'dun bzhugs gnas phul ba yin/ /thub pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bcas/ /gtsug lag khang gi don du ni/ /tshig gis rab tu bskul ba dang / /tshogs pa yis ni grogs byed cing / /nges par dus su 'gro byed pa/ /gnyid log pa 'am langs pa na/ /bsod nams rgyun ni tshad med 'phel/ /shes rab rdo rje'i mtshon cha yis/ /phyin ci log gi ri bcom nas//sa dang bcas pa'i khang bzangs ⑤'gyur/ /dge 'dun la ni yo byad dang / /longs spyod bzang po dang bcas pa/ /gtsug lag khang ni gang zhig byed/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzangs ni/ /rin chen mchog gi rang bzhin gyi/ /rtsig pa ka ba dang ldan pa'i/ /mdzes ldan lhan cig dus kun du/ /de ni lha yi 'jig rten 'dir/ /yun ring du ni mngon par dga'/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i bla re rjodang / /sna tshogs kyi ⑦ni gos kyis spras/ /khang bzangs ⑧mchog ni 96—508

'od 'phro ba/ /yang dag gnas par gyur pa ni/ /yon tan tshogs ldan phul ba yis/ /brgya byin gyi ①ni khang bzangs ①mchog /rnam par rgyal byed thob pa yin / /gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i gtam ste bcu dgu pa'o// //khyogs dang stan ni mnyam pa ru/ /'bol stan la ni chung ma ni/ /nu ma rgyas dang lhan cig tu/ /mal stan la ni sa bdag nyal/ /nyes pa'i tshogs spangs dam pa la/ /de yis mal stan phul ba yin/ /rkang rten dang bcas khri la ni/ /sna tshogs gos kyis brgyan snel 'dug /dbyangs snyan rol mo dang mgrin bsdebs④/ /rin chen rang bzhin stan la ni/ /dri zhim pas ni byugs pa yi⑤—/ /dad ldan mal stan chen po la/ /dpung pa la ni mgo brten dhinas/ /yun ring lha yi khang pa ru/ /'jigs pa med par bde bar nyal/ /de dag mal cha stan rnams ni/ /dge 'dun rnams la phul ba yi/ /'di ni 'bras bu yin par bshad/ /ga pur tsan+dan a ka ru/ /lus byugs dze+epa yi lha mo ni/ /nu ma zung ldan lus brten nas/ /gos mchog 'bol stan la rtag ⑧nyal/ /de dag mchod rten rnams la ⑨ni/ /gdugs dang gos khri phul bas yin/ /mal cha dang stan gyi gtam ste nyi shu pa'o// //gling bzhi las ⑩ni rnam rgyal nas/ /stobs ldan brgya byin gnas yin te/ /nga las ⑪nu yis sum cu gsum/ /bdag po'i stan phyed dbang byas nas/ /'dod pa'i bde ba'i dga' ba myong / /zhag bdun bar du dbyig rnams kyi/ /char ni khang par dpag med phab/ /de dag lhung bzed du gtor ba'i/ /sbyin 96—509

pa chen po de yi ①ni/ /'bras bu ngo mtshar chen po yin/ /snod ni de dang de dag gis/ /rgyu bzhi dag la brten pa yi②/ /sdug bsngal la sogs bye brag gi④//'bras bu tha dad tha dad 'gyur/ /de phyir mi dbang khyad 'phags rgyal/ /zla ba lta bu'i bzhin dang ni/ /ut+pal lta bu'i kha dog dang / /mi rnams nang du rtag par ni/ /dri med mig ldan ro stod yangs/ /dga' zhing stan dang mal cha dang / /zas dang snod du ldan pa ni④/ /mi rnams sbyin pas yang dag 'thob/ /mi mchog gis ni nad pa dang / /dman pa dang ni dbul ba rnams/ /snying rje can gyis sbyin btang bas/ /dpal ldan yang dag khyad 'phags 'gro/ /mi dbang brgya byen dang mnyam rtse/ /dga' zhing bu dang bran g.yog bcas/ /zla ba dang 'dra bzhin gyi mchog /mig yangs lus ni nyi ma bzhin/ /grags pa snyan pa dag dang ldan/ /mi dbang dgra yi stobs 'joms shing / /bde ba thams cad thob pa ni/ /de yis rang gi bla ma dang / /pha ma rnams la sbyin las byung / /gang zhig rta dang shing rta glang / /zhon la skye bo'i tshogs phyag 'tshal—/ /gser gyi yu ba dang ldan pa/ /zla ba'i dbyebs dang ldan pa yi⑤/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer zlog byed thogs/ /mi dbang mchog tu gyur pa ste/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ni④/ /sa rnams dbang phyug dang bcas pa'i/ /gang zhig rgyal por gyur pa ni/ /yang dag zhing la de dag gis/ /sbyin pa'i sa bon sbyangs pa yi/ /yon tan mchog gi 'bras de yin/ /dman pa'i snod la sbyin pa yis/ /mang du byin yang 'bras bu nyung / /yur ma tshor ma'i skyon bcas dang / /rdo ba'i steng gi zhing rnams la/ /sa bon mang po btab pa bzhin/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug spangs/ /yon tan gyis brgyan zhing la sbyin/ /96byed510

nyung ngu byin yang mang du 'byung / /n+ya gro dha yi sa bon bzhin/ /zhing gi gtam ste nyi shu gcig pa'o// //gang gis chos kyi sbyin byen zhing / /bri ba dang ni nyan pa dang / /rtag tu de dag sems nyid dang / /gal te yang dag sgom byed na/ /skye ba dran pa rtag tu 'thob/ /gang zhig lha yi 'jig rten na/ /dpag bsam gyi ni shing gi mchog /don rnams thams cad 'grub byed pa/ /lha tshogs bde ba'i mchog gyur pa/ /de ni ba mchog byen pa yi①/ /rgya che ba yi 'bras bu yin/ /gang zhig mngal du rdzogs par ni/ /gtsang zhing yid 'ong ro myang la/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi stobs dang ni/ /gang zhig 'o ma 'thung tshe yang / /pad+ma'i ge sar mdangs ldan pa/ /khu 'jo'i sdedus gang yin par 'thung / /skyed rdzogs nas kyang de bzhin te/ /bdud rtsi'i mchog kyang 'thung byed pa/ /de ni ba mchog btang las byung / /seng ge'i khri ni rab dga' zhing / /mjes pa gus pas chos la ni/ /rim pa bzhin du des phul bas/ /gzhig par mi nus rdo rje'i gnanasne / /rab mchog seng ge'i khri la gzhugs④/ /lha klu grub pa phyag 'tshal 'gyur—/ /gser gyi snod du rtag tu der/ /ro ldan 'o ma blugs ⑤nas ni/ /mi yi mchog ni 'thung byed cing / /dpal ldan phun sum tshogs pa dang / /pad+ma'i mdog ldan bud med rnyedadhi/ /de ni ma he mchog btang yin/ /rtag tu nad pa nyam chung la/ /bzhon pa mchog ni sbyin pa dang / /bla ma rnams ni mnyes byas nas/ /btsun zhing mi rnams kyis bstod 'gyur/ /gser gyi chas kyis ⑦brgyan pa yi/ /rta ni yid du 'ong ba la/ /mi mchog rtag tu zhon nas rgyu//96—511

shin tu ring ba'i yul rnams su/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni 'gro byed pa/ /bzhon pa mchog ni phyin ①pa yis/ /de lta bu yi mi ru 'gyur/ /do shal dang ni do shal phyed—/ /'og pag dang ni ldan pa yi/ /yid 'ong lha mo rnams la rtse/ /sum cu gsum bdag dang 'gran pa/ /ltos pa med par byin pa las/ /byung bar mkhas rnams rab tu bshad/ /bdud kyis zil gyis ②mi non cing / /legs par gsungs pa ①rtag tu ni/ /bdud rtsi lta bur mnyan par gyis/ /sa gzhi lta bur chos kyi yum/ /nyon mongs dgra ni spong bar byed/ /'khor ba'i bde ba nyams myong zhing / /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyi④/ /rab mchog nyid ni thob par 'gyur/ /dub pa'i dus ni thams cad du/ /mkhas pas ⑤gnas ni phul ba yis/ /mtho ris phyin nas rtag tu dga'/ /brgya byin dang ni lhan cig tu/ /rtag tu dga' ba myong bar byed/ /'dir ni skyed mos tshal phul bas//sna tshogs pa yi shing rnams la/ /me tog dri zhim dang ldan zhing / /mngon par mtho ba'i mi thob nas/ /skyed mos tshal rnams longs spyod ldan/ /chu bo rgal bar dka' ba yi/ /gnas su zam pa 'dzugs byed pa/ /mi de longs spyod dang ldan pa'idhi/ /mtho ris gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gser mdog lta bu'i lus dang ldan/ /nyams dga' rdzing bu byed pa'i mi/ /mtho ris gnas ni thob par 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'di ru mir gyur nas/ /rgyal po yi ni dga' bde thob/ /khron pa dang ni bu nyen khang / /sems can rnams ni rten ⑦pa dang / /than pa grang ba skyob gyur pa/ /byed pa'i mi mchog gang yin pa/ /lha yi bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer tsha ba yis⑧/ /shin tu sdug bsngal ldan pa la/ /gang zhig gdugs ni sbyin byed pa/ /gdugs dang 'dra 96—512

bar de dag ni/ /dgra yi tshogs las rgyal 'gyur zhing / /rtag tu bde ba mchog dang ldan/ /mchil lham rgyan gyis brgyan pa ni/ /sems can thams cad dag la ni/ /gus pa yis ni sbyin byed pa/ /de dag bzhon pa mchog rnams la/ /lha dang mi yi 'jig rten du/ /yun ring zhon par skye bar 'gyur/ /yon tan rnams ni sgrogs pa yis/ /rgyal ba mchog gi stod ①byed pa/ /thams cad dag ni btud sdepa yis/ /lus kyis ①phyag ni 'tshal byed pa/ /bla mar brten ④pa'i rigs skye ⑤zhing / /de dag so sor rig pa 'thob/ /rdza rnga pi wang pa ṭa has/ /bde bar gshegs mchog mchod byed pa/ /mir gyur 0nas ni dbyangs snyan la/ /sgra ni shin tu snyan par 'os/ /yid du 'ong ba'i gzugs dang ldan/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten la/ /dga' bas srog dang 'dzugs ⑦byed cing / /gdugs dang dril bu rnams dang ni/ /gdugs kyi phreng ba 'bul byed pa/ /de dag mir ni rgya che zhing / /dpal ni phun sum tshogs pa 'thob/ /mir gyur pa ni ma lus pa'i/ /bdag po nyid ni stobs dang ldan/ /dpung rgyan mu tig rgyan ⑧ldan pa/ /sa rnams sbyin par btang ba las—/ /yin pa ru ni mkhas pa 'chad/ /mchod rten dang ni rgyal ba yi/ /sku mchog rnams ni bzhengs byed pa/ /gdugs ldan sku gdung 'dzug byed pa/ /mtho ris yang dag 'dir thob nas/ /mi rnams kyis ni bstod par 'gyur/ /gang zhig dang por sangs rgyas la/ /sa dang lci bas byugs nas ni/ /me tog 'bras bu zas skom ⑨phul/ /rtag tu mchod pa byed pa ni/ /rgyal po'i mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /rgya ⑩chen mar me sna tshogs dang / /dri zhim me tog bdug pa dang / /bu ram la sogs btung ba rnams/ /dge 'dun la ni 'bul byed 96—513

pa—/ /de yang nor dang ldan 'gyur zhing / /lha mi'i bde ba dag dang ldan/ /mchod rten gdung bcas gtsug lag khang / /mi gang 'bad pas nyen 'khor 'phyag① /kun nas dri ma med byed pa/ /gser gyi kha dog 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu snang ba 'dul ④byed cing / /grang dus gos dang khang pa dang / /rgyan dang bu mo btung ba byen/ /skye gnas rnams su bde ldan 'gyur/ /sa stengs su ①ni tshe ring zhing / /thams cad nad las grol dhibar 'gyur/ /mnyam pa med pa'i bde ba thob/ /de dag rtag tu bde dang ldan/ /lha yi bde ba sna tshogs pa/ /nyams su myong zhing 'byung 'gyur ba/ /srog gcod spangs pa las yin par/ /nges par mkhas pa rnams kyis bstan/ /gzhan mthong brnab sems mi byed pa/ /chom rkun las ni dben gyur cing / /rdzas ni yongs su srung ⑤bar byed/ /gser dang dpag med phun tshogs thob/ /rkun ma brgya phrag dag gis ni/ /mi dbang las ni 'bral mi nus/ /chung ma gzhan la mi 'phyo zhing / /legs srung chung ma mnyam rjomed rnyed/ /skye bar dgrar gyur cung zad med/ /'dir ni 'jig rten yid rton ⑦cing / /de la yid mi ches yod min/ /de dang der ni skye ba na/ /ut+pal sngon po lta bur ni/ /dri ldan yid du 'ong ba'i gzugs/ /de ni mi 'gyur kha dri zhim/ /brdzun gyi tshig kyang smra ma yin/ /dam pa yi ni grogs ldan zhing / /mi dbang gis ni gus pas mchod/ /bu dang chung ma bran dang ni/ /longs spyod rgya ni chen po yis/ /dpag tu med pa'i bde thob pa/ /rtag tu phra ma spangs pas yin/ /yid du 'ong zhing sgra snyan la/ /ngag ni snyan par 'os pa dang / /rtag tu shin tu mdzes pa dang / /mi rnams dang ni lha rnams su/ /de rgyal tshig ni rtsub mo dag /mi de yis ni spangs pas yin/ /96—514

chos don dben pa dga' ba yis/ /smra ba de ni 'jig rten byi/ /rtag tu mchog tu yid 'ong 'gyur/ /yang yang mchod pa de yis thob/ /rin chen mang dang bzhon pas phyug /mngon mtho 'jig rten sna tshogs pa'i/ /bde ba mtha' yas myong bar 'gyur/ /bdag gzhan chags pa spangs pa yis de 'dir 'dod chags chung 'gyur zhing / /rtag tu longs spyod rgya chen ldan/ /ngag la dbang zhes ①grags ldan 'gyur/ /rab tu mdzes pa nyid thob cing / /de ni rtag tu phyug cing bde/ /rgyal srid kyis mtho 'jig rten gyi/ /tshangs pa nyid ni thob 'gyur zhing / /yang dag byams pa'i sems ldan pa/ /dbang do yod pa'i mi ru skye/ /mtho ris thar 'bras bde ba thob/ /yang dag rdzogs dang mi de ldan/ /gang phyir 'di dag thams cad ni/ /yang dag lta ba mchog tu ni/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /dad dang blo gros dang ldan pa'i/ /bsod nams kyi ni zhing mchog las/ /sa gsum bde ba rgya chen byed/ /de lta'i khyad par mi shes pasasne/ /yon tan rin chen thams cad kyi/ /gter du gyur pa'i dad pa ni/ /rtag tu de yis brtan ④par bya/ /dad pa yis ni ma bzhin du—/ /bde ⑤ba rnams ni bskyed par bya/ /de bas thog mar skyes bu yidu/ /yid kyis legs par bsten par bya/ /'byung gnas dad pa spangs pa yis /dam chos rin chen byang chub mchog⑦ /nges par gzung ④bar nus ma yin/ /rgyal po las ni nyams pa yis/ /longs spyod 'bras las nyams pa ltar/ /dad pa'i dbang po las nyams na/ /de bzhin 'bras rnams thob ma yin/ /de phyir skyes bu mkhas pa ni/ /'jig rten bde gshegs byed 'dod pas/ /yid ni rab tu dad pa yis/ /rtag tu phan pa nyid du gyis/ /lhag mas nyes pa zhi ma 96—515

yin—/ /gzhan du dad pa dang ldan pa'i/ /nyes pa'i tshogs ni thams cad bsreg① /dman zhing gos med rmongs pa dang / /lag pa na ni thod pa thogs//'jig rten 'di na slong ba snang / /sbyin pa med pa'i 'bras la ltos/ /tha dad khyem du slong zhing rgyu/ /rtag tu bkres par kun du 'khor/ /gang zhig lus las ④lag rkyong la/ /khye dang 'dra bar ring na gnas/ /kun du 'jug cing slong ba la/ /phyir log snenyung shas cha gcig kyang / /gang zhig kha zas mi ster brka/ /kha ni khab tsam lto ba ri/ /lus skam skra yi gos kyis ni/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer snang min la/ /yi dwags skom gyis gdungs pa rnams④/ /'bras de lag gis ma byin cing / /dus ma byin pa'i 'bras bur gsungs/ /sna tshogs bsdus pa'i gtam ste nyi shu gnyis pa'o// //bsod nams spro ba bskyed pa mnyan par gyis/ /gtong dang bsod nams dkon pa ste/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la/ /sku gdung rnams ni bcug byas na/ /khrus gsol gdugs ni 'degs pa dang / /maṇ+ḍal zas dang skom rnams dang / /gos dang me tog la sogs dang / /snang ba dad ni mar me dang / /gtsug lag khang du mal stan dang / /zhing dang sna tshogs phul nas ni//bstod cing phyag ni 'tshal byed pa/ /'di 'dra du ma phun sum tshogs/ /gtam ni nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyis/ /yang yang sbyin pa'i bsngags pa brjod/ /mtsho ni sbrul gyis gang bzhin du/ /me tog lo ma rgyas pa yi/ /ljon shing tsher ma dang bcas bzhin/ /thos dang dpyod dang rigs ldan zhing / /de lta bu yi bye brag can—/ /tshul khrims la ni rgyab phyogs yin/ /dbul yang khrims ldan mchog 96—516

yin gyi/ /yon tan rgyan dang bral ba yi/ /nor ldan rnams dang mtshungs ma yin—/ /dbul yang skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /de dag yon tan ro myang bas/ /bdud rtsi lta bur khyad par 'phags/ /yang dag dran bya bla ma bzhin/ /yon tan ldan 'phags gzi brjid ldan/ /nor rnams dang ni rgyan dang ni/ /de dag rgyal po rnams kyis ni/ /drung du nye bar mchod 'dod pas/ /tshul khrims 'di ni bsrung bar gyis/ /'jig rten bde ba rnams rgyal ba'i/ /'jigs dang zhe sdang bcas pa la/ /chos kyi bdag nyid blo byas te/ /bde ba mchog ①ni skyes bu yis/ /bde ba rgya chen mi 'phrogs pa/ /thob par 'dod pa de yis nirka/ /tshul khrims nyid ni srung ④bar gyis/ /tshul khrims las nyams 'dul zhing 'tshe/ /de yis 'jigs bcas nyams su myong / /tshul khrims ldan la de dag med/ /de nas 'jig rten pha rol du/ /mtha' yis gtugs shing 'gro ba na / /bde ba'i yul rnams 'dod pa yin/ /de yi ①tshul khrims 'di nyid srung rjo/ /tshul khrims brten ⑤dang nges ldan na/ /bde 'gro nyon mongs bdag nyid min/ /log par lta bas lam gol phyir/ /de phyir thar pa rab byung zhing //rtags ldan mtho ris 'dod pa yis/ /de yis tshul khrims 'di nyid srungs/ /mi 'jig rjodabrog tu med pa'i rgyan/ /tshul khrims 'di yin bsrung bar gyis/ /tshul khrims nor gyi mchog yin te/ /gzhan gyis ⑦dbrog cing rkur mi tshugs/ /tshul khrims brtan ⑧te 'chi ba na/ /gzhan du rjes 'brang lus ma yin/ /tshul khrims rjes su 'brang ba'i grogs/ /tshul khrims rgyan gyi mchog yin te/ /rgyan de la ni stor ba med/ /yid gcugs pa yi grogs po yin/ /tshul khrims lta bu'i phan byed med/ /tshul khrims yang dag nges pa'i gnyen/ /pha dang ma dang 96—517

bu yin te/ /'dod pa ster ba tshul khrims te/ /mthu yis 'bras bu 'di sbyin byed—/ /tshul khrims kyi gtam ste nyi shu gsum pa'o// //bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi/ /sbyin dang bder gshegs mchod la sogs—/ /legs spyad gang yin de kun yang / /khong khro gcig gis 'joms par byed/ /zhe sdang dang mnyam sdig pa med/ /bzod dang mnyam pa'i dka' thub med/ /de phyir 'bad pas bzod pa sgoms①/ /sna tshogs pa yi tshul gyis nirka/ /zhi ba'i yid kyis ma bzung na/ /dga' dang bde ba myong ma yin/ /sdong ②ba'i zug rngu yid gnas la/ /gnyid med brtan pa yod ma yin/ /zhe sdang bral bar ma gyur na/ /ji srid 'tsho bar gnod dang bcas/ /khro ba gcig pu bcom pa yis/ /rnam par sdang ba thams cad bcom/ /rtog pa'i bud shing la mched pa'i/ /khro ba'i me yis 'gro ba bsreg /dang por bdag nyid sreg byed la/ /gzhan dag sreg pa'am yang na min/ /rgas pa yis ni gzugs bzhin dang / /khros dang mun pas mig dang ni/ /blo dang bral bas 'dod don ldan/ /de bas khro ba 'joms par byed/ /dge ba'i las la 'di sbyar bya/ /bdag la gnod byed 'byung ba dang / /de las bzlog par bya snyam na—/ /sdig ldan sems yin khror ci yod/ /mtshon sogs byed pa spangs nas ni—/ /'phen pa ci zhig khro ru yod/ /rtsod byed zhe sdang yin pas na/ /de phyir zhe sdang la sdang bsngags/ /bzod pa'i gtam ste nyi shu bzhi pa'o// //yon tan rin chen thams cad kyi/ /gter du gyur pa brtson 'grus te/ /96byed518

nyon mongs rgya mtsho kun sgrol ba'i/ /rgya chen mchog ni brtson 'grus yin/ /brtson 'grus shing rta gang zhon pa/ /dngos po bsams ①pas mi thob ④pa/ /de 'dra 'gro na yod ma yin/ /glang po rta dang rkang thang dang / /mda' dang mda' chen dgra sta dang / /mtshon cha yis ni g.yul 'gyed cing / /dgra bgegs mthar ni rgyal byed pa/ /'di de stobs dang ldan pa yi/ /brtson 'grus dpa' bo chen po yin/ /rgya mtsho chu srin tshogs gnas shing / /chu rlabs mthon por rim rgyu ba/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa'i dpa' bo yis/ /ba lang rjes bzhin 'gom par byed/ /rin thang med pa'i rin chen gyi①/ /gter ni len par byed pa yin/ /'dod chags la sogs sbrul gdug rnams/ /lus la brtson 'grus can gyis sgongs④/ /khrims ldan skye bo dam pa ni/ /sems ni dri med khyad 'phags pas/ /mir ni yang dag mnyam gzhag ⑤'dzin/ /ri rab mdzes pa'i rtse mo ru/ /blta na sdug pa'i lha mo la/ /pang du lag pas 'khyud pa yibu/ /bde dang ldan zhing dga' bar byed/ /mkha' gnas lha ni gang yin pas/ /gnyis gnyis ldan pa nges spangs nas/ /yang dag nyid kyi bde ba myong / /shin tu 'bras bu rgya che ba'i/ /bskyed pa'i rgyu ni brtson 'grus te/ /bstan pa la sbyor de sbyor byed/ /brtson 'grus kyi gtam ste nyi shu lnga pa'o// //nyon mongs dgra yi sde tshan rnams/ /bsam gtan ldan pas zil mnan nas—/ /yang dag byang chub dpal rnams thob/ /byang chub yan lag rab sbyin zhing / /'chi med skye ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs pa / /nyes pa thams cad sel ba yi/ /rgyu ni bsam gtan yin pa ru/ /blo 96—519

ldan de yis rab tu gsungs/ /nam mkha' dang ni sems mnyam la/ /gser dang bong bar mnyam pa yi①/ /bsam gtan sgom byed skyes bu yi⑧/ /yon tan rnams kyi rgyu ru gsungs/ /nyon mongs dgra tshogs las rgyal ba'i/ /dge ba'i stobs kyis bsgrub ①pa las/ /mtshan ni thams cad ldan pa yi④/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub dpal/ /yon tan rab mchog bdag nyid can/ /dkon pa'i rigs ⑤pa thob par 'gyur/ /sems la ye shes chen po yis/ /dgra yi 'jigs pa rnams spangs nas/ /gang gis mi yi dbang po bskyed/ /bsam gtan gcig pu de rgyu ste/ /yon tan kun gyi gter yin pas/ /'phags pa'i yon tan gyis phyug gsung rjo/ /rmongs pa'i mun pa sel mdzad cing / /rgyun gyis ⑦rtag pa'i ye shes kyis/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi nyi ma dang / /mi rnams dang ni lha rnams kyi/ /bde rgyu bsam gtan rab mchog yin/ /bsam gtan gyi gtam ste nyi shu drug pa'o// //shes rab stobs dang bral na yang / /skyes bu'i gzugs brnyan 'ba' zhig ste/ /snying po spangs ⑧pa'i mthar thug par/ /ri mo bris pa'i gzugs dang mtshungs/ /blo ldan brtson 'grus yang ldan pa'i/ /blo ldan de la 'bras 'dod 'byung / /bla med bdag gsod pa yi dgra/ /skye ba du mas gang chod dang / /bdag nyid skye bar 'gyur ba yis/ /rigs dang ming dang rus rnams dang / /dbus bzhin du ni mtha' bzung la/ /rnal 'byor pa yi shes pa 'jug /shes rab stobs kyis de shes gsungs/ /'jig rten rnams ni dri mi yi/ /rab rib tshogs ni sel byed pas/ /de ⑨bas blo de chos mchog yin/ /ye shes snang 96—520

ba skyed ①pa yis/ /mi rnams kyi ②ni nyes pa'i tshogs/ /rtag tu stongs par byed pa yin/ /dang por dbang po 'di bsgrub bya/ /yid kyis ④phra rab rnam shes shing / /rig pa thams cad gsal byed yin/ /shes rab de yang rtag par ni/ /stobs kyis dge ba rjoskyed byed pa'i/ /rgyu yin par ni rtag tu grags—/ /bya ba'i rgya mtsho'i nang du ni/ /gdon mi za bar nub pa dang / /g.yul gyi nang du shes rab gtso/ /shes rab stobs kyis rnam rgyal thob/ /thos pa'i shes rab gang yin de/ /dge ba rnams kyi rgyu ru 'gyur/ /de ltar duyon tan thams cad ni/ /sgrub par byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ /gdon mi za bar shes rab sgrubasarjo/ /shes rab med pa'i skyes bu ni/ /mi gsal tho rangs mar me bzhin/ /shes rab kyi gtam ste nyi shu bdun pa'o// //mtho ris thar pa'i yon tan ni/ /rin po che yi gter gyur pa/ /pha rol phyin pa drug 'di nyid/ /sa gzhi bzhin du shes pa'i mis/ /bdag phan bsgrubs pa de yis ni/ /gzhan la phan par bya ba'i phyir/ /myur bar rtag par rgyun du 'bab/ /pha rol ⑦phyin pa'i gtam ste nyi shu brgyad pa'o// //legs par bshad pa rin po che ⑧za ma tog lta bu'i gtam snyan dngags mkhan ⑨chen po slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ru dra ⑩dang / dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur// //96—521

ni mchog tu ring yang lo brgya kho nar zad/ /de las kyang ni dang po byis pa tha mar rgas pas don mi ①byed/ /gnyid dang nad sogs dag gis de dus med par kun nas re ba 'joms/ /bde bar gnas pa'i mi nang 'gro ba'i tshe yi lhag ma ji tsam yod/ /sum cu rtsa gsum bdag po'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyal po de rnams ni/ /shes pa'i snang bas mun pa zad byas drang srong de yang shi bar 'gyur②/ /gshin rjes zin par gyur tshe longs spyod kyis min bshes pa dag gis min/ /skyes bu rtsol bas zlog mi byed na 'dir ni mi rnams su la ji ltar skyabs su 'gro/ /bstan bcos klags ①dang bcas shing rig dang bzo yi bya ba dang bcas dang / /yid rton grogs bcas sdug pa'i chung ma dang bcas drung gnas rjo'akhor bcas pa'i—/ /mi rnams 'chi bdag snying rje med pas sa stengs ⑤'dir ni khyab 'gyur bas0 / /med par byed na kun gyis ci bya ma yongs dge ba legs par gyis/ /e ma'o skyes bu rmongs rnams 'di na bde 'gror skyes pa bzang zhes grags/ /rga dang 'chi dang na rnams kyis kyang 'di la brtse ba med par grags/ /gzhan las skyes pa'i sdug bsngal brgya phrag 'di dag skyes ④pa nyid byed de/ /rang gis bskyed nas bu ni gsod pa'i don du de dag la stod ④byed/ /sha ma'i rkyal par shin tu bsdams shing dbugs ma phyin par nyam ngar gnas/ /mi gtsang khron par lto ba'i me yi tsha ba mi bzad ⑨pas bsregs nas/ /smra mi nus shing thos min bskyong ba'i ⑩dbang med nyal ba ma yin par/ /mi ni mngal du zla bcu nye ba'i bar du sdug bsngal nyams myong 'gyur/ /dka' ba dag gis byung nas nyi ma'i zer rnos mod la sreg ⑪pa dang / /tshad pa'i rlung gis bud shing sbrang bu mchu sbrang dag gis gnod pa dang / /nye du dgra bo dag gis lte ba bcad ⑫pas na tsha 96—527

skyed byed dang ①/ /mngal na gnas kyang bla yi snang ba dag tu gnas pa 'di mi rung / /lus kyi bya ba lag pa dag dang rkang pa bskyod pa tsam du zad/ /smra ba'i yul gyur thams cad la yang khyad par med par du bar byed/ /nyal ba'i tshe na gan rkyal gnas pas nyin dang mtshan mo 'da' bar byed/ /sa stengs dag na khu 'jo ②ba ltar sdug bsngal nyam thag ngas ma mthong / /'dug pa dag las ldang bar mi nus nyal dang 'greng dang 'gro bar bskyod mi nus/ /'dug ste gnas dang lus mi brtan pas gom gcig 'gro bar nus ma yin/ /tshig gis ①rang don bstan par mi nus byed 'khrul lus dang ngag la ni/ /dbang byar med par srog 'dzin byed pas kyi hud na tshod 'das sdug bsngal/ /mngal na sdug bsngal mang po yun rings rjes myong rjogyur kyang mi mthong la/ /'chi ba'i dus kyi ⑤gnas skabs skye bo 'dris pa'i mig gi yul ma yin/ /dregs ldan dga' ༷bas bcom pa tshogs sar skyes pa bud med brgya phrag gis⑦/ /mig ni 'be+en du gyur pa mda' char 'bab pas nyam thag lta bu yin/ /skom pas kha skams ⑧tshe na bsil zhing dri zhim chu ni 'thung ba dang / /bkres pas nyam thag pa na 'bras chan sha dang bcas pa za ba dang / /'dod chags me 'bar gyis gdungs tshe na chung ma dam du 'khyud nas byed pa yi⑨/ /nad sel byed pa bde ba yin zhes skye bo phyin ci log par 'gyur⑩/ /skyes bu zas nyung dag gis ring gyur zas mang dag la mngon dga' bas/ /dbugs mi thon cing sdug bsngal gyur la mi mthun zas kyis 'chi bar byed/ /zas mi 'ju bas nad skyed ⑩'gyur zhing zhu bas bkres pa nyid du 'gyur/ /kye ma zas zos gyur na sdug bsngal mi skyed ⑫skabs de yod ma yin/ /shing lag dag ni rab tu 'bar ba'i skabs su rnge las tha dad min//96—528

de ni 'jig rten dag gis kyi hud me zhes zer zhing yongs su spong / /de bzhin lus la sdug bsngal shin tu chen po nyams myong gnas skabs su/ /'di ni snyug bsngal lus 'di myong ①zhes khyad par med la 'jug mi byed/ /mi gtsang snom zhing srin bu'i tshogs ni brgya yis yongs su bskor gyur la/ / slad sa'i drod kyi dugs ②kyis mtshungs pa med pa'i sdug bsngal nyams myong zhing / /snang ba med pa'i btson snera'i khyem nang lta bu'i ma yi lto na gnas/ /de bskyed pa na de yang de ltar min nam ci phyir khyod rig byed/ /ji ltar khyi dag rus skam dusra la ro med pa la brkam ⑤par 'cha'/ /rang gi kha chu khrag gis gos la rnyi zhing zhim pa yin snyam sems/ /de bzhin lus zhes bya ba shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i tshogs de la/ /rmongs rnams rang gi 0rtog pas yon tan brgya yis sgo btags dga' bar byed/ /sha rgyas mtho zhing zlum la nu ma'i blo yis kun nas 'khyud pa dang / /kha ni kha chus gang ba chang bcas snod ltar 'thung bar byed pa dang / /reg pa'i sred pas mi gtsang rlan pa'i ⑦lam la chags pas na/ /'gro ba rmongs pa chen pos ldongs pa dag la yid du mi 'ong ci zhig yod/ /'khru bas dri mas sbags dang dri zhim skud pas mi ro'i dri 'dra dang / /so rtsi 'cha' la brtson ⑧par byed pas kha ni dri mi zhim pa nyid/ /gos kyis kun nas dkris pas shin tu mi sdug yin par 'di byed de/ /lus 'di ⑨'jigs su rung bas bdag ni ⑩gzhon nu ma la smra zhing rton/ /yid brtan rung las nyan par mi byed bdag nyid kyis kyang rtog ⑩med pas/ /khyed la rna ba dang ni snying med pa zhes bya bar shin tu rigs/ /zlon ⑫byed 'jigs su rung zhing mi sdug lus kyi dri ni ma tshor ba/ /khyed la 'gro ba sna med yin zhes kyang ni ci yi phyir mi smra/ /shin tu gtsang ba'i 96—529

dar dang dri zhim me tog sbrang rtsi gur kum la/ /de dang de ni gang du reg na skad cig gis ni mi gtsang 'gyur/ /rma yi sgo dgu dag nas mi gtsang dri nga'i ljan ljin ①'dzag 'gyur gang / /de la khyed ni skal bzang yin zhes 'dir ni zlom sems ji ltar byed/ /phung po lnga po 'di la yul dang yul can nyid du brtags nas ni/ /bdag dang bdag gir ②med pa dag la nga dang nga yi nges byas pa/ /'jig rten rmongs pa 'di ni 'jig rten skom rmis gdungs pa mya ngam ①du/ /smig rgyu'i chu yi chu bur las byung snod du 'thung snyam sems dang mtshungs/ /bdag ni rtag ⑦pa yin zhing bde dang sdug bsngal nyams su myong 'gyur la/ /lus kyi yul ni gcig pu dag la bdag gi ⑤zhes blo bskyed dhidu zad/ /bu dang chung ma phyugs ⑦rnams zhes bya 'di dag las gzhan gyis bskyed pa/ /de la ji ltar bdag gi zhes rtsi 'dir ni gti mug stobs can yin/ /de ni rgyu las byung zhing gnas pa'ang rang gi rkyen gyi ⑧dbang las byung / /dus kyis rgas shing tshe dang bsod nams zad la sogs pas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /skye la dbang byar ma yin rgas la ⑨ma yin shi la dbang med na/ /bdag gi chung ma zhes smra ngo tsha bar ni ji ltar de ma gyur/ /gang zhig rtag tu rang dbang gyur dang gang zhig bde ba nyid gyur pa/ /gang zhig skad cig tsam yang 'dor mi 'gyur ba de ni bdag gir bshad—/ /lus 'di dbang byar med cing sdug bsngal dag kyang skyo bar 'dor gyur na/ /'di la rim pa gang zhig mthong na 'di la gang zhig mngon zhen 'gyur//mi rtag pa la rtag snyam sems la sdug bsngal ba la bder ⑫mngon dga'/ /mi gtsang lus la gtsang ba nyid du shas cher zhen par byed pa dang / /bdag med pa la bdag ces 'dzin pa'i rdul rnams rnam par bsal ⑪nas ni/ /skye med 96—530

'gag med 'chi ba med cing rtag pa'i gnas ni 'bad pas mngon du gyis/ /phyin ci log bzhi 'gag ①par byed pa'i gtam/ /'di byas pa las bdag gis dge bsags pa/ /gang yod des ni 'gro gsum ma lus pa/ /phyin ci log bzhi las ni yid grol shog /phyin ci log bzhi spang ba'i gtam slob dpon ma ti ④tsi tras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po burtse bha dra ①dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ /bsdur mchan/525 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉la phyin ci log bzhi spang ba'i gtam bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/526 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tam/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyug ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sa/ ④〈〈pe 〉ra tud/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉the / rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stab/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharnyings/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bas ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉maragyur ba'i mi nyams/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉ra ga ⑫〈〈snar 〉ra / ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rig ⑫〈〈snar 〉ra pa/④〈〈pe 〉skadakrol mis bskor/ 〈〈snar 〉skadakrol mis skor/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉khyod/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na/527 ①〈〈snar 〉stabad/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyur/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra klag 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nas/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉steng / rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyur pas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagatod/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zad/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra skyod pa'i/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasregs/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sto ba bcas/528 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / ②〈〈pe 〉〉steng dag na khu ljo/ 〈〈snar 〉〉steng dang na khu ljo/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉mongs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉kyis/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 / ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(gi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bskams/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyur/ ⑪⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra skyed/529 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanan/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga da pa'i drod kyi gdugs/ ①〈〈snar 〉ra rtson/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma mas/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabaskam/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉steg pas gcing brlan pa yi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra na/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nyid/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉96byed531

rtogs/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tren/53༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdon shing /②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngan/rjo〈〈snar 〉〉rtog ⑤〈〈pe 〉stagos/du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phyug ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bde/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉sngagasal/521 ①〈〈co 〉〉dgag ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi'i tri/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉tra/bsdur 'bras re'u migaskyes rarngams/ (2༷)96wa 532

400༄ga /rtsod pa'i dus kyi gtam/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ka lī yu ka pa ri ka sdethā/ bod skad du/rtsod pa'i dus kyi gtam/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshul khrims las nyams thos pa'i nor bral 'dod pas 'di nyid cung zad mchod par byed/ /nyes med tshul khrims ldan la yon tan ro la rgyab phyogs zhe sdang cung zad nyes pa rgod④/ /rab byung rnams la khyem pas las bsgo de nas rab byung des kyang khyim pa mgu bar byed/ /ci spyad 'gro ba 'dir ni 'gro ba'i khyem du ma lus dus kyi snyigs ma zhugs pa yin/ /da ltar legs par spyod pa'i ④skye bo ngo tsha sdig pa can bsngags dga' bar 'gyur/ /slob dpon nor rnams mchog tu sems pas ⑤'joms phyir slob ma rnams ni zhum par gnas//'di na byis pa'i nye du'i 'khrul 'khor byis bcings pa ni sun 'byen byed pa bzhin—/ /da ltar rtsod pa'i dus na 'jig rten rnams la g.yo sgyu'i mtshon drag 96—533

stobs dang ldan/ /bcud rnams sas 'thung dngos rnams stobs chung lha rnams char ni 'bebs mi byed/ /rlung rnams rab tu drag ldang lo tog rnams ni mi smin skye mi 'gyur/ /skyes la ser 'bab sa rnams rtsod pa'i dus kyis ①dbang sgyur 'bras bu med/ /dngos rnams mthu med dgos pa sgrub rnams nyams pa thob la brtag /'gro la nad 'phel sa ni ④de dag skye bo rnams kyis stongs①/ /ljon pa'i nags tshal skom ④pas yal ga'i lag pa gyen du 'greng byed de/ /rtsod pa'i dus kyis bcom byas ⑤bzang po'i dus nub ri bo cho nges 'debs/ /yul bzang chags pa rnam rjospangs sa rnams su ni dus bzang yongs su zad/ /yon tan mkhas la mi bkur nor ldan rnams la ⑦mchod bya min par mchod/ /skye rmongs mchod byed gshin rjes 'jig rten srug bsngal des khrid gang gis bzlog /tshul khrims 'chal pa stobs ldan tshul khrims ldan pa bsnyigs shing tshar gcod byed//sdig pa dga' ba'i stobs ldan g.yon can rnams kyis dam chos bsnub par 'gyur//gang zhig sdom pa la gnas brtan pa'i mchog la 'jug par byed pa nyung / /the tshom yod min drang srong bstan pa ring po mi thogs nub ⑧par 'gyur/ /g.yul 'gyed rtsod pa du mas gos ltar sa g.yogs lo tog skyes la 'dod mi 'byung / /rlung rnams mi bzad ldang zhing de bzhin skye bo dam pa yang dag mchod mi byed/ /rgyal po dgra dang rkun ma'i 'jigs pas mi dag bag phebs nor rnams longs mi spyodaske/ /da ltar skye bo sdug bsngal bcas 'tsho 'gro ba rnams la 'jigs pa 'byung / /gang zhig dus su char med gang du lam zhugs ser ba mi mthun du ma 'babaske/ /gang zhig ba rnams 'o ma mi 'byung dus rnams 'khrugs shing sa las 'bru mi skye/ /sman rnams gang yin nus med de bzhin khyad par rnams ni rab tu 96—534

nyams—/ /yid ni nges bcom chos min rtsod pas dngos po 'di rnams ①nyes dang bcas/ /rtsod pa'i dus 'dir chos spangs mi bzad pa la yang dag zhugs pas na/ /gang du dbang pos char phab spyon shing yal ga dag las me tog 'bras bu cung zad snang / /sa gzhi rlan khrupa dang bcas sa rnams gang yin pa las lo tog smin gyur pa/ /de kun tshul khrims brtul zhugs yang dag sdom ldan chos dang ldan pa'i mthu/ /dus rnams 'khrul zhing sa la bcud rnams nub 'gyur ①nyi zla log par rgyu/ /chung ma khyo la gcugs ④pas 'byel pa'i sems med dman pa rnams ni mthon por 'gyur/ /rgyal po chos spangs nor rnams mchog tu don gnyer bu rnams pha la sdang / /kyi hud sdug bsngal rtsod pa'i dus ni nyer gnas bsod nams gnyer ba nags su song / /chos dang rab byung dka' thub rnams 'bros bde ba rnams ni ring du song bar gyur/ /sa rnams 'bras bu nyung zhing rgyal po 'khrug byed mtshon gyis ⑤rgyal byed rnam par gnon/ /'jig rten bud med la dad bud med kyang g.yem bram ze rnams ni 'dod chen bcas/ /legs pa rnams nub skye ④ngan stobs ldan du ma rtsod pa'i dus su bzang po yi/ /dus song bde ba rnams 'das dus der sbyor ba'i skyes bu rnams kyang 'das/ /'dir yang dus mtha' de rnams mun bcas phug bzhin shes ma yin/ /legs spyad brgya phrag dri yis bsgos pa yi⑦/ /skal ldan nub cing dus ni 'das par 'gyur⑧ske/ /pad gzhon rtsa ba'i skud pa bzhin/ /dkar po'i chos rnams phra bar 'gyur/ /blo ldan skyes bu gtam mkhas dri mas rgod⑨/ /'gro 'di dga' med dga' ston zin pa bzhin/ /bdag nyid chen po 'di ni yang dag 'gags//gang na yon tan rnams kyi stobs phra la/ /yon tan la bdud 'bab pas gcod 96—535

byed cing / /skye bo smra ba la brten 'tsho bar byed/ /rtsod pa'i dus kyi gtam slob dpon ma ti tsi tras ①mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/532 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉75 rtsod dus gtam mā ti tsi tras mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉tā/ ni〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dgod/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉spyod pa yi/ 〈〈snar 〉gsung ba yi/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpas/524 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉7)/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉de dang / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉btang / du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bskams/⑤〈〈pe 〉7) bcom byas pa/ 〈〈snar 〉7) bcom byas/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnams/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stani/⑧〈〈pe 〉〉dus/525 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kun/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlan/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'ur/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bcugs/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ du〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉stanas/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉yir/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgod/536 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ga'i tri tsi tas/bsdur 'bras re'u migaskyes rabs/ (21)96wa 536

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bi be ka ka thā/ bod skad du/ dben pa'i gtam/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dka' thub rnyed pa'i bde ba 'dod rnams kyis/ /'chol bar ⑧spyod pa rnams ni mthong gyur pasne/ /rab tu dben pa yang dag bsten rjopa yi/ /dge slong 'di skad tshig tu brjod pas smra/ /phongs pa spang phyir de bzhin gshegs pa yis/ /rab bsngags ⑤zhi ba'i dbang bskur nyer blangs nas/ /dka' thub khyim dang 'dris pas rab chags pa'i/ /phongs nyid rgal dka' byeng ba rjoji lta bur/ /'phags pa 'gran med shing drung gnas nas ni/ /'gro ba ⑦skye dang 'gag pa mthong bas na/ /zhi ba'i bde ba yongs smin tshe dge ba/ /mi las shin tu 'phags pa thob par 'gyur/ /sems kyi rnam par 'ching ba gnyen po yi/ /stobs kyis bsal ⑧bas skye bral nags dag tu/ /rnal 'byor 96—537

nyer zhi'i ①bdud rtsis tshim gyur pas/ /bde bar gnyid log pa dang sad par 'gyur / /mtshan mo zla ba'i snang dang rab gsal ba'i/ /skar ma'i me tog bkram par nyer mchod nas/ /dgon par brten pa'i yid ni nges zhi ba'i/ /lhag par dga' ba dag ni skye bar 'gyur/ /gang du dge slong dben pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ /kha na ma tho med pa zhi 'gyur bde/ /gang du yo byad yang dag bsten ②chags pas/ /sems ni sna tshogs phongs pas gdungs par 'gyur①/ /ji ltar chu shing sgyug ma 'od ma dag /'bras bu 'byin nas rang nyid 'jig pa ston—/ /de bzhin dka' thub khyem las rnam grol nas/ /bdag nyid zil gyis gnon la chags mthong 'gyur/ /sa yi rdul gyes gos pa'i ri dwags dag /rtswa budang 'dab nas tsam zhig sgrub byed ltar/ /sems ni dben par gzhol ba ⑤'dod 'gyur gyi/ /gling bzhi'i phun tshogs rgya chen dag la'ang min/ /shing drung 'bab chu bstan dupa'i dka' thub dag /yongs su 'dzin pa dag ni rnam ⑦spangs nas/ /rang sems tsam dang rab tu 'byel pa yi/ /bde 'byung gang de rgyal po rnams la med/ /ljon shing sngon po'i rtse mo rlung dag gis/ /rnam g.yo phra la stoms pa'i char 'bab pa'i/ /mi g.yo rnam brtags ⑧ri yi sul gnas ni//dge slong mtshan mo dge ⑨ba skyed par byed/ /rnyog can 'dod la 'dris pas 'phos ⑩pa yi/ /bdag bsnyen pa yi chags spangs ltos med cing / /skye bral nags gang yin par dga' bya yi/ /dge slong gyur nas don med 'gyur mi bya/ /dge slong rtags ni bdag nyid gnod med par/ /nyer blangs gang zhig sgrub par mi byed cing / /dman la yongs su 'dzin pa'i 'dam bying ba/ /de ni 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten slu byed yin/ /chu dang rdo khya rtsa ba med pa yi/ /sa dbang 96—538

'dzegs nas mi bzad yang ①dag tu/ /rtog dang ldan pas shi ba bzod bya yi/ /bslab pa yongs su nyams pas 'jug mi bya/ /rgya mtsho rnam par 'khrugs pa'i rlabs tshogs su/ /rin chen khur gyis gru ②dag nub pa bzhin/ /khyim dang 'dris pa'i rnyed chags khur dag gis/ /gang dag mchog brten snergya chen snub par byed/ /nags na brten ④pa'i zhi ba'i ri dwags ni/ /gzhon nu ma yi 'gro bas dkrugs mtshon pa/ /gnyen po ji bzhin bdag nyid zhi 'dod rnams/ /sdom can rab tu dben nyid yang dag rtsom/ /yul gyi ro yi ⑤dug gis nyer gdung dublo can dag /chags pa ⑦nyung ngu dag gis gdung gyur ⑧na/ /de dag yongs su sgong la rtsod ⑨med pa'i/ /dka' thub kyi hud e ma'o rab nyams 'gyur—/ /sdom can rkang pas 'gro zhing 'jog pa ltar/ /de ltar 'dris pa ⑫'dod pa 'phel 'gyur te/ /rang rlabs chab ngogs mngon brdabs 'jigs rung bas/ /sprin chen char gyis ya mu na bzhin no/ /dka' thub ji ltar dman pa dag la yang / /'dod lha'i dbang gis rjes su zhugs gyur pa/ /de ltar rang lag gis drang phun sum tshogs/ /rgyal chen khyem la khyem pa chags pa medarka/ /rang gi khyem dang gdong dag mchi 'dzag pas⑩/ /brlan pa'i gnyen dag spangs par gyur nas ni/ /dman pa gzhan gyi khyem la chags pa yi/ /rab byung 'di la shin tu ngo tsha med/ /thar pa 'dod gang rang khyem spangs nas ni//mi shes gzhan gyi khyim dag 'dod byed pa/ /rgya mtsho rnam par 'khrugs pa'i rlabs tshogs las/ /bdag nyid rgal ⑫nas glang rjes byeng dang mtshungs/ /sdig pa spong byed de bzhin gshegs pa yis/ /gnang ba'i sgrub ⑫pa dag gis 'di brtags gang / /dman pa'i nor la 'dod pa'i sred pa yis/ /gzhan 96—539

khyem la chags dri ma can du 'gyur/ /chu bo ni lu ①tsha yi me tog lhung ba'i dum ①bus mtha' mar bris/ /bye ma dkar po'i ngogs dang ngang pa ka dam pa dag gnas—/ /nags kyi glang chen khyu dag rtse bas tha dad 'thor rlabs can/ /dgon gnas brtul zhugs can la dga' ba rab tu skyed ①par byed/ /srid pa'i longs spyod don du gnyer ba'i yi dwags rnams bsal nas/ /ma brtsams ④yid 'ong bde ba bsten ⑤pa rnams kyi gnas skabs ni/ /pad+ma kha bye bzhin du dka' thub rang gi grags pa yis/ /'jig rten yongs su dga' ba rab skyed rjokun du dpe las 'das/ /dka' thub ri dang nye ba'i shing rtsa rab yangs dang 'brel bar/ /gnas pa'i tshom bu mi snyoms lhod pa'i srubs ⑦bar la chags pa'i//ba mo'i dum bus ⑧gos pa tho rangs nyi ma'i 'od zer gyes/ /lag pa dag gis nyul ba bzhin du rnam par skems par byed/ /khang ⑨stong shing drung rlung ni rgyu gyur kha ba'i tshogs chen 'bab/ /mdangs zad rab rtsub lo ma dag gis gdu bu bzhin bskor ba'i/ /'dod pa kun spangs shes rab rno ba'i brtul zhugs can dag la/ /mtshan mo rnam par skyo ba dag ni skyed par zad mi byed/ /shing gi lo ma'i tha ma la chags ba mo'i ⑩chu dag gi⑪/ /dum bu nyi ma 'char tshe mdog ⑫nor bu dang 'dra/ /thigs ⑫pa dag ni shing drung gnas pa'i dge slong la/ /'gro ba'i skye dang 'jig pa ji bzhin rab tu ston par byed/ /rab zhi'i bde ro shes pas 'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal 'byor kyang / /yongs su dpyad ⑫pas rnyings pa'i me tog phreng bzhin rnam spangs nas/ /lang tsho rang bzhin gyis g.yo ngang tshul can dag yol byas te/ /dgon par ri dwags 'drar 'chi zhi ba'i sems ni brtan ⑫par bya/ /'dod pa la 'jen phyin ci log pa'i sems la ku mu ta'i/ /96—540

dum bu ltar dkar mi thod so dang 'brel pas nyer dgod dang / /rlung gis bud ①pa'i ro bsregs dze+eme yis nye 'khor shing bsregs pa'i/ /dur khrod dka' thub gcig pu la ni mtshan mo dga' ba ①skyed par byed/ /ljon shing tshogs dang rgya ches ri yi rtsa ba sngor gyur cing / /rdo bas khyab dang bsil la rab dang ba yi chu 'dzag 'bab/ /rma bya rab dga' sgra yis khyab pa'i ri sul nang du ni/ /khyem du 'chi ba'i skyo ba'i sems ni rab tu dga' bar byed/ /'gro ba'i don ma byas pa'i 'chi bar 'gyur ba khyem dag la/ /dga' ba dag la ④dben pa mchog la slob byed sems can mchog /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems ni rnyed gyur pha rol tshogs 'thob pa/ /srid pa'i dug gi ⑤sdong po'i rtsa ba brtan po 'byen par byed//nags tshig pa yi bya dang 'dra bar sdug bsngal brgya yi gzhir gyur pa'i/ /khyem gang yin pa yongs su spangs nas nags su 'gro byed pa/ /des ni srid pa'i gnyid rab bsal ba 'gro ba kun gyi rjomagon/ /sangs rgyas rab tu mnyes par byed pa yin zhes de skad grags/ /margad ⑦sngon po dang 'dra ṣ+pe'u gseng ⑧tshogs dag ni/ /shing rtsa nye bar bkod dang yal ga me tog gis bskor ba'i/ /zhi ba'i nags mtha' kye ma'o dge slong mchog gis spong ⑨byed pa/ /gsad phyir rngon pa'i glu yis drangs par gyur pa'i ri dwags mtshungs/ /'phags pa'i bzhed pa bde bar gshegs pa'i lam gyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /nags dang 'dra bar khyim gyi ⑩rang gi don dag sgrub byed kyang / /rnam par 'tshe ba rang bzhin gyis med nags ni dben pa yis/ /sems kyi ⑪'ching ba dag ni 'bad pa med par gcod par byed/ /'dod chags gang dag de la dgos par 'gyur bas kun 'phel zhing / /legs spyad thub pa'i bstan pa dag kyang nyams byas nas/ /me 96—541

dpung rab tu 'bar ba rgal dka'i khongs ①ni mthar thug pa'i/ /ngan song dag tu dge slong bde chung la chags 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyes pa ma lus gdung ba zad byed sangs rgyas pa'i/ /legs par bshad pa khas blangs nas ni ngan 'gror ngan 'byen pa/ /ut+pal sngon po'i snying po'i dri mchog dag dang chu dum bu/ /sar la bsel ldan rlung gis ④de dag ji ltar tshim par 'gyur/ /sa ra sa yi sgra ni rang bzhin snyan pa'i glu dbyangs dag /sdog pa med par sgrogs par gyur pas mchog ①rnams khyab gyur pas/ /brtul zhugs can gyis ④'gro dang gnas pa dag las dub skyes dang / /lus lhod gyur pa'i mtshan gyi gung thun gnyid dag sad par byed/ /rang gi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis spras yongs su gnas pa yis/ /zla ba'i 'od zer tshogs kyi dpal 'joms shin tu zil gnon pas—/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba nyer bsags skal ⑤ldan 'jig rten la gzigs shing / /rang byung 'phags pa mchog ni dgon pa de yang sten rjopar mdzad/ /ci ste gang zhig nang gi dgra las dze+enges rgyal bya ba byas pa yi/ /ston pa 'jig rten mtha' gzigs de yang nags dag sten ⑧mdzad na/ /yang dag mi rtogs ⑨skye bo mi gtsang 'dam du byeng gyur pa'i/ /sdom can zhi 'dod bde gshegs rjes su ci phyir 'jug mi byed/ /bdag tu log par 'dzin par gyur pas nyin dang mtshan//srin bus ji bzhin rnam rtog snyig can dag gis zos pas na/ /nyon mongs rnag gis nyer gos zhi ba'i chu yi bum pa yis/ /bkrus pa bzhin du sems ni skye ba med nags bsten ⑩par gyis/ /'bras bu'i phyid kyis yal ga gug pa'i tha ma lo ma yis/ /gsal gyur lcug ma me tog kha bye'i ⑩dga' byed rgyu ⑫ldan pa'i/ /nags kyi shing ni dge slong phongs bral bsten ⑫pa la/ /mdza' bo bzhin du shin 96—542

tu dbugs ni 'byen par byed/ /zla ba shar ba kha ba 'bab pa bsgrigs ①pas 'gog 'gyur ba'i/ /dgun gyi mtshan mo dag ni rab zhi bde ba 'dod rnams kyi//rnal 'byor rtswa yi stan la dga' ba dag la tho rangs dag /nags kyi shing na yib pa'i bya rnams 'dra bar byed/ /shing dang nye ba'i ri yi rked du mi g.yo skyil krung bcasarka/ /me tog gis bskor rab dga'i rlung gis g.yo bar byed pa na/ /'gro gnyen srid ②gsum rnam rgyal dus na byang chub snying po yi/ /gdan la bzhugs bzhin sdom can mtshan mo rjes su sgrub par byed/ /dman pa'i 'gro ba'i sems kyis reg byas dregs pa'i chags pa dag /'dod bya don du gnyer ba rnams kyis khyad par spangs nas ni/ /'phags pas rjes chags brtan ①pa mi snang 'ching ba 'jigs pa yi/ /'dod pa lhag ma med par dga' bzhin nags su zhi bar bya/ /skye dang 'chi dang na ba'i sdug bsngal mthar ni ma byas par//srid pa'i rgya mtsho dag tu byeng 'gyur bag med ma byed cig /mthar byed kun gyi srog kyang 'phrog par byed pa gang 'di ni/ /rgyun mi chad par 'gro la sta re'i so dag 'dar bar byed/ /sa 'dzin pa yi chu bo'i tshogs dag 'bab pa lta bu ni/ /chos kun gnas pa'i rang bzhin rjes su shes nas ni/ /ro la sems ldan gzhan las dam pas legs par 'gro ba yis/ /srid la rjochags bral rab zhi dga' ba dag la brten ⑤par gyis/ /smra ba tsam ni nus su zin kyang tshig la gnas pa'ang grub med de/ /skyes bu tshig dang rjosnying por byed pa ston gyi chu bral sprin dang mtshungasaske/ /gang phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'di la sgrub pa snying po nyid—/ /de phyir de nyid la 'jug blo gros yin bzo'i tshig la mkhas/ /kun nas nyon mongs dgra 'di yi/ /bdag nyid bran du gyur pa ste/ /de bas 96—543

bdag sems zhi byed cing / /rang nyid yongs su smra bar byed/ /dbe+en pa'i gtam slob dpon chen po sa 'tsho byin rmis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi ①mkhan po dri paṃ ka sder dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //dze+ebasdur mchan/537 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉ma dben pa'i gtam bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brten/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉sngags/ du〈〈snar 〉dbyen pa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra 'i/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasal/538 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhi'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rten/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ra/ ④〈〈co 〉ra ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thar/ rjo〈〈snar 〉thasten/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉rams/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉ra nas/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dga'/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phod/539 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagayang / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉marabru/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rtan/ du〈rtepe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sten/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadungs/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'i/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sngagadungs 'gyur/⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartson/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thas/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉marachi 'dzag par/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉rgyal/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sgrub/54༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mthus/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dus/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaskyed/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sams/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rten/ du〈〈pe 〉ma skyod/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉ra slubs/ 〈〈snar 〉ra slugs/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rab/⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skabang / ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉pa me'i/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 gyur/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra 'i/ /thig ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pad/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sten/541 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bas/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesags/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ra/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mgos/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉gyis/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma da/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉song / ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉bangs/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ye /542 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skabang / sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mgo/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phyogs/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra skal/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi mgon po de yang brten/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skal/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sten/96byed544

sngag /chos smra ba dang dam pa'i chos nyan pa la gus par bya ba'i gtam/1 ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa t+ya tresnakṛt+ya dhadz+re snyeb tsa na sad dhan+d+ra shā ba 4 ka thā/ bod skad du/ chos smra ba dang byedam pa'i chos nyan pa la gus par bya ba'i gtam/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang zhig gser btso ma dang kaṇi hūṃka dang nyi ma shar ma thag gi 'od 'bar zhing gsal bar byed pa dang / rgya cher mi phyed pa'i 'od dang /bco lnga'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad du dri ma med byung rnam par dag pa dang /tsam pa ka dang / a sho ka rab tu rgyas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya dang / in+d+ra byā la dang / rdo rje dang / ldong ros dang / pad+ma dang / glog gi 'od pas lhag pa dang / gser bzang po'i 'od dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma/ dpag tu med pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i gter bsdus pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag ni mgon du gyur pa/96byed549

bla mar gyur pa/ chos kyi rje/ spyod pa dang ldan pa/ sgu dang gsung dang thugs kyis gnod pa med par kun du spyod pa/ stobs bcu mnga' ba mi 'jigs pa bzhis bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba/ khyu mchog gi mchog /seng ge'i sgra sgogs pa/ dbang po dang / nye dbang dang / drag po dang / khyab 'jug dang /77 gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / lus srul po dang / nyi ma dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / dri za dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / sha za dang /grul bum dang / rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis mngon par bstod pa/ byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang btang snyoms kyis bsam gtan mchog gi dran pa brnyes pa/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams la lhag par mos pa/ zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched dang / zad par gyi skye mched dang / stong pa nyid dang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 3snaston pa dang / thugs rje chen pos yang dag par bsgul ba/ gser dang / dngul dang / shel dang / nor bu dang / be+e ḍūr+ya dang / rdo rje dang snye/ in+d+ra m+bi la dang / zla ba'i 'od rnams las lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rnam par gzigs dang / gtsug tor can 4dang / thams cad skyob dang / 'khor ba 'jig 5 dang / gser thub dang / 'od srungs dang / dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la sogs pas gsungs shing rjes su bstan pa 'di la/ kye dge slong 'di lta thuste/ chos bshad pa dang / chos kyi gtam la 'ga' zhig tu tshogs shing 'dug ste/ 'dug nas bya ba gnyis pa gang yang rung ba gcig gi ྅rjes su 96—550

gnas par bya ste/ chos kyi gtam bya ba'am yang na 'phags pa'i mi smra bas rjes su gnas par bya'o/ /de la 'phags pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i gtam du gyur pa dang / 'phags pa'i mi smra bar gyur pa de gnyis ni nges par legs pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin te/ phyis mi ⑫rtog pa'i phyir dang / the tshom gcod pa'i phyir nges par stobs kyis gzung ba'i phyir de skad du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal zhing 'di skad du gsungs so/ /dge slong dag gang zag gnyis po 'dis bsod nams mang po bskyed de sdig pa'i rtsa ba 'byin zhing bdud dang g.yul 'gyed par byed/ bdud kyi rgyal mtshan stol bar byed/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan sgreng khubar byed/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor 1bar byed do/ /gnyis gang zhe na/ gang gus par byas te chos 'chad pa dang / gang 'di na sngugus par byas te chos nyan pa'o/ /de bas na khyed kyis gus pas chos bshad par bya zhing bla ma rnams la gus par bya ste chos mnyan /snyepar bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni 'byung ba dkon no/ /mir skye ba ni rab tu dkon no/ /dal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ni dkon no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la dad pa ni dkon no/ /de bas na 'khor ba'i nyes pa la kun du brtags thupa la gus par byas te chos mnyan par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'dir brjod par bya ste/ nges par dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur zhing chos kyi snang ba dang bral bar 'gyur/ ye shes kyi snang ba rab tu nub par 'gyur la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad par mi 'gyur te/ rab tu 'jig ⑦pa dang bcas pa'i dus nye bar gnas shing / chos dang mi ldan pa'i sems can rnams dang lhan cig 'grogs par 'gyur bar shes par byas nas gus par byas te chos mnyan 96—551

par bya'o/ /cung zad na ⑨chos kyi gru ni zhig par 'gyur/ ye shes kyi ri ni rdib par 'gyur/ chos kyi nyi ma ni nub par 'gyur/ chos kyi chu bo ni skam par 'gyur/ chos kyi gtam gyes ni dbe+en par 'gyur/ dbang po'i rtod thag ni chad par 'gyur/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi me tog ni skam par 'gyur/gsung rab kyi rgya mtsho ni bo bar 'gyur/ dran pa'i lcag ni chag par 'gyur/rnal 'byor gyi kyedabang phyug ni yongs su mya ngan las 'das/ nyon mongs pa'i chom rkun ni stobs dang ldan par 'gyur la/ ring por mi thogs par yang dag pa'i spang leb bshig pas bcos legs byas pa/ dran pa'i gru skya bas yongs su bsrung ba/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang ba dan legs par btsugs pa/ting nge 'dzin gyi zhal ce thubs rtsod pa yongs su spyong chob/ dad pa'i lam brgyags 5dang ldan pa/ brtse ba'i btung chu'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ dbang po dang stobs dang byang chub kyi lam gyi ④rin po ches yongs su bkang 3ba dang /slob pa dang mi slob pa'i tshogs yongs su rgyu ba/ chos smra ba'i bya bas ḍūrab tu sad par byed pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'bad pas rab tu 'phel zhing spogs phyin pa/ dam pa'i chos kyi gtam gyis bcos pa'i rgya mtsho dba' nyu )rlabs kyi shugs kyis bskyod pa/ dam pa'i chos kyi gru thams cad kyi thams cad du ⑪nub par 'gyur ro zhes shes par byas la/ sems can rnams kyi ⑫khong du chud par bya ba la 'bad pas dam pa'i chos kyi tshogs nub pas phyis yid la gcags pa med par bya ste/ 'jig rten ma rig pas mig long ba/ ser sna'i dgab pas g.yogs pa/ phyogs dang mtshams la rtag pa dang / chad par rnam par lta ba/skye ba dang rga ba dang na ba dang 'chi ba dang / sdug bsngal gyis kun du gdungs 96—552

pa / 'chi ba'i g.yang sar lhung ba/ 'khor ba'i rtod thag gis kun du brtod pa—/ gshin rje'i pho nyas skrag pa/ bya ba ngan pa la chags pa'i blo dang ldan pa/phan tshun rtsod pas g.yengs pa'i sems can rnams phyin chad nyuyid la gcags par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bas na 'khor ba'i nyes pa spang bar 'dod pa dang /bdud kyi spyod yul spang bar 'dod pa dang / phung bo'i khur dor bar 'dod pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i shing gcad snyepar 'dod pa dang / ye shes kyi rdo rje 'chang bar 'dod pa dang / 'khor ba'i 'khor lo phye mar brlag par 'dod pa dang / ser sna'i rgya mtsho skam par 'dod pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho dbo bar bye'adod pa dang / khams gsum gyi tsher ma rim kyis shin tu dkrugs 4par 'dod pa dang / nyon mongs spangs pa'i 'phags pa'i gang zag gi tshogs thob par 'dod pa dang / ye shes kyi mig yongs su sbyong chobar 'dod pa dang /mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur bar 'dod pa dang / 'khor ba'i 'brog las rgal bar 'dod pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam nas 'gro bar 'dod pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'jug par 'dod pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i tsha bas gdungs pa'i sneyid tshim par byed par 'dod pa rnams kyis gus par bya ba dang / dam pa'i chos kyi chus dbang bsgur ba la 'bad par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ brjod par bya ste/ dam pa'i chos thob khyapas sor mo'i phreng ba ma gsod pa las log par gyur pa dang / gnod sbyin 'brog gnas mi rnams gsod pa las log par gyur pa dang / klu'i rgyal po sog ma med lo tog 'joms par byed pa dang / gnod sbyin mo 'phrog ma srog chags brgya phrag du ma gsod pa las log par gyur pa dang / gnod sbyin ba spu khab dug gis rdeg par byed cing 96—553

gsod pa dang / rgya mtsho na gnas pa'i nya ti ming gi la tshong pa stong phrag du ma gsod par byed pa dang / sbal pa dud 'gro log par ltung ba'i 'jigs pa dang /zla ba sgra gcan gyi 'jigs pa dang / nyi ma lha ma yin gyi 'jigs pa dang /brgya byin ngan song gi 7sna'ajigs pa dang / tshangs pa rtag par lta ba las dang /rtag tu 'tsho ba rtag tu lta ldub las kyang / gcer bu pa'i bu log par rngubya ba la mngon par spyor ba'i sngulas dang / bram ze grags pa'i rigs mngon par zhen pa dam pa'i chos thos pa las zhelog go/ /de dag la sogs pa gzhan dag tu ma thar pa'i skom gyis gdungs shing srid pa'i yal ga gcod par 'dod pa dang /ma rig pa'i sbubs dral bar 'dod pa dang / shes rab kyi snang bas lta kyebar 'dod pa dang / 'khor ba'i chu bo rgal kyebar 'dod pa dang / de dag gi 8 dam pa'i chos thos pas 'gro ba lnga'i 'khor bar 'gro ba las rab tu 'grol kyebar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na gus par byas te dam pa'i chos 'bad pas mnyan par bya'o / /yang 'di skad du/ mkhas pas nad la sman pa bzhin/ /thog mar dam pa bsten par bya/ /nad sos bya phyir 'bad pa yis/ /sman ni sman pa la nyan ltar/ /dam pa'i chos ni mnyan par bya/ /blo dang ldan pa'i skyes bu yis/ /sman de rnams ni thos nas su/ /gus pas sten mepar byed pa ltar/ /de bzhin byas pas 'chi med 'grub/ /bdud rtsi de ni 'thung ba yis/ /mchog ni thob par byed /1pa yin/ /chos smra ba dang dam pa'i chos mnyan pa la gus par bya ba'i gtam slob dpon sa 'tsho byin shārdugyis mdzad pa sdogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po gnas brtan a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang / lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur ba'o// //96—554
