༄ga /bshes pa'i spring yig①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ su z-i da le kha/ bod skad du/ bshes pa'i spring ②yig /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo yon tan rang bzhin dge 'os bdag gis ni/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung bsnyad las byung ba'i/ /bsod nams 'dun slad 'phags pa'i dbyangs 'di dag /cung zad cig bsdebs khyod ⑦kyis gsan pa'i rigs/ /ji ltar bde gshegs sku gzugs shing las kyang / /bgyes pa ci 'dra'ang rung ste mkhas pas mchod/ /de bzhin bdag gi snyan ngag 'di ngan yang / /dam chos brjod la brten slad smad mi bgyi④/ /thub pa chen po'i bka' ni sman ⑤dgu zhig /khyod kyi dhithugs su lta yang chud mod kyi/ /rdo thal las bgyis ⑦dgung zla'i 'od kyis ni/ /ches dkar nyid du ci ste mi bgyid ⑧lags/ /rgyal bas sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /gtong dang tshul khrims lha rjes dran pa drug /rab tu bka' 96byed669

stsal de dag so so yi/ /yon tan tshogs kyis rjes su dran par bgyi/ /dge ba'i las lam bcu po lus dang ni/ /ngag dang yid kyis rtag tu bsten ①bgyi zhing / /chang rnams las ldog de bzhin dge ba yi/ /'tsho ba la yang mngon par dgyes par mdzod/ /longs spyod g.yo ba snying po med mkhyen nas/ dge slong bram ze bkren dang bshes rnams la/ /sbyin pa tshul bzhin stsal ①bgyi pha rol du/ /sbyin las gzhan pa'i gnyen mchog ma mchis so/ /khyod kyi snetshul khrims ma nyams mod mi dma'/ /ma 'dres ma sbags ④pa dag bsten ⑤par mdzod//khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs—/ /sbyin dang tshul khyems bzod brtson bsam gtan dang / /de bzhin shes rab gzhal med pha rol phyin/ /'di dag rgyas mdzod srid pa'i rgya mtsho yi/ /pha rol phyin pa rgyal ba'i dbang po mdzod/ /gang la pha dang ma dag mchod byed pa'i/ /rigs de tshangs bcas slob dpon bcas pa'ang lags/ /de dag la mchod grags par 'gyur ba dang / /sbad ma la yang mtho ris 'gyur ba lags—/ /'tshe dang chom rkun 'khrig pa brdzun dang ni/ /chang dang dus min zas la chags pa dang / /mal stan mtho la dga' dang glu dag dang / /gar dang phreng ba'i khyad par rnams spong zhing / /dgra bcom tshul khrims rjes su byed pa yi/ /yan lag brgyad po 'di dag dang ldan na/ /gso sbyong 'dod spyod lha lus duyid 'ong ba/ /skyes pa bud med dag la stsol bar bgyid/ /ser sna g.yo sgyu chags dang snyom las dang / /mngon pa'i nga rgyal 'dod chags zhe sdang dang / /rigs dang gzugs dang thos pa lang tsho dang / /dbang thang che bas rgyags pa dgra bzhin gzigs/ /bag yod bdud rtsi'i gnas te bag med pa/ /'chi 96—670

ba'i gnas su thub pas bka' stsal to/ /de bas khyod kyi ①dge chos spel slad du//gus pas rtag tu bag dang bcas par mdzod/ /gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa la/ /phyi ②nas bag dang ldan par gyur te sneyang / /zla ba sprin bral lta bur rnam mdzes te/ /dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin/ /'di ltar bzod mtshungs dka' thub ma mchis pas/ / khyod kyis dhikhro ba'i go skabs dbye mi barmi/ /khro ba spangs pas phyir mi ldog pa nyid/ /'thob par 'gyur bar sangs rgyas zhal gyis bzhes/ /bdag ni 'dis spyos 'dis gtag ⑤pham par byas/ /'di yis bdag gi nor phrogs gyur te zhes/ /khon ④du 'dzin pas 'khrug long rnam ⑦bskyed de/ /khon 'dzin rnam spangs bde bar gnyid kyis log /sems can chu dang sa dang rdo ba la/ /ri mo bris pa de 'drar rig par bkyi⑧—/ /de'i nang nyon mongs can la dang po ni/ /mchog ste chos 'dod rnams la tha ma lags/ /rgyal bas snying la 'bab dang bden pa dang / /log par smra ldan skyes bu rnams kyi ⑨ni/ /sbrang rtsi me tog mi gtsang lta bu'i tshig /rnam gsum bka' stsal de las tha ma spang ⑩/ /snang nas snang ba'i mthar thug mun pa nas/ /mun pa'i mthar thug snang nas mun mthar thug /mun nas snang ba'i mthar thug gang zag ni/ /gzhi ste de dag rnams kyi dang por ⑪mdzod//mi ni a mra'i 'bras bzhin ma smin la/ /smin pa dang 'dra smin la ma smin 'dra/ /ma smin ma smin par snang smin la ni/ /m+bin par snang zhes bgyi ba 'drar rtogs mdzod—/ /gzhan gyi chung ma mi lta mthong na yang / /na tshod mthun par ma dang bu mo dang / /sring mo'i 'du shes bskyed bgyi chags gyur na/ /mi gtsang nyid du yang dag bsam par babyi/ /g.yo ba'i sems ni thos mtshungs bu lta bur//96—671

gter bzhin srog dang 'dra bar bsrung bgyi ste/ /gdug pa dug dang mtshon dang dgra bo dang / /me bzhin 'dod pa'i bde la yid 'byung mdzod/ /'dod pa rnams ni phung khrol bskyed ①pa ste/ /rgyal ba'i dbang pos kidza'i 'bras 'drar gsungs/ /de dag spang sdebagyi de yi lcags sgog gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar 'jig rten 'di dag bcings/ /gang dag dbang po drug yul rnams la ni/ /rtag tu mi brten ①g.yo dang gang dag cig④ /g.yul ngor dgra tshogs las rgyal de dag las/ /mkhas rnams dang po dpa' rab lags par 'tshal /bud med gzhon nu'i lus ni logs shig tu/ /dri nga ba dang sgo dgu dod pa dang //mi gtsang kun snod 'dra ba dgang dka' dang / /pags pas g.yogs dang rgyan yang logs shig gzigs/ /ji ltar mdze can srin bus nyen pa ni/ /bde ba'i don du me la kun bstan dukyang / /zhi bar mi 'gyur de dang 'dra bar ni/ /'dod pa rnams la chags pa'ang mdon par mdzod/ /don dam gzigs par bgyi slad dngos rnams la/ /tshul bzhin yid la bgyid dupa de goms mdzod/ /de dang 'dra bar yon tan ldan pa yi⑦/ /chos gzhan 'ga' yang mchis skepa ma lags so/ /skyes bu rigs gzugs thos dang ldan rnams kyang / /shes rab tshul khrims bral ba bkur ⑨ma lags/ /de ltas gang la yon tan 'di gnyis ldan—/ /de ni yon tan gzhan dang bral yang mchod/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa rnyed dang ma rnyed dang / /bde dang mi bde snyan dang mi snyan dang / /bstod smad ces babyi 'jig rten chos brgyad po/ /bdag gi yid yul min par mgo stoms mdzod/ /khyod kyis ⑩bram ze dge slong lha dang ni/ /mgron ⑩dang yab yum dag dang btsun mo dang / /'khor gyi slad du'ang sdig pa mi bgyi ste/ /96—672

dmyal ba'i rnam smin skal nod 'ga' ma mchis/ /sdig pa'i las rnams spyad pa 'ga' yang ni/ /de yi mod la mtshon bzhin mi gcod kyang / /'chi ba'i dus la bab na sdig pa yi/ /las kyi ①'bras bu gang lags mngon par 'gyur/ /dad dang tshul khrims thos dang gtong ba dang / /dri med ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod dang / /shes rab nor bdun lags par thub pas gsungs/ /nor gzhan phal pa don ma mchis rtogs mdzod/ /rgyan po 'gyed dang 'dus la lta ②ba dang / /le lo sdig pa'i grogs la brten pa dang / /chang dang mtshan mo rgyu ba ngan song ba/ /grags pa nyams par 'gyur ba de drug spang ①/ /nor rnams kun gyi nang na chog shes pa/ /rab mchog lags par lha mi'i ston pas gsungs//kun du chog shes mdzod cig chog mkhyen na/ /nor mi bdog kyang yang dag 'byor pa lags/ /des pa bdog mang ji ltar sdug bsngal ba/ /'dod pa chung rnams de lta ma lags te/ /klu mchog rnams la mgo bo ji snyed pa/ /de las byung ba'i sdug bsngal de snyed do/ /rang bzhin dgrar rjo'abrel gshed ma lta bu dang / khyim thab brnyas ⑤bgyid rje mo lta bu dang / /chung ngu'ang rku ba chom rkun lta bu yi/ /chung ma gsum po de dag rnam par spang / /sring mo lta bur rjes mthun gang yin dang / /mdza' mo bzhin du snying la 'bab pa dang / /ma bzhin phan par 'dod dang bran mo bzhin/ /dbang gyur gang yin rigs kyi lha bzhin bkur/ /kha zas sman dang 'dra bar rigs dupa yis/ /'dod chags zhe sdang med par bsten ⑦bgyi ste/ /rgyags phyir ma lags bsnyems pa'i phyir ma lags—/ /'tshag ⑧phyir ma lags lus gnas 'ba' zhig phyir/ /rig ⑨pa'i bdag nyid nyin par mtha' dag dang / /mtshan mo ⑩thun gyi stod smad bzlas 96—673

nas ni/ /mnal tshe'ang 'bras bu med par mi 'gyur bar/ /dran dang ldan par de dag bar du mnol/ /byams dang snying rje dag dang dga' ba dang / /btang stoms rtag tu yang dag bsgom ①mdzod cig /gong ma brnyes par ma gyur de lta na'ang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /'dod spyo dga' dang bde dang sdug bsngal dag /rnam par spangs pa'i bsam gtan bzhi po yis/ /tshangs dang 'od gsal dag dang dge rgyas dang / /'bras bu che lha rnams dang skal mnyam thob④/ /rtag dang mngon par zhen dang gnyen po med/ /yon tan gtso ldan bzhi ④las byung ba'i las/ /dge dang mi dge rnam lnga chen po ste—/ /de bas dge ba spyod la brtson par bgyi/ /lan tshwa srang 'gas dhichu ni nyung ngu zhig /ro bsgyur ⑤bgyid kyi gaṅgā'i klung min ltar/ /de bzhin sdig pa'i las ni chung ngu yang / /dge ba'i rtsa ba yang rjol mkhyen par bgyi/ /rgod dang 'gyod dang gnod sems rmugs pa dang / /gnyid dang 'dod la 'dun dang the tshom ste/ /sgrib pa lnga po 'di dag dge ba'i nor/ /'phrog ⑦pa'i chom rkun lags par mkhyen khrupar mdzod/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dag dang dran pa dang //nying 'dzin shes rab chos mchog lnga nyid de/ /'di la mngon brtson mdzod cig 'di dag ni/ /stobs dbang zhes bgyi rtse mor gyur pa'ang lags/ /na rga 'chi sdug bral dang de bzhin du/ /las ni bdag gir byas las ma 'das zhes/ /de ltar yang dang yang du sems pa ni/ /de yi gnyen po'i sgo nas rgyags mi 'gyur//gal te mtho ris thar pa mngon bzhed na/ /yang dag lta la goms pa nyid du mdzod—/ /gang zag log par lta bas legs spyad kyang / /thams cad rnam par smin pa mi bzad ldan/ /mi ni yang dag nyid du mi bde zhing / /mi rtag 96—674

bdag med mi gtsang rig par bgyi/ /dran pa nye bar ma bzhag ①rnams kyis ni//phyin ci log bzhir lta ba phung khrol sneb/ /gzugs ni bdag ma yin zhes gsungs te snyebadag /gzugs dang mi ldan ④gzugs la bdag gnas min/ /bdag la gzugs mi gnas te de bzhin du/ /phung po lhag ma bzhi yang stong rtogs bgyi/ /phung po 'dod rgyal las min dus las min/ /rang bzhin las min ngo bo nyid las min/ /dbang phyug las min rgyu med can min te/ /mi shes las dang sred ⑤las byung rig mdzod/ /tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin rang lus la/ /phyin ci log par lta dang the tshom ste/ /kun du sbyor ba 'di gsum thar pa yi/ /grong khyer sgo 'gegs lags par mkhyen par gyis/ /thar pa bdag rjol rag las 'di la ni/ /gzhan gyis grogs bgyir ci yang ma mchis pas/ /thos dang tshul khrims bsam gtan ldan pa yis⑦/ /bden pa rnam pa bzhi la 'bad par mdzod/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims lhag pa'i shes rab dang / /lhag pa'i sems la rtag tu bslab par bgyi/ /bslab pa brgya rtsa lnga bcu lhag cig ④ni/ /gsum po 'di nang yang dag 'du bar 'gyur/ /dbang phyug lus rtog ⑨dran pa bde gshegs kyis/ /bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam du nye bar bstan/ /de ni bsgrims nas mngon par bsrung bgyi ste/ /dran pa nyams pas chos kun 'jig par 'gyur/ /tshe ni gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi/ /chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na/ /dbugs rngub dbugs 'byung gnyid kyis ⑩log pa las/ /sad khom gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che/ /lus mtha' thal ba mthar skam mthar 'drul ⑪zhing / /tha mar mi gtsang snying po ma mchis pa/ /rnam par 'jig dengs myags par 'gyur ba ste/ /so sor 'gyes chos can du 96—675

mkhyen par mdzod/ /sa dang lhun po rgya mtsho nyi ma bdun/ /'bar bas bsregs ①pa'i lus can 'di dag kyang / thal balgeyang ni lus par mi 'gyur na/ /shin tu nyam chung mi lta smos ci 'tshal/ /de ltar 'di kun mi rtag bdag med de//skyabs med mgon med gnas med de slad du/ /'khor ba chu shing snying po med pa lasadze+e—/ /mi mchog khyod kyi rjothugs ni dbyung bar mdzod/ /rgya mtsho gcig gnas gnya' shing bu ga dang / /rus sbal phrad pa bas kyang dud 'gro las/ /mi nyid ches thob dka' bas mi dbang gis/ /dam chos spyod pas de 'bras mchis par mdzod/ /gang zhig gser sdod rin chen spras pa yis ngan skyugs 'phyags ⑤par bgyid pa de bas ni/ /gang zhig mi ru skyes nas sdig pa dag /bgyid pa de ni ches rab blun pa lags/ /mthun par gyur pa'i yul du gnas pa dang / /skyes bu dam pa la ni brten pa dang / /bdag nyid rjolegs smon sngon yang bsod nams bgyis⑦/ /'khor lo chen po bzhi ni khyod la mnga'/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa sketshangs par spyod/ /yongs su rdzogs pa ⑨thub pas gsungs de'i phyir/ /skyes bu dam pa bsten ⑩bgyi rgyal ba la/ /brten nas rab tu mang pos zhi ba thob/ /bog par lta ba 'dzin dang dud 'gro dang / /yi dwags nyid dang dmyal bar skye ba dang / /rgyal ba'i bka' med pa dang mtha' 'khob tu⑪/ /kla klor skye dang glen zhing lkugs pa nyid/ /tshe ring lha nyid gang yang rung bar 4)ni/ /skye ba zhes bgyi mi khom skyon brgyad po/ /de dag dang bral khom pa rnyed nas ni/ /skye ba bzlog pa'i slad du 'bad par mdzod/ /des pa 'dod pas phongs dang 'chi ba dang / /na dang rga sogs sdug bsngal du ma yi/ /'byung gnas 'khor ba la ni skyo mdzad cing / /'di yi nyes pa'i shas 96—676

kyang gsan par mdzod/ /pha ni bu nyid ma ni chung ma nyid/ /skye bo dgrar gyur pa dag bshes nyid dang / /bzlog pa nyid du mchi bas ①de slad du/ /'khor ba dag na nges pa 'ga' ma mchis/ /re res rgya mtsho bzhi bas lhag pa yi/ /'o ma 'thungs te da dung so so yi/ /skye bo'i rjes su 'brang ba'i 'khor ba pas/ /de bas chos mang nyid cig btung 'tshal lo/ /re re'i bdag nyid rus pa'i phung po ni/ /lhun po mnyam pa snyed cig 'das gyur te/ /ma yi ②thug mtha' rgya shug tshi ①gu tsam/ /ri lur rjobagrangs kyang sa yis lang mi 'gyur/ /brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas ni⑤/ /las kyi dbang gis phyir yang sa steng lhung / /'khor los sgyur pa nyid du gyur rjonas kyang / /'khor ba dag tu yang bran nyid du 'gyur/ /mtho ris bu mo'i nu ma rked pa la/ /reg pa'i bde ba yun ring myong nas slar/ /dmyal bar 'thag gcod dbang ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis⑦ / /reg pa shin tu mi bzad bsten 'tshal lo/ /rkang pa'i reg pas ṣ+pem par bde bzod pa/ /lhun po'i spo la yun ring gnas nas ni/ /slar yang me mur ro myag ⑧rgyu ba yi/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad phog snyam bgyid 'tshal lo/ /mtho ris bu mos ⑨'brongs shing dga' ba dang / /rnam par mdzes 'tshal son par rtses nas slar/ /'dab ma ral gri 'dra tshal nags rnams kyis/ /rkang lag rna ba sna gcod 'thob par 'gyur/ /dal gyis ⑩'bab pa lha yi bu mo ni/ /gdong mdzes gser gyi pad+ma lhan bzhugs ⑪nas/ /slar yang dmyal ba'i chu bo rab med par/ /tsha sgo bzod brlag chu tshan 'jug 'tshal lo/ /lha yul 'dod bde shin tu chen po dang / /tshangs nyid chags bral bde ba thob nas slar/ /mnar med me yi bud shing gyur pa yispyo/ /sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad pa bstan 96—677

'tshal lo/ /nyi ma zla ba nyid thob rang lus kyi/ /'od kyis 'jig rten mtha' dag snang byas te/ /be+er yang mun nag smag tu phyin gyur nas/ /rang gi lag pa brkyang ba'am mi mthong 'gyur/ /de ltar nongs par 'gyur 'tshal bsod nams ni/ /rnam gsum mar me'i snang ba rab bzhes shig /gcig pu nyi ma zla bas mi brdzi ①ba'i/ /mun nag mtha' yas nang du 'jug 'tshal lo sems can nyes par spyad pa spyod rnams la/ /yang sos thig nag rab tu tsha ba dang / /bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod mnar med la sogs pa'i/ /dmyal ba rnams su rtag tu sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /kha cig til bzhin 'tshir te de bzhin gzhan/ /phye ma zhib mo bzhin du phye mar rlog /kha cig sog les 'dra ste de bzhin gzhan/ /sta re mi bzad so rnon rnams kyis gshags/ /de bzhin gzhan dag khro chu bzhu ba ②yi/ /khu ba 'bar ba 'khrigs pa ldud ①par bgyid/ /kha cig lcags kyi gsal shing rab 'bar brjo/ /tsher ma can la kun du rgyud par bgyid/ /kha cig lcags kyi mche ba ldan pa'i khye/ /gtum pos dbad cing lag pa gnam du bsgreng / /dbang med gzhan dag lcags mchu rnon po dang / /sen mo mi ⑤bzad ldan pa'i khā rnams 'thog /kha cig srin bu sbur ba sna tshogs dang / /sha sbrang sbrang bu mchu rings dukhri phrag dag /reg na mi bzad rma srol cher ⑦'byin pas/ /za bar bgyid cing 'gre ldog smre sngags 'don/ /kha cig mdag me ⑧'bar ba'i tshogs su ni/ /rgyun mi 'chad par rab bsreg ⑨kha yang bgrad⑩//kha cig lcags las byas pa'i zangs chen du/ /spyi'u tshugs 'bras kyi cung 'pheng ⑩bzhin du 'tshed/ /sdig can dbugs 'byung 'gags ⑫pa tsam zhig gi/ /dus kyis bar du chod rnams dmyal ba yi/ /sdug bsngal gzhal yas thos nas rnam 96—678

stong du/ /mi 'jig ①gang lags rdo rje'i rang bzhin no/ /dmyal ba bris pa mthong dang thos pa dang / /dran dang bklags dang gzugs su bgyis rnams kyang / /'jigs pa skye bar 'gyur na mi bzad pa'i/ /rnam smin nyams su myong na smos ci 'tshal/ /bde ba kun gyi nang na sred zad pa/ /bde ba'i ④bdag por bgyid pa ji lta bar/ /de bzhin sdug bsngal kun gyi nang na ni/ /mnar med dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rab mi bzad/ /'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis/ /rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang lags pa/ /des ①ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu la'ang / /'ol yang mi bgyid ④char yang mi phod do/ /de ltar sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzad ⑤lo/ /bye ba phrag brgyar nyams su myong yang ni/ /ji srid mi dge de zad ma gyur pa/ /de srid srog dang 'bal rjobar mi 'gyur ro/ /mi dge'i 'bras 'di rnams kyi sa bon ni/ /lus ngag yid kyi ⑦nyes spyad khyod kyis ni/ /ci nas de rdul tsam yang ma mchis pa de ltar nyid kyi rtsal gyis 'bad par mdzod/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang gsod pa dang / /bcings dang brdeg ⑧sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa/ /zhi 'gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni/ /gcig la gcig za shin tu mi bzad pa/ /kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa dang ⑨/ /sha dang pags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur—/ /dbang med gzhan dag rdog pa lag pa dang / /lcags dang lcags kyu 'debs⑩pas btab ste bkol/ /yi dwags na yang 'dod pas phongs pa yis⑩//bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal rgyun chags mi 'chos pa/ /bkres skom grang dro ngal dang 'jigs pa yis/ /bskyed pa shin tu mi bzad bsten 'tshal lo/ /kha cig kha ni khab kyi mig tsam la/ /lto ba ri yi gtos tsam bkres pas nyen/ /mi gtsang 96—679

gyi nar bor ba cung zad kyang / /'tshal ba'i mthu dang ldan pa ma lags so/ /kha cig pags rus lus shing gcer bu ste①/ /ta la'i yang tog bskams pa lta bu lagasarka/ /kha cig mtshan zhing kha nas ④'bar ba ste/ /zas su 'bar ba'i khar babs bye ma 'tshal/ /smad rigs 'ga' ni rnag dang phyi sa dang / /khrag sogs mi gtsang ba yang mi rnyed de/ /phan tshun gdong du 'tshog cing mgrin pa nas—/ /lba ba byung ba smin pa'i rnag 'tshal lo/ /yi dwags rnams la sos ka'i dus su ni/ /zla ba'ang tsha la dgun ni nyi ma'ang grang / /ljon shing 'bras bu med 'gyur 'di dag gis/ /bltas pa tsam gyis klung yang bskam ④par 'gyur/ /bar chad med par sdug bsngal rten gyur pa/ /nyes par spyad pa'i las kyi zhags pa ni/ /sra bas bcings pa'i lus can kha cig lo/ /lnga stong dag dang khrir yang 'chi mi 'gyur/ /de ltar yi dwags rnams kyis sna tshogs pa'i/ /sdug bsngal ro gcig thob pa gang lags pa/ /de yi rgyu ni skye bo 'jungs dga' ba/ /ser sna 'phags min lags par sangs rgyas gsungasarjo/ /mtho ris na yang bde chen de dag gi/ /'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal nyid ni de bas che/ /de ltar bsams nas ya rabs rnams kyis ni/ /zad 'gyur mtho ris be+ed du sred mi bgyi—/ /lus kyi kha dog mi sdug 'gyur ba dang / /stan la mi dga' me tog phreng rnying dang / /gos la dri ma chags dang lus las ⑤ni/ /sngon chad sked pa'i rngul 'byung zhes bgyi rjob/ /mtho ris 'chi 'pho spron bgyid 'chi ⑦ltas lnga/ /lha yul gnas pa'i lha rnams la 'byung ste/ /sa steng mi rnams 'chi bar 'gyur ba dag /sgon par byed pa'i 'chi ltas rnams dang 'dra/ /lha yi 'jig rten dag nas 'phos pa la/ /gal te dge ba'i lhag ma 'ga' med na/ /de nas dbang 96—680

med dud 'gro yi dwags dang / /dmyal bar gnas pa gang yang rung bar 'gyur//lha min dag na'ang rang bzhin gyis lha yi/ /dpal la sdang phyir yid kyi sdug bsngal che/ /de dag blo dang ldan yang 'gro ba yi/ /sgrib ①pas bden pa mthong ba ma mchis so/ /'khor ba de 'dra lags pas lha mi dang / /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro ④rnams dag tu/ /skye ba bzang po ma lags skye ba ni/ /gnod pa du ma'i snod gyur lags mkhyen mdzod/ /mgo 'am gos la glo bur me shor na/ /de dag bzlog phyir ①bgyi ba btang nas kyang / /yang srid med par bgye slad 'bad 'tshal te/ /de dubs ches mchog dgos pa gzhan ma mchis/ /tshul khrims dag dang bsam gtan shes rab kyisadhi/ /mya ngan 'das zhi dul ba dri med pa'i/ /go 'phang mi rga rjomi 'chi zad mi 'tshal/ /sa chu me rlung nyi zla bral thob mdzod/ /dran dang chos rab 'byed dang brtson 'grus dang / /dga' dang shin tu sbyangs dang ting 'dzin dang / /btang stoms 'di bdun byang chub yan lag ste/ /mya ngan 'das thob bgyid pa'i dge tshogs lags/ /shes rab med par bsam gtan yod min te/ /bsam gtan med par yang ni shes rab med / /gang la de nyid yod pas srid pa yi/ /rgya mtsho gnag rjes lta bur 'tshal bar bgyi/ /lung ma bstan pa bcu bzhi 'jig rten na/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyis rab gsungs gang dag lags/ /de dag rnams la bsam par mi bgyi ste/ /de yis ⑦blo ni zhi bar bgyid ma lags/ /ma rig pa las las te de las ni/ /rnam shes de las ming dang gzugs rab 'byung / /de las skye mched drug ste de las ni⑧/ /reg pa kun du 'byung bar thub pas gsungs/ /reg pa las ni tshor ba kun 'byung ste/ /tshor ba'i gzhi las sred pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /96—681

sred pas len pa bskyed par 'gyur ba ste/ /de las srid pa srid las skye ba lags//skye ba yod na mya ngan na rga dang / /'dod pas phongs dang 'chi dang 'jigs sogs kyi/ /sdug bsngal phung po shin tu che 'byung ste/ /skye ba 'gags pas 'di kun 'gag par 'gyur/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung 'di rgyal ba yi/ /gsung gi mdzod kyi gces pa zab mo ste/ /gang gis 'di ni yang dag mthong ba des①—/ /sangs rgyas de nyid rig pas ④rnam mchog mthong / /yang dag lta dang 'tsho dang rtsol ba dang / /dran dang ting ①'dzin dag dang ④las mtha' dag⑤/yang dag rtog nyid lam gyi yan lag brgyad/ /'di ni zhi bar bgyi slad bsgom par bgyirjo/ /skye 'di sdug bsngal sred pa zhes barmi ba/ /de ni de ⑦yi kun 'byung rgya chen te/ /'di 'gog pa ni thar ba lags te de/ /'thob bgyid ⑧'phags lam yan lag de brgyad lags/ /de ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po dag /mthong bar bgyi slad rtag tu brtson par bgyi/ /pang na dpal gnas khyim pa rnams kyis kyang / /shes pas nyon mongs chu bo las brgal ⑨gyi/ /gang dag chos mngon bgyis ⑩pa de dag kyang / /gnam ⑪las babs pa ma lags lo tog bzhin/ /sa rum las ⑫'thon ma lags de dag sngon/ /nyon mongs rag las so so'i skye bor bas/ /bsnyengs dang bral la mang du gsol ci 'tshal—/ /phan pa'i gdams ngag don po 'di lags te/ /khyod kyis thugs dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis/ /sems ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags par gsungs//khyod la de skad gdams pa gang lags de/ /bas par dge slong gis kyang bgyi bar dka'/ /'di la ⑫gang zhig spyod pa'i ngo bo de'i/ /yon tan bstan ⑫pas sku tshe don yod mdzod/ /kun gyi dge ba kun la yi rang zhing / /nyid kyi ⑫96—682

legs par spyad pa rnam gsum yang / /sangs rgyas nyid thob bgyi slad yongs bsngos nas/ /de nas dge ba'i phung po 'di yis khyod/ /skye ba dpag tu med par lha mi yi/ /'jig rten kun gyi rnal 'byor dbang mdzad nas/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang spyod pa yis/ /'gro ba nyam thag mang po rjes bzung ste—/ /'khrungs nas na rga 'dod chags zhe sdang rnams/ /bsal te sangs rgyas zhing du bcom ldan 'das/ /'od dpag med dang 'dra bar 'jig rten gyi//mgon po sku tshe dpag tu med par mdzod/ /shes rab tshul khrims gtong 'byung grags chen dri ma med/ /lha yul nam mkha' dang ni sa steng rgyas mdzad nas/ /sa la mi dang mtho ris lha ni na chung mchog /bde dgas ①dga' ba nges par rab tu zhi mdzad de/ /nyon mongs nyam thag sems can tshogs kyi 'jigs skye dang / /'chi ba zhi mdzad rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid ④brnyes nas/ /'jig rten las 'das ming tsam zhi la mi bsnyengs pa/ /mi bgres nongs pa mi mnga'i go 'phang brnyes par mdzod/ /bshes pa'i spring ①yig slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis / mdza' bo rgyal po bde spyod la bskur rjob rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzha ⑤de ba dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de dpal brtsegs dukyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //96—683

na41 ༄ga /spob ma la zings pa'i spring yig①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shi byu ②le kha/ bod skad du/ slob ma la springs pa'i spring yig /dkon mchog gsum la phyag/ 'tshal lo/ /gang gis mdzad pa shin tu dka' spyad sngon ④byung ba/ /mi'am ci dang lha mo rnams kyis durab bsnyad ⑤na/ /bdud kyi bu mo bzhin ras pad+ma'i nags tshal dag /da ltar zla ba'i zer gyis phog pa bzhin du zum/ /bkra shis yid 'ong shin tu rmad byung sku mnga' ba/ /bsod nams chung ngu'i skye bos mthong ba durnyed dka' ba/ /'jig rten mngon par 'dod pa'i re ba bsgrub pa gang / /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur gzhan don ro gcig spyod/ /gang zhig rtag tu pha rol bde bas bde 'gyur zhing / /gzhan dag sdug bsngal gyur pas mchog tu 'o brgyal ba/ /thugs rje chen pos yon tan shin tu bskrun pa gang / /de nyid rang gi bde sdug spangs te bzhugs pa yin/ /gang zhig gzhan gyi don du dbu rnams gcod byed kyang / /96—687

pad+ma lta bur dgyes pa'i spyan 'byed ①gzigs mdzad cing / /nyid kyi don du gdugs dkar gcig gis khebs pa lta'i/ /sa yang ral gri so bdar rnon po lta bur dgongs/ /zla ba yar gyi ngo ltar yon tan gsal ba rdzogs/ /nyes pa'i mun pa sel mdzad gcig pu yid du 'ong / /'jig rten phan la brtson pa rab tu gsal ba byung ④/ /de shar zla ba bzhin du 'gro ba bsil bar mdzad/ /bstan pa rin chen mchog ltar bzang la 'phan med pa/ /rnam par dag tshul gang yin klu mgo gdengs ka can/ /chen po rnams kyis gtsug gi rgyan bzhin gus mnos nas/ /sa yi steng na gnas pa'i rab rib sel bar mdzad/ /chos kyi sprin de phan pa mdzad pa'i don du g.yos/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi mya ngan 'das pa mchog gi rgyu/ /ro gcig gdung ba sel ba char chu bzhin du bab/ /de ni snod la brten nas ro rnams du mar gyur/ /snod yangs zab la dri ma med cing gsal ba yi/ /bsam pa dang ldan khyar kun bzod pa gang dag la/ /skye bo kun gyis nye bar spyad bya de gnas pa/ /mtsho chen mi yi gzugs can de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig skye nad ①rga shi sel ba'i bdud rtsi de/ /thob par mi byed mi spyod 'dzin par mi byed pa/ /de dag nyes mang gti mug thibs pos basbad pa ste/ /yun ring nad kyis thebs pa sman chen mi bsten bzhin/ /'gro ba kun gyi mig gcig dri ma med pa gang / /de ni sa rnams gsum po'i spyi mthun sgron ma ste/ /bstan pa legs par rnyed nas gang zhig 'dor ba de/ /gti mug shin tu rmad byung dag gis dugatses par zad⑤/ /byang chub khang bzangs bgrod lam them skas lta bu yi/ /bslab gzhi bcas pa rnams la rkang tshugs rton dhipa rnams/ /rjes su sgrub pas dze+ego 'phang che mthor phyin 'gyur te/ /ldog par 96—688

byed pa rang gi sa ni gnyug ①mar rtsang / /skye ba'i rgya mtsho shin tu rgal dka' rgal 'dod pa/ /su zhig tshul khrims gzings gyur lag tu 'ong ba spang sde/ /'phags pa'i ded dpon dang bral lam rgyus mi shes pa/ /'brog dgon 'khyams na ci ste yun rings gdungs snemi byed/ /'khor ba'i ri sul khrod kyi g.yang sar lhung gyur pa/ /mun nag thibs po'i nang nas ldang bar brtson pa gang / /yon tan smyug ma'i phreng ba bar ma dor 'dor ba/ /de dag shugs drag nyam nga'i rtsang bar 'og tu be+eng / /gang dag gcig pu'ang yid kyis nges par rab brtags dhiste/ /yang dag lam dang lhan cig 'grogs par byed pa de/ /sa steng dkyil na gtso bor gyur pa dam pa ste/ /slob ma mchog des bla mar bkur ba nyid du 'gyur⑤/ /ngo tsha yon tan tshogs skyed rjom gcig ya rabs mo/ /mchog tu g.yo med byams pa lta bu'i rjes 'brang ba/ /bden dang gzhung ⑦la dga' ba'i gzi brjid ldan pa rnams/ /srog ni bde blag gtong bar byed kyi dam bcas min/ /re zhig skye bo kun gyis dbyas dang ⑧sdig pa yis⑨ 'gro ba kun la ⑩dmyal ba mi bzod ⑪phar zhog gi/ /rang bzhin rnal ma bor nas smod pa sdug bsngal ba/ /mkhas la sa steng de las sdug bsngal gzhan ci yod/ /gang zhig thub pa rnams kyis ⑫srol btod ⑫chos kyi lam/ /rgya chen gru dang 'dra ba rnyed nas slar 'dor ba/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i klong 'khyel gar mkhan 'dra rnams la/ /dga' bas nges par de yi sems bslus 'gyur ba snyam/ /gang zhig 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rtag tu 'khor gyur pa'i/ /nang du zhugs nas bste ba ④tsam la bder sems pa/ /de ni nges par dbang med rim gyes brgya phrag tu/ /'gro ba ⑫mnyam dang mi mnyam kun du 'khyam par 'gyur/ /shin tu mi bzad dri 96—689

nga mi gtsang gtser ①bas bgags/ /rab tu dog pa mun nag thibs ④por 'dug pa'i mi/ /mngal gnas dmyal ba lta bu'i nang du de zhugs nas/ /lus yongs bskum la sdug bsngal chen po brnag snedagos so/ /de ni rim gyis til mar btsir spyad ⑦sra ba yis/ /btsir ba ltar byas de nas ci zhig ltar de btsa'/ /'on kyang mod la de srog mi 'dor gang yin pa/ /sdug bsngal nye bar spyad pa'i rnam par mtho btsams mod⑤/ /mi gtsang de nang gnas bcas 'phel ba'i lus de ni/ /mngal gnas rlam ༷pas dkris shing dri nga mi bzad ldang / /gzir bas gnod pa bdo ste ⑦rma rmen zhig pa ltar/ /gyur pa de yi skyon gyis sngon gyi ⑧dran pa spong / /byis lus nye bar spyod pa kun la mi 'bongs pa/ /mi brten ⑨'khor ba spangs te mkhrang ba'i ⑩dngos gyur nas/ /dar la babs ⑪pa'i ri dbang btsan po'i ri sul du/ /sbrul gdug gnas gyur mu ⑫la bag rkyang ⑫spyod par byed/ /bsam brlag ④de ni de nas kyang lhung la/ /lhung bzhin ⑫mi gcigs spyod pa mi 'dor ba/ /byis pa bdag lus sdug pa rga ba dang / /'chi ba med pa nyid du sems pa lta/ /rmongs pa de ni thub dbang gis bstan pa'i/ /lam bzang rnam par spangs nas lam min ⑩par/ /glang po myos pa lcags kyu med pas gzhan/ /bab dgu phye mar rlog pa bzhin du 'gro/ /de nas de ni mi 'dod bzhin du mgor/ / brtse med rga ⑩bas rdog pa ⑫nan mnan nas/ /skra dkar lcags kyu bdar ba rnon po yis/ /glang chen rdzi bos glang chen bzhin du 'debasaske/ /'on kyang de ni spyod la skyor 'byin pas/ /dge ba'am 'jigs pa bzhin du spang ⑪bar 'gyur/ /rmongs pa bya ba ⑩min byed bdag ⑥skyes pa/ /smyug ma 'bru chags lta bur brlag par zad/ /de nas de ni 'chi bdag dga' 96—690

ba'i spun/ /gzhil ba'i bcos thabs med pas bzung nas ni/ /rgas pa'i ngo bo'i cha bdag 'ongs nas ni/ /rgod pa bzhin du spyi nas ①'dzin par byed/ /de nas de ni lhu tshigs rnams 'bye zhing / /blo yang bslad 'gyur 'gro ba nyams par 'gyur/ /lus kyang dengs nas shig shig por 'gyur la/ /nges par ldig pa 'phel ba kho nar 'gyur/ /dbang po rnams kyang rim gyis zhum nas ni/ /yul la chags kyang nus pa nyams par 'gyur/ /gnas skabs gang du 'di 'gro gyur pa de/ /gal te dmyal na yod na de nyid 'jigs/ /bdag gis ji ltar de bzhin 'di sdem byas/ /ci ste de ltar de byas 'gro ba nyams/ /bdag gis ci ste 'di ltar 'chi bdag ni④/ /mgo bor rdogalgepas gnon pa 'phrigs ma gyur/ /mya ngan rdo rje de lta de lta bur/ /sems la gnod pa rnams kyis de gtses nas/ /nye du'i skye bo dud mo'i mchi rgyun can/ /sdug bsngal snying ni rdo ⑤rje lta bus bltas//gnad kyi gshis su 'jibs par gzir nas ni/ /shin tu mi bzad mun rum 'jug par 'gyur/ /'bad pa lhur blangs srung dub byas pa'i lus/ /yid 'ong 'dris pa rnam par 'dor bar 'gyur/ /gshin rje'i zhags pas dam du btags pa ste/ /co do ⑦'bal zhing cho nges ⑧'debs byed kyang / /de yis glengs pa nye du'i ⑨skye bo yis/ /rang gi ngus sgra ldir ba bzhin ⑩mi thos/ /bgrod dka' chu dang pha bang ⑪thag thug 'dom ⑫pa'i bar/ /tsher ma rnon pos 'dzings pa nyam nga'i lam dag du/ /dus kyi zhags pas ske nas btags te gshin rje'i mi/ /gtum po rnams kyis dbyug pas bda' zhing khrid ⑫par 'gyur/ /mi bzad skam byapas rgyang nas chu klung dri med pa/ /mthong nas btung bar 'dod de song na de nyid kyang / /skra shad nya lcibs tshogs dang rnag sungs spyo96——691

'dres pa dang / /'dam rdzab khrag dang phyi sas gang ba'i chur 'gyur ro/ /dus rlabs rlung langs chu 'thor ri rtse bsil 'gyur zhing / /tsan dan ljon pa sngon ①'khrungs ma la yar song nas/ /de yang 'di la nags sreg me lce rnos 'khrigs shing / /mgal dum 'gyel ba mang pos rad rod can du 'gyur/ /chu gter rlabs 'jigs 'phang khrumatho gyes pa las byung ba'i/ /dbu ba tsher ①ma lhag ge stug par rjosong na yang / /de yang 'di la bye tshan khya ba dmar tsub pa'i//rlung dmar 'jebs pa ⑤'tshub pa'i mya ngan nyid du 'gyur/ /'di ni de gnas char sprin ldang bar 'dod na yang / /sprin las lcags mda'i char pa dud 'thul mdag mar bcas/ /tsha tsha rdo rje'i pha bang rjodamar 'phrog ser mdog lta bu yi/ /glog phreng dmar ser 'gyu ba lus la char du 'bab⑦/ /tsha bas nyen la bu yug kyang ni tshar 'gyur la/ /lhags pas ⑧nyam thag pa la me yang grang byed do/ /shin tu mi bzad las yongs ⑨smin pas rnam rmongs pa/ /'di la sna tshogs 'di kun phyin ci log tu snang / /khab mig tsam gyi kha la dpag tshad mang 'jigs pa'i//lto can nyam thag rgya mtsho chen po'i chu 'thung ⑩kyang / /mgul phugs yangs pa nyid du phyin par ma gyur par/ /kha yi dugs ⑪kyis chu yi thigs pa skam ⑫par 'gyur—/ /ral pa'i tshogs mang spungs pas bsgyings pa'i khyi dag gis⑫/ /mche ba gzong rings ⑫rdo rje'i rtse mos lus dbad ⑫cing / /chu bo rab med thal skyo ⑩me lces gang ba'i ngogs/ /rdo ba zur rnon mi bzad rtse rnon can du bdas/ /spu gri rdos gtams lcug tshal lo ma ral gri yi⑩/ /nang du thang chad rgyugs ⑫na lus smas ⑪skyabs med pa/ /rtse gsum mdung thung dang ni ral gri rnos gang ba'i//khron pa gshin rje'i kha bas thu ba'i nang du lhung / /nyi tshan gyis gdung ⑩bzod 96—692

dka' rlag par dga' ba'i lus/ /ljon shing lo ma sngo stug mthong nas song ba dang / /de yi lo ma ①mtshon brgya lhung ②bas lus dbad cing / de na yun ring ngud mo las shes brlag par gnas/ /bud med kun nas me lce brgya phrag 'thon ①pa'i me/ /me stag phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i rgyan gyis gzhag ④gyur cing / /sog le lta bu'i ⑤rtsub pa'i lus kyi rjozon med pa⑦/ /shin tu sdug pa'i tshul du bcum nas 'khyud par byed/ /ri dang mnyam du lug ru ⑧'jigs su rung ba gnyis/ /'dus pa'i phrag tu lus kun phye mar zlog cing 'joms/ /cung zad bsel ba'i rlung zhig langs pas brtas ⑨nas de/ /de bzhin phyir yang lan brgyar kun nas phye mar zlog /bse khyi bong bu ce spyang stong phrag gis bred nas/ /shal ma ri mtho ⑩mi bzad de la myur 'jegs na/ /tsher ma'i tshogs kha thur du bltas pas thal 'byin cing / /zug rngu tshabs po che dag khong rlag nub par 'gyur/ /gshin rje'i lag na thogs pa dus kyi zhags pa lta'i/ /sbrul sdug mgo 'phang bstod pas dam gzhag gzhungs nas ni/ /gson por kha dang bya gar ⑪kang ka bya rgod kyis/ /de na gnas pa'i mig dag tsham tshom med par 'dru/ /de lus de dag gi mchu rdo rje rtse mo ltas/ /brtsam ⑫pa med dbang nyam thag nga ro 'byin byed cing / /thur du babs na lcags tsher gyen du kha bltas pa/ /sbom pa ⑫rno ba mang pos lus phug dran pa nyams/ /de bas ⑫kha cig mdung rtse gsum pa 'bar ba dang / /zug rngu rnon pos lus dbad thur du 'bab mi nus/ /de tshe mtshon cha bdar ba'i mchu can khā ⑫rnams kyis/ /kun du drangs pas ⑫rgyu lto brang byeng nar zhing 'thor/ /kha cig ri bo'i g.yang sa ya ngar g.yang du lhung / /kha cig 'bru mar skol ba'i ⑩zangs chen nang du rtsang / /gzhan dag phye ma sreg ⑫96—693

pa me stag 'phro ba yi/ /sa gzhi rkang pa gzhag ①pa'i gnas mi thod par lhung / /kha cig 'bu sbrang phra mo lcig phyig 'dug pa yi/ /tshogs kyis ②lus rmugs bam zhing rnam par 'drul①/ /las kyi rang bzhin snyi dul 'tsho ba thogs pa rnams/ /bskyod pa tsam yang bya bar mi nus bzhin du gson/ /lhags pa dpe med rus pa la yang thim pa yis/ /lus sbrebs 'dar zhing bskur nas gum gum por 'dug pa/ /chu bur brgya byung ⑤rdol ba las skyes srog chags kyi/ /ral gris dbad nas zhag dang chu ser rkang bcas 'dzag /dkos rjothag so 'thams skra dang spu rnams g.yengs gyur pa/ /mig dang rna ba lkog ma gnod pas kun gzir zhing / /lus dang sems kyi bar dag rab tu klong ⑦gyur nas/ /grang ba'i dmyal bar gnas shing shin tu 'o dod ⑧'bod/ /dmyal me du ba mched dku mnam pa 'thul bas gnam mdog 'gyur/ /me lce'i lag mang rnam par 'phros nas phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor khebs/ /rus gong dkar dum phreng ba'i rgyan gyis spud pa skyi g.ya' ba/ /glang chen pags gyon bsdigs ⑨thabs kye ma kyi hud zer ba bzhin/ /la lar me stag che 'phro 'khrug pa 'ur sgra tog yar la/ /zhag gis bab na skad ngan bod pa'i rtse zhil ⑩chil chil 'bar/ /brang gi rus pa'i khong du thal la lhag lhag sgra grags pa/ /bskal pa'i dus kyi me yis bskyod du med pa'i nang du lhung / / glo nas ⑪rtswa skam rnying las ⑫sbar ba lta bur me tshogs 'bar/ /mgrin dang kha nas me lce 'bar ba dud bcas bstung mar 'byung / /khong ltogs pa nas lug nang khrol nar bas kun bred cing / /brda mi phrad pa'i skad chen tsam zhig 'don par byed par zad/ /sdug bsngal che las thar par 'dod pas de dag yang dang yang / /sgo bye gseb gzhan mthong nas thag ring ci zhig ltar 96—694

te ①'byer/ /gang tshe las kyi sgo 'phar dam pos de yang bcad 'gyur ba④/ /de tshe yi mug bzod blag ①sdug bsngal gzhan yang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mnga' chen rno tshogs 'bar ba char bzhin 'bab pa'i rjes la yang / /dmyal ba'i srung mas dbyug pas btab cing mchi ma 'dzag bzhin du/ /lcags zhun khu ba me stag 'bar ba'i phreng bas rjo'akhrigs pa ldud/ /kha sna rna ba'i bu ga dag nas dud 'thul gyen du 'byung / /mig dang glad spris rdol gyi bar du kun sreg cing / /glad pa'i rgyas la 'bar ba'i me ste smug nag tshogs/ /me de khros pa lta bur de yi lus phung la/ /bud shing skam po bcer la sbar ba bzhin du mched/ /skye bo de srog ri gzar klung gi chu ltar g.yo/ /dmyal ba'i me yang der zad tsha ba'ang der zad de/ /las rnams ji ltar thams cad shin tu mi bzad pa/ /snang bar 'gyur ba de ltar yongs su sgyur bar byed/ /skye bo rang gi las kyis rjodabang med 'chal spyod dupa/ /brgya la sdig nas ⑦dmyal ba dag nas thar na yang / /'jig rten 'gro ba mtha' dag ⑧bye ba 'phyes ⑨rnams su/ /mi yi ⑩dngos po shin tu rnyed par dka' ba nyid/ /gal te kla klo dmyal ba'i srung dang spyod mtshungs samaske/ /dud 'gro phan tshun za bar byed pa'i nad dag tu/ /skye ba thob par 'gyur na gang gi phyir yang ni/ /g.yang du lhung bar 'gyur ba'i ngang tshul de nyid bsten—/ /gang zhig thob nas skye ba'i rgya mtsho mthar 'byin cing / /byang chub mchog gi sa bon dge ba'ang 'debs gyur pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan lhag pa yi/ /mi nyid de ni su zhig 'bras bu med par byed/ /bde gshegs lam bsten 'gro ba 'dren par chas gyur cing / /sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa'i/ /lam de lha dang klu yis mi rnyed lha min dang / /96—695

mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi 'am ci ste lto 'phyes ①min/ /mi yi dngos po shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed gyur nas/ /don du brnag pa gang yin de ni brtun ②te bsgrub//mar me'i me lce shugs drag rlung gis ④bskyod pa lta'i/ /tshe ni skad cig gnas pa'i gdengs yang yod ma yin/ /'di ni sang bya 'di ni thang cig 'og tu bya/ /'di ni de'u re bya zhes skye bo sems pa na/ /gshin rje be con nag thogs zur gyis rjolta ba yi/ /mig rtsa dmar khros ma rangs gad mos re snyam 'debs/ /sos ka me tog rgyas pa'i dus 'di 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zla ba gsal bas mtshon pa'i ston dus 'di 'byung ⑤zhes/ /skye bo thams cad dga' 'gyur bdag gi tshe 'di ni/ /zad par 'gyur zhes shin tu mi dgar 'gyur ba med/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa nye bar brgyan byas shing / / rked 'chings 0char chen sprin gyi ⑦'khrigs pas 'khyud gyur pa/ /ri rtse'i nags kyi mthongs der chags pa med pa ④ni/ /rlung ltar g.yo ba'i rang bzhin tshe gtugs skal ba che/ /nags mthongs ri dwags rgyu ba'i tshogs kyis bsten byas la⑨/ /kun nas nyams dga' bzang po de ni skyid pa gang / /de ci dga' ba'i nags tshal lha mo'i nyams bag tu/ /thel gyis 'be+ebs pa'i rdo leb can la yod 'gyur snyam⑩/ /nags klung chu gtsang ngogs kyi dben pa ⑪skyid pa gang / /de ci lha yi bu mo dri zhim byugs pa yi/ /lan bu'i rgyan du thogs pa'i rgyu ldan me tog tshogs/ /mdzes pa'i zil gnon lha yi chu la 'ang yod 'gyur ram/ /rtsa ba 'bras bu shun pa lo ma phun sum tshogs pa'i ljon shing ldan/ /nags tshal ltos med ri bo'i chu rgyun bsel 'bab chags pa med pa'i gnas/ /chu klung yangs pa'i mtha' ru 'bras bu me tog lhung bas brgyan pa yi/ /nyams dga' ⑫bas mthar ci zhig 96—696

med de dmyal sdong khyim gyis bslus te sdod/ /ri sul yangs par skye bo bun long med pas rab bde ba/ /nyer spyod rgya chen nags tshal sngo 'khrungs phreng bas ①stengs| /chu ngogs snyan ②pa phu chu'i rgyun 'dra ①rnga ltar snyan pa yis/ /bdag cag nyon mongs yul ma yin zhes 'don la sgrogs dupa bzhin/ /'dod pa rnams dang 'byor dang srid gsum rgyal ba yis/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu chu zla dba' ⑤rlabs 'dra bar gsungs/ /rmi lam lta bu'i ngan spyod 'khrul bas bslus pa yi/ /byis pa gang dag de la chags pa dmyal bar rtsang / /yul dang dug mtshungs dang po myong ba tsam na bde/ /yul dang dug mtshungs rnam smin rtsub pas mi bzad pa//yul dang dug mtshungs gti mug mun pas thibs por byed/ /yul dang dug mtshungs shugs bzlog dka' zhing g.yo ba yin/ /dug dang yul rnams dzā yis nges par brtags byas na/ /nyis na dug bla mi bzad rang bzhin dhiyul rnams ⑦min| /dug ni skye ba gcig la dug tu 'gyur bar zad/ /yul ni tshe rabs gzhan la'ang dug tu 'gyur bar byed/ /dug ni dug dang bsres nas ⑧rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /gsang sngags mchog dang dug sel sman gyis gso bar rung ⑨/ /dug ni thabs ldan spyad na mi la phan 'gyur gyi/ /dug chen yul ni nam yang de lta ma yin no/ /ji ltar glang bu khron zab kha nas 'khrungs pa yi/ /rtswa lo kham 'ga' tsam la yid ni chags gyur pa/ /rnyed pa grub pa med par g.yang du ltung ba ltar/ /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten bde ldan 'dod pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /lha yi bu mo dal gyis 'bab pa'i chu rgyun gyis/ /'phral thabs 1nga pa ⑩rnams dang lhan cig rtse stsong nas/ /phyir yang chu bo rab med rba drag 'bogs ⑪pa yis/ /smas ⑫pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad bstan ⑫par bya dgos so/ /lha tshal dpag 96—697

bsam shing lo'i gding ba kun bkram par/ /lha yi bu mo dang bsten ①bde bar gnas nas kyang / /phyir yang mtshon rnon mang po 'bab pas lus dbad pa/ /lo ma ral gri lta bu'i nags tshal bgrod dgos so/ /rkang bzhag ṣ+pems dang 'phar byed reg na bde ba yi/ /ri rab spo ④yi dkyil du yun ring gnas nas kyang / /phyir yang bye ma bsregs pa'i me ma mur gyi tshogs/ /brla dang rkang lag kun du zhig par 'khyam ①par 'gyur/ /dril bu mdzes khrol ④mu tig phreng tshogs lhag ge ba/ /gzhal med khang du zhugs te lha yul bgrod nas kyang ⑤/ /mi bzad skyabs med mun nag thibs po dpag med pa/ /pha mtha' med pa'i nang du spyi tshugs 1nga bar 'gyur/ /gang du lha klu mi'am ci yi mgo rgyan gyi/ /'od kyi tshogs kyis rkang rten dhidamar ba'i brgya byen yang / /las kyi rlung 'khrugs 'gro ba ngan par 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de la skyes bu su zhig 'jigs pa bstan ⑦mi byed/ /me tog rab tu rnyings shing lus rngul thon ⑧pa dang / /gos rnying smre zhing nye du rnams la lta ba yis⑨/ /lha rnams 'chi ba'i rab tu sdug bsngal gang yin de/ /⑩'tsho ba chu bur lta bur g.yo ba'i ⑩mi la med/ /sdug bsngal me tshogs 'phung bas ⑫'jigs pa'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /skye bo bde snyam mngon pa'i nga rgyal byed pa dang ⑫/ /de ni gshin rje'i kha yangs ④'byed par byed pa ste⑫/ /de ni skye ba phyi ma'i ljon shing sa bon yin/ /de ni gshin rjes ⑩srid mtshor rgyu ba'i sems can la/ /log par smon pa'i ⑩'jigs pa dbyig ⑫pa nag po'i rtser/ /sred ⑪pa'i tha gu ring pos dam bzhag btags pa yi/ /mchil bas nya la bya ba bzhin du btab pa yin/ /dmyal rnams zangs chen lhag lhag skol ⑩ba tsha ba'i shugs drag nas/ /skad cig tsam zhig mgo stod ⑥dbugs 96—698

'byin 'gyur ba rnams/ /lcags kyi tho ba rab tu mang po khros te gzas pa yis /brgyab na de nyid mchog tu bde ba yin par sems pa ltar/ /de bzhin sdug bsngal mi bzad pa yis dbang med rtag gzir cing / /re zhig tsam zhig ji zhig ltar te skye shi'i 'khrugs ①med nas/ /skad cig sdug bsngal gnyug mar bzod dka' me lce zhil gyur na/ /'jig rten thams cad bde ba kham ①'ga' la yang sred par byed/ /ji lta ji ltar 'gro ba kun la bde ba'i 'du shes bskyed/ /de lta de ltar gti mug mun pa shin tu stug por 'gyur/ /ji lta ji ltar 'gro ba kun la sdug bsngal 'du shes bskyed/ /de lta de ltar gti mug mun pa shin tu srab mor 'gyur/ /ji lta ji ltar sdug pa bsgom pa shin tu rnam 'phel ba/ /de lta de ltar 'dod chags me lce shin tu 'phro bar 'gyur/ /ji lta ji ltar mi sdug bsgom pa shin tu 'phel 'gyur ba/ /de lta de ltar 'dod chags me lce shin tu rtse zhil 'gyur / /bud med yan lag dri nga rul pa mi sdug dang / /pad ma'i 'dab ma ut+pal dag tu snyam byed pa/ /snyan dngags mkhan gyi brdzun de'i 'bras bu mi bzad ④pa/ /de dag de yi mngal gnas 'jug pa de yin no/ /'gro bar lan brgyar ma son 'gro de gang zhig yod/ /sngon chad lan mang ma myong bde dub de gang zhig⑤ /rnga yab dkar mjes lta bu'i dpal gang ma thob pa/ /de yang gang zhig yod na 'on kyang 'dod chags 'phel/ /gang gi gling bar ma gnas chu bo de yod min/ /yul phyogs gang du gnas rjom bcas pa'i gnas de med/ /gang du ma song nam mkha'i phyogs de'ang yod min na/ /'on kyang 'dod chags dgang dka' 'phel bar 'gyur ba nyid/ /sngon chad lan mang ma myong sdug bsngal de yod min⑦/ /'gro bar gang gis tshim gyur ⑧'dod pa de dag med/96—699

gang gi ltor ma nyal ba'i sems can de med na/ /'on kyang ji ltar 'khor ba can la chags bral med/ /skye ba yongs su 'dzin pa 'gro ba rgya chen 'dir/ /bde dang sdug bsngal dag tu lan mang 'gre ldog pa/ /'gro ba gnyen ma gyur pa'i skye bo de gang med/ /'on kyang zhe sdang sbrul gyi rang bzhin 'jigs par gnas/ /gang dang lhan cig 'dus nas bgad cing rtses pa dang / /glu blangs dga' 'dun byas shing gcig tu zos 'thungs dang / /dus kyi rim pas me tog rna ①rgyan dengs byas dang / /gnas skabs ci zhig ltar mnyam mi mnyam byas pa yi/ /nye du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i khongs su chud gyur pa/ /klong ②gi nang du lhung ba lta bu snang bzhin du/ /skye shis 'phos ①pas ngo ma shes pa de bor nas/ /gal te gcig thar byed na de las khrel bor med/ /byis pa pang na btsa' ④ba ci yang mi nus par/ /gang gi nu zho byams pa'i shugs kyis gzags 'thungs pa/ /ngal ba mang bsten ⑤byams pa bsten rjopa de dag 'dir/ /shin tu ma rabs zhig na'ang sgong bar su zhig spro/ /gang gi khong na 'di skabs rnyed nas gnas bcas ⑦shing / /gang gi rtse ⑧bag sems kyis zon bcas 'di blangs pa/ /nyon mongs de dag sdug bsngal skyabs med der ⑨bor nas/ /'gro ba ma rabs tha shal zhig na'ang su zhig spro/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal mi bzad mang pos dbang med skyabs med 'dir/ /gzhan gyi don du sdug bsngal gang de bde zhes skyes mchog gsungs⑩/ /skad cig gzhan bkres skom dang tsha ngal bral bas rangs byas pa⑪/ /des dga' gang yin de dang 'dra ba 'di na'ang gang zhig yod/ /gzhan phan bde ba skyed par brtson pas dga' ba rnyed pa gang / /de ni yul bde'i ⑫longs spyod lhur len rnams kyis ji ltar yang / /gzhon bdes mi thob 96—700

mi dbang 'byor pa'i yo byad rnams kyis min/ /chung mas ma yin gzhan min lha gnas lha min 'gro bas min/ /shin tu rnyed sba rtswa kham 'ga' lta phyugs kyang rang nyid za/ /shin tu skom pas gdungs pa'ang ①chu zhig rnyed na dga' mgur 'thung / /'di na skyes bu gzhan don byed par brtson pa gang yin pa/ /de 'di'i brjid bag yin te de bde skyes bu'i rtsal de 'phags/ /nyi ma rlabs chen rta zhon rgyu ba snang byed gang yin dang / /khyar la mi rtsegs sa yis ②'jig rten 'degs pa gang yin de/ /①rang don 'ga' med chen po rnams kyi rjorang bzhin de 'dra ste/ /de dag 'jig rten phan dang bde ba'i ro la gcig tu gzhol/ /'jig rten ma rig dud sprin 'khrigs pas 'gro ba 'khrugs gyur pa/ /sdug bsngal me rab 'bar ba'i nang du dbang med rtsang ⑤mthong nas/ /thong la me lce 'bar ba lta bur yid brel brtson pa gang / /'di na de dag byes bu yin te mkhas pa'ang de dag yin/ /gzhan gyi don du me lces gang ba'i mnar med dmyal bar yang / /gangs dang zla 'od bsel ba lta bur rab tu dga' bzhin 'jug /nyid kyi don du pad ma kha bye lhag ger 'dug pa yi/ /mtsho yang de la me lce'i tshogs bzhin rab tu gdungs par dubyed/ /gzhan la phan par byed par chas pa'i mkhas pa rnams/ /lo ma ral gri tshal na'ang bde blag gnas byed kyis⑦—/ /skad cig tsam yang lha yi bu mo dang 'grogs nas/ /dga' ba'i tshal gyi nang du skyid par byed mi 'gyur/ /rgal bar gyur pa skyabs med skye bo bsgral ba'i phyir/ /phyir yang chu bo rab med nang du 'jug byed kyis④/ /lha yi chu bo dba' ⑨rlabs chil chil 'dug pa yis/ /reg pa'i bde ba ⑩bdag nyid sten par byed ma yin/ /de ltar rgyan gyis ⑪brgyan gyur legs spyad rin po che/ /96—701

gsal ba'i nang na gsal ba zhi ba'i bdud rtsi yangs/ /dga' ba'i dga' ba byas pa mi gzo ①rnyed dka' ba/ /bkra shis rnams kyi bkra shis zhi ba'i bde rgyun te②—/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi me tog rtag bsten snebya/ /ljon shing me tog de las ④'bras bu rgya chen 'byung / /bde gshegs me tog gsung las don tshogs bsten bya ste/ /sbrang ma sbrang rtsi la mchog dga' bar byed la ltos/ /skad cig gcig la zad cing rtag tu 'khrug ⑤pa'i yul rnams spong / /zhi ba'i bde 'bras 'chi ba'i 'tsher rjomed gcig pu dben pa sten⑦/ /rnam thar sgo yi gtan pas gti mug 'khrugs pa'i rab rib sol/ /rta mchog rte'u ni shin tu yun ring gnyid log 'gyur ma ⑧yin/ /khyod gcig gdung bas nyam thag rnams la srid pa'i mya ngam ⑨du/ /shing chen sdang brtan ⑩rgya chen kun gel bzod dang dul ba'i lo ma can/ /zhig nas me tog shes rab yal ga rab smin lo bran stug /sgon lam rtse mo tshul khrims dri ma rab zhi 'bras bcas kyis/ /khyod gcig gdung bas ⑪nyam thag rnams la srid pa'i mya ngam ⑫du/ /mtsho chen yangs gsal byen gzhol gting zab bsam pa rab tu dwangs/ /rtag baṅgal sgrul gdug rnyi ⑫yis bag med 'jigs spangs ④rang bzhin gyis/ /rab tu gtsang zhing sred pa gcod byed rtul ba'i khur bzod kyis/ /khyod gcig gdung bas nyam thag rnams la srid pa'i mya ngam ⑫du/ /sprin chen skye bo mang phan mi 'jigs smra ba'i sgra chen sgrogs—/ /drag ⑩pa rgya chen char gyi shugs drag snying rje'i rlung gis bskyod/ /rdul bral zhi bas tshul khrims dri mas sa steng brgyan par gyis/ /bdag gis de skad brjod pas bsod nams cung zad bsgrubs pa gang / /de yis skye bo ma lus bde gshegs spyod la dad byed cing / /rtag bde longs spyod bzang ldan yid la 96—702

re ba 'byor ba dang / /gzhan la phan dga' de nas ①rim gyis kun mkhyen bgrod par shog /dmyal ba lag mthil ltar mnyam rnam bsal ①me rab zhi ba dang / /skam 'khrungs pad+ma'i lo mas khebs shing rtsa ba'i khye'u so ①'thon/ /gtsang zhing dri zhim pad+ma kha byes sa rnams brgyan pa dang / /rgyas shing bzang la ser bu'i ngad bcas char zim 'bab pa bupar shog /bdud dpung pham pa cho nges 'debs pas mi bsnyengs sgogs ⑤pa po/ /lha chu'i rtse dumo bas kyang dga' mdzad lha dang mi 'dul ba/ /skye shi nyon mongs sdug bsngal rgyun rnams 'joms pa'i sangs rgyas dag /phyogs dang phyogs su brnag pa bzhin du nam zhar 'byung bar shog /'gro ba chos kyi kun dga' 'phel ba'i dga' ④ston che bar shog /'chi bdag re ba shin tu yun ring goms pa don med shog /thub pa'i skye bo gtam tshogs 'phel bas zhe ⑧ba bdud rtsi yi/ /char gyi zla ba'i snang ba rab bzang ⑨bsel bas don byas shog /slob ma la springs pa'i phrin tu) yig slob dpon chen po tsan dra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba snyo ⑪de ba dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de dpal brtsegs ⑫rak+shi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //96—703

lhung / du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadung bar/ ⑦⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rba/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wab/phonye〈〈snazang 〉〉gyi/7༷2 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉togazos/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyud sten/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉brten/ ④〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorakhrugs/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zar/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsten/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngan/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdong bstan/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cig dungs pas/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngan/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stag/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spang / ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngan/ tho)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉grags/7༷3 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi de nas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snang gsal/ ni〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stan song / ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wapa/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stengs sgrags/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bu'i rtsed/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉stanaga' ba'i/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar zhi/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzangs/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉ma la spring pa'i 'phrin/ 〈〈snar 〉〉mi la spring pa'i 'phrin/ 〈〈co 〉〉ma la spring pa'i phrin/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tshwa/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsegs/bsdur 'bras ze'i1 migakhyung yig/ (12)96wa 706

414༄ga /rgyal po chen po ka dzas ka la zings pa'i spring yig①༄la/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā rā dza ka ni ska ②le kha/ bod skad du/rgyal po chen po ka nis ①ka la springs pa'i spring rjoyig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bgrod par bgyi 'os khyod lags na/ /bkug kyang ma mchis gang lags de/ /ma gus ma lags brnyas ma lags/ /rga dang nad kyi bar chad bgyis/ /bdag ni sems can thams cad dang / /'dra bar khyod la brtse mod kyis⑤/ /khyod kyi yon tan gyis khyod la/ /lhag par nye mgon khyad par bgyid/ /gdams bgyi duphal cher mchis mod kyi/ /thams cad gdams par sus ⑦rngo thogs/ /khyod kyi yon tan gang lags des/ /bdag ni spyi brtol skyes par gyur/ /bzlog ⑧pa med pa'i yon tan gyis/ /phyogs rnams kun du bsgos pas ni/ /mi mchog rnams kyang thugs thub par/ /mdza' bshes bzhin du 'jem pa med/ /de ltas snyan bstod ⑨nyid kyi ched/ /96—707

bdag gis ①gsol ba 'di gson te/ /bsgrub dang btang ba'i phyogs ②gnyis las—/ /gang rigs de ni nyams su bzhes/ /dga' bar babyid pa'i yul rnams dang / /rgyags par bgyid pa'i lang tsho dang / /bdag nyid rang dgar spyod pa de①/ /kun du don med bgyid pa'i sgo/ /phung bar byed pa de gsum spang / /mkhas pas dam pa bsten rjopa dang / /dbang po dul ⑤dang shes rab kyi—/ /stobs mthus nyams ni smad nas spyad/ /khyod kyi nyos dupa'i gzhir gyur pa'i/ /cha ni gsum po de dag rnams/ /chos lugs dag dang 'dul ba yis—/ /bcos nas yon tan nyid du mdzod/ /ci ste rgyal po blon po dag /dkyel che snying rje'i bdag nyid ni/ /rtag tu nyon mongs med pa yi/ /las kyis dze+ergyal srid bya bar ⑧rung / /'jig rten 'di na blo gros kyis⑨/ /nyam chung gyur dang mgon med pa/ /bya ba ma yin byed pa la/ /gdon mi za bar 'jug par 'gyur/ /de bas ji srid sa de las⑩/ /myur du ma brgal ⑩bar du ni//blo mthu bskyed phyir mkhas pa dag /bsdu bar dgyes pa'i nan tan mdzod/ /chos kyi bstan bcos gdon bgyi zhing / /de yi don gyi tshul gson la/ /gsan pa'i chos rnams rnam dpyad de/ /dpyad pa la ni mkhas par mdzod/ /mya ngan gyis ni ma gdungs shing / /na gzhon nad med longs pa yi/ /dngos po da ltar byung ba yi/ /blo gros la ni mi nus med/ /'dir ni skyes bu dam pa las—/ /dus dus su yang nyung zad gson/ /nyung ngu bsags na'ang nges par ni/ /ring por mi thogs mang por 'gyur/ /rtag tu chu thigs re re'i rgyun//bar chad med par 'bab pa yis/ /gang zhig gang bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /snod de ji lta bu zhig mchis/ /de ltar dpe gsal de lta bu/ /rgyal po tshad mar 96—708

mdzad nas ni/ /dam pa'i chos ni gsan pa la/ /rtag tu dges pa nyid du mdzod / /yon tan nor ni gnyer la gnyen/ /mkhas shing snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /byas gzo phongs chos mi bgyid pa/ /bzang po khyod kyi ①be+ed du zhog /khyod kyi ①blun dang phongs snechos can/ / skams shing dhibyas pa mi gzo dang / /kha gsag gtum po mi bzad pa/ /yul na rang ⑤gnas su ma stsal cig /rtag tu so so'i skye bo yiX/ /khyad par mkhyen par mdzod cig dang / /de yi khyad par mkhyen tsam la/ /phun sum tshogs pa rag las so/ /mi gang dka' ba spyod byed dang / /dor bar bya dka' 'dor ⑦ba dang / /bzod par dka' ba bzod byed dang / /bkur dka' nyams su len pa dang / /gnas min las ni zlog byed dang / /gnas su 'jog par brtson pa dang / /de yi ⑧bsam pa mthun gus dang / /bde bar 'dod cing 'o byams pa/ /de dag rnams ni mdza' bshes te/ /gnyen 'dun grogs po'ang de dag lags/ /rang don tsam phyir 'brang ba'i mi/ /gzhan dag skye bo phal par ⑨bas/ /grogs po phan par 'dod pa'i tshig /mi snyan yang ni phan pa dang / /'jam dang bde ba lags pa dag /thugs la bzhag par mdzad du gsol/ /tshig snyan phan pa ma lags dang / /'jam yang bden pa ma lags pa/ /dam pa ma yin rnams kyi tshig /khyod kyi thugs la ma bzung shig⑩ /phan par smra ba khro yang ni/ /khyod kyis gnad chen dag tu mdzod/ /mi phan smra ba bstod bgyis ⑪kyang / /dgyes pa dag tu ma mdzad cig /rab dwangs mtsho la ngang pa yi/ /rgyal po dang ni chus 'jigs bzhin/ /dam pa rnams kyis bsnyen be+e ⑫dang / /dam pa min pas bsnyen dka' mdzod/ /khyod kyis mkhas rnams tshim bgyis pas//96—709

'byor pa don du gnyer mi bgyi①/ /yon tan dgyes phyir khyod kyis ni/ /yon tan rnams kyis mi ngoms mdzod/ /longs spyod byed dam bde ba dang / /sdug bsngal phrad pa'am spyod pa'am/ /spyod lam kun du spyod pa na/ /khyod kyis dam pa bsten pa dang / /dran pa'i grogs kyis bskor ba na/ /bag yod par ni gnas 'gyur te/ /sā la'i shing la 'khri shing bzhin/ /bzang po dpal gyis 'khyud par 'gyur/ /khyod kyis gzhom ⑤pa bden pa dang / /khyad par zhing la sbyin pa dang / /dran dang bral bas 'dod par dbye/ /chad pas gang du'ang gcad mi bgyid①/ /log pas 'thab gcugs dubyed pa dang / /bkren la dman par lta ba dang / /tshul khrims ldan rnams mi dga' dang / /dka' thub sdom pa 'khrul byed pa/ /bzhi po 'di dag 'dod min te/ /rtsa ba 'joms par bgyid pa lags/ /rab brtson khyod kyi yul na ni/ /de dag gtan ma ma chis par mdzod/ /stobs dang ldan pas ⑤stobs chung ba/ /gnang chen gyis ni mi gnang dang / /mchod 'os rnams kyis mi mchod dang / /smos 'drin rjogyis ni mi shes pa/ /gang yang rung la ⑦gang gis kyang / /brnyas pa med par khyod kyis mdzod/ /tha snyad rnams ni dag pa yis/ /kun la 'dra ⑧bar gzigs su gsol/ /kun gyis rang gi chos thob cing / /chos kyis thams cad 'tsho bar mdzod/ /mi sdug kyang ni nyes med na/ /thams cad bde bar mdzad du gsol/ /pha yis bu la ji lta bar/ /khyod kyis 'khor la byams bgyis na/ /bu yis pha la ji lta bar/ /khyod kyis zhabs ⑨'bring dga' bar bgyid⑩—/ /phal rnams rang bzhin bzang na ni/ /khyod kyi ⑩dgongs pa bzhin du 'gyur/ /phal rnams rang bzhin ngan na ni/ /khyod kyi ⑫dgongs pa 96—710

bzhin mi 'gyur/ /gal te gzhung lugs bzang bzhes 1snan/ /gong nas gong du 'phang bar 'gyur/ /ci ste ngan pa'i da —spyod mdzad na/ /'og nas 'og tu ltung bar 'gyur/ /dam pa'i las la gnas na ni/ /khyu mchog dang ni khyu lta bur ④—/ /rjes su 'tsho ba'i skye bo'i thutshogs/ /'di kun rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur / /khyod ni thugya gyu la zhugs na/ /gya gyu kho na'i rjes 'brangs pas/ /skyes ⑦dgu khyod mdzad rjes 'brang ba'i/ /skye dgu de ni nyams par 'gyur/ /de bas bdag gzhan bsrung slad du/ /thugs kyis rab tu bsgrims nas ni/ /gna' rgyal drang srong rnams kyi lugs/ /nyams pa sar par bcos su gsol/ /gna' yi rgyal po'i spyod pa las/ /gang dag bzang ba de mdzod la/ /mi rigs pa ni gang lags de/ /smad par mdzod la spang du gsol/ /sngon gyi bka' khrims skyon chags pa/ /gna' nas mchis kyang rgyun chod la/ /rgyal po ka ni skas 1snamatshan pa'i/ /khrims su bca' ba gsar pa mdzod/ /lha khyod yon tan don gnyer bas/ /yon tan lha bzhin kho nar mdzod/ /lha khyod skyon rnams mkhyen pa yis/ /lha bzhin nyes med kho nar mdzod/ /zla ba mar gyi ngo bzhin du/ /nyes pa'i tshogs rnams 'grib pa dang / /zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du / /rtag tu yon tan gyis brgyan mdzod/ /yab mes rkabazhin du bdag nyid kyis / /chos kyis sa steng bskyang ba dang / /yab mes bzhin du lha gang gi/ /dus ston 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /khyod kyis mtho ris byang grol gye11/ /them skas ma nyurtamanyam mnyam pa'i 11phyir/ /bsod nams las byung bzo rig che/ /rtag tu lha khang dag tu sogs/ /rga dang 'chi bas bsnyengs mdzod de/ /chos bzhin rgyal srid dpal spyad kyinas/ /bgres kar dgon par gshegs su gsol/ /96—711

dam chos bstan pas ①'bras mchis mdzod/ /rang byung rnams kyi rjes bslabs pas②—/ /ku sha'i rigs su 'khrungs khyod kyis/ /yab mes 'phags rigs nyi ma yi/ /gdung rgyud chos lugs ma nyams mdzod/ /skye ba can la nges par ni/ /rga dang 'chi dang na mchis na/ /ma bgres ma bsnyungs ma 'grongs ①zhes/ /legs smon gsol yang ci la sman/ /srid pa dag ni gang yang rung / /de nyid rgas dang 'chi ba lags/ /yongs su bsgyur bas rga ba ste/ /skad cig 'jig pa du'achi ba yi/ /ma rgas ma na ma ⑤'chi zhes/ /smra ba dag ni smra ba na/ /de ltar 'jig rten kun 'bar na/ /yang srid med las gzhan ci yod/ /gang na mi mthun yod ma yin/ /gang du 'du byed 'jig mi 'gyur/ /gang na gcig tu bde bar gnas/ /gang du song na 'chi mi rjo'agyur/ /srid pa kun nas nyon mongs dang / /sdug bsngal 'byung ba phyir ⑦mi mkho/ /de be+ed des pa srid pa rnams—/ /med par bsgom pa rgyas par mdzod/ /'dir ni bgyi ba 'di nyid derka/ /de las gzhan pa'i bgyi mi 'tshal/ /bgyi ba de ni bgyis pa yis/ /mi bgyi ba yi tshar phyin to/ /bgrang phreng bzhin du 'khor ba ru/ /lan mang yongs su 'khor ba ni/ /lan brgya'am yang na stong dag tu/ /'jig rten dag tu ci ma bgyis/ /'di ma bgyis slad ⑧byis pa yi⑨/ /yang dang yang du bgyi 'tshal bas/ /thog ma med pa'i dus can 'di⑩/ /da dung bar du ma log go / /'chi bdag su dang mi bshes ⑪pa/ /glo bur dag tu 'bab 'gyur bas/ /sang dag bya zhes ma bzhes par/ /dam pa'i chos la bsnyur ⑫te mdzod/ /'di sang deng 'di mi bya zhes/ /bya ba mi la bzang po min/ /nam zhig khyod ni med 'gyur ba'i/ /sang de gdon mi za bar 'ong / /'chi bdag brtse ba med pa 96—712

can / /skyes rtsal don med gsod 'gyur ba/ /gsod pa sngon du 'ong bzhin du| /mkhas pa su zhig bag rkyong ①spyod/ /de las ②dpag chen bzod med des| /mda' ni mi bzad 'chor med par①/ /de ni ji srid ma 'phangs pa/ /de srid rang gi don la 'bod/ /rnam smin 'byen pa sngon las kyis/ /khyod ni yongs su btang gyur pa/ /gsar ④pa'i las dang rjes 'brel zhing / /'chi bdag gis ni drangs pa na/ /dge dang sdig pa ma gtogs par/ /'gro ba thams cad phyir log nas/ /'ga' yang khyod rjes mi 'brang bar/ /mkhyen par mdzod la legs par spyod/ /bdag ni snying rjes zil gnon cing / /yid mi dga' ba'i rlan gyis ni/ /shin tu brlan pa'i smre sngags 'di/ /re zhig gsan par mdzad du gsol/ /'gro ba dman pa log ltung ba/ /mgon med nyes med phal cher ni/ /rtswa dang chu dang 'bras bu ni/ /phal pas 'tsho ba sgrub ⑤bgyid pa/ /bya dang ri dwags phyugs dag la/ /rgyal pos gsod dam gsod 'jug parjo/ /ci ga rigs sam mi rigs pa/ /bde la gnas pa khyod nyid gsungs| /khyod ni chen por mi khro zhing / /gnod pa bgyid la'ang ⑦bzod ces gda'⑧/ /khyod kyi thugs rje ⑨dud 'go la⑩/ /kye ma su yis ⑩dgag par babyis⑫| /gnod pa bgyid la bzod mdzad cing ⑫/ /gnod mi bgyid pa 'gums mdzad pas/ /khyod la brtse dang mi brtse ba'ispyo/ /rgyu mthun pa ni gnyis ka gda'/ /sngon chad bgyis ⑫pa'i sug las kyis/ /'di ltar 'ben du gyur pa la/ /khyod nyid gnod pa mdzad na go/ /su la skyabs su mchi ⑩ba gsungs| /gzhan gyis gnod pa barmis na yang / /nyid kyi ⑩phyag gis bshug ⑫'tshal na/ /khyod bzhengs mngon du gnod ⑪mdzad na/ /phyogs kun mun par 96—713

ma gyur tam/ /kun la srog ni phangs pa ste/ /kun la gson pa sdug pa lags//thams cad 'chi ba'i chos can te/ /thams cad sdug bsngal rnams kyis gdungs①//'di ltar gang zhig mi 'tshal ba/ /de nyid kyis ni sdug bsngal te/ /mkhas pa su zhig mgar sdeb ltar/ /tshig pa la ni yang sreg bzhin/ /khyod ni srog gcod mi dgyes shing / /srog gcod dgyes las phyir log na/ /rgyal srid nyams par 'gyur ram ci/ /lugs 'di ci zhig lags pa gsungs/ /mtshon cha'i thabs la mkhas khyod kyis/ /g.yul ngor srol btod mthong lags na/ /gzhan du khyod la ri dwags la/ /ci slad gnod pa'i las rnams mdzad/ /ri dwags gzhon nu'i spyan mnga' ①khyod/ /spyan dang 'dra ba'i ri dwags rnams/ /rtabs nas rig rig lta ba lasarjo/ /ci yi slad du thugs mi rje/ /khyod kyi spyan dang mig 'dra'i phyir/ /khyod la dga' ba gang lags de⑤/ /ri dwags la yang dga' bgyid na/ /khyod ni ji ltar dgyes mi mdzad/ /log par ltung dang spyan 'dra dang / /mgon med yul na gnas pa nyid/ /re re yang ni ri dwags dag /mi 'gums pa yi rgyur rung ngo / /mi rnams la ni mdzad pa bas/ /sdug bsngal lhag par brtags pa yi/ /dud 'gro rnams la ches lhag par/ /khyod kyi rjothugs rjes mdzad du gsol/ /khyod nyid bsrung ⑦ba'i don 'di la/ /bdag gis thal mo sbyar mi 'tshal/ /rgyud gzhan gsal ⑧bas gus bgyis par/ /legs par thugs tshod mnga' ⑨lags grang / /co nas bzung ste basbab sbyang ba/ /dam pa rnams kyi ⑩lugs su grags/ /de ltar lags pas rgyal po la/ /bu sdug bzhin du gsol ba lags/ /gal te bdag gis mi phan pa/ /gsol na bdag la chad pas khum/ /ci ste gcig tu phan gsol na/ /bdag gis gsol ba 96—714

bzhin du mdzod/ /gal te mi dgyes mdzad par ma gyur na/ /bdag gis yang dang yang du gsol bar 'tshal/ /ci ste bdag tshig khyad du 'gums mdzad na/ /bka' mchid 'di ni nges par btang bar bgyi/ /dgyes par gyur na slar rjes stimi 'gums te/ /mi dgyes gyur na dog sa gzung ④bar 'tshal/ /gnod bgyid nyi ma ltar rngo mi thogs pas/ /sa bdag zla ba nya ①ba bzhin du mdzod—/ /sa bdag tsher ma'i shing las dusbrang rtsi ltar/ /dgra bo las kyang legs par smras pa gzung / /gser gyi ri la rjodug rgyun ji bzhin du/ /yid 'ong skye bo'i tshig ngan spang 'tshal lo/ /mi mchog gal te legs par mdzad pa'i sbyor bas bsgrubs gyur te/ /pha rol gnod pa sel ba'i dpal 'di yon tan rgyan rnams kyis/ /phyug par bgyid rjon legs spyad brgya la chags phyir g.yo ba'i snying / /mi brten ⑦pa yang rang dbang med par yun ring khyod la chags/ /slob dpon ma ti ⑧tsi tras rgyal po chen po ka nis dhika la springs pa'i spring ⑩yig rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā tumeka ra pra bhā dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de rin chen mchog gis bsgyur/ ā tusngetsār+ya dpal brtsegs ⑫kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa'o⑩// //96—715
