na415༄ga /sems rin po che rnam par sbyang ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba'i spring yig①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsit+ta ②rat+na bi sho dha na kra ma nā ma le kha/bod skad du/ sems rin po che rnam par sbyang ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba'i spring yig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa gsum dbang phyug skye dgu chos kyis skyong mdzad pa/ /lha mi'i bla ma 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyi yab/ /rgol ba tshar gcod rang gi 'khor gyi dga' skyed ①pa//chos kyi rgyal po gcig pu de ni rgyal gyur cig /blo zhan bdag 'dras gzhan la skul rjobar mi nus shing / /bskul bas phan par 'gyur ba'ang deng sang nyung mod kyi⑤—/ /'on kyang sa yi bdag po khyod kyis nongs pa yal bor nasadu/ /'gro mang de 'drar 'gyur 'di ma bzod khyod la bskul/ /mi skyong khyod kyi dbang phyug 'di ni sngon chad nyid kyi thugs/ /gdul dka' legs par btul las brnyes ⑦kyi gzhan gyis byin pa dang / /sa yi rum nas 'thon dang gnam babs lta zhig 96—718

ga la lags/ /sa bdag dpal 'di mi nyams bzhed na da dung thugs thul 'tshal| /gang zhig phan na de ni brtags te dka' yang mdzad rigs la/ /gang zhig mi phan de ni bsgrub par sla yang gtang ①ba'i rigs/ /de phyir sngon tshe thub chen rgyal bu zla bar gyur pa yis/ /rgyal po su ta sa yi bu la gdams pa smras pas kyang ④/ /rgyal po gcig pus g.yul ngor dmag gi dpung las rgyal/ /sems tsam tshar gcad phyir ni sngar ma ma mdzad cig /mi yi bdag po 'jig rten phyi ma'ang gzigs par ④rigs/ /de bas dgyes kyang phan pa ma yin bsten mi rigs/ /zhes so/ /de phyir gang gis dman pa'i rigs su ltung byed pa—/ /nga rgyal dgra spangs bdag gi tshig 'di sang phyir yang / / ci nas ④mi bdag khyod kyis gus pas gsan rigs te/ /legs smras byis las blangs ⑤zhes thub chen gsal bar gsungs/ /sa bdag tsher ma'i shing las sbrang rtsi bzhin/ /dgra bo las kyang legs smras gzung bar bya/ /gser gyi ri las dug gi chu rgyun bzhin| /yid 'ong skye bo'i tshig ngan spang 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /gang zhig ma btul mnar med sogs/ /sdug bsngal bzod dkar skyed dubyed cing / /de nyid btul bas lha mi dang / /'jig rten min pa'i bde ba'ang 'thob/ /rab tu mthu ldan sems 'di ni/ /mkhas pa su zhig 'dul mi byed/ /'dir sems ni rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba rtag tu rnam par mi rtog pa'i rang bzhin yin mod kyi/ lus dang ngag bran lta bu dang bcas pa glo bur gyi nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dag gis dkrugs pa ste/ de'i phyir 'di dag rnam par sbyangs te nor bu chu shel byu 'od ltar rab tu 'od gsal ba'i rang bzhin dkrug ⑦ma dang bral ba bskyed de/ 'di tsam ni mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 96—719

'das pa'o/ /de la 'dir bsdu ①na sems de dkrugs pas rtog pa can du byed cing / /lus dang ngag bran ltar 'khol ②ba ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ thams cad kyi rgyu rnam par rtog pa mang ba dang / 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / /gti mug shas che ba'o/ /de la gang rnam par rtog pa mang pa ①des ni rlung gi ting nge 'dzin la dmigs pas de spang bar bya ste/ bgrang dang rjes 'gro 'jog pa dang / rtog pa dang ni bsgyur ba dang / /yongs dag rnam pa drug tu 'dod//de ni bgrang ba dang / rjes su 'gro ba dang / 'jog pa dang / nye bar rtog pa dang / sgyur ba dang / yongs su dag pa ste rgyu drug dang ldan na yongs su rdzogs pa yin no/ /de la bgrang ba zhes bya ba ni/ /dbugs rngub pa dang dbugs 'byung ba dag la sems gtad nas mngon par 'du bya ba med par lus dang sems rnal du bzhag ste dran pa tsam rmis gcig dang gnyis nas bcu'i bar du bgrang bar byed pa'o/ /sems mngon par bsdus pa dang rjornam par g.yeng bar dogs pas ha cang mang ba dang nyung ngur ni ma yin no/ /de la skyon ni gsum yod de/ gal te gcig la gnyis su brtsis na lhag par bgrang ba'i skyon yod de⑤/ /gal te gnyis la gcig tu 'dzin na ma tshang bar bgrang ba'i duskyon no/ /gal te dbugs rngub pa la dbugs 'byin par 'dzin tam dbugs 'byin pa la dbugs dze+erngub par 'dzin na 'chol ⑧bar 'dzin pa'i ⑨skyon no/ /de las gzhan pa ni yang dag par bgrang ba yin no/ /bar skabs su sems rnam par g.yengs ⑩na/ yang mgo nas ji srid du ting nge 'dzin ma thob kyi bar du bgrang bar bya'o/ /rjes su 'gro ba zhes bya ba ni 'di dag ji srid cig ⑪tu 'byung ngam 'jug /ci 'di dag lus thams cad la khyab pa dag gcig gam 96—720

phyogs 'ga' zhig nas rgyu ba dag yin zhes mngon par 'du bya ba med par dbugs rngub pa dang / /dbugs 'byung ba'i rjes su 'gro ba ste/ de 'jug pa na sgog ma dang / snying ga dang / lte ba dang / rked pa dang / brla dang /byin par 'jug pa'i rim gyis rkang pa gnyis kyi bar du rjes su 'gro la/ 'byung ba na mtho gang dang 'dom gang gi bar du 'byung ngo / /gzhan dag na re rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang rnam par 'thor byed kyi rlung gi bar du'o zhes zer te/ 'di ni de kho na nyid ①yid la byed pa'i phyir rigs pa sdeyin no/ /'jog pa zhes bya ba ni ⑦nor bu'i thag pa bzhin du sna'i rtse mo nas rkang pa'i mthe bo'i bar du gnas par lta zhing ci 'di dag phan 'dogs par byed pa zhig gam/ gnod par rjobyed pa zhig gam/ grang ngam dro ba zhig ces rtog pa'o/ /nye bar rtog pa zhes bya ba ni 'di dag ni rlung 'ba' zhig ma yin gyi 'byung ba chen po bzhi po dag dang 'byung ba dag las mngon par grub pa'i rgyur byas pa'i gzugs dang / de dag la brten pa'i sems dang sems las byung ba rnams kyang yod do zhes phung po lnga nye bar rtog pa'o/ /sgyur ba zhes bya ba ni rlung la dmigs pa'i blo bsgyur te chos kyi mchog gi bar du blo gong nas gong du dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams la yang dag par sbyor ba'o—/ /yongs su dag pa ni mthong ba'i lam la sogs pa la 'jug pa'o/ /gzhan dag na re sgyur ba ni dran pa nye bar gzhag ⑤pa nas rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bar yin la/ rnam par dag pa ni zad pa shes pa la sogs pa yin no zhes zer ro/ /'di lta bu ni slob dpon dbyeg gnyen gyi zhal snga nas ji ltar bris pa kho bos 'dir yang bris par shes par bya'o/ /de ltar rim pa drug po de dag gi rjolas ni/ ji skad du 'phags pa sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo 96—721

las gsungs pa bzhin te/ de las ni ji ltar dran pa'i dbang gis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba la rtog ce na/ /yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du bgrang ba dang / rjes su 'gro ba dang / zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong dang / 'jug pa dang / yongs su dag pa la rtog go/ /de la bgrang bas ni bya ba'i las kyi dngos po rnam pa gnyis byed par 'gyur te/rten du gyur pas rnam par rtog pa dang rnam par dpyod pa gnyis thul pas①/dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba'i mtshan nyid 'dzin par nus pa'o/ /rjes su 'gro bas kyang bya ba'i las kyi dngos po rnam pa ④gnyis byed par 'gyur te/ yang dag par 'byung ba la brten ①cing / rnam par rtog pa dang rnam par dpyod pa dang bral ba dang / dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba'i 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid la mkhas par 'gyur ba'o/ /zhi gnas kyis ni bya ba'i las kyi dngos po rnam pa gnyis byed par 'gyur te/ dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba 'bri dubar mngon du ston pa dang /ting nge 'dzin gyi mchog la gnas par nus pa'o/ /lhag mthong gis kyang bya ba'i las kyi dngos po rnam pa gnyis byed par 'gyur te/ dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba zad par mngon du ston pa dang / sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos so sor rtog ⑤pa la gnas pa'o/ /'jug pas kyang bya ba'i las kyi dngos po rnam pa gnyis byed par 'gyur te/ nye bar len pa'i phung po spong ba'i sbyor ba la mkhas pa dang / 'phags pa'i sar 'jug pa la sbyor ba'o/ /yongs su dag pas kyang bya ba'i las kyi dngos po rnam pa gnyis byed par 'gyur te/ kun nas nyon mongs pa sgong ba dang / lta ba yongs su dag pa'o zhes so/ /de ltar dbugs thung ngu rngubs na yang dbugs thung ngu rngubs so snyam du yang dag pa ji lta ba dhi96—722

bzhin du rab tu shes so①zhes bya ba la sogs pa bcu drug kyang legs par rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /'dir rnam par rtog pa mang ba la bstan pa ni gtsor byas kyi yon tan ma lus pa 'di la brten ④pas na thar pa'i grong khyer gyi sgo 'byed pa ni dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba dran pa yin te zhes gsungs so/ /ji ltar zhe na rab tu gdul dga' ④ba'i sems zhes brjod pa de ni rlung las gud du ma dmigs pa'i phyir te/ de bas na sems zhes bya ba de ni rlung du brjod do zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar mi bdag khyod kyis rlung gi phra dang zab mkhyen nas/ /yun ring dus nas rnam rtog dgra yis rab tu gtses rjopas shin tu yang / /mnyel zhing skyo ba'i thugs ni deng nas ngal bsos rtog dgra bzlog pa dang / /lo yis ma yin gus par sbyor bas ⑤zhag gi rim pas rtog bral mdzod/ /de nas rim gyis yongs su dag pa'i mthar yang khyod kyi thugs gzhol rjon/ /sa bdag khyod kyi skye ba 'bras bcas de nas chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur/ /de yi bar du lha mi'i bde ba tshad med rnams la dgyes bzhin du/ /thugs btul mthu yis spyod pa ⑦'di la the tshom med par mngon sum gnas/ /rnam par rtog pa'i gnyen po bshad zin te/ /sems kyi rtog pa sbyang ba'i rim pa'o/ /mi skyong khyod kyi thugs ni gal te bud med kyis phrogs na/ /'di ni ④sa yi bdag po'i ⑨mthu rtsal rab tu dman pa ste/ /gang gi ⑩g.yul chen 'jigs su rung ba gzhom pa'i thabs mkhyen na/ /mi gtsang kun snong ⑪mngon gyur bud med mtshan nyid mi mkhyen 'di mtshar che/ /shin tu yid 'ong tsher ma'i gnod pa'ang mi bzod lus 'di ni/ /bud med bsten pa'i rgyu las 'di dang slad pa ⑫mgo gcod sogs/ /rab tu bzod dka'i sdug bsngal 'byung 'di nyid kyis ⑫mngon sum na/ /'on 96—723

kyang bla ma'i bka' yis 'dod chags zhi bar byed pa mdor brjod bgyi/ /chags pa can rnams kyi gnyen po ni rus gong yid la bya ba yin te/ keng rus chags can thams cad la zhes bshad pas so/ /ji ltar zhe na/ rus pa rgya mtsho'i bar du ni/ /spro zhing sdud pas las dang po/ /rkang rus dang ni thod phyed par/ /btang bas sbyang ba byas par bshad/ /smin ma'i bar du sems 'dzin pas/ /yid la byed pa rdzogs pa yin/ /zhes bshad pa'i rim pas so/ /gzhan yang byes pa rnams ni phal cher kha dog dang / dbyibs dang / reg pa 'jam pa dang / bsnyen bkur la chags te/ de dag gi gnyen por ni rnam par bsngos pa dang / rnam par dmar ba dang / rnam par tshig pa dag yid la byed pas kha dog la chags pa dag sel to/ /rnam par rnags pa dang /rnam par zos pa dang / rnam par 'thor ba dag yid la byed pas ni dbyebs la chags pa sel bar byed do①/ /rnam par dbus gzhig ④pa dang rus gong rgyus pas 'brel ba dag yid la byed snepas ni reg bya 'jam pa la chags pa sel to/ /rnam par bam pa'i ro mi g.yo ba rkyal ba stong pa bus pa lta bu/ rdo ltar bsnyen bkur byed pa dang bral ba yid la byed pas ni rkang pa bkru ba la sogs pa'i bsnyen bkur la chags pa sel bar byed do/ /gzhan yang rnam par phye ste brjod na / sngo bsangs la sogs pa'i kha dog la chags pa zhig na rnam par bsngos par yid la bya'o/ /tsan+dan dang ga bur la sogs pa'i dris byugs pa'i lus la chags pa lta na rnam par rnags par yid la bya'o/ /mtshan sprad pa'i reg bya la chags pa zhig na rnam par 'bus gzhig ④par yid la bya'o/ /dbyebs phun sum tshogs pa la chags pa ⑤lta na rnam rjopar bam par yid la bya'o/ /rgyan gyis 96—724

mdzes pa'i lus la chags pa zhig na rnam par dmar bar yid la bya'o/ /sha rgyas pa'i lus la chags pa zhig na rnam par zos par yid la bya'o/ /'khyud pa dang 'o byas pa la sogs pa'i rtse ①'jo la chags pa'i dus na rnam par 'thor bar yid la bya'o/ /kha dog dang dbyibs phun sum tshogs pa la chags par gyur na rnam par tshig par yid la bya'o/ /so ⑧rnams dkar ba la chags pa'i tshe na rus gong gi yid la byed pas snezhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rab tu mi bzad nags bsregs dhime lce'i tshogs/ /char rgyun drag pos skad cig zhi byed ltar/ /byis pa'i nags tshal thal bar byed pa yi/ /'dod chags me chen mi sdug char gyis 'joms/ /'jig rten gnod pa'i rtsa ba ji snyed pa/ /kun gyi ⑤phul byung 'khrig pa'i 'dod chags te/ /sa bdag 'di mkhyen 'dod las phyir ltos dang / /rab tu dgyes pa byes pas ma myong ba/ /bsam gtan bde bas lus la phan 'dogs shing / /kha na ma jo med pa myong ba'i rigs/ /'dod chags dang bcas pa'i sems sbyang ba'i rim pa ste/ 'dod chags kyi gnyen po bshad zin to // //rjolha mi'i bla mas gang du 'bad pas bkag gyur pa⑦/ /de ni 'go la byams dang snying rje med pa ste/ /de phyir mi dbang khyod kyis thub la gus pa dang / /nyid kyi thugs kyang dam pa'i grangs su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /gang la skra rtses gzung bya'i skye bo de la yang / /nyid kyi sras bzhin gces shing byams pas bskyang bar dze+erigs / /bshes gnyen dam pa'i lung gis goms par byas pa las/ /srin po sha za seng ge sogs kyang 'gro la byams/ /de phyir mi dbang khyod kyis dhithugs ni 'jam pa dang / /'gro ba bskyang las nam yang phyir ldog ma mdzad cig /96—725

legs pa'i lam ni ji snyed bstan pa dag las kyang / /gtso bor gyur pa byams dang snying rjer dam pas gsungs/ /'di ji ltar bsgom par bya zhe na/ dang por rang gi ma'am pha'am bu'am bu mo'am/ 'byel pa gnyis sam/ gang yang rung ba cig bde ba ma lus pa dang phrad par gyur cig snyam pa dang / bdag gis de dang phrad par bya'o zhes pa dang / nus pa lta na dngos su de bsgrub pa dang / phrad pa la phrag dog med pa nyi ma 'ga' zhig gus par bsgom mo/ /de nas ni de bas cung zad mi gcugs pa la'o①/ /rim gyes bar ma la'o /de nas dgra bo dman pa la'o/ /de nas de'i ②bar ma la'o/ /de nas de dgra bo rab tu ma rungs pa la'o/ /de la ma la sogs pa dang mnyam pa thob pa na grong dang grong khyer pa la'o/ /de nas ni yul dang ljongs dang gling gcig dang gnyis la sogs pa nas stong spyi phud dang / stong gnyis bar ma dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā ①klung gi bye ma snyed la sogs par byams pas khyab par byas te/ de nas gzhung de bzhin du sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig ces pa dang / sdug bsngal dang bral ba la dga' ba dang / de dag 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la dgod par bya'o zhes bya ba'i dhirim pas snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms rnams bsgom mo/ /dang po nyid du sdug cing yid du 'ong ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi ⑤byams pa yid la ma byas par ni sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i snying rje ga la 'jug ste/ de ltar rim pa gzhan yang ngo / /gnod par sems pa'i yid tsam bor bas kyang / /'khor los sgyur nyid thob par thub pas gsungs/ /byams sogs goms las 'chi med ma brnyes kyang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bde ba rgya chen thobadu/ /de phyir mi rje 96—726

khyod kyis gang spyod pa①/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi yis ni gnas par rigs/ /khyod kyis 'byor pa dug can zas bzhin du/ /bor nas gcig pu gzhan du gshegs 'tshal na/ /grogs bzang 'dod ②med dge ba de bkri'i phyir/ /thugs ni rnam par sbyang bar cis mi mdzad/ /zhe sdang dang bcas pa'i sems sbyang ba'i rim pa ste/ zhe sdang gi gnyen po bshad zin to // //①rang dang gzhan dang gnyis ka las skye dang / /rgyu med 'byung zhes smra ba gang lags pa/ /'di dag log par smra ba phung khrol ba/ /legs par spyad kyang 'bras bu mi 'dod 'byin/ /de phyir khyod kyis rten cing 'brel 'byung ba/ /lta ngan sel du'ajoms thub pa'i man ngag mchog /bdud rtsi'i mchog 'di myur du gsol ba yis/ /dkar phyogs ma lus rgyas shing brtan por mdzod/ /rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba ji lta bu zhe na/ 'di lta ste ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed—/ 'du byed kyi ⑤rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa/ rnam par shes pa'i rkyen gyis ming dang gzugs/ ming dang gzugs kyi rkyen gyis skye mched drug /de'i rkyen gyis reg pa/ de'i rkyen gyis tshor ba/ de'i rkyen gyis sred pa/ de'i rkyen gyis len pa/ de'i rkyen byis srid pa/ de'i rkyen gyis skye ba/ de'i rkyen gyis rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur te/ /de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'di 'ba' zhig 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes shes rab kyi mig gis lta dubar byas te rgyu med pa la sogs pa bsal lo/ /don 'di ni 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ gang du ma rig skye 96—727

'gyur ba/ /nyon mongs rgyu ni tshul bzhin min/ /de yi rkyen ni 'du byed de/ /sdug bsngal bar du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / gang gis sems can dag 'gyur ba/ /rgyu gnyis dang ni rkyen gnyis te/ /gzhan las rjes su mthun sgra dang / /nang du tshul bzhin lta ba'o/ /de bzhin rgyu ni zhi gnas te/ /lhag mthong yang ni rkyen yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar srid pa 'byung ba'i rim pa la yid ches par byas nas/ yang ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gag ①pa nas sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'di 'ba' zhig 'gag par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar du yid la bya'o/ /de nas rtag par ma yin pa dang / chad par ma yin pa dang / 'pho bar ma yin pa dang / de dang 'dra ba'i rgyud du ④'jug pa dang / rgyu chung ngu las 'bras bu chen po 'byung ba snezhes nges par bzung duste/ phyi rol yang sa bon las myu gu dang de las 'dab ma dang / de las sdong bu dang / de las me tog dang / de las 'bras bu 'byung zhing rgyu de dag dang rkyen du'abrel bar 'byung ba khams bzhi dang nam mkha' dang rjodus kyi khams te/ rnam pa bcu gnyis po 'di dag tsam mo zhes 'byung ba dang /'gag pa las ⑦rgyu med pa dang / mi mthun pa'i rgyu spangs te 'dir skeni mdor bsdus nas rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yid la byas pas rig pa bskyed pa dang /ma rig pa'i ngo bo'am de las 'byung ba'i log par lta ba spang ba'o/ /gal te rgyas par yid la byed pa lta zhig na rang rang gi mtshan nyid dang / ming gi don dang / las tha dad pa dang / yan lag lngas yang dag par bsdus pa dang /yan lag gsum gyis yang dag par bsdus pa dang / gsum las gnyis 'byung ba dang / gnyis las bdun 'byung ba dang / bdun las gsum 'byung ba 96—728

dang / dus gsum pa'i ngo bor gzhag ①pa dang / rkyen dang 'byel ba dag yid la bya'o/ /sa bdag rten cing 'brel 'byung mkhyen na snang bas mun pa bzhin / /khyod kyi thugs la gnas pa'i gti mug go skabs ga la mchis/ /'di mkhyen srid pa'i 'khor lo phra zhing zab pa gzigs pa'i phyir/ /shes rab ye shes spyan gnyis dri med lung gi sman byugs gzigs/ /ji skad du 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas kyang / /rten cing 'byel par 'byung 'di rgyal ba yi/ /gsung gi mdzod kyi gces pa zab mo ste/ /gang gis 'di ni yang dag mthong ba des| /sangs rgyas de nyid rig pa rnam mchog mthong / /zhes bstan to/ /gti mug dang bcas pa'i sems sbyang ba'i rim pa ste/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yid la byed pa bshad zin to // //②mi yi bdag po gal te phra ba'i thugs kyi go skabs su/ /thog ma'i rtsom med ①dus can sdig pa'i rtsa ba'i rtog dgra 'di/ /zhen pa gnas snyam zhum pa'i rtog pa mi bzad zhugs gyur na/ /de yi gnyen por brten tshucing skyes pa'i dngos pos ⑤rang bzhin gzigs/ /dri med me long ngos la skyes pa'i bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan gang / /gal te yang dag gnas na rkyen la rag las mi 'gyur zhing / /slar 'di rnam par 'jig 'gyur go skabs can du ga la 'gyur/ /de phyir dngos med rkyen la rag las gcig pu rnam par spang rjo/ /ji ltar gnas pa'i rang bzhin 'di yang legs par rnam ⑦dpyad na/ /rab tu phra rdul bar du 'gyur zhes dam pas dang por gsungs/ /gal te dngos yod de dag shes rab cis mi 'bab/ /de phyir de yang phyogs cha'i bye brag dag gis ga la gnas/ /96—729

rin chen sems kyi khyad par 'ga' zhig sna tshogs snang zhe na/ /de bzhin 'di la'ang skad cig ces bya rab phra dam pas gsungs/ /skad cig skad cig ces bya'i gang dag phra la rnam par rmongs/ /de yang ji ltar thog ma dbus mtha' dag tu ①blta mi nus/ /de'i phyir rin po che'i phreng ba las/ /skad cig ji ltar mtha' yod ltar/ /jog ma dang dbus de ltar brtag /skad cig rang bzhin gsum gyi phyir/ /'jig rten skad cig la mi gnas/ /zhes bstan to/ /de ltar 'di dag phyi dang nang du bcas pa gcig min zhing / /de nyid phyir na de yi rang bzhin rnam bsags du ma'ang min/ /'di dag las dben dngos po shes rab mig gis ②'ga' ma dmigs/ /des na 'di dag mtha' gnyis grol bar dam pas gsal bar gsungs/ /de bzhin gcig gis gcig nyid skyes ①pa mngon sum 'gal mthong ste/ /rab tu phra ba'i 'bras bu rgyu ni gcig min la ltos ④par—/ /'gro ba'i mngon sum nyid du ston pa bzhin du nges par gnas/ /de bzhin gcig gis gcig min skyed ⑤sogs thams cad gnod par bcas/ /dngos rnams thug med ma lus slar skyed 'gyur 'di bzlog dka'i phyir/ /yod pa 'ga' zhig skye zhes 'di ni sus kyang smra mi nus/ /gang med 'ga' zhig skye na med pa'i tha snyad su zhig 'jog /de phyir bdag las skye sogs 'di dag mkhas pas rtsa nas bton/ de ltar khyod kyi rjoshes rab spyan gsal dri med rnam rgyas ⑦pas—/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung mtshan nyid 'di la yun ring gzigs pa na/ /thog med srid rgyud bsags pa'i bsnyengs gnas rab tu phra ba yang / /gang na'ang gnas par 'gyur 'di gzigs min mi bdag gang gis zhum/ /de ltar ni 'phags pa mi pham pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'di la bsal bya ⑧ci yang med/ /96—730

bsnan par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta①/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas kyang / mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan 'das/ /bya ba byas pa'ang de nyid yin//zhes gsungs so/ / des na ②gang la dga' ba'am yang dag skrag nas 'di ci zhig /bskal pa bye bar bsgrubs kyang brtan gnas ①de ni su yis nus/ /gang zhig nam mkha' ④gzhom zhes 'bad pa'ang blun te rnam par ngal ci'i phyir zhe na gdod nas ma skyes de la su yis dgag /de 'dra'i gnas med 'dir gnas ye shes can te rtag bde ldan/ /gang la rnam rtog med 'di bde zhes thub pas gsal bar gsungs/ /'di spangs lha yul 'dod pas ⑤rab tu yid 'phrog byed pa dang / /'khor los sgyur ba'i 'byor ba'ang dam pas tsher ma'i gnod 'drar gsungs/ sa bdag 'on kyang gnas 'dir shin tu dgyes par ma gyur cig /ci 0phyir zhe na bdag gzhan phan pa mi bzod 'byor las khyod/ /rnam par rtsang ba'i sgo mo mi mkhas rnams la 'di rab spang ⑦/ /kha cig sgo 'dir rab dga' 'jug la snying brtse ring du spangs/ /gzhan dag gnas 'dir 'khrul sgephyir las 'bras thal ba bzhin du byed/ /gzhan dag shin tu med las sangs rgyas yon tan bsam yas 'dod/ /'di 'dra 'di dag sgo 'dir zhugs nas ⑨rang gzhan de las nyams/ /de phyir 'di ni yan lag ldan par bags kyis ⑫bsten par bgyi/ /de ltar ni 'phags pa dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa ⑩zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo las kyang / ming yang yod dang yod ma yin par tshig gis gsungs/ /rgyu la brten ⑫te byung ba'i chos ni 'di kun te/ /'di la bdag med tshor ba po dang byed med kyang / /dge dang mi dge'i las 96—731

rnams cung zad med mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i de bzhin nyid bsam gyis mi khyab par yid la bya'o/ /mi dbang yan lag bzhi po 'di tsam gyis/ /khyod kyi thugs kyi dri ma rags pa rnams/ /nges par bsal 'gyur 'di la dgos pa mdzad/ /de las gong du khyad par rnam bzhed na/ /dkyil 'khor byug pa sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /skye ba gzhan du 'byor ba mi zad ①pa/ /da lta'i bzhed pa nyid kyi phyag gnas ltar/ /slu ba med par bdag gis brjod par bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra re khe hūṃ/ gtsang spyod pa yi lci ba ni/ /chu dang 'o ma zho dang mar/ /thams cad de las byung ba dag /snod gtsang bskol te chu rnams dbo/ /tshigs ma dor te dbus kyi chas/ /dbyibs ci dga' ba'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ /sa bdag khru gang yan chad par/ /gsang sngags don ④la gzhol bar byug /de nas de ni gus pa yis/ rgyal ba sras gsum bcas la 'bul/ /mjug tu thub pas gsungs pa yi/ /tshigs bcad 'di dag brjod par bya/ /ba yi phyi ba chur bcas sbyin pa ste/ /legs par byug ①par byed pa tshul khrims so/ /srin bu grog sbur bsal ba bzod pa yin/ /bya ba la ni nyer zhugs brtson 'grus te/ /de yi skad cig sems ni gcig byed pa//bsam gtan shes rab ri mo gsal buba'o/ /thub pa'i maṇ+ḍal byas pa yis/ /pha rol phyin pa 'di drug 'thob/ /gser gyi mdog tu 'gyur ba ste/ /nad rnams kun dang bral bar 'gyur/ /zla ba ltar mdzes gsal ba yi/ /lha dang mi ni dam par skye/ /nor dang gser ni 'byor ba yi/ /rgyal po'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i pho brang mchog /maṇ+ḍal gang zhig byed pa gang / /sdig pa thams cad mi byed cing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs pa dang //96—732

rang gi sems ni yongs 'dul ba/ /'di dag sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsngags/ /zhes so/ /de nas dge ba de nyid rgyu mtshan du byas la①/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing / /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /bdag ni khyed la rnams sdekun dbul/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /dam chos 'khor lo mchog bskor dang / /yongs su mya ngan 'das spang phyir/ /bdag ni khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /'di sogs dge ba'i las rnams ni/ /byang chub bla na med par bsngo/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal khyar chen bor ba'i phyir/ /bdag gi ①sems ni byang chub phyir bskyed de/ /ma bsgral bsgral dang ma grol dgrol ba dang / /dbugs ma phyin pa bdag gis dbugs dbyung ste/ /mya ngan ma 'das bdag gis mya ngan bzla/ /de ltar byang chub kyi sems rab tu brtan 0par bskyed la ji ltar 'dod pa'i bya ba dge ba la 'jug par bya'o/ /mi dbang khyod thugs sbyangs pas dge ba rgya chen dag la dgyes bskyed na/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rgya chen ⑤spel mdzad der yang khyod kyi thugs ni rma dhimed 'bad 'tshal te/ /sems ma bsrungs pa'i skyes bu'i dgo la 'jug pa bu chu'i rgyun khrus ltar/ /phan dang 'byel ba'i gnod pa'ang rab tu ma rungs gyur pa'i gnas skabs mchis/ /gnas 'di mkhas pas gzigs nas mthu ldan nyid kyi thugs ni bsrung ⑦'tshal lo/ /de ltar bsnyengs dang bral na mang du gsol ci 'tshal / /phan pa'i man ngag don po 'di lags te/ /khyod kyi thugs thul mdzod cig ⑧bcom ldan gyis/ /sems ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags zhes gsungs/ /tshigs su bcad pa gcig pu 'di 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mkhar gyi rgyal 96—733

po bde spyod la gdams pa bshes pa'i spring yig las bdag gis drangs pa'o/ /mi skyong khyod ni gal te gsang ba'i lam la dgyes pa na/ /lam der ①rab tu rtogs dka' sems la rma 'byin tshig 'phros te/ /bud med 'khyud sogs tshul khrims ②ma yin yid la byed par ldan/ /kha cig mngon sum 'khrig dang drag shul spyod la 'jug pa ste/ /mi dbang thugs la gnod na thub pa'i bka' yang dug dang 'dra/ /de phyir khyod kyis gsang ba'i lam du zhugs pa'i rgyu mtshan las//khyod thugs 'dod chags la sogs dri mas gos pa 'di ni spangs④/ /gang gzhan skye bo de 'dra bzlog par khyod kyis rnam bsgrub rigs/ /don 'di ni④/zhu ba'i 'og tu za ba la/ /mar gyi nying khu ka ra dang / /sbrang rtsi dag ni bdud rtsi bzhin/ /ma zhu za ba dug tu 'gyur/ /de bzhin rab rgyas bdud rtsi mchog /dgongs pa'i tshig la mi mkhas shing / /byis pa'i blo dang ldan rnams la/ /mi bzad pa yi dug tu 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di ni 'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo las gsungs pa bdag gis 'dir bris pa'o/ /rin chen sems 'di rnam par sbyang ba'i phyir/ /thub pa'i bka' lung cung zad 'dir bris pas/ /sa yi bdag po thugs ni dri med pa/ /ston ka'i zla rgyas lta bur gsal gyur cig /'gro ba'ang rim gyis sems ni rnam sbyangs te/ /mu nyig dri med 'bru ltar rnam dag shog /sems rin po che rnam par sbyang ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba'i spring yig slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' chen po dgra las rgyal ba dugasang bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar byi mkhan po ā tsār+ya dudu lo pa dang / lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //96—734

༄ga /bla ma la sprung ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ gu ru le kha/ bod skad du/ bla ma la spring ba②/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi don du stug po bkod par sangs rgyas nas/ /dga' ldan skye bo'i don mdzad phyir ni dam pa tog dkar gyurasne/ /de nas 'dir ni 'gro ba'i don du shākya thub gyur gang / /kun mkhyen nyes bral ngo bo nyid med de ni rgyal gyur cig /bla ma mkhas pa blo gros rgya che dhil/ /'dod sred bag med nyon mongs spang ba'i thabs//thub pa'i gsung bzhin mdor bsdus brjod pa 'di/ /sman bzhin phan par brtags nas gsan ⑤pa'i rigs/ /ji ltar rigs ngan lag nas rin chen mchog /blo ldan skye bos rab gus len pa ltar/ /kun rmongs bdag gis brtse bas gsol ba yi/ /spring rjoyig 'di ni rab gus blang bar 'os/ /ston pa'i mdo sde zab cing rgya chen ⑦rnams/ /mkhan po nyid kyi ⑧thugs su chud mod kyi/ /96—737

lus kyi don du gsod ①pa'i kha zas ltar/ /bdag gis brjod pa 'di yang bstan dze+epar mdzod/ /ri dwags glang po phye ma leb dang nya/ /sbrang ma lnga po lnga yis bcom gyur na/ /gcig gis bcom na gang gis lnga po kun/ /rtag tu bsten na ci phyir bcom mi 'gyur/ /'dod pa rnams ni kun nas 'bar ba ste/ /rab tu smad cing bsad dang dgra bo yin/ /phyir rgol ba dang rtswa yi sgron me dang //kim snepa ka yi 'bras bu ral gri'i so/ /me mdag spungs pa dug gi lo ma dang / /lcags kyu tsher ma mi gtsang rlubs lta bu/ /'dod pa'i rgyus ni sems can dmyal bar ltung / /yi dwags rnams dang dud 'gror skye bar 'gyur/ /'dod la brkam pa bde 'gror mi skye zhing / /mya ngan 'das pa nam yang thob mi 'gyur/ /dal rnyed shes rab ldan gyur cing / /rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs pa khyod/ /'dod dang sred pa bag med dang / /nyon mongs rnams ni spang bar ④mdzod/ /kun rtog las ni 'dod skye bas/ /'dod pa'i rtsa ba mkhyen nas ni/ /khyod ni kun rtog ma mdzad dang / / de ni ⑤khyod la 'byung mi 'gyur/ /'dod pa rnams las mya ngan skye/ /'dod pa rnams las 'jigs pa 'byung / /'dod pa dag ni rnam spangs na/ /mya ngan med cing 'jigs pa med/ /'dod pa'i rnam smin sdug bsngal te/ /dang po mngar la 'bras bu tsha/ /me sgon lag nas ma bor na/ /mjug tu byis pa sreg byed bzhin/ /nor bu'i rna cha bu dang chung ma la/ /yongs su chags sems gang yin la ltos rjon/ /lcags shing gres dze+em las byas chings ma gang / /de dag dam po min zhes 'phags pa gsungs⑧/ /'dod pa'i chings ma gang yin de lhod kyang / /rab tu dgrol bar dka' zhes 'phags pas gsungs⑨/ /brtan rnams 'dod pa'i bde la mi lta bar/ /de 96—738

dag gtubs nas myur du 'gro bar byed/ /'jig rten sna tshogs gang de 'dod min gyi/ /skyes bu'i kun rtog 'dod chags 'dod pa yin/ /'jig rten sna tshogs de la gnas kyang ni/ /'on kyang 'jig rten 'di na 'dun pa 'dul/ /mi rnams la ni brten ①pa'i 'dod pa med/ /'dod pa gang la chags te mi rtag pas| /yang srid med phyir sems kyis rab spangs ④la/ /'chi ba'i gnas mi 'gyur bar gyis zhes gsungs/ /'dun pa bskyed cing zag par mi byed dang / /sems la skyon med pa dang dran pa dang / /'dod pa rnams la so sor ma chags gang / /de ni gong du 'pho ba yin zhes gsungs①/ /mgar ba yis ni rdul bzhin du/ /blo gros ldan pas rim pa bzhin/ /skad cig thang cig cung zad tsamaske/ /rang gi dri ma bsal bar bya/ /lham mkhan gyis ni ko ba dag /yongs su sbyangs pa'i lham bde ltar/ /'dod pa gang dag rjogang spangs pa/ /de de bde ba phun sum ldan/ /gal te bde ba kun 'dod pa/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs su sgongs⑤/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs spangs pas/ /mchog tu bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /ji srid 'dod pa'i rjes 'brangs pa de nyid rab tu ngoms mi 'gyur/ /de la gang dag shes rab kyis/ /zlog byed de dag tshim pa 'thob/ /'dod pas ngoms par mi 'gyur bas/ /shes rab kyis ni ngoms pa bde/ /shes rab kyis ni ngoms pa'i mi/ /srid pa'i dbang du mi 'gyur ro/ /'dod la chags pa'i mi gang yin/ /de dag kye ma chos min dga'//cung zad gson por 'dug pa na/ /bar chad mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ / blo ngan 0longs spyod kyis bcom pa/ /pha rol tshol bar mi byed cing / /bsam brlag 'dod la srid dze+epa yis/ /bdag phung gzhan yang phung bar byed/ /lha 96—739

yis 'dod pa'i char bab kyang / /'dod ldan rnams la ngoms mi 'gyur/ /brgya byin dang ni mnyam pa yi/ /lha yi 'dod pa yod gyur kyang / /nga las nus ①bzhin mi ngoms par/ /rtogs par mdzod la legs par spyod/ /'dod pa mnog chung nyes mang bar/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi ②khong du chud/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos rnams/ /lha yi 'dod pa rnams la yang / /lhag par dga' bar mi 'gyur gyi/ /sred pa zad pas dgyes par 'gyur/ /gang dag sdug bsngal rgyu shes pa/ /de dag nam yang 'dod la dga' mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten dag na zug rngu'i rgyur mkhyen nas/ /'di dag gdul phyir bstan pa 'thob ①par mdzod/ /'dod pa spang ba'i le'u ste dang po'o// //lus can rnam par rtog pas rab bcom pa/ /'dod chags mi bzad gtsang ma'i rjes lta bas/ /'dod chags phyir zhing rab tu 'phel 'gyur te/ /rang gi 'ching ba de yis dam por rjobyed/ /gang dag rnam rtog nye bar zhi dga' zhing / /mi sdug bsgom rjopa rtag tu dran byed pa/ /de yi sred pa rab tu spangs pa yin/ /rang gi 'ching ba de dag gtubs par 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i mun nag dra bas g.yogs/ /sred pa'i dgab pas dhibakab pa dang / /bag med 'ching bas bcings pa dag /tshod mar chud pas nya dang 'dra/ /skyes bu bag med rab tu spyod byed pa/ /'khri shing bzhin du sred pa 'phel 'gyur zhing / /skye rga na 'chi'i rjes su 'gro 'gyur te/ /ma drung nu zho 'dod pa'i bu dang 'dra/ /'dod pa'i bran ⑦dang mngon dga' chags byed dang / /yid bde ba la rtog par byed pa dag /de yis yang dang yang du 'khor bar 'khyams/ /tshal dang 96—740

'bras bu 'dod pa'i spre dang mtshungs/ /mi gang rtag tu bde ba 'dod byed pa/ /skye rga na 'chi'i dra bar chud 'gyur zhing / /ngan 'gro'i srid pa rnams kyis ①mdun du bdar/ /rgya nang ri bong yongs su rgyugs ①pa bzhin/ /srid pa'i zhags pas mdud pa'i sems can dag /srid dang longs spyod dag la sems chags shing / /bu dang chung ma rnams la rab zhen pa/ /yang dang yang du sdug bsngal 'thob dze+epar 'gyur/ /skye bo grub dang bde rnams dang bral zhing / /bdud kyi sbyor ba dag dang ldan pa de/ /'jigs dang sdug bsngal rnams kyis 'joms 'gyur te/ /rtswa dang lo ma'i mchog ④la me dang 'dra/ /'di na gred pa ⑤de 'dra spong byed pa/ /sred dang longs spyod dag la sred bral zhing / /dge slong srid pa zil gyis gnon byed pa/ /lhag ma med par yongs su mya ngan 'da'//gang zhig 'jig rten spang dka' ba'i/ /srid pa'i bud med 'dir bsten pa/ /de yi dumya ngan 'phel 'gyur te/ /rtswa la char pa bab pa bzhin/ /gang zhig 'jig rten spang dka' ba'i/ /srid pa'i bud med 'di spong ba/ /de yi ⑦mya ngan ldog 'gyur te/ /pad+ma la ⑧ni chu thigs bzhin/ /u shi'i phyir ni rtswa bzhin du—/ /srid pa'i rtsar bcas drung ⑨nas phyung / /skyes bu sred pa dang 'grogs na / /yun ring dus su 'khyams 'gyur bas/ /sred pa drung nas phyung ⑫shig dang / /mya ngan med cing 'jigs pa med/ /yang dang yang du nyer len cing //yang dang yang du mngal du 'jug /gnas skabs 'gyur dang gzhan 'gyur bas//sems can 'od dang 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'dir ⑩ni spang dka'i sred pa de/ /spongs la sa bon chod cig dang / /de yi ⑫sred pa med 'gyur zhing / /de ni yang du 'khor mi 'gyur/ /gang phyir srid mtsho'i rgyur gyur pa/ /yul la sred 96—741

pa 'bras kyi gzhi/ /'khri shing dra ①bas khebs byed pa/ /gdung bar byed pa ma btul ④na/ /sdug bsngal 'di ni yang dang yang / /rnam pa kun du ldog mi 'gyurarka/ /dper na ljon shing rtsa nas ma bton na/ /bcad kyang phyir zhing skye ba kho nar zad/ /de bzhin srid pa'i phra rgyas ma bton na/ /yang dang yang du sdug bsngal 'di mi ldog /dper na bdag nyid kyis ni byas pa'i mtshon/ /de yi ①rkun po'i mthu yis bdag gsod ltar/ /de bzhin nang gi sems las byung ba yi④/ /srid pas lus can nye bar gsod par byed/ /de ltar srid las sdug bsngal dag /'byung ba'i nongs dmigs mkhyen nas ni/ /sred spang ⑤nye bar len med pa'i/ /don dam dge slong mchog 'gyur mdzod/ /sred pa spang ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //bag yod 'chi med gnas yin te/ /bag med pa ni 'chi ba'i gnas/ /bag med rjo'achi bar mi 'gyur ste⑦/ /bag med pa ni rtag tu 'chi/ /de yi ⑧khyad par de rig pas/ /mkhas pa rnams ni bag dang ldan/ /bag yod pa la rab dga' ba/ /'phags pa'i spyod yul dga' ba yin/ /brten ⑨pa grub bde bla med pa/ /mya ngan 'das la reg pa yin/ /gang tshe mkhas pa bag yod pas/ /bag med bcom pa de yi tshe/ /shes rab khang bzang steng 'jegs nas/ /mya ngan med pas gdung bcad de/ /brten ⑩rnams ri bo'i rtse dag nas/ /sa steng ⑪byis pa rnams la blta⑫/ /brtson 'grus dang ni bag yod dang / /yang dag sdom dang dul ba yis⑫/ /mkhas pa'i gling du byas nas ni/ /chu bo chen po mngon du zlog⑫ /brtson pa ldan zhing dran dang ldan pa dang / /spyod pa 96—742

gtsang zhing brtags nas byed pa dang / /yang dag sdom dang chos kyis 'tsho ba dang / /bag yod rnams kyi ①grags pa mngon par 'phel/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab mchog /thub pa'i bslab gzhi rnams la bslab/ /nyer zhi rtag tu dran ldan pa'i/ /skyob pa mya ngan med pa yin/ /dman pa'i chos la mi brten cing / /bag med pa la brten ②mi bya/ /log par lta la 'dod med dang / /'jig rten 'phel bar mi bya'o/ /'jig rten pa yi yang dag lta/ /chen po su la yod gyur pa/ /de ni tshe rabs stong du yang / /ngan 'gror 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bag med pa la sbyor byed pa'i/ /skye bo byis pa bsam brlag yin/ /tshong dpon nor rnams bsrung ba ltar/ /mkhas pa bag dang ldan par bya/ /bag med pa la mi sbyor zhing / /'dod pa rnams la rgyab phyogs nas—/ /rtag tu bag yod sems byed pa/ /zag pa zad pa thob par 'gyur/ /zag pa zad pa ma thob par/ /mkhas pas bag med mi bya ste/ /ri dwags mo yis seng ge ltar/ /bag med pa dag gsod par byedasne/ /bag med pha rol bud med sten byed pa'i/ /mi gang yin la gnas skabs 'di bzhi dhi'abyung / /bsod nams min 'thob bde bar mi nyal dang / /dam pas smad cing lus zhig ngan 'gror skye/ /gang zhig bdag bde lta 'dod pa/ /de ni gong ma bzhin du sbyar / /byis pa'i shing rta bzhin gyur pas/ /brtan pas brtson 'grus zhan mi bya/ /dper na byes pa'i shing rta dag /lam chen bzang po bor nas ni/ /lam ngan dag tu 'gro byed pa/ /mig chag sems khong chud pa ltar/ /de bzhin chos ni spangs pas kyang / /chos min rjes su 'jug byed pa'i/ /byis pa 'chi bdag dbang 'gro zhing / /chos nyams bde ba bcom pa 'thob/ /gang 96—743

zhig bya ba rnam spangs nas/ /mi bya ba dag byed pa dang / /bag med pa yis rlom byed pa/ /de dag rnams kyi zag pa 'phel/ /gang zhig lus sogs dran pa dag /rtag tu legs par brtsams pa dang / /bya ba ma yin mi byed cing / /rgyun du bya ba byed pa dang / /dran dang shes bzhin ldan pa de'i/ /zag pa rnams ni zad par 'gyur/ /ji tsam mang du smra byed pa/ /de dag dam chos 'dzin pa min/ /gang dag 'di na thos nyung yang / /yid kyi chos dag mngon sum byas/ /gang dag chos la bag byed pa/ /de dag dam chos 'dzin pa yin/ /gal te rigs bcas mang du smras kyang ni/ /bag med mi dag de ltar byed mi 'gyuraske/ /dper na phyugs rdzis gzhan gyi phyugs bgrang ①ltar/ /de dag dge sbyong skal ba thob ma yin/ /gal te rigs bcas nyung ngu smra byed kyang / /chos kyi rjes su chos la spyod pa dang / /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug spong byed pa/ /de dag dge sbyong skal ba thob pa yin/ /bag yod bsngags pa rjod byed cing / /rtag tu bag med la smod ②pas/ /bag med ④mchod sbyin rgyal ba yang ④ lha rnams nang na gtso bor 'gyur/ /bag dang bcas pa'i mkhas pa yis/ /don gnyis rab tu len par byed/ /tshe 'di'i don ni gang yin dang / /phyi ma'i don ni gang yin pa'o/ /de dag brten pas rtogs pas na/ /mkhas pa zhes ni nges par brjod/ /dge slong bag yod la dga' zhing / /bag med pa la 'jigs lta bas/ /bdag nyid ngan 'gro las 'dren te/ /'dam rdzab las ni glang chen bzhin/ /sdig pa'i chos rnams sprug par byed/ /rlung gis ljon shing lo ma bzhin/ /kun du sbyor ba phra rags dag /sreg ste me yis rtswa bzhin no/ /'du byed nyer zhi zhi ba yi/ /go 'phang mchog ni so sor rtogs/ /mya ngan 96—744

'das dang nye ba'i phyir/ /yongs su nyams 'gyur mi srid do/ /brtson 'grus ldan zhing bag yod dang / /chos spyod legs par spyod byed pa/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ /dga' dang bde ba rab tu 'thob/ /zhi phyir bslab pa la brten dang / /rtsol ba dang ni brtson 'grus skyedadhi/ /mi dran pa dang bag med dang / /brtson 'grus chung dang kun sdom med/ /gnyid dang sdom pa g.yeng ba rnams/ /'di dag basbab pa'i bar bcad pas/ /khyod kyis yan lag de mkhyen nas/ /dran pa chud ni mi gzan mdzod/ /mkhas khyod tshul khrims bzang ba dang / /bag yod pa la dgyes pa yis/ /kun rtog legs par mnyam zhog ste/ /nyid kyi thugs ni rjes su srungs②/ /gang zhig chos 'dul 'di la ni/ /bag dang ldan par spyod byed pa/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal tha mar byed par 'gyur/ /bag med pa spang ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //nyon mongs rnams ni bdag 'joms sems can 'joms shing tshul khrims 'joms—/ /nyams bcas rnyed ①pas dman zhing srung dang de bzhin ston pas spangs—/ /rtsod bcas mi snyan de ni gzhan du mi khom rnams su skye/ /thob dang ma thob nyams pas 'jigs dang sdug bsngal chen po 'thob/ /nyon mongs lhag pas thub la rma 'byin te/ /dam chos spong dang dge 'dun skur bar byed/ /pha ma gsod cing chom rkun log g.yem spyod/ /rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub 'khyal pa smraske/ /brnab sems gnod sems log lta yid byed cing / /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro 'phel bar byed/ /'dir ni nyon mongs sa bon bzhin/ /klu 96—745

bzhin rtswa bzhin ljon shing bzhin/ /de bzhin shun pa lta bu ste/ /las ni shun ①bcas 'bras dang 'dra/ /de bzhin sman dang me tog bzhin/ /skye ba bza' btung grub pa 'dra/ /kun sbyor 'ching ba bag la nyal/ /nye ba'i nyon mongs kun nas dkris/ /chu bo sbyor ba nyer len mdud/ /sgrib dang tha ba dri ma sdig /zug rngu ci yang nye bar spyod/ /zag pa phongs pa yongs su mdud/ /'khrug ②dang 'thab pa rims nad dang / /nags sbyor dang ni gnas zhes bya/ /'dod chags khong khro gti mug dang / /nga rgyal lta ba the tshom dang / /khro dang khon du 'dzin pa dang / /'chab dang tshig dang phrag dog dang / /ser sna dang ni sgyu bag dang / /g.yo rgyags rnam 'tshe ngo tsha med/ /khrel med rmugs dang rgod pa dang / /ma dad pa dang le lo dang / /bag med pa dang brjed ngas ①dang / /rnam g.yengs rjoshes bzhin ma yin pa/ /rab mkhas khyed kyis spang bar mdzod/ /nyon mongs de dag spang slad du/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong bsgom ⑤pa dang / /mi sdug byams khams rten 'brel dang / /dbugs rngub dbugs dbyung dran pa mdzod—/ /dran pa nyer gzhag spang ba bzhi/ /de bzhin rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dang //dbang stobs byang chub yan lag dang / /lam gyi yan lag bsgom dupar mdzod/ /de ltar 'dir ni mdor bsdus nas/ /mkhas pa khyod la springs pa yi/ /dge ba gang des 'gro ba kun/ /rnam grol zhi ba thob par shog /nyon mongs pa spong ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //bla ma la spring ba dge slong dgon pa pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsār+ya bi na ya tsān dra ⑦dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //96—746

bsdur 'bras re'u migadzing yig(15)96wa 748

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ su tai ②le kha/ bod skad du/ bu la spring ba①/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtsho chen sa gzhir gyur 'di dgra bcom bye ba'i yul/ /legs spyod mis gang dpe med dpal sgo rig gnas 'dir/ /mkhas pa rin chen rdo rje'i rgyud 'dzin bram ze'i rigs / /gzugs stobs shes rab phun tshogs ma hā dzā nar 'gyur/ /mchog tu brtse ba'i pha ma mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun tshogs/ /mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du ltos med yal dor nas/ /mtha' 'khob kla klo mun pa'i nang na gcig 'khyams ④pa/ /blo ldan bu de shes rab sgon mas ⑤snang gyur cig /shin tu brtse ba'i ded dpon bdag gis ni/ /legs bshad rgya mtsho'i gling nas blangs pa yi/ /spring ༷yig rin chen 'di ni bu la bskur/ /rab gus dga' zhing dad pas mnyan par gyis/ /dge ba'i yul dbus khang bzang longs spyod dang / /96—749

g.yo med sems kyis rgyun du brtse ba yi/ /pha ma mdza' bshes rtsa lag spangs nas ni—/ /bu khyod mtha' 'khob rgyu ba shin tu smad①/ /dam chos phyir ni pha ma yal dor nas/ /nor bzang bzhin du yul gzhan rgyu 'os na/ /'dod pa'i don du pha ma yal dor nas/ /smad pa'i don④du rgyu ba ga la rigs/ /bu khyod gzugs sdug mchog dang sgra snyan dang / /dri zhim ro mchog reg bya'i bde byed pa//'dod pa'i 'dam du 'gro ba 'di dag bying / /dper na glang chen 'dam du chud ①pa bzhin/ /'dod pa las ni 'jigs dang sdug bsngal dang / /mya ngan dang ni 'tshe ba sna tshogs 'byung / /gsod dang bcing dang yan lag gcod pa dang / /me dang chu dang g.yang sar 'dor bar ④byed/ /'dod la brkam pas sems can dmyal ba dang / /yi dwags dud 'gro rnams su sdug bsngal rnyed/ /mir gyur na yang sdug bsngal ⑤mi snyan dang / /dri mi zhim dang bkres skom nad kyis gzirarka/ /g.yen dupa can la phrug ⑦na bde/ /⑧de bzhin 'jig rten 'dod ldan bde/ /de bas 'dod pa med pa ⑨bde/ /ji ltar me long brag ca dang / /spos snod gzar ⑩bu nam mkha' rnams/ /gzugs brnyan sgra grags spos dang ni/ /tshod ma'i ro dang rlung rnams kyis/ /nam yang ngoms par 'gyur ba med/ /de bzhin mig dang rna ba dang / /sna dang lce dang lus rnams dang ⑪/ /gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim dang / /ro mchog reg bya bde ba yis⑫/ /nam yang ngoms par 'gyur ba med/ /de bas 'dod pa rnams spang ⑫zhing / /'phags pa'i chos ④rnams bsten par bya⑫/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab mchog /rnam grol bde bas ngoms par 'gyur/ /'dod la chags pa spang bar bya'o/ /nor la chags pas 'dir ⑩gdung phyi mar gdung / /gnyis kar gdung ste des na 96—750

bdag nyid kyis/ /las rnam ①smin mthong de gdung rab tu gdung / /'gro ba dman par song bas phyir zhing gdung / /bsag dang bsrung dang brlag pa'i gdung ba yis/ /nor ni phung khrol ②mtha' yas shes par bya/ /nor la chags pas g.yeng b.rashegyur pa rnams/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las grol skabs med do//nor gyi phyir ni rgyal bu ④dge don gyi⑤/ /mig gnyis tsher ma rnon pos brtol rjobar gyur/ /bu mo mdza' bo ⑦rna ba bye ba ri/ /rgya mtshor shi 'phos 'khyam ⑧par gyur pa yin/ /'di na nor 'tshol ⑨kha cig gsal ⑩shing btsugs/ /la la yan lag nying lag gcod par snang / /gzhan dag btson ra shin tu zab mor bcug /kha cig khong sgril ⑪su mi 'dod kyis bcings/ /nor bu len pa'i tshong pa lnga brgya dag /ṅgang ga la yi gling du srin mos bzung ⑫/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i rta rgyal ba la has/ /de dag bsgral bar nus pa ma yin no/ /'di na gser dang dngul dang bai ḍūr+ya/ /mu tig byi ru asma gar+bha dang / /kār+ṣa ⑫pa ṇa la sogs char babs kyang / /nor 'tshol ⑩rnams ni ngoms par 'gyur ba med/ /gangs can 'bigs byed dang ni mnyam pa yi/ /nor gyi phung po la ni dbang bsgyur ⑫kyang / /nor tshol gcig kyang ngoms par 'gyur ma yin/ /de phyir bu khyod nor la chags pa spongs/ /'di na ⑩nor mang skye bo sdug bsngal ba/ /'dod pa chung rnams de lta ma yin te/ /klu dbang rnams la mgo bo ji snyed pa/ /de las byung ba'i sdug bsngal de snyed do/ /lus srog yal bar dor nas nor bsags kyang / /shi na skal ba nyams par 'gyur ba yi/ /nor de rmi lam sprin dang mtshungs pa yin/ /de bas 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes bya/ /nor mang bsags shing sba byas kyang / /cung zad cung zad spyad pa yis/ /'jungs pa'i 96—751

nor ni 'dra ①ba ltar/ /sdug bsngal skyed pa kho nar zad/ /bu khyod gal te nor 'tshol na/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun bsten par gyis/ /rgyal po rkun pos mi phrogs shing / /srid pa'i dbul ba sel bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu tshul khrims ldan pa la/ /sbyin pa bkur stes ②brgyan par gyis/ /nor rnams de ①ltar gter du sbos/ /rjes su 'brang zhing dbrog ④tu med/ /'di na ⑤nor slong dman pa ste/ /mi sbyin pa ni de bas dman/ /nor sbyin pa ni mchog yin te/ /mi 'dod pa ni de bas mchog /nor la chags pa spang ba'odhi/ /'dod pa'i phyir ni byis pa rnams/ /bud med rul pa sten byed pa/ /'gro ba rul par 'gro 'gyur zhing / /ngan song rnams su rtsang bar 'gyur/ /'jigs pa chen po'i 'ching ba ni/ /bud med zhags pa mi bzad pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'dod pa dang / /bud med bsten pa'ang ma bsngags so/ /lam 'dis byang chub bar bcad pas/ /sbrul gdug shin tu khro ba ltar/ /mkhas khyod bud med rnam par ⑦spongs/ /mi gang dag ni bud med 'dod/ /de dag bde bar ga la 'gyur/ /bud med phung bar ⑧byed pa ste/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol phung⑨/ /rnam pa kun du nor 'jig ⑩dang / /ngan song rtsa ba bud med yin/ /bu khyod bdag la phan 'dod na/ /de bas bud med rtag tu spongs⑪//bud med rnams kyi rang bzhin ni/ /'dod can rnams kyis mi rig ste⑫/ /skyes pa dang ni yid gcugs ⑫shing / /rtse dga' du ma byas nas kyang / /sbrul gyi lpags rnying 'dor ba ltar/ /bud med kyis ni blo bur 'doraspyo/ /sbrang mas me tog rnying pa ltar/ /bud med kyis ni nor med pa'i/ /skyes pa rgan po 'dor byed cing / /gzugs byad ngan pa'ang 'dor ba yin/ /rab tu brtse 96—752

bas bud med dag /thams cad du ni yongs bskyangs kyang / /bud med shin tu mi bzad pa/ /bdag gir bya bar ①mi nus so/ /de yi rang bzhin 'di ②yin te/ /bud med rnams ni sems mi srun①/ /byas pa drin du mi gzo bas/ /rang gi skyes pa'ang gsod par byed/ /chu bo dang ni sder mo can/ /rwa can lag na mtshon thogs paX/ /rgyal po ngan dang bud med la/ /nam yang yid brtan mi bya'o/ /bud med kha zas nyis ⑤'gyur te/ /g.yo sgyu dag ni bzhi 'gyur yin/ /phrag dog shas ni drug 'gyur te/ /'dod pa brgya 'gyur yin par bya/ /shing rnams kyis ni med ⑦dang ni/ /char gyis rgya mtsho chen po dang / /'byung po kun gyis gshin rje ltar/ /skyes pa bud med ngoms mi 'gyur/ /pu ⑦ka rtse yi ⑧kha chu yis/ /bye ma'i phung po ji ltar 'bang ⑨/ /skyes pa gzhon nu thams cad kyis/ /bud med gcig ni ngoms mi 'gyur/ /byi bo byed pa'i ngang tshul can/ /ma bsdams mi bsrun 'dod la brkam/ /rang gi chung mas mi chog ste—/ /'jig rten dag na smad 'os yin/ /'di dang tu)pha rol sdug bsngal 'gyur—/ /gsod dang chad pa drag po stsong / /sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye—/ /de bas bu khyod de sgongs shig /bye bo byed pa shasma li/ /lcags kyi tsher ma rtse mo 'bar/ /sor ni bcu drug yod pa la/ /ngu zhing stobs kyis 'dzegs ⑪par 'gyur/ /bud med shin tu 'jigs 'jigs lta/ /mche rno lus che 'bar ba yis/ /gzhan gyi bud med 'phrog pa la/ /ci nas za ba kho nar 'gyur / /gal te chung mar brten na yang / /de yi ⑫nyes dmigs drug cu lnga//drag shul can gyi mdo las gsungs/ /de'i phyir bud med spang bar bya'o⑫/ /bud med la chags pa ④spang ba'o // //⑫96—753

gang zhig 'thungs ①nas ra ro glo nas ②gom tshugs dbang med 'dor/ /yul grong ma 'dris par yang 'khyam zhing brdeg ①'chos 'gyur/ /bza' dang mi bza' spyad med dug dang 'dres pa za④/ /de bas bu khyod myos 'gyur khu ba rtag tu spongs⑤/ /gang 'thungs na ni bdag la brtan med blo nyams shing / /phyugs dang 'dra bar mdza' bos sgong zhing dgra bos 'phya/ /'dus pa bro gar byed cing glu len 'khar rnga rdung / /dge legs grags nyams rgyu de su zhig 'thung bar byed/ /de 'thungs ngo tsha khrel yod dor nas ni/ /gcer bur byung kyang 'dzem med smyon pa bzhin / /rkun po gcan gzan rgyu ba'i lam du 'gro/ /lus srog nyams rgyu de ni khyod kyis spangasabu/ /de 'thungs ④skyugs pas gos shing 'gyel gyur nas/ /kha yang khye yis dogs pa med par ldags⑧/ /dran med lam po cher yang nyal gyur ④na/ /bag med rtsa ba rtag tu spang bar bya/ /gang zhig 'thungs nas myos par 'khrul 'gyur te/ /'bris na an dha dag kyang rme byung na/ /du chen 'thib ste ⑩phan tshun thal mar byung / /phung khrol rtsa ba de ni su zhig 'thung / /gang zhig ⑪'thungs na dpal gyi gzhir 'gyur ⑫rigs/ /je mtho je mtho gyur pa'ang rlag byed pa/ /nor gyi dbyig ldan khyim kyang phung 'gyur ba/ /nyes mang gzhi rtsa de ni su zhig 'thung / /glo bur ngu zhing re ⑫'ga' dgod par byed/ /ma nges smra zhing gdon gyes zin pa bzhin/ /dam pas smad cing brnyas pa'i gnas gyur pa/ /'khrul slang ④rgyu de su zhig 'thung bar byed/ /bag yod rnams kyang de 'thungs sems nyams shing / /bdag la phan pa'i lam du mi 'jug pa⑫/ /ma brtags mang du smra zhing tshig rtsub 'byen/ /sgo gsum nyams byed de ni btung mi bya/ /gang gi nyes pas sngon gyi lha rnams myos//96—754

lha yi dbang po'i dpal ni nyams gyur nas/ /skyabs 'dod phyir na rgya mtsho'i nang du gab/ /lha yang nyams byed de ni btung mi bya/ /mi bya ba yang bya ba bzhin du byed/ /mi bden pa yang bden pa bzhin du smra/ /zhum pa rnams kyang ma zhum bzhin du spyod/ /myos 'gyur rigs nyams sdug bsngal rgyur gyur pa/ /sdig pa'i srin mo byur ngan mngon sum bzhin/ /rtsod pa'i gzhi dang tha dad ma yin pa/ /snying gi mun pa mi bzad de su 'thung / /de 'thungs yid ni rab tu 'khrugs gyur nas/ /brtse ba'i pha dang ma yang gsod 'gyur zhing / /nyes med dge sbyong ①bram ze drang srong gsod/ /chom rkun dang ni log g.yem smad pa byed//rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub 'khyal pa smra/ /brnab sems gnod sems log lta'i mun pa 'dzin/ /mi dge'i ④rtsa ba de ni btung mi bya/ /gang zhig btung na tshul khrims nying 'dzin dang / /shes rab lta ba 'tsho ba cho ga dang / /dran pa shes bzhin dad pa brtson 'grus nyams/ /dge chos chud gzon ①de ni btung mi bya/ /de 'thungs sdig spyod rnams ni lus zhig nas/ /rab tu bzod dka'i sems can dmyal bar rtsang / /yi dwags dud 'gro rnams kyang ④smyon par 'gyur//sdug bsngal rtsa ba de ni btung mi bya/ /thub pas dga' ba can gyi mdo las ni/ /myos 'gyur nyes pa sum cu rtsa lnga gsungs/ /de phyir bu khyod bdag la phan 'dod narka/ /nyes kun rtsa ba de ni btung mi bya/ /chang dga' dgos pa thams cad la//rtag tu bag med spyod par 'gyur/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi sman ⑤'gyur zhing / /dkar po'i chos rnams 'grib par 'gyur/ /nyes kun rtsa ba bag med gnas/ /'di dang gzhan du rnam par rmongs/ /de bas skye bo chen po khyod/ /chang la dga' ba rtag tu sgongs/ /phan par smra ba dkon dupa ste/ /nyan par byed pa 96—755

shin tu dkon/ /de dag bas kyang mi nyan yang / /phan pa'i rjes su byed pa dkon—/ /phan par smra ba mchod pa ni/ /bsgo ba shin tu sgrub pa yin/ /bu khyod nga la mchod 'dod na/ /gdams pa bzhin du rjes su sgrubs①/ /chang la dga' ba spang ba'o/ /bdag gi spring yig rin chen 'di/ /bu la brjod pa las byung ba'i/ /dge ba gang des 'gro ba kun/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thob par shog /bu la spring ba ①paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa chen po sad dza na chen pos ①mdzad pa rdzogs so// //kha che'i mkhan po ma hā dza na dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bldur mchan/749 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉tshol bu la springs pa bzhugs so/ /zhes dang / 〈〈snar 〉skal rgyal po zla ba la springs pa'i phrin yig rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shrī dza gad ta ma tri ā nan tas mdzad pa/ bshes pa'i phrin yig rgya cher bshad pa tshig gsal bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pu tra/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉springs pa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉springs springs pa/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉marakhyam/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thabs/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉springs/75༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rmad/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thul/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉masad/ rjo〈〈pe 〉maradod par/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉'gyur na yang gzugs ngan/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gyur ni gzugs ngan/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagayan/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phrugs/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 de bas g.yan pa med na bde/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ ⑩〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzar/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra nga rnams/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yon/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma nga / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tshogs/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byas/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉skaradi/751 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnams/ ②〈〈pe 〉maraphung grol/ 〈〈snar 〉ma nga krol/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagayengs par rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shes/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra tung / ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bo/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'khyams/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra la/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sal/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉41la/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzung / ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kar+ṣa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra la/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgyur/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉theg/96byed756

na418༄ga /rnge ma med pa rin po che'i spring yig ces bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bi ma la rat+na le kha nā ma/ bod skad du/dri ma med pa rin po che'i spring dzuyig ces bya ba/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma hā gha tir sku bltams nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel mdzad cing / /rgyal srid chos kyis skyong mdzad pa/ /nir ya pha la rgyal gyur cig /khyod kyis sngon chad sbyin pa dang / /dge ba bcu dang gso spyong dang / /bzod dang brtson 'grus la goms pas/ /lha khyod da lta phun sum tshogs/ /bla ma rnams kyi bka' lung dang / /mdo stsogs chos kyi rjes 'brang 'di/ /gus pas spyi bos blang mdzod dang / /bdag gzhan gnyis la phan par 'gyur/ /the tshom thams cad rnam spangs shing ①/ /sgrub la nan tan che bar mdzod/ /gnyid rmugs le lo rnam spangs shing / /rtag tu brtson 'grus 'bad par bya/ /dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pas/ /dbang po'i sgo 96—758

rnams rtag tu bsrung / /nyin mtshan dus su yang dang yang / /sems kyi rgyud la brtag par bya/ /rang skyon rtog la mig bzhin bya/ /gzhan skyon rtog la long ba bzhin/ /dran dang nga rgyal med pa dang / /stong nyid rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /bdag gi ①nyes pa bsgrag bya zhing / /gzhan gyi 'khrul pa btsal mi bya/ /gzhan gyi yon tan bsgrag par bya/ /bdag gi yon tan sba bar bya/ /rnyed dang bkur ste spang bya zhing / /khe grags rtag tu spang bar bya/ /byams dang snying rje bsgom bya zhing / /byang chub sems ni brtan par mdzod/ /mi dge bcu ni spang bya zhing / /rtag tu dad pa brtan par bya/ /'dod pa chung zhing chog shes dang / /byas la ④drin du gzo bar bya/ /khro dang nga rgyal spang bya zhing //dman pa'i sems dang ldan par bya/ /log pa'i 'tsho ba rnams ①spang zhing / /chos kyi 'tsho bas 'tsho bar bya/ /zang zing thams cad rnams ④spang zhing / /'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug por bya/ /rtag tu 'du 'dzi spang bya zhing / /dgon pa la ni gnas par bya/ /'khyal pa'i tshig rnams spang bya zhing / /rtag tu ngag ni bsdam par bya/ /bla ma mkhan po mthong ba'i tshe/ /gus pas rim gro bskyed par bya/ /khyad par can gyi skyes bu dang / /gang zag chos kyi mig can dang / /las dang po yi sems can la/ /ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya/ /sdug bsngal dag gis gdungs pa dang / /sems can thams cad mthong ba'i tshe/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bya ste/ /pha ma bu tsha'i 'du shes bskyed/ /'jig rten bya ba kun spangs te/ /rtag tu ting 'dzin bsgom par mdzod/ /sdig pa'i grogs po spang bya zhing / /dge ba'i bshes la sten ⑤par mdzod/ /tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dge slong dang / /chos kyis dhiphongs pa gzhan dag dang / /sdig pa 96—759

spyod pa mthong ba'i tshe/ /de dag yal bar dor mi bya/ /mi dge'i bshes gnyen thams cad dang / /sdig pa'i grogs po thams cad dang / /dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma dang / /mkhan po slob dpon mi gus dang / /byas la ①drin du mi gzo dang / /tshe 'di 'ba' zhig dran pa dang / /gzhan yang dad pa chung ba dang / /zhag gsum 'das par gnas mi bya/ / sdang dang mi dge'i sa spangs shing ④/ /gang du bde bar 'gro bar bya/ /gang la chags pa spang bya zhing / /chags pa med par gnas par bya/ /chags pas bde 'gro mi 'thob cing / /thar pa'i srog kyang gcod par byed/ /gang du dge ba'i bshes gnas paske/ /der ni rtag tu gnas par bya/ /bla ma rtag tu bsten pa dang / /rtag tu mdo sde blta bar bya/ /thog mar brtsams pa gang yin pa/ /dang por de nyid bsgrub bya zhing / /gzhan du gnyis ka 'grub mi 'gyur/ /gzhan du sdig pa bshags pa dang / /bsod nams mchog la 'bad par bya/ /'jig rten spyod dang mthun pa dang / /rtag tu pha rol sems su ①mdzod/ /gang tshe mtho ba'i sems skyes tshe/ /de tshe nga rgyal bcag bya zhing / /gang du bag yod bral ba'i tshe/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag dran par bya/ /zhum pa'i sems ni byung ba'i tshe//sems kyi gzengs kyang bstod par bya/ /shes rab pha rol phyin dran te/ /spros pa ma lus zhi bar mdzodadu/ /gang du chags sdong ⑤yul byung tshe/ /sgyu ma sprul pa bzhin du blta/ /mi snyan tshig rnams thos pa'i tshe/ /brag ca lta bur mkhyen par mdzod/ /lus la gnod pa byung ba'i tshe/ /sngon gyi las su blta bar bya/ /bas mtha' dgon par rab gnas shing / /ri dwags shi ba'i ro bzhin du/ /gang du sus kyang mi shes par/ /bdag gis bdag nyid sba bar bya/ /rtag tu 96—760

yi dam brtan par bya/ /'dod dang gnod sems gnyid dang rmugs/ /le lo snyom ①las sems byung tshe/ /de tshe bdag la rngan bgrang zhing / /brtul zhugs snying po dran bya dang / /mi rtag pa dang 'chi ba bsam/ /gzhan gyi mdun du gnas pa'i tshe/ /zhi des gsong por smra bar bya/ /khro gnyer ngo 'dzum spang bya zhing / /rtag tu 'dzum zhing gnas par bya/ /rtag tu gzhan la dga' bya zhing //ser sna med cing gtang ④la dga'/ /rtag tu phrag dog spang bar bya/ /gzhan gyi sems ni bsrung bya zhing / /rtsod pa thams cad spang bar bya/ /ngo dga' med cing gsar 'grogs med/ /rtag tu zungs ni thub par bya/ /rtag tu bzod dang ldan pa dang / /'dod pa chung zhing chog shes bya①/ /gdol pa bran gyi 'du shes so/ /ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod dang / /pha rol mgu bya de la brtson//rang gi sdom pa bsdam rjopar mdzod/ /gzhan la brnyas pa spang bya zhing / /gus pa'i tshul gyis gnas par bya/ /gzhan la gdams ngag byed pa'i tshe/ /snying rje phan sems ldan par mdzod/ /sangs rgyas chos la gus pa dang / /dam chos nam yang spang mi bya/ /rtag tu dkon mchog gus pa dang / /'khor gsum yongs su dag par mdzod/ /sngon du snying rje song ba yis/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /mchod pa bdun du rab grags pa'i/ /phung po gsum pa gdon par mdzod/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsal 'dod pas/ /smon lam rgya chen gdab pa dang / /sems can smon dang byang chub 'dod/ /thams cad byang chub chen por bsngo/ /dus ni ring por dam bcas nas/ /rtag tu brtson dang ldan par bya/ /de ltar mdzad na tshogs gnyis po/ /rdzogs 'gyur sgrib gnyis zad par 'gyur/ /mi lus thob pa don yod cing / /mthong ba'i chos 96—761

la mya ngan 'da'/ /bdag dang gzhan don rdzogs gyur nas/ /dam pa nyid ni thob par 'gyur/ /sos ka'i khu byug gzhon nu skad snyan sgrogs zhes te①/ /rma bya gzhon nu skad mi snyan pa ②mi sgogs sam/ /mkhas pa mang pos legs par ①gsungs pa yod mod kyis/ /rgyal po gdung ba bcad phyir ༷bdag gis bris pa yin/ /phan sems ldan pa'i gtam de ⑤legs par dgongs mdzod la/ /rtogs rjodang ldan pa'i skye bo gzhan la'ang ⑦smra bar mdzod/ /rtag tu lha drug dran mdzod dam tshig gtsang mar ⑧mdzod/ /rgyal srid chos kyis skyong mdzod bdag la bzod par mdzod/ /dri ma med pa'i rin po che'i spring ⑨yig ces bya ba/gnas brtan mkhas pa chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā nas/ rgyal po nir+ya ⑩pha la la brdzongs ⑪pa rdzogs so// //dus de nyid du bla ma de nyid dang / lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba/ sh+lau ka bzhi bcu pa'o// //96—762

bsdur mchan/758 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉pa dri ma med pa rin po che'i phrin yig ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanan/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spang zhing /759 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stagos/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnam/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brten/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/76༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉ldang dang mi bde'i sa spang zhing / 〈〈snar 〉〉spang dang mi bde'i sa spang zhing / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsrung / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉padzad/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ldang /761 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stoms/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagatong / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉padzod/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsdams/762 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snyan sgrog ces/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stan/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉walegasapa/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagacad phyir/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toradi/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtog ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgon/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nir+ya/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brdzangs/bsdur 'bras re'u migasprung yig (17)96wa 763

༄ga /rgyal po zla ba la dz+rengs pa'i spring yig①༄༅༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsan+d+ra rā dza ②le kha ka /bod skad du/rgyal po zla ba la springs pa'i spring yig /'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa gsum dbang phyug lha dang mi ①yi rje/ /yon tan rtul dhiphod 'phags pa'i bu stong mnga'/ /mnyam med chos kyi 'khor los ⑤sgyur mdzad pa/ /chos kyi rgyal pos rgyal po rgyal gyur cig /grogs po'i buming can rnal 'byor gyis/ /zla ba'i mtshan can sa bdag la/ /brtse bas rgyang nas nyid kyi drung / /rigs pa'i gdams ngag 'phrin du gsol/ /sa bdag ji ltar 'byor pa'i dus/ /de nyid dus na spyad btang zhing / /yongs su bsngo bas gter du sba/ /tshe 'di gcig la gzhan dpag med/ /gang tshe phyi nas ser sna dang / /phongs pas bsregs na ci bgyir mchis/ /sa bdag ji ltar gang dang mdza'/ /de ltar snga nas 'byel rab spang / / des na ⑦gnod pa mang po'i rtsa/ /skal lan mi 96—764

bgyid grags mi bgyid/ /gang tshe yud tsam rkyen stobs kyis/ /dbang bsgyur ①de tshe ci bgyir mchis/ /sa bdag ji ltar dgrar lta ba/ /de ltar sngon nas rtsod mi bgyi/ /ma la ④rkyen dbang gis bskul lags/ /sgyu ①'dra gnyis ka dngos med phyir/ /gang tshe nags la me shor ltar/ /'bar bar 'gyur rjotshe ci bgyir mchis/ /sa bdag ji ltar g.yar po'i lus/ /nad med rgud med bder gnas pa/ /de nyid tshe na snying po blang / /na 'chi rgud pas 'jigs med bgyi/ /gang tshe na rgas rgud sogs na/ /dran yang de tshe ci bgyir mchis/ /longs spyod ci 'dra khyim gyi ⑤sbrang / /bshes pa ci 'dra tshong khang mi/ /sdang sde rmi lam gnod pa bzhin/ /rang lus ci 'dra sbrul gyi lpags/ /'du 'dzi ci 'dra nad gzhi bzhin/ /tshe srog ci 'dra ri gzar chu/ /gang tshe gang la sems chags pa/ /de nyid dus na de 0btang bgyi/ /ci phyir chung yang gang la zhen/ /de nyid 'ching ba mi bzad phyir/ /gang tshe gang la sems sdang ba/ /de nyid dus na de bzhag bgyi/ /ci phyir chung yang blo 'khrug ⑦pa/ /de nyid phung khrol mi bzad phyir/ /gson cig 'di ltar khyod kyis ⑧sa/ /rgya mtsho'i mthar thug dbang 'byor pa'ang / /nam zhig khyod nyid rnam 'gyur dus/ /de tshe ci 'dra legs par gsungs/ /re zhig khyod sku rdo rje ltar/ /'gro ba'i skyabs dang rin chen ni/ /brtan du mi rung g.yo bdag pas/ /nges par bskyed ⑨dus de mchis so/ /de ltar phun tshogs dpal gyi gseb/ /khyod ni dgyes rol snyam bgyid na/ /thar pa rnams kyis ⑩rgyal srid bsdam/ /rgyal po bying ba lta bur gzigasaske/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho gting mtha' med/ /srid pa'i glong du byeng gyur kyang / /skyo med 'jigs med dga' dang dgod/ /bdag cag snying la ci 96—765

zhig mchis/ /phongs dang btsal dga' bsrung ①dang brlag /'bral ②dang phrad dang na rgas rgud/ /rtag tu 'bar ba'i mer zhugs kyang / /bde zlom smyon pa lags pa snyam/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg dang chos/ /gzugs brnyan dgra ①brnyan tshogs mtshungs phyir/ /rtag tu mi bsam chags mi bgyi/ /chags na'ang de nyid rnam spyod mdzod④/ /thog med bag chags las dbang gis/ /sems ni bung ⑤bas rtsi bzhin no/ /rigs pa dang ni gdams ngag dang / /skyon dran pas ni be+er bzlog bgyi/ /don med don log don dman don/ /'di 'dra'i don du 'dod nas dar/ /sgo gsum mi bzad sdug bsngal bgyis/ /mi mchog kyang ni rnam dpyod rigs/ /ji ltar lus ngag de bzhin yid/ /rtse dang 'khyal dang rnam g.yeng dang / /srog gcod phra ma gnod sems sam/ /tshe 'dir chags pas dge babyid pa/ /de lta de ltar don yod bzang / /don mchog bgyis na cis ma legs/ /ji ltar mi rtag srin po duyi/ /khar chud ma gyur de srid par/ /lha yi srid pa ru bzlog la/ /bsgrim ⑦par mdzod cig mi yi rje/ /gang tshe srin bu'i ⑧mgrin chud gyur/ /de tshe khyod kyi dmag dang dpung / /mthu dang 'byor pa btsun mo sras/ /rtsal bsnyems ⑨cir yang ma mchis so /kye ma sngon nas dub pa'i las/ /rtag tu bzod dka'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /nyer rtsal da dung bsnyems ⑩med na/ /rgyal srid rgyal po ji ltar dregs/ /rgya mtshor bying bas rnyed pa'i gru/ /chu rgyun drag po'i rba dang ni/ /mngar skyur lo tog bya sgod shing / /rgyal po na rgas rgud dang 'chi/ /bzhi po 'di dag bsam par gyis/ /ji ltar phan btags ⑩de ltar gnod/ /yod na skyo dang med na gdung / /'grogs na skyon mthong rtsod gyur pa/ /sems can rnams kyi mtshan 96—766

nyid lags/ /gcig tu dge ba dkar po'i chos/ /des ①ni 'di phyi 'phral yun du/ /don yod ④don yod dgos mi dgos/ /na rgas rgud dang 'chi la dris| /kyi hud 'jig rten mig bcas long / /mngon sum rtag tu nges mthong yang / /da dung cung zad mi sems pa/ /khyod snying rdo rjer gyur tam ci//tshe 'di bstod bde rnyed grags kyis①/ /gzi brjid 'od kyis snying brid pa/ /'chal rnams de don gnyer ba yis/ /sems g.yengs nas ni dran ma mchis /yun ring ༷sngon nas da lta srid/ /na tshod gzhon dang gnyen ⑤dang rgan/ /'di tsam grangs kyis shi gyur kyang / /khyod ni rten dbang gis buganas na/ /ji srid skyes nas da lta'i bar/ /dus ni thung ngam ring yang rung / /yud tsam bsdad kyang mi snyam ⑦par/ /skad cig gcig gi ⑧chad par 'das/ /de bzhin da ⑨nas 'chi mtha' yas/ /cung zad 'dug pa'i lang med par/ /chad ⑩kyis 'das pa'i skad cig la/ /dran pa yud tsam byas te 'gro/ /btsun mo lha mo 'dra na yang / /mi bzad rul sungs brgyal ⑪ba nyid/ /sgo dgu mi gtsang rgyun rtag 'dzag /bshes gzugs ro langs lags so rje/ /lha gcig ⑫ji ltar khyod 'byor kyang / /gshegs nas 'jig rten gzhan bzhud tshe/ /mya ngan thang la dgra bcom ltar/ /gcig pu sras med btsun mo min/ /na bza' ma mchis bshes ma mchis/ /rgyal srid ma mchis khab ma mchis/ /dpag med mthu dpung mnga' lags kyang / /gzigs su ma mchis gsan ma mchis/ /gcig tsam nyid gcig phyi thag gi⑫/ /rjes su 'brang ba'ang mi mnga'o/ /mdor na nyid kyi mtshan tsam yang / /de tshe med na gzhan ci smos/ /'jig rten bde ba sdug bsngal te/ /thar pa'i bde ba bde ba nyid/ /de bas sdug bsngal mi 96—767

bzhed na/ /nges par thar pa cis mi bzhed/ /thar pa zhes bya bcing ①grol phyirarka/ /'ching rgyu longs spyod sems can lus/ /bsdam phyir chags sdang zhe sdang yin/ /de phyir rgyal pos 'di nyid gzhom/ /gang yang mi yi gtso bo gson//'di na gang dag 'dren pa yin①/ /bshes gnyen ngan pas sems bslad dag /'jig rten snga phyi sked smra ba/ /de ni sbrul gdug nag po'i lha/ /tshig tsam rigs ①pa la brten nas/ /zhib mo rnam dpyod ma mdzad par/ /lha yi thugs brten rjomi rung ngo / /'di ltar snga phyi yod min na/ /da ltar srog sems gsal 'di gang / /rlan drod dus sad yal 'dab las/ /me tog 'bras bu ji bzhin no/ /nags dang sa las me tog dang / /sha mo rdol ba bzhin ce na/ /'o na ji lta de lta bur/ /shing sdong la yang srog sems min/ /gang de 'di 'dra dngos po'i rigs/ /tha dad rigs pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /de bas 'di dang 'di yi dpe/ /mtshungs par ⑤dpag par mi nus so/ /gzigs shig sems can srog lus dag /gcig dang cig shos rtag gi narjo/ /re zhig gcig na lus dang sems/ /shing dang nam mkha' 'dra ba'i phyir/ /de dag phan tshun de 'drar 'gyur/ /pha dang bu yi lus sems bzhin/ /de zad cig shos zad min pas—/ /tha dad phyogs kyang mi rung ngo / /yun ring gnas skabs 'byel ba yis④—/ /rjes su 'gro ldog nges na ni/ /shing dang yal ga ri dang sdong / /thams cad da ⑧ltar thal bar 'gyur/ /sems ni thogs med 'gags ⑨med bdag /mkha' ltar zhi ⑩dag stong pa'i phyir/ /gang du ji ltar chad par 'gyur/ /dul ba gzhan yang mu stegs can/ /bdag tu lta ba gtan ma ⑪mchis 'di la mgon po ma brtags par/ /nyid kyis bab col ⑫mi bgyi'o/ /'ching ba 96—768

rnam grol las gdams pa/ /gzigs nas brtan pos rnam dpyod mdzod/ /mi bzad lta ba 'di nyid las/ /gcig ni sreg byed me dpung ste/ /gnyis pa lcags sgog 'ching ba lags/ /mkhas rnams nye bar mi bgyid do/ /de ltar lta ba'i dri ma las/ /log nas drang srong bstan zhugs ①te/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas dang sras/ /theg gsum rim gyis ②bgrod par gsol/ /dpyod ldan bdag gis khyod gsol cig① /gus dang mi gus tsam nyid kyis/ /blang bar mi bgyid dudor mi bgyi/ /gser la dhimagar bas bsreg sogs bzhin/ /rnam brtags nges par gyur nas gdodadhi/ /mi rigs rgyang du 'phang du gsol/ /de ste rigs par gzigs na ni/ /nyid kyis ④spyi gtsug blang du gsol/ /rgyal po zla ba la springs pa'i spring ⑧yig /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shrī dzā ga ta mi tra ā ⑨nan+das mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rnal 'byor gye dbang phyug de nyid dang / bod kyi lo chung gnubs tshul khrims shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //96—769

bsdur mchan/764 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉la rgyal po zla ba la springs pa'i phrin yig rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shrī dza gad ta mi tra ā nan tas mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/sde〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ga ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnam dang lha/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rtul/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈rtesnar 〉〉lo/ rjo〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉de nas/765 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyur/ mi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lags/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyu/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyur/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma de/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉marakhrugs/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyes/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/766 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉byedaka' gsung / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉marabras/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sgra/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mdzad/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dbyeng / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / dze+e〈〈snar 〉ra sgrims/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge 'i/⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snyems/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabastsal da rung snyems/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabartags/767 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phyir 'phral yul bu/ /don med/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazhan dang nyams/ 0rte〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mgo/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mnyam/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉phyag 〈〈snar 〉〉phyed/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasum rgyal/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cig ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shegs/768 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cings/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ ④〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rig ni〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rtan/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da / dze+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(5/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gag ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma nga / ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉smra/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉ma col/769 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rtan bzhugs/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉gyi/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tshog rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra gyi/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉maradod/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉rte〈snar 〉raban/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mas/96byed770
bsdur 'bras re'u migazing yig (18)96wa 771

snyi /bshes pa'i spring yig gi rgya cher bshad pa tshig gsal ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ byag ①ta pa da su z-i da le kha ṭī kā/ bod skad du/ bshes pa'i spring yig gi ①rgya cher bshad pa tshig gsal ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdza' bo rgyal po ④bde spyod la spring yig yon tan can 'di bskur bas na bshes pa'i phrin yig ces bya ba'odu/ /de la yon tan rang bzhin zhes bya ba ni bod pa ste—/ sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba las nges par skyed dhipa'i phyir/ /rang bzhin ni rgyu yin no/ /de nyid kyi phyir/ dge ⑦'os zhes 'chad par 'gyur te/ gang zhig 'das pa'i dus na dge ba ⑧byed pa de ni/ da ltar byung ba'i dus na/dge ⑨ba'i skal ba can du 'gyur ro/ /'dis ni 'di dam pa'i chos mnyan pa'i 'os nyid yin par bshad de/ /de lta bas na khyod kyis 'phags pa'i dbyangs 'di dag gsan pa'i rigs so zhes bya ba yin no/ /de dag sus ni byas/96—772

ci'i phyir ni byas she na/ bdag gis ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ba ①snyad las byung ba'i/ /bsod nams 'dun slad 'phags pa'i dbyangs 'di dag /cung zad cig bsdebs zhes bya ba smos so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ②bsnyad ces bya ba ni rab tu bstan pa zhes bya ba'i tha tshig ste/ de las byung ba'i bsod nams gang yin pa de la 'dun pa'i phyir bdag gis①/'phags pa'i dbyangs 'di dag bsdebs shing sbyar gyis/ gsan pa'i rigs so zhes bya ba yin no/ /'phags pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba ni tshigs su bcad pa'i ming ngo / /de dag kyang ci tsam zhig ce na/ cung zad cig ces bya ba smos te/'dis ni tshig mangs pa'i 'jigs pa spong bar byed do/ /rnam pa gzhan du na/yon tan rang bzhin zhes bya ba ni yon tan gyi ngo bo nyid ces bya ba'i tha tshig ste/'dis ni 'di dge ba'i mtshan ④nyid yin par bshad do/ /dge 'os zhes bya ba ni dge bar 'os pa nyid de/ dge ba'i bsam pa can gang yin pa de ni dge bar 'os pa yin no/ /de bas na dam pa'i chos mnyan pa'i rigs so zhes ston par byed de/ dge ba ni de'i ⑤sngon du 'gro ba can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lhag ma ni snga ma yin dhino/ /gal te khyod kyi snyan dngags bzang po ma yin pa 'di ⑦mi nyan no snyam du sems na de'i phyir/ ji ltar bde gshegs sku gzugs shing las kyang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ kyang zhes bya ba'i sgras ④ni/rdo ba dang 'jim pa la sogs pa bsdu'o/ /ci 'dra'ang rung zhes bya ba 'dis ni bzang po'am bzang po ma yin pa yang rung zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /ji ltar shing las de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs byas pa ci 'dra'ang rung ⑨ba ni bzhi ⑩po'i khyad par la mkhas pa rnams kyis mchod par bya ba yin pa de bzhin du bdag 96—773

gi ①snyan dngags 'di yang ngan zhing bzang po ma yin yang / dam pa'i chos kyi gtam la brten pa'i phyir bsngags par bya ba yin no zhes ston par byed de②/bsngags par bya ba ①yin pa'i phyir/ mnyan par bya ba yang yin no snyam du dgongs pa yin no/ /'on te dhings de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' rnams shes zin pa nyid pas/ /yang snyan dngags 'dis ji zhig bya snyam du sems na de'i phyir—/ thub pa chen po'i bka' ni snyan dgu zhig /khyod kyi ⑤thugs su lta yang chud mod kyi/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ yang zhes bya ba'i sgras ni thos pa dang rab tu bshad pa dang bsgom 0pa dag bsdu'o/ /'di skad du khyod kyi dze+ethub pa chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' snyan pa dag lta thugs su ④chud mod kyi/ 'on kyang snyan dngags 'di smad par bya ba ma yin no zhes bshad pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rdo thal las bgyis dgung zla'i 'od kyis ni/ /ches dkar nyid du ci ste mi bgyid lags/ /zhes bya ba ⑨smos so/ /ni zhes bya ba ni 'di ⑩ltar zhes bya ba'i tha tshig ste/ 'di ltar gzhal med khang ⑪rdo thal las byas pa rang bzhin gyis dkar ba yang zla ba'i 'od zer rnams kyis bzlas pa bzhin du dkar po nyid du byed pas bka' 6) zin pa la yang bzlas na/ ches gsal ba nyid du 'gyur bas snyan dngags 'di smad par bya ba ma yin no/ /de la nyon mongs pa dang skye ba bag chags dang bcas pa de ⑫med pa'i phyir/ thub pa chen po ni ⑫de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /legs par gsungs pa'i phyir snyan pa yin no/ /'di man chad rgyal bas sangs rgyas chos dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni chos bstan pa yin no/ /sdig pa'i chos las rgyal ba'i phyir/ rgyal ba ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams te ji skad du/ sdig pa'i chos las spyong 96—774

rgyal bas/ /de bas nyer 'gro nga rgyal ba'o①/ /zhes gsungs pa ②lta bu'o/ /rjes su dran pa drug /rab tu bka' stsal zhes bya ba drug gang zhe na 'di lta ste/sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang / chos rjes su dran pa dang / dge 'dun rjes su dran pa dang / gtong ba rjes su dran pa dang / tshul khrims rjes su dran pa dang / lha rjes su dran pa'o/ /de la sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i dran pa nyid rjes su dran pa yin te/ de bzhin du thams cad la sbyar ro/ /yang rjes su dran pa de dag ji ltar bsgom par bya zhe na/ rang rang gi zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa ①so so'i yon tan rnams kyis ④rjes su dran pa de dag rjes su dran par bya zhing yid la bya'o zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /'dir ni sangs rgyas la sogs pa nyid rjes su dran pa dag yin par bshad de/rjes su dran pa'i gnas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir sangs rgyas la sogs pa de dag rang ⑤rang gi yon tan gyi dhitshogs rnams kyis ⑦rjes su dran par bya'o zhes byas na legs par 'byor pa nyid do/ /yang sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i yon tan gang dag yin zhe na/ re zhig sangs rgyas kyi yon tan sgeni/ 'di ltar de ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ste/ de lta bu la sogs pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan yin ⑨no/ /'di ltar ⑩bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten na snyan pa'i rnam par ⑪grags pa gang yin pa de ni/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das/ 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa zhes 96—775

tshig thams cad dang sbyar bar bya ①ste/ 'di lta bu yang yin/ 'di lta bu yang yin zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /de la 'dod chags la sogs pa bcom pa nyid kyis bcom ldan 'das so/ /byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs pa la/ bar chad bya bar brtson pa'i bdud bcom pa'i phyir yang bcom ldan 'das so/ /rnam pa gcig tu na 'di la skal ba yod pas na bcom ldan 'das de ②dbang phyug la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba ni dngos po ji lta bar gnas pa ①de dag de bzhin du rtogs shing thugs su chud pas na de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /ji skad gsungs pa de dukho na ltar yin gyis ⑤gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir yang de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /dgra bcom pa zhes bya ba ni nyon mongs pa'i dgra bcom pa'i phyir ro/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcom pas 'di'i phyir yang dgra bcom pa'o/ /rnyed pa dang bkur stes mchod par 'os pa'i phyir yang dgra bcom pa'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba ni 'dis chos rnams yang dag par rjophyin ci ma log par kun nas sangs rgyas pas na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa zhes bya ba ni rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa ste/ mkhyen pa dang zhabs lta bu tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dag dang ldan pa'i phyir rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa zhes bya ba ni mjes pa'i gnas su gshegs pa'i phyir bde bar gshegs pa zhes bya'o/ /phyir mi ldog par gshegs pa'i phyir yang bde bar gshegs pa ste/ rims nad legs par byang ba bzhin no//'jig rten mkhyen pa zhes bya ba ni 'jig pas na 'jig rten no/ /de yang rnam pa gnyis te/ sems can gyi 'jig rten dang sdod kyi 'jig rten no/ /de dag 96—776

mkhyen pas na 'jig rten mkhyen pa ste sems can gyi 'jig rten gyi ni rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i yan lag bcu gnyis rnam par gzhag ①pa yongs su mkhyen pa'i phyir dang / snod kyi 'jig rten gyi yang sa dang ①ri la sogs pa 'byung ba dang gnas pa ①dang tshad la sogs pa yongs su mkhyen pa'i phyir 'jig rten mkhyen pa zhes bya'o/ /rnam pa gcig tu na 'jig rten gyi tha snyad bzang po yongs su — mkhyen pa'i phyir 'jig rten mkhyen pa zhes bya'o/ /skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba—/ bla na med pa zhes rjobya ba la/ gdul bar rung ba ni gdul ba'o/ /de dag ni skyes bu yang yin la/ gdul ba yang yin pas skyes bu gdul ba'o/ /de dag gi kha lo sgyur ba ni skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba ste de dag gdul ⑤ba'i phyir ro/ /bla na med pa ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dag pas khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir te 'dul ba ni 'dir 'phags pa'i lam thob pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /des ni 'di 'dul dubar 'gyur te/ yang dmu rgod kyi ngo bor mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa zhes bya ba la lha dang mi zhes smos pa ni de dag mchog yin pa'i phyir ram/ 'phags pa'i lam gyi snod yin pa'i phyir ro/ /phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i phyir ston pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan 'di dag ⑦ni bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du ⑧chos ston pas rab tu phye ba bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/⑨ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni/ de kho na nyid thugs su chud pa'i phyir sangs rgyas zhes bya ste/ tshig gi mjug mi mngon par byas pa'i ⑩phyir ro/ /rnam pa gcig tu na blo rgyas pa'i phyir te/ pad+ma rgyas pa bzhin no/ /yang na mi shes pa'i gnyid las ⑪sad pa'i phyir te skyes bu gnyid sad pa bzhin no/ /'di ni tshig 'di rnams kyi ⑫bsdus 96—777

pa'i don yin te/ rgyas par ni bstan bcos gzhan dag las khong du chud par bya'o—/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bshad zin to/ /chos kyi yon tan ni legs par gsungs pa la sogs pa ①yin te/ 'di lta ste bcom ldan 'das kyi snechos ni legs par gsungs pa yang snedag par mthong ba dang bund med pa dus chad pa med pa/ 'di mthong ba la don ⑤yod pa/ nye bar gtod pa/mkhas pa rnams kyi so sor durang gi rig par bya ba ste/ bstan pa'i chos dang rtogs pa'i chos zhes bya ba chos rnam pa gnyis bstan to/ /de la bsdus pa'i don ni legs par gsungs pa zhes bya ba 'dis ni thog ma dang bar ⑦dang tha mar dge ba nyid kyis ⑧bstan pa'i chos bshad la/ lhag ma rnams kyis ni rtogs pa'i chos bshad do zhes ⑨bya ba yin te/ ha cang tshig mangs su dogs pas ma spros so/ /dge 'dun gyi yon tan ni legs par zhugs pa la sogs pa yin te/'di lta ste bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ni legs par zhugs pa/drang por zhugs pa/ rigs par zhugs pa/ mthun par zhugs pa 'di lta ste/skyes bu zung bzhi dang / skyes bu gang zag ya ⑩brgyad po dag yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge 'dun 'di ni kun du sbyin pa'i 'os su gyur pa/rab tu sbyin pa'i 'os su gyur pa/ bskor ⑪bar bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ thal mo sbyar ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ 'jig rten gyi bsod nams kyi zhing bla na med pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /'dir yang bsdus pa'i don ni 'phags pa'i dge 'dun slob pa ⑫dang mi slob pa'i yon tan rnams ⑫pa gnyis bstan te legs par zhugs pa la sogs pa tshig bzhis ni bsgrub ④pa'i yon tan bshad do/ /kun du sbyin pa'i 'os su gyur pa la sogs pas ni mchod par 'os pa nyid kyi yon tan bstan 96—778
