༄ga /dad skyed sgon ma bzhugs so//①༄4/ /sems can dam pa'i chos la dad pa skyed ②mdzad pa'i/ /dad— pa skyed ①mdzad bla ma dam pa dang / /mos pas yon tan 'byung ba'i dkon mchog la/ /bdag nyid gus pas de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhe sdang me yis rang gi rjorgyud bsregs shing / /gti mug mun pas shes rab dmigs bu ldongs/ /'khor ba'i g.yang busar lhung bas sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bzung zhing lcags bcug pa'i/ /ma 'ongs skye bo'i don du bdag gis brtsam par bya/ /bdag gi rjorgyud la legs par tshur bltas pas/ /mi lus 'di ni shin tu thob par dka'/ /gyang ngos sran ma gtor ba gcig chags srid—/ /thams cad sa la ltung ⑦nas song ba ltar/ /mi lus thob dka' sems can grangs la ltos/ /rgya mtsho gcig nas gnya' shing bug pa dang / /rus sbal phrad pa bas kyang dud 'gro nas/ /mi nyid ches thob dka' bas mi dbang 96byed956

gis—/ /dam chos spyad pas de 'bras mchis par mdzod/ /sbyin nor 'dra ba'i mi lus 'di thob tshe/ /'di la phan pa'i thar pa ma bsgrubs par/ /phyis ni dal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa 'di/ /thob par dka' ba'i tshe 'di chung ma ①gsan / /'jig rten spyod pa dag la phar bltas pas/ /thar la mi mos sdig la ②dga' ba bta/ /mtho la phrag dog mnyam la 'gran sems byed/ /dma' la nga rgyal bstod na dregs pa skyerjo/ /mi snyan brjod na khong nas 'khrug par 'gyurarka/ /rang don thar pa rgyab tu bor byas nas/ /'khrul don bu dang nor la bdag tu 'dzin/ /skyabs pa'i chos bzhag thar pa'i lam sna bor/ /sdug pa'i mi chos glen pa'i bu nor sog⑤ /ji tsam sdig la bsdos nas nor bsags kyang / /sdig pa'i rnam smin rmongs pa bdag nyid 'khyar/ /bsags pa'i nor ni kho bdag bu tsha khyer/ /ro dang mtshungs kyang bdag nyid bzang por 'dzin/ /'khor ba'i btson rar tshud kyang 'bros bsam med/ /phyi na rten med zas nor bu la chags/ /dad ldan pha ma'i gdung dhisems rtsad nas bral/ /bdag ni stobs bzang gzhan ni dregs pa 'joms/ /gzhan gyi nor dang rdzas la chags pa skye/ /ma bcol gzhan la gnod pa'i kha gtogs zer/ /nyan bshad dus na ⑦bsam pa logs su gtong ⑧/ /dkon mchog mthong na skyon med gshe tshig smra/ /sems can mthong na zhe sdang gsod sems skye/ /'di la skyid na phyi ma sdug mod zer—/ /de dang ldan pa'i sems can skye bo de/ /mi lus chud gsan ad tsa ⑨snying re rje/ /gling mchog bzhi na 'dzam gling 'dir skye dka'/ /'di na sems can grangs mang gnas pa la/ /mi lus 'di ni shin tu thob dka' na/ /'on long zha bor gyur kyang chos spyod dka'/ /sgro skur med pa'i lus thob gzhon pa'i 96byed957

tsheske/ /dam chos mi spyod mi lus chud re gsan/ /gang zhig gser snod rin chen spras pa yis/ /ngan sgyugs 'phyag par byed pa de bas kyang / /gang zhig mi ru skyes nas sdig pa dag /byed pa de dag rab tu blun pa lags/ /na dang rga dang 'chi ba'i dus byung na/ /mi lus chud gsan 'gyod kyang phan pa med/ /dper na zon med dgra phyogs phyin pa'i tshe/ /dgra yis ①zin nas 'gyod pa'i 'bras sems byer/ /skyes kyang phan med bdag gis mi thar na/ /de 'dra de bas chos la 'bad par rigs/ /phyis 'jigs dogs nas sngon du mkhar dpe rtsig① /phyi ma ngan song 'jigs nas sngon du spyod/ /lo dus su ni dar cig mi sdod na/ /nam la yod de tshe la long med do/ /lo zlas dhi'adas shing 'chi dang phar phar nye/ /rang gi tshe ni gad kha'i shing bu 'dra/ /'chi bdag bdud ni gad rtsa'i chu bo 'dra/ /skye rga dun 'chi rang thag dhire mos 'dra/ /mi rtag 'gyur ba dbyar dgun ston dpyid 'dra/ /snga ma shi ba'i mi rnams kun gyis kyang / /rtag tu re zhing bu dang nor bsags kyang / /bu nor phyir lus bdag la phan pa med/ /rang nyid dge sdig gnyis dang sbrags nas 'gro/ /nor dang rdzas ni shing ga'i bye'u mechung 'dra/ /mi rtag nges kyis chags sems gnyen pos chod—/ /skyid sdug mi rtag kha song ⑧di ring 'dra/ /chos la 'gro bar chas ⑨tshe gnyen 'dun ⑩tshogs/ /yon tan brjod cing mi chos bya dgos zer/ /nor gyis brid cing de yi bar du gcod/ /dug bum thogs nas gtor du 'ongs ⑪dang mtshungs/ /bdag la bya snyam gnyen 'dun smra ba nyan/ /bde ba bkag nas g.yang sar gtong dang mtshungs/ /'khor ba'i bu tsha dug gi me tog 'dra/ /mthong na dga' ste ngan song rgyu sogs yin/ /bdag nyid 'chi bdag bdud 96—958

kyis bslus pa'i tshe/ /mal gyi tha mar nyal nas lus gdungs te/ /zas kyi tha ma skyug kyang ngur brgyags snyod①/ /pha ma gnyen 'dun rnams kyis mtha' bskor te—/ /de tshe rang la ci yis phan sems dang / /shags kyis mi ④lo dpa' bos 'thab tu med/ /mkhar gyis mi thub nor gyis slu ④ru med/ /gnyen gyis mi phan sdar ma 'bros su med/ /zug gzer che yang gnyen 'dun bskor mi btub//gson tshe byams kyang shi nas 'jigs nas 'bros/ /yul mkhar bor nas rang shong gcig tu skyel/ /gnyen 'dun bor nas bdag dang gcig pu 'khyam④/ /bdag la byams kyang phyi nas 'ong ba med/ /de 'dra'i gnyen rtsad gos kyi rdul bzhin spongs/ /byang sems myu gus rtsad nas ma bsregs par/ /byang chub mchog gi sems de rtag tu zung / /byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis//'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde gshegs sras su dgongs te byin gyis rlobs/ /sems can mi bde bsal ⑤bar 'dod pa dang / /'khor bar gnas dang bral bar ④'dod pa rnams/ /byang chub mchog gi sems 'di rtag tu bskyed/ /'phags pa'i gdams ngag don chen 'di lags te/ /khyod kyis thugs dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis/ /byang sems chos kyi rtsa ba lags par gsungs/ /khengs grags dge ba bsod nams 'bras bu bzhin/ /bden par spyad kyang zad par 'gyur ba yin/ /sems bskyed pa yi yon tan rtag par yang / /'bras bu 'byin cing mi zad 'phel ba yin/ /sdig pa'i phung po ri rab tsam yod kyang / /sems bskyed tsam gyis de dag zhi nus na/ /de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi rten⑦/ /des ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig chen rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis de dag bsreg par nus/ /de phyir bdag 96—959

gis sems bskyed g.yo ba dang / /smon dang 'jug pa gnyis kyis sems bskyed de—/ /mi ldog rtse gcig pa yi dad pa yis/ /byang chub sems de rtag tu ①gzung bar bya/ /de nas le lo gnyid kyi dbang song bas/ /sems bskyed brjed kyang bsod nams shugs la ②'phel/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i chu bo'i ①gzhung dang mtshungs/ /nam yang 'byung ste yon tan brjod mi lang sems bskyed dad pas dam chos sgor zhugs pa'i/ /skyes bu dam pas man ngag 'di ltar zung / /mi khom gnas su skyes na chos spyad dka'/ /rang la dbang yod bzhin du dbang med zer/ /bdud kyis mngon bslus rang nyid phung rjobar 'gyur—/ /thar pa bdag la rag las 'di la ni/ /gzhan gyis ci yang grogs bgyir ma mchis kyis/ /mi lus thob tshe dal gyis spyad par rigs/ /bde sdug zin pa med kyis dam chos spyod/ /'jig rten longs spyod sus ⑤za cha med kyis//sngun dun sdod kyi dze+eso nam 'bad par rigs/ /gal te mi lus thob nas gzhon pa'i tshe/ /'jig rten dga' ba'i ca co sogs bor la/ /gzhon pa'i tshe ni dam chos dang du long / /bu tsha snying sdug 'khor ba'i rtod ④phur yin/ /bu tsha bden par 'dzin pa'i rmongs pa 'ga'/ /lus la shig za bya ra mig gis byas/ /sor mo'i rgya ba bkye ⑨nas gshed mas gsad⑩/ /rnam smin gdong na sdod ⑪de phyi mar smin/ /sdug bsngal myong tshe bu yis bdag mi phan/ /khyod kyis ⑫dge slong bram ze lha dang ni/ /mgron dang yab yum sras dang btsun mo dang / /'khor gyi slad du sdig pa mi bgyi ste⑫/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bskal ④'dod 'ga' ma mchis/ /de phyir bu la ma chags chos la 'bod/ /gzhon tshe dam pa'i chos la ma 'bad na/ /rgas nas nyan 'dod rna bas sgra mi thos/ /shes rab bying 96—960

bas blo la rtogs pa ①dka'/ /chos la 'gro 'dod lus la nus pa med/ /chos la dga' yang bdag gis spyod mi nus/ /gzhon pa'i tshe na dam chos cis mi spyad//dam pa'i chos la bden par ngo yis zung / /'jig rten bde ba sprin bzhin 'gyur ldog che/ /chos la spyod na phyug por mkhyen par mdzod/ /'jig rten nor gyis phyug pas phung bar nges/ /sdig bcu spangs nas dge bcu dang len pa//mdzangs ②pa lags te skyes bu phyi mar bde/ /mi 'khyag ④tsam du dag dug gon byas shing / /mi ltogs tsam du zas ngan zos byas la/ /longs spyod bla med byang chub bsngo bar bya/ /nor rnams kun gyi nang na chog shes pa/ /rab mchog lags par lha mi'i ston pas gsungs/ /kun du chog shes mdzod cig chog shes na/ /nor mi bdog kyang yang dag 'byor ba lags/ /bdag ni khyod la byams pa'i zhal ta zer/ /bdag la zas nor skyabs kyi re ba med/ /ngan song 'khor ba'i gnas dang bral phyir gdams/ /bka' ltar mi byed gti mug smad pa'i gnas/ /g.yang sar 'gro yang dogs zon bya dgos na/ /bskal pa'i gting lhung g.yang sa smos ci dgos/ /di ring sang la 'chi bar mi 'gyur zhes—/ /bde bar 'dug pa bdag gis ga la rigs/ /chos spyad gzhon yang rjoshi ba bde ba ste/ /zhing khams dag par 'gro zhing sdug bsngal med/ /chos med rgan rgon shi ba skyid ces smra/ /shi sdug lags te ngan song gnas su 'gro/ /skyid sdug gnyis kyi bye brag mkhyen par mdzod/ /chos dang ldan na dman yang bkur snyi thob/ /chos kyi ngag byung mkhas pas bshad kyi ⑤nyon/ /'jig rten nor dang ldan zhing dam chos rdzas kyis spyod/ /chos la ma thongs durdzas kyi mngon zhen gyis/ /longs spyod rnams ni skar mda'i rang bzhin la/ /yongs su ma 96—961

btang de dag nges par 'gyur/ /dgra dang chom rkun dag dang rgyal pos 'joms//mi bsad stong du 'gro srid rkun pos rku yang srid/ /chos la btong ①ba'i brtson 'grus spyad par rigs/ /longs spyod g.yo ba snying po med mkhyen nas/ /dge slong bram ze gnyen dang bshes rnams la/ /sbyin pa tshul bzhin stsal bgyi ②pha rol du/ /sbyin las gzhan pa'i gnyen mchog ma mchis so/ /'gron po yun rings rgyags su sbyin pa rme/ /rdzas rnams myur du thod cig skyes bu ①dad pa can//byin rlabs 'dir 'byung phyi ma gdong na sdod/ /bde skyid 'dod dang sdug bsngal sgong 'dod dang / /rigs mtho bzhin legs bde ba'i gnas thob dang //bde mthong mos shing sdug bsngal spong 'dod pas/ /dam chos 'di ni rtag tu spyad par bya/ /lha dang mi yi bde ba thob 'dod pas/ /dge bcu spyod de lus kha bsrung ba ni/ /'dod log g.yem dang srog gcod rku dub dang / /brdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub 'khyal pa dang / /brnab sems gnod sems log par lta ba dang / /rang don lags kyis sdig bcu rgyab tu bor/ /rang la byams shing brtse bas 'bad par bya/ /rngon pa mi rgod rkun po jag pa sogs/ /sdig pa'i rkyen sogs grogs po 'dug pa spong ⑤/ /kun du dge ba'i slob dpon sman bzhin bsten/ /'on long zhar sgur lus thob rgud pa dang / /dbul phongs rjobazhin ngan las las nad mang rnams/ /rnam smin lags kyis gzhan la yus ma ches⑦—/ /mtho ris ngan song gnyis la gang mos pa/ /rang dbang yod kyis skyid sdug khyad par nyon/ /gal te mtho ris thar ⑧pa mngon zhe ⑨na/ /yang dag lta ba goms pa dag tu mdzod/ /rnam rtog ri bos mnan pa'i sems can rnams//sdug bsngal 'di la bzod pa'i glags ⑫med de/ /'khor bas 'khor te zo chun 96—962

khyud ①mo 'dra/ /rnam rtog rlung gis khyer te rtsi shing lo 'dab 'dra/ /rnam rtog rgyud la skyes te rtswa la me mched 'dra/ /ye shes skad cig mi gnas dbyar kha'i she ④mun 'dra/ /phyi yi sdug bsngal bzhi ni rang sems pyong / /yod na mi thub med na btsal ①mi rnyed/ /byams dang bral dogs sdang dang phrad kyi dogs/ /nang gi sdug bsngal bzhis ni rang lus 'joms/ /ma lus 'byung tshe brag bar btsir ba 'dra/ /ma yis mchongs tshe g.yang la phyin pa snyam/ /lhung tshe tsher ma'i dong du bsgyur ba snyam/ /blangs na bye chung khra yis khyer ba snyam/ /skye ba'i snyug bsngal rang lus rdul bzhin zlog /lo zla 'das shing rgas pa shugs kyis 'ong / /rgas tshe mgo la skra dkar so yang med/ /rna bas mi thos mig gis rang mi mthong /'dug na rang lus sa rdo chad pa 'dra/ /langs na spang las ⑦phur pa 'byin dang mtshungasaske/ /phyi sgor 'gro yang sgur nas gog cing 'gro/ /zas skom 'dod na gzhan la rag las slong / /bu tshas mthong yang mi mos yid mi 'ong / /dug po bskon zhing sgo rtsa srung du gtod/ /gzhan dag 'ong nas dhingo tsha phar zur zer/ /khyem mtshes dubyis pa gshe zhing 'tshe ru 'ong / / 'tshogs par ⑦phyin na sgyugs ④bro phar song zer/ /shi skal chad de rgan rgon yi dwags skye/ /ngo tsha khrel 'dzem shor de gzhan gyis skyur⑨/ /bu smad kun yang shi na rung zhes smras⑩/ /rkang lag 'dar zhing kha mig chu yis khengs/ /lus kyi stobs shor ber ga grogs su tshol/ /legs par smras kyang gzhan gyi rnar mi snyan/ /bde bar nyal kyang lus tshigs khol zhing na/ /gzhan la gtam smras rgas pa'i ngag mi snyan/ /rgas pa'i sdug bsngal bshad na kun la'ang / /lus la nad med bde sdug re ba rnams/ /nges pa 'dod pas nongs dang 'chi ba dang / /na rga la sogs sdug bsngal du ma 96—963

yi①ske/ /'byung gnas 'khor ba la ni skyo mdzod cig /de yi nyes pa'i ④shas kyang mkhyen par mdzod/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i lam la bde ba med/ /rigs drug sems can nad la grangs re mang / /dug lnga dug gsum nad kyi dbal re tsha/ /thog mtha' med pa nad kyi yun re ring / /de ltar lags te ma rig bde ru med/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi zhags pas zin pa'i tshe/ /lus ngag yid gsum nad kyis thibs pa'i tshe/ /ngag gi sdug bsngal rnga mo bu stor 'dra/ /lhang lhang tser tser cis kyang nad kyi dbang / /lus kyi sdug bsngal skam la nya skyur 'dra/ /rgal bu stod stod 'phar yang nyams ①stobs med/ /'bros par bsams kyang thar pa'i dus mtha' med/ /gzer gyis lus btab ngo tsha khrel 'dzem shor/ /gnyen 'dun bskor yang sdug bsngal rang gis myong / /zas skom kha ru bcug kyang bro brlag med/ /nye bas dubos kyang kha nas ⑤skad mi thon//ji ltar nyal kyang bde ba'i bar skabs med/ /sdig la 'gyod pa skyes kyang bshags long med/ /na ba'i sdug bsngal lags te mekun la 'ong / /des na mi ni yang dag nyid du mi bde zhing / /mi gtsang bdag med pa ru rig par bgyi/ /'chi ba'i tshe na dge sdig las kyis 'byed⑦/ /dge ba can ni 'chi tshe bde ba mthong / /mun pa'i khams nas bde ba byung ba dang / /lus la chags pa med cing lus sems bral nas ⑧dga'/ /bde gshegs bskor ba byed cing chos bshad mthong / /bde ba'i zhing khams byung bas mos pa 'byung / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan mchod pa'i rdzas 'bul dang / /'gro drug gnas mthong snying rje'i sems 'byung ste/ /de dang ldan na bde ba'i gnas su skye/ /sdig can dag ni 'chi tshe nyes skyon mthong / /snang ba'i khams ni mun pa nam sros bzhin/ /96—964

mtho na spyi tshugs ①thur la song ba mthong / /lag na 'dug pa gdug pa'i mtshon char mthong / /sgra skad thams cad gdug rtog sgra ru thos/ /sdig pa byas na ②ngan song lam du ston/ /'chi bdag gshin rjes rgyab nas phul zhing brdeg /srog gcod bdud kyis gdong nas brtson ①bzhin khrid/ /gcan gzan gdug pa'i 'brug sgra bzhin du sgrogs/ /mtshon cha gdug pa'i dbal ni rtsang bzhin 'dzugs| /'khor ba'i g.yang sar ri gzar rbab bzhin 'dril/ /yi dwags gnas na sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /bkres skom grang ngo rjongal dang 'jigs pa yis/ /skyed ⑤pa shin tu mi bzad sten tshu'atshal lo/ /mgo lus skom ④par mi mthun rgyu las byung / /skom skyugs bro ⑧zer sna yi ⑨rgyu las byung / /sdug bsngal che ste las la zad dus med/ /gal te tshe zad dmyal ba'i gnas 'gro ste/ /skad cig yud kyis gnas der myur bar phyin/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rig na mchi ma 'ong / /btsong ⑩khu rgyal po 'phrang du bsdad nas ni/ /gson po pags pa bshus shing yan lag 'don/ /de ltar byas kyang rnams ⑩smin 'chir mi 'dod//bye ba phrag brgya nyams su spyong yang ni/ /ji srid mi dge de zad ma gyur pa/ /de srid srog dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /dmyal ba'i lcags khang mthong na dga' snyam sems/ /las kyi sgo phye nang du dbang med 'gro/ /las rlung phug nas sgo gcod mun pa 'thibs/ /phyogs mtshams kun nas me 'byung 'bros sa med—/ /sha rus tshig kyang 'chi ru las kyis 'tsho/ /rang nyid zangs su 'tshod cing sha rus bral/ /phur bzhi rgyang ⑫shing steng 'og lcags kyis btab/ /lcags gzer steng 'og lus la gang bar 'debs/ /gal te 'gul ⑫na lhu tshigs rus pa 'bral/ /lcags kyi bya phra ④mkha' la lding zhing 'debs/ /mtshon cha'i 96byed965

'khor los lus la dum bur gcod/ /lcags kyi tho chen mkha' la lding zhing brdeg /sog les spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang mthil ①gshog / sru gris ②gtams pa'i ri la dbang med 'dzeg /rnag khrag bshul ba'i dri ma dpag tshad khyab/ /rang gis rang bsregs ①skye bo rang gis len/ /'chongs pa dude ltar lags te lha mi dang / /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro rnam ⑤dag tu/ /skye ba bzang po ma lags skye ba ni/ /gnod pa du ma'i snod gyur lags pas mkhyen par dumadzod/ /des na 'jig rten bde nus ci la phan/ /de phyir bdag gis bshad pa'i man ngag nyon / /'gro ba'i don mdzad bla ma dam pa yis/ /ma 'ongs sems can skye ba'i ④don dag tu/ /man ngag dad skyed ⑧sgron ma 'di brtsams pas/ /'gro ba kun byis sangs rgyas thob par shog/ //slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/ dad skyes ⑨sgon ma rdzogs so// //⑩96—966

༄ / /dpe'i phreng ba/hu7 ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ dṛhā na ta mā l+ya/ bod skad du/ dpe'i phreng ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por smra ba rnams kyi rab mchog ston pa dang / /srid pa gsum gyi 'dod chags rnams 'joms chos dang ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i bstan pa bdud rtsi'i snod gyur pa/ /gang zag mchog brgyad kyis brgyan dge 'dun rab brtul zhing / /bsam rdzogs rtsib logs 'tsher la sogs pa de dang de/ /thams cad yod smra'i khyu mchog dad pas mchod byas te/ /dpe yi phreng ba 'di ni bdag gis bshad par bya / /rab blo'i legs sbyar ma sbas 'di na de bstan byis/ /yon tan dang skyon gyi 5snyematshan nyid khong du chud pa las mchod par bya ba dang / mchod par bya ba ma yin pa rtogs par 'gyur bas yon tan dang skyon byi mtshan nyid khong du chud pa la sgorab tu 'bad par bya'o/ /de yang 'di ltar rjes su thos te/ yul gan 96byed969

dha ra nas tshong pa kha cig bcom brlag ①tu song ba dang / de de na mchod rten rnams la yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal zhing dge sbyong rnams la yang bsnyen bkur dang bcas pas phyag byed par gyur pa dang / de la 'di ni dge bsnyen yin no snyam du shes nas bram ze rnams kyis bzhad gad byas par gyur to zhes grag go/ /de nas re zhig gcig ②na de so ga'i ①dus kyi phyi dro'i tshe bram ze zhig gis ④lam srang na 'dug go/ /der yang ⑤bram ze kha cig khrus byas shing dris byugs pa dang zas la spyad pas dbang po tshim pa dang khang pa sgo'i phyogs na lag na rnga yab thogs shing mchod phyir dkar po thogs la/ gcig tu shas cher bgad dude gtam la rjes su chags shing dga' bas kun du 'khod par gyur pa dang / de rnams kyis dge bsnyen de bltas nas rab tu bgad ⑦do/ /bram ze gzhan zhig gis kyang smras pa/ sangs rgyas kyi dge bsnyen khyod tshur shog stan yod par 'dug shig⑧ /de der 'dug pa dang / bram ze zhig gis dris pa/ gang lha chen po dang khyab 'jug la sogs pa'i lha rnams spangs nas sangs rgyas la mchod pa byed par ⑨gan dha ra ba rnams kyi rang bzhin 'di ci zhig yin/ des bgad de smras pa/bdag cag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi yon tan rnams kyi phyogs gcig shes kyi lha chen po la sogs pa'i lha rnams kyi yon tan ni ⑩mi shes te/ rgyu des na ⑪sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed pa yin no/ /des de'i tshig de thos pa dang / bram ze kha cig gis smras pa/ legs ldan lha chen po'i yon tan mi shes pa ⑫'di ni/ khyod glen pa yin te gang gi phyir/ 'di na lha min grong khyer mkha' la rgyu/ /skyes pa bud med rgan dang gzhon bcas pa/ /gzhu chen blangs nas 'bar ba'i mda' yis ni/ /me yis rtswa bzhin skad cig dag 96—970

gis bsregs/ /dge snyen ①gyis smras pa/ gang rang bzhin gyis 'chi ba'i chos can gyi srog chags rnams la gsad pa'i phyir 'bad pa dang ldan pa'i sems can gyi khyad par de 'dra ba la ni kho bo mi dga'o/ /su zhig zil pa'i thigs pa ni/ /rtswa yi rtse la chags pa dag /ngang gis 'jig ①pa'i chos can la/ /gzhig pa'i phyir ni 'bad par byed/ /re zhig gzhan thams cad lta zhog gis①/ ci khyed rnams pha rol la gnod pa byed pa yon tan yin par shes sam/ de nas bram ze de dag thams cad kyis dus gcig tu smras pa/ lha ma yin gsod pa ni yon tan yin par rab tu shes pa'o/ /dge snyen dubyis dbugs phyung ste smras pa/ las gang las ni dam pa rnams/ /ngo tshar ⑤gyur pa de nyid la/ /dam pa min pa dregs gyur pa/ /kye ma 'jig rten ngo mtshar che/ /zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten las dulegs par smras pa yin no/ /mdor na/ yon tan skyon stsogs brtags la bya ba dang / /bya min sad pas rgyal ba'i yon tan ni/ /rgya chen rjes la yon tan nges dga' rnams/ /mchod pa'i 'bras bu 'dod pa rgya chen yin/ /skyon la yon tan dag tu 'du shes shing / /skyon dang ldan pa dam par shes pas mchod⑦—/ /'bras bu rgya chen thob par mi 'gyur gyi/ /lta ba ngan pa dag kyang 'phel bar 'gyur/ /tshig de bram ze rgan po kha cig gis thos pa dang / khro bas 'bar ba'i mig gis dge bsnyen de la lta zhing brnyas pa dang bcas lag pa g.yon pas ston cing smras pa/ gan dhar ba rmongs pa rnams de skad ma smra shig⑧ /gal te lha ma yin gsod par dga' ba'i lha chen po la sogs pa'i lha rnams mchod par bya ba ma yin na mchod par bya bar su zhig 'gyur/ dge snyen ⑨gyis smras pa/gang yon tan yang dag pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba ste/ bram ze chen po ltos shig /96—971

gang zhig stobs ldan 'tshe ba rnams/ /gal te mchod byar de gyur ①na/ /dred dang gzig dang stag la yang / /'gro ba rtag tu mchod par 'gyur/ /yon tan skyon mkhas dam pa ni/ /su la yang ni 'dod mi byed/ /dred la sogs pa'i gdug pa rnams/ /yon tan med la mchod mi byed/ /mi 'tshe ②la sogs yon tan yin/ /'tshe sogs skyon du shes par bya/ /yon tan skyon rnams mi shes pas/ /skyon ni yon tan dag tu shes/ /gang gis shin tu drag po'i las/ /'jig rten byes pas mthong ①nas su/ /mchod pa'i yul las mi mkhas pas/ /de nyid lan ④ni mchod byar shes/ /gan dhar ba ni nges par yang / /skyon dang yon tan rtog dang ldan/ /des na sangs rgyas bcom ldan la/ /dad kyi ⑤lha chen sogs la min/ /bram zes smras pa/ kye gan dha ra ba re zhig sangs rgyas—zhes dhibya ba 'di su zhig yin dge bsnyen gyis smras pa/ /shākya'i rigs su legs 'khrungs pa/ /kun mkhyen nyes pa kun las rgyal/ /sems can kun la phan bzhed pa/ /drang srong chen po sangs rgyas yin/ /bram zes smras pa/gal te sangs rgyas drang srong chen po yin par shes na/ gzhan la gnod pa byed pa de mchod par bya ba ma yin par smra ⑦'am/ 'di la ⑧'pho ba dang / me 'bar ba dang / rgyas pa dang / gnas 'jog dang / rgyun shes dang /phur bu gsum pa dang / rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pa drang srong chen po rnams kyis ⑨dmod pa 'debs so zhes 'jig rten na grags so/ /gal te sangs rgyas de drang srong chen por gyur na nges par des kyang dmod pa 'debs par byed par ⑫'gyur ro/ /dge bsnyen gyis rna ba bkag nas smras pa/ sdig par ma gyur cig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni dmod pa 'debs par mi mdzad do/ /bram 96—972

zes smras pa/ sdig pa zhi bar gyur cig ces 'dir ci'i phyir smra/ gal te sangs rgyas dmod pa 'debs par mdzad na ni/ de yang dag par 'tshe ba can du 'gyur ro/ /'on te su la yang dmod pa mi 'debs na sangs rgyas 'di la mthu ci yang med do/ /de nas bram ze de dag rnams kyis gnyis ①ka ltar 'gal ba'i tshig gis gan dha ra ba khyad par du bsad nas gsang mthon pos brgyad par brtsams so/ /dge bsnyen des ma 'khrul pa nyid du smras pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mthu chen po mi mnga' ba yang ma yin mod kyi 'on kyang dmod pa'i rgyu dang bral bas gang la yang dmod pa mi mdzad do/ /bram ze chen po ltos shig /chags can gang la kun du chags/ /de dang bral na de khros te/ /bya dang bya min rnam rmongs pa/ /phyi ④nas dmod pa gtong bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod chags bral/ /rmongs pa dang bral khro las rgyal/ /sems can thams cad phan mdzad na/ /de ni dmod pa ji ltar mdzad/ /de nas bram ze de rnams yid la bzung ba'i rgyu rnams rjes su dpog cing dge bsnyen de la smras pa/ kye gan dha ra ba gal te sangs rgyas dmod pa mi byed na/ nges par phan 'dogs par yang mi byed do/ /dmod pa dang phan 'dogs pa'i nus pa dang bral na ni/ drang srong chen por yang mi 'gyur ro/ /dge bsnyen gyis smras pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dmod pa'i nus pa mi mnga' ba 'di ni de ltar bden mod kyi/ 'on kyang phan 'dogs par ni ④spyod pa nyid yin te/khyed rnams kyang ltos shig /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal la sdar bas/ /de ni dmod pa mi mdzad kyi/ /'jig rten phan 'dogs brtson pas na/ /phan par yang ni mdzad pa yin/ /rga nad 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /ngang gis 'jig rten 96—973

sdug bsngal na/ /rma la lan tshwa ji bzhin du/ /mkhas pa su zhig dmod pa 'debasarka/ /de yang byams pa la gnas shing / /rtag tu snying rje'i bdag nyid can—/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung bsel ba'i/ /chu yis 'jig rten tshim par mdzad/ /de nas bram ze de rnams yud tsam zhig mgo thur du smad nas bsams te/ dge bsnyan ①de la rjes dang bcas pa'i mig gdangs pas bltas teske/ smras pa kye gan dha ra ba shin tu brtags pa'i gnas rnyed nas khyod kyis rab tu dad pas bdag cag ngo mtshar du byas so/ /mang du smras pas ci zhig bya ste—/ gan dhar ②zhes bya ba'i yi ge ni don phyin ci ma log par grags pa yin te/ci'i phyir zhe na/ go zhes bya ba sa ru bshad/ /sa de gang zhig yang dag 'dzin//skyes bu dam pa de rnams ni/ dam pa sa 'dzin zhes bshad do/ /ci'i phyir na sa 'di ni/ /khyed cag rnams kyis 'dzin mi byed/ /gang phyir khyed kyi yon tan bsngags/ /mgon po sangs rgyas la brten ①yin/ /de nas dge bsnyen des bram ze rnams kyi sems sdod du rung bar byas par shes te/ da ni sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bshad pa'i dus yin no snyam nas/ yang dag par dga' ba'i bzhin gyis gzengs rjobastod de smras pa/ gang byed ⑤rnams sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la dad pa skyes par gyur pas bdag ni mchog tu yang dga' ba skyes par gyur mod kyi/ 'on kyang dad pa 'di nyid 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir yon tan dang skyon gyi bumatshan nyid rjes su dran par bya ste/ de ④ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang tshe 'gro ba yon tan rab rtog tshe/ /rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho gcig pur mthong //zhi dang dga' ba skyes par gyur mod kyi/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab kyis//sangs rgyas dang mnyam gang na'ang yod ma yin/ /dper na ri rab mnyam pa'i 96—974

ri ni med/ /rgya mtsho mnyam pa'i mtsho ni yod ma yin/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas dang mnyam sa stengs sam/ /mkha' la lus can mchog de yod ma yin/ /shākya'i khyu mchog des ni gang phyir dal bas dka' bar ma zhugs ci zhig yod/ /thub pas phan pa'i don du lan mang dgongs te ma gzigs de ni gang zhig yod/ /de la skyabs song drang srong des ni phan gdags ma byas de ni gang zhig yod/ /'di nas ①des gsungs lam la rab gnas nyon mongs dgra bcom de ni su zhig yodarka/ /mu stegs kun las rgyal de ④bde bar gshegs zhes yon tan rnams ④rgyas dri med grags pa'i kha bye gzhan su yod/ /phug na seng ge lta bur lha yul sa stengs dag na 'jigs med rang gi rjogasung mchog sgogs pa gzhan su yod/ /rtag tu yid 'ong gsung gis las dang nyon mongs dag gi ⑤gnas skabs rjes su ston pa mdzad pa'ang gzhan su yod/ /gang gis ④mchod rten mkha' la sprin dkar lta bur 'gro ba yang dag brgyan pa 'ga' yang 'di na yod ma yin/ /de nas bram ze de rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi bsngags pa thos pa dang /sangs rgyas la mngon par dad par gyur to/ /'dis ci zhig ⑦ston pa yin zhe na/de ltar sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thos pas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par dad par shes pas/ dad pa la ni gzhan rnams kyang yang dag par gzhug par bya'o zhes nye bar ston pa'i mdo brtsams pa yin no/ /de yang dge slong dag khyed rnams kyis gang ⑧rjes su brtse ba dang / gang snying brtse bar bya'o zhes rgya cher gsungs pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas mchog la gsungs pa'i yon tan gyi ⑨phan yon gyi mdo sde dag la yang nye bar sbyar bar bya'o/ /gus par byas te chos nyan pa la yang brjod par bya'o/ /yang 'dis ci zhig ston ce na/ de ltar sangs 96—975

rgyas kyi yon tan thos pa don gzhan la mngon par zhen pa'i bram ze rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das la mngon par dad par 'gyur na/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thos pas rna dkrugs pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ khyed rnams sangs rgyas kyi ①yon tan thos pas dad pa rnam par 'phel bar ci'i phyir mi 'gyur te/ de bas na sangs rgyas dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' dag gi bsngags pa mnyan par shin tu 'dod pa'i khyem na gnas pa dang / rab tu byung ba khyed rnams kyis ma yengs par mnyan par bya'o zhes 'di ni yang dag par skul bar byed pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas mchog gi dpe ste dang po'osti/ /rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma ①shrī bha dra dang / lo tsā ba ban de tshul khrims yon tan byis bsgyur cing / dge slong rin chen bzang pos bcos nas zhus te gtan la phab pa// //96—976

bsdur mchan/969 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉la dpe'i phreng ba bzhugs so/ /zhes dang / 〈〈snar 〉〉la dpe'i zeng ba bzhugs/ mya ngan med pa'i sgo nas klu btul ba'i le'u bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉gyis/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/97༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bag ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gigacig ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sos ka'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra yang / du⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma rgad/ ske〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ga ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpa/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gidi/ ⑪〈〈snar 〉sngag nas/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉tham/971 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉rabasnyen/ ②〈〈snar 〉skarajigs/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sheg/ ༷〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉so/ /dge bsnyen/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamatshar/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamadzod/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mo'ig ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra snyen/972 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉maragyur/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rnamachod/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skal/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shes/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉 ba/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7byed par/973 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganyi/ sde〈〈snar 〉〉phyin/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gini/974 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉thasnyen/ ②〈〈pe 〉sngagan+d+rar/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snyen/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazeng /⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉khyod/ du〈〈snar 〉7)sa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gide/975 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnam/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ste sa/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉gis/rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(gi/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da ston pa/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gigang / ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giyon tan gyi/976 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyis/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de dang po/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dharmā/96byed977
bsdur 'bras re'u migadzing yig (25)96wa 978

༄ga /mya ngan med pa'i sgo nas klu btul ba'i le'u'o//①rak+ṣa/ /rgya gar skad du/ a sho ka mu kha nā ga bi na ya pa ri ts+tsha daḥ①/bod skad du/ mya ngan med pa'i sgo nas klu btul ba'i le'u'o/ /'di ltar rjes su thos te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya lon pa na/ grong khyer pa ta li pu trar rgyal po mya ngan med ces bya ba 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i ①bzhi cha la dbang byed pa zhig byung dubar gyur to/ /des nor gyi don du tshong pa lnga brgya bkug nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed song la rgya mtsho chen po nas rin po che sna tshogs pa long la shog shig⑤ /gang gi tshe de dag rim gyis song ste rgya mtsho chen por phyin nas/ rin po che dang / gser dang /dngul dang / rdo rje dang / bai ḍūr+ya dang / shang ka shi la dang / bye ⑥ru la sogs pa rin po che'i tshogs du mas de dag gi ④gru yongs su bkang ste 'dzam bu'i gling du phyogs te chas so/ /de dag log nas 'ongs pa na rgya mtsho'i dkyil du 96byed979

klus gru bcom nas/ de nas tshong pa de dag srog gi lhag ma 'ba' zhig dang grus 'ongs te/ gang gi tshe rim gyis grong khyer pa ta li pu trar phyin pa dang / rgyal po mya ngan med kyis tshong pa rnams 'ongs so zhes thos so/ /de skad ces bya ste/rtswa yis me ni ngoms med ①sreg /rgya mtsho chu yis ngoms pa med/ /'dir ni lha yul yid 'ong bas/ /'gro rnams dbang drug ngoms pa med/ /ces bya ba yin pas de 'dod pa'i rgyus sems bskyed cing nor du ma dgram pa'i gnas bya'o snyam du bsams te/ de nas de'i ②rdzing bu dang bcas pa'i skyed mos tshal du gnas rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ba dan dang rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba bla re dang gos kyis spras par yid du 'ong ba'i spos rnams ni gtul/ gangs ltar bsal ba'i chus gang ba'i rdzing bu na shel lta bu'i phye ma dang ldan pa ut+pa la dang / pad+ma dang / ku mu ta dang / puṇ+ḍa ①rī ka rnams kyis khebs pa/ ngang pa dang /khu byug dang / rma bya dang / ṣ+pe tso dang / ri skegs dang / ngur ba dang /ka la ping ka dang / shang shang te'u dag ④bya skad snyan pa sgogs pas nyams dga' ba/ pi wang dang / gling bu dang / rdza rnga dang / sgra bzangs dang /'khar rnga dang / pa ṭa ha dang / rnga bo che dang / dung rnams rgyun du rdung ba/blon po dang / grong mi dang / ljongs kyi mi dang / skye bo rnams ni 'dus/dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / kun du rgyu dang / gcer bu pa dang /kun du 'tsho ba pa ⑤la sogs pa ngo mtshar gyis 'dus te nor bu dang / mu tig dang / be+e ḍūr+ya dang / shang ka shi la dang / bye ru dang / mu tig dmar po dang / mu sa la galba rjodang / in+d+ra nī ⑦la dang / mthon ka chen po la sogs pa'i rin po che'i bye brag rnams blta bar bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po 96—980

nor dgram par ①'dug ste/ tshong pa lnga brgya po de dag kyang rgyal po'i drung du 'ongs pa dang / thams cad stod g.yogs gcig pu dang ldan zhing gcer bur gnas so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ ci'i phyir 'di lta bu'i gnas skabs su gyur/tshong pa rnams kyis smras pa/ lha gru bcom pas 'di ltar 'gyur ro②/ /rgyal pos spras pa/ gang gis gru bcom par gyur/ tshong pa rnams kyis smras pa ba tshwa can gyi rgya mtsho na gnas pa'i klus bcom lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/bdag gis dus 'dir ①ji ltar bsgrub par bya/ tshong pa rnams kyis smras pa/lha 'di yongs su btsal du gsol/ /gal te tshol bar mi mdzad na phyi dhinas kyang tshong pa 'ga' yang rgya mtsho chen por 'jug par mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe 'khor de na dge slong dbang po zhes bya ba bsod nams che ba zhig yod de/ de rgyal po dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig na 'dug par gyur to/ /rgyal pos tshe dang ldan pa dbang po la smras pa/ slob dpon bdag gis 'di la ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/tshe dang ldan pa dbang pos smras pa/ rgyal po chen po zangs ma'i byang bu la yi ge bris la rgya mtshor rdzongs shig /ci tsam na rgyal pos zangs ma la spring yig tu bris te smras pa/ sa 'di rgya mtshos gtugs pa skyong / /rgyal po stobs ldan mya ngan med—/ /rab tu drag cing btsan pa yis/ /nor khyer mtshor gnas gang yin pa—/ /de dag 'dir ni myur ba ru/ /nga yi drung du bskyal bar gyis⑤/ /zhes yi ger bris te/ zangs ma'i byang bu de ⑦rgya mtshor bskyur ro/ /de nas klu ma rangs nas/ rgya mtsho nas slar 'dzam bu'i gling du bskyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po'i pho nyas zangs ma'i byang bu de blangs nas slar pa ta li pu trar 'ongs te/rgyal po la skabs de bsnyad pa dang / de nas rgyal po mya ngan med sems khong du 96—981

chud nas mtshan mo stan gyi steng du ①nyal te/ ji ltar 'di la bsgrub par bya snyam du sems so/ /de nas nam mkha'i dkyil na gnas pa'i lhas rgyal po la smras pa/rgyal po chen po sdug bsngal ma byed cig /'jig rten gsum mchog lha mi'i ②mchod—/ /stobs phyug chu srin rgyal mtshan can/ /mthar byed bde gshegs sku gdung la/ /mchod pa rnams kyis rab mchod gyis/ /de rjes khyod kyi ①dgos 'grub 'gyur/ /lha gnyis pas smras pa/ gang zhig bya min rgyal chen mya ngan ma mdzad par/ /sngags dang rig sngags sman sbyor mi bubagyid par/ /mi dbang dbang du bya bar nus 'gyur ba/ /bde gshegs bstan la lhag par ⑤gus pa yis—/ /de yis klu rgyal gang yin dbang du 'gyur/ /de nas zhag gnyis pa la rgyal po mya ngan med skra bkrus te/ gos dkar po bgos nas dri dang / me tog dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa rnams thogs nas tshig 'di skad ces smras so—/ /phyogs mtshams mkha' bzhugs rdzu 'phrul ldan/ /shar gyi phyogs dang gzhan bzhugs la/ /bdag ni gsol 'debs spyan 'dren gyis/ /bdag la thugs rjes gzung du gsol/ /rgyal pos de skad ces smras ma thag tu shar phyogs dang lho phyogs dang nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs rnams nas dgra bcom pa stong phrag drug cu byon zhing 'dus par gyur to/ /rgyal pos me tog dang /spos dang / dri dang / byug pa rnams thogs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung la mchod pa byas te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod pa—/ na ba ⑥dang ni rgas dang sdug phongs gzhan yang 'chi gzigs nas/ /rgyal bas yul dang 'byor pa btsun mo'i 'khor dang nye du spangs/ /sa bdag zas gtsang drung gshegs bskrad nas rgyal po'i dpal spangs pa/ /bcom ldan de 96—982

la bdag gus dang bas de yi sku gdung mchod/ /gang gi stobs kyis bdud ni shin tu stobs ldan blta bar dka' rnams bcom/ gang gis bā ra ḍā sīr ①'khor lo legs bskor srid spangs ④zhi bar mdzad/ /gang gis lnga sde skye ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gdungs 'chi ba bkrol/ /shākya thub de'i sku gdung dpe med 'di la bdag gis yang dag mchod/ /gang zhig gang du mya ngan 'das gshegs 'dir ni mar me 'gags pa bzhin/ /glang po stong stobs las lhag de ni mi rtag stobs kyis phye mar brlagasasne/ /sa bdag mchog gis cha brgyad mnyam bgos sku gdung yang dag mchod gyur pa/ /de yis rjosku gdung dpe med 'di ni 'jig rten mkhas pas yang dag mchod/ /de nas dge slong gi ⑤dge 'dun la gdugs tshod drangs nas mchod do/ /de nas rgyal pos tshe dang ldan pa dbang po la smras pa/ 'phags pa ci zhig mchog tu bsgrub par bgyi/ tshe dang ldan pa dbang pos smras pa/ rgyal po chen po dang po ni khyod kyi gzugs gnyis pa klu'i gzugs te/ sku gzugs legs pa gnyis mdzod la gser gyi snod chen po byas pa'i nang du de gnyis stsol cig dang de las mngon sum du gzigs par 'gyur ro//de bzhin du byas te phyis rgyal pos bltas pa dang / klu'i gzugs 'dug pa la rgyal po'i gzugs phyag byed pa rgyal pos mthong ngo / /rgyal po yid la gcags par gyur pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa dbang pos smras parjo/ rgyal po chen po dus 'dir yang dang yang du nyi ma re re la khyad par gzigs par 'gyur ro/ /ji lta ji ltar rgyal pos de bzhin gshegs pa la me tog dang / phreng ba dang / dri dang / spos dang / byug pa rnams kyis mchod cing dge slong gi dge 'dun la yang rang gi lag nas bza' ba dang bca' ba rnams tshim par bstabs shing rgya 96—983

cher mchod par byas te/ chos kyang gus par mnyan pa de lta de ltar rgyal po'i gzugs langs pa la klu'i gzugs phyag 'tshal bar gyur to/ /yang de'i rjes la klu'i gzugs de yan lag thams cad kyis rgyal po'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal bar gyur pa mthong bas des ①rgyal po yid rab tu dga' bar gyur te/ tshe dang ldan pa dbang po la smras pa/ kye ma dkon mchog gsum mchod pa'i/ /'bras bu ci 'dra 'di la gzigs/ /rgya mtsho'i nang na gnas pa'i klu/ /bdag gis btul zhing 'di dbang bgyis/ /blo gros chung ba'i mi rnams kyang / /su zhig sangs rgyas mchod mi bgyed/ /gang zhig 'bras bu 'phral ②bskyed la/ /su zhig yid kyis sems mi bgyid/ /bdag nyid che ba thob 'dod pa'i/ /lha rnams dang ni mi rnams kyis/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yang dag mchod/ /skye ba zad cing yang srid med/ /slob dpon dbang pos skabs la bab par shes nas smras pa/rgyal po chen po zangs ma'i yi ge yang nga spring ba'i rigs so/ /rgyal pos yang zangs ma'i yi ge de bskur nas btang ngo / /de rgya mtshor bsgyur ba dang /klu'i rgyal pos yi ge de spyi bos blangs so/ /de nas des ①rgyal po la lan mang du lha tshong pa de dag 'dir rdzongs shig /so so'i rin po che gang lags pa bskur ④la slar brdzang ngo zhes smras pa dang / de nas rgyal po'i pho nya slar 'ongs nas rgyal po la phrin de smras pa dang / de nas rgyal pos tshong pa rnams ⑤bos nas smras pa khyed cag song la so so'i rin po che gang yin pa long la slar shog shigarjo /de nas gnas brtan dbang pos rgyal po la brgyad pa/ chos kyi rgyal po la sa rdul ngan pa 'bul bar byed pa yin mod/ de nas rgyal pos gnas brtan dbang po la smras pa/ slob dpon 'o na ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ gnas brtan dbang 96—984

pos smras pa/ khyod la chad pa yin gyis rang gi phrag pa la khur la 'dir skyol cig ces zangs ma la yi ge slar btang bar gyis shig /de nas rgyal pos spring yig tu bris pa 'dzam bu'i gling gi dbang phyug dam pa'i mnga' bdag gi ①bka' bcag pa'i chad par rang gi phrag pa ②la skyol cig ces yi ge btang ba dang /yi ge bklags ma thag tu klu'i rgyal po skrag par gyur nas smras pa/ lha de lta lags na gdugs bdun na 'tshal la 'chi'o④/ /de rgyal pos thos pa dang /pa ta li pu tra'i grong khyer thams cad du dril bsgrags te/ gang zhig grong khyer 'di na gnas pa'i skyes pa dang / bud med bsod nams kyi khyad par dang /rgyal po'i rnam par 'phrul pa mthong bar 'dod pa dag zhag bdun pa la rgyal po'i pho brang du shog shigadhi /de nas rgyal pos zhag bdun pa la grong khyer pa rnams dang / blon po dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs kyi mis yongs su gang bar bskor te/ rgyal po'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / mthu chen po dang / 'byor pa chen pos 'khor gyi khyams su song nas seng ge'i khri la 'dug go/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po klu du mas yongs su bskor nas mi'i cha byad du sprul te/ rang rang gi phrag pa la rin po che'i khur thogs nas rgyal po chen po mya ngan med ga la ba der song ste phyin nas khyar rnams phog nas rkang pa gnyis la phyag byas so/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen po de ⑤ngo mtshar du gyur terjo/ sngon ma mthong ba mthong ngo zhes ca co'i sgra bsgrags te 'di skad ces ⑦smras so/ /'di 'dra'i bsod nams stobs kyis ni/ /rgyal po yongs su gzung bar gyur/ /skye bo rnams ni ngo mtshar skyes/ /lha rnams dang ni 'di ru yang / /phun sum tshogs pa 'dod pa yis/ /bsod nams gang yin zhes bya ba/ /'di lta'i bye brag su mi sgrub⑧/ /bsam du med 96—985

pa'ang gang bsams pa/ /don de 'bad pa med pa ru/ /mi rnams la ni 'bras bur smin/ /rkang thang glang chen stsos pa dang / /rta dang shing rtas rgya mtsho na/ /gnas pa'i klu dang lhan cig g.yul/ /stobs chen sna tshogs mtshon chas min/ /sdug bsngal mgo bo'i gdengs ka can/ /bsod nams rang bzhin 'di 'dra ba'i/ /zhags pa yi ni nges bcings nas/ /mya ngan med rgyal zhal mthong ba/ /bka' drin bsams pas rjes mthun 'jug /des kyang de dag sna tshogs pa'i dka' bas 'ongs pa mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ①bka'i yon tan rjes su brjod pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad gsungs/ /bsod nams me yis mi 'tshig ②ste/ /rlung gis ④'jig par mi 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams chu yis 'ju mi 'gyur/ /sa bzhin du ni khyer mi 'gyur/ /rgyal po dang ni chom rkun gyis/ /dbrog tu med par bsod nams gnas/ /skyes pa dang ni bud med kyis/ /dbrog par nus pa ma yin no/ /bsod nams bde ba skyed pa'i gter/ /'dir ni lus par mi 'gyur te/ /gang dang gang du skyes pa ru/ /de dang der ni rjes su 'brang / /de nas blon po gzhan zhig ngo mtshar skyes nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /yongs su bskor ba'i 'khor dbus na//bsod nams rgyan gyis durgyal po mdzes/ /skar ma'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor pa'i—/ /ston ka yi ni zla ba bzhin/ /chu dang mkha' la 'gro ba'i klu⑤/ /bsod nams kyis ni nges pham byas/ /sa la gnas pa'i dgra yi tshogs/ /bsod nams kyis ni zad par byed/ /ji ltar yid la bsams pa yi0 bde ba bsod nams kyis thob byed/ /bsod nams 'di ni bsags pa ru/ /sems dang ldan pa su mi byed/ /sbas ⑦pas grub ces bya ba'i blon pos smras pa/96—986

bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad gsungs/ /bsod nams 'di ni dag byed yin//bsod nams nges par 'bab stegs te/ /mtho ris su ni 'gro ba'i lam/ /mi rnams bdes ①rol bsod nams yin/ /bsod nams rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi//mya ngan 'das par 'gro ba'i lam/ /yang blon po gsum pa gzhan zhig gis smras pa—/ bsod nams kyis ni khyod kyi bzhin/ /zla ba dang ba ⑤shar dang mtshungs//rgya mtsho'i nang du zhugs pa yang / /bsod nams kyis ni stor ①ma mchis/ /yid du 'ong ba thob byed pas/ /bsod nams 'gro bas phyag byar rjo'os/ /bsod nams yang dag bsags pa la/ /'bad par mi rnams su byed pa/ /bsod nams kyis rgyal skyes bu ni/ /rta yis ma yin glang pos min/ /shing rtas bsod nams las rgyal min/ /mda' dang ral gris ma yin no/ /nor rnams dang ni yul dang ni/ /g.yul byis bsod nams las rgyal min/ /bsod nams kyis ni rgyal ba la/ /rigs dang stobs dang gzugs kyis min/ /bsod nams kyis 'phags mi rnams nidu/ /sa rnams gsum gye steng na gnas/ /bsod nams mi rnams gnas yin te/ /bsod nams thar pa thob byed mchog /bsod nams 'jig rten grags byed yin/ /de phyir bla med bsod nams btsal//mtho ris thob byed ngan song spong / /mi yis rtag tu bsten 0bya ste/ /mkhas pas bsod nams bya ba yin/ /de nas rgyal pos tshong pa de dag rnams la smras pa/byed rang rang gi rin po che rnams khyer cig /de nas de dag gis blangs nas rgyal po la rab tu bstabs te/ gzhan yang lha'i sbyor bas lags kyi/ /lha'i de ⑦dag legs par ⑧snoms shig /rgyal pos smras pa/ bdag la cung zad kyang dgos pa med kyis khyer la song la the tshom med par longs spyod cig /de nas 96—987

rgyal pos rab tu dga' ba'i yid kyis dkon mchog la bstod pa 'di skad ces smras so/ /e ma ①sangs rgyas e ma'o chos/ /e ma'o bstan pa phun sum tshogs//sa rdul snyim gang phul ba yi⑧/ /rnam par smin pa 'di 'dra thob/ /de nas rgyal pos yang smras pa/ ding 'dir klu ni bdag dbang gyur/ /thub chen khyod kyi snebaka' drin las/ /legs spyod rgyal po bdag bgyid pa/ /bdag gi ④skye ba 'bras bcas lags/ /yon tan mchog ldan thub pa yi/ /bstan mchog 'di la su mi 'jug /dper na sa bon rdul btab pas/ /'bras bu chen po skyong byed na/ /rin chen phul ba smos ci 'tshal/ /de nas klu chos la sbyar nas slar song ngo / /mya ngan med pa'i sgo nas klu btul ba'i le'u rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po gnas brtan a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang / dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur ba'o⑤// //96—988

bsdur 'bras re'u migadzing yig (26)96wa 990

3428༄ga /dge 'dun spyan drang ba/①༄s+dza/ /rgya gar skad du/ saṃ gha man+t+ra②/ bod skad du/ dge 'dun spyan drang ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po kun mkhyen rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dri ma med pa zab mo'i chos/ /yon tan che ①ldan dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dpal shākya'i rigs chen po dam pa gtsang ma dpal shākya'i mgon po thub pa sangs rgyas nyid/ sa la mdzad pa mtha' dag rdzogs te/ 'jig rten du yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa na—/ dpal dga' ba'i bshes gnyen zhes bya ba'i sdom brtson rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan pa mngon par shes pa drug pa 'jig rten las 'das pa zhig byung bar gyur to/ /de yang 'di ltar thos te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgyad brgya 'das pa de'i tshe de'i dus na yul shi bi'i grong du/ rgyal po rnam par rgyal ba'i sde'i dus su/ dga' ba'i 96—991

bshes gnyen zhes bya ba'i dge slong byung ste/ dge slong de yang dgra bcom pa/rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan pa/ mngon par shes pa drug dang ldan pa rdzu 'phrul chen po can/ mthu chen po dang ldan pa ste/ de yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus su dge slong gi dge 'dun 'dus pa la/ ma 'ongs pa'i don lung bstan pa dge slong rnams kyis ma shes te/ gnas brtan dga' ba'i bshes gnyen la yongs su dris pa/ gnas brtan bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa yun ji srid cig gnas zhes so/ /de nyid la smras pa mar 'bri ba'i ①tshe lo bcu pa nas/ yar 'phel ba'i tshe lo drug khri pa'i bar de srid du gnas so/ /de'i 'og tu lo stong phrag bcur dbu skra ②sha la sogs pa'i ring bsrel ①gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu lo stong phrag bcur rang sangs rgyas rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas lo brgyad khri pa la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das byams pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de'i bstan pa la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la sangs rgyas la dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrun pa'am/chos la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa'am/ dge 'dun la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa de thams cad sangs rgyas byams pa'i bstan pa la 'dus pa gsum par yongs su mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur ro/ /de la sangs rgyas la dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrun pa gang zhe na/ tha na nas tsam gyi sangs rgyas ri mor bris pa dang / glegs bam bris pa dang / 'tsho ba'i ④rgyu bsgrubs pa'o/ /chos la bsgrun pa gang zhe na/nyan thos kyis bshad pa'am/ byang chub sems dpas bshad pa'am/ sangs 96—992

rgyas kyis gsungs pa'ang rung ste/ tha na tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam bzung ba'o—/ /dge 'dun la bsgrun pa gang zhe na/ phyogs pa la sogs pa srun drangs pa dang / tha na a ru ra gcig tsam phul ba'o/ /de skad thos nas dge slong de rnams ngus pa dang / gnas brtan gyis dbugs phyung ba/ dge slong rnams ma ngu shig① /smre sngags ma 'don shig② /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ④yongs su mya ngan las 'das dhipa'i dus kyi tshe/ /nyan thos chen po bcu drug po rnams kyi phyag tu dam pa'i chos gtad par gyur te/ sbyin pa po rnams dang sbyin bdag rnams la rjes su brtse ba'i phyir dang / yon yongs su sbyong ba'i phyir du'o/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / dge slong de rnams kyis gnas brtan dga' ba'i bshes gnyen la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gnas brtan bdag cag rnams kyis gnas brtan chen po bcu drug po de dag rnams kyi mtshan dang / de dag gang du bzhugs pa mi shes so/ /gnas brtan gyis smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa rnams dang po re zhig duganas brtan bha ra dh+wa dudza piṇ+ḍi la bha ra dh+wa ⑦dza/bsod stoms len zhes bya ba/ dgra bcom pa stong dang thabs cig tu nub kyi ba lang spyod ⑧na bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan gser kanaka bat+pa ⑨be'u zhes bya ba dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang thabs cig tu byang phyogs kha che'i yul na bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan bha ra dh+wa ⑩dza zhes bya ba dgra bcom pa drug brgya dang thabs cig tu shar gyi lus 'phags gling na bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan mi phyed aster+ya⑪pa zhes bya ba dgra bcom pa bdun brgya dang / thabs cig tu byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling na bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan ba ku la ⑫zhes bya ba dgra bcom pa brgyad brgya dang thabs cig ⑫tu dzam+bu'i gling na bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan bhadrabazang po 96—993

zhes bya ba dgra bcom pa dgu brgya dang thabs cig tu zangs gling na bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan kā'od yī nag po 'char ka zhes bya ba dgra bcom pa stong dang thabs cig tu seng ha la'i gling na bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan bskru pu tra 1snazhes bya ba dgra bcom pa brgya phrag bcu gcig dang / thabs cig tu pa ṇa ba'i gling na bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan gong/la sbed byed ces bya ba dgra bcom pa stong phrag bcu gnyis dang thabs cig tu ri spos kyi ngad ldang na bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan pās+tha sa 2lam bsten 1zhes bya ba dgra bcom pa brgya phrag bcu gsum dang thabs cig tu 4sum cu rtsa gsum na bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan sgra rāhul gcan 'dzin ma grags 'dzin dang / lhan cig dgra bcom pa stong phrag bcu bzhi dang thabs cig tu thra yaṅga'i gling na bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan panagā spru 5nags na gnas zhes bya ba dgra bcom pa brgya phrag bcu dang thabs cig tu ri skya bo la bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan angabi ta 6/yan lag 'byung zhes bya ba dgra bcom pa brgya phrag bcu gsum dang thabs cig tu ri 7ngos yangs la bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan nāgase na klu'i sde zhes bya ba dgra bcom pa 8brgya phrag bcu bzhi dang thabs cig tu lus 'phags ri la bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan adzitam pham pa zhes bya ba dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang thabs cig tu bya rgod phung po'i ri la bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan lam phran tsu9ḍāpar+sā bsten rkuzhes bya ba dgra bcom pa brgya phrag bcu drug dang thabs cig tu ri gshol 11mda' 'dzin la bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan bcu drug po de rnams la shin tu chung ba'i yon phul yang 'bras bu chen por 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang / sems can gang zhig bdag bstan la/ /skra tsam rab tu sbyin byed pa/ /bskal pa stong phrag brgyad cur ni/ /longs 96byed994

spyod chen po'i 'bras chen dang / /gzugs dang nad med bde spyod cing / /de bzhin 'dod pa'i dbang phyug dang / /mthar yang bla med byang chub kyi/ /'bras bu mngon du thob par 'gyur/ /de lta'i 'bras bu che thos nas/ /su zhig bsod nams byed mi 'gyur/ /gaṇ+ḍi'i ①dus ston chags bral dus ston dang //phyogs pa spyan drang la sogs dag kyang bya/ /da ni chags bral rnams kyi mchod pa'i cho ga brjod par bya ste/ dang po re zhig nyi ma dang po la/ rje btsun sangs rgyas kyi sku khri mtho ba ④la bzhugs su gsol te/ nyi ma 'char ka'i dus su me tog la sogs pa rnams kyis dze+eyang dag par mchod de/ de'i spyan sngar maṇ+ḍal gsum dang / na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā rjoya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya zhes bya ste ⑤gnas lngar me tog la sogs pa rnams dudabul bar bya'o/ /de nas rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang / 'phrog ma la oṃ yig sngon du 'gro ba'i bzhi ba'i mtha' can gyis dze+eme tog la sogs pa dbul bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal gsum gyi de ma thag tu/chu tshod bdun pa'i don du spyan drang bar bya ste/ tshig 'di sngon du 'gro bas so/ /nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi gling na bzhugs pa'i gnas brtan ⑧bha ra dh+wa ⑨dza bsod snyoms len thub pa dge slong stong phrag gis yongs su bskor ba rnams/ sbyin pa'i bdag po ming 'di zhes bya bas sang ⑫zhal zas la chu tshod bdun pa'i don du spyan drang bar bgyi'o/ /zhabs la mchod yon dang zhabs kyi chu sngon du 'gro bas soske/ gnas brtan gser be'u zhes bya ba dge slong lnga brgyas yongs su bskor ba de—/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po ming 'di zhes bya bas song ⑪chu tshod bdun pa'i don du zhabs la mchod yon la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas spyan drang bar 96—995

bgyi'o—/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i ①dge 'dun chen po dang / 'phrog ma la yang mchod yon ②sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag pos sang zhal zas la spyan drang bar bkyi'o/ /nyi ma phyi ma la snga bar chu klung gi 'gram dang skyed mos tshal dang mchod rten gyi gnas dang nye ba'am/ gzhan du yang rung ste phyogs gtsang mar so so'i rnam pa sngon du 'gro ba la dbul ba ④la sogs pa bya ba'orjo/ /'di ltar bya ste/ nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi gling na bzhugs pa'i gnas brtan bha ra dh+wa ⑤dza bsod stoms len thub pa dgra bcom dge slong stong gis dhibaskor ba de/bdag che ge mo zhes bya ba dang sbyin pa'i bdag pos chu tshod bdun pa'i don du gzung ⑦lags kyi stan 'di la bdag rjes su gzung ⑧ba'i slad du bzhugs su gsol—/ zhabs bsel 'di dang zhabs la mchod yon 'di dag zhabs dag la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /drurba ⑨ma nyams pa dang dri dang me tog dang bcas pa'i rung ba'i chu yis zhabs dag bkru bar bgyi'o/ /de nas so so la gdan phul te ⑩ji lta bar bzhugs pa la zhal zas la sogs pa dang yid las byung ba'i 'byor pa lha rdzas kyi dri dang me tog dang bdug pa dang sgon me dang gos dang gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa ji ltar 'byor pa dbul bar bya ste/ tshig 'di yis so/ /gnas brtan bha ra dh+wa ⑪dza bsod stoms len thub pa dgra bcom pa stong gis ⑫bskor ba la zhal zas la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i tshod ma dang khur ba dang bshos dang zho la sogs pa dang bcas pa rung ba'i dri bzang po'i chus gang ba'i bum pa dang lha rdzas gya ⑫nom pa me tog dang bdug pa la sogs pa phul ba 'di bdag che ge mo dang sbyin pa'i bdag po dang sems can thams cad kyis thams cad 96—996

gzigs pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pas dbul bar bgyi'o/ /gnas brtan gnyis pa gser be'u zhes bya ba dge slong lnga brgyas yongs su bskor ba de/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba dang / sbyin pa'i bdag pos chu tshod bdun pa'i don du gzung stilags kyi/ stan phul ba la bdag rjes su gzung ②ba'i be+ed du bzhugs su gsol/ zhabs bsel dang zhabs kyi mchod yon 'di zhabs dag la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /drurba ④ma nyams pa dang / dri dang / me tog dang bcas pa'i rung ba'i chu yis zhabs dag bkru bar bgyi'o/ /de nas stan gnyis pa phul te/ ji lta bar bzhugs pa la zhal zas la sogs pa yid dang mthun pa'i lha rdzas kyi dri dang me tog dang bdug pa dang sgon me dang gos dang gdugs dang ba dan dang rgyal mtshan dang dril bu la sogs pa ji ltar 'byor pa tshig 'dis dbul bar bya'o/ /gnas brtan gser be'u thub pa lnga brgyas ④bskor ba la zhal zas la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i tshod ma dang khur ba dang / bshos dang zho la sogs pa dang bcas pa'i lha rdzas gya nom pa dri bzang po'i rung ba'i chus gang ba'i bum pa dang me tog la sogs pas ⑤bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba dang sbyin pa'i bdag po dang sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thams cad gzigs pa nyid thob cing rab tu dgod bupar 'dod pas dbul bar bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang / gnod sbyin mo chen mo 'phrog ma la yang bza' ba la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i tshod ma dang zho la sogs pa dang khur ba dang bshos dang lha rdzas gya nom pa dri zhim po rung ba'i chus gang ba'i bum pa dang me tog la sogs 96—997

pa 'di yang bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba dang sbyin pa'i bdag pos sems can thams cad bsgral ba'i phyir de rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /bzhes pa yongs su rdzogs pa na zhal bsel dang / tsan+dan dang tām+bu ①la yang 'bul zhing bzod pa ②gsol bar bya ste/ de sneskad brjod do/ /gang 'dir bdag gis bum rnyed dang /ma shes pa dang ma tshang ba/ /de yang dgongs chen bzod par gsol/ /zhing dang bsam pa rnam dag las/ /nyung ngu phul yang mi nyung 'gyur/ /bden pa yi ni tshig 'di yis/ /phra mo yang ni rgya cher 'gyur/ /phyag 'tshal ba yang bya ste/ston pa'i bstan pa skyong mdzad ri mchog gling dang niṅgi dza lar rjobazhugs/ /sangs rgyas mnyes pa lhur mdzad nyon mongs ltos 'gro 'joms/ /sems can don ni mchog tu rgyas mdzad sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung / /gnas brtan bcu drug slob mar bcas pa'i zhabs la mchog tu phyag 'tshal bo/ /bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba yang bya ste/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid//thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te/ rga nad 'chi ba'i rlabs chen 'khrugs rjopa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba 'don par shog /ces ⑦so/ /lcogs ⑧brgyad rang bzhin ri bo ni/ /gling dang nye ⑨gling yang dag ldan/ /rin chen bdun gyis yang dag dkrigs/ /bla med yon 'di ⑩dbul bar bgyi/ /bla ma byang chub sems rnams la/ /'gro bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal yang dag rdzogs/ /dngos po kun gyis dbul bar bgyi/ /de ltar smon lam brjod nas ⑪gshegs su gsol te/ /khyed kyis ⑫sems can don kun mdzad—/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub khyed/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra mu ⑫swā hā zhes pas 96—998
