na429༄༅/ /gnas brtan spyan drang ba/hūṃ ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ s+tha bī ro pa ni man+t+ra rde4/ bod skad du/gnas brtan spyan drang ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /btsun pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ dgongs nas kyang / shel dang / nor bu dang / dngul dang / ku mu ta dang / kha ba'i phung po dang / zla ba'i 'od zer dang / ston gyi chu dang / nam thang ba 1dang / pad+ma'i rtsa lag ltar dri ma med par mdzod la/ rlung gi stobs kyis shing gi lcug phran bskyod pa dang /smig rgyu dang / sgyu ma dang / rmi lam dang / glog dang / rta'i shing rta'i rdul dang / ba glang gi phru gu'i rna mchog dang / sbrul gyi lce dang / zil pa dang / rgya mtsho bskyod pa'i rlabs ltar g.yo ba'i yid/ skad cig re re la yang mi sdod par 'gro ba rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis yud tsam zhig rgyu ba nang du dgag tu gsol/ smras pa/ ri gzar 'bab pa'i dba' rlabs 96byed1001

gyur pas kyang / /gang gi 1dba' rlabs 'gyur la bsgrun med par/ /'jig zhupa thogs med g.yo ba'i yid de ni/ /yud tsam rtse gcig mdzod cig btsun pa rnams / /lha yi bu mo yi chad shugs phyung skad cig zim mar byas pa'i mig /ring zhing rdzir ldan bkra la 'od 'tsher mig chags lta ba'i g.yo ba yis/ /gang gi thugs ni skye 5 rgyun gcod pa las 'khrungs g.yos 6 par ma gyur pa/bdud kyi dpung 7'joms mkhas gcig thams cad mkhyen pa de la phyag mdzod cig /skye ldan gang zhig bsten na 9 dud 'gro'i skye gnas sems can dmyal zhi dang / /yi dwags 'jig rten gnas su 'gro bar mi 'gyur sdug bsngal 'jig nyu1byed pa/ /'khor ba dag 1 na 'gro ba chen po rnams kyi grogs gyur 'phags gcig po/ /zhi bde 'gro de'i sgor gzhol chos 1 de la ni 1 gus pas brten par mdzod/ /zhi ba'i bdag nyid gang zhig bde gshegs gsung rab mthar phyin 'byung smra zhing / /gang la gus par cung zad tsam zhig byin yang sbyin pa 'phel 'gyur el/ ye shes snang bas mun pa zad byas dge slong dge 'dun de la ni/ /nyon mongs gcad pa'i ched du thams cad kyis kyang gus par phyag mdzod cig /lcang lo chun po'i skra mang mgo la thogs shing dpung mgo gnyis g.yogs la/ /rang gi 'od zer phyogs mthar 'phro ba rnams kyis 'jig rten kun 'gengs pa/ /lha dbang brgya tshebyin cod pan btud de tshangs la phyag byas gang yin te/ /byin nas dga' byas sems kyi ting 'dzin shin tu chen po'i 'bras bu yin/ /rdo rje 'od 'phro'i phreng bas dpung rgyan 'dres nas mdzes gyur cing / /lha la bka' stsol dbang po mtho ris skyong ba gang yin pa/ /de dag dge ba dag 'byung rnam smin 'gyur dus nyams dga' zhing / /mngon par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu phun 96—1002

sum tshogs pa'i rgyu rnams yin/ /kha nas rgyags 'gyur dri zhim 'byung zhing rmyemig gi mtha' dmar la/ /dbugs 'byung do shal g.yos pas nu ma 'bur la 'drud byed pa/ /sdu thugu lhan cig nor bdag dga' tshal 'dug pa gang yin pa//de yang 'gro ba nyams dga' sbyin pa'i bdag nyid chen po yin/ /'brug sgra sgrogs shing 7sprin rnams chu ni kun du len byed pa/ /rlabs 'byung dus na nor bu byi ru dung dang nya phyis 'byung / /rin chen gnas nang zichu lha nyid kyi 'byor pas gang bsrung ba/ /der yang rgyu ni sbyin pa mchog ces thub pas bka' stsal to//gang yang 'od zer rnams kyis mkha' la skar ma'i 'khor lo zil mnan cing / /ku mu ta yi rjing 5yangs rnams su dpal ni rab tu rnam phye nas/ /glang po'i mche ba'i dpal dang ldan zhing mtshan mo shin tu rab mdzes pa/ /de yang nges par sbyin pa nyid kyi 'bras bu ro bro mang po yin/ /ri rab rtse la shing rtas lam kha 'dug pa'i rin chen rdo gcog cing / /rta yi rkang lag rnams kyis dgu tshigs chu bo'i 9rlabs ni gcod byed la/ /mun pa bsal phyir nyi mas skar ma zil mnan lham me gang yin pa/ /de rgyu yid kyi 7ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed pa'i sbyin par thub pas gsungs/ /rgyal mtshan rtse btags rin chen 'od zer snang bas nam mkha' dmar gyur cing / /rta rmig 'dor bas mkha' la sprin gye phreng ba dag kyang 'dral byed la/ /rnga yab dkar pos g.yabs shing 'khor los sgyur ba song ba gang yin pa/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu de yang sbyin pas bsgrubs zhes 8thub pas bka' sprul to/ /gser gyi pad+ma'i rdul gyi bye mas dmar bris mtshor 3ni khrus byas te/ /de ni khunags 'dab bung ba sgra 'byin rnams su nyal ba'i bde rnyed nas / /rig 11'dzin chung ma lhan cig 'jigs med mkha' las 'gro ba gang 96byed1003

yin pa/ /de yang ser sna 'jil zhing skyon med dga' ba'i sbyin pa'i gzi brjid yin / /ma la ya yi ri rtser 7snatsan+dan grib mas bsel ba bye yangs pa dang / /'bigs byed ri dang gangs dang lhun po'i ri dang man da ra ba'i 1ri bo la/ /grub pa'i tshogs chen chung ma lhan cig 'jigs bral dga' ba gang yin pa/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu tshe 'di'i snying po 'byor pa de yang gtong bas yin/ /bud med rkang gdub 'khrol bas 'grogs nas 'phur ba'i phu ④ron gnas pa yimu7 /khang pa mthon po rnams dang 'bigs byed ri rtse 'gran /thupa'i ban glang dang / /gdugs dang rnga yab bud med g.yog 'khor rin chen gser dang rta rnams dang /bzang mdzes de dag kun kyang sngon gyi sbyin pa'i dge ba'i rnam smin yin/ ban+d+ra ka ltar rtsa dmar rgun chang gser snod bzang por legs drugs pa/ yongs dag a mra smin gas lta bur 7dri zhim ut+pal 'gying zhing sdem/ /na chung gshin ma nam dgos 5dus kyis stobs shing yams grangs mang 'drim pa/ /mchog tu dge ba de rgyu sbyin pa yin zhes blo gros dag pas gsungs/ /gser gye phag skas rked bcings snyan smra 'jam zhing smin ma ya gcig bskyod/ /mig yangs rnar thug dkar nag 'byes la skra bkab 9sname tog phreng dkres ⑪pa'i/ /na chung bzang mo brla rgyas bdag nyid legs byas rnams kyi skyebran ltar byed/ /tshogs bsags 'bras de sbyin pa'i che ba nyid ces zas gtsang sras pos gsungs/ /de lta lags pas bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag muthugs su chud pa shin tu rgyas pa'i chu ltar gyur pa snying po 4dri ma med pa dang / lha'i skye bo dang klu'i gnas su gyur pa/ tshul khrims 'dren ma ma yin zhing rgya che ba'i chu dang ldan pa/ dge ba la rnam par rtog pa'i zla ba shar ba'i dbang gis/ ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs 96—1004

rgyas pa'i dus kyi rlabs kyis byang chub kyi yan lag skyon med pa'i nor bu mang po kun du g.yengs pa/ sems kyi 'og gzhi la 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i ri bo chen po brtan 1pa/ 'bras bu'i bye brag thob pa gang zag chen po'i chu srin rgyu ba/ 'phags pa'i bden pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i shing ljon pas mdzes par shebyas pa/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i ngogs dang ldan pa/ sgrib pa'i ro mi gnas pa/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan goms pa dag pa'i mu tig gi nya phyis kyi khog 1lus dang ldan pa/ mngon par rtogs pa'i chos nyid gting mi dpogs shing zab pa/ rgyun mi 'chad par klog pa dang kha ton byed pa'i sgra rgya cher 'byung ba/ 'phags pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi rgya mtsho chen po la bdag gsol ba 'tshal lo/ /'di lta ste/ srid pa'i 'gro ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud 4pa dum nas dge ba'i sa bon btab pa/bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa gzhal med khang gis gzhi gcig pur 5gyur pa/bzod pa dang des pa dang byams pa dang / tshul khrims dang thos pa dang zhi ba'i gnas / bdag dang gzhan gyi 6gzhung gi don gyi de kho na ma lus par rtogs pa/yongs su shes pas bsgoms pas dran pa nye bar gnas pa yang dag pa'i ye shes mthong bas log par lta ba'i rab rib bsal ba/ legs par brjod cing shis la rgya che ba'i mig dang ldan pa skye bo bla ma la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang mngon chedu smra ba dang / phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa'i tshul bzang po dang ldan zhing mdongs gsol pe7che bas snyan pa rnams bskyed pa/ ston gyi zla ba nya ba'i 'od zer dag pa lta bu'i yid 'byung ba/ sbyin bdag chen po che ba'i bdag nyid can ming 'di zhes bya ba 'di ni khyem bdag legs sbyin dang / bzang ldan dang / btsun 96—1005

mo'i ṭ+wā'akhor kyi bla dang / mu shi la dang / tra du sa zhe7dang / go shi la dang /ta pa kaṇi snaka dang / mgon med zas sbyin dang / drag po dang / nag pa dang / nam gru la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das la yid rīmangon par dad pas/ rgyal po 5gsal rgyal dang / tshangs pas byin 6 dang /rgyal po 'char ka'i 7bu dang / gtum po rab snang la sogs pa sa'i 8steng la dbang ba'i sbyin pa las byung ba'i legs par shespyad pa'i rjes su slob ste/ lus dang / longs spyod dang 1 / srog la sgyu ma dang / smig rgyu dang / dri za'i grong khyer dang / mgal me skor 11ba dang / rmi lam dang / ri'i 'bab chu ltar g.yo bar rig 12nas/ stobs bcu mnga' bas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / chos dang 1 mngon pa dang / 'dul ba dang / mdo sde 'dzin cing dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa yod do zhes bsod nams kyi sa bon skyed kipa'i rgyu 'khor ba'i bde 7ba phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhi/ skye bo ngan pas rnyed par dka' ba ser sna can gyi yid 'joms pa sgrub pa ni ston ka'i la zla ba dri ma med pa ltar dang ba'i thugs mnga' ba/ srid pa'i sa bon nyon mongs pa 1 gcod pa/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam —snyepa mkhyen pa/grags pa 'jig rten gsum du khyab pas 1 bdud kyi bu mo steg pa rgyun gcod pa'i rgyu / skyabs su 'os pa/ chos ston pa/ 'gro ba la dge ba'i phyir 3 bya dka' ba'i phrin las rnams kyis/ chos thams cad thugs su chud pas rnam par sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi snang ba gsal bas reg nas/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa ltar ring zhing spru ma legs pa'i spyan dang ldan pa/ gnod sbyin gye bdag po'i gtsug gi nor bu chen pos zhabs kyi sor mo kun du bskor ba gser 96byed1006

gyi mchod sdong ltar gsal ba/ sku la rdo rje dang / lcags kyu dang / pad+ma dang / nya dang / rgyal mtshan dang / gdugs dang / 'khor lo la sogs pa'i mtshan rnams kyi mtshan mnga' ba/ pad+ma'i 'byung gnas rnams la snang ba mdzad pa'i 3'od kyi phreng ba bye brag med par khyab pa rgyas par 'gengs pa/bung ba'i tshogs ltar sngo ba'i gtsug tor gyi nang nas kun du 'byung 2ba'i 'od kyi dra bas phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus par bkra bar byas pa/ kha na ma tho ba med par zhugs 1pa/ 'phags pa'i bden pa ston pa/ zhi bar gzhol ba'i lam du 'dren pa/ 'jig rten sgol ba/ mnyes gshin pa'i thuganyen gcig pu/mu stegs can ngan pa'i rgol 5ba rnams kyis gsung dang thugs dang dpal 6dang /mthu la mi gnod pa/ zas )gtsang ma'i sras/ yul rnams kun la sred pa 'byung ba'i rgyun rnams skems 8snapa'i rgyu/ /skye bo mkhas pa rnams ni sad par bya phyir shar gyur pa/ /bag la nyal gyi rab rib sel ba ye shes snang ba'i mchog /sa rnams mtha' dag snang bas 9phyogs rnams thams cad snang mdzad pa/ /phyag dang zhabs dang dbu ni rab tu byin zhing tshul khrims dang / /smon lam dag gis byang chub lam bzang yang dag bsgrubs gyur pa/ /srid pa'i 'gro ba'i dug gi snye ma'i steng du lhung ba'otso / /skye dgu rnams la kha na ma tho ba nyu1med pa ston par 12mdzad pa/ srid pa rnam pa gsum 'jig pa/ bcom ldan 'das stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi mnga' ba/ dpa' ba dang mthu kha na ma tho ba med pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos brgyan pas sgu brjid pa/pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang dka' ba brgya phrag du mas dam pa'i chos dkon mchog bsgrubs pa/ brtsal ba tsam gyes sems can mtha' dag gi bsam 1)pa thugs su 96byed1007

chud pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rab tu zhi ba dang / tshul khrims dang / thos pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / bzod pa dang / byams pa dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa/ nyon mongs pa'i rab rib dang ling tog ma lus par bsal ba/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin rig pa dang phyogs dang 2snaphyogs kyi gtsug lag khang dang / kun dga' ra ba dang / ri dang / nags 'dab dang / khrad khrod dang / chu dang / ri sul dang / gsher sa dang / ṣ+pe'u gseng dang / shing gi grib ma rnam pa sna tshogs la dgyes pa/ yul dang ljongs du ma la phan gdags par rtsol ba mdzad pa / yang dag pa'i dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / dga' ba thob pa las ma nyams pa/ phung po lnga'i phyir skad cig yang dag par so sor rtog pa'i yid la byed pa bskyed pa/ mdo dang / 'dul ba dang / chos mngon pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / gleng gzhi dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang /rtogs pa brjod pa dang / de lta bu byung ba dang / gtan la dbab pa'i gtam gyis sems sbyangs pa/ rang gi lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi 1'jug pa dran pa nye bar gnas par rgyu ba/ /dbang po dang / stobs dang /byang chub kyi yan lag dang / bden pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam dang /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa sgom pa 4goms pas dad pa thob pa la tshe rabs gzhan dang gzhan nas bsags pa'i chodage ba'i rnam par smin pas grub pa/ ji ltar 'byor pas thunus pa dang mthun pa'i rtsom pas tshogs bsags pa/ phan yon lnga'i rgyu sems can thams cad gnas par byed pa/ 'jig rten pha rol du bde ba thob par byed pa/ kha dog dang dri dang ro dz+wadang reg pa dang ldan pa yid du 96—1008

'ong ba/ gya nom pa'i bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / ldag pa dang /rngub pa dang / gzhibs tshosnapa la sogs pa zhal zas bsham 2par bya ba rnam pa sna tshogs zhal zas khyad par can gyes spyan 'dren to/ /de la thog mar bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa'i tshe/ gang dag ye shes kyi rnges nyon mongs pa'i bud 1shing thams cad ma lus par bsregs pa/ gtong ba'i ngang thutshul can gyis sbyin pa'i sa bon 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ phra ba gzigs pa/ mkhas pa/ de kho na la bsgoms pa 'di lta ste/ gnas brtan bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len dang / 'phags pa sgra gcan zin dang / spyin byed dang / lam bsten ltadang / skyed byed dang gser be+e'u dang / rtogs byed dang / rdo rje can gyi bu dang / 'phags pa bsrung ba'i klu dang / klu sde la sogs pa slob ma bstan pa gnas par bya ba'i phyir gnod par gyur kyang lus kyi khur khyer ba rnams dang / gzhan yang gang dag sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i skye bo la phan pa'i phyir/ gser gyi rdo leb chen po'i steng na 'dug pa'i rig sngags 'chang du ma glu len pas glang po che yur ba9/ bung ba'i mchus 7pad+ma la 'jib cing 'khod pa'i man+da ka'i 87rdzing gi chu dang ldan zhing yal ga gsal ba'i steng na rin bo che'i me tog gi phreng ba byes tsu pa'i shing yongs 'dus kun du mdzes par byas pa'i ri'i lhun po 'bab chu 'bab pa'i sa gzhi la 'khod pa rnams dang /yang na nyu1gang dag /gser ri'i dkyil zhenas bsel ba'i chu 'bab la chu la zla ba'i gzugs brnyan 'byung 'gyur zhing /1/ /zla ba'i 'od kyis ku mud kha phye ste / /ku mud tshal na skad snyan ngang pa gnas/ /ngang mo mtshe'u na sgra skad snyan pa 'byin/ /mtsho ngogs rma bya dgar bcas rgyags par nyu4gnas/ /rma 96—1009

bya rgyags sgras ri sul snyan par ①grags/ /ri sul yal ga lhags tre7pas ri rtse 'khrigs / /ri rtse stod rnams na ni sprin chags la/ /lang ling sprin gyi sman ljongs khra khro snang / /sman ljongs skyes pa'i nor bu ldum bu gsal/ /ldum bu las brul lhung ba'i me tog ldan/ /me tog rgyas pa'i dpag bsam shing tshal mdzes / /mdzes pa'i lha mo ༄ gser gyi phag skad drung / /gser gyi phag skad je7sgras ni bya 'drogs shing / /byas 'chos shing thog rtsa las chad cing grulashā/ /rtsa 'phyang khu ba shezags pa spos kyi dri/ /spos glang dbang po dregs 3zag dri rab zhim / /dri rab zhim pa'i li shi ri 'khor mang / /ban byesnaglang mo rgyags drag 'gro lang long gyur/ /bung ba'i khyu yis me tog gzes byegyur cing / /yal ga me tog rgyas pas gad pa dkar/ /gad pa chad pas nor bu'i ldum hūṃ1bu snang / /me tog mgo lcogs bral te1bas rnam par bkra/ /nor bu sil ma mod pos ri 15gzhol spras/ /me tog thegs pa'i shing gi 7yal gar gnas pa'i bung ba dga' bas 'phur rnams dang / /zla ba'i 'od zer dkar po ngang pa lta bus nye 'khor rdo ba chag chag btab/ /lhun po mtho ba'i ri la thub pa gang dag rab tu zhi ba'i thugs kyis bzhugs/ /de dag dri med zla 5'dra'i grags ldan 'di yi sbyin pa'i gnas la brten du gsol/ /rgya mtsho'i nye ba'i chu 'gram ri bo ma la ya'i ri ngos ta 1 mal sbal mig 'thon nyu—pa'i phreng ba can/ /sbrul mang 'khris nyu5pa'i tsan+dan shing gi nags tshal na/ /brten pa gang dag bzhugs par gyur pa de dag dang / /nyi ma'i rta yi rmig pas rdo bcag cing / /mi'am ci yi lnga bu mo phrugs kyis nyams dga' la/ /ri sul mthon po dpag bsam nags mang dang / /ri 'gab rnams na gang dag bzhugs pa dang / /shing gi me tog 'phrul —1pas dri 96byed1010

zhim byas pa'i ser bu ngad ldang zhing / /nags na glang po dregs pa zag pas bsgos 1pa'i rin chen 'dza shing khyim/ /khyem la chags pa med pa'i lha yis bstan krupa'i bsod nams chu gling gi/ /gnya' shing 'dzin khri bya rgyal khyung 1gnas pa na gang dag bzhugs pa dang / /ba glang mos bsnyogs snang ba rtsub 'gyur tshal/ /me tog ldan zhing ser bu ngad ldan pa/ /sa t+ya ri bo ngos rab yangs pa la/ /yang 4dag thugs mnga' thub pa bzhugs dgu dang / /pad+ma at+pal rgyas pa 'byung ba'i gnas/ /nyin re nyi ma'i shing rtas rdo rīsnad can/ /srid pa'i 'jigs bral rab tu yid 'ong ba/ /'char ba'i ri stengs dzigang dag bzhugs pa dang / /ri yi rtse mos sngo bsangs sprin thal sman ljongs can/ /ngogs ldan chu bo man da ras ni ri sul bkrus/ /glang chen myos pas bsnyogs pepas sa phyogs rlog pa'i ri/ /'bigs byed rma bya rgyags gnas pa na bzhugs dgu dang / /sna tshogs 'byung khung tshon gyis kha bsgyur phug dang ldan zhing sprin kyang chags gyur la/ /ko lpags ldan pa gtsang ma'i chu yis 9ngogs kyi rdo ba mang po bkrus gyur cing / /ngos la ba lang mjug ma mong 1 po dag gis 'phyang 11zhing glog 'gyus snang byas pa/ /yongs 'dus ri rtse phrag na gcig pu 1nasred dang bral ba gang dag bzhugs pa dang / yang / gang dag shing 1nadang 'khri shing rnam pa mang po 'dab chags par ⑩gnas pa/ ṣ+pe'u gsing 'jam la sngo ba'i steng na rma bya'i khyu gar byed cing sgra snyan pa 'byin pa/ ri dwags kyi tshogs bag yangs thuganas pa'i sos bcad pa'i rtswa'i myu gu yod pa/ me tog dri zhim pos bsgom pa'i ser bu 'jam zhing bsel ba'i ngad ldang ba'i nags 'dab rnams su gnas bcas te bzhugs pa rnams dang / yang / gang dag dus su rlabs 96—1011

'byung ba'i chu'i dba' rlabs kyis g.yengs pa'i na le sham chodang li shi dang la ba kha'i —'bras bu sngon po mang po 'khrigs pa'i tshal dang / a ka ru'i shing khrod na gnas pa'i sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka gdengs shing 'jigs su rung ba yod pa/glang po che dregs pa dang bcas pa'i gnas byu ru'i sdong bu bsgyel ba dang ldan zhing /nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis reg pa'i dbang gis mu tig yod pa'i nya phyis kha bye ba'i khog pas snarnam par spras pa nye bar 'bul ba dang ldan pace/ nor bu mchog gi rdo las 1grub pa'i chung ma'i skye bo gnas shing 6bya'i khyu dga' ste sgra 'byin pas glu len pa lta bu yod pa'i rgya mtsho'i gling dag na/ klu'i bdag po'i lus chen pos sku dkris te/ gdengs ka'i gdugs kyis nyi ma'i 'od zer bsgribs shing bsam gtan mdzad pa rnams dang / sman ljongs dag na phyogs kyi glang chen brang gis mu rdo ba khebs pa'i khyu 'khod cing / khyor bcas lan cig ma yin ra ror gyur pa'i gnod sbyin mo dag gnas gyur la/ /klu yi rgyal po mgo bo stong de kha ༄/—snanas me 'bar 'byung bas shing sreg cing / /gangs ri ti se la ni blo gtsang gang dag zhal ton 1 snamadzad cing bzhugs pa dang / /rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyis bshal ba'i ri bo 'gab ldan 11ma smad pa/ /ri bo man da ra la nyin phyed tshun chad bzhugs bzhugs shing / /nyi ma phyed par gyur nas gang dag gzhan du bzhugs pa'i phyir//nor bu'i sgortartse mo bkram pa'i 'khor 1/yug ri la brten pa dang / /gang dag 'khri shing gzhon nus rdo ba khebs gyur pa'i/ /dbang chen rtse mo yid 6du 'ong bar bder gnas te/ /mkha' lding shugs kyis nang du klu rnams dkrugs pa yi/ /rgya mtsho rin chen gnas la rnam par gzigs pa dang / /ngang pa'i tshogs can shin tu gtsang ba drag 'bab char gyi chu yis ri 'gab khubakrus gyur cing / /96—1012

phyogs kyi glang pos bsgyel ba'i sa la ki yis rdo ba chen po mang po khebs gyur la/ /gcan gzan dbang po ral pa 'khyil zhing gsal bas dpung pa'i phyogs 'bar nyal bas gang (rmyegyur cing / /sbal mig mthon pa'i lcug mas 'khor bas grub pa ngal sos ri bo kron 37dzar gang gshegs dang / /gang dag mun bsal khyad par can gyi blosabye sna/ /shing ljon sna tshogs me tog rgyas gyur byung / /ri dwags rgyu bas ṣ+pe'u gseng gzhon snang ba/ /gzi rdo nags rnams mi spong bzhugs pa dang //yang gang dag nub kyi ba lang spyod dang / shar gyi lus 'phags po dang /byang gi sgra mi snyan dang gling gzhan dag na skyes pa'i lcug phran mdog snum zhing sngo la 'jam pa mang pos sa gzhi kun du khebs pa/ shing gi grib ma'i dkyil 'khor bsil ba dang / khri shing gis 'khor zhing ri dwags mang po gnas pa'i nags tshal de dang de dag na bzhugs pa rnams dang / yang gang dag da ra 5dang /gan dha ra khyedang / gu zan dang thu/ li dang / shi ring dang / ba le dang /bri 5sha dang / kha che'i yul dang / rgya yul dang / grong khyer zas 'dra dang /rdo 'jog zas 'dra dang / skyes pa'i grong khyer dang / phyogs mtshams dang /kun ti ma la ba dang / srung byed dang / grong khyer dang / tsha du ka 9dang /tsha ta dang / bha ru kad shā snatsha dang / kau shāsbyi dang / ser skya'i gnas dang /mnyan yod dang / mi thub pa dang / grong khyer me tog dang / ti ra dang /bcom rlag dang / grong khyer longs spyod dang / tsam pa ka dang rgyal po'i khab dang / dbang po'i brag phug dang / 'brog dang / ko na'i grong dang /kun dga'i grong dang / mchod rten kyi grong dang / 'khrur bcug gi grong dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i grong dang / nyu1/ yangs pa can 7dang / li khar nyu1shing 'phel 96byed1013

ba dang / 'phel byed dang / zangs kyis ① g.yogs pa dudang / rdo snyigs 1'dzin dang / ko sa la ④dang / an dra dang / ka 3ling ga dang / ba rba phyodang / ya ba na'i kyegling dang / seng ga la'i gling dang / ka la sha'i grong khyer dang / gser gyi sa dang / ha ri ke (1la dang / ba ro posnasha ka ta ha dang / na ri ke la snadang / pa /rtan sa'i gling dang / shu sa ra nyubyedang /nilba'i grong khyer dang / dpal gyi zhing 8dang / dngul chu'i gnas la sogs pa yul dang / cha byad dang / skad dang / gnas pa dang / cho ga dang /rigs dang / rus dang / tshul khrims dang / tshul khrims can du ma'i yul/mi gnas pa'i yul gzhan dag na bzhugs pa rnams dang / gang dag sngon chad nyi zla'i 'od kyis ma phog cing / /she sha sbrul gyi lus kyi 'obs gnas ri yi drung / /de yi gtsug gi rin chen 'od kyis mun bsal ba'i/ /sa 'og tu ni ring por ma thogs gshegs gyur dang / /gang dag chu ltar sa la thogs med bye'u 'dzul nyu 7 mdzad pa dang / /gang dag sar gnas phyag gi kyirtse mos zla ba reg mdzad dang / /gang dag bya ltar nam mkha' la ni shugs kyis rgyu mdzad cing / /na bza'i tha mas sprin mthar 7reg pas sprin ling 'jig ⑫mdzad dang / /gang dag lha dang /klu dang / grub pa dang / 'khor ba dang sgope/ tshogs rnams kyis rtag tu mchod pa'i ri 'jigs med dang bung ba'i ri dang / rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal dang / shar gyi ri bo dang / nub kyi ri bo dang / shi ri kun pa ta dang /kun du so ma dang / ta ma sa'i tshal dang / bsel ba'i tshal dang / lhas sprul dang / 'jigs med pa ri dang / nags tshal chen po dang / tsher ma can gyi tshal dang / byams pa'i ri dang // 7 chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri dang /96byed1014

ri nag po dang / gnas kyi ri dang / ser skya'i ri dang / me tog gi /1snari dang /rngu klu'i ri bo dang / tsan+dan gye ri bo dang / tsher ma'i ri bo dang /lha yul babs pa dzudang / a sa selba thudang / kun dga' ston 5ldan dang /ri bo'i rgyal mtshan dang / gzhi 5bkrus dang / rang gi mchod rten dang /sā pyalu spungs ldan dang / pho brang 'khor dpal yon can dang / bya rgod kyi phung po dang / ri dwags kyi nags 8dang / ka sho 9 dang / gtsug lag khang gser ka niṣ+ka ⑪sha hi/ la sogs pa cho 'phrul rmad du byung ba sna tshogs dang ldan pa rnams dang / dharma rā dzi ka shā1mchod rten du ma dang / sangs rgyas bzhi'i gdan khri yod pa bsod nams su gyur pa'i sa phyogs rgyun mi 'chad par klog pa dang / kha ton dang / bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /stoms par zhugs pa dang / tshul bzhin yid la byed pas 'jug pa dag pa'i dgra bcom pa rnams bzhugs bzhugs pa/ chos gos dang bsod snyoms dang mal cha dang / na ba'i gso thusman dang / yo byad dang 'tshog chas 1 rnams kyis legs par byas pas mtha' mtha' na 1 chu'i gnas yod pa la nye bar spyod pas nyams dga' ba/ bde bar gshegs pa'i zhabs kyis bcags pas gtsang bar gyur pa'i sa gzhi can/ zhi ba thub pa'i skye bo gnas pa rnams na/ de kho na bsgoms pa'i yid 7kyis ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa/ che'i lhag ma gnas par mdzad pa rnams dang / gang dag glog 'gyu bya gag r+ṣadag gis sku lus bkra byas sprin snum 'dra gyur nas/ /bkres pa'i sdug bsngal snod gyur mda' rtse rnon po lta bu'i spu yis rab gang zhing / /bsgoms 7pas mig zha me stag 8bcas pa'i me rnams kyis ni kun nas lus bskor ba'i/ /yi dwags gnam du lta ba rnams la 96—1015

thugs rjes steng nas char gyi rgyun 'be+ebs dang / /rin chen bye ma'i phreng bas gya gyur dkrigs mtho la/ /ngang khyu bag yangs gnas shing lang long nyal gyur cing //chu dang nye bas chu yi zer mas bsil gyur pa/ /ma na ya rmyeyi mtsho gling bsam gtan mdzad dgu dang / /gang dag mi ro mang po'i sha dang khrag gi ro bro bas dga' bar gyur pa'i bya khwa'i rītshogs kyis gang bar gyur pa'i sa phyogs mgo'i thod pa gas nas tshil thigs zags pa'i snum gyis mched pa'i mes tshig cing /rang gi me lces shing bcer ba bskams shing rnyings pa'i lag pa dang / rkang pa dang / so dang / skra'i dum grugs kyis gang zhing / zla ba dri ma med pa'i 'od lta bu'i keng rus kyi phung po yod la/ skabs shig ཿtu ro langs byung nas/a la la a la la zhes sgra 'byin cing / me stag dang bcas pa'i gad mo drag pos 'byung ba 'khrugs shing skrag par gyur pa ce jespyang mi bzad pa'i kha nas du ba dang bcas pa'i me lce 'byung ba'i dur khrod chen po dag na bud med kyi ro sgos shing lto sgang nger gyur pa'i steng na 'dug cing / dga' ba'i bya rgod kyi mchu dang /sder mos lto 'brad cing lto'i nang na snyesrin bu'i rigs rnams gnas pa/ ce spyang gi stobs kyi shugs kyis drangs pa'i nang grol dri mi zhim pa'i dum bus 'khor la / bya khwa bkres pas mig gi 6sha brus pa dag la gzigs shing / rtag tu mi sdug pa bsgoms te/ gang dag kha cig ro'i gnas mal dong nas ni/ /khrag dang sa chags dmar zhing rtsub pa'i skra 'khyil dang / /bya yi mchu dang sder mos mig rkong dz+wabrus pa yang 4sna/ /mi ro bor ba'i lus la gzigs par gyur pa dang / /sgo dang srang bar la lar me 'bar me lce'i rtse mo mang pos mgo rmongs shing / /ral gri gtun dang rdo bas bsnun cing brdungs 9nas skye bo ku co /gye96—1016

'don gyur la/ /gshin rje'i pho nya snying rje med pa sdod cig zer ba'i bzod glag ①sgras gang ba'i/ /sems can dmyal ba rnams su'ang srogs chags don sgo phyir gang dag skad cig 'jug pa dang / /gzhan yang sha ri'i ༄ mi'i dug mangs glang po che 'khrug cepa'i mdun logs na yal ga byegs pa'i sdong bu yod pa phyogs kyi bar nas rlung chen po langs pas 'od ma'i tshal bskyod nas 'khri shing gi dra ba dang drud grupa las me byung ba'i me lces shing mchog sna tshogs tshig nas/ ri dwags dang / phag rgod mchog mgyogs pa brgya phrag rngo dag skrag cing mgo rmongs pa yod pa/ shing lo mang po lhags la 0shing rnyings pa can bsil ba'i grib ma sang sing med pa/ nyams dga' ba'i longs spyod yod pa/ nags kyi ma he dang phag rgod kyis me tog at+pa la dang / pad+ma dang / sa ha ka ra bskyod pas chu dri zhim por gyur pa'i mtshe'u 'gram na shing la spre'u'i 3khyu gnas pa nye 'khor gyi ri las chu rlabs mi drag 1 snapar 'bab pas 'khor nas ṣ+pe'u gseng mod pa'i sa gzhi yod pa'i 'brog dag na zhi ba'i bdag nyid can 'chag pa dang klog pa dang kha ton dang / bsam gtan la mngon par brtson pa/ gang dag bag med pa'i gnas dar la bab pa yol 11bar mdzad pa rnams dang / ri bo rdo leb che zhing yangs 6la rab tu sgrum 1/pa 'dra gyur cing / /glog gi phreng bar me tog yod la 'ja' yis bkra ba'i bdag nyid can/ /chu bsel sprin chags rnams la chu 'bab zer phran chags pa'i rdzing 6ldan can/ /ser snyebus na bza' g.yo ba gang dag nyi ma'i gung la bzhugs pa dang / /de bzhin du rtag tu goms pa'i lam nas 'dong ba'i glang po'i khyu'i rmig rjes yod la/ /nags kyi ma he 'khrugs pa'i rwas grog mkhar chen bo bshig pa'i shul gyi khyang bu nas sbrul gyi lus phyed phyung lnga96—1017

ste / nags kyi rlung 'gam pa yod pa/ sa tshal stug po dang 'dam ①bu dang /shing ka sha stug po'i khrod na stag zung ngu gnas pa can/ phag rgod kyi snas zlog 'upa'i gla sgong kyegi rtsa ba 'dzings pa ral pa ltar 'dug pa yod pa shing ni tsu krula'i me tog brul bas rdo ba rtsa sadamar bar gyur pa yod pa/ shing gi phyogs su ri dwags kyi khyu 'dam rdzab la thogs pa yod pa/ shing lo sngon po stug por skyes pa'i dri bsung thumang po yod pa'i gsher ba'i chu rgyun dag tu hūṃmangon par dgyes shing dge ba'i phyogs ston pa rnams dang / rin po che'i 'od zer gyis chu'i ldurtsa dmar bar gyur la/ thugs bsam gtan la zhen pas dpag bsam gyi shing gi lcug ma'i rtse mos khereg pa'i ri spos kyi ngad ldang gi sul na rtsol ba med pa gang dag bzhugs pa dang / gang dag seng ge bsgyings rkyapa yod pa ri dwags rgyu ba dang ldan pa/ chu 'dus te 'bab pa yod pa g.yos pas steng gi rtse mo ldem pa'i sngags nyu1kyis skar ma'i tshogs 'phangs pa/ sa'i steng na phyi ba lhun bo yang lcug phran la bya ba bzhin du sgrim mi dgos par zhabs kyi sor mos sa'i 'og gi rmang dang bcas pa 11gsal bar 'phen pa dag dang / ting nge 'dzin thob pa gang dag char pa'i chus rdol ba'i bu ga du ma nas nyi ma'i 'od zer byung ba zla ba lta bu yod cing / rmang rdo dang rtsig ngos shag shig tu gyur pa'i mtshams su ⑫brgya chags pa / sbrul gsob ngarlung gis gang ste sgang der 'dug pa'i phreng 6ba rtag tu yod cing / nags kyi ri dwags kyi lces tsha sgo rdul can rtsub po bldags dzopas/shing rtsa sed sed por gyur pa yod pa/ rtsig rmang 7du srin bu go da'i tshogs ring nas gnas par gyur cing / sre mo tso1mgo bstod de rngu phyogs su blta bas byi ba skrag pa yod la/ nang du rtsa sgyu :sngon po stug po skyes pa'i 'jag ma'i drung gi 96—1018

gseb na phye ma leb rgyu ba yod cing / 'ug pa mang po sgra 'byin cing glu len pa lta bu yod pa'i grong stong sus kyang ting nge 'dzin ma byas pa rnams na/ ston pa'i bka' nan tan gyis bsgrub pa rnams dang / gzhan yang / gang dag g.yag gi ①rmig pas rdo bcag yod cing sprin ldings ldan gyur la/ / mtha' mar sā la 2 thang shing skyes la chu bsel mi khebs 'bab yod cing / /bsam gtan zhen pa'i blos ni kha ba bab pas chos gos lci zhing zag gyur kyang / /gangs ri dag gi ltong na 'gro ba shing gi drung du bzhugs par dgyes pa dang / /nang na chu srin 'khrugs te g.yos 1pas nya rnams kun 'byer zhing / / skam pas nyam chung gyur pa'i sprin btung kha yis chu 'thungs la4/ /gshong du 'khyil bar sbrul dbugs phyung bas rba rlabs rgyun 'chad pa'i/ /rgya mtsho la yang mtshan mo brtan pa gang dag 'chag mdzad pa/ /snod gyur bdag thunyid thugs ldan gtsang ma'i lhung bzed phyag bsnams shing / /bsod nams ldan pa'i sku lus na bza' chos gos rab g.yo bsgo/ /de dag sang gi gdugs ni nam gyi gung du phyin pa na/ / gabye brdungs gyepa'i sgra snyan skad gsang grags par gyur pa'i tshe/ /bstan bcos sna tshogs kyi de kho na goms pa'i chu blugs pas mi shes pa'i sems kyi dri ma bkrus pa'i mkhas pa'i tshogs 'dus pa/ nyi ma shin tu mang po nas 'dris pa'i srid pa'i bye spros pa bcad 7pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rin po che'i sgom du gyur pa/ dge ba'i tshogs bdud rtsi'i btung ba'i gzhi bro brta— / ye shes kyi gser ma gtogs pa brdar ba'i brdar rdo 13sngon por gyur pa/ legs par spyad pa stong gi tshogs bsags pas grags pa rgya che ba dang ldan pa/ sbyin bdag chen po bdag nyid 12can ston gyi nam thang 11lta bu'i yid dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bya 96—1019

ba 'di'i gan du/ ma he'i rwa ltar sngo zhing dri med mkha' las 'phur/ /gzi brjid kyis ni nyi ma'i 'od zer stong 'thor 7 zhing / /mngon du phyogs nas 'ong ba'i sprin byeni dral nas su/ /skye bo phan phyir thub rnams song 1'dir gshegs su gsol/ /rgyun mi 'chad par ting nge 'dzin dang / klog pa dang / 'chag pa dang / skye bo bla ma la brten par mngon du dga' ba'i blo gros dang ldan pa/mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam gyi rjes su mthun pa/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i rig pa gsum rab tu sgrub pa/ nyon mongs pa las grol bar 'dod pa'i dge slong gang dag 'di na gnas pa 'dul ba'i cho ga la goms pa/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi 'jug pa zhi ba dang ldan pa de dag kyang ma lus par ci bder do mod kyi mtshan mo zad par mdzod la/ 'di nyid du gnas par gyemadzod cig /thub pa'i sras mo shes rab zhi dang dul bas brgyan pa'i dge slong ma/ tha dad gling dang klu thudang nags dang ri dwags spros pa'i bsam bral zhing khye/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dri bral zhi 'os 'gro ba'i ma lta bu/ /de dag dgyes par mdzod la sbyin bdag phan par bzhed pas sang 'dir spyon/ /phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa dang choganod sbyin gtso bo dang / /grub pa rnams dang gang dag lha ma yin dang klu rnams dang / /sangs rgyas la ni rab tu dad pa'i lha mchog gang yin pa/ /de dag rnams kyang sbyin bdag 'di la phan phyir sang 'dir spyon/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / rig sngags 'chang dang / grub pa dang / mi 'am ci dang / nam mkha' lding la sogs pa 'byung po rngurnams dang / stobs bcu mnga' ba'i bstan pa'i yon tan bsgrub pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis kyang /dam pa'i chos gnas par bya ba dang / sbyin bdag chen po bdag nyid che ba 'di/96—1020

sdod bzang po la sbyar ba dang / sbyin bdag chen po 'di la grogs bgyi bas nyid kyis 1dge ba'i yon tan skyed pa la dge 'dun 2snanan tan mdzod cig /rgyun mi 'chad par bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / bskyang ba la brtson par mdzod cig /yang dul ba dang / tshul khrims dang / thos pas shin tu che ba'i 'phags pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun 'dus pa la gsol ba 'tshal lo /lhun po las byung sbrul mgo lnga 'dra rdo rje ka na ka /nya dang gdugs dang 'khor lo dag dang lcags kyu'i mtshan mnga' ba/ /pad+ma gser gyi dpal ldan phyag sor dra ba byesrab mos 'byel/ /sen mo'i 'od kyis khyab pa rgyal ba'i phyag gis bskyab depar shog /srid gyepa'i 'dod chags nyon mongs zhags pa bsal zhing 7sred med pa5/ /chu yi chu gter lta bur yon tan rnams kyi —/gnas gcig pu1 / /thub pa'i sras mchog dge 'dun bdag gis gus par spyan drangs pas/ /de ring dge ba gang bsags de ni byang chub thob gyur cig /ji srid mkha' la 'od 'phro 11'od kyis gsal bas 7rnam par snang byed cing / /ri dwags rtags can 'od kyi ral pa'i dkyil 'khor ldan la se'achar ba dang / /rgya mtsho rgyas par gnas pa de srid lha dang lha min phyag byas pa'i/ /bde bar gshegs kyi bstan pa thogs pa med par chaganas par shog /gnas brtan spyan drang ba slob dpon bhā ba skan+da pa snyezhes bya bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //ā tsār+ya medzi na mi tra dang / ban de ye shes sdes sgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //96—1021

bsdur mchan/1༷༷1 hūṃmatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la gnas brtan spyan drang ba bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ (snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don/ rngo1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rnamakha'/1༷༷2 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shegs/ ñtsha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'jigs/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazir/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra /thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da ba/ ṣe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyu las 'khrugs/ kyang gar kyi rje zhes bya ba'i tshong dpon byi bu ru mgo bo'i ri bo la gtsug lag khang mdzad nas 'phags pa nyer sbas rab tu phyung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas dgra bcom par gyur te/ gnas pa las de la bstan pa gtad de yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /'phags pa nye bar sbas kyis kyang bdud sdig can btul te/phug srid du khru bco brgyad pa rgyar khru bcu gnyis par gnas nas/ de'i gdams ngag bdun gyis dge slong rnams kyis dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas pa'i thur ma rnams kyis bkang ngo / /bar skabs der mya ngan rnged ces bya ba stobs kyis 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la dad pa phyi phyir thob nas 'phags pa grags pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen byas pas bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten gang yin pa rnams dang nyan thos kyi yang ste/ de rnams la so so so sor gser gyi rgyan phul lo/ /byang chub kyi shing la yang de bas ches lhag par rab tu dang ba skyes nas bkur ste chen po byas te/ gser dang dngul dang be+e ḍūr+ya dang shel gyi rang bzhin gyi bum pa sna tshogs pa dri'i chus yongs su bsgos pa rnams kyis de la khrus gsol to/ /der 'ongs nas lo lnga'i bar du dge slong 'bum phrag gsum la ston mo byas te/ dang po la 'phags pa la bsod snyoms rgyas pa dang / rgyal mtshan la sogs pas mchod do/ /gnyis pa la slob pa rnams la'o/ /gsum pa so so'i skye bo dge ba can rnams la chos gos gsum rnams kyis g.yogs so/ /ji tsam du rim gyis dbyig dang gser bye ba dgu bcu rtsa drug phul te/ kha cher yang dge 'dun rnams la de dag nyid phul lo/ /de ltar 'phags pa nyer sbas kyis sems can la phan pa mdzad cing bstan pa yongs su bskyangs nas 'phags pa dhī ti ka rab tu 96—1027

phyung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas dgra bcom pa nyid la bkod/ de la bstan pa gtad nas yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /'phags pa dhī ti kas kyang bstan pa yongs su bskyangs shing sems can la phan pa mdzad nas/ 'phags pa nag po la bstan pa gtad nas yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /'phags pa nag pos kyang bstan pa yongs su bskyangs shing sems can la phan pa mdzad nas 'phags pa legs mthong la bstan pa gtad de yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /'phags pa legs mthong gis kyang bstan pa yongs su bskyangs shing sems can la phan pa mdzad nas yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /ji tsam du yangs pa can du yangs pa can pa'i dge slong rnams kyis rung ba ma yin pa'i gzhi bcu byung ste/de dag thams cad 'dod la sogs pa'i dgra bcom pa bdun brgya rnams kyis nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir bdun brgyas bsdu ba mdzad do/ /bar skabs der bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo sum brgya lon te/ mya ngan rnged ces bya ba'i rgyal po nyid shi nas kha cher legs mthong byung ste ma dang pha dag las de la seng ge zhes bya ba'i ming du grub pa bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ste dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /ji tsam na byang gi lam nas rgyal po ka niṣ+ka zhes bya ba 'phags pa seng ge blta ba'i phyir kha cher zhugs so/ /de la 'phags pa seng ges chos bstan to/ /des de las chos thos nas byang gi lam du song ste ka niṣ+ka'i mchod rten la rab tu gnas pa dang de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la sbyin pa dag sbyin/ bsod nams dag byas so/ /dge slong rnams la yang bstan nas kha cher rna rgyan gyi nags kyi gtsug lag khang du 'phags pa rtsi ba logs la sogs pa'i dgra bcom pa lnga brgya 96—1028

dang / ba su mi tra la sogs pa'i btsun pa bzhi brgya rnams dang / byang chub sems pa lnga brgya rnams kyis kyang chos mngon pa rnam par bshad pa mdzad cing kha cher yang de rnams dge 'dun la phul lo/ /'di rgya dpe shog gcig ma cig lag tu byung ba/ bstan pa'i gtad rabs su 'dug pas mgo mjug ma tshang na yang /tshong 'dus kyi pho brang du 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyis bsgyur ba yin no/ /bsdur mchan/1༷26 1mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉75 mi bzhugs nga/sa 〈〈co 〉〉dang dpe bsdur byas yod/ 4〈〈co 〉〉ba/bsdur 'bras re'u migadzing yig (29)96wa 1029

༄/ /dgra bcom dge 'dun 'phel gyis lung bstan pa bzhugs so/ /te༄go/ /dgra bcom pa dge 'dun 'phel gyis lung bstan pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis slob dpon gyis bshad pa thos pa na/ yul 'di'i gtsug lag khang bru nya zhes bya ba'i dgra bcom pa dge 'dun 'phel zhes bya ba gsum rig pa mngon par shes pa thob pa/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan pa zhig dus — gzhan zhig na slob ma zhig dang thabs cig tu dbyar zla ba ༄ gsum 'jig tshogs kyi ri zhes bya ba la bzhugs te/ slob ma ban+de chos 'dul ba la slob 4pa zhig lags na/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lon pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi bstan la rgya gar gyi yul kau shāsbyi 5zhes bya bar nub par 'gyur ro zhes thos nas 'di snyam du rgya gar yul gyi chos dus de tsam zhig na/ yul kau shām+bhir nub par 'gyur ba lta zhig na/ li yul la sogs pa gzhan gyi 5chos yun 96—1030

ji srid cig tu gnas par 'gyur/ nam 'jig rkyen ni gang gis 'jig par 'gyur snyam du the tshom skyes so/ /de nas hūṃdagra bcom pa de phyi na'aphred kyi dus kyi tshe nang du yang dag 'jog pa las bzhengs pa dang / slob ma des mkhan po'i zhabs la yan lag lngas phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces the tshom zhus so/ /slob dpon ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa lo nyis stong nas 'jig par lung bstan na/ li yul 'di la sogs pa yul gzhan gyi bstan pa ji srid du gnas par 'gyur/ nam 'jig rkyen gang gis 'jig par 'gyur ba lags/de nas mkhan pos bka' sprul pa/ bu khyod kyis li yul la sogs pa'i skye bo mang po'i don dang / bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir the tshom dris pa legs kyis/ legs par nyon la yid la zung 4shig dang / li yul la sogs pa'i bstan pa ji srid du gnas par 'gyur/ nam 'jig pa dang rkyen gang gis 'jig par 'gyur ba ngas so sor lung bstan par bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa ni bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong lnga brgya lon pa dang 5yul du dad pa med pa rnams 'byung zhing dam pa'i chos 'jig tu rgol lo/ /de'i tshe li yul 'dir dad pa med pa'i rgyal po yang 'byung bar 'gyur zhing / yul yang rgyal pos phan tshun rtod cing 'phrog gyepar 'gyur ro/ /de phyin chad ni yul yang nyin gcig bzhin du nyams par 'gyur/ grong dang gtsug lag khang la sogs pa yang phal cher stongs par 'gyur / mi rnams kyang nyin gcig bzhin du phyir yang dkon mchog gsum la dad pa 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyu des na dkon mchog gsum dang / chos smra ba dang / bsam gtan pa kun kyang mchod gnas su mi byed cing / mu stegs 96—1031

kyi rgyal po dang / blon po dang / yul 'dzin pa dang / khyem bdag rnams kyang chos dang hūṃmi mthun pa'i phyogs 'dzin cing dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yal bar 'dor bar 'gyur ro/ /chos dang mthun pa ma yin pa dang / ma brtags byepa dang / bab chol gyi 1longs spyod kyang sogs par byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de'i 'og tu dge slong dang / dge slong ma rnams 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyi phyir g.yem 4spyo bar gyur chote/ chos 'dul ba las 'byung ba dge sbyong gi tshul dang /spyod pa zhi ba dang / dul ba dang / ngo tsha shes pa dang / khrel yod pa la sogs pa yal bar 'gyur zhing / zhing dang / ldum ra dang / nyo tshong dang /skyi brnya dang / slong mo ba rnams kyis 'tsho bar byed do/ /khyem pas bslab par bya ba'i bzo dang / khyim gyi so nams 6dang / 'thab rtsod dang / sgo gsol rngam 7po che yang byed par 'gyur snye/ pho nyar yang 'gro bar byed/ las kyi go 'phang dang / rtsa 'jing yang tshol bar byed par 'gyur te/ de'i tshe gtsug lag khang dang / dgon pa la mi gnas shing bde bar gshegs pa'i gdams ngag yal bar bor te/ yang dang yang du mkhar dang / grong dang /tshong dus dang / srang dang / sum mdo na gnas par sems dga' bar 'gyur/bran dang / bran mo dang / rkang 'gros kyang tshol bar byed do/ /rgyu des na she7khyim bdag dang / yul 'dzin pa dang / blon po la sogs pas kyang de dag la rim gro mi byed cing / dad pa phyir log nas dkon mchog dang dge 'dun gyi dkor la yang 'phrog par byed do/ /khyim pa de dag gis kyang nor rdzas de dag la brten cing spyad pas bsod nams 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyu des na li yul la sogs par gnod pa sna tshogs 'byung zhing lo re bzhin dma' bar 'gyur te/96—1032

rtsod pa dang / nad dang / dus ma yin pa'i char dang / rlung dang /dgra mang po yang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dus ma yin pa'i sad dang / srin bu dang / bye ba dang / byi ba yang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe na sems can rnams nang 3mi mthun par 'gyur zhing dus tshigs kyang 'chol bar 'gyur te/de ltar na yul gang dang gang du chos lugs log parmyepa byed pa de dang der ni gnod pa de dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe li yul la sogs par rgyal po dang /blon po la sogs pa —ya rabs las kyang dkon mchog la snying thag pa nas dad pa 'ga' las mi 'byung na/ phal pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ rgyu de lta bus li yul la sogs pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi mchod gnas thams cad kyi thams cad du rmegs pyamed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas li yul la sogs par dge slong gi gnas sngon rgyal po la sogs pa dad pa can kyis byas pa yang blon po la sogs pa dad pa med pa rnams kyis btsan 'phrogs su 'phrogs 5nas bdag nyid gnas par byed do/ /dge slong rnams kyang 'khyams nas 'tsho ba dang / chos gos dang / gnas kyis phongs khupar 'gyur ro/ /blon po la sogs pa de dag gis dge slong gi zhing chu dang / ldum ra la sogs pa yo byad rnams kyang btsan thab 7 su 'phrog par byed/ lha 'bangs dang / nang gi g.yog 8 rnams kyang dge slong gi ngag mi nyan cing gnya' rengs su byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dge slong rnams kyis kyang de lta bur gyur par tsoshes nas yi mug ste/ li yul gyi dge slong rnams phan tshun du gcig la tso snagacig 'di skad du yu bu cag rnams gtsug lag khang tshar ma zhes bya ba dang po chos 'byung ba'i gnas der 'du'o zhes sbran nas gtsug lag khang der nyu1'dus te/ dpyid zla tha chungs tshes bco lnga'i nub mo 96—1033

gso sbyong byas nas gcig la gcig 'di skad du yu bu cag rnams sngon bag med par gyur nas mkhas pa chos dang mthun pa rnams la dbang zos pa'i rgyus de rmyeltar khyem pa rnams kyis kyang rtsis med par byas te/ da ni 'tsho ba yang mi 'byor na deng 2phyin chad gang du 'dong / thabs ni gang gis 'tsho bar bya zhes smras terngu/de'i tshe thams cad kyis ④cho de chen po 'debs par 'gyur ro/ /thude nas de'i tshe bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa srung gyeba'i lha/ bcom ldan 'das kyi hūṃbyas pa gzo ba thams cad kyang gtsug lag khang der 'dus te gcig la gcig lta khyazhing 'di skad du bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa ni yun ring por 9mi gnas so/ /yul 'di yang stongs par 'gyur ro zhes mya ngan byed cing ngu bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe dge slong de dag 'di snyam du yul 'dir ni 'tsho ba mi 'byor rmyen 'di bor te yul gzhan du 'gro bar bya'o snyam du sems mthun par gyur pa gang du 'dod par bya zhes gros byas te/ yul nye ba gzhan dang gzhan na ni dad pa med pa dag gis gang / rgya gar yul du 'dong du ni lam mi thar bas bod kyi yul na/dkon mchog gsum la mchod gnas su byed ces grags pas der 'gro bar byas nas nyi ma 'di la 'dong ngo zhes dus btab nas de'i nub mo gtsug lag khang tshar mar gzhag 11go/ /nam langs pa dang bud med dad pa can zhig gis gdan chung la spyan drangs te/ de nas gaṇ+ḍi 1rtabardungs nas dge 'dun spyi'i rtse5gtsug lag khang bskor te mchod pa byas pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan gyi gang na khye zhig gas pa'i gseb nas sgom bu tha ram ⑩can zhig snang bar gyur te/ de nas sgom bu de phye ba dang / de'i nang nas gser las byas pa'i kha zas kyi sder cha bdun byung ste/ dge slong kun gyis de blangs te/ 'brur 96—1034

bsgyur nas de hūṃ/dge 'dun kun dbyar zla ba gsum gtsug lag khang tshar mar tshul du 'jug pa'i 'tsho ba sbyar nas zong lhag ma las yul nas byung ste/ 'gro ba'i lam brgyags /bye dang khur khal sbyar ro/ /dbyar zla ba gsum 'das nas 'di skad du yu bu rnams byen gyis brlabs —snapa'i yul 'di bltas la 'gro bar bya'o zhes smras te song nas/ 'phags pa sa'i snying po'i gnas gtsug lag khang ye shes ri zhes bya ba'i drung du phyin pa dang / de'i tshe de na brag la mchod rten gye 'og gzhi rnyed pyapa zhig yod pa dib snyepa'i nang nas/ gser phor chen po mu tig gis gang ba zhig byung ba dang de yang blangs te 'brur bsgyur nas phyogs der rgun 6zla ba gsum gnas pa'i 'tsho ba sbyar te/ de nas dpyid byung ste 'gro ba'i dus la bab nas song ste/ shel chu 'og ma brgal 7ba dang / yul mi stod pa rnams kyis sa lam yogs su gdugs tshod sbyar nas/ nyi ma re re zhing gtsug lag khang 9dag tu gdugs tshod gsol bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe yul mi smad pa rnams kyis kyang dge slong rnams yul byung ste 'gro zhes thos nas dge 'dun de dag gtsug lag khang cong zhes bya bar spyan drangs nas/ zhag bdun gyi bar du bshos spyor bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe li yul na gnas pa'i klu thams cad 'di snyam du bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa ni rmegs / med par 'gyur 11la thug go snyam du mya ngan byed cing bstan pa gnas par bya ba'i 1bye phyir char chen po phab ste/ char pa des gtsug lag khang cong zhes bya ba'i nang nas thumachod rten gyi gzhi zhig yod pa nas gser phor gser phyes gang ba zhig byung ba dang / de yang dge 'dun kyis btsongs nas dpyid kyi 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnams spyor bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang yul mi smad pa rnams kyis gtsug lag khang sā 14la'i tshal zhes bya bar dge 96—1035

'dun rnams spyan drangs nas zhag bdun gyi bar gyi gdugs tshod gsol nas zhag bdun lon pa'i nyin par yul stod smad kyi mi thams cad gtsug lag khang sa na bar 'dus nas dge 'dun la rdzongs dang khur khal 'bul lo/ /de'i tshe mi rgan rgon rnams ni bslab pa 'dzin par byed/ gzhon nu ⑫rnams ni rgyang nas lta zhing gad mos 'debs pa dang grogs byed par shakhya'agyur ro/ /de'i tshe mkhar dge ba can gyi nang nas kyang mi rgan rgon kha cig gis 1gos kha dog bsgyur ba dang /lam du 'jug pa'i yo byad so so nas thogs nas so so'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge slong de dag gi mdun du lhags byenas 'phags pa rnams bzod par bzhes shig ces smra zhing chomachis te/ phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe mchod pa de ni dper na ku sha'i grong khyer gyi mi rnams bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das par treshes nas mya ngan byed pa bzhin du mchod pa byed pa dang 'dra bar/li yul du dkon mchog gsum mchod pa'i tha ma yin no/ /de'i 'og tu dge slong rnams gtsug lag khang de nas bod yul ngos su chas pa dang lam kha na mchod rten rnying pa zhig gi drung du dpal lha mo chen mos dge 'dun gyi ched du gser gyi dang tse phu dung )gang bzhag pa rnyed nas dge 'dun gyis de bgos te lam kyi chas rdzas sbyor bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe li yul gyi mkhar gtsug lag khang ka sa ra zhes bya bar rgyal rigs las skyes pa'i yon bdag cig ḍasna'abyung bar 'gyur te/yon bdag des dge 'dun rnams zhag bdun du skrumachod ston gsol bar 'gyur ro / /de'i tshe mchod ston gsol ba de ni li yul du dge 'dun gyi ⑪ mchod ston gsol ba'i tha ma yin no/ /de nas dge slong rnams me skar gyi lam du zhugs te song ba dang / de'i tshe dge slong pho mo 1rtegasar bu las phal 11cher rang rang gi 96byed1036

slob dpon dang / mkhan po la chos gos phul te bzod par gsol nas slar yul du ldog par 'gyur )7dge slong pho mo gsar bu kha cig ni rab tu byung ba'i dngos po mi gtong zhing pha ma la sogs pa'i gnyen skyel du 'ongs pa rnams la mya ngan gyi tshig smra zhing dus nas gnyen rnams phyir bzlog ste/ dge 'dun dang lhan cig tu mi dga' ba'i yid kyis phyir byin gyis 5brlabs pa'i yul dang /gnyen gye rjes bzhin du lta bzhin par bye me skar gyi lam du zhugs te 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar song ba dang de'i tshe rnam jos kyi bu dang / dpal lha mo chen mo gyeganyis mchog tu snying rje skyes te/ 'brog mi pho mo 5gnyis kyi lus su bsgyur tehūṃ/ dge 'dun rnams spyan drangs nas 7yul me skar du zla ba gsum gyi bar du gdugs tshod gsol te/ lam du 'jug pa'i yo byad ci dgos pa yang rdzong 87bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas dge slong de dag mdo lo'i lam du zhugs nas ri dang lung pa'i sul gtugs te song ba dang / 'brog dgon par lam stor nas ngu zhing phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang li yul gyi lha thams cad kyi ming nas 'bod par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe rnam thos kyi bu snying rje skyes nas g.yag dkar po sgal pa dang / snal chu can cig tu sprul nas dge slong de dag gi drung du 'ongs pa dang dge slong rnams kyis 9de mthong nas g.yag 'di ni mi'i khal g.yag cig yin te/ 'di'i phyi bzhin song na gdon mi za bar mi rnams dang phrad par 'gyur bas da ni mi 'chi'o snyam du yid sos te/ g.yag des kyang lam drangs nas gseb lam du byung ste/ tshal byer bskyal nas g.yag nyid mi snang bar gyur totshe/ /de'i tshe dge slong rgan rgon mang po zhig ni lam kar 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas yul tshal byi'i bod rnams kyis dge slong de dag mthong nas 96—1037

bsu te shesna/ 'phral du yo byad rnams sbyar nas bod yul 'dir li yul gyi dge slong mang po lhags na ji ltar bgyi zhes pho nyar gtong bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe na 2snargya rje'i bu mo byang chub sems dpa'i rigs can byug btsas pa bod kyi rgyal po'i khab tu len cing btsun mo dam pa byed par 'gyur te/ /de ni dad pa shin tu che ba/ snying rje dang ldan pa skad snyan pa dang des pa/ bslab zipa'i yan lag lnga bzung ba zhig 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /btsun mo des nyi 'og gzhan nas dge slong mang po bod kyi yul du lhags par mthong nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni ring du mi gnas so snyam nas 5mya ngan chen pos non nas rang gi 'khor bud med nyis brgya dang / skyes pa sum brgya dang / ru rum dang / gzo 67bo dang gnang chen rnams drung du bos te ngus nas 'di skad ces/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa ni de'u re 'jig par gyur 7snagyis khyed rnams myur du bsod nams ma byas/ tshul khrims ma bsrungs na 'phyis par 'ong ngo zhes smras par 'gyur ro/ /de nas btsun mo des rgyal po la 'di skad du dge 'dun de rnams bdag gis bzhon pa dang gos la sogs pa'i yo byad sbyar nas 'dir spyan drang bar —ci gnang zhes gsol pas rgyal pos kyang gnang bar 'gyur te/ tshul de lta bus dge slong de dag bod yul du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe bod yul gyi 9rgyal po dang blon po rnams kyis dge slong de dag mthong nas dad pa chen bo skye zhing gtsug lag khang chen po bdun yang brtsig 7par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du dge slong an rtse 11pa dang gus tig pa dang / par wan nyu2pa dang / shu lag 1/pa rnams kyang sdug bsngal chen pos non nas bru sha'i yul du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /tho kar ⑩yul dang / kha che'i yul gyi dge slong rnams kyang dad pa med pa'i mi 96—1038

rnams kyis gtses te/ ma chags nas bru sha'i yul du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong de dag thams cad kyis bru sha'i yul du phyin nas/ /bod yul na gtsug lag khang rmyemang bo brtsigs pa dang / rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' zhig gnas pas dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa dang ri mo cher byed pa thos nas yid dga' ste/ thams cad bod yul du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /bod yul du lhags nas lo gsum gyi bar du ni mchod pa chen po la sogs pa skyid pa nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /lo gsum lon pa dang bod kyi yul du bdud kyi ris kyi lha dang /lha ma yin dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za rnams kyis 2snand chen bo 'bras dang / phol mig dang / 'bru ma bu gdug pa dag gtong bar 'gyur te / nad des zhang blon dang dmag du ma dag 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe rgyal mo de'i snying gar 'bras gsug pa byung ste/ shi nas lha yul du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe bod kyi zhang blon rnams khros 'khrugs te 'di skad ces bdag cag 4gi yul 'di sngon gya nom pa las phyis mi bkra mi shis pa 'khyams pa sha stag 'dir lhags nas da ni yul du yang 'di lta bu gnod pa rnam pa sna tshogs chobyung bar 'gyur gyis/ rdzas lhag ma 'di rnams kyang yul 'dir mi gzhag 5cing sa mtshams 'das te bskrad par bya'o zhes gros byas nas dge slong gcig kyang bod yul du gnas su mi gnang ngo zhes glo bur du bsgo bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal mo de nad kyis thebs pa'i tshe bdag nyid mi 'tsho bar tshor nas rgyal bo la kha chems su bdag gum na bdag gi 7nor rdzas ril gyis dge 'dun la 'bul bar ci gnang zhes gsol nas rgyal pos kyang gnang ste/ btsun mo'i rdzas thams cad dge 'dun la 'bul zhing des rgya gar gyi yul gan dha ra zhes bya bar 'gro ba'i 96—1039

rdzas byas nas 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe bod yul gyi dge slong rnams kyang yi chad nas nyi 'og gi shedage slong rnams dang gros gcig tu byas nas lhan cig tu she'agro bar 'gyur ro/ /skye bo dang rtsod pa'i dus de'i tshe rgya yul kyi dge slong rnams kyang shin tu sdug bsngal bas gzir nas yul gan dha rar 'gro bar 'gyur ro / /de ltar dong ba dang dge slong de dag thams cad yul gan dha rar 'gro ba'i lam kar phrad par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe bod kyi dmag gis rjes bzhin bsnyags nas lam kar bran g.yog dang / nor phyugs dag phrogs te dge slong dag kyang gsod par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar dge slong de dag bod kyi dmag gis bdas nas klu'i rgyal po e la'i 'dab kyi gnas drung du phyin pa dang / klu'i rgyal po e la'i 'dab kyis grumi rgan zhig gi gzugs su bsgyur te dge 'dun gyi rnyimadun du 'ongs nas phyag 'tshal te/ skyes bu dam pa khyed rnams gar gshegs zhes dris pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis 'di skad du bdag cag gi yul na dad pa med pa sha stag gis gang bas 'tsho ba'i yo byad la sogs pas phongs te/ da yul gan dha rar 'tsho ba'i yo byad tsam zhig ci rnyed snyam nas lhags so zhes smras pa dang / de nas de'i tshe klu'i rgyal po de bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'jig pa'i mtshan ma 5rtogs nas mchi ma khrag tu 'dzag cing ngus nas/ dge 'dun rnams la yul der gshegs nas shul brgyags dziji tsam mnga' zhes rmed gyepar 'gyur ro/ /dge 'dun kun gyis kyang zhib tu brtsis nas zhag bco lnga'i brgyags byeyod do zhes smra bar 9sna'agyur ro/ /klu'i rgyal pos 'di skad du 'di nas yul gan dha rar mtsho 'di'i g.yas g.yon du bskor na zhag bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i shul mchis na/ dgung bco lnga'i brgyags ( 'tshal lam/ gzhan yang 96byed1040

shul ka nas la ka 3mthon po dang nags tshal stug po dang / gcan gzan gdug pa dang / sbrul gdug pa dang /rke sdig sbrul la sogs pa dang /chom rkun pa yang mchis pas phyi nas tshur yang dmag gis bsnyegs pa dang /mtsho 'di'i nang na yang bdag gi 'khor gtum po dad pa ma mchis pa du ma zhig mchis pas bdag gis phyir bzlog par mi nus te/ bdag ni de'i shul du bzhud par mi dga' zhing mchis so/ /de'i tshe dge slong pho mo mang po de dag thams cad 'di snyam du bdag cag rnams 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa 'dra snyam nas ngu zhing mya ngan byed par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe klu'i rgyal po e la'i 'dab kyis dge 'dun rnams kyi mdun du pus mo btsugs nas dge 'dun ma bshums shig4 /bdag gis dge 'dun rnams kyi slad du srog kyang yongs su btang zhing bdag nyid kyi lus mtsho 'di'i steng du zam par bgyib tsho 5/gas so/ /bdag gis 5sngon bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa thog mar legs par ma bsrungs par chad par srog gis god pa zhig gcod par 'tshal lo zhes smras par 'gyur ro/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po des rang gi lus sbrul chen po zhig gi 6gzugs su bsgyur 7nas/bod yul ngos kyi ri'i rtse mo la ni mgos 'khyud/ yul gan dha ra'i ri'i 8rtse mo la ni mjug mas 'khyud de lus kyi zheng du ni shing rta lnga'i khyen tsam gyi zam par btags so/ /de'i tshe dge slong de dag gis 9sbrul chen po de'i gzugs de mthong nas sngangs skrag ste/ phyogs su 'byer bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po des mi skad phyung ste/ dge 'dun dag ma sngangs shig /bdag gi 1 lus 'di khyed kyi slad du zam par btags pa lags kyis/ ma bsnyengs 11par rjes dgra choms su dogs pa ni 'bangs 1rtadang phyag rjed dang khyar rnams 96—1041

sngon la dgyer du gsol de'i 'og tu dge 'dun gzhon rims gshegs su gsol/bgres po rnams ni slad kyis gshegs su gsol zhes smra bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe klu'i rgyal po de'i rgyab kyi pags 1pa phyugs kyi rmig pa dang mi'i rkang pas bshus te rma chen po byung ste mtsho'i nang du rnag khrag kyang sna'adzag par 'gyur ro/ /mi phyugs phal yang mtsho'i nang du ltung zhing 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /tha mar dge 'dun rgan rabs rgal ba'i 'og tu klu'i rgyal po nyid kyang 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /mtsho de yang skams par 'gyur te/ mtsho bskams gupa'i nang du klu'i rgyal po shi ba'i rus pa ri lta bur 'dug par 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sangs rgyas byams pa 'khor lnga brgya dang thabs cig tu klu'i rgyal po e la'i 'dab kyi rus pa'i drung du gshegs te klu'i rgyal po e la'i 'dab kyi skyes pa'i rabs brjod pas byams pa'i 'khor dge slong lnga brgya po de dag thams cad kyis dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dge slong de dag yul gan dha rar phyin nas lo gnyis kyi bar du gnas so/ /lo gsum pa'i tshe yul de'i rgyal po dad pa can zhig yod pas 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po de shi ba'i 'og tu rgyal po de'i bu dad pa can zhig dang dad pa med pa zhig rgyal srid la brtod phyenas dmag gi g.yul bkye nas/ phyogs gnyis su chad par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe na dge slong de dag gi nang na 6dge slong dpa' ba brtul phod pa tsham tshom med pa stong zhig yod pas rgyal bu dad pa med pa de dmag gis btab ste pham par byas nas rgyal bu dad pa can de la rgyal srid 'bul bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal bu dad pa can des zla ba lnga rgyal po byas nas yang 4dge slong stong po de dag gis bsad khyenas dge slong gcig rgyal po la bcug ste lo gnyis kyi bar du kyergyal po byed par 'gyur ro/ /96byed1042

de'i tshe yul gan dha ra'i blon po dang yul mi thams cad 'dus te gsangs 1nas ci'i phyir nyi 'og gi mi bdag cag gi yul du bros pa/ ngan pa 'dis bdag cag gi rgyal po gsad thudo zhes gros byas nas 'phral la dmag drangs te rgyal po gtubs /shepar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe yul gan dha ra na gnas pa'i dge slong thams cad mthong dgu bsad de dge slong gang zhig yul dbus su bros te thar pa de 'ba' zhig gson par 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu yul dbus ma gtogs par 'dzam bu'i gling 'di na dad pa med pa gsum 'byung bar 'gyur te/ byug 4ni la sogs pa mang po 3zhig gis rgyal po ni ta zig gi 67rgyal po byed par 'gyur ro/ /dru gu rus sna tshogs du mi'i 7rgyal po ni dru 8snagus byed par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan mang po zhig gi tsu7rgyal po ni bod kyi rgyal po ⑫byed par 'gyur ro/ /nyu1rgyal po de gsum ka muni yang sems mthun par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po de gsum la dmag dpa' ba/ brtul pod nyu5pa sum 'bum zhig yod pas yul dbus ma gtogs pa/gzhan yang dag pa'i lta ba 'dzin pa'i yul thams cad bcom nas mi mang po kha btags 6nas grong la sogs pa yang stongs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po de gsum 'dus nas yul dbus su dmag drangs zhes gros byed par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe na yul dbus kau shāsbyi zhes bya bar rgyal po bzod dka' zhes bya ba zhig 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de btsas pa'i tshe khrag gi char pa yang 11'bab lag pa gnyis kyang gru 7mo man chad khrag gis bskus pa lta bur dmar ba zhig yin no de'i blon po yan lag mchog dang ldan pa lnga brgya dang dmag mi 1 snagayul ngor dpa' ba nyis 'bum byung 15bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe ta zig shāspegi rgyal po la sogs pa gsum yul dbus kau shāsbyir song nas rgyal po bzod dka' tshol bar byed do/ /96byed1043

de nas rgyal po bzod dkas de skad rmyethos nas dmag dang chas te rgyal po de dag gi mdun du bsgugs nas zla ba gsum gyi bar du rgyun du g.yul chen po sprad pa dang / rgyal po dad pa med pa de gsum dmag dang bcas te gtan med par brlag par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po bzod dka' dmag dang bcas pa slar yul du 'khor nas rgyal po de 'di snyam du bdag gis 4mi mang po kha btags na/bdag gi 'gro ba ni ji lta bu zhig tu skye bar 'gyur/ nam zhig ngan song gsum las thar par 'gyur snyam du 'gyod pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po de la blon po rnams kyis gsol ba/ ma bsnyengs 4par dmar bu can gyi yul na dge slong shir sha ka zhes bgyi ba sde snod gsum la mkhas pa zhig bzhugs pas de spyan drongs dang / des lha khyod kyi las ngan pa de bshags par 'gyur ro zhes smra bar 'gyur la/ rgyal pos kyang dge slong de spyan drangs nas/ de'i mdun du las ngan pa ji yeltar byas pa thams cad lo rgyus smra bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong des kyang 'di skad du rgyal po khyod kyis shin tu ma legs pa byas kyi che thang du 'gyod la/'dzam bu'i gling 6gi dge slong thams cad 'dir spyan drongs la rtag tu yo byad lnga phul te/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang nyin gcig bzhin du dge 'dun gyi 7mdun du sdig pa shogs shig /khyod kyis mi mang po kha btags 8pa'i las bsrabs par 'gyur ro zhes smra bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas de'i tshe rgyal po des yul yul gyi dge slong rnams spyan 'dren pa gtong bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong rnams kyis kyang yul kau shāsbyi zhes bya ba na rgyal po bzod dka' zhes bya ba dge 'dun la yo byad lnga 'bul ba zhig yod do zhes thos nas yi rangs te/ yul kau shāsbyi zhes bya bar 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe yul kau shāsbyir dge slong 'bum 'du bar she'agyur ro/ /96byed1044

de nas tshes bco lnga'i nub mo dge slong rnams gso spyong la 'dus te dge slong shir sha ka bos nas khyed kyis lkuso sor thar pa'i mdo thon nacig ces smra bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong shir sha kas kyang 'di skad du khyed rnams la so sor thar pas ci zhig bya/mi sna dang rna ba gcad pa la me long gis rici zhig bya zhes smra bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas de'i tshe dge slong de dag gi nang na 5dgra bcom pa su ta ra 6zhes bya ba langs nas seng ge lta bu'i skad kyis dge slong shir sha ka la dz+wa'adi skad ces khyod byu'i phyir de skad ces smra kho bo ni bde bar gshegs pas bka' stsal pa bzhin bslab pa cig kyang ma nyams so zhes smras pa dang / dge slong shir sha ka shin tu skyengs par 9 'gyur ro/ /de nas dge slong shir sha ka'i slob ma a kan 7bi zhes bya bas dgra bcom pa de la 'di skad du khyod ci'i phyir nga'i slob dpon la mi mad sngar 11de skad smra zhes khros nas lag pa gnyis kyis sgo gtan blangs nas dgra bcom pa de gsod rtapar 'gyur ro/ /de nas dgra bcom pa de'i slob ma dge slong ka ra ta zhes bya bas kyang rang gi slob dpon gsad par mthong nas shin tu khros te dbyug pa blangs nas dge slong shir sha ka gsod par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe dge slong dag rim 1rtegyis khros nas phyog 1 gnyis su chad nas gcig gis gcig gsod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sum cu rtsa gsum gye lha thams cad der lhags te/dge slong shi ba'i ro de dag mthong nas ngud mos 'debs shing mchod pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong de dag gis mgos kha dog bsgyur ba dang skra dang sen mo yang lha'i gnas su khyer bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe yul der rlung dmar nag po dang / ser po dang 'dres pa ldang zhing dus dus su me'i char pa 'bab pa dang sa g.yo ba dang / 'ur sgra dang tug com dag kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de 96byed/045

nas rgyal po des skya rengs shar ba'i tshe 'di ltar dge slong thams cad kha btags gyopa mthong nas/ mya ngan gyis byegadungs pa'i rgyus mig gis dwares 'ga' ni mthong res 'ga' ni mi mthong bar 'gyur ba bzhin du pyong la/ gtsug lag khang du brgyugs nas cho nges cebatab ste/ dgra bcom pa dang dge slong sde snod gsum pa'i ming nas 'bod 'ucing de gnyis kyi ro pang gis 'khyud de/ 'di skad du kye sde snod gsum pa khyod ni bde bar gshegs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa lags/ kye dgra bcom pa khyod ni bde bar gshegs pa'i bslab pa'i ⑥gzhi 'dzin pa lags na/ da khyed gnyis nongs pas 'jig rten 'di stongs par gyur to zhes smra bar 'gyur ro/ /dam pa'i chos nub pa'i nub mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyang lha ma yin gyis pham par byas nas 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /de nyid kyi nub mo lha rtag tu myos pa'i nang nas lha 'di ni zhes bya ba 'chi 'pho bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'dzam bu'i gling de'i bu ram shing dang / rgun dang sbrang rtsi thams cad kyang nub par 'gyur ro/ /bdud dbang sgyur zhes bya ba yang 'chi bar 'gyur te/ de nas nas dang gro dang 'bras thams cad nub par 'gyur te/'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams kyi )zas su sre da dang khre rgod dang rtswa'i bye 'bras bu sna tshogs za bar 'gyur ro/ /dar dang za 'og dang man 7dri dang / ras bzang po la sogs pa yang nub nas gos su gso ras dang / re phyar la sogs pa gyon par 'gyur ro/ /gser la sogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan rnams kyang nub nas rgyan du rtswa las byas pa la sogs pa thogs par 'gyur ro/ /tshon bzang po dang ro zhim po rnams kyang nub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs rnams kyang klu'i gnas su 'khyer bar 'gyur ro/ /li yul gyi mkhan po 96—1046
